tei:div.tei:p: hā:bye ni gu/ 1 bca 'ab 3777ne bya 8330lung0606ba 'ang 5055'bya 17 bci kho migaXng khukhu po khor
— — — —3 — — — —sde / tre /pha go ji ༷ ༷ / nu ———tshu ri

dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib la jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur nyi dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang /lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dad cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o// rmispung lha'i bod rig pa dpe kun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyogs sgrig khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla blta pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdo/sgrig gsal bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb nyanas 4bar pod rtags (ka) (kha) (gnakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) 'a) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja spu (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags 6) ste rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags rton)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags 6)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (pe)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) (mi (che ka ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza/ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la bod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (ba)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma khong)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la ljang yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs snyel nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag bi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ rmad la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'brul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad dar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyog sgrig khang nas/bod sa grang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog cesabyar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / g.yin yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags spyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi po sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'brungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'a tu thol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhud chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srud gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam g.yin mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ga khug nang ba na dpe rnying 'tshos ba phyogs ga khang nas/16)

dkar chagarje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (1)'jig rten dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i phreng ba/ (161)khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar/ (234)dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs phreng / (246)'jam dpal dbyangs chos kyi rje dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ (388)khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ (414)byang pa rig 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ (476)

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)ra༅༅//rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhus/sa tre sna//༄7//bla na med pa'i ye shes mchogo gi yongs 'du'i ljon pa gsar pa gang //phul du byung ba'i bsod nams bye ba'i sa bon rgyu las byung pa'i tshul//2na skol bzang 'chi med tshogs la ston phyir gzugs sku'i rkang 'thung g.yur za ba//rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid gcig pu lus can kun gyi phan bde'i dpyid//2ba ) phyag na pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/khrims gnyis drang por srong zhing ches sgam pa//lha chos bdun gyi mes po 'byom rje sogs//ngo mtshar skye ba'i phreng ba bgrang yas mthar//dge tshogs rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser//dngos grub yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po las//bde legs char gyis rgya mtsho'i gos can kun//yongs khyab snyan pa'i gtam de tshar du dngar//bsod nams rang bzhin rgyas pa' rgya mtsho rje//blo gros rtoyis gzhal bar ches dka' yang //sngon byung khungs ldan gtam gyi bum bzang las//ngo mtshar yi ge'i snod du cung zad spel//dbyar dus chu 'dzin rgyas pa'i phang pa na//'brug sgra dal gyis rgod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis//rma bya'i yid la 'jebs pa'i dga' ba'i gar//rab bkra'i sgro gzhog zlum por bsgyur la brel//thub bstan zad pa med pa'i mchod sbyin sgo//skal bzang 'gro la brgya phrag 'byed pa'i ma//pad dkar 'dzin pa mi yi srid pa'i gzugs//'dzin de'i rtogs pa brjod pa cis mi spro//rab snyan dri za'i rgyud las legs drangs pa'i//'dzad med tshig gi 'dod 'jo'i rnam par thar//dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta zhes bya ba//gzur gnas yongs kyi dga' ston dpal du longs//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)de yang / dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams 'gro ba thams cad la ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes kyi mthus/ grangs med pa'i gzugs sku'i rnam rol gyis gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i phyir na/ thugs rje chen po phyag na pad+ma nyid kyi sku'i rnam par sprul pa 'di tsam mo zhes brjod pa'i yul (3na〉pas 'gong na'ang / ding sang yongs su grags pa/ glegs bam rin po cher/ khye'u gsal ba sogs 'khrungs rabs ches mang ba dang / khyad par thugs rje chen po nyid kyis 'dul ba'i zhing khams bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ glegs bam rin po che las/ spyir sems can rnams kyi mgon po yin/ /sgos gangs ri'i khrod du rgyal srid skyong / /zhes spyi dang bye brag gi dbye ba bstan nas/ bye brag bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal khams 'di nyid thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ 'bangasalta bu'i tshul gyis thul ba ma yin pas/ bod 'di rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ /ces pa'i lung bstan ltar/ thog mar rje gnya' khri btsan pos bod spyi la dbang sgyur/ de rjes lha tho tho ri gnyan shal gyi bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ de nas rim gyis srol btod pa ni/ glegs bam las/ rje dkon cog 'bangs 'di bod du 'gro/ /bod glo bur rgyal po chos la spyod/ /ces chos rgyal srong btsan sgam por lung bstan cing /de nyid kyis bstan pa'i srol btone pa yang / sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad yul gyi dbus/ /gnam 'khor lo rtsibasabargyad phub pa'i 'og /phyogs bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa'i sa/ /gnas phun sum tsho gos pa dam pa'i yul/ /mi khyod kyi zhing khams dam pa yin/ /gnas de ru las can dpag med 'du/ /zhes ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rten brten pa dang bcas pa rnams gsal bar bstan to/ /de rjes mi rabs 'ga' nas mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan du gyur te/ bod mtha' 'khob kyi lha (3ba)srin rnams gdul par bya ba'i slad du/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs te/ mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / mkhas grub lo paṇa rnams kyis 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin bo che dar rgyas su mdzad de/ji skad du/ lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/ 'jam dpal rdo rje der 'byon te/ /dpa' po chen —2

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)po bod du byon/ khri srong lde'u btsan bod rjer mdzod/ /ces dang / byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su bod na rigs btsun par grags pa thams cad kyis bkur ba zhig tu khyod kyis lus blangs te/ khyod kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa zhig /rgya gar nasang spyan 'dren du thong / da gzod mi rnams gnas skabasadang mthar thug gi bde ba la dgod par bya'o/ /zhes dang / deng sang gangs ri'i khrod du mi ma yin 'dul du btang ba'i sprul pa de slar 'di nyid du log nas skyon skyong zhing / mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud par byed la/ tsho gos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po yang bskor/ srin po gdug pa can yang des 'du pa/ zhes/ bla ma dri ma med pa nyid slob dpon chen po'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs dang / dkon cog 'bangs khri srong lde'u btsan du gsal bar bstan to/ /de rjes bstan pa phyi dar la/ 'brom chos gyi rgyal pos/ mnyam med jo bo chen po dbus gtsang du spyan 'dren pa dang / ra sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas btab ste/ bka' gdams kyi mes po mdzad pas/glegs bam le'u lnga pa las/ shar phyogs rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /spur rgyal bod kyi zhing khams grags pa can/ /sgos kha (4na tha can ljongs khyad 'phags na/ /nying sgos dbu ru byang phyogs de yi nang / /klungs shod nag po thob brgyud 'byom gyi yul/ /chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes/ /zhes lung bstan cing / gzhan yang kha che dgon pa ba/ sa chen kun snying / bla ma zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po/ mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer/ lha rje dge ba 'bum sogs skye sprul mtha' yas par bstan pas/de yang sa la gnas pa'i rgyas sras chen po rnams ni/ dus gcig tu skye sprul bgrang yas pa ston par nges pas na/ dus mtshungs su byung ba dang / rgyal sras gzhan gyi skyes rabs su mchis pa sogs la the tshom mi bya ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig la snang brnyan bye ba 'byung bas so/ /de nas glegs bam rin po che las/ chos dge ba bcu yis khyad 'phags pa/ /gling phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling / sgos myang shab sa yi lte ba ste/ /sa de yi nang nas khyad 'phags pa/ /mtho bkra shis brtan pa lhun po'i 'dab/ /nor pad+ma rā ga lta bur 'dun/ /zhes thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)dang bkra shis lhun por bcas pa lung bstan cing / de nas bu chos le'u lnga pa las/ shar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /gnas sbur rgyal bod ces bya ba yod/ /ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yod/ /mtsho dma' mo g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal yod/ /gangs dkar po shel gyi mchod rten yod/ /spang ser po gser gyi mchod rten yod/ /dri zhim po sman gyi bdug spos yod/ /tshon bkra ba gser gyi me tog yod/ /dbyar bkra ba g.yu yi me tog yod/ /kyai gangs ri'i (4bsgo gon po spyan ras gzigs/ /zhing de na khyod kyi zhing khams yod/ /zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /ces dang / nged mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi go ra la/ /yid rtag tu gusapas 'dud par byed/ /sa de la bzhugs te bstan pa skyong / nged mkha' 'gro bya ba 'bum gyis bskor/ /tshogs zag pa med pa'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /zhes glegs bam rin po che las gsal bar gsungs pa dang / /rig 'dzin las 'phro gling pa'i gter lung las/ rig 'dzin mang po bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /'ol dwags mtshams kyi lung gsum ljongs/ /dag gnas brgyad kyi gcig yin yang / /gzhi bdag mchod la gnas sgo phye/ /yi ger bri bar mi 'os kyang / /pad+mas phyi rabs don du bris/ zhes dang / skyon spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yis/ /lung gsum ljongs 'di 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang / bstan pa'i mjug tu bstan pa 'di nas 'byung / /khyad par gsang sngags bstan pa 'phel ba'i gnas/ /zhes sogs dang / gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gter ma las/sngon nub phyogs skyon gyi yul du byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas rigs mchog tu gyur pa'i tshe/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis chos rgyal in+d+ra bhu ti sogs 'khor mtha' yas pa'i nang du/ byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas rigs mchogo nyon cig /byang chub sems dpa' chen po khyod ni 'gro ba sems can gyi ston pa chen po ste/ ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar de srid du/ 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dam par 'gyur ro/ khyad par gangs can gyi yul du gzugs kyi sku'i skye ba blangs te sde snod gsum gyi chos kyis bstan pa dar bar byed (ldan༄nga 'gro ba'i don la spro bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' yas rigs mchogo gangs can gyi yul de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyis 'dul ba'i zhing —4

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)yin te/ yul gangs can de'i lta ba 'bigs byed kyi ljongs/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'dod khams dbang phyug chen mo/ bdud dang mu stegs kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ma/ dpal ldan gtso mo dbang gi rgyal mo gnas kyi srung ma byed pa/ yul gyi dbyibs ni e chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbyibs can/gnas kyi ming ni 'phags pa'i gnas rgyal zhes thun mong du grags pa thun mong ma yin par mkha' 'gro'i brda sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas de ni/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i gter la sogs pa/ nor dang chos kyi gter bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang yod la/ zhes sogs dang / gangs can gyi ljongs de ni byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs mtha' yas rigs mchog khyod kyi 'dul ba'i zhing du gyur pas na/ gnas de khyod kyi sde snod gsum dang bla med rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi bstan pa rab tu gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes ma 'ongs pa'i gnas dang gdul bya sogs lung bstan pa ltar/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos se 'bras bkra shis lhun po rnams kyi gdan sar phebs te/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mtha' klas (5ba tha grub pa mdzad pa dang / rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i mdzad chen lha sa smon lam chen mo'i nyams gsos la brten nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i gzhi dam pa legs par btsugs/ khyad par chos 'khor rgyal mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzheng ba sogs rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rgya chen po bskrun no/ / de yang gong du bka' gter gyi lung khungs mang du 'dren pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho gnyis ka chos de dag tshad mar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bris pa yin gyi/ ding sang la la dag gsang sngags snga 'gyu skru chos mtha' dag chos rnam dag min no zhes smra bzhin du rang chen po dang dam par sgrub pa'i tshe de dag gi lung 'dren pa'i bla chen bston ham can rnams kyi rnam thar dang mtshungs pa ni min no/ /mi 'gyur chos sku'i lha lam yangs pa'i —5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)ngos/ /sprul sku'i zla snang grangs med 'char ba yis/ /phan dang bde ba'i kun mud rgyas byed pa/ /bslu med rgyu las 'bras bu'i rten 'byung mtshar/ /sa dbang chos rgyal tshul dang ngur smig 'dzin/ /mkhas shing grub pa rig sngags 'chang ba sogs/ /gdul bya'i mos ngor 'tsham pa'i zlos gar la/ /spangs dang rtogasapa'i tshul kun gcig tu mnyam/ /med byung bsod nams kun gyi zhing gyur pa/ /don gnyis rgya mtsho rlabs ltar yol med du/ /lhun grub lag rtser stsol ba'i ngo mtshar gtam/ shes ldan rna ba'i bcud len 'di na'o/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang po de nyid gdul bya rtag 'dzin can (6na sgoms kyi gnyen por sku na smin pa'i tshul bstan te/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs spros bcas kyi 'phrin las rnams btang snyoms su mdzad de/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gtso bor thugs gzhol skabs 'di ltar bla ma rgas shing 'khogs pa'i lus 'dis rang g.yin gyi don gnyis bgyi bar gang yang rngo mi thogs pas/ de bas na da ni bla ma gzhen nur gyur pa zhig gi zhabs tog byed pa la dga' bar gyis shig ces dang / nga dang 'bras spungs pa la da dung las 'brel 'dug da nang mang ja med na'ang dung skad gsang ba bzhi byung / nga la 'khrul pa med pas sems la gzhogo cig khres dang / nga dang sne'u gdong gong ma chen mo khu dbon rnams la'ang las tshol 'dug /rtse zhabasadrung nas 'bul du btang ba yin zer/ rgyal mtshan bzhi byung ba dmigs pas/ de rnams sems la gzhog ces gsungs te/ de nas dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes brgyad la gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas zung 'jug ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'dra ba'i gar gyis mngon par rol pa na/ kha ba ri pa'i skye bo mang dag zhig gis/ sngon sku dngos 'i bzhugs pa dus su gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i sprul pa'i sku zla ba gsar ba'i rang gzugs myur du 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i gsung 'gyur ba med pa'i zhal gyis 'ches pa de ltar na/ da cha yul dus rigs sogs gang 'dra zhig tu 'byon par 'gyur zhes gleng ba'i tshe/ 'ga' zhig gi yar klungs bkra shis bde legs na mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i lung bstan gsal po yod pa'i rnal 'byor ba zhig la brtag pa zhus (6ba)pa'i yi ge ngo bo las 'di lta ste/—6

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (nyanan mo rat+na gu ru shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ yar klungs bkra shis bde legs su/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba'i drung du/ stag lo hor zla gsum pa'i nang du/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bsten pa/ slar yang bstan pa rin po che dang / sems can gyi don du sprul pa'i sku'i skye ba bzhes pa cig yong ba dang yul phyogs gang du 'byon/ dus ji tsam na 'byon lung bstan du gsol ces zhus pa'i lan du lung bstan pa ni/ bskal pa grangs med sngon rol du ma sa /tshogs gnyis rlabs chen mdzad pa rgya chen gyis/ /'gro ba dpag med thar lam 'god mdzad pa'i/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang gus pas ma chad/ /slar yang 'gro ba mtha' dag ma lus pa/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i 'khrul 'khor ji snyed kyis/ /lhag par byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /'gro ba'i don du dngos sam sprul pa yis/ /'gro rnams thugs rje'i thabs kyis 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /sprul pa'i sku yang zhing 'dir bltams pa las/ gdul bya rang rang re ba yongs bskangs nas/ /slar yang gzhan don 'phrin las rgya chen gyis/ /'gro ba'i don du sku yi bkod pa yang / /rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul nyid kyis/ /zhing mchog gzhan du 'pho ba'i tshul bstan pa/ da lta cho me nyid dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /gdul bya zhing khams yang dag ldan pa mā /bsams bzhin sku yi sprul pa ston pa yi/ /thabs shes rten 'brel 'dzoms pa'i rigs dag la/ /sku mchogo bltams pa'i sgrom bu g.yar tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don du slar yang sku sprul te/ /'gro ba mtha' dag 'khor (7na) ba'i 'dam chen nas/ /mthong thos dran reg smin grol lam la 'god/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rgya chen gyis/ /gdul bya gang dang gang la 'tsham pa yi/ /bla med chos 'khor yongs su bskor bar 'gyur/ /zhing mchog der yang sku tshe'i tshad rnams la/ /bar chad bdud kyi cho 'phrul mang tsam gyis/ /ha cang mtha' ru 'khyol ba cung zad dka'/ /sku yi skye ba len pa'i gas dag kyang / /dpal ldan thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzad nas/ /nyi ma shar phyogs byang dang khad nye ba'i/ /gdul bya'i rigs la gzigs nas thabs shes kyi/ /rten 'brel 'grig pa'i dus dang bstun byas te/ /lo ni gsum dang lnga las 'gyang mi srid/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong phyir sprul sku 'byung / /skal —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)ldan mtha' dag mos pa'i mchog 'gyur pa'i/ /lusang ga yid gsum gus pas gsol btab cing / /gang la mos pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchode/ /zhing mchog gang dang gang du sku sprul kyang / /zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs byas nas/ /lus can tshe 'di'i 'gal rkyen bar chad sel/ /mthar thug spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing mchog tu/ myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par the tshom med/ /de ltar sprul pa'i sku yi zhing mchog gi /snga phyi gnyis kyi rnam par thar pa tsam/ / legs bshad gsal bar bstan pa de ltar yin/ /zhes pa byung zhing / /gzhan yang mngon shes rdzu phrul mnga' ba'i chos srung du mas lung bstan dang / skal ldan du ma la dngos nyams ci rigs su gsal ba sogs mtha' klas par snang ngo / /de yang khang gsar gong du skye srid ma bzung ba'i (7bsngon dang / ye shes kyi sku'i ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i mdzad pa'i bkod pa grangasamed par bstan pa mtha' dag brjod par ga la nus/ 'on kyang cha shas tsam rje nyid kyi gsung las byung ba 'di ltar/ dang po ngas 'di nas dga' ldan du phyin pa'i tshe/ chos kyis mtho ba'i pho brang dam pa de na/rin po che'i seṅge'i khri la rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po bzhugs/ de'i sku gzhogos g.yas na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bzhugs/ g.yon na rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po bzhugs 'dug pa de dag mjal/ chosakyi bka' mchid mang du byung / gzhan yang der bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po 'dug pa de rnamasakyis kyang legs so brjod/ der rje rin po che'i drung du re zhig sdod snyam tsa na/ rje'i zhal nas khyed 'di ru ma 'dug par 'di nas dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su byon cig /ces gsung ngo / /de nas dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su phyin tsa na/ gnas der rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros gang ba'i dbus na/ ston pa shākya'i rgyal po/ rgyas ba tshe dpag med/ sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa bzhugs 'dug pa rnams mjal/ de na yang bla ma slob dpon ngo shes pa mang po 'dug /gsung gleng zhib tu byung / de'i tshe ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas 'ongs pa legs kyi/ de yang 'di nas dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du song zhig gsung / ngas bde ba can du yud tsam gyis phyin pas/ sangs—8

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ rton)rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i dbus na/ byang chub kyi shing ljon pa'i dbang po rgyas pa de'i drung na rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs (8na〉ning rgya che ba'i steng na/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na spyan ras gzigs dang / g.yon na phyag na rdo rje bzhugs pa mthong ste/ de dag la phyag dang bskor ba byas thugs dgyes pa'i bka' mchid kyang mang du byung / de nasangs yang srin po'i yul rnga yab gling du phyin tsa na/ yul mtha' zhig tu/ srin po mgo gcig pa byung nas gar 'byon zer/ nga srin yul la 'gro ba yin/ zangs mdog dpal rir 'gro ba'i lam gang na yod byas pas/ 'di na yar yod zer nas/ mtha' chen po phyogs gang nas kyang thar ba dka' ba zhig 'dug /yang srin po mgo bcu yod pa/ mgo re re la'ang mche ba tshad med pa bzhi gtsigasapa zhig byung nas/ srin yul la 'gro ba'i lam 'di na yod zer nas dar lam 'dra ba zhig brkyangs byung ba la kho rang song bas mthar ngas kyang ma thar pa'i ngang la/ der srin po mgo bcu gcig pa steng na rta mgo can zhig byung nas/ des me tog sna tshogs kyis mngon par gtor te/ 'di skad ces/ 'khor ba'i tsha gdung skyob byed chen po 'dir byon pa legs so kun tu 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin lta bus/ srin yul gyi dbus su/ lam 'di nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du byon cig zer nas/ gos chen 'dra ba'i lam zhig byung ba na/ de la phyin pa dang phyed tsam du slebs pa dang / der srin po mgo bzhi pa zhig byung bas/ nga'i rkang pa nas 'then du byung ba'i tshe mtha' chen po de las/ srung ma che chung gnyis byung ste/ de gnyis kyis brdeg stangs (8bshigs mo re byas byung ba dang / kho rang lhung song /de nas bde bar phyin te/ ngas srin yul du sleb ca na/ srin po rta mgo can de yang rjes su sleb byung / yul de ni yangs shing rgya che la yid du 'ong ba zhig 'dug /de'i nub phyogs la nye ba dang pad+ma'i gdan 'od can la/ ston pa bco me ldan 'das shākya thub pa bzhugs/ g.yas na di paṃ ka ra/ g.yon na 'jam dpal snying po bzhugs pa dang 'jal/ de'i tshe nga la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so/ da dung stong pa nyid kyi lta ba bsgom zhing / rtag tu 'gro ba'i don gyis shig gsung / de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)drung nas phyin tsa na/ grong khyer thams cad kyi dbus su/ zangs mdog dpal ri rtse gsum pa dbus na snying gi dbyibs can gyi steng na/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhi la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa lta bas chog mi shes pa'i rgyan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa can/ ri de'i mtha' kun nas srin po'i grong khyer dpag tu med pas yongs su bskor ba/ pho brang chen po de'i dbus na nyi ma'i gdan la gu ru dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid rigs 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la zab mo'i chos ston cing bzhugs/ yang de'i g.yas phyogs na jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha dang / g.yon na sa skya paṇ+ḍita chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan mdun na rje rin po che btsong kha pa chen po rnams bzhugs 'dug de dag gi drung na sngar gyi srung ma che chung gnyis po yang 'dug ste/ srung ma cheb de ni/ lus bongs che la (9na〉 dog nag pa/ shin tu 'jigasapa'i gzugs can/ ral pa dkar po'i thor cog bsgrengs pa/ sma ra dkar pos sked pa non pa/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis na ral gri ngang thod khrag 'dzin pa zhig 'dug /srung ma chung ba ni kha dog dmar po me ltar 'bar ba/ brtse khrab dang bse glog gyon pa'i ldem 'phru dar snas brgyan pa/ lag na mdung dmar dang zhags pa thogs pa/ stag ral dang / gzig shubs can/ bse lham dmar po gyon pa'i steng na an rgyab pa lta bu zhig 'dug pa/ de'i tshe nga449na rin po che la/ 'di gnyis su zhig lags zhug pas/ gu ru rin po che'i zhal nas/ nga'i bka' sdod yin pa rim gyis shes par 'gyur zhing / khong gnyis grogs su khrid la/ slar bod yul dbus su song zhig ces gsungs nas/ srung ma de gnyis kyang grogs su brdzangs so/ de nas de gnyis dang 'grogs te yud tsam gyis bod du 'ongs/ skyor mo lung / dga' ldan pho brang / bde chen rtse/ 'ol kha gzhis ka /e'i re sgo la sogs par snang yul re bltas te/ 'phyong rgyas kyi phu nas yud tsam gyis ri rab kyi steng du phyin pas/ de na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams phal cher 'dod pa'i yon tan la g.yengs 'dug /lha de rnams kyi nang nas lha'i bu mo 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig byung nas/ mdun nas bsus te bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas so/ /de ni dpal ldan lha — 10

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma yin par 'dug /de nas lha mo de kho mo'i skur gyur pa'i mdun na/sprul pa'i sprin dkar po mtha' 'ja' (9ba)ris sna tshogs rnam par bkra bar mdzes pa zhig ling nge 'dug pas/ de'i steng du dpal ldan lha mo rang nyid bzhugs te/ de'i phyogs gcig tu nga la yang 'dir byon gsung / der phyin pa dang sprin de'i sna las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros te mi yul du song / de nas dpal ldan lha mo dang lhan cig tu sprin la zhen nas 'od sna lnga'i lam nas yud tsam gyis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas stod lungs kyi mthil khang gsar gong gi gzhis gar yongs/ der a ma drung pa'i sku lus la gzhan zhig bzhugs nas/ nga sdod sa de bkag 'dug pas/ dpal ldan lha mos bgegs de phyi rol tu 'byin pa'i 'phrin las mdzad nas ma'i rum shin tu gtsang bar gyur pa dang / der ngas zhugs pa yin gsung zhes snang ngo / /e ma mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba bzhin/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i gar/ /dag pa'i zhing du bgrod dang lung bstan sogs/ /sgyu ma'i rol rtsed lta bur ston 'di mtshar/ /rgya chen thugs bskyed dbang phyogs sa 'dzin rtser/ /sprul pa'i rta ljang 'gog med rtag 'char na/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras mang pos bskul ba la/ /ltos pa'i tshul 'di gzhan la co 'drir nges/ /bde legs rgya mtsho'i mchod sbyin brgya phrag sgo/ /ma lus cig car 'byed pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /ma dmad btsan po'i go cha cher gyon pa/ /lag na pad+ma rang gi ngang tshul yin/ /de yang / glegs bam lung bstan las/ rtsod dus dgu yi tha ma la/ /bsod nams mchog gi mtshan ldan pa/ /bshad tsho gis rgya mtsho lta bu na/ /bstan pa'i me ro gso bar byed/ de dus khrims kyis(10na)cung zad lhod/ khrims ldan nyan thos yin zhes smod/ /mig gcig pa dang mche ba can/ khrims 'chal byol song skyong bar byed/ /ces dang / bod byang gi phyogs nas byang phyogs su/ /mi khyod kyi sprul pa dam pa zhig /'bangs mgon med mang po 'dren du 'gro /zhes pa'i lung bstan gyi dus la bab ste/ thamasacad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po 'di nyid sku bltams pa'i yul ni bod skyong ba'i —11—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)rgyal po mes dbon rnam gsum gyi dus su dbus gtsang ru bzhin grags pa las/ dbu ru'i sa dge bcu'i yon tan thams cad ngang gis 'du ba/ shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang gis nye bar mdzes pa'i skyid shod kyi yul gru'i cha/ stod lung mda' rtse kha khang gsar gong zhes bya bar/ rigs rus ni sngon chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su/ lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa/ sad mi mi bdun gyi nang tshan/ rma rin cen mchog ces grags pa nas bzung ste 'di pa'i gdung la mkhas grub kyi skyes chen mang du byon pa yin la/ dpal ldan sa skya bas hor rgyal po'i lung la brten nas bod kyi bdag mdzad pa'i tshe/ khri bskor bcu gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan rgya ma khri bskor gyi lung dang las kasamangon par mtho zhing / sde srid rin po che dpal phag mo gru pas/ 'phan po dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan la bran bkon gyi las ka gnang / rgyal chen rtse'i rdzong dpon du bskos te/ lugs zung gi mngon par mtho ba gang gi brgyud las/ phyi tha snyad rig pa sogs lugs gnyis la mkhyen pa rgyas shing / nang gsang (10ba)sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin la mngon par gzhol ba'i yab sde pa rnam rgyal grags pa dang / yum ni/ sdesrid phag mo gru pa'i dkon gnyer dpon sngags rnying ma'i rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug rin po che kun bzang rtse nas kyis sras mo dpal 'dzom bu khrid yin la/ 'di pa'i rus ni zin yin zhing / de yang dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku 'ad rdzing ji pa grags pa rin cen gyi rigs las byung ba'i lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod mthu stobs nus pas mngon par mdzes pa zhig go /rje thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid dgung zhag bdun phrag gnyis pa'i nub yum gyi lhums su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yum gyi mnal lam du/ rang nyid khang gsar gong gi rab gsal nas 'phur te/ shing ljon pa'i sdong po shin tu che ba zhig gi rtse mor byon pa dang / 'bras spungs phyogs nas nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gcig 'phur nas byung ba de rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa dang / nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i dbyings nas/ nyi zla gnyisamanyam du shar ba la skar ma 'od can lngas bskor ba gzigs pa dang / dge 'dun chos gos snam sbyar gsol ba/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / rol mo rnam pa mang pos bskor nas 'bras spungs la 'gro —12

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grubargya mtsho'i shing rta/ (nyanab yin zer/ ri mthon po gcig la 'dzegs pa dang / rang gi mkhur tshos gnyis las khrag gi mtsho rdol ba yin zer khrag rgyun rab tu zags pas/ sa steng thams cad dmar chil te byas par gyur pa sogs rmis shing / yab kyi mnal lam du'ang / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bdag chen zhig yin zer ba'i bla ma chen po 'gran zla (11na〉spred pa zhig 'byon pa yod ces de'i phebs bzhugs kyi grabs bshoms mang po byas pa dang / bla ma de nyid phebs pa'i dga' ston chen po byas pa byung gsungs shing / /mngon sum la'ang / sngon med pa'i spos kyi dri bsrung zhim po 'thul ba dang / de'i sang nyin nas bzung ste/ nyin re yang / nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' 'od kyis khyab pa dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor khang gsar gong gi steng gi nam mkhar sleb pa na/ de'i mtha' kun nas 'ja' tshon kha dog sna lnga pas yongs su bskor bas gdugs phub pa ltar mdzes pa dang / lha'i me rtag gi char 'bab pa sogs dge mtshan brjod kyis mi lang bas gnam sa bar snang gi khyon thams cad lta na nyams su dga' zhing yid du 'ong bar gyur to/ /de lta bu'i snga ltas rnams kyis yab yum gnyis thugs the tshom du gyur te/ sku rim la brtson par mdzad cing / sku rim gyi gtso bo chos rje yon mchog pa gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ khong pas kyang / sde pa tsho grub mtha'i thugs slong che ba'i grags pa yod pas/ sku rim la byon na legs mi legs kyi thugs dam brtag pa mdzad pas byon pa bzang ba babs/ mnal lam yang bzang ste/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gis 'bras spungs kyi chos dung de nyi ma la sros las bus dang gsungs pa na/ chos dung de nam mkha' las babs te/ na bza'i mthu bar blangs nas bus pas skad gsangs shin tu mtho ba 'jig rten kun gyi thos yod snyam pa zhig byung nas dgyes bzhin der byon te/ sku rim mdzad pasashin (11brko 'phrod pa byung ngo / /dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba'i sprul sku dpal ldan blo gros bzang po'i mnal lam du'ang /nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dbyings yangs shing rgya che ba la/ gser gyi seṅge re dang gser gyi 'brug —13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)re spel mar 'khod pa rnams go mtshams cung zad tsam gyi mtha' dbus kun tu khyab pa'i 'od kyis phyogs thams cad gsal bar snang ba zhig rmis/ de ma brjed pa'i ngang nas/ phyis zhabs drung rin po cher sprul sku 'phrang kha bas rnam thar gyi dogs gcod zhus pa'i tshe/ rje'i zhal snga nas sku gcings pa'i gong tsam du bdag la'ang rmi lam 'di lta bu zhig byung ba ji ltar lags na zhus pas/ khyod kyi rmi lam de nged la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ 'o na bzang lags sam zhus pas/ bzang ngan ci yin kyang / lta ba ni nga la lta ba 'dug /de yang rgol ba la 'jigs pa med pas seṅge 'dra ba dang / snyan grags 'brug sgra ltar kun tu khyab par 'gyur ba'i snga ltas yin gsungs/ de ltar yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa na/ sku lus bde zhing / byams pa dang snying rje dad pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa rgyas shing / srid kyi dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams kyang 'bad med du ngang gis 'du ba byung / yang de'i tshe/ sku gdung rin po cher mchod pa'i sprin chen po phul ba'i nang nas/ rgya spos rgyun mi chad du phul pa'i dud ba/ der cha gnyis su gyes nas/ cha gcig sku gdung rin po che'i bzhugs gnas zangs sgrom dar zab kyis klubasapa la bskor cing / cha gcig stod lung phyogs su nges par 'gro ba gang gis kyang (12na〉zlog tu med pa dang / pur sgrom gyi rtse la rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gsol ba yang stod lung phyogs su yo zhing bzhugs pa/ yang yang drang por bsrangs nas bsgran kyang sngar bzhin yo ba dang / drung gnas rin po che dpon slob rgyal la thegs ka sogs su sa g.yo ba dang / sgra grag pa dang / me rtag gi char bab pa sogs cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa byung ngo / /de yang yongs grags kyi chu stag zla ba lnga pa nyis brtsegs kyi bcu gcig pa'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa/ rgya nag rtsis gzhung lugs kyi mdzes byed ces pa chu mo yos kyi dpyid ra dang po'i nyer lnga la / gzugs sku chu shel gyi dbang po mngal gyi tshul 'dzin gyi rgya las grol te/ skal bzang kun da'i dpal du sku bltams so/ /dge mtshan 'dod rgu ma lus 'khyil ba'i yul/ /yul gyi lte ba lha ldan gtsug lag khang / /khang bzang dam pa'i nyi 'og khang gsar gong / /gong ma khri dpon rigs kyi —14

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)srid pa bzung / /rab dkar zla shel shel dkar brtsegs pa'i ri/ /'dab brgya pa de de bzhin be+eḍūr dkar/ mdangs 'od ma lus lus pa med bsdus pa/ gzugs sku 'dren byed byed por bdud rtsir byas/ /de yang grod dkar dri ma med pa'i gur khang sgo med pa'i sbubs su bzhugs pa ji ltar bya ba rngo ma thogs par/ re zhig lus pa dang / ji zhig na/ nyi 'od 'thungs pa'i pad+ma ltar grod pa dkar po'i me tog de rang gisang nga gis phye ba'i nang nas/ sprul pa'i sku khye'u lha'i sras po pas kyang mdzes shing lta na (12ba〉sdug pa/mthong na dga' zhing lta bas chog mi shes pa/ sku la dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dpe thams cad dang ldan pa/ sku stod la lha'i gos ka shi ka las kyang 'jam zhing gnyen pa'i khru ma dkar po'i chos gos gsol ba/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i ri mo rang byung du rnam par bkra ba/ zhabs pus man chad khyab pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ spyan gnyis ut+pa la'i 'dab ma ltar mdzes pas kun tu gzigs shing / cung zad ba 'ad pa'i tshul du 'dzum mul le bzhugs pa mthong ngo /mthong nas kyang yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang dga' zhing spro la/ yid bde bas dga' zhing ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i 'du shes skyes par gyur to/ /yang de'i tshe pho brang dam pa de ni sngar bas kyang stong 'gyur gyis lta na sdug cing nyams dga' la bag phebs par gyur te/ yul de'i skye bo las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis ni/ de'i nub mo khang pa brtsegs pa de me ri me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i ra gur gyi dbus na lham me lhang nge lhan ner 'dug pa mthong ngo / /gzhan yang kun la mthun snang du grub par/ phyogs thams cad phyis pa ltar dag cing gsal bar gyur pa las/ 'ja' ris rnam par bkra bas rma bya'i gtsug phud bkram pa ltar mdzes pa lha'i me tog gi char rnams lding zhing 'bab pa/ lha'i spos kyi dri bzang ni kun nas 'thul ba la sogs pa'i dge mtshan gyis mtho ris kyi gnas sa la babs pa ltar gyur to/ /yab yum de gnyis las sngon du yang lcam sring mang du 'khrungs kyang /(13na)phal cher snga ma'i sri thog tu gshegs pas 'jigs nas yab yum gyis sri gnon pa'i thabs dang rten 'brel mang du mdzad/—15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)khyad par du'ang chos rje yon mchog pa'i grub mtha' mi mthun yang thugs dad song bas/ sras kyi sku srung pa zhus/ mchod pa'i thog mar ra mo dkar mo'i 'o ma zhal du gsol/ sri thar zhes pa'i bud med nu zho yod pa zhig ma mar bskos/ sras kyi mtshan yang ra nu sri chod dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ chosarje yon mchog pas ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang dang skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang phul/ de nas sku'i skyed bsring ba'i tshe/ byis pa gzhan gyi lo bskyed pas/ gzhen nu de nyi ma zla bskyed lhag par che bar gyur to/ /de yang sku 'byungs nas zla ba gsum lon pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ nang par tho rangs rtag tu sngar bar sku tsog bu'i tshul du bzhugs shing / ma ma yang gnyid las slong bar mdzad de/ phyag gis skra nas 'then zhing / ma ṇi zhes gsungs nas tsog pur sdod 'jug par mdzad do/ /de yang rang bzhin gyis brtan cing sgam pa/ zhi zhing dul ba/ nges shing gtsang sbra dang ldan pa/ thugasam zhus zhing ma khengs pa/ sran che zhing gang la yang mi 'jigs pa/ ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa/ chosadang chos ma yin rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pas/ blang dor gyi gnas rnams la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog par rang stobs kyis phyag len la 'debs shing / rtag tu (13ba〉sems can la thugs brtse bas legs par gzigs pa sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'gyur res kyang g.yin dad pa skye ba la mkhas pa/de'i drung du su dag byung yang / de dag la byin rlabs gnang ba'i phyag rgya ston cing dgyes dgyes ltar mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rang bzhin du bzhugs so/ /lo 'di nang du drung nas rin po che rgyal du byon te/ gser tog gi bzo 'phro dang khyams smad kyi logs ris rnams mdzad pa'i tshe/ de nas mtshams dam pa zhig gi skabs/ nub gcig tho rangs kyi mnal lam du/ mgon khang gi steng nas gzigs pas klongs la ngos nas bang chen mi reng gnyis byung ba dang / mgron gnyer blo bzang la su yin ltos shog gsungs pas/ khong gi de gnyis kyi lag nas/rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' shog yin zer ba'i yi ge hung la zhig khyer byung ba de 'phral phye nas —16

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (nyanagazigs pas/ gsung rab pas go dgos rgyu la/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug der 'byon pa yod pas grabs yul ma thogs pa gal che gsung ba zhig 'dug pas/ de 'phral du gzims chung bka' gdams pho brang du bzhugs gdan gsham pa sogs/ phebs grabs kyi bkod pa thams cad legs par mdzad de/ spos phor bsnams nas phyi logs su gdan 'dren la byon pas/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bco lnga byon pa'i rjes su/ glang po che'i phrug gu shin tu yid 'dzin pa 'dzam bu'i gser gyi 'od 'tshar ba zhig byung ba de rnams gzims chung nang du thegs grub kyang / da dung gnas brtan chen po (14na gi cig byon te 'ong snyam nas/ sgo'i phyi rol der phebs bsgugs zhu zhing bzhugasayod tsa na/ nang nas gcig na re/ gnas brtan chen po gcig glang po che'i phrug gu 'di ka yin/ nga nang du spyon gsungs byung ba dang nang du byon tsa na/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bco lnga po rnams 'bor gyi tshul du gral gyi mtha' la bzhugs shing / de dag gi dbus su/ sngon rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzhugs khri yin snyam pa'i khri rin po che sna tshogs pas phra bkod pa seng ges bteg pa'i steng na glang po che'i phrug gu de gtso bo'i tshul du bzhugs 'dug pa zhig rmis gsungs/ /yang de'i tshe nub cig gi mnal lam du/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ rgyab ri'i rtse 'dir myur du shog gsung ba zhig byung ba dang / ri de'i rtsel 'dzags byon pas/ ri rtse de na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la dus bzhi'i lha mos bskor nas bzhugs 'dug pa gzigs te/thugs la ci yin/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa ni bzhugs mi 'dug /dpal ldan lha mo la dus gzhi'i lha mos bskor ba 'ong ste/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la dus bzhi'i lha mos bskor ba 'di ci yin snyam du dgongs pa dang / dus bzhi'i lha mo rnams yum la thim yum rdo rje phag mo yang yab la thim pa'i mthar/ thams cad nga rang yin gsung ba dang / mnal sad pa zhig byung gsungs/ drung nas rin po cher mnal lam gyi tshul du/ thams cad mkhyen pas sprul pa yang sprul gyi bkod pa sna tsho gos ston pa (14ba)dang / gsung gi snang ba stsal ba sogs mtha' yas pa'i ngo mtshar byung 'dug /khang gsang gong du chos— 17

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)rje yon mchog pa dpon slob rnams sku rim mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sprul pa'i sku gzhen nur gyur pa de khong dpon slob la shin tu nga rgyal pa'i rnam 'gyur ston cing / rol mo dang gtor ma mchod rdzas sogs la yang nas yang du gzigs pa dang / rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol ba sogs la sngon gnas rjes dran gyi nyams mtha' yas pa mdzad/ skabs shig khong dpon slob kyis gtor ma'i grangs dang go rim sogs rje gong ma'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin du bshams nas gzigs su phul te/ khyed bla ma zhig gi sku skye ni yin pa 'dra/ gal te nga'i bla ma de yin na ni gtor ma 'di rnams ji ltar yin pa 'dug ces zhus pa'i tshe/ 'di dang 'di'o zhes rim pa bzhin du ngos 'dzin zhabrul med du mdzad/ gzhan yang khong dpon slob kyi rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs rnams la/ thugs dgyes pa'i nyams ci yang mdzad cing / dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra la yang lhag par dgyes pa'i tshul ston pas/ sku 'khor ba rnams kyis kyang thugs gzung ba'i ched du rol mo 'bul bas dus 'da' ba dang / khyad par sku rim pa dpon slob kyis rol mo dkrol ba'i tshe/ gar+sha ne nu spyan 'byed 'dzums brag tu mdzad cing / zhal nas ma hā bā la a bya ta bya zhes gsung zhing / thugs 'dun drag po'i tshul ston pa'i tshe zil chen pos kun kyang spu zing zhes byed par gyur to/ /de nas dgung zla brgyad tsam bzhes pa'i tshe/ yul gangs can gyi ljongs na kun tu rgyu ba'i dka' (15na)thub pa chen po/ rin po che kre po chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes grags pa'i drang srong chen po slob ma'i 'khor brgya phrag du mas bskor ba zhig /phyogs der bsod snyoms kyi phyir byung ba dang / sde pa yab yum gyisamagron du spyan drangs te/ phyag dang mchod pa phul nas chos dang byin rlabs zhus so/ /yang de'i tshe sprul sku gzhen nu de yang yum gyi pang du spyan drangs te/ bla ma bgres po lo brgya lon du nye ba de la byin rlabs zhu bar brtsams pas/ thugs khrel ba'i rnam 'gyur ston cing / nyid kyi dbu phyir bskyed de/ yum gyi thugs ka'i nu bar du gtad nas/ yan lag mchog gi spyi gtsug ni bltar yang mi snang bar mdzad/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya ni sprul gyi gdengs ka bzhin 'phyar/ zhabs—18

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (3)kyi pad+ma'i mchu ba ni glang po che'i sna ltar brkyangs nas/ drang srong chen po de'i dbu la phyag dbang dang zhabs dbang gnang bar chas te/ spyan 'bur tshugs su gzigs pa zil gyis mnan pa dang / der tshogs pa'i mchod yon rnams ha las te ngo mtshar du gyur to/ /drang srong chen po de'i zhal nas kyang /khong rang nga las lhag pa zhig yin 'dug pas nga la byin rlabs mi zhu yod/ da phar gdan drongs gsung /phyis sbyin bdag gzhan gyi nang du phebs pa'i tshe/ rin po che dpon slob rnams khang gsar gong du phebs pa gnang 'dug pa/ der 'bras spungs chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku skye 'khrungs 'dug zer ba bden par 'dug lags sam zhus pa'i tshe/ rin po che kre po'i zhal nas/ 'bras spungs chos rje'i sku skye ni yin min ma shes (15bti na nga las lhag pa'i sras po gzhen nu zhig 'dug gsung ngo zhes grags/ tshul de thos pa thams cang 'di snyam du e ma ho/ /'byungs nas zla ba brgyad lon pa'i gzhen nu des/ bla chen bgres po de lta bu yang zil gyis gnon par nus pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin par gdon mi za'o zhes phyogs bral gyi skye bo dag dam pa de nyid lta ba la pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa bzhin du swa bar gyur to/ /spyan gyi pad+ma rnam par ba 'ad pa dang mnyam du/ dpal ldan lha mo phyag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod pa nor bus gang ba bsnams pa bzhen pa med pa zhig gzigs pa de zhal gzigs kyi thog ma yin 'dug /g.yul khar ma mas khur te sku sangs la phebs pa'i tshe/ ljon shing gi sdong po'i rtse nas dpal mgon zhal khā can byon te/ khyad par nga tshe rabs snga ma nas las 'brel yod pa yin pas mchod gtor phul zhig gsungs/ skabs shig blon gong rgyal pos glags lta ba'i ched du/ ban+de ma rungs pa'i gzugs kyis bar chad byed par brtsams pa na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed bdud las rnam par rgyal ba byon te/ nag po'i phyogs de dag tshar bcad pa dngos su gzigs/ dgung lo gsum lon pa sna tshogs dbyig ces bya ba shing mo sprul gyi lo/ chos sder po skyor mo lung du byon pa'i tshe/ chibs thog tu dgongs skyems zhus pa na/ zhal dkar 'phangs pas ma chag pas kun ngo mtshar du 'dzin/ de nas dgon par — 19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)phebs pa na/ phyogs de'i skye bo rnams kyis 'di ni rgyal sras dam pa'i ngang tshul ma gags/ tha mal (16na)gyi spyod tshul cung zad tsam yang mi mdzad pas/ skyes bu dam pa zhig yin par gdon mi za zhes dar dir du gleng zhing / la la dag thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sku skye yin pa 'dra zhes gleng ba la brten/ dpon sa gdung brgyud rin po che mi'i dbang po bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gzhis gar spyan drangs/ de'i tshe yab kyis phyag dang mjal dar khyed rang gis 'bul lam ngas tshab byed zhus pa la/ nged rang gis 'bul gsungs nas mjal dar de gdung brgyud rin po che'i phyag tu phul te/ phyag ma mdzad pas/ mi dbang chen po de nyid kyis tshod brtag pa'i phyir du phyag dbang gnang bar brtsams pa na/ sku phyir sgeg tsam mdzad de spyan hur re bzhugs pas/ gdung brgyud rin po ches 'o na nged la byin rlabs shig gnang bar zhu zhes dbu dud mdzad pa na/ tshur byon nas dbu thug cig mdzad pas kyang thugs yid lhag par ches par gyur/ de'i chos bdag rgyal por mchod pa'i sprin phung bla na med pa'i dpal 'byor chen po la rol par mdzad/ mi'i dbang po des mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i thugs dam thang kha zhig gzigs su phul nas/ 'di ngo e mkhyen sdos/pas/ los shes 'di'i rjes gnang nged kyi phul ba yin gsungs pa na/ sngon thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho la dpon sa gdung brgyud rin po che phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gsan pa thugs kyis dran te/gzhan du dogs pa'i the tshom gyi dra ba mtha' dag 'bad med du chod/ rje gong ma'i phyag sil hor sil zhig yod pa de (16bsko rigs pa na nga'i yin zhes ngos 'dzin mdzad/ drung 'khor rnams kyis phyag dbang zhus pa na/ drag zhan 'bring gsum la phyag dbang gnang lugs sogs sgo du ma nas kun yid ches so/ /de nas khang mo cher sku mtshams kyi ngang du bzhugs pa na/ yul phyogs gzhan dag rnams su 'brum nad sogs kyis khyab na'ang / rje 'di gang bzhugs pa dang nye ba'i phyogs kun tu nad dang rims dang dus ma yi na pa'i 'chi ba sogs pa dkar min gyi 'bras bu mtha' dag rgyang ring du bsrings shing / char chu snyoms shing rtsi bcud dang lo tog rnams 'phel ba/ skye bo rnams phan tshun du gnyen gshin —20

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)pa'i ngang tshul du gyur pa sogs legs byas kyi 'bras bu bla na med pa'i dga' ston la yongs su sbyong bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe nag phyogs kyis bdud rigs 'ga' zhig gis bar du gcod pa brtsams pa na/ dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor gyi rgyal mo byon te tshar gcod pa dngos su gzigs/ nyin gcig 'od kyi gur khang zhig 'dug pa la phyag mang du mdzad pas/ sku 'khor rnams kyis ji ltar lags zhes zhus pa la/khyed rnams kyis ma mthong ngam/ rje rin po che bcong kha pa byon te da lta'ang bzhugs 'dug gsungs/yang phyogs bzhin yang btsal nas/ rje rin po che'i phyogs bzhin sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa bzhugs 'dug shar phyogs pa rnams sngon po/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser po/ nub phyogs pa rnams dmar po/byang phyogs pa rnams ljang khur 'dug gsungs/ nyin gcig nga la bar chad rtsam pa'i ban+de zhig 'dug pa de dpal ldan lha mos bsgral nas da (17na〉lta 'di khar bzhugs 'dug /ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa yang byon byung / k+ṣe tra pā la 'dis mi mgo zhig khyer 'dug gsungs/ /gzhan yang / klu sgrub/ thogs med/ slob dpon pad+ma/ jo bo rje/ birnya pa/ sa ra ha sogs rgyal ba'i sras mtha' yas pa'i sku'i snang ba gzigs/ jo bo rje nga'i bla ma yin/ 'di na bzhugs pa khyed rnams kyis ma mthong ba e yin gsungs/ bar bar du bzhugs stan gyi steng du/ sku drang por bsrengasate ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog cing / res 'ga' ni rgyal mdun ma dang / dmigs brtse ma sogasabla ma'i bstod pa dang / ya ma rā dza dang / bh+yoḥr smo bh+yo sogs sngags mang po gsung zhing / phyag sil bde mo zhig yod pa dkrol ba las/ byis pa'i rtsed mo phal pa mdzad pa'i skabs med pa yin no/ /nang gcig snga bar chos sde'i tshogs dung bus pa gsan pa dang / nga'i na bza' khur/ mang ja'i bsngo ba la 'gro ran gsungs/ /nyin gcig lcang rar gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ rje gong ma'i sku 'dra rin po che zhig bzhugs pa de la phyag reg nas 'di nga'i sku yin/ rgyab na yi ge yang yod gsung ba bzhin/ zhal thang de'i rgyab na gzungs sngon gyi phyag bris ma yang yod 'dug pas/ nang pa lcang ra ba 'khor bcas dad pa'i sa la —21—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)bkod/ gzhan yang chos rje yon mchog pa la/ rje gong mas gnang ba'i phyag dril gcig yod 'dug pa de la gzigs pa dang / 'di ngas byin pa yin yang gsungs/ de dus skyor mo klung na dpon sa gdung brgyud rin po ches sbyin bdag mdzad pa ste/(17ba)gong ma'i dngul gdung rin po che 'bras spungs na bzhugs pa 'di bzhengs pa'i skabs sprul sku 'phrang kha bas/ thig rtsa dang bkod pa byed pa'i bar skabs zhig tu phyag 'bul la phyin/ rje gong ma zhing g.yin du thegs gar gnang ba'i bka' 3(ga gi mtha' ma de gzigs su phul bas/ yud pa gcig gzigs nas thugs dam gyi steng du phyag sor reg ste/ 'di nga'i the'u tshe yin pa 'dug gsung ba sogs ngos 'dzin mdzad pa ni grangs kyis mi chod do/ /de'i tshe paṇa chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa rnam dpyod mchog gi sdes skyor mo klung tshogs pa la mnyam med jo bo yab sras kyi gsang chos thun mong ma yin pa glegs bam bu chos kyi spyi chos mdzad pa'i tshe/gzims spyil gyi thog kha nas gsan pas/ pu shu nas chos grwa'i phyogs su gzigs te/ chos rje bsod nams grags pa nga'i rnam thar 'chad kyi yod dam/ gsol ja zhig la 'dir phebs dang gsungs pas/der 'khod pa'i skye bo thams cad 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po gdon mi za bar slar byon pa'o zhes mgrin gcig tu gleng zhing / tshogs pa thams cad dad pa'i shugs chen pos chos gsan 'phro la har bzhengs mdzad de/ phyag btsal nas 'brom rin po chen rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas khyed la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o zhes sogs dar dir du grags par gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'ol kha stag rtse nas sa skyong a mo gha rdo rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang po zhes rje gong ma la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can de'i zhu yig rten bcas phul ba'i tshe/ me tog gi char bab cing / la la dag zhu yig gi steng du chags pa byung bar ngo mtshar (18na tha'i gnas su byed do/ /slar yang khang gsar gong du phebs/ phyag ris 'bri klog gi tshul bstan par/ dka' tshegs med par brda tsam bstan pas mkhyen zhing / mdor na bzo'i rig byed sna tshogs dang / sgyu rtsal sna tshogs dang / bstan bcos sna tshogs dang /yul skad sna tshogs dang / snyan ngag /sdeb sbyor/ rol mo dkrol brdung / gsang ri sngags ga sngags —22

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (nyanagazungs sngags kyi khyad par/ sngon dang phyi ma'i gnas mkhyen pa sogs bag chags bzang po goms pa'i nyams sad pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa phra mo res kyang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che bskrun par nus so/ /gzhen nu rol rtsed kyi tshe/ tha mal gyi spyod tshul thams cad rgyang ring du bsrings te/ chos 'chad pa/ ting nge 'dzin sgom pa/ dgos pa 'debs pa/ rdo mang po gral du bsgrigs te chos skyong 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba yin no zhes mchod bstod mdzad pa sogs kyis dus 'da'o/ /grwa pa zhig mjal du 'ongs nas/ rje btsun btsong kha pa'i sku zhig phyag tu phul bas shin tu mnyes mnyes mdzad/ steng mthon po la bzhugs su gsol te phyag dang mchod pa phul/ yab yum la phyag mchod phul zhig gsungs pas/ nged ni khyed kyi bla ma de la dad pa med zhug par/ nga'i bla ma khyad par can 'di la ma dad na/ khyed rang rnams dal 'byor stong log tu song ba yin zhes gsungs nas mi dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pas/ 'o na nged gnyis kyis phyag 'tshal zhing sku mi tshad tsam zhig bzheng ngo zhus pas mnyes te/ dmigs brtse ma gsung ngag nas slob par mdzad (18ba8/ dmigs med brtse ba'i gyis/ gter chen spyan ras gzigs gyis/ zhes sogs tshig rkang re re la spor thengs gnyis gnyis mdzad nas slob pa gnang / yang lan gcig ni/ yab kyi phyag dpe rnams kyi khrod nas/ dpe cha grasathung gru bzhi rgas se ba rnying pa zhig phyag tu bsnams byon nas/ mchod gnas brgyad stong pa klog pa'i mdun du/ dpe chung de gcal du bkram nas/ de'i steng du zhabs skyil krung bcas te bzhugs pa'i tshe/yab der byon nas/ a po chos rje nga'i dpe cha lag dan mdzad pas yin/ 'o na 'di yang thing zhig gsungasanas/ brgyad stong pa'i shog bu zhig 'dings grabs mdzad pa'i tshe/ kyi sras zhal nas rgyal ba'i bka' yin pas mi rung gsungs/ yab kyis 'o na 'di ci yin pa 'dug pa zhes zhug pas/ 'di ni lta log bon po'i dpe cha yin par 'dug ga /gsungs nas bzhengs song ngo / /de nas re zhig na nga'i bu 'di 'jig rten thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sprul sku zhig ni yin nges na/ su zhig gi sprul pa yin/ gal te 'bras spungs chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)yin nges na gang sa nas legs pa 'dug /gang ltar yang brtag par bya ba mang du byed dgos dgongs nas/ skyor mo klung gi chos sden/ gnas brtan zla ba bya ba/ sgrol mas lung bstan gsal por yong ba yod pa la/ 'di skad du/ khyed kyis nga'i gzhen nu 'di rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku skye yin min brtag pa mdzod cig gsungs pas/ gnas brtan pas kyang gal po cher brdung nas/ mtshams dam par bcad de/ lhag pa'i lha sgrol ma la gsol ba btab nas (19na)don de gsal bar lung bstan du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ tho rengs zhig gi rmi lam du/ mi dkar po zhig na re/ rnam dag mkha' dbyings rab gsal yangs pa la/ /sa 'di'i 'od stong nor bu legs 'bar bas/ /'dzam gling gangs can nor bu rab gsal ba/ /bsam zhing sprul par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs mtshamasakun tu grags pa'i dpal mnga' zhing / /'od stong 'bar ba'i sku yi rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /rnam dag gdul bya'i 'gro la bu ltar brtse/ /'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter mnga' zhabs brtan mdzod/ /'di ni dge 'dun grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /sa dga' 'phags pas gangs can zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /des mtshon te rnal 'byor pa thugs dam gyi gdengs dang ldan pa du ma la yang / rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul pa'i sku min par lung bstan dngos nyams ci rigs su byung ngo / /de la brten nas mchog dman gyi skye bo mang dag /sde pa rnam rgyal grags pa'i sras ya mtshan can 'di 'bras spungs chos rje'i sprul pa'i sku yin pa 'dug zer ba la brten de'i skabs drung nas rin po che 'bras spungs su rje gong ma'i dngul gdung bzheng ba dang / rgyal du mchod khang chen mo'i gser tog bzheng ba sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i mdzad pa brlabs po che'i skabs/ gong gi gnas tshul rnams gsan pas/ e ma ma la rje gong ma de'i sku tshe'i mjug tu skyor mo klung gi gzhis kar phebs pa'i tshur lam/ khang gsar gong du (19bskod na du drangs par/ bka' las/ da lam nged khams cung zad ma bde ba 'dis 'ong mi thub pa 'dug pa nas/ sde pa zhal ngo dang mjal spro ba yod pas/ ma tsongs par de tsho 'grub pa'i —24

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)'dun pa rtse gcig tu byed pa yod zhus ang gsung ba'i zhal bzhes bzang po zhig kyang de dus gnang yod cing / de nas tshur phebs lam/ khang gsar gong gzhis ka de gzigs ma gzigs kyi sa mtshams skyar po'i mchod rten gyi drung du chibs las gzhol ba gnang / chibs pa de yang brje dgos pa byung ba'i rten 'brel dang da lta skye bo rnams kyis gleng ba sogs gang dang sbyar na'ang / rje bla ma de'i rnam par sprul pa ni yin pa/ de lta na'ang rtab rtob tu ngos bzung na/ gal srid min pa lta bu zhig byung tshe bla ma'i zhabs 'dren du yang 'gro ba 'dug cing yin bzhin da yal bar bor na/ tshul ma yin pa'i bya ba 'di las che ba gzhan na med pa lta bur 'dug pas/ 'di ni phungs 'tshengs kyi gzhi chen por gda' ba nas/nged rang ngos kyis phyin te brtag dpyad zhib par bya'o snyam du dgongs te/ gser rtag gi bzo 'phro sogs rgyal gyi gnyer pa chos skyong dpon g.yog la bslab bya mdzad nas/ 'bras spungs su byon/ shing 'byug zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rengs snga bar bzhengs te/ dpon g.yog nyung bsdus gsang thabs kyi khang gsar du 'byon par chas pa'i tshe/ gnas chung lcog tu sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po rdo rje 'od ldan dkar po thog phebs su sku khog tu zhugs nas/ kye grogs po gsung rab pa khyed cag da nang tshab tshub ma mang / nyi mar shar ba la sgron me 'degs mi dgos/ da dung re zhig glod la gzhog /ma 'gyungs par (20na lhan 'brel legs tshogs su 'grig pa'i tshe/ khyed cag 'gro ba dang lhan cig tu nga yang de'i drung du 'gro/ de dus nga'i phyag mjal gyi dar dkar po gru bzhi 'di sngon la phul na/ legs tshogs rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu 'ong la yod pas/ mi mngon par nged rang gis 'phul te/dngos su grogs pos phul zhig /ces bkra shis kha btags dkar po dri ma med pa zhig gnang nas/'di ngas dgos pa 'di la bsams te/ rgyab na mar pa bsod nams zla ba la khyed shog byas/ lo sngon ma nas dmegs pa yin/ the tshom dang brtag dpyad gang yang dgos pa med gsungs byung bar brten de res bskol lo/ /de'i tshe sde pa yab yum rnams rang la bu ngo mtshar ba 'di 'dra zhig byung na'ang / ngo mtshar ba'i snyan —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)grags la brten/ phugs rang nyid kyis srid 'dzin pa la phan par dka' zhing gsang ba'i nus pa dman pa lta bur gyur mchis na'ang / da dung re zhig gsang ba las 'os med snyam du sku mtshams kyang dam par bcad/ 'khor rnams la ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad ba rnams phyir mi bsgrag pa'i dam bsgrags so/ /de'i tshe drung nas gsung rab pas/ sras mjal du byon chog pa'i sde pa la zhu yig phul ba'i lan du/lags/ ma bsgrags par yang grags pa can/ /bdag gi gzhon nu 'di nyid ni/ /gang yin de ni su yis shes/ /de lta na yang phyogs kun nas/ /bu chung grags chen 'di la ni/ /lta zhing rtog tu kun 'ong na/ /khyed cag lta bus cis mi gzigs/ /bu 'di mjal du 'byon par mdzod/ ces zhu 'phrin phul ba de gsan pas sras kyi zhal nas/ drung nas bya ba gcig las med/ kho la 'di ru shog cig gyis/ zhesagasung / /(20ba 〉 sbo 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i gza' skar legs pa la/ drung nas rin po che dpon slob nyung bsdus khang gsar gong du byon pa'i sngon 'gros su/ sngon gyi drung yig pa chos kyi dpal 'byor legs pa/ zhabs drung gong ma'i chibs pa bzhen te song ba/ gzhis ka'i sgo drung du nye bar sleb pa na/ ma ma la/ nga'i rgya mtsho 'ong gi yod pa 'dug rta g.yul rgyal sleb byung / g.yul rgyal shog shog snying re rje gsungs/ de nas yum la/ ma ki na dge bshes yig mkhan gyis bzhen pa'i rta de nga'i yin gsung mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ drung nas rin po che dang chos mdzad blo gros pa dpon g.yog rgyang nas 'byon pa gzigs pas/ a li nga'i rgya mtsho sleb byung / blo gros pa yang byung gsungs nas zhabs bro mdzad/ de nas khong dpon slob dang sdo pa mchod yon gdan 'dzom pa'i tshe/ sras gdan 'dren par btang bas/ nga a bar du song pas ngo tsha gsung thugs 'tsher ba'i rnam pas yol ba'i phag nas gab snyug mdzad cing ba 'ad/ de nas gsol ja dang po'i thog tu bzhugs gdan la phebs pa na/ drung nasarin po ches thog mar chos skyong chen pos 'bul rgyu bskur ba'i kha btags kyis sna drangs/ dpon slob tshang mas mjal dang rim bzhin phul/ der nam mkha' dag pa dang / me rtag gi char/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ dri bzang po'i ngad pa thul ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mtha' yas pa byung / rje gong ma'i thugs —26

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)dam 'bras spungs rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku li ma zhig bsnams yod 'dug pa de mchod gral du bzhugs su gsol bas/ gzigs ma thag bzhedas nas dbu dang thugs ka sogs su gtugs te gus pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ nga'i (21na sko yin zhes gsungs nas der 'khod pa kun la byin rlabs re gnang / rje gong ma'i hor shel gyi phyag 'phreng zhig drung nas kyi phyag na yod pa de la gzigs nas/'di nga'i 'phreng ba yin 'phreng thag de brje dgos pa yod gsungs/ phul bar mgul du bzhes/ nga'i chos gos/ snam sbyar/ paṇa zhwa rnams gang na yod gsung ba sogs 'khrul pa med pa'i yid ches pa byung / dpon slob gnyis ka thugs yid gcig tu 'dres te/ sngar gyi mya ngan mtha' dag sprul gyi shun lpags brjes pa ltar gyur nas/ rab dga'i sa la 'gran pa'i spro ba rgyas par gyur/ drung nas dpon slob kyis gsung gling dang byin rlabs rnams tshim par zhus te phyir 'byon par chas pa na/ khyed tsho 'gro na nga yang 'gro gsungs nas bzhugs gdan las bzhengs pa dang / drung nas rin po ches nga lam 'di khar bzhugs pa zhu/ mi 'byangs par 'bras spungs spyi so'i gdan 'dren dang bcas te/ dbu zhwa sku chos sogs khyer nas spyan 'dren la 'ong ba lags zhus pas/ 'o na nas khyer shog gsungs te/ drung nasadapon slob la bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi me tog gi char phab/ thag ring po'i bar du spyan gyis skyel ba sogs dpon slob 'bral mi phod pa ltar du gyur/ dpon slob gsar rnying mjal phrad mdzad pa la 'di bas ngo mtshar ba sngon chad ma byung zhes gleng ngo / /de yang drung gnas rin po che 'di ni mdzad pa'i babs gang la dpags kyang skyes bu dam pa zhig yin par shes shing / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhal gdams su/ khyod kyi bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / kha zhes med pa'i dad pa brtan po yis/ /nga yi chos thun bsgo (21ba tha'i ngag ma gcag /gang gi thad du'ang sems kyi khrel ba med/ /ces bka' stsal ba ltar gyi 'phrin las byed por byin gyis brlabs pa'i rje nyid kyi sprul par nges so/ /de nas phyogs thams cad du khang gsar gyi sde pa'i sras po de/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku'i skye ba yin par the tshom mi 'dug go zhes snyan grags—21—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)kyis khyab par brten/ sngon gyi bla ma slob dpon grwa rigs sbyin bdag sogs mchogo dman mtha' dag /zhal mjal bar gnam sngon bzhun
