ma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba ltar khang gsar gong du 'du long rgyun chad med par byung bas/ sdeb yab yum rnams cung zad thugs sun pa'i rnam pa mdzad de/ nyin gcig ben ser slob dpon rat+na ba dpon slob byung par/ yum gyis g.ya' g.ya'/ yang ni ma gi na bla ma'i rta pa gcig dang dge 'dun mang po 'byon gyi 'dug gsungs pa sras kyi gsan to/ /nga 'di na yod tsa na dge 'dun rnams los yong gsungs pas/ yum gyis thugs bden zhus nas/ de phyin chad nas yab yum rnams thugs sun snang mi mdzad par/ mjal mkhan rnams mjal ba don dang ldan par gyur to//khams pa'i grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis/ dreg ja ser nas gos chen sogs phul nas dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang zhus pas/ gtor ma so so'i mgo bor bzhag ste bh+yo raka mo tshar gsum gyis byin rlabs mdzad pas dga' zhing mgu bar gyur/ khams pa de tsho'i nye ba tshe 'das tsho'i ming nas smos te bsngob zhug pas/ bdeb can du skye bar gyur cig /myur du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /gsungs/ yang gson po rnams kyi ming nas smos te/ nad med par gyur cig /tshe ring bar gyur cig /gsungs pas/ dgung lo gsum pa'i bsngo ba (22na 〉 khyus che zhes kun ngo mtshar du 'dzin/ rje gong ma'i dus kyi yi dam chos skyong gi gtor chog bskang bshags sogs 'bad med du mkhyen cing / thugs dam bskang gso la gtso bor mdzad cing sku rim pa rnams kyi gral dbu la phal cher bzhugs pas/ mtha' dag kyang ma yengs par thugs dam shugs drag tu byed dgos pa zhig yod 'dug cing / yar ngo'i tshes gsum zhig gi nyin/phyag sil dkrol zhing thugs dam mdzad 'phro la/ rje rin po che byon byung ja phud mgyogs par khyer shog gsungs shing / phyag sil gnyas sbyar nas/ da lta 'di'i nang na bzhugs yod ces cung zad kha phye nasagazigs yang kha sbyar nas na bza'i phugs su bcug gces gces mdzad/ rdo rje grags mo rgyal yang byung / da dung ja phud khyer shog /rnam sras kyang byung / nas phun khyer shog gsungs/ nas dkar mo li sder gang phul bas/ rten gsum dang / mchod gtor sogs la phyag nas 'thor ba mdzad / de zad pa —28—

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyenadang /da dung long shog gsungs nas zad rim gyis phul bas/gzims chud de'i mdo phugs kun tu phyag nas kyi char chen po yun ring du 'bebs par mdzad do//de nas nyi ma phyi dror song tsa na grags mo rgyal kyi 'khor da dung bsdad 'dug gsungs/dpal ldan lha mo'i bris sku zhig gi dbu'i thad kyi bar snang la nas 'bru zhig rten med du chags/mda' dar zhig gi sne la nas 'bru gsum brtsegs su chags/dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bshes gnyen bkra shis pas mar me chung ngu zhig drung du phul ba/nyin zhag gnyis kyi bar du bzung /nyin gcig gung bsangs la/wa kya kha kya gsungs pa sku 'khris su yod pa rnams kyis ma go 22ba tha na/phyag gnyis snyan gyi thad gar gdengs pa bong bu'i rna ba ltar mdzad/ljags rkan sgra rtag pa dang bcas pas oṃ lha kye di na maḥgasung bas/sngags snga ma de 'jam dpal gyi sngags yin 'dug pa 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungasapa de dran nas lung zhus so//skabs 'gar sku drang por bsrangs phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad de rgyal ba tshe dpag med yin gsung ba dang /yang phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la gtad spyan hu re gzigs nas/pad+ma 'byung gnas sde brgyad 'dul ba yin gsungs jo bo rje gang du bzhugs zhus pas/dbu gtsug tu phyag mdzub gtad do//'byom gang du bzhugs zhus na shangs la phyag sor gyis reg spyan mjug gnyis phyag sor gyis cung zad mnan la nga bla ma zhang du gyur pa'i tshe 'di 'dra zhig yod gsungs/'khor rnams kyis bltas tshe mar pa lhas skal gyi sku 'dra shin tu 'dra ba zhig byung 'dug/skabs 'gar jo mjal la 'gro ba yin gsung bar/ma mas lha sa thugs rgyud med dam zhus pas/nga rang srong btsan sgam po byed dusargyab pa yin gsungs/gzhan yang rang gzhan gyi 'khrungs rabs dang skyes rabs sna tshogs gsung ba sogs brjod kyis mi lang zhing /nyin gcig thugs dam gral dbur bzhugs pa'i tshe/na bza' bangs pa tsam gyi spyan 'chab bsil ba la/'khor rnams kyis nges tshos thugs dang 'gal ba ni ma zhugaci yin zhus par/'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal ༷thong tsa na mchi ma 'chor bar 'dug/nga yis a

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)ma'i khog pa nas khyed tsho ci byed mthong gsungs/ thengs gcig ma ma la sngar gtad pa'i gu gul de khyer shog gsungs/ ma mas de 'dra med zhus pas/ kha (23na〉song tsa na ngas lag pa brgyab la btang nas khyod la gtad pa de gar song gsungs pas dran te btsal nas phul pas/ legs byung nga la brjed pa yong ma myong gsungs te/ de yang / bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i dran pa yang dag gi ye shes ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig gis khyad par du 'phags chos yin par mdo rgyud du ma las gsungs pa'i phyir te/ji skad du/ gsang sngags chen po rjes su 'dzin pa'i gzungs las/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig dag gis/ 'jig rten du sems can brjed ngas med pa'i chos can byung ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes yang dag pas smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag pas smra bas smra ba yin no/ zhes gsungasapa ltar ro/ /nyin gcig nam mkha' la sprin chen po 'khrigs shing rlung 'tshub pa sogs kyis sku bsil ba'i rnam pa byung nas/ rab gsal gyi phyi logs su/ phyag shing gi phred gdang la bkab nas gsung snyan pos mgur mang du then pa gnang ba/ ci gsung sku 'khor ba zhig gis dris pas/ dga' ldan pho brang de yin na dga' ba la a/ gsung rab rgya mtsho de byung na skyid pa la a/ /gtum mo'i bde drod cig 'bar na spro ba la a/ me sgong dron po zhig yod na mkho ba la a/ byas pa yin/ sngon ma tsho blo la ma zin brjed 'dug gsungs/ de nas gzims chung du me skong btang ste gdan drangs pas mnyes mnyes mdzad/dpal ldan lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis nyi zla 'dzin cing / 'og ma gnyis thal mo rdeb pa 'khor mang pos bskor ba zhig gzigs/ skabs shig bskang (23bsko so'i tshe gzhan rnams dang mi bstun par phyag sil dang phyag rnga drag tu brdungs shing / cho ga thun mong ma yin pa mang po zhig saṃ sla ta'i skad du gsungs/ de'i mthar bod skad du/ srid gsum bdag mo nam gru ma/ khyod kyis 'phrin las dus la bab/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gisalas bcol 'grub par mdzod/ /'dir ni chos skyong phyag bzhi drug gur zhal gyi snang ba'ang mang po —30

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)'dug pa e mthong / dpal ldan lha mo ni sku chung chung rang zhig mdzad 'dug /ces sogs ya mtshan gyi gsung gleng mang po gnang ngo / /shing mo sbrul lo'i mjug gi dgu gtor gyi nyin/ tho rengs kha nas nyin hril po thugs dam drag tu mdzad/ dgongs mo gtor zor rnams grub ste bskang gso ba rnams zhabs drung du slebs pa na/ dngos grub zhu ba/ gtang rag /mnga' gsol shis brjod/ mjug chog rnams grub nas/ da 'phyar dar sogs sdud dgos pa rnams bsdus gsungs/ dpon slob rnams der gzigs rtog la byon pa na/ der yab kyis 'phyar dar rnams chos skyong gang gi yin zhes dri ba zhus par/ rim pa bzhin du 'di chos skyong 'di dang 'di'o zhes ngos 'dzin mdzad/ zhal bram gzugs kyi 'phyar dar la zhal bzhi pa'i sku yin gsungs pas/ yab kyis zhal gcig las mi 'dug pa zhus par/ don la khyad med gsungs beg tshe'i 'phyar dar la gnod sbyin chen po'i sku yin gsungs pas/ yab kyis gnod sbyin chen po la rigs mang zhus pa na/gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse can yin gsungs/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i 'phyar dar la rten bshad mi mdzad par thal le thegs pas/ a bo chos rjes 'di ngo ma mkhyen pa (24na 'dra zhus pas/ los shes 'di nga'i sku yin mod gsungs pa la/ yab kyis khyed la phyag drug byas pa'i sku zhed po 'di 'dra yod dam zhus pas yod nged la skabs 'gar lag pa stong yang yod gsungs par/ 'o na mtshan la ji skad zer zhug par/ shī ma hā kā la yang zer/ res 'ga' bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho yang zer gyi 'dug /gzhan ming mang gsung /de nas zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta'i lo gsar chen mo'i dus/ rje gong ma'i phyag len ltar/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i mchod gtor bzang zhing gya nom pa dag legs par bshams te/ gnam gang gi dgongs mo gtor ma byin brlab dang tshes gcig gi rgyu skar lha mtshams shar ba dang mnyam du thugs dam tshugs te/ nyi shar la yang thog tu phebs nas gtor skyong rten 'bul sogs rgyas par gnang / de'i tshe mdun gyi bar snang la dpal ldan lha mo dngos su byon pa —31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs snang dpag tu med pa byung ngo / /de yang dus gtore gal che ba rnams kyi dus/ sku 'khris kyi g.yon du phyag rgya 'dzin mkhan de bzhag /sku pang du sil snyan gcig kha bskyel/phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang rnga g.yog lhan cig tu bzung ba la sil snyan gyi lung thag brgyus g.yon dril bu bzung ste/ rol mo rnams dus gcig tu dkrol ba la 'grig cing byin chags pa g.yin dag gis shes par dka' ba mkhyen no/ /thengs gcig bzhugs khri mthon po'i steng nas de ltar gnang ba'i tshe phyag mtshan mang ba'i stabs kyis ḍā ma ru lhung yang gas chag ma byung ba sogs grub rtags mang du bstan/ nyin gcig dbu la snum sbran te dbu skra'i (24bsnyu mo rnams mgul gong du bcug pas/ dbu'i grib ma dbu zlum gyi rnam pa lta bu zhig byung la mnyes te/ a li bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu lo zhus 'dug gsungs/dpal ldan lha mo chibs pa dang bcas te byon byung 'bras spungs pa rnams de ring 'ong ba yod gsung ba ltar chos grwa chen po'i slob dpon rnams byon pa'i bzhugs gral dang po grol gnyis pa ma bsgrigs pa'i bar der/ blo gsal gling gi slob dpon chos rje legs don par rje gong mas gnang ba'i zhwa thul zhig yod pa de gdan khar bzhag pa'i tshe/ zhwa thul gyi gseng tu zhugs pa la slob dpon pas der bzhugasan grib 'ong bas tshur phebs pa zhu zhus pas/ nged rang gi yin gsungs nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/yang nyin gcig nga'i gdan de dmas 'dug gsungs nas sa gdan gyi steng du 'bol kha gdan sogs mang du brtsegs kyang / da dung dmas gsungs nas stag sgam che ba gnyis kyi steng du/ bzhugasagadan rnams brtsegs te/ shin tu mtho bar byas nas de'i steng du bzhugs te/ chos khor rgyal gyi khri 'dra gsungs/ yab kyis/ rgyal gyi dgon pa de 'gangs chen rang zhig yod skad mi 'dug /khri ci 'dra yod dam zhus par/ nga'i rgyal gyi bkod pa zhig 'dri yi gsungs nas gyang logs la sol ris kyisargyal ri mthil lung pa'i bkod pa sogs legs par 'bri ba gnang nas/ 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba yin zhes ngos 'dzin dang bshad pa mdzad/ yang logs shig tu dgon pa chen po zhig 'bri ba mdzad nas/32

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)dgon pa gsar du 'debs na 'di ltar byed gsungs/ 'ol kha nas sde pa'i zhu yig 'bul mkhan byung tshe/ nga la sde pas shog gsung ba yin nam/ yi ge (25na8 ni tshur thong dang gsung mnyes mnyes mdzad/la la dag gi zhu yig la gzigs nas/ khong nga la dad pa ni med ces gsung ba yang yod 'dug /sdeb dpon g.yog rnams rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams ma gtogs g.yin ma gang la yang ngag mi ster ba zhig yod par dgos pa'i dbang gis rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i sku che ba'i yon tan mang du gsungs shing / dpon g.yog thams cad dmigs brtse ma 'dren par bskul ba sogs kyi sgo nas phyis su sa dge gnyis la khyad par med pa'i dag snang mdzad pa byung / de yang rje btsun btsong kha pa dang rje sa paṇa gnyis la rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don 'grel bar mkhas mi mkhas kyi khyad par chen po yod pa skad yab kyi drung du gsungs shing / yab thegs pa'i shul du gzhan rnams la sa paṇa dang rje btsun btsong kha pa gnyis ka 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos yin pa la khyad par med do gsung / de'i tshe gnas brtan bshes gnyen bkra shis sogs la da ni rang cag rnams 'bras spungs su 'gro ran 'bod mi yang myur du 'ong / rnga sil 'phyar dar sogs yo byad rnams kyang phar skyol gsung ba sogs/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba la spro ba ni/ rgyal bu gzhen nu don thams cad grub pa'i rnam thar bzhin no/ /ring nas mi phyed mdza' bas 'khyud pa yis/ /'phags mchog dam pa'i spyod tshul mtha' klas pa/ /ched du bslabs pa med par rang bzhin gyis/ grub pa 'di ko sngon med ngo mtshar gnas/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu/ /bzhugs la zhi dang khro bo'i snang brnyan dag /'char dang mi 'char zhes pa'i skabs bral yang / /thun (25ba〉dung gdul bya'i snang ngor cir yang ston/ /phra zhing blang dor 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /sgom chen rgan po'i yongs 'dzin rgyang du bsrings/ gsan bsam mdzad par 'os kun lcags phye dang / khab len rdo ba'i snang tshul ji bzhin grub/ /snyan grags mi dbang rna lung rgyan gyur pas/ /phun tshogs rten 'brel sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye/ sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i snang tshul gyis/ /yid gnyis the tshom dra ba mtha' dag bcad/ de nas drung nas rin po che dang / spyi gzims —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)mkhan slob thams cad bka' bgros te/ bod shing sgo btsugs pa'i rgyal khab chen po/ pho brang sne'u gdong rtser/ sa gzhi'i dbang phyug dpal ldan gong ma chen po zhes gangs can gyi skye rgu mtha' dag gi bla dpon zung du 'jug pa/ mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa de nyid la bslab ston zhib char zhus te/ me rta nag pa zla ba zhes/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lugs kyi lo'i thog ma/ dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal las ring du bskyangs pa'i/ dbyar gyi dga' ston ngoms pa la ring du phyogs pa'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa/ res gza' phur bu zla skar rgyal dang 'dzom pa'i nyin/ dbu skra lcang lo dang ldan yang / paṇa zhwa sku chos sogs rab tu byung ba'i rtags dang bcas te/ rta mchog g.yul rgyal la drung nas rin po che chibs pa'i sku pang du 'degs pa'i tshul gyis phebs/ rtse kha nas sde pa rin po che dpon g.yog rnams/ rtsi gos dang btsugs zhwa/ shal dkar dmar rna cha sogs rin cen rgyan cha dang bcas pa'i skya rags/ chos sde chen po'i mkhan slob sogs ngur smrig gis rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams kyi chibs bsu dang bcas/ chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi nye (26na tsher dbas su phebs pa na/ dge 'dun grangs med pa chos gos snam sbyar gsol/ ngur smrig gi rtags kyis mdzes par klubs shing spos phor thogs pas sna drangs/ gdugs rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ rnga yab/ sil snyan/ rnga/'khar rnga/ dung dkar/ zangs dung / rag dung / rgya gling sogs kyi rol mo dang / gzhan yang mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa'i ser sbrengs kyi bkod pas mdzes shing chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyang bsu ba la byon pa nam mkha' gang ba lta bu dang / bstan srung sprul pa'i cho me skyong pe dkar yang sku khog tu zhugs te bsu bar byon/ skye bo'i khrom khri phrag tu nye bas zhal mjal byed par 'ongs pa dang / dar 'bag phu mda' sogs yul mi mang po'i skyes pa dang bud med rnams rgyan gosabazang pos spras te rnga shon bro gar glu gzhas sogs rtsed sna ji snyed pa dang / dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang gi rtse mor 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing g.yas g.yon du bkra shis khra ring dbang po'i gzhu ris ltar brkyangs/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis me tog gi char 'ja' 'od kyi gur —34

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)sogs lha dang mi'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs te dga' ldan pho brang gi 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khri chen po la zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod do/ /thog mar gzims chung nyi 'od 'khyil par dbus su seng ge'i khri gnyis bshams pa'i g.yas la paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang / g.yon du thams cad mkhyen (26ba)pa nyid bzhugs/ g.yasagral la slob dpon rnam pa sogs dge 'dun pa'i rigs dang / g.yon gral la sde pa yum sras sogs sbyin bdag gi tshogs dang / yar khyu'i gral la phyogs kyi mi sna sogs gang 'os bsgrigs/ slob dpon rnams kyis rig lung mdzad pas/ rje 'dis thal skad mdzad nas/ shes bya 'di la nga mkhas zhes gsungs/bzhugs gral grol 'phral du nga'i dril bu shing kun ma dang ra log ma de long shog gsungs/ phul bas mnyes mnyes mdzad/de nas slob dpon rin po che bsod nams grags pa'i drung du/ yongs su rdzogs pa dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhes te/ mtshan bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs thams cad lasarnam par rgyal bar gsol/ tsha ba chos rje mi g.yo bas skad cha gsan pas lung bstan du dge 'dun gyi ming can gsum byung bar bshad pas/ dge 'dun grags pa bzhes 'dogs dbos rgyu yin pa la kho'i ming gi zur de rang 'jags na ma 'jags ci yod/ ces bka' bkyen pa'i rnam pa mdzad skad/ de nas bzhugs gral chen mo bsgrigs thog /thog mar sde srid rin po che nas legs ja'i gnang sbyin bka' shog dang bcas pa/ de nas chos sde'i mkhan slob/ sku zhang chos kyi dbang phyug /g.yin yang phyogs mtha' grwa rigs sbyin bdag mchog dman kun gyis 'bul ba sogs dga' ston rgya chen po bsgrubs/ /paṇa chen rin po che gzims khang gong du thegs shing gral pa rnams so sor gyes pa'i bzhugs gral grol nas gzims chung du 'gol bzhugs skabs/ yab yum gnyis kyis/ bsod grags (27na tshe spru dad pa e song zhus pas/ de 'dra ma zer nged kyi bla ma yin pas/ chos kyi rje bsod nams grags pa'i zhal snga —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)nas zer ba gyis gsungs sngar gong ma'i slob ma yin pa'i cha nas/ zhes sogs cher mi gnang yang /dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes pa tshun nas/ zhes dang gus pa phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ de'i nyin hril por 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang dri bzang gis kun tu khyab cing / brgyad mchod chen mo dang 'grig pa'i dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ 'byung po'i gtor ma/ ga slong la sbyin pa sogs dang mtshan mo mar me'i 'phreng ba rgyu skar sa la babs pa lta bu rten 'brel mtha' yas pa 'grig go /ma cig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma zhabs thang gi tshul du phebs te/ smyu gu ring thung gnyis phyag tu phul byung ba/ chos srung mang po'i sku bas 'bri dgos par dgongs te zhal bkod gnang / khyad par dpal ldan lha mo'i 'phyar dar zhig thog mar 'bri bcug par/ tshes bco lnga'i dus gtore gyi spyan 'dren skabs spyan lam du phab pas shin tu dgyes te/ gung bsangs zhig la phyag mang du 'tshal ba gnang zhing / drung du 'khod pa kun la yang phyag brgya rtsa re tshol zhes phebs sgo gnang / /bka' las/ sngar sor spyan 'dren gyi dus su dpal ldan lha mo sku tshad shin tu che ba mthing nag zhal gcig phyag brgyad pa/dang po gnyis na be con dang thod khrag /gnyis pa gnyis na sil snyan/ gsum pa gnyis na lcags kyu dang lcags sgrog /bzhi pa gnyis na rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhig byon nas chibs kyi dre'u de bzhag /bris thang de la thim song sil snyan rkyang pa yang nam mkhar mi shong ba (27ba) tsam 'dug kyang / rang re'i stir dar 'di la shong song bas 'di dpal ldan lha mo dngos yin gsungs/ de nas chos srung gzhan rnams kyi 'phyar dar la'ang rab gnas gnang bas ye shes pa rnams thim pa dngos su gzigs/yab yum rnams rang gi gzhis su 'byon khar/ bka' bsgo zhug pas/ sa skya pa'i chos skyong 'di 'os gsung mgon po zhal gyi bka' bsgo gnang / chos skyong khyed rang gi rjes la bzhud song / zhes bka' phebs/phun tshogs lugs brgya'i 'bras bu ma las pa/ /'phyur bur spungs pa'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i gling / /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i spo na seng ge'i khrir/ /lag na pad+ma mi yi zol gyis 'gying / /srong bsdo rang gi khri la khas pad zung / /bkod pa'i ngo ma' rgya mtsho dga' ston la/ /lha mi'i 'byor pa spel —36

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)ba'i snyan pa'i rnga/ /mchog dman yongs kyi thos 'dzin rgyan du sgrog /de skabs mdo khams phyogs nas 'bul dpon ngag dbang bkra shis 'byor/ rta/ khrab/ ja/ dngul zangs sogs yul lugs dang mthun pa'i 'bul ba rgya cher bsgrubs/ bod rgyal po'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa gu ge bdag po dpon blon dang / paṇa chen shān+ti pa nas 'bul skyel brdzangs pa 'byor/ gser srang stong la nye ba sogs zang zing gi bdog pa'i skyes mtha' yas pa phul/ paṇa chen shārnyi pa'i 'bul skyel bas/ 'bras spungs su phebs pa yan gyi rnam thar ras bris su byas te/ mnga' ris su gdan drangs/ 'di rnam thar zhing bkod zhal bkod gnang ba'i thog ma yin/hor zla lnga pa'i nang du than pa chen po byung bas/ gzims chung lcog tu mchod rdzas kyi me tog rnams (28na)re re gtor te bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la 'bul lo gsungs/ yon chab rnams phan tshun du gtor ba dang sdugs pa sogs/ gzims chung gi phyi nang kun chal chil du mdzad pas/ drung nas kyis/ rang bzhin gyi rol rtsed yin par mngon nas sku rdzi rnams la yang bka' bkyen mdzad/ zhabasadrung la yang khyed 'gro ba mtha' dag gi skyabs gnas yin pa la/ 'di ltar byis pa'i rtsed mo mdzad na/gdul bya rnams mi bslu'am/ lhag par dpon sa gong mas gnang sbyin legs bya sogs thugs mthong tshad med pa mdzad pa la 'di ltar snyan du son na rung ngam/ bstan 'gro la nga gongs nas thos bsam sgom pa'i tshul gnang bar zhu zhug pas/ khyod kyis mig dmar por bltas kyang nga mi bred/ nga'i nye gnasayin gsungs par 'o na dpon sa gong ma la yang mi bred dam zhus pas/ nga ni rje btsun btsong kha pa ma gtogs su la yang mi bred gsungs pas/ snyan sgron phul pa la ye mi gsan na/ phyag g.yog mi nusapar 'dug pas paṇa chen bsod grags pas kyang / rgas khar so yod pa dga' bas/ nged kyi 'dir shog gsungs byung bsang ni gzims khang gong du 'gro/ nang zan phal cher yang nga'i rjes su 'gro bas/de nas ji ltar gnang blta'o zhus par/ de khyod rang la mi dga'am gsung zhal bsgyur nas bzhugasapas/ phyag phul te/ bka' bzhin bsgrub par zhug pa la/ 'o na khyod rang yang chu skyol gsungs te/ phyi —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)nang thams cad chus khyab par mdzad/ rta g.yul rgyal long shog gsungs/ khrid byung ba dang rta sga thod/gsung rab pas zhon las dbang du thog gsungs nas dpon slob rgyal (28ba)thigs pa'i tshul gyis chibs bcags mdzad/ da gsung rab pa babs gsungs nas zhabs drung nyid kyis chibs kha phar bsgyur tshur bsgyur kha yar mdzad/ de nas char bab pa dang chibs las gzhol lo/ /de'i sngon tsam du nam mkha' shin tu g.ya' dag par yod pa la/ de 'phral du chu 'dzin gyi tshogs stug po 'khrigs te/ dbyar rnga dal gyis dgod pa dang bcas/ char gyi rgyun phyogs kun tu khyab par babs/ de skabs shing gi sdong po'i rtse na dpal ldan lha mo bzhugs pa gzigs/ char chad nas gzims chung lcog tu gan rkyal mar bzhugs te/ shangs la mdzub mo btsugs nas/ yon tan thams cad ma bslabs thugs su chud/ gsungs/ drung nas nged bde yangs slob dpon pa gnyis kyis rgyal po dkon cog 'bangs kyi gsung gleng mdzad pas/ ro stod gser ro smad g.yu sked pa dung la byas pa de e gsungs/ drung nas kyi 'khor rnams la/ da gi de tsho da lo'i than pa 'di la dgongs par 'dug /da phyin nas bka' thams cad tshul bzhin du sgrubs shig ces gdams so/ /yang phyi dro tsa na 'brug gi sgra chen po bsgrags pas/ a phyi gnam gyi gung rgyal ma'i rnga yin pa 'dug /a phye gnam gyi gung rgyal ma de dpal ldan lha mo yin gsungs/ sang nyin rgyab ri'i rtser sprin dkar po che ba zhig 'dug pa la gzims chung gi byang ngos kyi dkar khung nas/ nan tar gzigs pas/ drung du 'khod pa rnams kyis ci 'dug pa yin zhus pas/ sprin gyi gseb na dpal ldan lha mo sku tshad shin tu che ba zhig la sku tshad chung ba mang pos bskor 'dug pa thams cad kyang dkar por 'dug gsungs/ nub gcig gzims chung du drung nas la/ a ma 'ongs pa e yin gsungs pas (29na〉ri a ma yin dogs med yum khang gsar gong na bzhugs pa la zhus pas/ de yang a ma yin te/ 'khor bar 'khor tsa na khyod kyang nga'i a ma yin/nga yang khyod kyi a ma yin/ nga a bar du song tsa na khyod rgas 'dug /de yang khyod gzhon nur gyur pa na nga rgas yong ste/ khyod la byams po byed do gsungs pas/ zhu lan du/ bka' drin bskyangs tshe phyi mar —38

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)yang zhabs phyir 'ong ba mdzod cig zhus pa na/los byed smon lam rnam par dag pas 'tshams sbyar nas rjes su 'dzin no sogs dang gzhan yang 'das ma 'ongs kyi gnas tshul mang du gsung ngo //thegs gcig snga bar bzhengs te na bza' rnams phyir phud/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bcas te bzhugs 'dug pa/'di lta bu sku bsil ba e yin zhus par/grang po mi yong lha mo dbyangs can mas bslabs byung /da lta yang 'di khar bzhugs 'dug gsungs/nyin gcig mchod pa rgya chen po bshamasapar gnang ste/slob dpon pad+ma/mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/rje bla ma sogs mang du zhal gzigs pa la mchod bstod mdzad/me lug lo gsar srid gsum bdag mo'i mchod gtor sogs grub rjes/chos 'khor rgyal nas spyi tshogs kyi gdan 'dren pa 'byor/gzims dpon rgyal dbang pa phyag phyir 'gro mi dgos pa'i 'dod sbyar gyi dgongs pa khrol/zhal gdams shig zhus pas/dad pa dkon cog gsum la gyis//byams pa sems can rnams la sgoms/'khor 'das stong pa'i bang du gzhog/de la khyod kyi chos skal gyis//zhes pa gnang /hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum la 'bras spungs nas bteg ste tshal du phebs/yang dgon rin po che dang /rgyud pa dpon 29bslob kyis gtsos pa'i tshal gung gi skya ser rnams kyis bsu ba dang bsnyen bkur/khyad par nang so dga' ldan pa dpon g.yog gis bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs/mchod khang rnams zhib mjal dang /mgon po bya rog gi mawo can la gnyer gaganang /der 'khod pa'i khrom mtha' yas pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis tshim par mdzad de/rim gyis gsar la brgyud/bar nang gi rong du phebs pa na/mi dkar po zhig gis mdzo dkar mo dang /nag po zhig gis mdzo khra mo la 'o ma bzhes te zhal skyems su drangs shing /g.yu chen po zhig phyag tu phul bas/sngon rgyal po dad pa brtan par gyur dus kyi dung stong dang /'dzin pa lag mang gnyis su mkhyen/las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis mdzo mo gnyis mthong ba yang byung 'dug/bka' las/lung pa 'di srin yul gyi 'dzin pa lag mang stod sa de 'dra/mi gnyis po de khong gnyis kyi sprul par 'dug/nga srin yul du 'gro dusadad pa brtan pa zer ba yin/zhes sogs dge ba/sa legs bshad pa dang /gnas brtan rwa sgreng pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)sogs la mang du gsungs so/ /lam dog sar pha bong gur tsam zhig gi steng nas chibs pa g.yas g.yon du bzlog ma bde bar/ thog tshad gcig tsam na mchongs pas skyon du ma gyur pa ni chos srung gi mthur thugs nges gnang / rim gyis chos 'khor bsam yas su phebs pas/ mdo sdomacho ne pa dang 'grig pas skya ser gyi khrom chen po 'dus shing / mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pas ser sbrengs dang /bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po sku khog tu zhugs te phyir byon pa sogs lo dus kyi bsgrigs btsug rnams mdzad pa de/ da lam rje thams cad mkhyen pa dpon slob phebs (30na)pa'i mched gnyer du byas 'dra ba'i rten 'brel ma bsgrigs par lhun gyis grub bo/ dbu rtse rigs gsum/ gling bzhi gling phran/ jo mo gling gsum dang bcas pa zhib tu mjal zhing smon lam dang / bstan srung sprul pa'i rgyal po la 'phrin las bcol ba gnang / dbu rtse rigs gsum la zhib tu gzigs te/ 'di dag la dka' las li po byas/ bod la nga dang / skyon pad+ma gnyis drin che bar yod gsungs/ de ni/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan du zhal gyis bzhes pa'o/ /rim gyis tshong 'dus brag khar phebs/ rtses thang sogasayar 'on gyi skya ser grangs med pa 'dus pa la thugs rje chen po'i bzlas lung dang / grwa rigs sbyin bdag rnying pa rnams la ngos 'dzin/ phyag dbang / phyag nas/ bdog pa'i skyes sogs lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas tshim par mdzad/ mkhar ltag la brgyud/ tshes bcu dgu la sdeb 'ol kha nas yab sras dang /rdzing phyi mkhan po sogs 'ol kha'i dgon pa khag rnams dang bcas pa'i skya ser gyis bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te 'ol kha rtser phebs/ dus ston gyi tshe chos rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang dang /chos rje dge 'dun lhun grub gnyis kyis bgro gleng byas pas thugs dgyes dgyes gnang / skya ser gyi tsho gos la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / khrom la zhal mjal/ phyag nas so gos mdzad/ gnas bcu'i zhalathang la me tog gtor bas nam mkha' la yun ring du chas/ de'i tshe'i bdag cag gi ston pa zhal gzigs shing / me tog gi char chen po yang bab/hor zla drug pa'i tshes lnga la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mtha' dag 'du ba'i bsti gnas chos 'khor —40

rgyal dbang bsod nam rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)rgyal du phebs/ gnyug mar gnas pa dang glo bur du lhags pa'i dge 'dun rnams (30ba)kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa ngo mtshar ba byas/ mchod khang rnams zhib par mjal/ byams mgon gyi drung du phyag mchod smon lam gnang zhing spyan chab gsil bas/ der 'khod pa thams cad dad pa dang / skyo ba dang spro ba rnams cig car du byung / gsol ba btab pa la ma ltos par gsol 'debs rgyal mdun ma dang /rab 'byams rgyal ba ma gnyis kyi lung gnang / mgon khang du gtor gsos/ spyan gzigs/ 'phrin las 'chol ba rgyas par gnang / nyang long e dwags kong po sogs khrom che bar 'dus pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung gnang / phyag mtshan gnam lcags kyi ral gri la gzigs rtog gnang ba'i tshe lde mig nor nas g.yin zhig phul bas/ de ma yin pa gzhan 'di 'dra zhig yod ces gsungs/ de skabs chab mdo nas mkhas btsun thub pa'i dbang phyug don gyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'phags sde lo tsā ba rje drung rin po che dge 'dun bkra shis kyis/ gser gyi bla bre la dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs kyi ri mo yod pa/ lha rnams dngul gar blugs las grub pa'i bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis pa/ de mtshungs tshe dpag med lha dgu /kyai rdor lha dgu yod pa'i bla bre/ gzhan yang gos chen gyi bla bre/ 'phan/ rol cha sogs mchod rdzas/ mgon khang du go mtshon/ snyan dar gyi rigs/ mchog gi sprul sku phebs pa'i legs bya/ brgya 'bul/ tsho gos su mang ja 'gyed sogs bsgrub par dpon gnyer chos grags/ bla ma grags pa/ gung ru dbyangs dpon pa kun dag 'arnams 'byor/ ja gral gyi sar/ bka' las/ dbyangs dpon pa 'byor pa legs/ sngar gyi dbyangs snyan po de gyis dang gsungs par/ gshin rje rlung (31na tshe tswa sgor ma la dbyangs shig phul bas/ de ga yin/ ngas kyang byed gsungs nas shin tu snyan zhing brdzid pa zhig mdzad/ yang mgon khang du phebs pa zhig la/ zham 'bring pas de snga mgon khang du phebs e myong zhus pas nged rang rgyus che gsungs/hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bdun gyi tho rengs/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po la/ bka' gdams kyi dge bshes mang pos bskor ba gzigs pas/ gzims dpon dpal ldan grags la mchod pa shoms shig —41 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)ces bka' stsal/ nub cig mnal lam ngo mtshar bar byung ba ni/ rje de nyid kyi zhal nas/ rmi lam ngo mtshar ba zhig la/ nga gzims chung du 'dug pa'i mdun du/ dge bshes legs bshad byung nas/ thog tu phebs dang gzigs mo 'dug zer/ kho dang mnyam du thog khar phyin nas bltas pas/ me tog thang gi sa gru gsum de'i dkyil na/ lcags khang sgo med pa chen po phyi thams cad me 'bar ba/ me'i srubasal la na lcags khang gi logs sngo sding sding mthong ba/ ngos gcig la phug pa mgo shong ba tsam zhig yod pa zhig 'dug /de'i nang nas mi nag po chen po zhig 'thon byung bas de na re/ 'dir byon dang zer/ ngasadage bshes la mnyam du 'gro byas phyin pas/ lcags khang de'i nang na ro chen po khang pa tsam zhig 'dug /de'i g.yas ngos na khrag dmar po dang / g.yon na khrag nag po 'dzag cing 'dug /de'i steng na ma he nag po shin tu khros pa'i mgo mdun du bkug cing / mig phyir blta ba zhig 'dug pas/ zhed pa'i snang ba yang cung zad byung / de nas gshin dang brje de gnas chung chos rgyal yin gsungs/ de las zla ba gcig lhag tsam song ba'i tshe (21ba)mnal lam du nga 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi klu sdings su 'dug pas der gsung rab pa byung nas/ phyi 'di na sngar med pa'i dur khrod cig 'dug pas/ legs nyes ji ltar yin lags zhes 'dri bar byung bas/ ngas ma bltas par mi shes lta ru 'gro byas kho dang mnyam du phyin pa na/ mtsho nag po chen po zhig 'dug pa de mi gsum tsam gyi dpangs su 'bar zhing 'byug pa/de'i dbus su chos khrung gru gsum dmar po zhig 'dug /de nas mi a tsa ra'i rnam pa can yin pa la/ /sma ra dkar po sked par slebs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba zhig byung bas/desanga'i lag pa nas 'then te/'dir shog zer bas/ ngas gsung rab pa'i lag pa nas 'then te/ chos yang gi nang du khrid nas phyin/de nas bltas tsa na phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba zhig 'dug de nas a tsa ra chung ba zhig byung nas/ rgan pa de la lag g.yub cig byas byung bas kho langs song / gsung rab pa na re/ ngas pha gir mi bzhin byung na gzhi len byed kyi zer nas langs song / de rjes sngar gyi a tsa ra de byung nas/nga la cho 'phrul chen po ston rgyu yod/ de nas a tsa ra chung ba des a rag yin zer ba'i mdog dmar 42

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)ser can zhig drangs byung bas phor ba do btung tsam na a tsa ra gzhan de byung nas bum pa gcig gi nang nas sngar bzhin drangs byung bum pa de su'i yin byas pas/ 'di la zhal bzhi pa zer pa'i chos skyong zhig yod pa des khyod la drongs zer byung bas 'ongs pa yin zer/ de nas de'i nang nas zhal bzhi pa yin zer ba'i mi nag po gdong pa bzhi yod pa 'dra ba zhig byung nas nga la 'di skad ces/ khyod kyis nga la bskul dgos pa yong ba yod khyed (32na ting mnyam du nga yang bde ba can du 'gro /zer ba rmis te yid brtan 'ong ba dka'/ 'on kyang de'i sang nyin/ grub thob pa zer pa zhig gis/ zhal bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs shig phul byung gsung / yang nub gcig mnal lam du/ bud med sngon mo rgyan gos bzang po yod pa hor mo 'dra ba zhig gi mche ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal khams thams cad gang ste nor bu mang po dang lhan cig tu 'dus nas rje nyid kyi tshems la thim/ de las 'od 'phros nas rgyal gyi lung pa gang / de nas rje nyid kyi 'phrin las dang / rgyal du lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal 'debs pa'i ltas so/ /rgyal ri mthil gyi gzhi pa bla ma la chos rje dge 'dun lhun grub bkas legs par bskos/hor zla bcu pa'i gza' tshes bzang ba la byams khang gi gtsug lag khang gi steng du/ gtsang khang rnying pa'i rgya khyon dang bstun pa'i/ gser thog gis bzo thab 'dzugs pa gnang / 'bras spungs nasagadan 'dren pa byung ba la brten/ bzo dpon/ bzo bo rnams la bslab ston gyis khyab pa gnang ste/yar klungs byang kha brgyud/ 'bras spungs su phebs/ 'di dus phyag rjes zhabs rjes gnang ba'i thog ma yin/ de dpon gnyer chos grags kyis rje drung dge 'dun bkra shis gyi dad rten la khyer/ sa sbrel lo'i dus rim lo gsar sogs rgyas par mdzad/ nag pa zla ba'i nang du ra sahrūl snang du phebs/ jo shāg gis gtsos pa'i rten gsum rnams la gser chab/ dkar me/ lha bsgos/ snyan dar sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ bstod phyag mang du mdzad cing smon lam rgya chen po 'debs pa gnang / jo bo rin po che sku gzhon du song 'dug gsung / der 'khod (32ba)pa rnams la jo bo'i sku mdun du bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig gnang / bzhugs mtsher du phebs pa na gnas chen rnams kyis —43—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)gsol ba btab ste/ khrom khri phrag brgyal ba la yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gnang / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje mjal bar phebs skabs/ lha sa dang ra mo che'i bar gyi sa thamasacad khyab pa'i khrom gyis gang ste kun kyang dad pa'i sal bkod/ 'di jo mjal gyi thog ma yin/ slar 'bras spungs su phebs/ gsol ja thum chung gi rten dang bcas pa'i yum la bka' shog cig gnang bar/ sku 'khor pa zhig gis rten 'di cung zad chung ba 'dra zhus par/ 'di khas 'ong / rgyal gyi gser thog ma grub ring / spyan phra se ba byed dgos 'dug gsungs dgongs pa can gyi bka' phebs/hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum la chibs kha bsgyur te bde chen/ brag kha bel kha sogs brgyud/ rgyal du phebs/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas gser thog la rab tu gnas pa mdzad pasame tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogs ltas ya mtshan pa byung / lha mchod mi mchod kyi dga' ston rgyas par gnang ste rim gyis 'bras spungs su phebs so/ /na tshod ches phra dbyar skyes gzhen nu la/ /rgan po'i blo stobs 'bras bu'i khur la4 ba/ /sngon med ljon pa'i shing 'di tshangs pa yis/ /brgya phrag thabs kyis gsar du bskrun par nges/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa mtshan dpe'i sku/ 'gro ba'i mig gi pad dkar ba 'ad pa dang / /tshangs gsung 'brug sgras dang ba'i chu gter kun/ /lhan cig 'phel bar byas 'di ngo mtshar gnas/ /'dzam bu'i gser zhun sa la 'khyil 'dra ba'i/ /gtsug lag khang bzang mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog gis/ /rnam (33na tshe sbosabu yi 'byor pa ma lus pa/ /'jig rten mes pos gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin/ /zhi ba zhes pa sa mo bya'i lo'i dus rim lo gsar sogs grub nas/ gsan bsam gyi rim pa la brtson par bzhugs pa nas/sag zla ba'i dus paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mkhan po/ gsang phu chos rje legs pa don grub kyis las slob/ shar rtse legs don pas dus sgo ba mdzad de/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ sdom brtson dam pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag par bzung / paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i drung du/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ rnams sras gser chen/ 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor ma/ mkhas grub dpal —44

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyenaldan seng ge lugs kyi dpal mgon 'kha/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ cho ge rgyal phyi sgrub rnams kyi rjesaganang gsan / gling stod chos rje legs don pa'i drung du/ 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i ṭīk+ka/ lam rim che chung lam sgron/ byang chub gzhung lam/ 'dul pa'i bslab bya che chung / gzhi gsum cho ga /las chog /rtsa 'jug gnyis dang / de'i ṭīka chen/ 'grel pa don gsal/ rnam bshad snying rgyan/rnam 'grel/ thar lam gsal byed/ mdzod/ mdo rtsa/ drang nges rnam 'byed/ dpe chos/ gsal sgron/gdan rdzogs/ mkhas grub bka' 'bum/ bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho rnams kyi lung gsan/ shar rtse legs don pa'i drung du pad dkar/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ mgon po snying zhugs/ 'khor brgyad ma/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ lcags ral can/ gur drag /nā ga rag sha/ u tsarla/ phyag bzhi pa tshal lugs/ sgrol dkar/ tshe ring mched lnga / ye shes khyung khra/ beg rtse/ dmar (33ba〉na skor gsum/ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig /rnam sras rta sngon can/ be con can/ mdung dmar can/phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ gar mkhan mchog /drag byed/ dkar po tshe sgrub/ shra ma ṇa/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/seng gdong ma/ rme brtsegs rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi lung / gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis kyi dbang / bka' gdams thig le bcu drug dang / glegs bam gyi ljags lung rnams gsan pa'i don thams cad thosabasam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa dang nyams bzhes mdzad/ skyor mo klung du zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po ches gdan drangs/ zhal ngo rnams la tshe rta dang / khrom du dbang sogs dam pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ slar 'bras spungs su phebs/ zla ba drug pa'i nang du bye ri stag rtser gdan drangs/ khrom shin tu che ba la zhu lan nor bu'i 'phreng ba dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang / rim gyis mal 'gro brgyud/mkhar skya/ rin cen gling / rdzing phyi sogs su skye bo'i tsho gos ji snyed pa la thar pa'i sa bon bzhag ste/chos 'khor rgyal du phebs/ tshogs pa la glegs bam rin po che'i spyi chos dang / sgos chos sogs kyisatshim par gnang / chos srung mchod pa'i cho ga sogs rgyas par mdzad/ tshur lam 'ol kha bsam gtan —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)gling du phebs/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen por ngo mtshar pa'i ltas gzigs snang mang du grub pa'i gzims phug mjal ba gnang / der rdzing phyi ba'i gdan 'dren sleb ste/ 'dod sbyar gyi dgon par phebs skya ser kyi khrom chen po la chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad nas 'ol kha rtser phebs/ sde ba yab sras la 'dod (34na〉byas bka' dbang gi rim pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs ji snyed pa la legs byas kyi sa bon bskrun te/ rim gyis 'bras spungs su phebs/thun mong zhes pa lcags khyi'i lo gsar grub nas/ dpyid kyi ring thos bsam sgom pa dang / gdul bya rnams kyi re ba skong phyir du bzhugs pa'i ngang nas/ dbyar ston sgril ba'i zla ba drug gi ring / dgon pa rtse mor sku mtshams shin tu dam pa gnang ste/ tshe dpag med kyi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho bcu gsum dang /rta mgrin gyi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho nyi shu rtsal ṇi ga gnang bas/ yi dam gyi lhaganyis ka dngos su zhal gzigs shing gsung gi gnang ba stsal/ 'gal byed ces pa lcags phag zla ba lnga pa'i nang du rgyal du chibs kha bsgyur/ de skabs than pa shin tu che ba zhig byung bas/ lha sar phebs thog jo shāka sogs rten rnamasal khrus gsol dang / klu khang du klu dga' bar byed pa'i khrus/ dung skyong ma sogs srung ma rnams la gnyer gtad gnang bas/ tsha ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad rgyang du bsrings te char gyi rgyun phyogs kun tu khyab pas ri klung thams cad mgod kyi gos gyon pa la chas so/ de nas rim gyis chos 'khor rgyal du phebs/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu la byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i bka' chos gnang / nyin re bzhin me tog gi char bab/ zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du 'dod khams bdag mo'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad pas mtshan ma khyad par can brnyes/ zla ba dgu pa'i nang du 'ol kha rtser phebs/ thub pa bdud 'dul gyi sku zhig gsal bar gzigs/ mchog dman mtha' dag phan bde'i lam la bkod/ rin cen sgang du sku 'dra rin po che mjal zhing smon lam gnang bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par (34ba lon byung / 'od gsal lha'i gdung brgyud nang so rgya ri bas e rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi sa'i cha ri sgor spyan drangs/ sdo pa zhal ngo la 'dod chos ci rigs pa dang / khrom khri phrag brgal ba la tshe —46

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)dbang gnang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang me tog gi char chen po bab/ rim gyis khams su phebs/ /der khrom la tshe dbang gnang bas/ nam mkha' dwangs pa la 'ja' tshon dang / me tog gi char chen po bab par ma gcig lab sgron gyi cho 'phrul du gleng / mtho ris kyi yon tan mtha' dag gcig tu 'du ba/sman ljongs nor 'dzin gyi lte ba yar klungs kyi sa'i cha/ chos grwa chen po rtses thang du phebs/ lnga mchod chen mo'i nyin/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bor spyan drangs te/ bla na med pa'i mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/ chags su snying po don gsum gyi bka' chos dang / bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par gnang bas kun dad pa'i sa la bkod/ sde srid rin po che'i sku gzhogs su bka' shog 'phul ba dang bcas/ drung nas gsung rab pas byon/ sku na phra ba'i stabs kyis slar rim gyis mjal ba sogs kyi snyan 'bul mdzad/ sde srid nas kyang dgyes pa'i bka' lan dang / ja 'dren rgyas par gnang / sngon rang nyid srong btsan du gyur pa'i tshe bzhengs pa'i khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang mjal bar phebs/ mchod pa dang smon lam rgyas par mdzad/ rim gyis gser la brgyud/ dga' ldan pho brang du phebs so/ /shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu la/ /longs su spyod pa'i mi zad go 'phang che/ /ring nasamangon du gyur kyang thos pa'i tshul/ /mdzad 'di ma dag gdul byar dgongs lags sam/ /mi zad dam pa'i chos kyi char chen po/ /phyogs med lus can yongs la phab (35na)pa'i 'bras/ /phan dang bde ba'i me tog man+ta ra/ gzur gnas lus phra'i rna bar g.yur za ldem/ /yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu bo byi ba'i lo gsar grub rjes/ chos kyi rje bsod nams grags pas zur bzhugs mdzad par ba ched nas/spyi gzims drung nas rin po che sogs bka' bgros thog nas/ pho brang sne'u gdong rtser/ gdan sabasko bzhag gi bslab ston zhib cha zhus shing / gong nas kyang dgyes bzhin du legs so dang bcas pa'i bka' stsal byung bar brten nag pa zla bar dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu bzhi'i gza' skar 'phrod spyor ba'i thog /dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen po'i mkhan po'i 'jigs med chos kyi khri la —47—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)zhabs sen 'khod de/ sde srid rin po che nas bsko ja'i gnang sbyin/ bka' shog gi lung bsgrags/ g.yin yang skyor mo klung nas zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po che mi'i dbang po bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / nang so rgya ri ba dang dga' ldan pa dpon blon gyis thog drangs skyid shod yar klungasagatsang sogs nas sbyin bdag grwa rigs mtha' yas pas rang rang gi 'byor ba dang bstun pa'i 'bul ba sogs dga' ston gyi dpal 'byor char du bsnyil/ me rtag gi char dang 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogasa'achi ba med pa rnams mkha' la lhags te mchod pa 'bul ba'i ltas rgya chen po byung / chos rgyal chen po la nga der dngos su byon te dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur ji snyed cig mdzad do/ /de nas rje bsod nams grags pa'i drung du/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i gsung 'bum thor bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum po ti lnga dang skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i lung / 'jigs byed kyi dbang / sgrub (35ba)thabs rgya mtsho/ mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang rnams gsan/ rigs grwa dang byams smon sogs kyi tshogs dbur phebs/ bag yod ces pa chu glang gi lo gsar grub rjes/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa mu stegs rnams btul ba'i dus ston/ rje btsun 'jam dpal snying po'i mdzad pa/ smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs/ /thog mar ra mo che'i smon lam/ gos sku zhal 'byed dang dga' ldan khang gsar du sde pa dga' ldan bas bsnyen bkur zhus/ de nas lha sar snga dro 'brungs rabs so bzhi ba'i bka' chos/ phyi dro smon lam sogs phyag len gyi srol ma nyams par gnang bas mchog dman mtha' dag dad pa'i sal bkod / de'i tshe nam mkha' mtha' dag ni dbang po'i gzhus legs par dkrigs shing / lha rnams kyis mchode pa'i rdzas su man+ta ra ba phyogs kun tu 'thor ro /slar 'bras spungs su phebs tshogs su bka' chos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan phul bar bka' las/ kha sang khri thog tu bskos pa'i nyin 'bul sna la byung ba'i po ti de ci yin ltos dang gsungs/ lam rim yin pa 'dug zhus pas/ de kha byas chog gsungs nas tshogs chen du byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i bka' —48

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)chos gnang /lo de nang du sdogazar chen po langs te/gung thang me rtag mchod pa lha sa'i smon lam sogs bstan pa'i bya ba chen po rnams rim gyis stings par 'gyur ba mkhyen nas/bstan pa spyi sgosakyi sku rim la thugs brtson pa gnang /gos sku che ba zhig bzheng ba'i dgongs pa gtad de/nang so tshul khrims rin cen 'bul dpon la mdo smad du rdzong sta gnang ba'i tshe sngon sangs rgyas kyis shing sgrol rgyu'i tshal du tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po la gnang ba ltar bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas36na lhan 'brel sgrig pa mdzad/chos kyi rje bsod nams grags pa'i drung du/gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang /rig byed ma'i rjes gnang /las chen kun rgyal ba'i bka' gdams chos 'byung /be bum sngon po rtsa 'grel/da rna sha rta/me tog 'phreng brgyud/dga' ldan chos 'byung /gnas bcu'i sgrub yig rnams kyi lung gsan/don bdun cu'i rnam bshad cig bskul ba gnang bar brten/rje bsod grags pas skal bzang them skas zhes bya ba zhig mdzad de'i bshad lung phul/rig grwa'i tshogs dbu dang /phyogs 'dus kyi dad ldan rnams la bka' chos/mjal kha/rang nyid gsan bsam mdzad pa sogs phan tshun 'gran bzhin pa'i ngang nas/bsod nams kyi mthus sa la spyod pa'i mi bdag nang so dga' ldan pa don grub rgyal po dang /dbyangs can ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis rab brtan mched kyis/gung thang gi rten brten pa zhig gsos dang gos sku gsar bzhengs kyi rab gnas la gdan drangs/nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' tshon gyis khebs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang du byung ba ni/zhang bde ba'i rdo rjes rang nyid kyi gnas la slar rang nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i mthu'o//chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba'i khri wo por//dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang po//slar yang skal bzang gdul bya'i dpal yon du//thun mtshams gsar pa'i zol gyis 'gying pa la//gser mngal can dang dbang phyug pad dkar mig/lha yi bla ma 'chi med bdag po sogs//snyim pas sna tshogasamachod pa'i bye brag rnams//thogs te nam mkha'i khyon kun dog por byed//de nas kun dga' zhesapa shing stag gi lo gsar gtor chen sogs rgyasaX/ mdzad/36bti yang lo snga ma'i nang du nang so

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)dga' ldan pas/ skyor mo lung du dpung khyer 'khrid sogs la brten/ sdogazar gyi 'phro ma rdzogs pa'i stabs kyis/ lo 'di'i smon lam yang re zhig 'a rgyangs pa nas/ mal gro brgyud/ rgyal du phebs/ byamasakhang shod du nye ba'i sras brgyad bzhengs pa la rab gnas dang sbyin sreg gnang /de skabs kha ba chen po zhig babs pas thugs dam bskang gso ba rnams gser tog khang bzang na bzhugs pa la kha rengs skyel pa gnang ba'i gral du/ dpal 'jam dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed pa yi/ /don rnal 'byor lhur len thugs dam pa/ khyed der bzhugs tshogis pa'i rna lam du/ /mgur nyamasadabyangs kyi glu 'di bgyid par spro/ /dpal chu skyes me tog bkra ba'i gnas/ /rje bla ma'i byin rlabs chags pa'i sa/ /gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams/ /dpung mkha' la sprin bzhin 'du ba'i gnas/ /lar kha ba nyin zhag sbrel nas bab/ /ri mthon po'i rtse mo mkha' la reg /la lung rnams lha lung dkar po byas/ /dus de tshe nged kyis kha rengs bskyal/ /da de yi gdab lan re na yang / /ja bzang po lan grangs mang bar drangs/ /da de bas spros pa e yod na/ /da phyis nas yi ge bskur ba la/ khyed mkhan slob bka' gros thon par mdzod/ /yig lan zhig byas na mi drag gam/ /de mgur ma'i tshul gyi nyams 'tshar yin/ /zhes phyag bris su gnang /de yang gong du kha rengs dang bka' shog skyel bar/ drung nas kyi tsha bo bsod nams dpal 'byor legs pa bla btags ser chung zer ba zhig btang ba/ sku rim pa rnams kyis e zin bltas 'dug pas/ yang 'di skad gnang ngo / /thugs dam pa rnams kyi snyan du phul ba mdangs da nang (37na lnga zhugasaspro ba nas/ nged kyi kha rengs kyi lan la spyan hu re yod la che/ kha sang ja 'debs bzang po gnyis drangs pa de brjed pa min la che/ kha sang ser chung ma zin pa snying tshim/ da nang ser chung bsgugs pa snying na/ /kye kha rings kyi gdab lan chen po de/ /steng dga' ldan lha yul du dga' zhing song / /skyid tshor ro sems bde de la yang / da khyed rnams thugs dam rtse gcig mdzod/ /ces gsung ba gnang ngo / / thugs dam phyag g.yog pa dpal ldan bzang pos smon lam zhig zhus pas/ skyabs kyi mchog —50

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyedagyur yi dam lha tshogs dang / /mthu ldan chos skyong srung ma thams cad la/ /mchod gtor phul zhing bzlas brjod lhur blangs pa/ /de yi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ /bdag gi zhabs phyir thugs dam bgyid pa rnams/ /mthar thug bde ba can du pad+ma las/ /skyes nas theg mchog chos la legs spyod cing / /'dren pa 'od dpag med kyis rjes 'dzin shog /ces gnang / dga' ldan rtse'i sku skye grags pa rdo rjes/nyid kyi bstod pa zhig zhus par/ bsod nams rlabs chen bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ /lha mchog tshangasapa'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i gsung / /bslab gsum yon tan rgya mtshos gang ba'i thugs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /pheb/pa gnang / dka' bcu pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyis zhus pa'i ngor/ srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud cing khams gsum ma lus zin gyis gnon byed khro bo'i dbang po drag po'i chas kyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /srin po'i gzugs can 'jigs rung dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgus dgra bgegs ma lus 'joms par byed/ (37ba)phyag g.yon lcags kyi sdig pa nag pos log 'dren thams cad hub la 'debs byed mgo dgu rno ba'i rwa ni bco brgyad dang ldan pa/ /dbu skra kham ser gyen brdzes spyan gsum gdangs mig klog ltar 'khyug cing zhal nas mche gtsigs hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs khyod la bstod/ ces pa dang / yang skabs shig /ri dbang lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gran zla med pa'i gsung / /bslab gsum mkhyen pa'i dpal gyis gang ba'i thugs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes rje gong ma la bstod pa dang / g.yin yang rgyal ba btsong kha pa sogs mang po zhig la bstod pa thung thung ci rigs pa mdzad do/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba rje drung bkra shis pas chab mdo'i gdan sa zur bzhugs mdzad/ rgyal tshab tu mkhas grub mi g.yo snying po bskos nas kho rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i mchog gi sprul sku mjal pa dang chos 'khor rgyal gyi ri khrod du thugs dam la gzhol bar byon te/ thog mar me —51 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)tog thang du sgar mdzad/ mang 'gyed 'bul ba sogs longs spyod kyi za ma tog kha phye ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog gi sprul pa'i skur 'bul chen/ drung nas sogs sku 'khor ba rnams la gnang sbyin/tshogs su mang ja 'gyed bcas rnam gzhag sogs gya nom pa mdzad/ rje drung rin po ches thog mar zhabs drung du/ tshe dbang / dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang sogs chos la ci rigs gas/ rje drung rin po che la tshe dpag med lha mang gi dbang dang / gu ru zhi drag gi dbang gsan/ 'gur drag dmar chung gi ljags bsnyen zhig (38nasgo dzad pas/ lha tsho gos rnams zhal gzigs te/ bstod pa byin rlabasakyi rgyun chags zhes bya ba zhig mdzad/ rim gyis 'ol kha dang / bde chen sogs mchogo dman gyi skye bo rnams kyi re ba skong bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'bras spungs su phebs rje drung rin chen po che dpon slob bla brang du phebs te/ sgrub khang skyed tshal bde chen gling gi mkhar las dang bcas rgyal pa rnams chos dang zang zing gis skyong bar mdzad do/ /de mtshungs gos sku'i sbyin bdag chen mo klu skyabs ta shin gyis gtso byas 'bul dpon tshul khrims rin cen yang mkho rgu'i 'byor pa ji snyed pa dang bcas te sleb/ dgun chos la tshogs chen du lam rim gyi gsung chos gang 'gro zhig gnang / srin po zhes pa shing yos kyi lo gsar dang / smon lam chen mo'i thugs brel rnams grub rjes/ 'bras spungs su 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge'i gos sku khyad par can bzheng ba'i bzo grwa btsugs/ dbyar thog de la gegs med par grub ste/ dngos gzhi rgyal du bzhugs rgyu yin yang / chos skyong chen pos zhug pa ltar sa spungs su rten 'brel zhig gnang / bka' las/ hor zla dgu pa'i nyer gsum gyi nub nga'i mdun du/ mi nag po 'jigs zhus pa zhig 'ongs te nga'i gzugs bris zer/ khyod su yin byas pas/ de na re/ nga'i gzugs shig bris mdzod/ de nas mkhyen par 'gyur zhing / ci bzhed pa yang ngas bsgrub bo zer zhing mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas zla ba dkar ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin/ lha bris pa la bkod pa byas nas/ de'i sku 'bri shra'i dbu btsugs gtso bo'i skya ris grub ste mi mngon par las nas bzhag /de'i nub mo ye shes khyung nag —52

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyedame'i 'khor lo can yin zer ba zhig lus gsal bar (38ba tha stan byung nas/ nga'i sku bris pa de ston dang zer bstan pas legs 'dug /da dung 'di'i lto ba na gser gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su 'khor lo chen po dpa' bo gcig pa'i sku 'dra zhig 'bri ru chug zer zhing g.yin yang bkod pa mang du byas song bas de bzhin bris pa yin gsungs/ de'i sang nyin ras bris de'i g.yas kyi 'og zur du/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa rnam 'gyur gsum pa'i sku zhig skya ris brgyab pas/ de'i nub mo rmi lam du mon pa mang po byung ba rnams kyis phyag rten du ras re phul byung ba/ ras gcig gis kyang nang 'di thams cad khengs 'dug nga'i mdun na mtsho chen po zhig rba rlabs 'khrug cing 'dug pa'i nang nas a tsarla ras gos gyon pa zhig lag pa g.yas mi snying dang / g.yon rgyu ma khyer ba zhig byung ba des snying de za zhing mgon po'i sku de la bltas nas/ da lam rang rnam 'gyur bzhi pa'i sku zhig bris na dga' zer nas skya ris kyi sku de la thim song ba zhig rmis/ de nas rnam 'gyur gsum pa'i sku de kha'i dbu gtsug tu rnam 'gyur bzhi pa'i sku yang 'brir bcug pa yin gsung / rnam 'gyur zhes pa'i tha snyad gter ma dang mkhas grub dpal ldan seng ge'i nye brgyud bzhin la yod pa yin nam sa lugs la ni ma grags so/ /ri mo phal cher grub tu nye ba na mnal lam du/ klu sding ma 'di na stegs bu dpangs la gyang 'phar gang tsam yod pa de'i kha na phar la lus stod mi la smad g.yag tu yod pa 'ug pa'i mgo can/ lag pa g.yas pa gsum na gri gug so gsum pa so dbus ma la mi ro bskyon pa'i rgyab tu so'i rtse mo 'thon pa/lcags kyi rdo rje dang / lcags kyi bum pa rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon gsum mi rkang gi gling bu/ lcags sgrog /lcags kyi lag pa sdigs(39nasgo dzub can 'dzin pa/ stod la rin po che dang / smad la rusargyan gyis spras pa zhig gis/ rdo rje'i pho nya mo yin pas nga'i gzugs bris zer ba ltar zhal bkod gnang /ras bris rnams grub pa'i nub cig mnal lam du/ mi nag po zhig byung ste/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga las 'od zer dkar po zhig byung ste sku la thim pas dkar por yod/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)las 'od zer dmar po byung ste/ kho rang la thim pas dmar por song / de na re/ yi dam chos skyong gi gser thang mang po bzhengs mdzod/ de 'dri ba'i lha bzo ba yang bde ba can du skye zhing / khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral bar 'gyur zhes zer ba zhig byung bas/ ras gzhi bzhi tsam gyis ras 'dul bka' gnang ba'i sang de rje'i zhal nas mdang nga'i rmi lam du dge slong zhig byung nas/ lha lam yangs pa'i chu 'dzin la/ /bgrang yas nyi 'od kyis mdzes pa/ /bri cha'i skyon gyis ma gos par/ /yongs su grub na legs pa yin/ /zer ba zhig byung bas/ rgya nag gi skad du/ gzhi la zi zer ba yin pas/ ras gzhi gcig bsnan te lnga gyis la/ thub pa bdud 'dul/ 'jigs byed/ khyung nag /zhal/ chos rgyal rnamasabris gsung thang kha rnams grub tu nye ba na/ gsol ja zhig bzhes shing tshigs su bcad pa mang po zhig gsung gi 'dug pa la/ sprul sku bas ma zin par bskyar ldab cig zhus pas/ dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can gyi zhing / /'od dpag med mgon mdzes pa'i 'od zer tso/ /khyod kyi drung du bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /'di nas 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /ces pa de tshigs bcad kyi rjes ma yin de khas chog gsungs/ thang kha rnams grub tu nye ba na dgyes pa'i thugs kyi zhabs bro (39bsgo dzad pa dang mnyam du/ gu ru drag po nga yi pha/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed phu po yin/ /zhal bzhi pa ni zhang po ste/ /dpal ldan lha mo a lce yin/ /re ma ti ni bag ma ste/ /ye shes khyung nag g.yog po yin/ /bstan ma gnyis ni g.yog mo ste/ /nga rang gu ru pad+ma yin/ /zhes gsungs/ thang kha de bka' rgya dam pas 'bri sar thams cad ma 'gro zhes pa'i sgo yig gnang ba ni/ nyon cig dgos med mi rnams nye zhe/ /zhal thang 'bri sar ma yong zhig /gal te yongs na chad pas cho de/ /ces so/ /yang nub cig mnal lam du/ brag ri dmar po gnyis kyis bar la phyin pas zangs kyi bum pa kha gcod yod pa zhig 'dug pa'i rtsar sleb pa dang mnyam du/ chos rje yon mchog pa byung nas kha gcod 'di a bsol zer bar bsol byas pas kha gcod de phye song bas/ bum pa'i nang nas zangs kyi khrab gyon pa'i mi dmar po zhig don byung nas nga ngo shes sam ma shes na khyed rang gi chos skyong gnod —54

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)sbyin chen po yin zer/ de'i rjes su bud med dred thon pa zhig byung ste/ gnas 'di lam ru rtse zer ba yin zhes phyogs kun tu rgyug pa zhig byung / de gnyis gas nga la yang bkur sti byas slob dpon yon mchog pa la yang dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug gsungs/ de nas tshe dpag med lha gcig bum gcig gi ljags bsnyen zhig mdzad pas/ tshe dpag med dngos su byon nas dbu gtsug tu bdud rtsi'i rgyun pa blug pa zhig byung /thengs gcig drung nas la tshe dbang brgya rtsa zhig gnang bas/ spyan ltas la nam mkha'i khams su sprin gyi phung po'i dbus nas/ lha'i bu bu mo bum pa lhung bzed thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung ste/gsung rab pa'i mgo la bdud rtsi blug pa dang (40na)'od zer dkar pos lus gang ba sogs kyi nyams snang mtha' yas pa brjod kyis mi lang ba byung gsung/ yang thengs gcig bskang gso grol nas bzhugs me la bzhugs pa'i sar/ bka' las ngas ni sngags kyi bzlas pa mang po song / khyed tsho so ji rma song shod cig /ngas ya ma rā dza/ shā san/ bh+yo raka mo/ /la3 pa rnams dung phyur re song / tsa muṇ+ḍis ya gcig song / gzhan yang bzlas pa mang po song gsungs pa la/ gzims dpon chos rje yang dgon pas/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin byung dus 'gyur khyad rtsi ba'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la che/ gzhan de tsam mi 'gro zhus pas bka' las/ nga la gdong pa bcu gcig yod pas bzla theng re la stong phrag re 'gro ba 'dug /nyi zla gza' 'dzin gyi 'gyur la ma ltos/ yid ma ches na lha mo dpang du bzhag nas mna' skyal chog /gzhan yang shod rgyu mang du yod de khyed rnams kyi blor mi shong ba 'dug gsungs/mnga' ris nas mnga' bdag lha btsan po kong ma 'jig rten dbang phyug pad dkar lde dang paṇa chen shān+ti pa mchod yon gyis/ phyogs dang bstan 'gro'i ched du phebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul dang / de gong du sku tshab lta bur rnam thar ras bris ma shig dgos tshul gyi zhu tho 'bul skyel dang bcas par gnas brtan dka' bcu mang thos 'byor/ de yang mnga' ris rgyal po dang rje gong ma gnyis mchode yon lugs legs mus kyi rten 'brel rang 'grig tu gyur te/ so so'i zhu yig 'bul skyel rnams phul/ gu —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)ge bdag pos sprul sku 'phrang kha ba la yang bka' shog mdzad nas/ dad rten gyi rnam thar zhing bkod bskur dgos tshul yod 'dug pa ltar bslab ston (40ba)sogs/ rnam thar thun mong ba de tsho bris gsung pa ltar/ rten gtso dang sku bltams tshul sogs kyi skya ris kha yar thub pa na/ spyan 'bebs la khyer shog gnang / zhib tu gzigs te/ gu ge bdag po lta bu'i snod ldan la gsangs nas gzhan du 'chad pa dka' bas/ zhabs drung gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa nas/ bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar/ dga' ldan/ mkha' spyod/ bde ba can/ rnga yab gling sogs su sgyu 'phrul gyi rol gar gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar rnams stod cha la bris gsung ba ltar dang / rgyal du thegs pa'i bkod pa 'dri ba'i tshe/ de'i gnas bkod/ dpal ldan lha mo'i bla mtsho thun mong gi snang tshod ltar brisapa'i tshe/ bka' las mgon po zhal gyi bla mtsho'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum nag po yod pa'i nang du/ bram ze mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud pa/ chos 'byung gi phyi rol rba klong zhabrug pa'i nang du bud med nag mo gri thod thogs te gar byed pa'i tshul dang / khyung nag gi mtsho myur du mtsho zhal 'byed pa yin pas de yang bris gsungs/ de'i dbyibs tshul ji ltar lags zhus par/ mtsho kha dog nag po rba klong 'khrug pa/dbus su khyung nag dang g.yas su gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtsa dgu pa rwa shin tu gdengs pa/ g.yon tu rdo rje pho nya mo/ g.yin yang rba klong gi gseb nas gzugs med pa'i lag pa gdengs pa dang / me 'bar zhing glog 'khrug pa 'jigs su rung ba'i tshul yod pa de ltar bris zhig gsungs/ bka' las/ nub gcig nga'i rmi lam du/ gnas khang mun pa nag po yod pa'i nang na 'dug cing / de'i logs gcig la dkar khung snag bum gyi kha rgya tsam zhig 'dug /gsung rab pa la ngas 'di sus bdag byed (41na)pa yin dris pas/ dang po stor mo klung pa'i yin/ da lta dga' ldan pas bdag byed zer rtsan/ dga' ldan pa'i sde pa bgres pa yang de na 'dug pa na re/ nged sus kyang 'di la ma thar/ zhal snga nas kyis e thar lags zer/ ngas e thar bltas pas dka' se ba la thar byung ste/ dga' ldan yin zer ba'i steng gi khang pa chen po bzang po zhig tu phyin pas/ de na 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar —56

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyenaser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar pa las 'od zer rgyang nger 'phro ba zhig bzhugs 'dug /mar bltas tsa na 'dzam bu gling yin zer ba'i ko ba tsam zhig 'dug /slar bug pa de nas phyir 'thon te/ rdo skas ring po zhig las babs nas/ rdo skad de'i rtsa bar slebs pa dang / phyir bltas rtsa na/ gsung rab pa yang khang steng de na 'dug pa la / ngas g.yab yug byas pas/ gsung rab pa bug pa de ma ltos par 'phur nas byung / de nas nged gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang chen po zhig tu slebs pa dang / der tsha ba dbu mdzad dang / dbyangs dpon rin wo rgyal mtshan dang / kong po dbu mdzad dang / thon pa dbu mdzad sogs langs nas mchod dbyangs kyi gyer mo byed cing 'dug pa de rnams chos skyong srung ma'i cho 'phrul du snang / de nas nyi 'od 'khyil par 'ongs pas/ khri'i 'gram g.yas g.yon na/ chos rje yang dgon pa dang / dge bshes legs bshad pa 'dug pa la/ ngas khyed cag sgug yun ring po ma byung ngam byas pas ma byung zer zhing / da sku bsil yong na bza' bzhes pa zhu zer ba zhig rmis/de gnyis srin yul nas nga dang mnyam du 'das pa'i chos skyong chen (41ba)po'i cho 'phrul du 'dug /de'i sang bsam grub zer ba zhig gis ston pa'i sku gcig dang / dzam bha la'i sku gcig phul byung /dzam bha la'i sku de nang so 'bul dpon pa la byin/ ston pa'i sku de da lta yang bzhugs yod/ nga'i rmi lam de lha sa'i smon lam chen mo 'di la lta ba yin par 'dug /smon lam dka' las che se ba'i ngang nas rgyun ma chad tsam zhig 'ong ba 'dra/ rmi lam yin yang 'di'i bkod pa zhig bris gsung ba ltar bris/ de ltar ri mo grub nas rab tu gnas shing byin gyis brlabs pa de/ mnga' ris rgyal pos dad rten du spyan drangs so/ /'di sku tshe 'di'i rnam thar zhing bkod zhal bkod gnang ba'i thog ma yin no/ /hor zla bcu pa'i nang du gsang chen chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bka' bab tshul ni/ 'phags sdo lo tsā ba sngags ram pa dge 'dun ba po shis zhes smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi khrid rgyab rten gyi lung / rgyud sde'i bshad bka'/ rjes gnang bka' gtad bsnyan sgrub las sbyor sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i phyag bzhes/ gar thig dbyangs gsum/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba/ gtor bzo sogs/ mdor na rdo rje dang dril —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)bu 'dzin lugs tshun chad kyi phyag len phra rags mtha' dag la sgro 'dogs chod cing las rab 'byams sgrub pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba la 'jug pa la med du mi rung ba'i las rang gi bsnyen pa kha skong dang bcas pa tshad du thon shing / bskyed rim phra rags dang rdzogs pa'i rim mchog gi ting nge 'dzin zab mo'i rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po 'di nyid ni rgyud thams cad kyi bka' bsdu ba po dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje bsam bzhin du gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa ngur smrig gi gar gyis rol (42na tha'i zol la brten nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na bad ma gangs can pa rnams kyi mgon du mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam par bstan pa'i yongs 'dzin du byon pa zhig ste/ rtog ge pa dang sgom chen pa rgan po sngags kyi tshul la rnam par mi mkhas bzhin du/mgrin bzang gzig lpags gyon pa'i ngang tshul ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs brnyan la brten nas gdul bya mang po slu bar byed pa'i spyod tshul can rnams dang ye 'dra ba ma yin no/ /de lta bu'i dpal ldan bla ma de ni chos 'khor rgyal gyi gzims khang gong skyed tshal bde chen gling nas spyan drangs te dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs/ gzims chung nyi 'od 'khyil par bka' chos 'bul mdzad nas/ thog mar spyan ras gzigs don zhags/ bcu gcig zhal/ tshe dpag med lha dgu gsum gyi dbang rim gyis phul bas/ sang nyin bka' las/ mdang rmi lam nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i dbyings nas/ 'ja' 'od dkar po zhig shar 'dug pa'i steng na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khore gyi dbusasu bum pa thogs pa'i mi dmar po che ba gcig la bskor ba'i mi dmar po chung ba brgyad kyang bum pa 'dzin pa rgyan cha lugs 'dra ba zhig byung / kha sang tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang zhug par bzang ba'i ltas yin pa 'dra gsung / de'i tshe rje drung rin po che'i phyag na bzhugs pa'i nang rten rnams mjal ba mdzad mtshan ldan dbu thod de gzims chung lcog tu spyan drangs/ dbu sngas mgor bzhugs su gsol nas mchod pa dang smon lam gnang ba'i tshe/ bka' las da nang tho rengs rmi lam du khang pa brtse gos pa chen po zhig gi sgo khang na yar phyin rtsa na/ khyams na thab (42brdza po khang pa tsam zhig gi steng na/—58

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyenasnod chen po zhig btsugs nas ja 'dra ba zhig skol zhing 'dug pas/ ci byed dris pas sems can thams cad la ster ba yin zer/ de nas mar phyin pas gnam sgo zhig gi nang na skas gcig 'dug cing / de la 'dzegs nas tag tag byas pas/ bud med gzhen nu ma zhig gis bltas byung / de na su yod byas pas rdo rje phag mo yod zer/ bltas pas rje drung gang bzhugs 'dug cing / gsung rab pa yang de na yod dam snyam pa 'dug /ngas yongs e chog byas pas da lta ma ran zer gnam sgo bcad song ba zhig byung gsung / sgo srung de ni rang cag kha ba can pa rnams la thugs brtse ba zhig yin 'dug ces sprul sku 'phrang kha ba gsung / de nas rim gyis/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang la brgyud tshul sngon chad mang du byung yang / kṛ ya sa muts+tsha dang / gcig tu bsres pa'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga ma sa bzang 'phags pa nas dbang gi chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa 'di nyid/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang e waṃ pa yab sras ma gtogs/'phreng ba mkhan por grags pa phal cher gyi spyod yul du ma gyur kyang dam pa 'di nyid la mnga' bas rdzogs par phul/gzhan yang zur bka'i dbang / 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis/ bde mchog lo hi ba/ dril bu phyi dkyil dang lus dkyil/ sam+bha ṭa/ kyai rdor man ngag lugs dang rngog lugs/bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ gur rigs bsdus/ drag po gangs can/ rwa lugs kyi 'jigs byed/ dgra nag /gnyes lugs kyi ro langs brgyad bskor dang dgra nag /shad lugs kyi zhe dgu ma/ dpal 'dzin lugs kyi gshed dmar bcu gsum ma/ rnal (43na)'byor dbang phyug lugs kyi gshed dmar lha lnga / 'khor chen/ gtum po khyung nyi shu rtsa gcig khro bo bzhi dang bcas pa'i nyer lnga ma/ kun rig /mi 'khrugs pa/ gdugs dkar/ grwa lnga/ mi tri lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs dus 'khor rnams kyi dbang /phyag rdor khyung lnga/ u tsarla 'gro bzang lugs/ rnam 'joms/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal/ nor rgyun ma/'od zer can ma/ dzam bha la/ lo ma gyon pa rnams kyi rjes gnang / sa ra ha'i lugs kyi mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi/ dga' ldan pa la grags pa'i mgon po bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang /—59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)lha mo phyag bzhi ma gnod sbyin dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / snying zhugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / phyag bzhi pa ras bris dang lus dkyil la rten pa'i dbang / gur zhal legs ldan mched gsum/ bde mchog dang 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu/ dbyangs gsal ye dharmā/ yig brgya pa rnams kyi rjes gnang / mgon po bzhi sbrags dang dus mtshan ma'i dbang / seng gdong rigs lnga'i dbang dang de'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi dbang rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/gdugs dkar gyi dbang / rnam sras gsang sgrub ljang gu klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba/ ser chen/ dkar po/ bdud mo bzhi skor/ gshin rje ltar sgrub pa/ rkang thang ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / mi tra khrid drug gi rjes gnang / ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i be'u bum dkar nag /gtor chen 'khor lo sogs kyi phyag len zhal bzhes dang bcas pa/ rwa pod/ gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor/ drug cu pa sogs kyi phyag len man ngag sogs/ mdor (43ba)na dbang khrid lung gi rim pa mtha' yas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan par mdzad cing / dbang rjes gnang gi chas rnams ma bsdus gong du/ 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon bka' rab 'byams sogs chos don gnyer mang po dang / dge ldan rtse'i sprul sku grags pa rdo rje/ rje lha dbang dpal 'byor ba'i sprul sku rin po che dang / drung gnas rin po che sogs nang 'bor ba rnams la yang chos kyis tshim par mdzad do/ /de yang spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub bcu gsum ma'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang phul zin nas dkyil 'khor ma bsdus pa'i gong der/ dgu gtor dang 'grig pa'i chos skyong chen po dkyil 'khor gyi drung du byon te/ 'di skad ces gsungs/spyir sangs rgyas stong gi thugs kyi ze'u 'bru de pad+ma 'byung gnas/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' sdod de nga yin/ ngas pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' las rta rnga dum bu stong du gshags pa'i cha tsam yang 'da' ma myong / pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis nga'i las skal du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang / zas skal rdu dgra bo'i sha khrag srog dbugs rnams phog pa yin pas/ nga ni gtsug lag khang bre zhabs yan chod/—60

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)dkon cog gi rten mchod swā ts+tsha yung 'bru tsam dang / dam pa'i chos yig 'bru gcig yan chod kyi drung na pe dkar rgyal po re re yod / rten de dag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs kyi sha za khrag 'thung / dgra bo'i srog dbugs chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun tsam zhig nga'i kha na rgyun mi 'chad par 'gro yang / snying rje chen po dang skad cig kyang 'bral ma myong / de gnyis e 'gal/ nga ni mi 'gal ba zhig yin/ yang gal te rgyus sa bon rtsub mos bskyed pa'i 'bras bu 'jig rten rang rgyud (44na)kyi dregs pa sde brgyad du gtogs pa zhig yin pa'i tshe na'ang / de rtag tu de ga'i ngang du sdod pa ma yin te/ dper na ru tra thar pa nag po'i gtam rgyud la ci 'dra zhig 'dug /khyad par du deng sang snyigs ma'i dus su yod/ sems can dmu rgod gdul dka'/ ban dhes tshul khrims mi thub/ sngags pas dam tshig mi thub/ rgyal pos rgyal khrims lol bar btang / de'i 'bras bu 'thab rtsod/ 'khrug long / mi nad / phyugs nad/ lo nyes/ mu ge sogs kyis bde ba'i skabs med pa 'di yin/ de 'dra'i dus 'dir/ gdul bya sems can gyi don byed pa la/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bka' bsgos nas/ gdul bya chos dang zhi bas 'dul ba la/ sprul sku mthong ba don ldan byon/ de'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang / gdul bya dmu rgod drag pos 'dul ba de nga la babs pa yin/ sngar yang dgra bo yan par gtong ma myong / da dung mi gtong ngo / khyad par bcom ldan 'dasakyis rgyud sde las ji ltar gsungs pa'i dbang gi grangs dang / go rim cho ga lag len rnam par dag pa 'di lta bu mthong tsa na/ nga yan chad kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes pa rnams kyang /yul dang / gnas dang / dur khrod sogs gang na bzhugs kyang / so so'i zhing khams nas dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su skyong ba'i phyir 'byon dgos shing / nga man chad kyi lha srung yul lha gzhi bdag 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang rang gi dam tshig dran nas 'ong dgos pa yin la/ de ring nga yang legs so 'bul bar dga' bzhin du 'ongs pa yin/ la la zhig gis mi shes pa'i shesardzu/ ma go ba'i go rdzu/ ma (44btogs pa'i rtogs rdzu byed cing / de'i tshab 'dis 'ong / de'i dod 'dis gyis zer zhing / zag dang las sla dang / g.yo sgyu 'ba' zhig gis blun po dad pa can gyi khrod du/—61 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)grub pa thob pa'i khyad par can zhig yin pa skad byas shing / mi mgo bskor nas tshe 'phyid pa dag mthong tsa na/ dpe dkar rgyal po yang shin tu skyo bar 'ong gi 'dug kyang / 'di ltar rgyud sde rin po che rnamasalas gsungs pa'i dbang gi chu bo/ nor zhabrul gyi rnyog pa med cing / phyag len rnam par dag pa'i rlabs 'phreng 'khrigs pa/ gang gis myong ba de dag myur du 'chi bdag gi bdud las rgyal nas/ ye shes chen po'i bdud rtsis khyab par 'gyur ba 'di lta bu dag mthong tsa na/ dpe dkar rgyal po yang mchog tu dga'o/ zhan tu legs so/ /da dung 'phro mus rnams nan tar legs por yongs su rdzogs par mdzod cig dang yang gtor rgyab la 'gro'o/ bka' bsgo ma zhan cig /ces gsungs nas thegs so/ /de nas gsung chos 'phro mus rnams chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnang ba'i skabs shig tu/ rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po lo tsā ba ོ po'i drung du/ gnas sa nas/ chos skyong wo pos 'di skad ces/ gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku tshad che ba legs po gcig bzhengs la/ rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad nas/ nga'i gnas 'dir bzhugs pa zhig mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhug pa bzhin/ skyon rin po che'i sku mi tshad las che ba zhig bzheng ba'i bka' bkod gnang ba bzhin/ lha bzo ba 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos de'i bzo byas so/ /sos kyi chu 'dzin dkar po'i phang pa nas/ khru char 'phreng ba chal chil g.yo ba la/ /'dod ldan zhing sa'i snying la dga' skyed pa/ /dngos po'i gshis lugs yin phyir mtshar du ci/ (45na)grangasamed dus nas rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gling / du mar chos srung rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /'bral med bzhugs la sku yi snang ba dag /bstan pa'i tshul 'di dman ngor dgongs lags sam/ /rab 'byamasadakyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dge 'dun dbus/ /bkra shis rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len mkhas des/ /gsang chen theg pa'i bstan pa yongs gtad pas/ /in+d+ra bhu ti mkha' spyod gnas su bros/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pas/ rje mthong ba don ldan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs su gsol/steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ sku la khor khro ba'i mas 'jug /phyag —62

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)tu rdor dril phul te rdo rje slob dpon gyi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ rje sngags ram pa nyid kyis kyang rdor dril bsnams te/ bla med kyi rgyud sde las 'byung ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mdun bdar/ rje sngags ram pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'phreng ba'i ngag 'don gsal ba'i sgron me'i glegs bam phyag tu phul/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas par mdzad nas/ gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor rgya cher bskor bar bskul/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang glegs bam de nyid kyi steng nas gsung chos kyi dbu btsugs te rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs so/ /me pho 'brug lo'i tshes gcig gi gtor chen ma gshegs gong du/ rje'i zhal nas nub cig rmi lam du/ klongs la'i rtse na nga cung zad ngal gso zhing 'dug pas/ mdun gyi gangs ri de tshal bar dam pa'i nang nas mi dkar la dwangs pa/ sma ra ring pos sku sked du slebs pa/ smin ma me ltar 'bar ba zhig byung ba de na re/ nga la yang da lo nas bzung ste gtor (45bsgo che ba re dgos zer ba zhig byung bas/ma byas na mi 'ong ba 'dug gsung/ tshes bdun gyi nyin tshes gcig gi gtor chen gyi g.yas phyogs su bzhengs pas rgya dpangs thams cad mnyam pa zhig byung bas mnyes mnyes mdzad/ nang par snga bar bzhengs te/ nam 'og la bskang gso rnams grub pa'i nyi shar la rten 'bul sogs tshes gcig ji lta ba bzhin du gnang / bka' las/ da lam dpal mgon gyi gtor chen byas pa'i bkod pa thig ri mor 'bri dgos pa 'dug gsungs pa ltar bris pa'i 'og tu ban dhes gtor zor 'phen pa/ gtor rgyab kyi tshul du chos skyong chen po'i sku zhig dang / gtor chen gyi steng du zhal khra can gyi sku/ rgyab ngos su a tsa ra'i gzugs shig kyang bris shig gsungs/ de dag kyang zhal gzigs yin par snang ngo / /de grub pa dang phyag nas gtor te 'di skad du/ gu ge bdag po'i gdung brgyud 'di la mnga' bdag tse lde bya ba zhig byung 'dug pa dang / bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba gnyis bzlos/ bla mas mnga' bdag la chos skyong 'di rbad pas rtags mngon sum du byung / gus btud dang bshags pa phul 'dug kyang / de nas da lta'i bar du gong ma'i zhal ngo na rim la lo dus su shangs khrag 'chor ba'i nyen yod par 'dug /gnas —63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)brtan mang thos la gnang ba'i bka' shog phebs don kyang gcig la shangs khrag 'chor pa 'di phyis su mi 'ong ba'i thugs dam skyabs 'og dgos tshul du 'dug pa bzhin/ ngas gtor chen gyi nang du/ gong ma rang gis gnang ba'i gser gyi phud blug ste/ lha mi mthun sbyor gyi tshul byas pa yin/ rten 'brel gyi ltas kyang bzang po byung / sngar phan gong mas gzigs sar/ mgon po 'di'i sku (46na)khyer sa med pa 'dug ste/ da res 'di bskur gtong gsungs/ ras bris de gser yig pa log 'gro dus bka' shog gi rten la gnang /nag pa zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor thog /slob dpon chen po'i sku 'dra de la yab sras gnyis gas rab gnas mdzad de/ gnas chung lcog tu mchod sprin rgya chen po dang bcasate bzhugs su gsol/ tshes bcu'i nyin/ sngar gyi gtor chen gnyis kyi 'khris su rdo rje khyung nag gi gtor chen tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rgyas par bshad/ rje nyid kyis phod ka rus rgyan dbu zhwa rwa can sogs chas su zhugs/ drung gnas rin po ches gtsos phyag g.yog nang 'khor dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams kyi dbus su/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing zhal gzigs kyi ltas khyad par can byung / yang de'i tshe rje'i zhal nas/ nub cig tho rangs kha rmi lam du/ khyed rang skor lam du byon dang /rang byon zhig 'ong ba 'dug zer ba'i sgra zhig byung / de'i sang skor lam la phyin pas/ 'bras spungs kyi ltag gi mgon po bram gzugs kyi rdo sku rang byon 'di rnyed pa yin/ gzhan yang 'di na ngo mtshar can mang po yod de/ re zhig su la'ang ma ston zer ba zhig byung bas ma bstan pa yin gsung / de nas ston pa'i gos sku spyan drangs te/ bla ma yab sras rnams lhan cig tu rgyal me tog thang phyogs su chibs kha sgyur/ yar lam tshal zur khang / bde chen/ brag dkar rnams su sa skyong dga' ldan pas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ chos kyi bka' drin stsal/ de nas sha ra hor du gdan drangs pa'i tshe dga' ldan shar pa chos rje rin cen dpal bzang po yang mjal bar byon/ mchod yon (46ba) gnyis kyis gus pas mchod cing gsung chos kyi bdud rtsi zhus/—64

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyenade nas ma la gro rin cen gling du phebs te skya ser gyi khrom grangs las 'das pa la spyi chos gnang bas me tog gi char bab/ 'ol kha rdzing phyir phebs te mthong bas don dang ldan bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'ol kha rtser phyags phab/ sde pa rdzong dpon pas zhu ba la/ na ning gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i gos sku de da res gdan 'dren gnang yod 'dug pa ltad mo zhig zhu zhes zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ de ches pas khyon gcig par gdan 'dren thub pa zhig ni ma byung / dum bu re la khal rgyab re byas yod pas/ thamasacad sgrig thub pa rang ni da res la dka' ba 'dug /'on kyang sde pa zhal ngo gzigs spro na/ dum bu gcig gzigs phul zhig gsung / de nas smad dum gdan drangs te/ de la gtso bo'i khri dang / g.yasagayon tu dpal ldan lha mo dang rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gnyis kyi sku yod pas/ srung ma de gnyis kyi gnyan cha dang / 'tshub 'gyur gyi rnam pas slo bur du rlung 'tshub byung bas thams cad the tshom du gyur kyang / rten de 'grems par brtsams pa dang rlung yang zhi/ sprin yang dwangs nas nam mkha' g.ya' dang bral bar gyur cing / ci bder bkram chog pa byung ba na mchod yon rnams gzigs rtog gnang ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khyab pa'i 'od la dar dkar gyi gur lta bu dang / pad+ma'i tshal lta bu dang / gdod gnyan mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyi sku'i rnam par snang ba sogs ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i ri mo mngon par bkra zhing / lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs pa'i char bab pa sogs dge ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul brjod las 'das pa byung / rdzong chen der bla ma yab sras gnyis kyis (47na)gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bas/ gzhis ka de nyid skyon gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhā ti'i pho brang la 'gran bzod par gyur to/ /rim gyis chos 'khor rgyal du phebs/ tshogs pa la ja tshul dang rtsam pa sogs kyi bsnyen bkur dang gos sku'i lhu rnams bags te gos sku spe'u brtsigs grub pa dang / gos sku bkram pa'i g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang / mdun du mchod pa'i sprin rgya chen po spros/ bla ma yab sras dge 'dun tshogs chen dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas sbyin sreg dang rab gnas rgyas par mdzad/ de'i tshe 'ja' 'od sna lngas nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba las me tog gi char —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)babs pas/ der 'khod pa'i skye bo mtha' dag bla ma yab sras dang gos sku la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang ldan par gyur to/ / de skabs yar klungs su sde gzar langs par brten/ nang so 'phyong rgyas pas gdan 'dren snga phyir byung ste chibs kha bsgyur/ thog mar 'ol kha brgyud/ rong chad dkar du phebs gzhi len zhabs tog yang dag zhus/ ri sgor mchod yon lhan du phebs/ zhal ngo la bka' dbang dang khrom la spyi chos sogs gnang / de nas rgya ri rdzong du phebs te/ mchog dman mtha' dag chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ chab tshan gnang ste slar yang chad dkar du phebs/ zhabs drung rtse nas gdung brgyud sku gzhen pa'i drung yang mjal ba la phebs/ tshe dbang dpal mgon zhal gyi rjes gnang stsal/ rim gyis yar klungs tsha ba gru ru
