phebs/ bka' khras bcad 'phyong rgyas zhabs drung dpon g.yog ci bder thegs chog pa sogs dus gzings rnams zhi bar (47bsgo dzad de thams cad bde 'jags su bkod/ 'phyong rgyas rtser gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur gus 'dud phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ de nas rtses thang du phebs sngar nas dpon sa gong ma chen po la thugs gting nas gus pa'i tshul ston pa zhig yod cing / khyad par 'bras spungs kyi gdan sar phebs nas mjal bzhed thun mong ma yin pa thugs la gcags pa ltar sngar phan ngos mjal ma thub pas/ da res sne'u gdong rtser mjal bar phebs/ phyag 'bul gnang skabs/ sdesrid kyi phyag tu mi g.yo ba'i sku zhig bzung nas de la bsngo bsgyur mdzad/ sum gdan snye 'bol sogs bkur bzos che bar phul/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ rtses thang gi kun bzang rtser bzhugs pa'i nub/ bram ze mi mgo'i se ral kha yod pa zhig 'ongs te/ phyi'i yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed/ nang gi yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog /gsang ba'i yi dam rdo rje gdan bzhi byas na legs tshogs che ba 'dug zer ba zhig byung bas/ spyan ltas byung tshul dang bcas/ rgyal du rje drung rin po che la gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs shig thugs rtsom mdzad dgos par bskul ba ltar phul/ gdan bzhi'i nyams bzhes kyang 'chag med mdzad/ rim gyis nyang po gru brgyud 'bras spungs su phebs/ chos thog gcig gi ring tshogs chos —66

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)gsungs/ de skabs gzhan gyis rbad 'dre rbod gtong gi mtshan ma che bar byung ba dang / chos skyong chen pos kyang bskul ba ltar sku mtshams dam par gnang / sku zhang rin po che kun bzang rtse ba la mtshar chen nas brgyud pa'i dpal mgon zhal gyi dbang lung man ngag kha yar dang / rnying lugs kyi drag sngags 'ga' zhig gsan/ 'bri gung nas zhabs drung (48na〉sbos kyi rgyal po rin chen phun tshogs kyis gza'i than 'gyed zhig btang bas sprul gcig gzims chung du dngos su byung ba sku la thebs/ de gang zag rang bzhin pa cig la byung na dus kyi pho nyas zin pa las 'os med kyang / bar chad du 'gyur ba'i skyon ma byung / 'on kyang dus phyi mo'i bar du de'i shul du dbu skra mi skye ba zhig yod zer/ de dag bzlog thabs su mngon spyod drag po'i chas su zhugs te/ mnan sreg 'phang gsum gnang bas/ sbyin sreg gi skabs dgra phyogs su me lce tshad pa dang gtso rgyug pa slo bur du sprin 'khrigs te/ 'brug gi sgra chen po dang bcas te ser drag 'bab pa sogs rtags mngon du gyur/dmar ser can zhes pa me sprul lo gsar dang / smon lam gyi thugs brel rnams grub rjes/ snyan ngag gi dper brjod dang / rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bstod pa thugs rtsom mdzad/ /de nas rgyal du rten bzheng gi dgongs pa gtad de thig rtsa gzungs zhugs pa/ bal po shing bzo ba rnams sngon du rdzong sta mdzad de rim gyis rgyal du chibs kha bsgyur/ bde chen/ bsam yas/ 'ol kha rnams brgyud de phebs/thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma'i dngul gdung bzheng ba'i bzo grwa btsugs/ rje drung rin po ches bzo grwar phebs nas bgegs sgrod gnas khang byin rlabs bzo bo bzo cha bzo rgyu rnams la rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ bzo bo rnams la 'dzugs ston sogs bdag rkyen chad med pa gnang / bzo dngos gtsang zhing 'grub par byas skor gcig skyid shod du phebs te nang so 'bul dpon pa slar yang mdo smad du rdzong sta gnang /slar rgyal du phebs tshogs chen du ja tshul dang rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i bka' 'bum gsungs/gdan (48ba)bzhi'i dkyil thang bzheng ba'i ras gzhi la/ thig chog tshon byin rlabs sogs zhu bar —67—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)rje drung sku gzhogs su btang / zhabs drung nas bdun phrag gcig sku mtshams chod ma par bcad de gzims chung bka' gdams pho brang du 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa zhig gnang ba'i tshe mnal lam du/brag ri chen po zhig gi rtse na las gshin sku tshad che ba zhig 'dug pa gzigs pas/ sku mtshams zhag bzhi song nas glo bur du grol bas/ sku 'khor rnams kyis zhag bdun ma'i bcad rgya ma thim par sku mtshams glo bur du grol na bar chad du 'gyur ba ma lags sam zhus pas/ don grub na des chogamatshams la zhugs pa'i nub mo rang nas ltas bzang po mang bar byung / khyad par mdang rmi lam du rje btsun 'jam dbyangs yang gsang snying gi thig le sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bzung nas yum la 'byud pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba snyan gyi thad du kha phye ba'i steng na ral gri dang po ti/ de gnyis kyi steng nas 'tsher ba'i g.yas na nyi ma'i zhagasapa dang / g.yon na zla ba'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba'i stod g.yogs yug gyon gyi sne mo gnyis sa 'og tu song ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum dbyangs can ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa de lta bu'i yab yum gyi sku'i snang ba gsal po zhig byung / na bza'i dar sngon po'i sna gnyis sa 'og tu song ba de/ yar ji tsam 'then kyang rdzogs rgyu mi 'dug pa/ sa 'og gi sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/hor (49na)zla brgyad pa'i nyer gsum gyi nyin mgon po zhal gyi mchod gtor rgyas pa zhig gnang ba'i nyi rgas tsam gyi dus su/ glo bur du sku'i rnam 'gyur dkyus ma dang mi 'dra ba zhig mdzad/ har gyis bzhengs nas/ rje drung gi gzims chung du phebs te/ spyan ltas byung ba rnams kyi dri ba gnang / de 'phral phyir phebs te/ thugs dam gtor ma dang mchod pa 'di lta bu shoms zhes zhal bkod mdzad/de nub khrag cig dgos rgyur 'dug kyang mi rnyed pa 'dra zhes gsung / de skabs gdan bzhi'i rdul tshon —68—

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa 'dod snam la ma sleb tsam gyi skabs yin 'dug /spyan ltas ni phyag bris mar/ ka rang ka las byung ba'i gdong dmar li khri'i zhu ru can/ mkhur gnyis nag thig gis byugs pa zhig ka rang du sdod/ yang ka rang las skye dman skra'i lan bu rgyab tu 'phyang ba'i nag mo zhig byung ste/ ru mi la 'ba' ling nga tsam la bsgugs pa yin te ma byung / de ltar na maṇ+ḍal zhal 'byed par mi nus/ nga dkyil 'khor nang ma'i 'dod snam gyi mchod pa'i lha mo rnams bris ma tshar gong du/ nged gnyis la gtor ma dgos zer ba dang / mi li zhus pa de na re/ nged gnyis la 'bar ba khrag gtor dgos zer/skye dman de na re/ 'bar pa khrag gtor dgos zhes lan gsum zer zhing / de ma byung yang dpal 'bar me lce 'phongs zer/ de nas de gnyis kyi srubs de nas gdong brnyan zhig byung ba des skra sprugs byung bas nga'i lus khrag gis gang byung / de 'phral la nam mkha' nas rnal 'byor nam mkha'i zer ba'i sgra lan gsum byung ba dang / nga'i dpung pa la chab zer pa zhig byung / bltas tsa na 'o ma byo 'dug pa des khrag de rnams dag 'dug /de nas a tsa ra gcig byung ste 'tshab mi (49bskogos/ gang ltar na yang khong gnyis gtor ma la ham po byed kyin 'dug pas/ do nub rang khong gnyis la gtor ma byin zer/ de rjesang dang / chos rje rin po che'i sku mdun du yang / ma hā ra kodang / su ra ka ra gnyis byung ba yin tshod 'dug pa rnams brjed thor bkod pa yin zhes so/ /de ni rdo rje gad myo bzhi yab yum gnyis/de'i bstan srung dud sol lha mo/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa rnams kyi cho 'phrul yin par 'dug /gdan bzhi'i dkyil thang yang shin tu ri mo zhib cing legs par grub pa bar skabs su 'khyar ba/ ding sang phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i rten khrod na yod/ de nas bka' las/ thugs dam zab mo'i nyamasalen rtse gcig tu byed pa la/ 'di yang ma 'gol ba'i skyon zhig 'dug pas/ bar bar du mtshams dam po re byed pa'i mtshams khang zhig rgyag dgos pa 'dug gsung lhun grub dga' tshal gyi gzhi 'debs pa'i dgongs pa gtad pa yin la/ de yang chos 'khor rgyal gyi gnas 'di nyid ni/ mdo rgyud dang mkhas grub du ma'i gsung las lung bstan pa mtha' klas shing / khyad par e spel lcog pa gter ston —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)las 'gro gling pas/ tsa ri nas gdan drangs pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gyi yang snying / tshe dang ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyud gyi le'u bco lnga pa khol du byung ba 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas rigs mchog nyon cig /gangs can gyi yul de na byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyis 'dul ba'i zhid khams/ gangs can yul gyi lte ba/ ri bo 'bigs byed kyi ljongs/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug chen mo'i bdud dang mu stegs kyi g.yul (50na〉pas rgyal ba/ dpal ldan gtso mo dmag gi rgyal mos gnas kyi srung ma byed pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs gsang gi dkyil 'khor/ yul gyi dbyibs ni e las chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbyibs can/ gnas der 'gro ba gang gis bgrod pa thams cad nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtog pa 'gags shing zhi bar byed pa/ yul ni rig pa dwangs shing ngos dkar ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bsam gtan 'phel ba/dge slong gang dag gnas der gnas pa thams cad gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi don thob par byed pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i don la gnas pa/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mnga' ba/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ so sor yang dag pa'i rig pa bzhi mnga' ba/ dbang po lnga yid yul gyi mchog tu gyur pa/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la gnas pa/ rdzu snyul gi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i don mngon du gyur pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i 'phags pa dge slong gi dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po gnas der 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas rigs mchog bsam bzhin du gnas der 'dul ba'i sde snod 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gnas kyi bye brag ni 'di lta ste/ dpal ye shes sems dpa' 'jigs byed rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir na yul chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i dbyibs can/ dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i —70

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)rang bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro thams cad 'du ba (50ba)ri dang ri brag dang rtsi zhing dang nags tshal dang ldan pa/ dur khrod brgyad kyis dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/gcan gzan sna tshogs rgyu ba/ ljongs pad+ma'i mdangs gsal ba/ mtsho dang / rdzing bu dang / lteng ka /chu mig dang ldan pa/ lha'i gaṅgā'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i lha rdzas kyi me rtag bkram pa/ bkra shis par byed pa'i bya sna tshogs gsung snyan sgrog cing / bung ba rnams glu len pa/ dam pa chos kyi sgra 'byung bar byed pa/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs thams cad gnas der 'du zhing / phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang gnod sbyin kyi ded dpon thams cad gnas der dam la 'du zhing srung bar byed pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu bo mdangs ldan 'khor mar 'bab pa la klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang / nor skyong dang /dga' bo rnams kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che mchod pas dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du 'bab pa/ lha'i dbang po dang / lha tshangs pa rnams dang lha'i bu mo thams cad gnas der dus bzang po la 'du zhing chos nyan par byed pa/ dbus kyi ri bo 'bigs byed ces bya ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhugs pa'i gzhal med khang chen po rgyan bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod yul du gyur pa/ ri bo de nyid la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis dang / byang chub sems dpa' khri drug stong gi sku rang byon du bzhugs pa chu bur kyi mig gi mthong snang du grub pa/ ri bo de la 'khor ba'i mtsho mdangs ldan 'od kyi dra ba la dbus su 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba/ 'gro ba gang gi zhal lan (51na)re mjal bas las dang nyon mongs kyi bag chags sbyong bar byed cing bum pa'i dbang gi 'bras bu thob par byed pa'o/ /steng phyogs su dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa 'gro ba gang gis zhal lan re mjal pa thams cad bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i zhing du bgrod par nus te/ skye ba phyi ma shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i 'khor —71 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)gyi thog mar sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ro/ /'og phyogs su rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ gnas der phyin pa'i gang zag skyes bu chen po'i byams pa dang snying rje rgyud la skye ba/ g.yin yang yang dag pa'i snang ba'i ri bo bhi bha bya zhes ri bo zlum zhing mdangs gsal ba la de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs rgyal po dang / gser bzang dri med la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor ba rang byon lhun gyis grub pa/ byang chub chen po de nyid 'gro ba gang gis mthong zhing rna bar thos pa tsam gyis las dang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje'i mthus phyir mi ldog pa'i lha dang mi la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhing khams rnam par dag pa de na ri bo rat+na bkra zhes bya ba rin po che'i phung po spungs pa lta bu/ kha dog mdangs dang ldan pa'i ri la 'phags pa 'jam dpal gtso 'khor lnga'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bzhugs te/ gnas der bzhugs pa'i dge slong dang / dge tshul (51bskong / dge bsnyen yang rung ste/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa dang / ji snyed kun tu mkhyen pa'i ye shes brgyad la gnas te/ sa dang po nas sa bcu pa'i bar du byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob cing sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa gsal bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' gnas de na ri bo mchog tu gsal ba dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba ri bo de nyid mthong bas nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong 'gags par byed pa/ byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun khong du chud par byed pa/ bden pa bzhi mthong bar byed par/ rgyu dang gos bu'i don rtogs par byed pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi zas gos dang ldan pas 'jig rten gyi zas gos kyi khengs pa dang bral ba/ lha rnams kyi gzi mdangs 'jug cing 'phags pa dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu rdzu phrul la thogs pa med par thob par 'gyur ro/ /ri bo de nyid na 'og min lha'i rgyal po'i khang bzang dang mtshungs te/ dus bzang po la rgyal ba byams pa lha brgyad khri'i tshogs—72

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)dang bcas te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur ro/ /dus bzang po la 'gro ba gang gis sa phyogs der mchod par byas pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor byed pa dang / bkur bar byed pa thamasacad ni dgra bcom phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob nas rgyal ba byams pa'i sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyogs de nyid nas ri bo dri ma med pa'i mdangs gsal ba zhes bya ba/ sman gyi dri ngad dang ldan zhing pad+ma'i mdangs gsal bas sa phyogs de'i chu dang rtswa sogs 'gro ba gang gi lus la reg pa dang / stor zos pa thams cad kyang chag pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lus thob pa'o/ /zas gos kyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba ting nge 'dzin gyis zas gos la longs spyod pa sha stag ste/gnas der (52na〉kang zag gnas pa gang dag chos gos dang lhung bzed yid la bsams pas 'grub pa dang / zas gos kyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ skye ba phyi ma pad+ma las rdzus te skye ba dang / sangs rgyas stong gi zhal mthong ba dang / rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /ri bo de nyid ni sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas de na ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi chu bsam gyi mi khyab pa gnas te/ dag pa ye shes kyi chu klung gi chu 'thungs pas las dang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dag par byed pa dang / gnas de'i shar phyogs chu mig bdud rtsi ye shes kyi chu 'thungs pas lha'i spyan rnam par dag pa thob ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mthong bar 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje'i chu 'thungs pas tshul khrims kyi rgyan thob par 'gyur ro/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i mchog gi ye shes kyi chu 'thungs pas bde chen longs spyod kyi sku thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas de na lha'i bdud rtsi ro brgya dang ldan pa'i rtswa dang ldan pa'i rtswa mchog zos pas gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin thob pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhen nur gyur pa'i thugs rje las 'khrungs pa rtomachogo bdud rtsi'i zil pa can dang 'phags pa mtha' yas rigs mchog gi smon lam las 'khrungs pa'i byang —73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)chub ljon pa'i shing mdangs gsal ba'i me tog gi bdud rtsi dang / lha'i dbang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtswa mchog 'gro ba gang gis thos pa'i tshe phun sum tshogs par byed pa dang / tshangs pa'i stobs las skyes pa'i bdud (52ba)rtsi'i rtswa mchog zos pas dbang po'i gzi mdangs skyed par byed pa dang 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rtswa mchog zos pas nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa 'gags par byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi ming rnam par dag pa'i gnas de na dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i lha'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gter bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ ljon pa lha'i nor bu rin po che dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar byed pa'i gter dang / sbyin pa nas 'bras bu thob par byed pa'i gter dang /lha'i nor bu yid bzhin gyi gter yid la gang 'dod char bzhin du 'bab pa'i gter dang / lha rnams kyi gzi mdangs thob cing tshe phun sum tshogs pa thob par byed pa'i lha'i dbang po'i gter dang / 'bru dang rtsi bcud sbyin par byed pa klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang nor stong gi nor bu'i gter dang / dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du 'bab pa'i gter dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po rnam thos sras dang / dzam bha la dang / nor skyong gi dbang po la sogs pa'i bsod nams las grub pa'i nor bu'i gter dang / dgosa'adod thams cad 'byung bar byed pa'i gter dang / sa 'og dang sa steng dang sa blar gyur pa'i dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i gter dag kyang gnas de nyid na bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs yod/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtha' yas rigs mchog nyon cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhid rnam par dag pa'i gnas de nyid kyi ri de dag ni bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten du rang byung ba'o/ /ri bo rat+na tsakra ni lha las babs pa'i mchod rten du rang byung ba'o/ /ri bo mchog tu gsal (53na tha dri ma med pa ni lhums su zhugs pa'i mchod rten du rang byung ba'o/ /ri bo dri ma med pa pad+ma'i mdangs gsal ba zhes bya ba ni/ /sku bltams pa'i mchod rten rang byung ba'o/ /ri bo mchog tu 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba ni/ rab tu gyur pa'i mchod rten du rang byung ba'o/ /ri bo rin cen spungs pa lta bu ni dka' thub mdzad —74

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ rton)pa'i mchod rten du rang byung ba'o/ /ri bo rat+na zur mang zhes bya ba ni bdud kyi mthu thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i mchod rten du rang byung ba'o/ /ri bo lhun zhing mdangs gsal ba zhes bya ba ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mchod rten du rang byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtha' yas rigs mchog nyon cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag na tshangs ris kyi lha thams cad 'du ba'i gnas bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ sum cu rtsa sum gyi lha thams cad 'du ba pad+ma'i ljongs dang /'phrul dga'i lha rnams 'du ba me tog gi mdangs bkra ba'i ljongs dang / /mtshe ma'i lha rnams 'du ba zhe'u gsing gi ljongs dang / dga' ldan gyi lha rnams 'du ba spos kyi ngad dang ldan pa'i ljongs dang / g.yin 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams 'du ba gangs ri'i mdangs bkra ba'i ljongs dang / tshangs lha gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams 'du ba byang chub ljon pa'i shing gi me tog gi mdangs bkra ba'i ljongs te/ dus bzang po tshes brgyad dang bco lnga dang nyer lnga la rgyal ba byams pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang / lha'i bu bye ba phrag brgya'i tshogs dang bcas te gnas der chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'byon par 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba gang gis dus bzang po la gnas(53btir me tog dang phreng ba dang spos dang byug pa dang gdugs dang rgyan mtshan dang mar me'i 'phreng ba dag dang / zhal zas dang sil snyan dang rol mo dag gis mchode par byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor byed pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni bgrang bar mi nus so/ /dge slong dang dge tshul dang /dge bsnyen yang rung ste gang dag gnas der bsnyen par rdzogs shing / bsnyen par gnas pa gang yin pa de ni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' chen po mtha' yas rigs mchogo nyon cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnasader/ gang gnas pa'i dge slong dang / dge tshul dang / dge bsnyen 'ang rung ste/ 'gro ba gzhan dag kyang gnas der gnas pa de dag thams cad ni tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang /bsod nams kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung —75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānepo dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas der lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma dang phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong rnams dang rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang gnas de srung ba dang skyob pa dang sba bar byed do/ /gnas der gnas pa'i 'gro ba gang dag la bdud sdig can gyi tshogs kyis glags lta bar mi 'gyur zhing / bdud gyi bar du gcod pa'i tshogs kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i rgyal po mtha' yasadang / nor skyong dang / dga' bo dang / 'jog po dang / stobs rgyu dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma ོ po dang /rigs ldan rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas de'i mtsho mdangs (54na skon mtsho'i rmang la gnas te/ klu'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod par byed pas na sangs rgyas kyi zhing der dus dus su klu rnams kyis char 'bebs te/dus bzang po la me tog gi char 'bab cing / rtsi shing dang / myu gu dang / me tog rnams kyi mdangasagasal bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas de na gnas pa'i bya dang / ri dwagasadang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ro/ /skye ba phyi ma la chos kyi sal pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po mtha' yas rigasamachog /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas der dge slong dang / dge tshul dang / dge bsnyen gang dang gang dag gnas pa de dag thams cad ni phyir mi ldog pa'i 'phags pa dgra bcom pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyis rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs pha rol tu phyin pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dar/ smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang tshig dang don gyi gzungs thob pa/ dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtha' yas rigs mchog gangs can —76

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6) gyi ljongs der bsam bzhin skye ba blangs te sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par (54bskog pa'i gnas dang / 'dus pa dang po la ni nyan thos brgya phrag gsum dang / theg pa chen po'i gang zlag brgya'o/ /khrus pa gnyis pa ni brgya phrag bco lnga'o/ /dgra bcom phyir ma ldog pa bden pa mthong ba ni brgya phrag go /'dus pa gsum pa la ni khri phrag go /sangs rgyasagyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas de la chags 'jig mi 'byung ste/ rgyal ba byams pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i zhing khams kyi mchog dam par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ gangs can gyi ljongs de ni byang chub semasapas 'dul ba'i zhing du 'gyur bas na/ ji srid bskal ba'i bar du byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod gsum dang / bla med theg pa'i chos kyi bstan pa gsal bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas rigs mchog dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhen nur gyur pa dang / lha'i dbang po dang / tshangs pa dang / gtsang ris kyi lha thams cad dang / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i tshogs thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems pa chen po gangs can gyi ljongs sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa 'phags pas 'dul ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i gnas der sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gsal bar byed pa'i tshe bdag cag rnams kyis kyang gnas de bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i gnas der sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bgyi'o/ /zhes 'dus pa' 'khor thams cad rjes su yi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi yang snying tshe (55na skong ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ gangasacan gyi ljongs su 'phags pa mtha' yas rigs mchog gzugs kyi skur bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes te sde snod gsum gsal bar byed pa las/ gangs can yul gyi ri bo 'bigs byed sangs rgyas kyi/zhing rnam par dag pa'i 'ganas 'phags pa 'a yul zhes pa lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o/ /ḍā ki —77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skani gtad rgya: zhes pa 'di yin/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas rgyal po dza ya se na e spro bhū ti phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi rgyal po le'u khri drug stong bka' stsal ba'i gsang pa 'dus pa'i tshe dang ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyud rnams ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis skyon mkha' 'gro'i yi ger bkod/ rin po che be+e ḍūrla las grub pa'i mchod rten gyi bum par rin po che mthing shel gyi ga 'ur bzhugs pa las/tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i gnas su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis skyon gyi yul nas spyan drangs te pad+ma saṃ bha wa bdag la rdzogs pa'i bka' gtad bgyis pa las/ pad+ma saṃ bha wa bdag nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi bka' dri ma med pa skyon mkha' 'gro'i yi ge las bod kyi skad du bsgyur te/ gzab bshar 'dres pa las/ bod kyi yi ger btab pa 'di tsa ri tra ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i gnas kyi lte ba/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i pho brang rang byung rdo'i gtsug lag khang du gter du sbas te/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis srung ma mdzod la/ lnga brgya tha ma'i dus su byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtha' yas rigs mchog gangs can gyi yul der skye ba bzhes te sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i tshe/'phags pa ka t+yā ya na'i (55bsgom par sprul pa pad+ma bdag gis 'phrin las su rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa/ da lta'i la ba pad+ma gar dbang bsam bzhin skye ba len pa la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gdams pa'i gter gyis gtad rgya bgyis pa ni/ ḍā ki ni rgya rgya rgya: sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / rnam par dag pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs gsang gyi dkyil 'khor gangs can gyi yul rgyal gyi gnas dag pa ye shes kyi gnas mchog der/ pad+ma saṃ bha wa bdag gis gnam lo rgyal po sa pho 'brug gi lo la 'go btsugs/ gnas der dpal ldan gtso bo dmag gi rgyal mo dang / zhing skyong chen po dam la btags te gnas kyi srung mar bskos pa'o/ /gter kha gsum pa'i gter yig dang gnas yig zhib pa rnams yang rdzong shel gyi phug par gter du bzhugs yod/ sam ya rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di nyid gnam lo rgyal po shing mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ sprul sku las 'phro gling pa nyid —78

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ smyon)kyis pho brang g.yu mtsho'i gnas rang byon rdo'i gtsug lag khang nas spyan drangs pa'o/ lkog ser las bshus pa yin/ zhes pa byung la/ bye brag tu dga' tshal gyi gnas 'di nyid kyi lung bstan/ bka' gdamasaglegs bam rin po las/ der mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dga' ba'i tshal/ nyams bag phebs dga' bar skyong ba'i sa/ zhes pa'i lung bstan gyis zin pa'i gzar mo'i ri la dga' tshal dbang drag rol pa'i gtsug lag khang 'ding ba'i lta gon la mngon par phyogs te/ bka' las/ gzar mo'i ri sked kyi spang sdings pha gir sa bzung ba'i cho ga zhig byed du 'gro bas/ gur dkar nag 'bubs pa sogs grabs kyis gsungs nas/ dpon slob phal mo che der phebs nas thugs dam gnang ba'i tshe/ nam mkha'i mtha' (56nasgo skor kun tu sprin gyi yol bas bskor ba'i dbus g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' 'od dang / me tog sil ma'i char ltas bzang po byung zhing de dus bstan skyong chen mo grags mo rgyal mi'i khog la zhugs nas byung de/ 'di skad du/ sprul sku mthong ba don ldan chibs kyi yan lag bzhi nas mkha' 'gro bzhis bteg ste bar snang la 'byon pa 'di e mthong / chos 'khor rgyal gyi srung ma de sngar yang nga yin/ da dung ngas mi chog rgyu med kyang / sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su skyong ba'i ched du gnas 'di'i srung ma la/ rgyal po chen po srog bdag pe dkar chen po yang 'byon pa yod pas/ de'i sku mkhar zhig kyang rgyag dgos pa yod do gsungs/ de nas stag gi nyi ma la/ stag lo ba dbon po bsod nams dpal 'byor gyis rmang brkos pa'i 'og nas/ rdo'i gtor stegs shin tu legs pa dkyus ring la zheng che ba zhig byung ba'i khar/ thugs dam gtor ma cha tshang dpal 'bar dang bcas 'jog gnang ba/ rlung 'tshub chen mo byung yang dpal 'bar g.yo med du 'bar ba sogs ltas bzang po byung / phyis gza' skar bzang ba la gzims khang gis gcod pa'i thig 'debs pa'i dus su/ rdo'i dung g.yas 'khyil gnyis dang / rdo'i sgrom bu kha mtshams khro chus bsdams pa zhig byung / de nas brag che ba zhig gi ngos la hor lham bzhes pa'i zhabs rjes chen po yang byung / bka' las 'di slob dpon pad+ma'i zhabs rjes yin/ glegs bam las/ gser dri ma med pa'i mchod rten yod/ /gsung ba yang 'di yin zhes ngos 'dzin mdzad/ ces—79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skakho bo'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa gsung / mgon khang gi sa bcad pa'i thad du brkos pas rdo'i chos yang gru gsum pa/ ngos re khru re gang (56bakhi khyer kyi dpangs la sor bzhi tsam yod pa'i rang byung chos 'byung gi dbyibs can rnams 'thon pa sogs dge ltas phun sum tshogs pa byung / de nas zla ba dgu ba'i nang du dngul gdung gi bzo legs par grub ste/ byams khang gzhal yas lha khang du bzhugs pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel sogs phyag len dngos gtsang bar bstar ba dang / khyad par rje gong ma'i thugs las byon pa'i bde mchog rang byon/ gdung la dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi sbom sar mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad lta bu'i dung 'bur gyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ sku'i sgyu ma g.yung drung 'khyil ba dang / gdung rus gdung sol/ pur ras/ 'ching thag gi zi ta shu'i zhags pa/ gzhan yang dbu lo na bza' sogs dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung gi thog drangs/ sa dge bka' phyag /sngags rnying ma sogs ris bral gyis/ mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyi byin rlabs rten zad mi shes pa'i phung po za ma tog lta bur gyur ba'i mchod sdong dam pa de nyid la/ bla ma yab sras gnyis la rdo rje 'dzin pa grangs med pas bskor te/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ snga dro nam mkha' dwangs pa la 'ja' 'od sna lngas khyab pa/ phyi dro char chen po bab pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mtha' dag pa byung / de nas dwags po la gong 'og gis spyan drangs te/ bra pho steng / bsam gtan gling / lcang ra mkhar thog rnams su phebs nas/ khrom chos dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya phrag brgal ba bsgrubs/ rim gyis grum mdar phebs/ phun tsho gis dbang pos bsnyen bskur zhus/ lugs gnyisakyis tshim par mdzad/ sku rab gnas gzhin nang so g.yul rgyal pas thog drangs/ skya ser gyi tshogasal/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis dam pa'i (57na〉zhus kyi sgra bsgrags pas phyogs lhung gi kun rtog can rnams kyang dad pa'i gsos su byas/ de nas or dang / bang rim gyi bar gyi skya ser mtha' dag la dam pa'i cho so kyi char bab/ smin grol la bkod de/ bka' brgyud kyi chu 'go dwags lha sgam po'i gnasagazigs la phebs/ spyan snga bkra shis rnam rgyal de dag snang can zhig yod 'dug pas mjal gleng dang —80

rgyal dbang bsod nam rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)phan tshun du chos kyi 'brel pa gsan res mdzad/ mchod mjal skabs sku 'dra rin po ches/ skyes bu dam pa byon pa legs/ /dad pa'i sa gzhi gang ba legs/ /phrag dog rlung dmar zhi ba legs/ gdul bya smin grol bkod pa legs/ zhes gsung byon/ der 'khod pa'i skya ser rnams kyi don rgya chen po mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang nas ma la gro brgyud de 'bras spungs su phebs/ rje rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa de nyid/ rgyal nas tshur phebs pa'i lam kha phan bde dgon par sku myang ngan las bzla ba'i tshul bstan/de yang zhal chems su/ nged kyi skye ba dwags po gla mdar 'ong bas/ der nyer len gnang ba zhu zhesapa'i zhu 'phrin 'jog par mdzad pa ltar/ sprul pa'i sku mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid chen po de byon/'bras spungs su gnas tshul gsan pa dang dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs rgya cher mdzad/ dgun chos la rje gong ma'i gsung 'bum gyi 'phro mus gnang / sa rta'i lo gsar smon lam chen mo sogs grub rjes/'bras spungs su tshogs chen la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho rdzogs par gnang / mgon po zhal gyi bsnyen pa zhig mdzad/ de skabs yar klungs bkra shis bde legs su 'ol kha nas lung bstan zhus pa'i yi ge ngo bo las/ sa pho rta lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig gi nyin/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i drung du /sde pa (57ba〉sogs la stag rtse bas lung bstan zhus pa la/ zhabs drung rin po ches mchogo gi sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku cha bzang po zhus pa'i len ni/ mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po dang / /rang gang mos dpal ldan bla ma sogs/ /yi dam mas ldan srung ma mchod/ / rnal 'byor rgyu lus shel dkar mchod rten yang / /glo bur 'jig par ma gyur kyang / /mi gtsang 'khon grib la brten pa'i/ /nad kyi dri nogs phra mo 'khor/ /gting nas bar chad cher med kyang / /gnas skabs rnal 'byor rang gi snang ba lam du long / /yi dam lha yi bsnyen sgrub 'bad pa thon/ /lan med kyi sbyin gtong kun la 'bad/ /rigs drug gi sems can kun rnams skyong / /de khas bar chad kyi rigs rnams sel 'gyur zhing / /'khor 'das gnyis kyi dbus su ni/ /rnal 'byor rigs ldan sgyu lus shel dkar tshugs/ /rtsa ba ba gam brtan gyur cing / /dbus kyi bum pa bar snang yongs la khyab/ /rtse mo chos 'khor gser gyi gser —81—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6lophru re/ /steng dga' ldan lha gnas yul du khyab/ /mi gtsang 'khon grib kun la phyogs bzhin gzur/ /gtum chen khro bo nga bran 'khor bcas gnas pa'i sar/ /mchod gtor spyan gzigs nam mkha'i gang ba shoms/ /'phrin las kyi sgo mo phyogs bzhir kho bos 'byed/ /rnal 'byor da lta gnas pa'i yul phyogs der/ /dgos med kyi 'khrug long slong gyur bas/ /sa de nas nyi ma nub phyogs ri sna yi/ /lung gsum mdo ru khrag gi mtsho mo 'khyil/ /dgos med kyi kha chu mang po byung / /rigs drug gi sems can snying rje chen pos skyong / /dge ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /legs bshad kyi go yul de la 'tshol/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /drung nas rin po che'i sku cha zhug pa lan du/ rang mos bla ma yang ma lus pas mchod/ /sgyu lus thang (58na skong sdong chen de/ lo yi bskal pa cung zad bgrangs gyur pas/ /gnas ya mtshan can gyi rten rnams la/ phyag mchod skor ba 'bum gter dang / /lan med kyi sbyin gtong kun la thong / mthar thug don gyi snying po la 'bad na/ lo ni gnyis bcad gsum gyi ngo tsam du/ /rgyu lus srog gi sdong chen tshugs gyur cing / /rtsa ba drod gsher bcud kyis 'tsho bar gyur/ /legs bshad kyi go yul de la tshol/ /zhes pa byung 'dug go /hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga'i gza' skar bzang ba la/ se ra theg chen gling gi chos kyi khri la phebs/glegs bam rin po che'i tshogs chos gnang / lhas me tog gi char babs cing / kun dad pa'i sa la bkod/ lugs gnyis kyi dga' ston rgya chen po bsgrubs so/ /med byung rnam dkar dkar po'i 'bras bu kun/ /gcig tu 'dzag byed byed po bla na med/ /phul byung 'phrin las las bzang mtha' klas pa/ /spal mkhas bla ma ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon khyod dkon cog 'bangs su gyur pa'i dus/ /dus gsum gsal ba'i lung bstan nyer bab de/ /de ltar dgongs nas lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal ral chen spel pa'i sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ /theg chen chos tshul ma lus pa/ /theg gsum thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /theg mchog la brtson gling gi khrir/ /theg kun ma 'dres mkhyen 'di mdzes/ /slar 'bra/sa spungs su phebs/ rin po che kun bzang rtse ba la zhal gnad dbab kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang gsan/—82

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)de'i zhal thang hal tshon ma zhig 'phral bzhengs gnang / tshal ba'i mgon po ko gtums ma dang 'dra ba zhig yod gsungs/ zhal khebs kyi mtha' skor dmar btsems/ skabs shig kha phye bas ser drag dang thog 'khyug yong la khad pa lta bu'i 'tshub 'gyur byung/ da lta dga' ldan pho (58ba)brang gi gzims chung mgon khang na gzhugs/ de skabs dga' ldan pa dpon blon gyis skyor mo lung chos sde la bskor rgyag byas pas/ phyi nang gnyis gar mi gron che ba sogs byung bar/ dpal mgon gyi lung bstan der dgongs te/ bar chings su phebs/ chos sder dpang lag mdzad de phan tshun mtha' dag bde 'jags su grol/slar 'bras spungs su phebs nas bzhugs thog /hor dpon thar 'bum gyis sngar nas hor nang du phebs dgos pa'i gsol ba mang du btab cing / 'di res gdan 'dren pa yang slebs/ che bas kha ma bsgyur ba'i sngon du/ chos skyong chen po sku phebs nas hor rnams la 'di skad ces/ byang sha zan gyi rigs yin kyang / dkar po dge ba'i blo skyes/ chos dang chos smra ba la dad pa thob nas sprul sku mthong ba don ldan lta bu'i bla ma spyan 'drongs pa 'di bsod nams chen po yin no/ /bka' gdams pa las ma 'gal zhig /ces gsungs so/ /rje'i drung la'ang 'di skad ces gsol te/ da lo skor tsam phebs pa de srog chags tshad med pa'i don chen por 'gyur bar 'dug /'on kyang zhag nyi shu las mang ba ma bzhugs/ mi ngo rtags can zhig byung tsa na tshur spyon cig ces zhus pa/ de yang gsol ba nan gyis btab par brten rong po 'dam du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i lam zhen du/ lha sar rjo shāg mjal zhing smon lam gnang / slob brgyud glang thang gi thad du phebs pa na hor gyi gdan 'dren pa rnams rta rtsal 'gran pa sogs dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston/ sde pa dpon g.yog rnams kyi bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas phyon gzhis gar phebs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i chos kyi gdan khri la mngon par 'dzegs pa'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gsang chen slob bshad kyi bstan 'dzin chen po (59na〉khas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug mtshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bzhugs pa —83—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skadang 'grig /der dpon slob mjal 'dzom 'dzad pas chos rje'i gsung las/ nga rje gong ma'i slob ma yin pas da lam 'dir mjal ba 'di rten 'brel shin tu legs zhes bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel zhig zhus/ de nub mtshar chen la/ gur gyi mgon po'i rjes gnang zhig gsan/ dpon slob gnyis phan tshun du 'brel gtam gyis thugs dgyes par byung / rim gyis 'od 'jo'i mdor phebs pa'i tshe/ yul lugs kyi go khrab gyon pa'i hor gyi rta pa stong phrag gis bsu ba dang bcas te hor dpon gyis thog mar mjal bas dad pa gting nas rnyed dpon mo yo khom bza'i sger gzhis ldan byung du phebs/bsnyen bkur zhus/ stag lung chos rje khri gdan zur gyis ja 'dren dang 'bul ba mdzad/ de nas rim gyis mtsho sle gong du phebs/ dpon gyis yang 'di sa bkra shis pa chos 'brel gyi thog ma gnang dgos zhus pa ltar sang zhogs dbang gral bsgrigs pa dang nyi ma shar ba dus mnyam 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char sogs byung bas hor rnams kyis pi wang gi sgra las drangs pa'i bstod pa phul/ /de nas dpon tshang du bar sngon la byon/ /dpon slob rnams rim bzhin phyi nas phebs pa'i lam du/ hor gyis bskor ba'i ja pa rnams kyis spyan 'dren zhus/ de dag rnams la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes nas dbugs dbyung ste 'dam gzhung du phebs/ dpon tshang gi yul dkar po'i nang du gdan drangs te bkur sti gya nom pa bstegs/ sngon ko khyim la ye shes bla ma'i dgon shul du bzhugs sgar mdzad nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ phyin chad ja la pa'i 'grul rnams la gnod pa mi byed par gdams te/ dpon (59ba〉na yog thams cad kyis khas blangs/ hor sog gi mi glen zhing snying rje chung ba sha lpags la longs spyod pa srin po lta bu rnams kyang sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa la gzhol bar gyur/ de nas dpon mo dang sras blon po rnams kyis kyang so sor spyan drangs te mchod cing bsnyen bkur/bla ma bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi dpon po blo bzang ba dpon slob kyis bsnyen bkur zhing bka' chos mang du zhus/ dgun gyi dus yin yang / 'khyags rom rnams chur zhu zhing spang ljongs margad kyi gos gyon pa sogs dbyar gyi lang tsho la 'gran pas kun ya mtshan par byed/ hor stod pa khre rgyal 'bum —84

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)dang dmi dpal sgom sde nang chen po sogs kyi zhu yig dang bcas te gus mchod lhur len byas/ de skabs nub gcig bzhugs me gnang sar bka' las/ / 'dir hor lo bco lnga tsam rta kha rin pa la ngo mtshar du 'dug ste/ ngas lo gsum nas rta kha zin pa yin slong gsungs pas/ de las kyang ya mtshan pa mang du lags sam zhus pa na/ yod de/ lo bcu gcig yan la/ gur drag gi sngags 'bum phrag nyis brgya/ lo bdun yan la tshe dpag med kyi sngags 'bum phrag bcu gsum/ gzhan yang dbyangs can ma'i bsnyen pa sa ya lnga/ skyabs 'gro 'bum phrag bzhi/ lo bcu gsum pa la rgyal du ye shes khyung nag gi sngags 'bum phrag gcig /da lo yang 'bras spungs su dmigs brtse ma 'bum phrag bzhi song gsungs/nyin gcig bzhugs sgar nas lho phyogs kyi lung pa zhig la phebs pas/ tshur lam du chu kha zheng po zhig la/ chibs pa drag tu bskul te mchongs pas/ kun ha las te 'di 'dra mi gnang ba zhu/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis kyang chibs mchongs ma mdzad pa 'dug zhus pas/ /bka' las bla ma gong ma rnams kyis sde zhabrug chen po'i bar 'chings dang / yul (60na〉srungs sogs ma mdzad 'dug kyang / bla ma sngon ma rnams kyis ma mdzad pa mang po zhig byed dgos 'ong ba 'dug /gser la'i rong du rta khams bzang gis pha bong chen po gcig la mchongs pa dang / rtse thang du rta 'drogs nas gad g.yang gom pa bco lnga tsam zhig la mchongs kyang skyon ma byung ba ni dkon cog gi thugs rje yin/ da res kyis 'di nged rang gi rtsal yin/ da dung mchongs che ba gcig la sku rim pa'i gur sgo tsam du rgyag /'di'i bar la gom pa nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam yod gsung ba bzhin gzhal bas byung / dpon gyis nga rkarma pa dang lhag tu 'bri gung chos rje la dad po yod de/ da res tsam ma byung bdag gi skyabs gnas mthar thug khyed yin pas nga rang la sger du lhag pa'i lha zhig gnang ba dang / dgon pa 'debs dgos pa'i zhu ba phul ba ltar/mgon po zhal gyi rjes gnang gnang ba'i tshe las 'gyur gyi rnam pa dang dpon rang la mgon po'i sku'i mthong snang byung zer/ dgon pa'i sa dmigs der phyag nas 'thor bar mdzad/ nyer lnga zhig dang 'grig pas gling me sbar ba sogs lha mchod kyi srol btsugs/ rim gyis rwa sgreng du phebs/ jo bo phying dkar —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yoyob dngos su bsu ba la 'ongs pa gzigs/ zhag bdun gyi ring skya ser gyi tshogs la bka' gdams glegs bam gyi dkon chog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs dang / snying po don gsum gsungs/ jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rjes thog drangs pa'i rten gsum rnams zhing par mjal/ dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa rgya chen po spel ba gnang / 'brom ston slar yang rwa sgreng gi khri la phebs par/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab/ dkar me ru ba'i thebs sogs gnang / 'phan yul mda' brgyud tsho gis gsog pa sogs ja pa 'byor ldan rnams kyis mchod/ lam zhor du jo mjal (60ba)gnang ste/ 'bras spungs su phebs/grub chen dpal ldan rdo rje zhes 'ja' lus kyi sku brnyes pa de la/ gzims chung nyi 'od du bde mchog lu hi pa'i dbang gsan pas/ drung nas gsung rab pas kyang 'jabs nas zhu thub pas las dang skal bar ldan par lung bstan/ nam mkha' las gser gyi me tog yu ba can gsum tsam bab pas gcig dngul gdung rin po che'i gzungs bzhugs la yod 'dug /grub chen rang gis slob dpon pad+ma la dngos su gsan pa'i tshe dbang phul/ mnga' ris lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang gis/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i skar rtsis kyi skor dang / 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i chos bka' 'ga' zhig phul/ de yang rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' sdod/ sde brgyad thams cad kyi yang rje/ dregs pa kun 'dus kyi rgyal po/ sprul pa'i chos skyong lha'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje 'od ldan dkar po/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon yang le shel zhes yongs su grags pa de gnas chung gi sku mkhar du/ mi'i khog tu zhugs te/ rje 'di nyid la gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / sku che ba'i yon tan brjod pa'i bstod pa sngon du btang nas/ da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya skal ldan rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub tu smin grol la 'god pa'i ched dang / gnas skabs su yang / yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mtha' dmag gi gnod pa bzlog pa'i thabs kyi dam par/ rje nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ri mor bkod pa'i rten khyad par can zhig /bkas gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes zhus shing gsol ba btab bo/ /de'i tshul 'di ltar hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer brgyad kyi dgung la dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi chos grwa chen po'i lcags ri lta bu —86

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ rton)bka' srung rgya mtsho'i pho brang gnas chung rgyal po'i sku mkhar du/ chos skyong (61na rdza po sku khog la zhugs nas byon te/ dgos pa khyad par can gyi slad du spyan drangs pa la brten nas rje btsun rin po che dpon slob lnga mdzad nas shin tu gsang ba'i tshul gyis gnas der gshegs te/ lha'i rgyal pos legs par bshams pa'i stan bzang po la bzhugs so/ /de nas gsol ja dang gser skyems bzhes pa'i rjes su/ rje bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ chos skyong chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ spyir na chos thamasacad bden par med pa zhig yin na'ang / kun rdzob bden par snang ba'i ngor/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi thugs kyi pad+ma'i zi'u 'bru de/ pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtse mor pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang na yod dus/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' bsgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dag ster la btang ba yin/ de yang sprul sku mthong ba don ldan gyis zhi rgyas kyi sgo nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong gi 'phrin las mdzad/ nga pe dkar rgyal pos dbang drag gi sgo nas de'i 'gal rkyen sel zhing /mthun rkyen 'gug pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub/ de ltar gnyis gas kyang bstan pa'i dag ster byed dgos rgyu yin pa dgongs su gsol/ khyad par du'ang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis nga'i zas skal du/ dgra bo'i sha khrag srog dbugs phrog /las skal du bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin bsrung bar bskos pa yin pas/sngar yang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' las 'da' ma myong / da dung mi 'da' bas mthong ba don ldan gyi sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin las rnams la bar chad 'dug na ngas sel/mthun rkyen thams cad ngas sgrub/gal te gnod byed gdon bgegs shig yod na/ mi dang mi ma yin pa snang zhing srid pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad dregs pa can gyi nang tshan du gtogs pa cig 'ong ba las 'os (61ba)med/ sde brgyad thams cad kyi yang rje dregs pa kun 'dus kyi rgyal po de nga yin pas na/ nga'i bka' las 'da' bar nus pa'i gdon bgegs su gyur pa ni su yod/ de bas na bskul bar ma zhan zhig thugs chung mdzad mi dgos so/ /zhes sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i bka' mchid thun mong ma yin pa zhus gnang gi sgo mang du gnang ba'i mthar/ chos skyong chen po des yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di'i —87—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi thugs kyi pa blo'i ge sar las mchog tu sprul pa'i sku mthong ba don ldan/ /yul dbus 'dir mtha' dmag gi 'jigs pa chen po zhig mi 'gyang par 'ong ba 'dug ste/ /byung na'ang /sprul sku mthong ba don ldan rang gi 'gro don 'phrin las pa ni mi gnod/ 'on kyang da lta nas bzlog thabs byas na bzlog ni thub pas ji ltar byed zhu ba la/ zhabs drung gi zhal nas/ de lta na bzlog thabs cis kyang mdzod/ ces bka' bsgos pa dang / yang gsol ba/ de lta lags na/ spyir chos grwa chen po rnams su dgag dbye/ dgu gtor gyi rim pa/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i bya ba rnams gong 'phel du gtong ba dang / bye brag tu'ang sprul sku mthong ba don ldan nyid kyi rnam par thar pa sgro ma btags pa/skur pa ma btab pa/ ri mor bkod pa'i rnam thar gyi thang kha rgya che ba la bkod pa legs pa zhig 'phral du grub dgos pas/ de dag thams cad la bka' bkod kyis khyab pa mdzad pa zhu zhing / /ngas kyang dam las ma 'das pa bgyid par zhu zhes gsol to/ /yang de'i tshe chos skyong chen po de sprul sku 'phrang kha pa la'ang 'di skad ces gsungs te/ 'o des na/ sprul sku mthong ba don ldan gyi rnam thar thang kha che la legs pa zhig dgos pa de/ khyod kyis bris pa zhig byung na bsam pa e yong gsung / yong zhus/pas 'di skad (62na gi sungs te/ 'o na dbus su mthong ba don ldan gyi sku sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa gtso bo de'i bzhugs gnas thams cad me tog pad+ma'i rang bzhin yin pa/chi stod kyi cha la rnam thar gyi bkod pa yod pa de ya nga pad+ma re re'i ge sar gyi steng du/ sngon ji ltar sku bltams pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ nga pe dkar rgyal po dang zhal 'dzom mdzad pa yan gyi mdzad pa rnam thar re re bzhin bkod pa/ de'i smad kyi cha la g.yin yang 'di yin gyi nges bzung med pa'i dgon gnas kyi bkod pa rgya che la legs pa'i mdun du/ nges bzung med pa'i chos grwa chen po/ der yang chos nyan gyi dge 'dun tsho gos pa chen pos yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su chos lar pa po chos ston gyi phyag rgya can/ thams cad bkod pa ci mdzes/ de'i 'og tu pe dkar rgyal po khog pa la zhugs pa'i cha lugs thams cad da lta'i 'de ga 'dra ba la/ ru 'dren sdebazhi sku'i skyo rogs la sogs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyang rngam —88

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)brjid 'jigs su rung ba sogs gang la gang 'os kyi bkod pa gang legs bris pa zhig dgos/ nga'i sprul pa yang sprul gyi mtha'/ khyod mi'i 'gro bas mi chod/ de bas na de dag kun gyi mtshon byed yod par bris pas chog /de ltar byas na spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dga'/ sgos su slob dpon mthong ba don ldan gyi 'phrin las la'ang dga' ba yod/ de'i rgyu rnams srong btsan sgam po'i brgyud pa yin pa'i btsun pa des brtane na/ khong la yang dga'/ nga la yang dga' ba yod pas/ kun la dga' ba de cis kyang gyis shig /ces gsungs so/ /de nas slar gzims khang du phebs pa dang / rje nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / chos skyong gi gsung de dag thams cad la'ang dgos pa re 'dug /rnam thar thang ka de yang (62ba〉/na la dga' na bris pa drag /lha btsun pas kyang de'i ras gzhi thon/ nga la rnam thar mi dgos kyang / bstan pa dang sems can la phan na byed rin chog ces bka' gnang / yang dus re zhig na/ chos skyong gi zhal nas sprul sku 'phrang kha ba la 'di skad gsungs te/ khyod la ngas sngar byas pa'i bkod pa de'i logs shig tu/ chos 'khor lha sa'i bkod pa zhig byung na 'jig rten la dga' ba yod de/ des na nga'i bkod pa 'di shin tu gal che ba zhig yod pas/ khyod kyis brjed du mi rung bas/ brjed byang gi yi ge dkar 'jam gyi logs pa bris shig /'o ras gzhi ji tsam che ba legs/ dkyil du saganon mnyam gzhag can/ /de yi mchan khung 'og gnyis nas/ /byung ba'i pad sdong rtsa ba gnyis/ /'jol te byas nas gyen du 'byer/ /de las gyes pa'i me tog gi /'dab ma'i dkyil gyi phung po la/ /mdzad pa re re bzhin du bstan/ /dkyil gtso'i steng gi rigs bdag la/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas yongs grags te/ /de yang paṇa chen sku las ga' na/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo'i mgon du bsngags/ rten gtso dngos gzhi'i sku sked man/ /g.yas kyi bus mo'i mar zur la/ /gtsug lag khang gi bkod pa mdzes/ /g.yon gyi pusamo'i mar zur la/ /dgon pa de yi bkod pa mdzes/ /de dag dbus sam phyogs gcig tu/ khub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po'i sku/ /dre'u nag rting dkar chibs shing rngams/ /phyag g.yas spa yi 'gying zhabar dang / /g.yon na tsan dan rin chen bsnams/ /rol tu glog dang me lce khrid/ /'jigs rung khros—89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6lopa'i rgyal po de/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du bris/ /dgon pa de yi mdun na ni/ /bzhes dmar gtor 'phen pa'i tshul/ /pe dkar rgyal po rang mas bsten/ /'khor gyi ru 'dren bzhi po yang / /sngon gyi (63na)shul sel bud med ci/ /nas mo lag g.yas hu lu ma/ rgyag phyir ra lpags g.yang gzhi 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thal rdeb rgyag pa'i tshul/ kha nas drag sngags 'bod pa ni/ /mi bzad ral pa g.yo ba bris/ /rgyab nas sngags pa phur thogs ni/ /rngam brjid gar 'chams byed pa bris/ /g.yas na nyan thos zhi dul rnams/ /lhung bzed 'bar bsil g.yas na 'chang / /chos gos zlum por bgos pa yi/ rgyab na po ti khur ba bris/ /g.yon na skyes ma dpa' ba ni/ /go khrab gyon zhing ru mtshon 'phyar/ /skyo bsang 'bag seng gar mkhan rnams/ /rol mo 'brol zhing ju gar rtse/ /sku yi skyo grogs bal po rnams/ /la thod mdzes par bcings pas bskor/ /gzhan yang nag po a tsarla/ khros pa'i 'khor mang dang bcas bris/ /ngo bo de dag kun las kyang / /rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med 'phro/ /mog ro rta yi spu las kyang / /pe dkar rgyal po'i sprul pa mang / /de yang blo chung rnams la bshad/ /blon r+pā snod yangs khyod 'dra la/ /srid pa'i rtse nas mnar med bar/ /skyes 'gro dbugs kyis zin tshad kyi/ /ltag par pe dkar rgyal po re/ /yod kyang yod la bshad kyang shod/ /tshwa ni sus kyang gzung du med/ /des na rgyal po sku lnga po/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i tshad dang grangs/ /'gro ba mi yis ji ltar chod/ /mawo byed gang legs tsam re bris/ /de las gzhan yang bkod mdzes ni/ /bstan dang 'gro la dge zhing shis/ /yid 'ong lta na sdug pa rnams/ /rang blos legs par dpyad la bris/ /de yang gang 'gro mi shes pas/ khyod kyis gzabasadris yang dag gyis/ /rten de 'di ru dgos rgyu min/ lo ni bas gnyis tshun chad na/ mtha' 'khob kla klo'i yul du dgos/ /(63ba 'gro 'dul bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog de yin la/ /bstan pa'i zhabs tog kyang de yin/ /khyod kyi thugs dam des chog ste/ /tshogs gsog de las lhag pa med/ /'di nas brtsis pa'i byang phyogs su/ /chos dang chos min gnyis ka dang / /ldan min rgyal blon 'khor bcas rnams/ /mthong thos rnams kyi don ldan byed/ /de nas kyang ni yul gzhan du/ /de yis—90

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)dregs ldan rgyal po 'dul/ /'gro don mtha' rgyas lhun gyis grub/ kun la dga' ba de ltar yin/ /'o de ltar dkar 'jam gyi steng du nag chab phab pa min/ bstan pa gtan la phab pa yin pas de las gal che ba med ces gsung ba la brten nas/ sprul sku 'phrang kha ba dpal ldan blo gros bzang po zhes pas/ dbyangs can ma'i thang kha zhig 'dri bar brtsam pa'i tshe mngon rtogs ji lta bu zhig yod dam snyam the tshom pa na/ /dbyangs can dngos su zhal gzigs nas/ sprul sku ba nga 'di na yod pas gzigs dang zhes gsungs pas/ sprul sku nga la gzigs su gsal pa bi shwa ga rma sa 'dir babs pa lta bu des rnam thar zhing bkod kyi thang kha rgyas par bris so/ /de nas sa gzhi'i dbang phyug gong ma chen po dpal ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po kwan ding ta'i gu shri hong hang gis gser yig pa mngags te ti grir bkur ba'i bka' shog stsal bar/ dpal gangs can gyi mgon po 'gran zla dang bral ba khyed lta bus phyag dam dmar po gnang bar 'os shing / khyad par da ni nged sde srid kyi che ba yin pas bka' shog dmar po gnang dgos pas/ de yang rten 'brel legs tshogs kyi slad du/ /'di phyogs la chibs kha sgyur ba'i sngon du/ bka' shog gsar du bskrun pa 'di/ thog mar jo bo rin po che'i drung du tham phud (64na)'bul ba gnang nas/ kun gyi spyi bo'i rgyan du 'god pa zhu zhes byung ba la/ bka' las/ phebs skad ltar yin phyin bsgrub pa las 'os med gsungs/ jo bo rin po cher snyan ngag gi tshigs bcad dang bcas tham phud phul/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la chibs kha bsgyur te/ thog mar 'phyos su phebs/sde pa dpon g.yog gis bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ 'dod chos kyang thugs dgongs rdzogs par gnang / de nas nang so 'phyong rgyas pas thob rgyal lha rtse dang / srong btsan gzhis gar spyan drangs/ tshe dbang sogs 'dod chos ci rigs pa gnang / ri bo sde chen dang spyan g.yas su phebs te khrom chen po la dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston stsal/ slar thob rgyal lha rtser phebs te don grub ces pa sa lug gi lo gsar gtor chen gnang / de nas mkhar thog tu phebs/ rnam rgyal rab brtan nas zhabs —91 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yodrung sras yum gyis gus mchod mdzad/ sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbang gnang / de nas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te chos grwa chen po dpal gyi rtses thang du phebs nas stag tshang gzims spyil du bzhugs/ hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang ba la/ sde srid kyi bla ma'i che bar 'os pa'i las tshan gyi rim pa dang bcas pas bsu ba'i bkod pa ngo mtshar bas mdun bdar te/ pho brang chen po sne'i gdong rtser phebs me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od kyi 'phreng ba khor yug tu khyab pa sogs dge mtshan mtha' yas pa byung / de nas gzims chung kun bzang yang rtser lhan rgyas su bzhugs gral zhig gnang / de grol nas gong sar sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang tshe khrid thun mong ma yin pa dang bcas gsung chos 'bul bar mdzad/ de yang bka' las (64bsnyu zhabs drung dang mjal rgyu'i de nub/ zhabs drung gong ma chen po'i mnal lam du zhabs drung rang nyid spang ljongs me tog sna tshogs shar ba/ spro zhing yangs pa zhig gi dkyil du bzhugs 'dug pa la/ ri zhig gi rtse nas sprin shin tu dkar ba zhig dbu'i thad du nar gyis byung ba'i dkyil na mi dkar po zhig gis 'o ma'i chu zhig dbu la blug byung ba dang / thugs la 'di ci byed pa yin snyam tsa na/ lha'i bu gos dkar po gyon pa zhig byung nas/ me tog gi 'phreng ba zhig sku pang du bskyur byung bas/ sngar 'phreng ba ji snyed cig byung yang 'di 'dra ma byung dgongs mnyes/ yang de'i bum pa dkar po zhig nas bdud rtsi gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu dbu la blug pas/ sku lus bde bas gang byung ba'i tshul/ sang nga sku zhabs su slebs dus bka' phebs gnang byung / gzhan yang ngas phul ba yin zer ba'i dbu zhwa ser po mdog legs pa zhig gong ma chen po nyid kyi dbu la bzhes pa sogs ltas bzang po mang du byung gsungs nas dgyes dgyes gnang ba zhig 'dug ces bka' phebs/ slar yang sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i tshe dbang zab mo rgyas par 'bul ba gnang ba'i tshe/ tshe ril phyag tu phul ba gsum spel zhig byung bas rten 'brel legs par 'grig /tshe ril lhag ma rnams kyang phyag tu bzhes/ gso k+ṣa/ba gung tshigs kyi bzhugs gral nas bzung /gong ma nyid dang bzhugs stan mnyam pa sogs gzengs bstod/ deng phyin chad nas nged mi ngo dang —92

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)bcas pa la phyag 'tshal mi dgos zhes bkas bcad/ de'i tshe bod chos rgyal gyi gdung las 'byungs pa'i mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po lha btsun bsod nams mi 'gyur rab brtan dpal bzang po la/ gong nas thugs gnyer gang la mdzad dang grwa bskor (65na〉sogs kyi dri rmed zhib par gnang / zhu lan tshig don bzang po phul bas bzhugs gral mtha' dag gsan spro bar gyur/ de nas lha'i btsun pa dang rtses thang las chen sangs rgyas mgon po gnyis/ bzhugs gral la chos kyi 'bel gtam mdzad de/ ston pas bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi sngon du lung gi chos gsungs par thal/ de'i sngon du lha'i bkra shis don grub ma'i tshigs bcad gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes sogasachos 'khor gyi skor dang / tshad ma bslu med can zhes pa sogs rnam 'grel gyi skor la bgro gleng mdzad pas gong ma thugs mnyes par gyur/ gong nas shel bum chu ris mar grags pa'i zhal dkar/ sde srid kyi khyad nor la mtshar ba des gtsos pa'i zang zing gi dngos po dpag tu med pa phul/ /ka bzhir rtse tshogs pa'i rten 'grems dang bcas te bsnyen bkur zhus/ de nas rtses thang du phebs/ rim gyisa'aphyos rgyal mtshan rtser phebs bzhugs thog phyag dam dmar po gnang dgos pa'i yang skyor gyi gong ma'i bka' shog phyag bris ma las 'di lta ste/ chab shog khyad ja'i rten zhib cha dang bcas phebs/mdang sang sku mchog tu snyoms pa nas 'phyos tshor phebs skabs yin 'dug pa cis kyang legs/'dir yang nad 'tshe med ngos kha tan 'phel bar yod/ gang ci'i zhib cha dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i ngag nas 'bul ba ltar/ dgongs yul du zhugs pa zhu/ rten mtshon byed bkra shis kha btags zung 'brel la rgya ldan 'bul/ tshes bcu gsum la phul/ ja sor the'u rtse phul ba/ bstan pa dang / 'phrin las bzang po phyogs thams cad du khyab pa'i rten 'brel yin pas/ phyag dam dmar po rang gnang bkod yod pa zhu/ 'di bzhin gnang 'dug /de nas lha sa smon lam gyi grabs yul grub pa (65bskong / hor dpon yang mjal bar yong ba sogs la brten/ 'bras spungs dang hor dpon sogs kyis gdan 'dren byung bas skyid shod du chibs kha sgyur/ sa spungs su phebs/ hor dpon la mjal kha bka' chos sogs—93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)kyis tshim par gnang / dpon gyis kyang da lam yar klungs kyi mdzad pa gal chen rnams bgol nas/bdag gi don la phebs pa thugs rjes bzung / de yang sangs rgyas zer ba de ma thob kyi bar du rjes su 'dzin dgos/ dad pa'i rten zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ bka' las/ nged rang da lam yang khyed dpon g.yog gi don byed du 'ongs pa yin pas/ khyed mgu ba zhig ster dgos/ de yang thub pa grong khyer ma 'di gsung 'byon ma yin par yang byed/ sngon dmag gis 'di'i zhabs la sta re brgyab pa'i shul yod pa yang rim gyis bsos pa'i byin rlabs can yin gsungs nas gnang bas/ mchi ma 'khrug cing ba spu g.yo ba dang / mgo sgyur cing re zhig smra mi shes par lus/ de nas lha 'di 'dod kyang dmigs phub zhu ma nus/ mngon mkhyen thogs med mnga' ba 'dug /ces dad pa lhag par skyes shing rten de spyi bo dang snying ga sogs su sbyar te zhus pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma ston/ mchod yon lhan du smon lam chen mor phebs/smon lam nyi ma dang po'i mjal kha zhus nas hor rnams rang yul du log /smon lam gyi rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyi mdzad pa rgya chen po gnang / byang phyogs sa'i bdag po nang so dga' ldan pas dga' ldan khang gsar du spyan drangs/ dam pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de nas 'bras spungs su sku mtshams kyi bcad rgya dam par gnang ngo / /phun tshogs sdebazhi'i 'byor pa ma lus pa/ /phyur bur spungs pas srid 'dir mngon mtho ba/ /sa dbang phag mo (thun snyi pa'i cod pan du/ gyur pa'i snyan grags phyogs kyi 'gram par sgrog /rnam bzhi'i sbyin pas ris med 'gro ba kun/ phan bde'i lam du bkod la mtshar du ci/ gzod ma nyid nas lus can ma lus pa/ 'dren pa'i phul byung dam bca' mdzad min nam/ /de yang phag mo gru pa'i sde srid 'di/ spyir rgyal khams sgos sdod pon rnams la gcis pa yin zhes/ spyan snga chos grags pa gsung la/ dga' ldan chos 'byung du/ phag mo gru pa'i sdo srid dang rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i bstan pa gnyis srog gcig lta bur 'dug gsung bas/ spyi sgos tshang ma'i sar dpal phag mo gru pa'i bstan pa 'di rgyas pa zhig dgos rgyur 'dug na'ang / 'gro ba'i bsod nams dman pa'i dus kyis chad pa lta bur/ sdo srid zhal ngo nang zhig pas dus zings chen po langs te/ de zhi —94

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)ba'i thabs su chibs kha sgyur/ thog mar bsam yas su phebs/ mdo sdomachode pa dang 'grig /gnas mjal rnams zhib par mdzad/ pe dkar dkor mdzod gling du sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po dang mjal/gnod sbyin chen po 'di sde brgyad dregs pa kun gyis yang rje/ mthu stobs rdo 'phrul dpag par dka' ba zhig yin pas/ sngon sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis gur mgon gyi gsang khrid zab mo thugs nyams su bstar ba'i nus pas/ sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rnams la gus pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pa rang zhig yod 'dug cing / 'bri gung zhabs drung rin chen phun tshogs yab sras dang / gzhan yang gsang sngags rnying ma'i rig sngags 'chang ba rnams la/ skyon rin po ches dam la btags pa'i sngon gyi tha tshig rjes su dran pa dang / rang rang gi mthu stobs nus pa'i byed po la brten nas chos skyong chen pos gus pa'i rnam 'gyur (66bsgo dzad pa yin par snang / gzhan du na rkar 'brug sprul sku/ stag lung chos rje sogs bod 'di'i rang gzhan gyi 'gro ba'i 'dren pa chen por grags pa phal che ba la dngos su thugs sun phyung ba dang / brgyud nas bar du gcod pa btang ba sogs bla ma srang la 'deg pa zhig yin 'dug kyang / dam pa 'di nyid la bkur bzos legs par phul/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi lung bstan gsal bar gsungs/ sbug chol sogs spyan gzigs mchodi gtor rgyas par phul bas/ chos skyong gis sbug chol de dkrol dang gsung / dkrol par skad snyan po byung bas/ de dang mthun pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub ces zhal bzhes mdzad/ de nas rtses thang du phebs/ gong sa nas gzims khang ye bzang rtse 'bul ba gnang /der bzhugs/ de'i tshe sku zhang rin po che kun bzang rtse pa chos kyi dbang phyug ces/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i mkhas grub chen po de'i zhal nas/ nub gcig bdag gi rmi lam na ye bzang rtser phyin pas/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku tshad che ba zhig bzhugs pa'i g.yas na mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sku dang / phyon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku gnyis bzhugs shing / gzhan yang rten gsum ngo shes pa dang ma shes pa mang po bzhugs pa'i drung na/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa'i bkod pa phun sum tsho gos pa 'dug pas/ 'di snyam du sngar gyi rten mchod bzang po rnams ni sde gzar gyi gshis —95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6lokyi ma bzhugs kyang / dpon sa sde srid kyi dpal 'byor mi zad pa ni ngo mtshar che/ da yang rten mchod khyad par can 'di tsam bzhugs 'dug bsam pa shar/ de nas zhabs drung rin po che ye bzang rtser phebs 'phral du phyag 'bul la phyin pas/ rmi lam gyi jo bo bcu gcig zhal bzhugs sa de na zhabs drung rin po che bzhugs 'dug /sku (67na po zhe gos g.yas na rten mchod mang po 'dug pa'i khrod na rgyal ba tshe dpag med mgon gyi sku bzhugs/ skyon rin po che'i rnam thar thang kha zhig kyang 'dug pas/ /bzhugs tshul dang bkod pa thams cad rmi lam dang mthun pa byung gsung / rin po che pa de zhabs drung rin po che bsod nams rgya mtsho la spyan ras gzigs dngos kyi mos pa gnang ba yin/ phyis kun bzang rtser zhal thang 'dra sku zhig bzhengs pa'i tshe yang / lha gsum po de 'dra ba'i zhal bkod gnang ba yin no/ /de nas zhal ngo rnams la snyan sgron dang / blon po rnams la bslab ston sogs rgyas par gnang yang / gtan chings ni ma byung / bar chings g.yul 'thab phyir 'phul tsam gyis kyang sems can rnams kyi bde ba'i ngal gsor gyur/ nub cig mnal lam gyi tshul du/ mkha' 'gro ma mtshar mo zhig byung ba de nam mkha' la sbar ba byed cing / 'di skad ces/ 'bri gung pa dang sgam po pa sogs 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'du ba zhig e bzhed/ bzhed na ni yong bar 'dug zer ba la/ rje'i zhal nas gzhan don du 'gyur ba ni dka'/ rang don du 'dod pa che ba la dga' ba med pas mi 'dod gsungs/re zhig de khar sku mtshams mdzad pa'i mu nas/ rin po che kun bzang rtses la mgon po zhal gyi bskang gso'i gdangs dbyangs/ rnga chings sogs 'khrid par mdzad de phyag len du thebs pa gnang / de nas rgyal du bla ma chos mdzad pa dpon slob kyis gdan drangs/ gzims khang gong du rdo rje 'chang sngags ram gyi sku gdung zhugs la phul/ dbu thod dang zhal sgo sogs lha sku ring bsrel mang du byon pa'i rten ngo mtshar che ba rnams bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung gsar du bzhengs nas byams khang zhal ras lha khang (67ba)du bzhugs su gsol/ slar rtses thang du phebs/ drag po zhes pa lcags sprel gyi lo gsar gnang / gzhan don gyi 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i ngang nas/ dbyar chos la rgyal du phebs/ de'i tshe —96

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (nyanayang sngar gyi mkha' 'gro ma de byung nas/ g.yin don mdzad pa la thabs sna tshogs shig dgos/ de la sngar zhus de ltar thugs la e ba ched/ bzhed na ni gdan sa rin po che 'dir phebs na/ gzhan don rgya chen po 'grub par 'dug /gal te rten 'brel 'phyugs na ni gzhan gyis bdag tu byed de/ sne'u gdong pa khu dbon rnams ni su la yang dbang cha mi yong / de bas na da lta nas rten 'brel bsgrigs na legs/gzhan don rgya chen po byed pa dang / go sa chen po mi 'dzin pa ni 'gag pa yin zer/ 'o na rten 'brel sgrig lugs ji ltar byed dgos gsungs pas/ de na re/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i sku 'dra byin rlabs can bdun sogs la mchod bstod phul/ 'dod don la gsol ba thob dang / don thams cad de gas 'grub zer de nas 'bras spungs su phebs pas lam zhor 'ol kha rtser/ sde pa rdzong dpon pas 'bul sna la 'gro mgon rin po che'i sku 'dra khyad par can zhig phul byung bas/ rten 'brel legs par 'grig ces mnyes mnyes mdzad/ de nas sku 'dra rin po che grwa sa ma dang nyi ma lnga tsam rtsod med phyag tu 'byor/rim gyis 'bras spungs su phebs/ nyin gcig sku 'dra li ma zhig la zhal gser gnang ba'i tshe/ sde pa ke ru bas/ sku 'dra rin po che spyil bdun ma ya gcig phul bas/ snga phyi bsdoms par 'gro mgon rin po che'i sku 'dra bdun phyag tu 'byor bar brten/ sngar gyi lung bstan dang mthun par/ sku 'dra rnams la na bza' ber bcas/ byus dmar gyi sgom gzhu bzhugs stan snye 'bol sogs bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ (68nasgo chod pa rgya wo po dang phyag mchod mang du mdzad do/ /de nas yang nyin gcig rje'i zhal nas/ mdang nga'i rmi lam du nged 'khor bcas gzhan mi kha yar dang bcas pa/ ri zhig gi sgang zhig la 'gro gin 'dug pas/ de na khang pa gsum thog ma zhig 'dug /nga la mi gcig gis/ khyed rang sku skye gong ma gnyis po mjal ba la e 'byon zer/ nga'i bsam pa la/ thams cad mkhyen pa sku skye snga phyi gnyis la zhu rgyu re 'dug /bzhugs e yod dam bsam/ 'gro gin 'dug pas bar thog de na/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho bzhugs/ de yang khri shin tu mtho ba zhig la/ sku re bgres shig bzhugs 'dug pa la/ phyag 'bul zhus te byin rlabs zhu ru phyin dus/ bzhed ba dang dbu thug —97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skaganang ste/ khyed kyis byon pa e yin bka' phebs byung / de dus nged rang gi blo la/ nga la bzheng ba gnang ba 'di/ zhabs drung gong ma chen pos bdag rkyen gnang ba des yin la che/ gzhan gnang don zhig med la che snyam pa byung mtshams bka' lung la khyed rang steng la thegs dang / da dung mjal rgyu yod gsung phyin pas/ seng ge yol ba shin tu legs pa zhig btang 'dug de phye nas nang la phyin pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/ bzhugs gdan gsum gdan snye 'bol zhig gnang ste bzhugs 'dug /byin rlabs zhus pas/ 'ongs pa legs gsung ba nas/ phyag gcig gis byin rlabs gnang byung / de nas khyod la ci dgos gsung / nga la byung na gsung chos shig dgos zhug pas/ mang po byed long med/ dpal ldan lha mo'i 'phrin las bzhi'i rjes gnang byed pa yin gsungs/ gtor ma/dkar ser/ dmar/ sngo nag bzhi 'dug /rim bzhin zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las rjes(6shab)gnang / bka' bsgo dang bcas pa gnang ste/ 'o lags yod do/ /'di bzhi shin tu dkon pa yin pas/da res rkang btsugs su byas pa yin bka' phebs byung / slar 'og tu thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sku mdun du phyin pas/ khyed la ci gnang byung gsungs/ rjes gnang 'di bzhin gnang byung zhus pas/ 'o de yag /des dpal ldan lha mo'i chos skor thams cad thob pa 'dra gsung / gsol rasakyi bu ram gru bzhi zhig dang / gong du nged rang gi 'phreng ba de phyir gnang byung ste/ ga le thegs slar yang phrad yong bka' lung gnang byung / yang de'i tshe ngas 'di skad zhus te/ nga rang la yang rmi lam 'dra byung ba dang mthun par/ sde pa 'ol kha ba la/ rmi lam 'ga' re byung 'dug pa'i don 'di yong ba zhig yin nam min/ gal te 'ong rgyu yin pa'i tshe na/ bdag gir byas pa legs sam ma byas pa legs zhus pas/ bka' las/ don 'di ni dbang sdud las thabs gang zab zer bas kyang thob par dka' ba'i gnas yin mod/ 'on kyang sngon nas rgyu rkyen phun sum tsho gos pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ nges par yong yang yong la/ byas pa yang dga' ste 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'grub pa'i rgyu yin gsung / 'o na rgyal gyi dgon pa ni ma bzung ba'i thabs med/ 'bras ser dang phan tshun thams cad sgrag thub pa zhig ni —98

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)gshis kyis dka' bas ji ltar bya zhus pas/ sgrag mi thub rgyu yang rkyen med/ gal te ma thub na 'di ngos 'jogs pa dar yin mod gsung / 'di ngos pa rnams dad pa lhag par yang shin tu che bas gzhag par dka' bar yong ngam zhus pas/ sngar nga la yin na dad pa dang dam tshig gi skyon ma zhugs pa zhig de ltar yin te/ nga 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes su/ 'di ngos pa tsho la dam tshig gi sel cung zad cig zhugs (69na〉sgong bas/ de'i 'bras bu la skyon zhig yod de nam byung tsa na thabs kyis gshog la/ pha gi zungs shig /bzung ba'i tshe/ la la'i yid gdon gyis bsgyur nas skur 'debs la sogs pa'i bar chad 'gal rkyen ci thub byed pa 'ong yang 'gog mi thub/ 'on kyang 'gal rkyen bzlog pa'i slad du nyin re bzhin chos skyong gi bstod pa rkang brgyad de nyi shu rtsa gcig re thon dang / des sel te 'ong / 'gro mgon rin po che la bstod pa brgya rtsa res gsol ba thob cig gsung ba sogs mnal ltas ngo mtshar ba byung / de nas rin po che kun bzang rtse ba'i drung du sa phur lha khra'i stod las byang chub bsgrub pa dang /smad las gdug pa sgrol ba'i dbang gter kha 'og ma'i bla ma gsang 'dus kyi dbang lung / dum brgya zhang khrom gyi zab gter 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa/'jam dpal khro chu dug stong gi skor/ 'char kha gnam skas ma/ thel lugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i dbang lung / ma ning bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi skor/ tsa ri zhing skyong / bza' rgod dug gi spu gri gza' gdong dmar nag /rdo rje legs pa/ gter kha gong ma'i brag dmar gyi skor sogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi dbang lung man ngag cho ga phyag len mtha' yas pa gsan/ mtshams khang lha/da du dbon slob lhan cig tu sku mtshams mdzad de/ gshin rje'i mchod rten bcas chog ma/ zhal gyi rdo nag maṇ+ḍal sogs phyag len ltar bcas te bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mang po zhig gnang / srod thun gyi gtor kha gso bar mchod dpon gyis phyin pas/ them pa'i nang du mi mig khrag dza re ba gnyis 'dug pa mthong bas zhed de 'gro ma nus par log 'ongs/ slar phyin pas mi 'dug zer/ sred pa lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i phur pa'i (69ba〉pos byang 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang de'i kha skong / chos rje bla mas mdzad —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)pa'i dbang chog rtogs par sla ba rnams kyi phyag dpe/ sa skyong chos kyi rgyal po grags pa 'byung gnas kyi bla dpe las bshus pa'i dngos gtsang ba zhig sku zhang rin po ches phyag tu phul ba da lta'ang mchis shing / tshes bcu'i bla ma gsang 'dus kyi las byang / rtse lugs kyi chog bsgrigs ji lta ba rgya shog cig la phyag bris su gnang 'dug pa/ da lta 'bras spungs kyi bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi bdud 'dul mchod rten gyi gzungs zhugs la yod/ de skabs phur pa dang bla ma'i las byang gi gar thigs dbyangs gsum mtha' dag rtse lugs kyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin 'dzugs pa'i dgongs bzhed che bar byung 'dug na'ang / dus la cung zad ma sleb pa'i gang zag ci rigs kyi spyod tshul sna tshogs la brten nas rim gyis lus pa zhig byung bar gda'/ de nas bya lo'i lo gsar smon lam sogs grub nas/hor zla gnyis pa nyis brtsegs kyi phyi ma'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ rje'i zhal nas mdang nga'i rmi lam la/lha btsun pa dang / drung chen gnyis nga'i 'khor na 'dug /nged gsum po nag yug pha gi na yod tsa na/nyi 'od 'khyil ba'i nang na/ mi rgan gre bsangs byed pa'i sgra zhig byung bas/ su yin nam snyam nyan pas/yang glo skad cig byung / nga'i bsam pa la phal cher rang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho phebs yod 'dug snyam nas/ khong gnyis la ma bshad par nang du 'ongs tsa na/ bzhugs gdan bde ba zhig la rje thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid bzhugs pa'i sku gzhogs nas/ gsung rab pa pus mo btsugs nas bsdad 'dug pas/ ngas phyag 'bul byas pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas byin rlabs ma zhu/bzhugs gdan zhig (70na〉ske dgos gsung / mi dgos lags/ nyi ma 'di la sdad chog pa 'dug zhus/ nyi mthongs la bsdad pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku pang na nyi ma 'dug cing / ri la nyi ma ldos/ ngal du 'dug gsungs/ de nas gsung rab pa langs te/ da 'o na khyed rang dpon slob bka' gros gnang ba zhu/ ngas phyin gyi zer nas song / rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ ngas sngar bslabasapa de'i skor la/ gsung rab pa dang gros byed pa e byung gsungs/ nga'i yid la 'bras spungs kyi gdan sa'i skor de ka yin yong snyam nas/ de skor la da bar du gsung rab pa dang gros byed pa zhig ma byung — 100

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (nyanalags zhus pas/ de ci yin gsung / byed stabs bde ba zhig ma byung ba lags zhus pas/ da lta bzo thebs yod pa'i skabs la rtsol ba ma byas na/ nam zhig bzo thebs shor nas byas kyang ci la phan khyed kyi sku tshe'i tshad lo brgyad cu gya gsum yin mod kyang / de dus kyi dbang gis drug cu re bgrangs tsam las thub pa dka'/ de la yang bar chad 'ong / khyad par du khyed tshos dgon pa 'di mu mthud nas bzung ba mi dga' ste/ bzung na da ste lo bcu gsum na sku tshe la bar chad 'ong zhing / dgon pa 'di yang 'jig /de yang dgon pa stod nas 'jig pa zhig 'ong / khyed kyi ma bzung na dgon pa yang re zhig mi 'jig la/sku tshe yang drug cu re bgrangs thub de la yang bar chad cig 'ong ste byung yang lo bzhi bcu thub pa 'dug gsungs/ dgon pa de nam 'jig zhus pas/ bzung na lo bcu las mi 'gyang bar 'jig /phebs na 'di thabs kyis ci myur du bzhag pa legs so gsung / de nas nga'i bsam pa la/ lha btsun pa dang drung chen gnyis kyis kyang phyag dbang re thob na snyam nas khong gnyis la brda byas pas nang du byung ste/ phyag 'tshal (70bskos byin rlabs zhus pa la/ phyag dbang re yang gnang song / grwa sa la zhig ral 'ong pa de la bzlog thabs med dam zhug pas/ phyir 'phul yin na/ rim gros lo drug cu tsam thub/ de las gtan med la bzlog pa'i thabs mi 'dug phebs/ 'o na ngas 'di nyid du chos kyis phan thogs mi 'ong ba 'dra zhus dus/ 'o skol kyi chos kyi phan thogs 'di mu mthud byas pa dang / zur du bzhugs nas chos bshad pa gnyis pa phan thogs che chung dang / mthun snang du grub mi grub ni/ ngas mkhas pa'i steng du bskyal ba yin na legs/ mu 'thud na rim pas gsal yong ba yin gsungs pa zhig rmis/ bya lo la gsung rab pa khams ma bde ba'i rkyen gang yin zhus pa la/ dam tshig gi skyon yin phebs/ lo gar 'di bde mo e yong zhus phul/ lo 'char po'i lnga pa tshun bde mo yong / bzhi pa'i gnam gang la shin tu gzobs/ brgyad mchod chen mo la yang zon gyis/ lnga pa la lnga pa'i mthas slebs phebs/ de nas thabs med dam zhus pas dga' mo byed/ rdzogs pa de ga yin/ rdzogs pa de ga yin phebs/ khag po e yong zhus pas mi 'ong / bsam pa dag pas phebs/ kho 'das nas nang khrol lam zhus dus/ dpe ste thabs — 101

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loloyod gsung / drung chen gar babs dga' 'am zhugadus/ g.yog gi re chod byas pa dga'/ da lta'i 'di gas thus/ rim pas dod yong phebs/ yang kun bzang nags khrod la 'dun pa byas pa los dga'/byed dgos lo lnga drug tshun la yong phebs/ de gong du 'bras spungs bzhag chog /'jog lugs rim pas gsal sku1nga / thel byas na dga' bas bgyis phebs/ 'o na thel sgrags pa e yin zhus pabasasgrags pa sgrags 'os yin/ 'ol kha gdul bya'i zhing yin gsung ba dang / sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phros (71na)byung / ngas thel byed dus gsung rab pa sdod e thub zhus pas/ de dus sdod mi thub ste/gzhan zhig slebs yong phebs/ kho med pa'i rjes su 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag nga rang gis khur 'khur rigs sam ji ltar byed zhus dus/ khyod kyis khur 'khur ba'ang lags/ gzhan zhig la bskur chog pa 'ong phebs/ gzhan ji ltar yin zhugadus/ dbus gtsang gnyis na re re yod/ don yod dbus don yod phebs/ jo jo e yin zhus pas/ min he he gzhan zhig na yod/ lo bcu dgu nyi shu'i ngo ltar mchis/ mi brag la gtogs pa zhig yong / myur du 'ong / lo gsum tshun la 'ong / rab byung sgrub sa rgyal du legs/phrag dog 'phran bu yong ste skyon med/ kho rang gi blo chos la yang phyogs su 'gro phebs byung / yang bod mi don yod rdo rje dang / gtsang mi bsod nams mchog grub gnyis rogs legs don yod skyid shod rang na yod phebs/ gsung rab pa'i skye ba snga phyi zhus dus/ sngon nged chos kyi rgyal po dga' ba'i dpal gyi dus su/ gsung rab pa'i ming chos bzang bshes gnyen bya ba rab byung gtsang ma lo drug cu zin tsam thub/ de rjes kho bo mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dus su khong bsod nams rdo rje ming gzhan don grub rgyal mtshan zer/ der yang chos byas legs po byung / yul rgya gar bal po dang nye bar skyes pa yin/ yang bal yul du 'brungs pa'i paṇ+ḍita pad+ma badz+ra gyi dus su gsung rab pas lo brgyad cu gya lnga thub/ de'i rjes ma yul dbus su skyes ming rnam rgyal zer/ btsun pa byas yon tan yag po byung / lo drug cu tsam thub/ de'i rjes ma 'di yin da dung lnga drug tsam thub/ de bar gyi bar chad sel thabs la/ sgrol dkar dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dbyer med du byas na legs/ phyi ma mi lus thob skye ba dran rab tu byung ming (71ba)dge — 102

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar lung bstan to/ /'di lta bu la sogs pa 'das ma 'ongs kyi lung bstan mang po rnams zhus dus/ bka' las/ ja'i mchod pa zhig phul zhig gsung / yang lan cig ni nga'i dkar yol du 'thung bas chog phebs/ yang khyod kyi tshe tshad/ rang lo brgyad cu gya gnyis yin yang / bar chad bzhi bcu lnga bcu la 'ong / tshe sgrub gtso bo tshe dpag med/ sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma rtsal du brtan na lnga bcu drug cu sgral yong / zhes lan bzhi phebs/ nga'i skye ba brjes ma'i ming bde chen chos kyi rgyal por grags par 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ mkhar ba'i skye ba snga phyi zhus dus/ snga ma'i yul rgya gar wa ra ṇa si/ rigs bram ze/ ming sa man+ta nā tha/ lha dbyangs can ma la bsnyen pa mthar phyin/grub pa yang legs po thob/ yongs 'dzin rang dang / slob ma rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba'i ming can yin/tshe lo lnga bcu nga brgyad yin/ chos skyong phyag drug pa yin gsung / kho'i yongs 'dzin de'i sku tshe ji tsam da lta gang na bzhugs zhugadus/ tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes/ da lta rgya gar na bzhugs yod phebs/ de'i sngon ma dris dus/ bal bod mtshams su bris pa ming ni wen te zhes bya/ lha phyag rdor gtso che/ dbyangs can lha mo yang dum pa byas/ lo bdun nu don bgrangs/ chos skyong phyag drug pa yang dum pa byas/ gtso bo dpal ldan lha mo rang yin/ da lta lha ris legs pa yang snga ma de la brtan nas byung / de'i sngon ma yul gangs can/ lha'i ming lha phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung gsham can/ chos skyong phyag drug pa legasapa byas/ lo drug cu re gsum thub phebs/ yang sprul sku ri mkhar bas bdun cu thub rgyu yin te/ bar chad 'ong / de yang drug cu la 'ong / de bzlog thabs/rje rang la gsol ba btab na dga'/ /(72nasgo sgrub byas na lo drug cu re brgyad thub/ de yang rje rang la gsol ba
