btab pa gzab phebs/ ji ltar 'debs zhug pas/ nga dang mgon po tshe dpag med dbyer med du bsgoms/ de yang phyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku la thugs gar mgon po tshe dpag med bsgoms/ tshe gzungs ring ba 'don/ mtshams zla ba gnyis la nye ba tsam dgos/ de yang bya lo'i nang rang du dgos/ skye ba phyi ma bde ba can dang dga' ldan du/ rje dge bdun rgya mtsho'i rtsar 'gro phebs/ zhes so/ de ltar lung bstan gyi nang bzhin rgyal dang thel — 103—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yosgrags pa gnang thub na/ sku tshe yang mthar phyin cing bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po zhig 'ong tshod du 'dug kyang / dus rtags kyi dbang btsan pas thog tu ma khel/dgon pa lo bcu tsam nas 'jig pa dang / lo bcu gsum tsam nas sku tshe la bar chad 'ong rgyu sogs ni/ sku rim gyis phyir bsrings pa yin 'dug /dgon pa la nyams 'grib 'ong nges par gsungs pa ni/ sa rta'i lo'i dus gzings chen mo der nges shing / rat+na gling pa dang / gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che dang / gcung rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje sku mched gnyis/ 'phreng po gter ston pa sogs gter kha mang po'i lung bstan du/ jo bo shākya mu ni la rgyab bstan pa'i lha chen po zhig 'byung ba dang / des lha sa'i sa dpyad nyams te/ lha sar khrag gi mtsho 'khyil ba sogs dus rtags mang du gsungs pa rnams thog tu phebs par 'dug zer/yang thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho bde chen chos kyi rgyal po de nyid/ mtha' dmag gis khrod du gnod pa byung ba la ye mi dgyes shing / jing gir gyi rgyal rigs su 'brungs pas mtha' mi la 'chun che yang dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ g.yin bstan pa'i sku (72ba〉cags kyi dbang gis ser 'bras kyi mkhan slob gros dbang rnams kyi khrod nas kyang / sde gzar mi 'gab gsung mkhan phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan dang / rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa de nyid byes kyi slob dpon las thog pa yin pas/khong dpon slob gnyis tsam ma gtogs ma byung zhing phyag mdzod pa gtsang par 'phul phyogs dang / rje rdo rje 'chang de nyid la mkhan slob tshang mas bya ba chung du rtsi ba'i bka' brkyan zhe ba byung 'dug /thugs rje ོ po pad+ma'i dbang phyug gi lung bstan du/ bod 'dir 'gongs po dar ba'i tshe/ /'thab rtsod phal cher btsun pas slong / /zhes pa de/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' gang la bltas kyang bden par snang ngo / /de nas rgyal du phebs/ thugs dam gsung chos smar ba'i tshe/ sde srid nang zhig gis sde gzar skyid shod du langs te/ dga' ldan khri rin po che dge legs dpal bzang po dang / de'i zhabs phyir 'bri stag phag mo pa 'brug pa 'ol kha stod lung bde chen sogs kyi mi sna rnams dang bcas/ zhu chings mdzad kyang shogs cher ma byung bas/ rgyal du spyan 'dren dos drag byung ba ltar skyid shod du phebs/ bar — /04

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyenami rnams kyis chings lugs kyi skor la phyogs chen mi byed pa dang / bka' gros phyir gzegs mi byed pa'i chos skyong dpang btsugs kyi bsdams pa gnang / de nas phan tshun du bskor sbyangs mdzad pa'i mthar/ dar 'bag rin cen sgang du bzhugs sgar gnang / bka' khras bcad de dmag rnams so sor gyes/ rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la 'gran par gyur/de nas rnga chen zhes pa chu bya'i lo gsar dang smon lam grol rjes 'bras spungs tshogs pa la bka' gdams glegs bam gnang / de'i tshe char chu shin tu tshes pas/ bod yul gyi phan bde'i rtsal ga (73na)chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar chu nyen chen po byung ba na/ rags la phyag nas 'thor shing lta stangs mdzad pas/ chu bri ba kun gyis ma thong ba sogs bod yul gyi birnya pa gnyis par grags so/ /de nas gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas/ khri rin po che mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang pos byams chen gyi sku bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa dngos su bcug /dngul gdung rin po cher gos chen gser ma'i snam sbyar sogs mchod khang rnams su mchod rdzas dang / 'bul ba mang 'gyed lha mchod mi mchod rgya chen po bstar/khrag skyug ces pa chu phag gi dpyid ka ser 'bras dga' ba gdong sogs kyi dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams dang bcas/ lha sar chu rags rtag mar brgyag pa'i zhal bkod gnang bas dbyar nyal 'gro'i rgyun ji tsam che yang chu klung gi 'jigs pa dang bral bar mdzad/ de ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po rang gi gnas la sri zhu mdzad par bsam bzhin du byon par snang ngo / /phan pa dang bde ba'i rtsa lag dam pa yun du gnas pa'i thabs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rgya chen por bskrun pa ni/ rnam par thar pa 'di lta bu la zer bar 'dug gis/ rang nyid kyi dgra 'dul gnyen skyong bsnyen bkur longs spyod slad du thabs sna tshogs bsgrub pa la gzhan don du ming 'dogs pa tsho dang ye mi 'dra'o/ /de nas pho brang gong ri dkar por lha gzigs mi'i dbang po ngag dbang grags pas gdan drangs/ bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ zhabs drung la dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma dang /— 105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)zhal bsnyen dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang phul/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal (73ba po pa la bzang pos bskrun pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos sde chen por spyan drangs/ rten rnams zhib mjal mdzad/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mgon khang rnams la/ mchod gtor spyan gzigs rgyas par phul zhing / 'phrin las gnyer du gtad/ zhogs su mang 'gyed kyi mchod sbyin rgya cher spel/mig dmar zhes pa shing pho byi ba'i lo/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dus chen gsum 'dzom hor zla bzhi pa sa gas nya ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang pos mkhan po/ khri las thog pa dge bshes po to ba'i rnam par sprul pa dge 'dun bstan pa dar rgyas kyis las slob/ paṇa chen gnas pa gdan 'dren gnang yang / rin spungs pa'i bka' bkyon par song ba'i 'byon ma bde bas/ shangs dge 'phel chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal bas gsang ston/ lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang gis dus sgo ba mdzad de/ dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su/ dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ mkhan slob sogs la zang zing gi bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa mdzad pas/ chos rje slob dpon rin po che'i gsung las/ thod pa 'di'i 'og tu 'bul ba 'di pas che ba len ma myong zhes dgyes pa chen po mdzad/ de'i sang chos rje stag lung brag pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ rje bde ba can pa la 'dul ba'i bslab bya chen mo dang byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i zhib bshad rje bstan dar ba la rta mgrin shwa ṇa bzhi skor/ mgon po lho nub pa'i rjes gnang sogs bka' gdams kyi zab chos mang ba/ rje phyogs las pa la shangs pa'i rgyud sde lnga'i dbang sogs shangs chos skor/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang rnams rdzogs pa gsan/bod shing (74na〉sko can gyi rgyal po chen po de nyid zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i rkyen gyis dus gzing sngar bas kyang cher langs pa la/ ste srid zhal ngo rnams dang sde dpon so so'i gdan 'dren byung bar brten/ yar klungs su chibs kha sgyur/ rtses thang du phebs/ bka'i 'khor los khyab par mdzad de dpung rnams so sor bkye/ kun bde ba'i lam la bkod/ gzhan yang phyogs de'i mi nad phyugs nad — 106

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ snyenazhi ba sogs sems can gyi don rlabs po che mdzad/ zhabs drung gong ma chen po gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gral dbur sne'u gdong rtse'i bde yangs su rtse tshogs pa/ rtses thang pa/ ri bo sde chen/ bkra shis bde chen/ ri bo chos gling / ras chung phug zhal brag pa sogs ser tsho gis kyi dbus su sngo ba yon bshad yas gtam sogs rgyas par gnang / chos grwa chen po dpal gyi rtses thang gi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su phebs/ sku zhad rin po che kun bzang rtse bas sde srid khungs btsun pa'i yig tshang dang bcas te mas gtam rgyas par phul/ rje nyid kyis kyang dpon sa gong ma chen mo dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi sngo ba rjod byed kyi tshig mdzes shing / brjod bya'i don bzang bar mdzad pas/ phyogs de'i mkhas pa thams cad yi rang par gyur/ de nas shing po gru brgyud/ bsam yas su phebs/ bar khang nas shog dril lnga tsam zhig bzhes/ mnga' bdag gi gter zhabs yin pa 'dra yang / dus rtags dang chos bdag cung zad 'dzol bas shog ser la 'bebs pa gnang ba zhig ma byung 'dug /rim gyis 'bras spungs su phebs/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya phrag brgal ba bsgrubs/khro bo zhes pa shing glang gi lo gsar dang smon lam grub rjes/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin/drung nas rin po che (74bsko sung rab rgya mtsho dga' ldan du gshegs par/ dgung zhag gi ring sngags pa slob dpon pas gtsos pa'i dge 'dun bcu phrag lhag pas/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i bdag 'jug len pa/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud dang brgyad stong pa'i gsung sgrog /grwa tshang so so nas bsdus pa'i dge 'dun brgya lhag tsam gyis sman bla'i cho ga khri tshar/ nyi sdings grwa tshang pas sman bla'i cho ga stong tshar/bdun phrag re re bzhin dge 'dun brgya skor gyis kun rig gi cho ga /gzhan yang skyid phan stod lung klung shod/ e dwags 'ol gsum/ lho gnyal/ yar klungs/ gtsang sogs kyi phyogs med kyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams su mang 'gyed kyis dgongs rdzogs rgyas par bsgrubs/ phyi rten du rgyal ba btsong kha ba'i gser sku bod yul na che ba 'di bzhengs te/ 'bras spungs rnam thar sgo gsum gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa mdzad pa la sku tshe bsrings pa'i ltas — 107—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skakhyad par can byung / me stag lo gsar dang smon lam grub rjes/ gdong dkar du ston pa'i gos sku chen mo bzhengs pa'i rab gnas dang / dbyar chos la 'bras spungs su/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs yongs su rdzogs par gnang ste dam pa'i chos kyi tshim par mdzad do/ /khyogs bral 'gro la dam pa'i chos tshul gyi/ /'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor ba yis/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen/ /gnyis pa gzhan zhig mchis zhes lha rnams gleng / /dkon cog 'bangs dang khri srong g.yu brag pa/ /nyang sogs skye ba du mar pad 'byung gis/ /rjes su bzung phyir 'chi med grub pa de'i/ /theg mchog bdud rtsi thugs kyi bum par bltams/ blo bzang grags snyan chos kyi rgyal srid la/ rigs kyi bdag (75na)por mnga' gsol ngur smig ga /rgyal mtshan rtse mor bsgrengs pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /thub bstan yongs kyi shing rta che de 'grub/ /ston se rar phebs/ tsho gis pa la glegs bam pha chos gnang / rta mgrin khang du pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku brnyan dang / bsnyen phur mjal te mchod bstod smon lam rgyas par mdzad/ slar 'bras spungs su phebs te/ rab byung zhes pa me yos kyi lo gsar gyi dga' ston dang / srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i phyag len rnams rgyas par grub rjes/smon lam chen mo'i mgon du phebs/ snga rting smon lam gyi thog tu/ srod bskor thugs rus chen pos gnang bar brten/ zhabs bskor bum ther song 'dug cing / 'di res srod bskor zhig gi skabs/ phyag g.yog rnams kyi khrod nas yug gcig gar song cha med lta bu'i tshul du gshegs nas slar phebs/sngar za ma myong ba'i kha zas mang po gnang ste/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros tshogs 'khor la bos pa yin gsungs/ slar tsos spungs su phebs/ zhal gdong gnyan can gyi gtor chog gnam lcags spu gri me lce'i 'phreng ba dang / zhal gyi gdab las dang / las gshin gyi gtor zor gyi cho ga dang phag mo gru pa'i bstod pa byin rlabs kyi lhun po rnams thugs rtsom gnang / sngar lo chen rin cen bzang pos bse 'bag dang mnyam du gdan drangs pa'i thugs rten gnam lcags kyi rdo rje dang mgon po shing drung ma gnyis/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sku bsrung du yod pa/ chos rje pa bsam — 108

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)yas su dag pa'i zhing du gshegs skabs khyer te/ gzhis ka snel bar byung ba/ de nas rim gyis phyag tu 'byor pa'i lo rgyus gcig dang / bsam yas nas thel du 'khyar nas byung (75ba〉ba'i lo rgyus gcig dang / yang sa skyar phebs skabs dkon gnyer nas byung ba'i lo rgyus gcig dang / yig cha khungs ma zhig na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las/ rten de rnams bla ma sa chen zhes pa'i bgres po des gter du sbas par 'dug gsung ba la dpags na sngon gnas rjes su dran te gter nas ma bzhes pa'i nges pa mi 'dug go /nang so bya pa dpon blon gyis gnyal du gdan drangs/ yar klungs brgyud/ rim gyis lho rgyud kyi sa'i thig ler phyags phebs/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i mdzad chen/ lung grwa'i tsho gis dbu gnang/ glegs bam bu chos/ yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung / tshe dbang sogasachos kyi char phab/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs stong phrag tu nye ba bsgrubs/ bya pa nang sos brgya 'bul sogs 'dod dgu'i 'byor pa ji snyed dang bcas/ rim gyis zangs mo che/ ri steng / spa mgor/ ngang rgyal rnams su spyi chos sgos chos/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs gnang / de nas mtsho sna phyogs su gdan drangs/ mon dga' ldan pho brang gi bla ma bu mtshan gyis thog drangs phyogs de'i skya ser thams cad kyi re ba yongs su tshim par mdzad/ bla ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dang jo bo bstan pa tshe ring sogs mon pa'i mjal mi mang du byung bar chos kyi bka' drin stsal/ mon grab tu'ang skye bo'i tshogs du ma la yig drug gi bzlas lung / rab byung bsnyen sogs stsal ba dge ba'i lam rgya chen por bkod pa lho brag nas skya ser mchog dman du mas gsol ba btab pa la brten chibs kha sgyur te/ thog mar stong ri nyi shar du phebs/ skya ser gyi khrom chen po la bla ma'i rnal 'byor stsal te/ thig phyi'i gtsug lag khang du dpal gsang ba'i bdag po mi'i srid pa can/ grub (76na)chen las kyi rdo rje'i sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i mchod rten mjal phebs te/ mchod pa dang smon lam zhabs skor sogs mtha' klas pa gnang bas/ mkha' las sprin dkar po 'khrigs pa'i dbus su/ skyon rin po che'i g.yas su lho brag grub chen/ g.yon du rgyal ba btsong kha pa bzhugs pa zhig gsal bar gzigs/ mi 'khrugs pa'i smon — 109

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)lam thugs rtsom gnang / rig 'dzin chen po sprul sku mchog ldan mgon pos bzhengs pa'i slob dpon chen po'i sku gdon gyis bslad pa de la rab gnas kyi dgongs pa gtad de sang phebs rgyu'i de nub lha 'dre des zil ma bzod par/dkon gnyer khrid nas ri la bros pas yul de bsod nams dman pa'i stabs kyis lde mig ma rnyed par lus/ khra pa nang sos thig phyi'i gtsug lag khang sa skor dang bcas pa phul/ gdang pas gdang mkhar smon grub khyung rtser gdan drangs shing mi ngo gcig gis skra phud phul te rab tu byung / gdang dgon gsar du zhabs kyis bcags/ btsan gro stod smad rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin stsal/ bkra shis chos gling du phyug po stobs ldan bzang po zhabs tog gi mthil len zhus/ zhag bcu skor bzhugs te 'byor ldan rnams kyis brgya 'bul bcu lhag tsam byung / de dag gi dus nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang / me rtag gi char 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mtha' yas pa mig gi dga' ston du gyur/ rtse grong gzhis ka /yul rdzong / nam steng sogs su rim gyisaphebs/ phyogs de'i skye rgu mtha' dag 'brel tshad don dang ldan par mdzad/ mi rje srong btsan sgam po'i dus su/ yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs pa mkho mthing lha khang du phebs/ rten rnams(76ba)la mchod bstod dang bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam mdzad/ sde pa lha khang pas thog drangs pa'i phyogs de'i skye bo rnams la chos dang zang zing gis legs par bskyangs/ de nas smra bo lcog tu phebs/ /mnga' bdag nyang gi gter byon chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bla dpe bka' brgyad po ti dgu sogs gter rdzas nang rten thams cad zhib par mjal/ mdor na lho brag gi sa thams cad zhabs kyis bcags te 'gro ba kun la mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi sa bon rgya chen po bskrun/ rgyal khab gong ri dkar por phebs/ zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa dpon blon gyis bsnyen bkur mtha' klas pa zhus/ sil snyan tshangs dbyangs kun 'dus phyag tu phul/ gdung brgyud rin po che sku gzhen pa'i gtsug phud bzhes nas mtshan rnam rgyal grags par gsol/ lho kha phyogs brgyud rong cha dkar du lha byams pa rab brtan sku mched kyis bsnyen bkur gya nom pa bstab/ dbyar chos ma grol gong rgyal me tog thang du phebs/ byams—110

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)khang gi gtsug lag khang 'di sngar ka bzhi yin pa/ ka brgyad du btang zhing rgya khyon dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i thugs rtse gtad nas/ gang spyi'i do dam pir thogs kun gyi dbang po sman thang pa dpal ldan bkra shis kyis mdzad/ thog gnyis zla ba gnyis la zin pas kun grub rtags yin par gleng /rim gyis hor zla bcu pa'i nang du 'bras spungs su phebs/ mtshams khang shod du rin po che kun bzang rtse pa dang lhan cig par zhal gyi bsnyen sgrub gnang bas/ nub cig gsol dpon gyis ja zhu bar phyin pa na/ sgo'i nang nas dzo gi zhig don song bas/ rjes su brtsad bcad pas ma rnyed/ de ni mgon po'i sprul pa sna(/ /rnam byung zhes pa sa 'brug gi lo gsar dang smon lam sogs grub rjes/ lha (77na〉sor bsam yas nas gnod sbyin chen po sku khog dang bcas te byon/ lo snga res shig sde pa dga' ldan pa don grub rgyal pos lho kha phyogs su dpung 'khyer byas skabs/ bsam yas kyi phyogs la lag 'jog byas pa'i stabs kyis da res rgyal pos/ 'bras spungs dge bshes/ don grub rgyal po'i sgal pa la gri tshal tsam rgyab e chog gsung bar mi 'gab tshul gnang 'dug kyang ring por ma lon par sde pa gshegs 'dug /sa ga zla ba'i nang du nang so rgya ri pa dpon blon gyis gdan drangs / yar lam bde chen du dgongasardzogs kyi gral dbu gnang / rim gyis ri sgo bkra shis chos rdzong du phebs te/ lha ngag dbang bsod nams lhun grub la khri 'don dang / khrom khri phrag brgal ba la tshe dbang sogs lugs gnyis kyi dga' ston rgya chen po stsal/ 'ol kha rtser phebs/ sde pa phun tshogs rab brtan gyis bskul nas rgya chen bsod nams ma gnang / sku mtshams yun ring ba zhig gi skabs/ mar la lam ngo mtshar ba mang du byung zhing /khyad par drung nas rin po che'i sku gdung rgyal du ril por bzhugs pa de bzhugs su phul pa legs pa'i dpal ldan lha mo'i gsung gi gnang bstsal bar brten/ sde dgon mtha' dag gi re ba yongs su bskang ste/ chos 'khor rgyal du phyag phebs/ tshes bcu bdun gyi gza' skar bzang ba dang bstun 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas zhugs 'bul mdzad/ phyag mdzod dpal ldan rgya mtshos mar khal phyed re'i 'gyed dang — 1//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)bcas tshogs su tsha bra btang / nam mkha' dwangs shing 'ja' gur dang me tog gi char bab pur khang kha bye bas/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs ring bsrel mang du byon te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten pa dang rang nyid kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrungs pas 'bras bu'o/ /(77ba)tshogs su gsung chos dang / zla ba de'i nyer lnga rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor gyi nyin/ phyag mdzod pas do dam byas dpal ldan lha mo'i mchod gtor rgyas par bshams nas bskang gsang dang / chos 'khor rgyal gnyer gtad mdzad pas gtsang phyogs su 'phrin las rgyas pa dang khams phyogs su gdan 'dren 'byung ba'i spyan ltas shar/ mi ring bar cham mdo byams pa gling nas 'bul dpon bsod nams bzang po dang gnas chen pa sogs kyis gtsos gdan 'dren 'bul skyel ba dang / rje drung rin po che dge 'dun bkra shis kyi sprul pa'i sku bstan pa rgya mtsho rnams phebs/ brgya 'bul dang mang 'gyed sogs rgya cher bskrun/ dgag bya dang dgos pa'i dbang du gyur na ma gtogs khams phyogs su phebs pa'i bka' bzhes kyang gnang / mal gro brgyud 'bras spungs su phebs/ 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg gi thugs rtsom mdzad/ sku gak+ṣ-i gas grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gsar du btsugs te 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi chos thun zhig rten 'brel du gnang /dkar po zhes pa sa sprul gyi lo gsar dang / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rnams grub rjes/ g.yas ru gtsang gi phyogs nas skya ser mang pos snga gong nas phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba phul zhing / 'di skabasathos bsam gling pa dang dkyil khang ba'i slob dpon shar rtse'i ngo tshab dang bcas pa 'byor/ nang so dga' ldan pas gung thang du tshe dpag med kyi gser sku mchod khang dang bcas bzhengs par rab gnas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad/ zhang rin po che'i sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bus zhu phud mdzad pa rang dad rten du bzhes/ zhal ngo rnams la rjes gnang stsal/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi 'dra dpe gzigs5ma du phab/ slar 'bras spungs su phebs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la gtsang du chibs kha sgyur te/ (78na〉dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung gsang sngags pho brang nas phebs par brtsams pa nas — 112

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)bzung / gdong dkar du ma phebs kyi bar du 'bras spungs kyi thad kyi nam mkha' la spyin 'khrigs pa dang 'brug sgra che chung snyoms pa rgyun mi 'chad par byung bas chos srung gi cho 'phrul du nges/ gye re lha pas gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhus/ gu ru jo rtse'i gter ma'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung dang sku tshab pad+ma mthong grol mjal ba gnang / rgyal khab chen po gong ri dkar por gdan drangs lha gzigs mi'i dbang pos bsnyen bkur zhing / bka' chos 'bul ba sogs dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'dus sde rdo rje gdan gyi gnas gzigs kyang mdzad/slar/ gtsang po byang khar don/ 'khol mar sku zhang rin po ches gdan drangs te phebs/ der gshin rje'i mchod rten bcas cho ga dang / khyab 'jug gi dam shing sogs yod pa'i mgon khang der gzigs rtog la phebs/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang / 'phrin las gyi gnyer gtad rgyas par gnang / snyug la nas yol rin cen gling du zhabs tog zhus/ ri gong gi mgon po bar snang ma mjal bas byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma khyad par can byung / rim gyis thon dga' ldan rtser phebs/ nang so thon pa dpon blon dang / rgyal byed tshal mkhan slob rnams kyis bsnyen bkur rgya cher bsgrubs/ so sor dbang bka'/ spyi chos/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs kyis re 'dod yongs su bskang / mgon po zhal gyi gtor chen gyi sgo nas bar chad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pas/ chos skyong gis dngos su bsgrubs pa'i mtshan ma gzigs/rgyal byed tshal du phebs/ gang 'tsham gyi chos sbyin mdzad/ 'u yug gur sngon du phebs/ gtsug lag khang (78bsgo jal/ slob dpon chen po'i dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te bsu pa la 'ongs pa dngos su gzigs/ mchod bstod 'phrin las bcol/ dpon slob nyung bsdus zhig gnubs khu lung du phebs/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang / lha rje gnubs chung sogs kyisadrag sngags bsgrubs pa' gnas ya mtshan pa yin 'dug pa la zhib gzigs gnang / sku zhang rin po ches phyag g.yog mdzad de/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi sgrub rten rnams la bzo bkod bzhin shog bur 'dri ba gnang ba/ phyis su gung ru dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug ces drag sngags — 113

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6lol nus pa yer du 'thon pa des kyang gzigs pa'i gnas tshul rigs 'dzin gzhen nu don grub yab sras la gsungs pa/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa pad+ma dbang gis gsungs pa dngos su thos/ dpon slob byings dben sa dgon par bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes pas spyan drangs/ dben sa blo bzang don grub kyi nang rten la phyag nas gtor/ der 'khod pa'i sgrub pa pho mo rnams la gsung chos kyis tshim par mdzad/rim gyis chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun por phebs/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'brug gi sgra chen po sgrog pa dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ me tog gi char sogs ltas ya ma zung mang du byung / khrom shin tu che ba la/ las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis/ spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gsor mthong / nyin re bzhin dgon pa'i mdun gyi thang chen por/ bka' gdams glegs bam gyi bka' chos gnang bas me tog gi char lag tu bzung chog pa tsam bab/ gsung chos gnang ba'i sgra bsam grub rtse'i rdzong nang du tshig 'bru ma nyams par thos pa byung bas/ der 'khod pa mang po zhig ya mtshan 'dzin (79na)rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya phrag mang po bsgrubs/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ jo bo yab sras/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa sogs zhal gzigs te legs so gnang / gnas rnams 'i kha par gzigs shing byams chen la zhal gser dang / chos skyong rnams la gnyer gtad mdzad pas/ dpal ldan lha mos 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i mtshan ma gsal bar byung / de nas shangs ri bo dge 'phel du phebs/ bo dong nas rje phyogs las pas/ sngon rje btsun byams pa bram zer skye ba bzhes pa'i dus kyi/ dbu thod glang 'khun mar grags pa mkhas grub khyung pos rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i ngo mtshar can de phyag tu phul/ dge 'phel gdan sa ba rang gis kyang zhabs tog phul du byung ba mdzad/ skya ser gyi khrom chen po la snying po don gsum dang yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung gnang / de nas rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub gnas zab phu lung mjal bar phebs/ le'u brgyad pa'i sgo nas bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga gnang bas/ slob dpon chen po la rig 'dzin brgyad kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs/ rim gyis bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling / grub chen bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi dgon pa 'bras spungs su phebs/ bla ma'i rnal — /14

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ zhena'abyor dang yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung gnang / der chos rgyal nang sgrub khro bo'i zhal can gzigs/ rta nag gi sde dgon rnams kyis gdan drangs pa'i lam zhor du thag lung gi mgon po legs ldan mjal te 'phrin las bcol/ gzigs snang khyad par can dang / tsan dan sdong po skye ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung / rta nag rdo rje gdan du phebs dge 'dun pa rnams kyis ser sbrengs dang / bud med rnams kyis mda' dar me long bzung ste/ dpa' mo'i chas zhugs (79ba)kyis bsu ba byas/ chos skyong beg gdong lcam bral gyi zhal gzigs shing 'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ chibs kyi rmig pa bzhi gas rdo la rjes gsal bar bzhag /yul de'i skya ser mtha' dag dge ba'i lam la bkod de/ kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa'i gdan sa thub bstan rnam rgyal dang / chag lo'i dbon brgyud rnams kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ chag lo'i rten ring bsrel yang mang bar phyag tu 'byor/ bkra shis lhun po'i smon lam la phebs/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam sprul gnas rnying pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan khri thog tu bskos te phyag nas gtor/ bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon por dpon slob rnams kyi gtong len gyi khram gzigs pas/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi gdung tsha gdung rus sogs slob dpon gzhan gyis ngo ma shes pa rnams la ngos 'dzin mdzad/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi zhal gdams phyag bris ma shog ril zhig 'dug pa gzigs pas/ slob dpon thams cad thugs skyo shas dang ldan par gyu ri/ de nas dpal jo bo bka' gdams pa'i sde chen bo snar thang du phebs/ rten gsum rnams zhib par mjal/ chos dang zang zing gi 'phrin las rgya che bar spel pa'i ngos/ snar thang byang chen gyi rten mjal rnams gnang ste/gangs can chos 'phel du phebs/ tshogs su byang chub lam rim gsungs/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya phrag bsgrubs/ der dpal ldan lha mo'i sku shin tu gnyan pa zhig yod 'dug pa la mgon bstod dang 'phrin las bcol/ de nas khro phur phebs/ khro phu'i lung pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi spyan ya gshig gis gang ba'i gzigs mo dngos su byung / khro phu lo tsā bas bzhengs pa'i byams pa bod gangs can na sku tshad che ba de nyid mjal zhing smon lam gnang / (80na)rje btsun byams pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs — 115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6nergyas kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs/ gnas srin po rer gnas pa nang sos zhabs tog zhus/ mgon po zhal gyi gnas dar lung ming g.yin shog ma zhes par phebs/ rnam sras rta brgyad kyi sku brnyan 'cham pa sogs kyi bsu ba dang bcas seng ge rtse sde dgon gyis spyan drangs/ mgon po zhal gyi sku gsung thugs kyi mas ma bzang po brnyes/ lhun po rtse chos sder phebs/ rten mjal gnang zhing chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ bla brang shar du bzhugs/ dge 'dun la mang ja 'gyed bcas/ gdan sa chen po'i chos kyi seng ge'i khrir bzhugs pa'i bdag chen rin po cher 'bul ba/ mchod khang rnams su snyan dar spyan gzigs rgyas par gnang / 'jam dbyangasagazi 'od 'bar bas thog drangs pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i mchod khang ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa rgya chen po rnams mjal/ khyad par lo chen rin cen bzang pos 'phags yul nas gdan drangs pa'i bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi drung du mchod gtor spyan gzigs gya nom pa phul/ 'phrin las gnyer gtad mdzad pas/ snyan dar rang bab tu byung ba dngos grub kyi mtshan mar 'dug /phyag mtshan thod pa'i nang nas nas phud cig phyag tu dmod nas kyis tshul du bzhes pas/ de'i khrod du gser rdog po la ring bsrel yung 'bru lta bu gnyis tsam 'byar ba zhig byung / der gur mgon dngos su zhal gzigs/ bse 'bag de shin tu gnyan pa'i stabs kyis/ gdung brgyud zhal ngo rnams dang g.yin nusamathu can 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ gzhan gyis reg mi shi nusang / gal por reg na mi shis pa zhig 'ong gi yod 'dug kyang / rje 'di nyid zhal ras kyi rdul 'phyi ba sogs mdzad/ bse (80ba 'bag gi 'dra bshus ri mor bkod pa gnang / thos bsam gling pa'i slob dpon de rmi lam gsal po yod 'dug par/ shel dkar du phebs lam du cung zad gnyid du song tsa na/ mi nag po 'jigs su rung ba gnyisabyung bar su yin dris pas/ bse 'bag lcam bral yin phyag phyir 'gro zer/ de ni rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bas mi 'gyangs par kha'u brag rdzong pa'i snyan 5 da thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' rnams 'bul ba'i rtags su mngon/ lha khang chen mos thog drangs — 116

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6) pa'i mchod khang gzims phug tshun chad kyang mjal bar mdzad/ phebs pa la mngon du phyogs pa na phag gru'i phug pa'i sgrub chu 'phel zhing / phug pa'i nang du phebs pa dang chu glo bur du lud pa byung /gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas shin tu mang ba byung bar brten/ der 'khod pa'i skye bo mtha' dag rje btsun brtse chen snying po'i zhabs kyi rnam par sprul pa'o zhes dad pa'i spu long g.yo bar gyur to/ /de nas kha'u skye lhas su phebs/ gnas 'di ni bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nan tan thugs gtsigs che bas srung ma rang bzhin gyis 'du ba dang khyad par mtshar lugs pa zhes bstan pa'i snying po 'di nyid kyi 'byung ba'i gnas yin pa dang / lhag par mgon po zhal rdo la dngos su thim pa yin 'dug pa nas/ dad mos chen pos rje mtshar chen gyi bla ma mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug kun spangs rdo ring pas phyag len bstar ba'i mgon khang chos skyong dngos bzhugs pa der/ bskang gso bsnyen sgrub dmod bcol sogs 'phrin las rgyas par bcol/ der yang snyan dar rab tu byung ba sogs 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can gzigs/ nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin rma bya'i gdugs phub pa ltar gyur (81na)pas kun ya mtshan par 'dzin/ gcen lung pas thog drangs pa'i skya ser grangs med pa mjal bar 'ongs pa don dang ldan par mdzad/ rim gyis bo dong e'i gnas gzigs gnang / dpal ldan a phyi mar mchod gtor spyan gzigs phul/ rje gong ma gnyis kyi thugs dam 'dzugs gtor brje ba gnang / gzigs snang khyad par na byung lung nag shel dkar du nang sos thog drangs pa'i skya ser rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsi stsal/ slar gangs can chos 'phel dang bkra shis lhun po brgyud zha lu ri phug tu/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i sku dang nā ro'i bum chu sogs nang rten mtha' dag mjal ba gnang / las kyi gshin rje dang / lha mo rdo rje rab brtan mas 'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ de nas 'brong rtse chos sder phebs sde dgon gyis bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ sngar 'brong rtse chos rje phyag drug pa'i sku bzhengs rtsis la gsal kha med par mgon po bzhengs gsungs pas/ bzo bos mgon po zer na gur las 'os med snyam bzhengs pa'i bur mgon — 117

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skagyi sku 'dra/ mtshar lugs kyi snyan brgyud khyad 'phags rnams kyi 'byung khungs/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gcen rgya gar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis phyag nas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs can de mjal ba gnang / pa snam lhun grub rtse dang / 'brong rtse/ rgyal byed tshal du 'brug pa sprul sku ngag dbang nor busagadan drangs/ dpon slob gnyis ka phan tshun du dag snang che bas phyag rtse sprod dang bcas te mjal/khong rang gi phyag bzo'i rgya mtsho lha ba las grub pa'i gnas bcu de yang phyag tu phul/ rten mjal rnams zhib par gnang / sprul sku ngag dbang nor bu 'di bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma/ sgom chen pa'i sbag sbug gi nyams med par/ dpon slob (81ba〉na nyis lugs zung gi gsung gleng zhib tu byung 'dug pas/de nas bzung ste dge 'brug gnyis lugs legs kyi khul du byed par gda'/ de yang 'brug pa sprul pa'i skus de skabs dngas dngas dod dod mdzad 'dug kyang / rjes su dpal sder sgar pa dang mjal skabs dgos med sgar par bkur bzos 'bul phul ches pa'i gnas tshul gsan pas/ 'bras spungs sprul skus de 'dra mdzad yong ma bsam/ de ltar na nged kyis kyang ma mjal na'ang yod pa 'dug ces thugs cung ma rengs skad/ 'brug pa sprul sku 'di gsang sngags gsar ring mdo tha snyad rig pa sogs la mkhas pa tsam du ma zad/ dgos mi dgos kyis mtshams phyed cing lta ga tshugs zin pa/'jig rten phyogs nas kyang dgra go gnyen go tshang ma chod pa zhig yin par snang / de nas rtse chen du phebs/ dpon drung blo bde bas bsnyen bkur bteg /rim gyis dpal 'khor bde chen du/ rta pa'i bsu ba nyis brgya skor dang / dge 'dun pa stong ra can tsam gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas pas mdun bdar te phebs/ dge lugs pa'i grwa tshang bdun gyis nyin re bzhin 'bul ba bzang 'gran byas pa mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang 'khor ba tsam dang / sa zhal gyi grwa tshang rnams kyis kyang bsnyen bkur zhing / rdo gcal du skya ser gyi tsho gis la bka' gdams glegs bam dang / 'du khang du tshogs pa la snar thang brgya rtsa/ gzims chung du sa dge ris med la gur zhal gyi rjes gnang dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang / mchod rten chen mo/ gos sku mchod khang rnams mjal zhing bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon — 1/8

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (nyanalam mdzad/ rgyal mkhar rtser nang chen pas gdan drangs/ gus mchod bla lhag tu bsgrubs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i rgyal po ma skyes (82na)dgra'i rten skal gyi 'phel gdung / bla ma chos kyi rgyal po la rgya nag gong mas phul ba'i khungs btsun de mjal zhing smon lam gnang bas/ ring bsrel gcig gnyis shig 'bul rtsis la smon lam gnang bas bco lnga rang bab tu phyag tu byung / bdag chen rgyal rtse ba yab sras kun mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ ri khrod dga' ldan du gdan drangs/ gnas de'i spong ba bsam gtan pa'i dge 'dun rnams la chos kyi 'brel pa stsal/ rgya sngags 'chang chen po mjal/ dpal gsang ba'i gdung 'dzin gnas rnying chos rjes lha mgon lcam dral gyi 'cham sku sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas te gdan drangs/ gser 'bum dang khyad 'phags bcu gsum sogs gnas gzigs zhib par gnang / zhal ngo grwa bu slob rnams la 'dod chos stsal zhing zhabs tog kyang rgya che mdzad/ khyad par zhabs drung chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas kyis 'phel gdung ya mtshan can zhig phul/ stong sher 'brog pa rnams kyi khrod du gdan drangs te yig drug gi bzlas lung dang bsnyen gnas sogs dge ba'i lam la bkod/ phyir lam dpon drung rtse pas dbang ldan chos 'khor du bsnyen bkur zhus/ slar gnas rnying du phebs te mkhan pos thog drangs pa'i der 'bod thams cad la chos dang zang ring gi dga' ston stsal rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya skor bsgrubs/bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa ra lung du gdung brgyud ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis gdan drangs te gus 'dud lhur blangs / rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyi sku tshigs las byung ba'i khyad 'phags bcu gsum sogs rten rnams gzigs/ sna dkar rtse 'brog khri dpon gyis gdan drangs zhabs tog bsnyen bkur yang dag pa mdzad/ dpal sde ba gzhi gar phebs/ de'i thang la rje drung dme (82ba)pa yab srasabazhugs 'dug pa dang / mjal 'dzom gyi bcas gzhi shar/ khong dpon slob/ sne'u gdong gong ma dang yang mjal 'dzom lam ngan par ha gyes byung ba'i lo rgyus 'dug pa ltar/ phyag dang gdan sogs la rtseg po yod tshod du gda'/ thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar bzhin khe dang — 119

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skargyal kha gzhan la bskur ba zhig yin par 'dug kyang / phyag mdzod dpal ldan rgya mtsho dang / sku mdun chos bzang 'phrin las gnyis kyis skor g.yang byas pas/ sgar gyi phyag mdzod pas bkur gzos 'di las che ba gzhan la byed myong zhes mna' bskyal zer/ de yang rje bsod nams rgya mtsho de thugs dag snang ba che bas/ bla ma su 'dra zhig dang mjal na'ang rtsod pa mi mdzad cing / lhag tu bod dpon slob 'jig rten gyi sgrob che ba nas/ thugs ba 'ad dang bstun nas phyag 'bul ba dang phyag dbang zhu ba gnang 'dug /dpal ldan dmag zor ma sogs kyi cho 'phrul la brten/ sgar du ser ba chen po bab ste khong dpon slob thugs rtog zos pa byung zhes gleng / gang ltar na'ang 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa lta bu'i rgyal ba'i sras po yang / bod chol kha gsum la dbang sgyur te mi chen gyi tshugs ka 'dzin pa/gang zag 'di 'dra'i rigs tsho 'dul ba la dgongs par 'dug go /e ma kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram pa nas/ /rab dkar cha shas rdzogs pa'i zla ba gang / shar tshe phyogs bral ku mud ma lus pa/ /rgyasapar byed pa dngos po'i chos nyid ltar/ /lho rgyud gnyal dang lho brag g.yas ru gtsang / /nor 'dzin sto bar gnas pa'i gdul bya kun/ /thar pa'i gam du 'phrin pa'i 'phrin las 'di/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i mdzad pa gnyis par byas/ /bdag las gzhan gces rgyal sras rnam par thar/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i/(83na dugs dkar srid pa'i rtser/ /'khor tshe dregs ldan 'gro ba'i 'dren pa rnams/ /mthon po'i brag rir 'byung po'i bya bzhin gnas/ /bsod nams zhi 'gyur rje btsun bla ma gang / /bsod nams spel phyir phyogs bram gshegs pa'i tshe/ /bsod nams dbyig 'dzin lto bar mi shong zhes/ /bsod nams can gyi lha rnams ca co sgrog /de nas rgyal khab chen po gong ri dkar por lha gzigs mi'i dbang po ngag dbang grags pas bsnyen bkur/ tshe dbang tshe khrid sogs bzhed pa'i chos rnams phul/gong ma chen po 'di ni thugs dad shin tu che bas/ thugs dam gsung chog gi gral dbur phebs pa'i tshe/ brgyud mchod gnang dus/ rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i mtshan byung ba'i tshe/ zhabs pus gnyis btsugasate nang mchod 'thor bar mdzad skad/—120

rgyal dbang bsod nam rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma'i lo gsar gtor chen gyi phyag lan 'dzugs par bkas bskul zhing / lha mo'i sku 'dra zhig 'bul ba gnang ba da lta gong dkar gyi gzims chung mgon khang na yod/ de nas chu shul/ khol ma/ gye re lha pa/ ljang pa sogs kyis rim gyis bsnyen bkur nas gdong dkar du phebs/ dpal ldan mi'i dbang por bzhed pa'i chos rnams phul/ de nas dpal ldan 'bras spungasachos kyi sde chen por phebs te gsol ba phug sgo nas zhu ba sogs sku mtshams dam du mdzad/ chos skyong gi bsnyen sgrub du ma dang / khyad par lha mo 'od chen 'bar ma'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad pas/ a tsa ra mi steng khyer nas gar byed pa dang mtshan mo gzims chung gi sgo rdung ba/ bam bskyur ba lta bu'i sdig sgra/ sgra bgegs kyi mgo bo gzims chung gi khyams su dngos su bskyur ba sogs cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa byung /de nas dga' ldan du phebs/ mkhan po rin po che'i sku gdung zhugs la phul bas/ dbu thod (83ba)pa dri bzang gi chus bkrus pas/ ring bsrel sngon po shin tu 'tsher ba zhig byung / zhag shas song ba na gdung rus la rnam bcu dbang ldan bod yig gi rnam pa can du byon/ gdung thal rnams la g.yin gyis ji tsam btsan yang ma rnyed pa la/ rje nyid kyis phyag tu blangs shing gzigs pa tsam gyis ring bsrel grangs med 'phel bar/ byang rtseb phyogs nas/ 'di 'dra rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs rje ma gtagasachos rje bde ba can pa la byung ba min pa 'dug ces kun slong gi gtam smras/ mar lam sha ra hor du zhag bzhugs mdzad nas brag dkar du phebs/ sdo pa khu dbon la tshe dbang sogs stsal/ bde chen rtser zhag nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam bzhugs/ sku rim la zhi drag gi sbyin sreg dang / rtsam khal drug cu tsam la bzhengs pa zhal gyi mchod gtor phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas spyan gzigs sogs rgyas par mdzad pas gtor ma las bdud rtsi 'bab pa sogs bkra legs/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang mjal te mchod bstod smon lam gnang / rim gyis 'bras spungs su phebs/ lam rim gyi khrid dang / sa skyong bkra shes rab brtan gyis bskul nas ku ru kulbe dang tshogs bdag gi mngon rtogs thugs rtsom gnang / tshogs su bka' gdams glegs bam cha lag dang bcas pa dang /—121—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)gzims chung du slob dpon rnam pas thog drangs pa la rjes gnang lung khrid mang du rtsal/rab myos zhes pa lcags rta'i lo gsar dang smon lam grub nas se ra theg chen gling du phebs/tshogs chen du rje gong ma'i gsung 'bum gyi lung dang gzims chung du byes pa slob dpon chen po bas thog drangs pa la/ dpe chos rin cen spungs pa gsungs/ dbo zla'i tshes brgyad la dpal mgon zhal gyi gtor chen rten (84na 'dogs dang bcas pa rgyas par gnang / de nas rgyal du chibs kha sgyur/mtshar chen gyi zhal slob rin po che bod mkhar ba'i gsung las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las ngo bo gcig bsdus pa/ /'dzam gling yongs la grags pa yi/ /rje btsun mtshar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /pha khyed kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /bu yi tha chung me tri nga / /kha ba can ljongasasgom kyi lha/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon 'brom ston gyi/ /sprul pa bsod nams rgya mtsho las/ /gnasamachog rgyal la shog ces gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyal du 'byon dgos pa'i bka' shog phebs pa bzhin/ khong dpon slob kyang bde chen nas phyags phyir 'byor/ mal gro brgyud/ rgyal du phebs/ dga' tshal gyi mchod khang dkar po sngar nas yod bzhin pa la phyag mdzod dpal ldan rgya mtshos khur glengs nas de khyi ko ṭi dang / sde pa lcang rwa ba bsod nams lhun grub kyis do dam byas nas bsil ba tshal gyi mgon khang gi mkhar las mdzad/ de grub pa dang mgon khang bsil ba tshal du/ rin po che bod mkhar bas zhal bkod gnang ste/ snyan brgyud kyi phyag len ltar gur zhal gyi sku bzheng ba dang / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'dzugs mtshar lugs ltar mdzad/ sa skya'i gu shrī'i bla mtsho nas rgyun bsres pa'i bla mtsho gsar du bskrun/ gtor ma rnams rin po che rang gis phyag bzo mdzad 'dug pa da lta yang mchis/gzims khang dbus ma'i shod du sku zhad rin po che kun bzang rtse bas zhal bkod dang phyag len mdzad de/ khyab 'jug dang gza' gdong dmar nag gi bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan dang / rten mdos/ gzhan yang rdo rje legs pa dang pe dkar/ beg tse lcam dral gyi sku gzugs dang rten mkhar gyi rim pa rnamasabazhengs/ steng du (84ba)rje nyid kyis zhal bkod gnang ste/ 'jigs byed/ mgon po phyag bzhi drug /— 122

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)gur zhal/ 'dod khams dbang phyug /rnam sras/ las gshin/ /beg tse/ ma ning / legs ldan/ /zhang 'on/ dur khrod bdag po/ rnam sras mdung dmar can/ tsa ri zhing skyong sogs chos skyong spyi'i mgon khang dang / de da ko zhir dpal ldan lha mo'i sku brnyan sogs bzhengs te/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa dngos su bstims/ mgon khang rgyal mthil las kyang 'di nyid gnyan par grags shing / spyir yang gnas 'di nyid dam can srung ma ngang gis 'du ba'i stabs kyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dus/ 'bri kong gi dmag byung ba rnams gtor zor 'phangs pa tsam gyis thal bar song ba nas bzung / zho kha bas lag 'jog byas pa sogs sngar phan zhing bcu'i dgra bo byung tshad la lo ma 'gyangs par rtags mtshan mngon du gyur song ba ni/ ri mthil gyi mgon khang gnyis ga rgyu mtshan med pa'i lder bzo gog po la rtsi btang ba tsam ma yin pa'i/ rdo rje lang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar byung ba'i phyag len bzhin bstan par mdzad pa dang / rje 'di nyid bla chen du ming btags pa'i 'jig rten kho nas gzhan mgo bskor ba tsho dang mi 'dra bar/ mngon spyod drag po'i las la nang byan chud nges kyi rtags su go zhing / slad mar yang srog la 'theb med pa rnams phyogs de la 'dzem rigs par mngon no/ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi las byang / lha mo dus mtshan ma'i gtor chog /zhal gdong gnyan can gyi bsgral las/ gza' gdong dmar nag gi 'phrin las mgon dkar gyi sgrub thabs/ brtan bzhugs rgyal ba kun dngos ma thugs rtsom gnang / de skabs sngar mtshar chen la gsan pas snyan brgyud kyi 'phro gang yod rnams dbang lung (85na pog len dang bcas pa phal cher/ rin po che bod mkhar ba la rdzogasapar gsan/ mgon khang shod du dpal mgon gyi sku brnyan zhig bzhengs pa grub bstun/ nang du gdan 'dren rgyu la sku tshad ches te sgo la ma thar bas/ de nyid chos skyong gi spyan 'dren gdangs dbyangs rnga chings dang bcas pa zhig gnang ste/ nub mo mgon khang gi sgo ma bcad par bzhag pas/ sang thegasanang du rang byon gyis phebs zin 'dug pas/ kun ya mtshan par gyur/ sngar spyan g.yas rab 'byamasapa legs bshad rgyal mtshan ngam rings su gral skor la phyin skabs/ 'phral rkyen zhig la brten nas/—123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skasngags 'chang rta nag sgrol ma ba'i slob ma byas te/ lo bcu gnyis gyi ring sa 'og tu gshin rje bsgrubs/'chi bdag zhal dbye bar grags pa de gtsang du phebs dus 'bul ba'i khas len zhus 'dug pa ltar/'di skabs kho rang ngos kyis 'bul ba la 'byor te phul tshogs su spyi chos dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs kyis gdul bya'i re ba bskang / de nas nyang long rnams kyis gdan drangs te/ dwags po grwa tshang dang mnga' ris grwa tshang gnyis phyags phyir khrid/ dge 'dun sgang / ri kha/ sang sing / bkra shis chos lung / pha lu gnam tshal rnams su rim gyis phabs te/ skya ser gyi khrom la bka' gdams glegasabam/ snying po don gsum/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya phrag brgal ba gnang / rgya nang phur slob dpon chen po'i sgrub gnas brag dkar lha chu mjal bar phebs pas brag la phyag rjes gsal bar byung / slob dpon chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can gzigs/ rim gyis chos 'khor rgyal 'argyud/ 'ol kha rtser phebs/ skyes bdag ces pa lcags(85ba)lug gi lo gsar gtor chen sogs rgyas par mdzad/ dpal ldan lha mo'i bskang gso dang / bod rgyal po'i 'gur lha 'o de gung rgyal dngos su 'ongs te 'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ bstod pa zhig thugs rtsom mdzad/ sde pa yab sras dang / mthong chag mkhar gsum sogs mnga' zhabs nas kyang bsnyen bkur mtha' yas pa bstab/ rim gyis bsam yas su gnas mjal dang / bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po la 'phrin las bcol/ gser la brgyud/ 'bras spungs su phebs/ tsho gos chen la bka' gdams thor bu gsungs/ gong dkar du mi'i dbang phyug gis spyan drangs te phebs/ e gi ra zhes pa chu sprel lo gsar gyi dus rim chen mo'i rtsa 'chams drug 'chams sogs kyi gzigs 'bul dang /dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa lha ldan du phebs/ de nas re zhig 'brasaspungs su bzhugs/ gur lha brgyad kyi bskang gso thugs rtsom gnang / sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan gyis spyan drangs te/ brag dkar du phebs mgon po zhal gyi bsnyen pa gnang ba'i mtshan ltas byung ba phyag bris su bkod pa 'di ltar/ /rje phul byung ma ti'i gces phrug pa/ /dbyings nam mkha'i rnal 'byor —124

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)lhur len pas/ /nying 'byul la bden snyam mi sems te/ /ngo mtshar gyi rmi nyams 'di 'dra shar/ /lo e gi ra yi nag zla la/ /dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po'i tshes/ /grong lta na sdug mtshudas brag dkar gyi/dpal rin chen rtsegs pa'i gzhas yas su/ /mgon tsa tur mu khe'i bsnyen pa'i tshe/ khu men gyi ljon pa rus sbal dbyings/ kha sbyor ba bde chen gyi ros mchode de/ /ye gdod ma'i mgon la zhal mjal zhus/ /slar byu ru'i sdong po ti la gas/ /bde chen gyi nā da spyan drangs te/ /sprul pas zhing bcu'i (86na tshe gig 'gro bcom/ khyad par dga' ba'i rang zhal mthong / /slar mar gad sa lo sbram mdzes dag / mgon rin 'byung don grub gnyis spangs mar/ /lhan skyes bde skyong gi 'khor lo sdom/ /brjod bral gyi zhal bzang de 'dra mthong / /nga bzhad pa'i rdo rjer yid rton pa'i/ /rjes 'jug gi skal ldan khyed rnamasakyang / /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i thugs bcud kyi/ /drang nges kyi mgon la zhal mjal mdzad/ /yang de nas dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshe/ /khong nā gar pa'i grong khyer bas/ dpal rang byung he ru ka mchod tshe/ /mtshan ldan lha yi mdzes ma zung / /yum sher phyin dang dbyangs can srog mo dang / /g.yung mo dang tsa mun ṭi sogs kyis/ /don ngang tshul gsal bar bstan nas song / /ming tsam gyi btags yod chosarnams ni/ /ma btags pa'i snang ba bkra lags kyang / /nga bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bltas tsa na/ khong rdzun tshang rig pas tshig dgod shor/ tshul 'di lta'i ya mtshan ltas mo che/ /lha bla ma'i drin las bdag gis mthong / /ma 'gro drug nyam thag 'di rnams kyang / /ya mtshan gyi ltad mo 'di mthong shog /ces so/ /de yang nyin zhag gcig la thugs dam spros bcas spros med kyi rim pa gnang ba ni/ thog mar khrus dang nye reg gnas bsrung ba/ skyabs 'gro/ phyag mchod/ lam rim gyi khrid/ sgra mi snyan pa dang mgon po che chung gi tshe sgrub/ lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi dbang / snying zhugs 'pho ba dang bcas pa/ 'jam nag /'jam dbyangs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ sems bskyed/ bsam gtan nyal chog /bde mchog lus dkyil/ rtsa sngags brgya rtsa/ snying po nye snying sum brgya/ mi 'khrugs pa/ de'i gzungs sngags brgya rtsa/ bka' gdamasalha bzhi'i sgom bzlas/ sngags brgya rtsa/ bstod tshogs dang smon lam skor 'ga' (86bston ga /tshe dpag — 125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)med kyi bskyed rdzogs/ tshe khrid/ sgrol dkar/ 'jam dbyangs/ dbyangs can dkar dmar/ mkha' spyod ma rnams kyi bzlas bsnyen/ bde mchog gdan bzhi'i bsnyen pa sum brgya/ sngags ring nyer gcig /rdo rje shugs sngags nyer gcig /zil gnon sku gsung thugs sngags brgya rtsa/ skye ring nyer gcig /'jam sdud bzang gsum ljags klog /rta mgrin dmar nag /gu ru zhi drag gi sgom bzlas/ ma gcig gi gcod dmigs/ blo sbyong lta khrid/ spyan ras gzigs dang phyag rdor gyi sgom bzlas/ 'jigs byed kyi sngagasabargya rtsa/ zhi khro sbrags bsgrub/ e sa bh+yo bzlog /dus gsang 'jigs gsum/ bde dgyes/ tshe phur drag gsum/ yang gsang / phyag bzhi drug /mgon dkar/ chos rgyal/ dmag zor ma/ gur zhal/las mkhan dang bcas pa/ rnam gras dmar ser/ dud sol/ dus mtshan/ beng ma ning / bzhi sbrags/dkar po brgyad cu/ sgrol ma bcu gnyis/ du khri/ stag zhon/ pe dkar/ gza'/ rdor legs/ zhing skyong / ston kha/ gza' gdong dmar nag /rā hu la/ zhal bram gzugs/ dmar po skor gsum/ rja la rigs gsum/ gzhi bdag dang bcas pa'i gtor bsngo/ /thun bzhin skyabs sems/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa/ rtsa ba'i lha'i gtor bsngo/ /lhung ba bsngo grangs / stobs bzhi/ spyi bshags/ phyir bcos/khyung khra nag /'od zer can/ rme brtsegs yab yum/ lo ma can/ seng gdong / mi tri lugs kyi tshe gzungs/rnam rgyal 'joms/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya gang 'gro/ cha gsum/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg /nā ro ni gu'i khrid/ brag rdzong dang mgon po gnyis kyi gsang khrid/ phyag drug pa'i khrid/ mkha' spyod ma'i khrid/ gzhan yang gshin rje'i (87na gi tor ma/ chu gtor/ du ring ma/ zhal bzhi pa rigasabazhi'i gter bsngo/ gru'i bum srung / tshe dpag med mtshan rgya rtsa lha dgu'i gzungs/ dza zhi'i gdams pa 'ga' zhig /phyag 'tshal nyer gcig /bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags rnams yin zhes gsung dngos lasastsal pa dag bsdus te bris pa'o/ / sde pa 'ol kha bas ched gnyer gyis gdan 'dren pa mngags pa ltar byang kha brgyud gdan sa thel kun bzang nags khrod kyi gnas gzigs zhib par gnang / bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bskams pa glo bur du —126

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)gsos/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas gsum pa dang mjal/ de nas 'ol kha rtser phebs/ sa skyong a mo gha rnam rgyal rdo rje bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po mdzad de mtshan don yod rgya mtshan btags/rdzing phyi'i mkhan thog tu bskos pa la gnang sbyin dang phyag nas gtor/ sde pa phun tshogs rab brtan gyis thel gyi mchod ga chisko u bsdams pa la/ spyan snga grags 'byung bas drag las mdzad pas/ nub gcig sku gzhogs su yang dkon chos rjes har langs byas par ci byung dri ba gnang bas/ mi nag po gri thod bzung ba shin tu che ba zhig gis tshoms chen steng du skul bskyod byas pas brag thams cad zhig 'gro ba lta bu byung zhus par/ nga la yang de mtshungs shig byung / sde pa la legs po yong mdog mi kha ba 'dug pas/ re zhig rgyal la 'gro gsungs phebs/ de bar du sde pa phun tshogs pa rbab la shor te grongs/sde pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gral dbur gdan drangs te phebs/ thel gyi mthu bzlog cig zhus par/zhal gyi gtor zor gnang bas/ der rdo gru gsum du gas/ spyan snga yang mi ring bar gshegs/ rim gyis gong dkar du phebs/dpal gdong zhes pa chu bya'i lo gsar gyi (87ba jig 'a ston rgyas par gnang / rdzing phyi mkhan po don yod rgya mtsho dang / dpon slob gnyis dgongs pa mthun par/ gong dkar nas zhabs drung ngag dbang bka' brgyud rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ 'ol kha'i thugs khur bzhes par gdan 'dren rtsis kyi bka' gros nang bcar gnang ste/ smon lam chen mo'i gral dbur phebs/ 'gro ba rnams smin grol la bkod de zhag shas 'bras spungs su bzhugs ngos/ 'ol kha'i thugs brel gyi stabs nas/ gong dkar du chibs kha bsgyur/ de nas rong chad dkar gyi bar nyin lam gcig la bcad de 'ol khar phebs kyang / dpon sa dkar po nas dang / rdzing phyi'i che bgres rnams kyis sde pa yul 'khor ba gdan drangs la byon zin pas stabs cung zad ma 'grig /dgongs par ma ldan te rgyal du phebs/ sde pa yul 'khor nas kyis bshags pa tsam zhig phul na 'ong rgyur 'dug kyang / ma mdzad pas de phyogs nas rgyal du mi yang dus/ gnam cung zad 'tshub pa zhig 'dug /slar mal gro brgyud/ tshal zur khang du smra ba'i dbang — 1 27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)phyug bkra shis rab brtan gyis zhag 'gar bsnyen bkur/ 'bras spungs su phebs/ phyogs bral gyi gdul bya la 'dod chos dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs mang du gnang /dngos po zhes pa shing khyi'i lo gsar dang smon lam chen mo sogs grub nas gos spungs su phebs/ mchog dman yongs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin par bzhugs so/ /thugs rje'i ma la ya rlung gis bskyod pa/ /legs byas tshar du dngar ba'i dri bsung can/ / bsil ldan ljongs kun 'gengs pa'i rnam thar gyis/ /lag 'gro'i snying po khengs pa btang ste 'dar/ /gnam lcags thog mdas cha tsam gzhal min pa'i/ /rig sngags grub pa'i mthu stobs chen po yis/ /zhing bcu'i (88na8gra sde ma lus tshar bcad tshe/ /pad gnubs rwa gnyan rnam thar gcig tu byas/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam khyab len rdos/ /phyogs bral gdul bya'i lcags phye kun/ /ma lus gcig tu bsdu ba 'di/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa'i ngang tshul yin/ /de yang paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyis/ 'gog rir gnas brtan bcu drug zhal gzigs pa'i tshe/gtsang gi brgyags lhag khams su 'khyer ba'i lung bstan dang / 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa la se chen rgyal pos/ thog mar bod khri skor bcu gsum/ bar pa la bod chol kha gsum/ tha ma la rgya'i mi yur chen mo bcad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung gis thog drangs pa'i zang zing gi dngos po ste/'bul chen gsum byas pa'i tha ma la/ gos yug nag po bdun/ de'i rjes su dkar po gcig phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nged rang gnyis skye ba bdun cu ring mi 'phrad/ de nas khyod rgyal po gser gyi ming can dang / nged chu las byas pa'i ming can du gyur tshe mjal nas 'gro don rgya chen po byed gsungs pa'i sngon gyi yig tshang khungs ma mang por yod ces rnam thar gyi yi ge 'ga' zhig tu gsal la/ de yang sprul sku 'phreng kha bas mdzad pa'i rnam thar du rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i rnam 'phrul du bshad cing zhal gyis kyang bzhes pa yin par 'dug /'phags pa rin po che ni glang ri thang pa dang se ston ri pa sogs kyi sku'i skye ba dang / sku tshe phyi ma thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan se ra byams chen —128

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)chos rje sogs su ga snyings pa'i rim pa 'dug pa nas/ dngos bstan du mi 'grig par mchos na'ang /thugs brgyud gcig pa la nges pa med de/ sa chen/ zhad 'gro ba'i mgon po/ mnga' bdag nyang sogasakyang dus mtshungs su byung bas/ sku tshe (88bgi cig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i skyes rabs ma yin kyang / zla ba gcig la chu zla grangs med 'byung ba ltar/ sprul pa sna tsho gos su bstan pa dag so sor zhal gyis zhes pa ltar ro/ /de yang sngon lcags lug gi nang du al than rgyal po chos kyi snang ba cung zad skyes te/ phyogs der 'dzo dge a seng bla ma zhes bya ba zhig 'ongs pa la/ dri ba byas par/ rje 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa sogs zhib tu bshad pas/ 'phrog tu med pa'i dad pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel te/byang phyogs kyi sa chen por phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsan du/ blon po na gtso bos thog drangs gser yig mngags pa sku gzhogs su 'byor/ rgyal po'i zhu yig dang 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ de dag la dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal stsal/ phyogs de'i 'phrin las kyis sgo dus la bab kyang / re zhig gsal kha ma gnang bar gong dkar du phebs/ sbyin bdag grwa rigs sogs nas sku dngos kyis phebs pa la 'gab mi 'gab kyi gleng brjod mang du byung yang / gtso bor lha gzigs mi'i dbang po ngag dbang grags pas/mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po de'i re ba bskang ba 'gab tshul gyi snyan 'bul zhus pa ltar bka' gros thugs thag bcad nas 'bras spungs su phebs/ mchod yon mtsho khar ngos mjal gnang ba'i gang ci'i zhib cha dang / re zhig bla mar du bol ba slob dpon brtson 'grus bzang po rdzong sta mdzad/ bum chu gnang ba rgyal pos thog drangs pa'i mi khri phrag gis btungs kyang zad mi shes pa'i rdzu 'phrul ngo mtshar can bstan/ al than chos kyi rgyal po'i sku tshe bsring thabs su sku gak+ṣ-i gas grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling par gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma btsugs/ de nas bzung ste rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs (89na〉zugad gling zhes grags/na tshod ldan zhes pa shing phag gi lo gsar dang smon lam rnams grub nas 'bras spungs su bzhugs —129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)skabs/ sde pa rin spungs pas gtsang rong gi dmag khri phrag tu nye ba bteg nas/ stod lung sgal po na gar sgar phabs/ sgal byang smon gsum sogs bcom/ rim gyis skyid shod du 'ongs nas/ gtsang chen don yod rdo rje lta bu'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba zhig byed rtsis la/ rje nyid kyi phyag g.yog mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba sku zhabs kun bzang rtse pas mdzad de las sbyor gnang bas/ sgar du thog 'khyug sogs byung bas/ mi thub kyang lha mi thub par bsam ste phyir bzlog ga /tshul 'di ni thugs rtse chos skyong srung ma la gtad nas zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mdzad pa 'dug la ngos lkog du ma nas dus 'byug g.yo ba'i gya gyu'i snang tshul can gyi dam par rlom pa rnams dang 'dra ba ni min no/ /de nas sde pa rgya ri bas gdan drangs te gser la brgyud/ chad dkar dang / ri sgor phebs/ phyogs der 'khod pa'i skye bo mtha' dag la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon yang dag par bskrun/ yar klungs su sde gzar tshan che ba zhig langs te/ chos rje zhwa dmar nag dang / yar klungs btsan thang du zhal rgyas thog /chings bsdams te dus gzings rnams zhi bar mdzad/zhwa nag gi mjal kha dgos phebs par/ rje dbang phyug rdo rjes/ nged kyi zhwa khrom dang brgya 'bul med par mjal kha gtong srol med kyang / sprul sku rin po ches phebs sgo gnang phyin los 'bul/ zhwa sgam khyer shog gsungs/ thog mar dme pas bzhes/ rje 'dis gzims chung gi brgya 'bul mdzod gsungs gser zho brgya phul/ de nas dbu zhwa rje (89ba/'di'i phyag tu phul bas/ bdag gis gyon na gang 'dra 'ongs gsungs/ zhwa nag dbu'i thad kyi bar snang la bzhag pas/ ga me pa dpon slob mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob zer/ 'di ltar na zhwa nag de mkha' 'gro ma'i skra la bzos zer ba yang mi bden pa'i nges pa mi 'dug go /sne'u gdong rtser zhabs drung nor bu gling dkar gyis gus mchod mdzad cing / bka' chos 'bul ba gnang / 'phyong rgyas su zhabs drung mi dbang sku mched kyis gdan drangs chos dang zang zing gi dga' ston rgya cher stsal te/ nyang po gru brgyud 'bras spungs su phebs/ 'dzin byed ces pa me byi'i lo gsar dang smon lam grub nas/ mal gro brgyud rgyal du phebs/ spyi — 130

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)chos dang sgos chos mang du gsungs/ /mgon khang rnams su bskang gso gtor gsos bsnyen sgrub 'phrin las 'chol ba gnang / lcang ra/ grum mda'/ or/ bang rim sogs dwags kong nyang long gi skya ser mang po mjal bar lhags/ chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa rgya cher stsal/ rim gyis 'ol kha dang rong chad dkar du phebs/ sde pas thog drangs pa'i skye bo kun la 'dod chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ sne'u gdong rtser sdo srid kyis spyan drangs/ lugs zung gi bka' mchid mang du gnang /'phyong rgyas brgyud/ gong dkar du phebs/ zla shas bzhugs/ lugs gnyis kyi snyan sgron sogs zhikha par phan tshun du 'bul res mdzad nas 'bras spungs su phebs/dbang phyug ces pa me glang gi lo gsar dang / chos skyong mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad/ ra sa 'phrul snang du cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rgya chen po spel/ de nas 'bras spungs su phebs/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams la slar yang bca' yig gnang / sde pa rgya ri bas (90na〉gdan drangs nas ri sgor phebs/ mchog dman mtha' dag dge ba'i lam la bkod/ 'di'i skabs/ kho bo'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub de nyid kyis kyang rab tu byung ba gnang / rje de la thugs rje chen po nye brgyud dang 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/dpal lha mo'i rjes gnang nye brgyud/ tshe dbang nye brgyud sogs thun mong ma yi na pa'i zab chos du ma dgyes bzhin du stsal/ de dus grwa rkyang las spros pa'i ming che ba zhig mi 'dug kyang / phyis su bstan pa spyi sgos mtha' dag gi srog shing dam par 'gyur pa dang / khyad par rje nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos rnams gcam bu tsam min par 'phrul med kyi chos rgyun 'dzin nges par dgongs te/ don gyi bstan pa gtad par gor ma chag go /tshur lam rgyal dang 'ol khar phebs/ dpal ldan lha mos bstod cing 'phrin las gcol ba dngos grub rgya mtsho dang / gur gyi gtor 'bul thugs rtsom gnang / slar 'bras spungs su phebs thog al than rgyal pos khong rang mtsho kha phyogs su 'byor rtsis sogs gnas tshul 'bul ba dang / gdan 'dren pa skyar ma slebs/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du smon lam —13/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nesnga bsnur gnang / sku mdun chos mdzad pa chos bzang 'phrin las kyis do dam mdzad de/ nas kyi phung po rdo ring dang mnyam pa spungs nas/ nas 'gyed btang / slar 'bras spungs su phebs/ gzhi byes kyi bslab ston grabs yul sogs gnang /hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nyer drug la 'bras spungs nas chibs kha bsgyur/ rten 'brel gyi stabs nas dpal 'byor lhun por bzhugs sgar bsgrigs/ sku zhang rin po che gdan 'dren du phebs nas/ dzhai k+ṣiṃ las grub pa'i dbang gi sras (90ba)phur tshe chu dang lhan du gter nas byon pa'i khyad 'phags/ 'ug bya lung nas kun bzang rtser 'byor ba'i pad+ma ki la ya de phyag tu phul bas 'phrin las kyi rten 'brel dang / lcags kyi bsnyen phur thang cig dor ba/ ra rdzis rnyed de phur rtse gtad nas ra lug rnams brtsisapas sna khrag phrul le shi ba'i khyad can de yang mgul phur du phul bas/ bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten 'brel 'grig /de nas dga' ldan khang gsar du phebs/ drag po'i mas su zhugs te sbyin sreg blug /sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan nyid kyis rin cen rgyan cha sprad/ spos phor dang bcas te/'ong stod zhing khar gdan drangs/ khrom khri phrag la tshe dbang gnang / lha sa dang ra mo che'i mchod khang rnams mjal nas bstan pa rgyas pa dang bzhed don 'grub pa'i smon lam mdzad/ tshal zur khang du phebs/ tshal gung gi rten mjal dang / ye shes kyi mgon po la 'phrin las bcol/ bde chen dang brag dkar rnams brgyud/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs/ dngul gdung rin po che mjal zhing smon lam mdzad/ rim gyis 'phan yul gzhung brgyud/ byang rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su phebs/ bstan pa'i chu mig ring mo glo bur du rgyas/ jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje dang jo bo'i gdung rten gyis gtsos pa'i rten rnams mjal zhing smon lam mdzad/ mi g.yo ba'i sku thang zhig sku dpung g.yas kyi steng du bab/ skya ser kyi khrom che ba la snying po don gsum gnang / sku mdun chos mdzad pas gsol 'debs shig zhus par/ dpal thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bla ma'i zhabs/ /lha khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /rje mthong ba don ldan — 132

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)la phyag 'tshal/ dus snyigs ma'i (91na tsher gro ba yongs kyi mgon/ /gtan skyabs kyi dam pa sprul pa'i sku/ khyed snying nas dran pa'i gsol 'debs na/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i gnas skabs su/ /don bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / /rkyen phyi nang gi bar gcod zhi bar shog /ces dang / gzhan yang lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya'i zhal gdams mang du gnang zhing lhag par tshigs su bcad pa/ dpal mar me mdzad dpal ye shes zhabs/ /yab rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sku mched gsum/ /rje blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa la/ /snying thag pas phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /mi bdag gi rjes 'a lcag dad can la/ /thugs brtse bas rjes su 'dzin du gsol/ lar rnyed dka'i dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /rje sangs rgyasabastan dang mjal dus su/ /rang sgo gsum bla ma'i zhabs tag la/ /snying rus pa'i khong nas blangs byas pa/ /de don ldan yin pas dper byed na/ /'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yab sras dang / /rje mi la sogs kyi don gnyis 'grub/ /da dus kyi dbang gis de bzhin du/ /dpe ji ltar ba bzhin ma 'grub kyang / /bka' tshul bzhin bsgrub pa lhur blangs na/ /tshe phyi ma phan chad bde ba'i thabs/ khyu 'brasabu'i rten 'brel bslu med phyir/ /lar phan dang bde ba'i gzhi ma ste/ /don de ltar sems la bzhag 'tshal lo/ /nged sog po'i rgyal pos spyan drangs nas/ /yul mtha' 'khob gnas su 'gro shar yang / /dus mi 'byangs bzhin du 'khor bgyid pas/ /da bar du sems la bzhag bya ni/ /gnas dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde/ /gzhis dga' ldan pho brang 'khor bcas/ /don 'dzin 'bras le bar ma shor zhing / /rang rgyu 'bras chos la yid ches dang / /las dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad kyang 'tshal/ /dus (91bskags ma lnga bde'i sems can la/ /las goms pa'i dbang gis chags sdang mes/ rang rgyud kyi bud shing sreg par byed/ /de snang tshul bltas na don gyis stong / /bzhi chags sdang gi rtog pa mgo snyoms las/ /don kha zhe med par bla ma yi/ /zhabs spyi bo'i gtsug du len pa dang / /skyabs dkon cog gsum la blo phugs gto de/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mas bka' bsgos pa'i/ /chos skyong ba'i srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /dus rtag tu gsol wo mchod pa la/ /yid le lor ma 'jog brtson par gyis/ /don —133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skade ltar yid la legs bzhag nas/ /ngag gang smras bden par bzung byas na/ dus 'di nas ma 'ongasatshe rabs su/ /'bral med kyi smon lam snying la 'grogs/ /dpal 'chi med kyi go 'phang thob pa'i tshe/ /ngag thog ma'i bdud rtsi'i sbyin par bya/ /tshul 'di ni dge slong spong ba pa/ /ming bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos/ /rje rgyal ba rnams kyis byin rlabs pa'i/ /gnas rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su/ /gtam snyan pa'i tshig 'phreng yi ger bkod/ /dus mi 'gyangs myur du 'phrad pas na/ /yid gdung ba drag pos gsol ba thob/ /'bral med du rjes su 'dzin pas dge /zhes ma 'ongs pa na mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ 'khor gyi thog mar skye ba'i zhal bzhes gnang / de nas phebs skyel du byon pa'i dga' ldan khri rin po che gdan zur/ ser 'bras kyi slob dpon rin po che bod mkhar ba/gtsang pa paṇa chen rig pa seng ge /dben pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ slob dpon bkras rin pa/ rgyal nas sgar pa slob dpon nam mkha' byams pa sogs mdor na/ e dwags/ yar klungs phyogs kyi mkhan slob mang po/ rtse gong dkar gyi sku tshab/ sde phran mang po'i ngo tshab dang / sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan 'khor (92na)g.yog sogs phal cher de kha nas log rtsis kyis gsung gleng gnang sbyin mdzad/rwa sgreng nas chibs thog tu 'khyon thog /sa skyong bkra shis pas chibs yob la 'jus nas/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng yongs la khyab/ /ces tshig rkang gnyis 'phral rtsom mdzad thog /mchi mas brnangs te gsung rgyu mthong bas/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces chibs thog nas gnang ngo / /rim gyis dpon slob rnams 'dam ko khyim du phebs/ sku mdun chos mdzad par dzhai k+ṣiṃ las grub pa'i ston pa'i sku jo bo rin po che'i bzo phud du grags pa de dang gser rdog po chen po zhig gnang ste/bslab ston mang du mdzad/ phyis gser de phyag mdzod sa skyong ba bsod nams rab brtan gyis/ me stag lo lha bzo ba sprul sku dgos skyes kyis byas te sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i gser thang bzhengs pa'i sku rgyu la gtong ba mdzad/ sman thang nas la gnyan mgon 'khor mang gi zhal thang gzabs bris — /34

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)byed rgyu'i bslab ston gnang / thang kha bar skabs su 'khyar ba da lta dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung mgon khang na yod /lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang / rin po che kun bzang rtse pa ma chen/ sku mdun chos mdzad pa/ sman thang nas blo bzang pa rnams phyir log /hor stod pa lhas bsrungs dang / smad pa rkarma dpal sogs phyogs de'i 'brog sde rnams kyis zang zing gi bsnyen bkur bgyis pa rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos/ rim gyis phebs pa na nyin gcig bdud kyi bar du gcod pa'i rnam pas/ 'brong g.yag 'jigs su rung ba cig bzhugs sgar gyi dbus su brgyugs pa/ (92ba)gzigs snang la zhal bram ze'i gzugs can ral gri thogs pa zhig gis de bsgral ba byung / dpal mgon bram ze'i gzugs can la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa thugs rtsom mdzad/'bru mang zhes pa sa stag gi lo gsar rgyas par gnang ste phebs pa na/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul gyis 'bri chu glo bur du 'byugs shing g.yo bas phan tshun du bgrod dka' pa la/ khro bo'i lta stangs dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa tsam gyis mi phyugs mtha' dag bde bar bgrod chog pa byung / dgun dpyid kyi grang ba'i ngad thams cad ring du dor te/ dbyar ston gyi mtshams lta bu'i grang dro sgoms pa'i grub pa'i mtshan ma bstan/ rim gyis nyin lam du ma 'das pa na/ brag ri chen po dung gi dbyibs su 'dra ba'i logs shig nas/ nor gter la khyad du 'phags pa'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil shin tu che ba snyim pa kha sbyar tsam zhig gter nas bzhes/ snyan pa'i grags pas nor 'dzin gyi khyon thams cad khyab pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug /jo bo sgrogs chen gdong ra zhes pa'i lha mthu po che de/ de'i srung mar 'dug pa'i stabs kyis lus dngos su bstan nas/ mthun rdzas zhu zer ba bzhin gnang ste dam la btags/ nya mtsho stod du phebs/ dgon pas gtsos pa'i skya ser gyi khrom chen po tsho gos te/ gser srang stong phrag gsum tsam gyis gtsos pa'i zang zing gi 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs stong phrag tu nye ba sogs gnang ste kun kyang thar pa'i lam la bkod/ bzhugs khri'i rgyab yol gyi rdo la thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sku rang byon dang chibs pa — 135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yogayang 'dzin gyi dbyibs gsal bar byung / de nas rma chu'i 'gram du bzhugs snar phebs pa na/ tshur mthong gi skye bo rnams/ chu 'di ha cang che bas re zhig sgrol bar mi nus so/ /(93na tshe tshes smra ba la/sang nam langs te bltas tsa na dong pus nub tsam las mi 'dug pas thams cad smra mi shes pa'i ya mtshan du gyur/ rim gyis phebs pas bod 'brog gis dben pa'i thang chen po zhig tu/ ju thig gi thi gu ga shar brgyus pa'i rta pa bzhi tsam zhig /bag tsha ba dang ya nga ba med par 'ongs te/ mgron gnyer sogs ma brgyud par/ nged tsho'i dbon po mjal bar yong tshul sogs zhus song bas/ bka' bzhes gnang zhing / phyag mdzod pa sogs der 'khod phal che ba blo ma rangs pa zhig byung / tsha khad gcig phebs pa na/rta pa nyis brgya skor zhig byung ba'i dbus nas/ gtso bo bon zhwa gyon pa zhig gis rta las babs te/phyag btsal nas da ring nged kyis bsnyen bkur zhu zer/ chu tshod gnyis tsam thegs pa'i sar bza' btung gi bye brag mang po sta gon byas 'dug cing / bsnyen bkur bstab/ sgam gnyis sgo lcags bcug pa lde mig dang bcas pa'i steng du/ dar dkar po bzhag pa zhig phul te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rjesaganang zhus/ de ni rma chen spom ra dngos su bsu ba la 'ongs par 'dug kyang / 'ga' zhig la ci yin snyam pa'i the tshom dang / la lar rnam par rtog pa tsam yang ma byung /dmar nag ces pa'i chu klung chen po'i ngogs su/ dger rgyas dpon gyis 'ongs te bsnyen bkur zhus/ de nyid las bsgral te nyin lam kha shas na/ ag chen thang nas sog po mang po lhags te rnga mong la khal bkal ba'i bza' ba dang bca' ba'i bye brag du ma phul/ bzhugs skar gyi spyad pa phal cher 'go mi dang bcas sog po de rnams kyis drangs te ag chen thang brgyud phyir btang / dpon slob rnams bar lam bde ba zhig la rim gyi phebs pa na/ rma chen spom ra'i brgyud du grags pa'i dpon sangs rgyas skyabs g.yog (93na tshe sho thor dang gzhan yang skye bo'i tshogs du ma dag bcas te bsu ba la 'ongs/ dpon gyis ye shes kyi spyan dngos su mthong / gong dkar nas zha khas drung ngag dbang gragasapas/ kun bzang rtse nas rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi thugs sras la/ khyed phyags phyir bcar pas—136

rgyal dbang bsod nam rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)zhor la 'gro ba 'dug gsungs nas spom ra'i gsol chas/ dar chen sogs bskur ba 'bul ba la bla ri de'i rtser ched gnyer gyis phebs/ de nub bzhugs sgar du ser drag chen po bab par/ gzims gur cung zad tsam yang ma sbangs la/ gzhan rnams sbangs pa/ khyad par phyag mdzod kyi skor sbangs che ba byung bas/ ci yin zhug par/ kha sang sbom ra ngos kyi byung dus/ brnyas chos byas pa'i gdab lan yin par 'dug gsung / nyin lam kha shas bgrod pa'i sar/ nub cig /ljon pa'i rgyal po rta mgo can byung ste/ bsu ba la 'ongs pa yin zhes gus 'dud byas/ de nas nyin lam gnyis tsam 'das pa na/nub cig /sog po'i lha 'dre rnga mong rta byi la sogs kyi mgo brnyan can mang po zhig chos skyong beg tsesakhrid nas 'ongs pa dam la btags te chos byed rnams la bar chad mi byed pa'i bro bor/ sang nyin yong sha bu'i bar gu tha'i ji/ kha than bā thur/ mthu med kyi ma zin pak+ṣi rnams kyis gtsos pa'i rta pa brgyad brgya skor rgyal pos gdan 'dren gyi dang por mngags pa 'byor/ gos dar dang / rin po che'i rigasasogs zang zing gi 'byor pa dpag tu med pa phul/ 'on kyang rgyal rigs de dag rgyal po chen po'i lung gis 'ongs pa tsam ma gtogs/ mtha' 'khob kyi mi/ bla ma dang cho sol som nyi za ba zhig yod 'dug par/ de dag gi bsam pa mkhyen nas 'dul ba'i slad du/ phu chu zhig la sdigs mdzub mdzad pas cung zad gyen du bzlog pa'i rdzu phral (94na bstan pas/ mi ldog pa'i dad pa brtan po thob/ rim gyisa.a rig dkar po thang du bzhugs sgar bteg skabs/ rta stong phrag dang phyugs khri tsho nye ba'i 'bul ba phul/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang lha'i me tog gi char bab/ skye bo mtha' dag la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun te/ hang nge zhes pa'i yul grur/ phun tshogs rnam rgyal gling 'dus sdodang bcas pa gsar du bskrun pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ der dgon pa'i zhal bkod gnang ba'i skabs/ gdan 'dren gnyisapar 'ur bsdus rgyal rigs se chen hong tha'i ji dang / mthu med kyi rgyal rigs/ da yan no yon gyisagatsos pa'i rta pa stong phrag gsum tsam/ gser dngul gos dar/ rta sga srab kyis brgyan pa sogs phyag rten khyer nas gdan 'dren bskyar mar slebs/ tang tha'i jis/ thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi par mthong /—137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yoder tshogs pa rnams la 'dod chos stsal/nag pa zla ba'i nang du/ as dpal no yon gyi sder phebs/ mgon po zhal gyi mchod gtor rgyas par mdzad/ de la thugs rje chen po zhi khro sogs 'dod chos mang du gnang / khang pa ka drug ma tsam gyi rgya gur gyi nang du dar zab rin po che sogs kyis bkang ba dang rta sga srab dang bcas pa stong phrag tsam spu nag lug sogs bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / de dag gi do dam pa dung chen bcu phrag tsam phul/gdan 'dren gsum par nyi ma gsum gyi ring nyin re bzhin/ jo rog thu tha'i ji/ ching bā dur sogs rta pa sum brgya skor 'byor/ zang zing gi dngos po dpag tu med pa khyer 'ongs/ bzhugs sgar rim gyis bteg nas gdugs gsum bzhi tsam song ba na/ rgya nag nas zin gu shri rta pa brgya phrag dang bcas te bsu ba la 'ongs/ rgya lugs kyi rtsed sna dang 'bul ba sogs mang du byas/ der (94ba) sngar med pa'i mtsho chen po zhig gsar du chags/ sang nyin sngar rdzong sta gnang ba'i chos rje brtson 'grus bzang po dang / lo tsā ba gu shri pak+ṣi gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i rta pa lnga brgya skor/ rgyal po'i gam nas bsu ba la 'byor/ rim gyis phebs te hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ skya dar/ rgya gling / las tshan go rim sogs/ gong ma rgyal po'i bla ma la 'os pa'i che ba dang bcas te/ yon tan/ rigs/ stobs sogs kyis mngon par mtho ba'i drung 'khor rnams las tshan 'di'i rjes su 'di 'gro sogs/ yid la gang dran byas pa ma yin pa'i ya rabs khungs btsun gyi sgrigs bca' bstar dang ldan pa'i chibs rags/ glang po che sa la rab brtan 'chi med dbang po'i khrus kyi rdzing bur dal gyis rgyu ba ltar gshegs pa'i g.yas g.yon dang rgyab rnams su/ rgya dang sog po skya ser gyi rta pa stong phrag mang pos sa gzhi mtha' dag g.yogasapa ltar bskor te/ tsha khad gcig tsam phebs pa na/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong la brten nas rtsod dusakyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ al than rgyal po nyid/ mtha' 'khob mun pa'i gling dkar por byas pa'i brda chad du/ gos dkar po gsol/ 'khor khri phrag tsam de nyid kyi btsun mo'ang 'khor mang po dang bcas te 'ongs nas/ mchod yon mjal ba'i dga' ston gyi thog mar/ dngul srang lnga brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal/— 138

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)gser gyi phor pa yul dbus kyi bre tshad shong ba zhig rin po ches bkang pa/ gos yug dkar ser dmar ljang sngon po rnams nyi shu re/ rta dkar po rin po che'i sga srab kyis brgyan pa bcus thog drangs pa'i rta brgya/khrom zil gnon gyi gos chen sna lnga pa yug bcu/ dngul srang stong phrag gcig /ras dar sogs phul/de nas khrom 'bum phrag tsam 'tshogs pa'i dbus su mchod (95na tshe ngon nyi zla zung gcig phebs te/ hong tha'i ris gtam btang / gu shrī pak+ṣis lo tsā bsgyur te/ sngon nas cha dkar gnam gyi rigasalas chad pas stobs che/ rgya bod hor gsum drag pos dbang du bsdus/ sa skya pa dang mchod yon du 'brel te chos dang / slar zla mur rgyal po nas chos chad/ las su sdig dang thos su sha khrag kho na la longasaspyod pa'i mun nag khrag mtsho'i gling lta bur/ mchod yon nyi zla zung gcig gi bka' drin las/ dam pa chos kyi lam btod/ khrag mtsho 'o mar bsgyur ba 'di bka' drin che bas/ phyogs 'di na yod pa'i rgya bod hor sogs kun gyis kyang dge ba bcu'i khrims la gnas pa dgos/ nyi ma de ring nas khyad par sog po cha dkar la khrims su bcas pa ni/ sngar sog po shi ba'i rjes su/ drag zhan gyi rnam dbye rang gi chung ma bran g.yog rta nor sogs srog gcod pa yin na'ang / da phyin chad srog gcod kyi yul du gyur pa'i rta nor sogs kyi steng du ji tsam blos 'tsham par bcad nas/ dge 'dun dang bla ma la phul/ bsngo ba smon lam zhus/ gshin po'i rjes su dmigs pa'i srog gcod gtan ma byed/ gal te sngar bzhin mi bsad pa byung na khrims kyis lus srog 'bral ba yin/ rta phyugs bsad pa byung na khrims kyis nor thams cad 'phrog /bla ma dang dge 'dun gyi cha lugs can la brdung bcog sogs lag bzhag pa byung na/ lag 'jog mkhan gyi gzhi ma thams cad gtor/sngar ong bkod du grags pa'i gshin po thams cad kyi gzugs byas pa la ming btags pa'i grwa pa byung res kyi nya stong brgyad gsum la rta phyugs bsad pa'i khrag gis mchod pa dang / lo dus kyi mchod pa la drag gzhan gyi dbye ba mang nyung mtha' yas shig gsod pa rnams/ deng phyin chad nas bzung rten de (95ba) rnams me la bsregs nas/ lo zla'i dus kyi mchod par srog gcod pa gtan nas ma —139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonebyed/ gal te byas pa byung na khrims kyi chad pa rta nor gang bsad kyang / de'i brgya 'gyur 'phrog /ong bkod me la ma bsregs na khyim gtor/ yong dkod kyi tshab tu ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sku re 'dzin pa dang/ de la yang dkar gsum gyi mchod pa ma ga rta gos/ sha khrag gis mchod pa gtan nas ma byed/ gzhan yang thams cad kyis dge ba la 'bad pa la/ nya stong brgyad gsum la bsnyen gnasasrungs/ rgya bod hor kun la dgos med kyi 'phrog 'joms ma byed/ mdor na bod yul dbus gtsang du ji ltar bya ba ltar/ yul phyogs 'dir yang bya dgos zhes khrims mang du bsgrags so/ /thugs rje chen po'i bzlas lung gnang ba/ lo tsā bas sog po'i skad du bsgyur te kun gyis go bas/ mchog dman mtha' dag yi ge drug pa bzla ba la brtson par gyur/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang / me tog gi char mang du bab/ de nas mchode yon zhib par gsung gleng gnang ba'i skabs/ rgyal po yug cig dran med du song ba las gsos te/ sngon 'phags pa shing kun gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i tshe/ nga se chen rgyal po dang / khyed kyis gtsug lag khang la rab gnas mdzad/ da de nas de bar gang du 'khyams zhes sngon gnas rjes dran gyi zhu ba phul/ de'i bka' lan dang bcas te rigs lnga mtshon pa'i dar tshon sna lnga pa la sku srung rdo rje'i mdud pa'i rgyas spras pa dang / rin po che'i phor pa 'bru sna tshogs kyis bkang ba zhig rgyal po la gnang ngo / /e ma rtsod dus snyigs ma'i 'dam rdzab na/ /gdul bya'i re ba skong ba'i pad+ma dkar/ /phan bde'i sbrang rtsi ci yang 'dzag pa 'di/ /mtha' 'khor skye bo'i bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs/ /rgyal (96na)phran 'bum phrag dbus na bsod nams kyi/ /'khor lo mngon par 'phags pa'i gnam skos lha/ /tshangs pa mi yi gzugs can gang de yi/ /spyi bor zhabs sen man+ta ra bkod tshe/ /sdig spyong mun pa'i smag rum ma lus pa/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis gsal bar byas so zhes/ /sum rtsen grong na gnas pa 'i legs bris kun/ /dga' ba'i rtsed 'jo'i zlos gar bsgyur la brel/ /de nas/ mchod yon mjal ba'i sa der/ gtsug lag khang bzheng ba'i sa btul te/ rgya nag gi —140

rgyal dbang bsod nam rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)bzo bo mkhas pa mang po bkug nas bzhengs pa'i gtsang khang la dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / rje bla ma/ rje nyid kyi sku 'dra/ g.yas/ g.yon/ mdun gsum du 'jigs byed/ spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi lha khang re re la ka ba bcu drug gi khyon tsam yod pa de'i bar du/ sems dpa' dang gnod sbyin gnyis kyi lha khang / pe dkar lcog /mdun gyi g.yas g.yon du gzims chung 'od gsal pho brang dang bde chen pho brang / thams cad la rgya phibs sogs rgya nag gi lugs su bzhengs/ lcags ri rim pa gsum gyisabaskor ba ming theg chen chos 'khor gling du btags/ phyogs bzhir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg gnang bas so so'i bshad pa dang mthun pa'i ltas legs pa byung rab tu gnas pa rgya cher mdzad/dga' ston la khrom zil gnon gyi sku ber gsum gyis gtsos pa'i gos bzo ma brgya/ kha dog lnga pa'i gos yug brgya/ rin po che'i 'phreng bas gtsos pa'i 'phreng ba brgya/ 'bol rgan sogs pags rigs brgya/ gser gyi phor pa chen po mu tig gis gang ba dngul dam 'brug 'khor yod pa bdun tshar/ dngul srang stong las grub pa'i khog ma/ gser gyi zhwa dang na bza' cha tshang sogs rgyal po (96ba)rang nyid kyi chas/ dngul srang gsum re las grub pa'i ca sne dang sder ma bdun tshar rta rmig lug rmig gi dbyibs can srang lnga brgya/ ras zam stong phrag gcig /rta dkar po rin po che'i sga srab kyis spras pa gsum gyis gtsos pa'i rta brgya sogs 'bul
