pa grangs kyis mi lang ba phul/ de nas rgyal po'i sdig rta'i lha rten/ mgon po zhal gyi sbyin sreg gi sgo nas me la bsregs pas/ ye shes kyi me ljang khu me nang nasa'abar te nam mkha'i dbyings su 'thon pa yun ring du gnas/ chos 'phrul mtha' yas byung bas kun ngo mtshar du gyur/de nas bzung sog po thams cad kyi yong bkod me la bsregs/ de skabs stong 'khor chos rje yon to rgya mtsho bsnyen rdzogs dang 'dod chos zhu bar 'byor ba ltar re ba yongs su bskang / rgyal po chen po cung zhig bro 'tshal ba la/ srid gsum bdag mo'i mdos kyi cho ga gnang bas mi mthun pa'i g.yul las rgyas/ nub cig mnal lam du tshe dpag med dngos su byon te/ rgyal po'i spyi gtsug tu —141

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skabum pa bzhag nas dbang bskur ba gyur pas re zhig sku tshe la bar chad mi 'ong ba'i lung bstan mdzad/de nas sa'i tshangs pa de nyid kyis mi rigs mi gcig pa du ma'i dbus su las ka phul ba ni/ gser las grub pa'i dbu rgyan/ bum pa/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ bum pa sogs dbang chas kyi rigs/ gser srang brgya las grub pa'i tham ga 'brug sder mo lngas mtshan pa/ kha ris la/ rdo rje 'chang ta la'i bla ma'i tham ka rgyal zhes hor yig gsar du yod pa/ de'i shubs dngul las byas pa/ mu tig gi snam sbyar/bla bre/ sku ber tā hung gsar gyi 'brug sder mo lnga yod pa'i nang 'bol rgan gyi pags pas byas pa/ tā hung gser ma'i bar 'dam nang byi ba dkar po'i pags pas (97na)byas pa/ de'i cha 'grig gi khri khebs stan 'bol/ snye 'bol/ bya tshe ring sbu btags kyi bzhugs stan/ ding phon tshon tshogs kyi bla bre rgyab yol khri khebs/ pang khebs/ chibs pa dkar po rin po che'i sga srab kyis brgyan pa lnga/ gzhan yang rta bcu/ dngul gyi spyad pa stong phrag tsam/ gzhan yang gos dar/ ras zam la sogs kyi mi khur nyi shu lhag pa dag bcas/ ta la'i bla ma badz+ra dha ra zhes khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi las ka phul/ rgyal po la'ang chos kyi rgyal po lha'i tshangs pa chen po zhes mtshan gnang ngo / /rab mtho kun gsal ngos yangs nas/ /'jig rten byed po gser mngal gyis/ /nor 'dzin bdag por spyi bo nas/ /dbang bskur sa yi tshangs pa des/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i/ /lung dang las ka 'phul ba'i tshe/ cher rlom dregs ldan kun gyi gtsug /mngon par mtho ba'i cod paṇa grub/ /rgyal pos theg chen chos 'khor gyi bzhugs khri'i steng du gdan drangs te/ sngon mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su/ bod kyi mi la rab byung btub mi btub nyams sad pa'i phyir du/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba ltar/ rgyal rigs gsum gyis thog drangs pa'i btsun pa brgya phrag phul ba rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa la bkod/ gzhan yang de'i 'phros las 'bul ba'i rnam grangs/ gser srang brgya/dngul srang stong phrag gsum/ rta khrab/ gos dar/ zam ras sogs dang / rgyal po nyid kyi sku chas cha tshang ba phul/ mchod yon gnyis nas/ a seng bla ma sogs 'grul pa gtos che ba rdzong sta gnang ste/— /42

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ rton)jo shāg gi drung du dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod rdzas dang / ser 'bras dge gsum gyis thog drangs pa'i dgon sde rnams su mang 'gyed/ rtse/ gong dkar/ rgya ri ba/ dga' ldan pa sogs la legs skyes/mdor (97bsko mchog dman kun la gang 'tshams kyi 'dod rgu char du bsnyil/chos 'khor gling gi gzims chung 'od gsal pho brang du bdun phrag gsum bzhi tsam sku mtshams gnang bas/ phur mgon/ beng / dpal lha/ rdo rje legs pa rnams zhal gzigs/ rgyal po pe dkar gyi gsol mchod gnang / yul de'i lha srin rnams kyis dngos su 'ongs nas chos nyan/ de skabs rgya hor gyi mi dbon mang pos gsol ba btab pa ltar/ dgun gyi ring bzhugs sgar bteg /zang zing gi bsnyen bkur bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhes shing rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad/ 'ur bsdus kyi rgyal bu yin dus spyan drangs / gtsug lag khang gsar du bzhengs pa la/ phun tshogs g.yin phan sdo zhes ming du btags/ drag po'i sbyin sreg mdzad pas rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gzigs te thugs ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i snang ba byung rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul mtha' dag ngang gis zhi/ sog ban brgya zin tsam dang / gser dngul/ rta khrab/ gos dar/ phyugs rnga mong sogs phul/ rgya nas rgyal po hong khyi thul gyis pho nya btang nas/ rin po che pad+ma ra ga ispro ni la/ margad/ be+eḍūrla rnams bre gang tsam/ gser srang stong phrag gcig /dngul dang ma na ho'i spyad pa mang po/ /sku ber/ rten khebs/ gos chen 'brug ster lnga yod pa mang po/ thags grub kyi rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan tshe dpag med kyi sku/ gser las grub pa'i phyag dpe/ dril bu/ ḍā ma sa sku 'dra/ 'phreng ba/ rol cha sogs yid 'phrog pa'i spyad pa dpag tu med phul/ gan cu du thang zhes khri skor bcu gsum gyi sa la dbang sgyur ba'i mi dpon chen po zhig gis gdan drangs/ rol cha dang mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa'i bsu ba dang bcas te phebs/ lam gyi (98na)rigs so sor mi dpon rnams kyis rta rtsed sogs dang / bza' btung gi bye brag mtha' yas pa phul/ rje sa paṇa gyis btab pa'i sprul pa'i sde dang / ma rta si zhabs kyis bcags/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rgyal bu blo gros — 143

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6ska'aphel gyis ye shes kyi ral gyis klu bdud btul pa'i gnas der ngos 'dzin mdzad/ thang de'i dkyil du pha bong sho 'dra ba ka bzhi tsam gyi 'gram du rlung chen po zhig gi dkyil nas drang srong chos gos sngon po rgyan pa zhig 'ongs te gser phor pa gang phul ba kun gyis mthong / tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin zhig yin zhes bka' phebs/ mkhar der phebs pa la sa'i le bar bcu yod pas las/ le bar bdun tsam du phebs pa na/ rgyal po'i lung gis brdzangs pa'i gdan 'dren pa dmag khri phrag bcu gsum tsam 'byor te/ pho brang skyid bde sbug tu ma phebs kyi bar/ go mtshon ru dar rta chos sogs lha'i dmag lta bu zam ma chad pa sbrengs chags su 'ongs pas bsu ba dang bcas te pho brang du phebs nyin mi dpon gyi g.yog rnams kyis chibs pa seng ger mthong / spos phul ba'i dud pa la mun pa sel ba'i nyi zla shar/ lha'i bu zhes pa rgya yig la gsal bar byung / mi dpon kyis skye ba gsum tsam gsal bar dran/ snying bo don gsum gyi zab chos gnang / khrom la bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs lo tsā bas rgya nag yu gur sog po rnams so so'i skad du bsgyur/ du thang mnga' 'og gi btson rnams bton te bde ba la bkod/btsun gsar brgya tsam rab tu byung / mi dpon gyis spos spar te dmod bor bas/ rje 'di nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i phrin las pa yin zhes/ spos thal la rgya nag gi yi ge'i gzugs su byung bas dad pa lhag par thob/ mahā tsi na'i rgyal khams thams cad la snyan pa'i (98ba)grags pa phyogs bcur bsgrags/sngon nas cha dkar gyi rgyal brgyud kyis gtsos pa'i dpung khri phrag tsam zhig rgya nag gi lcags ri phyi ma'i nang du shor ba las/ mi mthams cad 'jigs shing skrag pa zhig 'dug pa nyid kyis bkas bcad/ rgya nag gi rgyu dngos kyis tshim par byas te kho rang tsho'i yul du brdzangs pa las/ rgya nag kun kyang 'jigs pa las bskyabs/ slar rim gyis rgya nag rgya'i rtsi mi bzhi bcus gnya' ba nas bteg pa'i khri la gdan drangs/ theg chen chos 'khor gling du phebs/ myos ldan zhes pa sa yos kyi lo gsar dang / srid gsum bdag mo'i mchod gtor rgyas par mdzad/ gtor ma las bdud rtsi'i rgyun mang du bab pa rgya bod hor gsum du mas btung yang zad mi shes pa lta bur 'phel/ skya ser gyi khrom chen po 'tshogs/ cho 'phrul —144

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)gyi mchod pa gnang / rgya nag nas nying shā rgyal bus/ rin po che dang rol cha/ ding phon gyi rigs/ pho brang gi spyad pa ya mtshan can mang du 'bul mi mngags/ sbub 'chol rngam pa sgra sgrog tu grags pa'i 'dzam bu gling na dkon pa de yang phyag tu 'byor/ lo dus kyi smon lam chen mo grol nas gzims chung 'od gsal pho brang du sku mtshams zhig mdzad pas/ yi dam chos skyong du ma'i zhal gzigs/ zhal gyi tshe sgrub zla ba'i chu rgyun dang / bram gzugs kyi gtor 'bul bsdus pa dang rang bstod rnam dpyod ma thugs rtsom gnang / sag zla ba'i nang du rgyal po dpon g.yog las ldan 'ga' zhig la/ bcom ldan 'dasadapal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur ba'i bum dbang tsam zhig gnang rtsis la mnal lam du rgyal po byung nas nged 'khor bcas las dag yin pas rdzogs par gnang dgos zhus pa ltar/ dbang phyi ma (99na sgoms kyang stsal/ nad yams mang po byung ba la 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg blug pas rgyun chad/ 'ur sdud ju nang rgyal po longs spyod mtha' yas pa dang bcas nas mjal bar 'ongs/ o rod dang 'byug pa'i sdig rgyun yod pa rnams zhi bar mdzad/ dbusanas a seng bla ma can yang sku zhabs su 'byor/ dbus gtsang gi lha sde mi sde tshang ma nas/ myur du phebasadagos pa'i zhu yig nan cher phul/ li thang 'debs pa'i dgongs pa gtad pa'i skyid shod nas bzo bo rdzong dgos tshul gnang 'dug pa ltar/ pā ṇa shing sogs bal po bzhi tsam 'byor/ sde pa bkra shis rab brtan pas zhu yig dad pa'i pho nya zhes snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa de dang / rin po che bod mkhar pa gnyis kyis myur du phebs dgos pa'i zhu yig nan chen po dang / rgyal po la yang dgongasapar gang gtad las spros pa'i nan chags mi 'gab tshul sogs zhu yig rgyas par 'dug pa kho bos kyang mthong / de nas rgyal po chen pos sog yul du phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba phul bas/ li thang du dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs dgos pa yod pas/ de grub bstun/ dbus gtsang gi phyogs su/ ldog tu mi btub pa'i bya ba ma byung na/ sog yul du phebs pa'i zhal bzhes gnang bas/ rgyal pos rje nyid kyi bka' shog dang phyag mdzod kyis gtsos pa'i drung 'khor drag rim gyi rtsi kha blangs/ rgyal po dpon g.yog phal cher —145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (te/rang yul du log cing / mchod yon bka' gros thog nas/ rgya bod kyi gser zam spel ba sogs la mtsho khar dpon po 'kho lo che ching bā thur 'khor bcas bzhag /re zhig sku tshab la sog yul du stong 'khor chos rje yon tan rgya mtsho rdzong sta mdzad/ hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du rgya nag gong ma wan yi (99ba)rgyal pos rgyal khams thams cad kyi skyabs gnas gyog ching gri'i mtshan dang / tham kha lung las zhwa las gos/ 'ja' sa sogs kyi sngon du rgyal po'i che ba'i rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas/ rgya nag gi mi dpon gsum gyis gtsos pa 'byor/ lu hang gser ma'i na bza' cha tshang / tā hung gser ma'i na bza' cha tshang / ha gser ma'i na bzang cha tshang / gser dngul gos dar sogs pho brang gi spyad pa mang du phul/nged rang gi 'bangs su gyur pa'i sog po tsho chen bzhi bcu dang / gan cu du thang gi mi dpon sogs kyi re ba yongs su bskang ba legs shing / pho brang chen por yang rim gyis gdan 'dren zhes pa sogs kyi bka' shog gnang / phyag mdzod pa la gu shi'i las ga dang / tham ga gnang / skabs de dag tu rgya nag gi mi dpon du mas 'bul ba dang / bod sog rnams kyis bsnyen bkur ba ni grangs las 'das shing /kun la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon yang dag par bskrun/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs stong phrag brgal ba bsgrubs/ blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ dngul srang stong phrag gsum tsam gyi sgo nas pho brang gong ri dkar por lha gzigs mi'i dbang po la rta 'bul gyi rgyun 'dzugs pa gnang / sgar chen mdo khams gyi cha li thang gi phyogs su bteg /lam du as dpal no yon gyisabasnyen bkur/ phun tshogs rnam rgyal gling zhes pa'i 'dus sde'i slob dpon du chos rje brtson 'grus bzang po bskos/de nas gling yul tu brag ri zhig gi logs nas dpal ldan lha mo gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku rang byon kun la gsal bar bstan/ 'phrin las dang snyan grags ches pos rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa/ ka thog pa dpon slob kyi yid la gar lugs kyi bla ma sgar pa/(103na)rnams dang 'dra ba'i 'jig rten gyi stobs che ba ma gtogs/ nus mthu rang med yod snyam ste/ btsan rgod — 146

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ (nyana'abar ba spun bdun rbad de cho 'phrul chen po btang bas/ 'bum nag thang du phebs thog /btsan rgod kyi cho 'phrul byung ba/ mgon po zhal gyi sgo nas phyir slog pas/ ka thog pa rnams yid ches te/ mjal bar mang po zhig 'ongs/ rim gyi phebs/ yi dam gyi lha du ma'i sgo nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/rnam gnon zhes pa lcags 'brug gi lo gsar rgyas par gnang / dgon pa 'ding ba'i 'u lag dang bzo bo mtha' dag 'jang sa tham rgyal pos bsgrubs te/ hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nas gtsug lag khang ka ba bco brgyad/ 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu gya gnyis/ mgon khang ka ba bzhi/ gzims khang ka ba brgyad/ gzims chung yang dben ka ba drug /rgyal po lcog ka ba drug gis grwa spyil sogs 'gyangs med du zin pa dang lhan cig par/ gser zangs las grub pa'i byang chub chen po thub chen khams gsum zil gnon rgyab mtho re bzhi pa bzhengs/ mgon khang sogs la rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad/rbad 'dre'i cho 'phrul che bar byung bas/ kun bzang rtse nas dang / bla ma rin cen seng ge gnyis kyis phyag g.yog mdzad de gshin rje'i sgrub pa gnang bas/ nyin gcig mchod dpon gyis gtor ma gso bar phyin pa na/ ral pa yod pa'i mi mgo khrag rdzar re ba gsum tsam zhig them pa'i nang du 'dug pa mthong / de'i skabs 'bri gung nas rgyal sras lha rje'i rnam sprul zhabs drung chos rgyal phun tshogs kyis/zhwa lha khang du sngags pa rnams bsdus te drag po'i sbyin sreg sdugs pa'i sgang la spo bo (100ba〉ban grong pa la steng grib phog ste rang gshed phab pa'i rtags chen po byung / bla ma rin cen la nged rang gnyis bam ro'i sgrub pa zhig byed dgos pa 'dug kyang / nged brel ba'i stabs kyis re zhig mi thub pa 'dug gsungs/ sku mtshams kyi skabs de dag tu/ 'dod khams bdag mo sogs lha mang du zhal gzigs/khyad par pur tras 'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ dgon pa'i ming thub bstan byams chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes btags/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya phrag brgal ba bsgrubs/ sa tham rgyal pos kwa bha shi dang bya kā gnyis mngags te phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba phul yang /de res go bo dban pos gdan 'dren dod drag pa la brten/ li thang gi dgon pa'i mjug skyong rnams — /47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānesku skye rin bo che bsod nams ye shes dbang po la mdzad du bcug nas/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du chibs kha sgyur te/ dmar khams kyi yul du phebs/ phyogs der rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs dam pa'i chos rgya chen pos tshim par mdzad/ yul lugs dang bstun pa'i 'bul nor mang du phul/ khyu mchog ces pa lcags sprul gyi lo gsar grub nas/ chab mdo ba rnams kyis gdan drangs pa'i phebs lam du/rgya mo bza'i phyag bzo las grub pa'i rnam snang gi sku mjal bas/ de rnam snang dngos su gyur pa'i dbu gtsug nas 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro ba dang / thugs ka nas mgon po gur zhi ba'i mas can gsal bar gzigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyis zhabs bskor stong mdzad/ bon dgon zhig gi gak+ṣ-i gas su bzhugs sgar babasapa'i nub/ bon pos thog ser sbyar te btang bas/ sku (101na skos su zhugs mgul phur gdengs te khro bo'i stangs stabs kyis 'chams dang bcas te/ thog ser bon dgon rang gi steng du bsgyur bas/skrag ste sang bshags pa 'bul bar 'ongs / rje drung rin po che lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis thog drangs pa'i bla ma gnas chen sogs rta pa nyis brgya tsam gyi bsu ba dang / dge 'dun stong phrag bzhir nye ba'i ser sbrengs dang bcas/ chab mdo byams pa gling du phebs yul lugs dang bstun pa'i 'bul ba mang du phul/ mi ring bar byang sems chos rje'i khri thog tu dar gdugs 'dzin pa dang spos 'dzin pa'i dge slong brgya phrag gnyis kyis mdun bdar te spyan drangs/ dge 'dun stong phrag gsum lhag tsam gyis gtsos pa'i khrom khri phrag nye ba la dam pa'i chos kyi char phab/ ja spag rtse stong phrag brgal ba/rta khrab gos dar dngul sogs mang du phul/ tshogs pa la bka' gdams glegs bam dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho gsungs/ rje drung rin po che dge 'dun bkra shis kyi sprul pa'i sku dge 'dun bstan pa rgya mtsho mjal bar byon te zhabs phyir bzhugs/ sku mdun chos mdzad pa sogs dbus gtsang nas grwa rigs sbyin bdag mang pos/ zhabs drung sbu lung pas drag las mang po mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ sku rim bsrung 'khor sogs kyi mnyel so zhus par brten/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i 'khrul 'khor gnang bas/ 'bri khung du nang zhig byung / ba so sprul sku lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bskul — 148

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)nas/ mtshar lugs kyi zhal bzhi pa'i gsang 'khrid kyi yi ge thugs rtsom mdzad/ g.yin yang gnas der lha tshogs dpag (101btu med pa zhal gzigs/ de nas ldan chos 'khor gling du chos rje lung rig pa dpon slob kyis gdan drangs te phebs/ snying po don gsum gyi 'khrid yig thugs rtsom gnang /al than rgyal po 'jig rten pha rol tu gshegs pa mngon par mkhyen pas gzigs te/ ri rab kyi rtser bde mchog gi dkyil ga bor du bsto / lha ngo bstan cing dbang bskur nas rjes su bzung / mgon po gur gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa zhig thugs rtsom mdzad pas chos skyong dngos su zhal gzigs/sna tshogs zhes pa chu rta'i lo gsar grub rjes/ tshogs pa la byang chub lam rim/ 'khrungs rabs so bzhi ba/ me tri brgya rtsa sogs gnang / chos skyong mang po'i rten gtor btsugs pas las gshin zhal gzigs/ sku mtshams yun ring du mdzad de/ gu ru drag po dang / ye shes zhung khra'i sgo nas klu bdud gdug pa can sogs lha srin mang po dam la btags/ dam la mi gnas pa rnams gzhan du bskrad/phug sgo chung ngu zhig la phar gshegs tshur gshegs mdzad pa dang / brag la zhabs rjes 'jog pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma mang du bstan/ sngon 'brom chos kyi rgyal pos chos sku snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku rang byung du gzigs pa'i pha bong chen po zhig /phyis 'gyur nas rang byon des 'og tu tshud pa la/yul pa'i mi rnams kyis pha bong de ka la chos sku zhes ming btags nas skor ba byed cing yod 'dug pa la/ sku de sa 'og tu tshud ces gsungs nas mi mang po bsgyur du bcug nas ma rnga zhe sum du bstan/ rgyal ba btsong kha ba sogs lha dang bla ma zhi khro rab 'byams grangs med pa'i zhal gzigs/ slong thang sgron ma'i gtsug lag khang mjal bar (102na)phebs/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung 'dul gyi sgrub thabs mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na 'e ti'i gdung mjal/ dran thang nang sos gtsos pa'i sde dgon rnams kyis 'bul ba dang zhabs tog byas/ sngar ldan chos 'khor gling du phebs thog /al than rgyal po'i zhal chems bzhin/rgyal brgyud gcig gis gtsos pa'i gdan 'dren pa mngags pa 'byor te mtsho khar phebs/ rgyal po al than dmigs yul du gtso bor bgyis pa'i smon lam byams pa'i 'dzum zhal mngon du bgyid pa'i — 149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)pho nya zhes bya ba thugs rtsom gnang / stag lung chos rje kun dga' bkra shis sgar bskor la byon par/'phrin las bzhed pa bzhin ma byung bar yar 'phral 'byon yang ma bde zhing / bzhugs pa la yang 'o brgyal bar yod skabs rje nyid kyis/ stag lung pa gdung rus khungs btsun pa'i bsngags brjod kyi sgo nas 'phrin las kyi sgo phye bas khong dpon slob ngal gso'i bde bar thob/ a sa dpal no yon bro 'tshal ba las grol bar mdzad/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i grang ba'i skabs der/ rje nyid kyi zhal gyi rlang pa las me tog pad+ma dkar po zhig byung ba'i steng du a yig 'dug pa as dpal no yon gyis gsal bar mthong / spos kyi dud pa nam mkha' la gdugs ltar phub pas ya mtshan pa byung /nyi ma zhes pa chu lug gi 31 gsar grub nas/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa sku bltams pa'i gnas sku 'bum du phebs/ der bshad grwa gsar du 'dzugs pa dang / bstan pa rgyas pa'i chos srung rnams la gnyer gtad mdzad/ bya khyung brag tu phebs/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang / chos mang du gnang / rim gyis ri bo dan tig tu phebs/ sku mtshams yun ring (102ba)du gnang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs zhal gzigs/ bde mchog lha lnga'i chos tshan 'ga' zhig thugs rtsom gnang / ang tig gi gnas sgo gsar du phye ba'i ngos der sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs rang byon mang du byung / de'i brag dngos nas chos gter dang / 'chi med tshe'i bum pa'i gter yod pa bzhes rtsis la/ 'ga' zhig gis brag de g.yang che bas mi 'gab tshul zhus pas/ sku tshe ring pa'i 'phen pa'ang med 'dug pa'i stabs kyis btang snyoms su bzhag /tshe chu de bzhes thub na sku tshe mthar phyin zhig 'ong tshod du 'dug /de nas byams chen chos rje'i bzhugs gnas mdzo mo mkhar du phebs/ dbang chos rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du gnang / nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing sprel gyi lo gsar rgyas par mdzad/ rgya kong rtse 'phrul gyis brag ri la brkos pa'i byams pa'i sku 'bum ther bzhugs pa de mjal nas/ ma sgal gyi sa'i cha bing ler sgar dmangs bzhag /dpon slob nyung bsdus shig sgal dgon par zhag gnyis tsam bzhugs ngos/ chu bo — 150

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)chen po la gru gzings btang ste/ 'phags pa shing kun tu phebs/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dras gsung byon/ sku de'i phyag mdzub chag pa/ gzhan gyis thabs gang gis kyang ma 'byar ba la/ rje 'dis tshegs chung ngus 'byar bar mdzad/ phyogs de'i skye bo mtha' dag thar lam la bkod/ thugs rje chen po'i sku rang byon bzhugs pa'i shar yul spen lhas nags tshal du sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu la las byang le'u brgyad pa'i sgo nas mchod pa mdzad pas slob dpon chen po la mtshan brgyad kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs/ slar tsong (103na khi'i yul du phebs/ der rgya hor gyi bar du 'brug pa chen po yod pa rnams zlums par mdzad de kun kyang bde ba la bkod/ rim gyis pag ras kyi sa'i char gdul bya rnams kyi re 'dod yongs su bskang / sems nyid du zhag kha yar bzhugs nas/ da lta'i dgon pa dga' ldan dar rgyas gling lung bstan/ de nas mtsho khar phebs/ dpon po 'kho lo ches bsnyen bkur rgya cher zhus/ 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ lugs gnyis kyi bgyi ba'i bslab ston lhug par stsal/sgar chen gdugs mang po'i bar du bteg pa na/ chu med pa'i mya ngam gyi thang zhig la 'di nas chu 'ong zhes bkas gnang ste brus pas re zhig ma byung bar kun som nying gyur skabs/ rdo mis theg tshod tsam zhig dong du brdeg bcug pa dang mnyam du chu thag shas gsum tsam gyis bar du rdol ba'i ngo mtshar bstan/ da yan no yon gyis gtsos pa'i rta pa stong phrag tsam gyis mdun bsus te/ 'ur sdus kyi dpon po se chen hong tha'i ji'i sde thog tu phebs/ dbang rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos du ma stsal/ gser dngul gos dar rta phyugs sogs 'bul ba khri phrag brgal ba phul/sa skyong zhes pa shing bya'i lo gsar dang / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rgyas pa mdzad/ rab tu byung ba stong phrag nye ba bsgrubs/ gtsug lag khang dang 'dus pa' sde gsar du bskrun pa la me tog gtor/ da yan no yon de sdig la rngams shing mi bsrun pa srin po'i rigs can lta bu zhig yin 'dug kyang / yan lag brgyad pa'i bslab pa la bkod de sdig pa shin tu 'dzem par gyur/ de nas se chen ta'i ching gi sde thog tu bzhugs sgar phebs/ tha'i ji la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor (103ba)du bcug ste dbang —131

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loyobaskur/ gtsug lag khang dang 'dus sdebazhengs pa la rab tu gnas pa dang / gshin rje gshed kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg gis nag phyogs rnams tshar bcad/ dgon pa de la phun tsho gos dar rgyas gling du btags/than pa shin tu che ba la char chen po bab ste mi phyugs mtha' dag bde ba la bkod/ sog po tsho chen bzhi bcu'i gur dkar po'i bdag po ju nang rgyal pos bsu ba dang bcas te gdan drangs/ rin po che'i phor pa/ gos yug brgya/ dngul srang stong sogs 'bul ba khri phrag phul/ rgyal po 'khor bcas bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur/ gtsug lag khang dang 'dus sde bzhedas pa la rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad/ 'di dag gi skabs snga phyi rnams su phyag mdud phyag dbang sogs grangs mang bas phyag brdol ba byung yang 'gro don la dgongs te dkris ma mdzad nas mtshams 'jog pa ma gnang / brgya bzhi'i cho ga rgyas pa bklags pas don grub dang /gsol 'debs dngos grub 'byung gnas thugs rtsom gnang / rgyal pos rang gi bu la rgyal srid gtad de/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs mtha' dag spangs te rab tu byung / rim gyis jo 'khor no yon gyis gdan drangs/ tha'i ji 'bor bcas 'chi med rnga sgra'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur/ hor zla bcu pa'i nyer lnga la rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po mchod pa'i dus ston rgyas par gnang bas 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang me tog gi char bab/ mtshan mo gling me spar ba'i 'od kyis nyin mo'i snang ba ltar gsal bas/phyogs der rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel 'grig /rje 'bangs mtha' dag dge ba'i lam la bkod/mi zad (104na)pa zhes pa mi khyi'i lo gsar dang / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rgyas par mdzad do/ /rab 'byams rgyal kun 'phrin las gcig bsdus pas/ /rang dgar mkhyen brtse nus pa zla bzhe na gyis/ /rab yangs mtha' 'khob rmodzas pa'i mun pa kun/ /rab tu gsal te rdzogs ldan lta bu bkod/ /bkod legs dregs ldan 'joms pa'i mnga' thang dang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i chos tshulu kun/ /kun nas phan tshun 'gran pa'i ngo mtshar dpal/ dpal ldan 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs spel/— 152

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)de nas al than rgyal po'i sras du ring rgyal pos gdan 'dren gyi pho nya mngags pa ltar/ chib kha sgyur te dmar chu'i 'gram du phebs pa na/ chu ha cang che zhing gting zab pas/ sgar dmangs rnams phebs mi thub pa 'dra zhes gleng skabs/ de nub 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la gnyer gtad gnang bas/ mtshan phyed nas thams cad g.yo ba tsam gyi rlung nag chen po byung / nams lang tsa na g.yas g.yon thams cad chu sngo ting nge ba la dkyil du dar lam skya sha re chags 'dug pa la/ sgar pa rnams 'grims/ ding sang yang dus tshod de khar chags yong ba'i bsod nams dar lam du ming thogs/ rim gyis mkhar sngon po zhes bod 'brog gi sde mtha' klas pa yod pa'i lha'i grong khyer sa la 'phos pa lta bu der/ ngo mtshar ba'i bsu ba dang bcas te phebs/ al than rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i dngul gyi shākya mu ne'i sku gzugs la gzungs bzhugs dang rab gnas rgyas par mdzad/ rgyal pos gser gyi maṇ+ḍal/ dngul gyi rgya dam/gos yug brgya/ rol mo'i rigs/ rta dre'u dar ras sogs 'bul ba khri phrag bteg / rje 'bangs kha shas la kyai rdo rje dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang (104ba)bskur/ bde mchog bong bu'i zhal can dngos su zhal gzigs/ rgyal pos bskul te/ dril bu lha lnga'i dbang chog thugs rtsom mdzad/ al than rgyal po'i gdung zhugs 'phul bas nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od kyi dra bas khengs shing me tog gi char bab/ hūṃ dang myi sogs yi ge dang / ring bsrel mtha' yas pa byung / phyi rten du dngul srang stong lasagrub pa'i mchod rten bzhengs pa la rab gnas mdzad/ cha dkar nas na mo ta'i hong tha'i ji mjal ba la 'ongs te/ zang zing gi 'bul ba khri phrag phul/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshem par mdzad/ rgya nag gi bzo bo mkhas pa la 'dra 'bag dang gsob bzo bcug nas/ bar dor dge sdig shan 'byed kyi rnam pa mang po bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya 'ga' zhig dge ba la bkod/ cung zad snyung ba'i tshul bstan pa la/ sku 'khor rnams kyis re zhig sku mtshams gnang bar zhus pas/ gzhan phan rgya che ba 'di'i skabs su mtshams kyis dgos pa med/ kho bo 'gro don la mi skyo zhes bka' stsal pa rgyal sras chen po'i rnam thar du mchis/—153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)thams cad 'dul zhes pa me phag gi lo gsar gyi dga' ston dang / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa gnang /mthu med kyi g.yas ru'i phyogs su phebs/ gtsug lag khang la rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ du ring rgyal po gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi mgon du phebs/ dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos/ khar kha rdo rje rgyal po mjal bar 'ongs pa la 'dod pa'i re ba yongs su bskang / 'bol rgan gyi pags pa'i khur sogs/ nor sna rngams chen mang du phul/ de skabs rin po che bod mkhar ba'i mtshan ltas la/ sku tshe la bar chad chen po yod pa'i rtags byung bas/ rin po che rang gis zhal gyi dmar chen gtor (105na)bzlog dang / dga' ldan pho brang du bsnyel so btang ba'i/ sku mdun chos mdzad pas 'bum brgya btsugs/u reng khan gyi jo 'khor no yon gyis pho nya mngags pa ltar/ bla mchod btang ste brgyud pa'i sgo nas btul/ khar chin gyi rgyal phran zhig rab tu byung bar 'ongs des dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa la phyag nas gtor/ mchod rten dkar po zhes pa'i byin rlabs can bzhugs pa'i yul gyi rgyal po al than mched kyis spyan drangs gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la rab gnas mdzad/ nyin gcig nags 'thor re ba yod pa'i ri zhig la phebs pas/ dge slong na bza' hrul le ba bzhes pa zhig dang mnyam phyag mdzad/ gsung gleng mang du gnang ste/ de nags gseb la yud kyis bzhud song bas/ sku 'khor rnamasakyis dri ba zhus par/ rgyal lha thog steng nas grub chen thar pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kho bo 'gro khar thug pa la byon par 'dug /da nang gang nas phebs zhus pas/ gtor ma grol nas 'ong gsung byung / khong yang yun ring bzhugs mdog ma kha gsungs/ cung zhig snyung ba'i tshul mdzad par/ mchog dman kun gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ sku mtshams gnang ba'i skabs/ rgyal ba btsong kha pas btang ba'i pho nya yin zer ba zhig 'ongs te/ yi ge phyag tu phul ba gzigs pa na/ re zhig dga' ldan du shog zer ba 'dug gsungs te/ mgon po snying zhugs kyi 'pho ba'i thugs dam rgyun du mdzad/ sku bsnyun pa las dwangs pa dang / dbus gtsang gi gdan 'dren pa rnams kyis/ yar phebs dgos pa'i zhu 'bul dang /khar chin gyi rgyal pos pho nya mngags te/ mtha' 'khob kyi sa phal cher na 'khod pa'i gdul bya'i re ba —134

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)skong bar mdzad zin pas/ nged kyi yul du phebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan (105bskon du phul bas/ kun mkhyen zas gtsang gi sras po gyad kyi yul sa can du gshegs pa ltar/ khar chin gyi gser yig par phebs pa'i bka' lan gnang ste/ bzhugs sgar rim gyis bteg nas/ hor rgyal po'i dus kyi pho brang shang to zhes pa'i shul gyis sar phyags phebs/ rgyal blon 'ga' zhig la bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i dbang dang / skye bo phal cher yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims sogs dge ba la bkod/ rgyal po'i 'bul chen gyi dus/ dngul las grub pa'i khang pa ka gnyis ma tsam zhig tu bzhugs gdan bkod pas/ re zhig sngas pa tsam yin kyang / 'dod pa dang bstun pas chog gsungs te/ dngul gdung gi rten 'brel du dgongs/ gser dngul gos dar rta khrab sogs 'bul ba khri phrag brgal ba phul/ der dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs 'dug pa la rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad/kun 'dzin zhes pa sa byi'i lo gsar dang / smon lam rlabs po che gnang / zla ba dang po'i mjug nas cung zad bro 'tshal ba'i rnam pa bstan/ rgya nag gong ma rgyal pos pho brang du phebs dgos pa'i gdan 'dren par/ mi brgyad kyis gnya' ba nas bteg pa'i gser yig pa mngags kwa ding ta'i gu shrī'i mtshan dang / las ka che ba 'di res byung / rten 'brel du dgongs nas pho brang du phebs pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ nag pa zla ba nas snyan babs lci ba'i tshul bstan te/ gsung gi mtha' ma phyag bris su stsal ba 'di ltar/gnas chu lha'i phyogs kyi skyed tshal na/ /dpal bshad pa'i ming can bde ba'i mchor/ /thabs shes rab kyi khu ba ster mkhas pa/ /gnas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs kyi/ /dri zas su za ba'i dga' ba'i tshal/ /gzhi de na bde stong longs spyod pa'i/ /lha su ra (106na kho sti'i dngos grub kyi/ /rgyan rin chen 'phreng ba spud byed cing / gdangs snyan pa'i lhung lhung sil sgra can/ /sgra 'dzin pa'i bu gar grag 'osapa/ /yid gnyis 'dzin gyi 'khri ba gcod pa'i dpal/ /yul gang de blo yi ra bar 'khod/ /de 'dusa'abral med pa'i dpal du bzang / /mi gnam bskos kyi dga' ba skyed byed rgyal/ /mtshan kun tu rgyal — 155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneba'i yon tan de/ dpal yar gyi ngo bzhin gong du 'phel/ /kye gzhan phan du rlom pa'i rnam g.yeng gis/ /nyin bzhin du 'khor kyang ngal ma tshor/ /mtshan dge sbyong gyi gseb tu'ang dran lam du/ /sgrib bral ba'i dbyings der nyi dkyil bzhin/ /chos gsal zhing gsal ba 'di ngo mtshar che/ /yid dga' ba'i me long dkyil 'khor la/ /sems bde ba'i yul gyi snang brnyan ni/ /mkha' dag pa'i dbyings kyi zla gzugs de/ /ches dwangs pa'i chu nang ji bzhin no/ /'di rdzun pa ma yin bden pa ste/ /skyabs rin cen gsum gyi dgongs pa yin/ /lha chos skyong srung ma dbang bzhugs pa/ 'di snang tshul bcos su med pa ste/ /de bden pa'i tshig gis yi ger bris/ 'di grogs su gyur pa dkar 'jam gyi/ ras bzang po'i logs la sug pas bris/ 'di rang gis bltas na bde ba'i rgyu/ grogs ga' na gyis bltas na ci 'char 'gyur/ /nyams bde stong rol pa'o rgya mtsho che/ /dbyar chu bo'i ngang tshul dag la 'gran/ /de lam bzang rdo rje theg pa'i drin/ /drin che bar nges so bla ma rje/ /bdag tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /lam bzang po 'di dang mi 'bral shog /skyabs bslu med dkon cog gsum la 'dud/ /kye yangs pa'i rgyal khams hor gyi yul/(106ba〉yongs spyod kyi 'byor pa kun tsho gos par/ khong gser gyi rgyal pos gtsos gyur pa'i/ /bcud dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag slob ma rnams/ /sngon dge legs kyi 'brel pa mi dman pas/ /dus ding sang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs/ /slar smon lam mthu las phyi mar yang / /tshul 'di ltar theg chen lam bzang nas/ khyed skal ldan 'dren pa'i dpal du 'gyur/ dus da res skal pa dang 'tsham par chos mtho ris thar lam legs bstan nas/ /sems bde ba'i yul la bskyod par bya/ /gzhan phan don gnyer gyi byed po 'di/ /dbus dad ldan don du 'dren pa gyis/ /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams bsod nams kyi/ /mthu dman phyir rkyen ngan mang na yang / /phyogs 'di nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas mchog /dus ring zhig gnas pa'i smon lam bgyi/ /don 'di la kun gyi byed par rigs/ /kye dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag slob ma rnams/ /dus long yod ma yin brtson pa yis/ /lha rin cen gsum gyi skyabs 'og nas/ /chos dam tshig sdom pa gces par srungs/ /dpal ba ched dgu ma lus 'grub par —156

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)'gyur/ /rje sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma yis/ /yul mtha' khob sdig mun kun gsal nas/ /kun phan bde'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /kye yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po na/ /longs spyod kyi mkho dgu kun tshogs pa'i/ /sde chen po kha ra chin gyi yul/ /bcud dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag slob mar bcas/ nyin bzhin du 'du 'khod kyi ngang nas kyang / /sems bde ba li yul la bskyod pa yis/ /gnyis skyes kyi cha lugs ma blangs na/ /gu ru yi tshe dpal ring bar 'gyur/ /dpal de yis phun tsho gis yid dbang gis/ /dran yul du gyur pa snang ba skyo/ /snang tshul (107na)gyi rten 'brel chos 'di la/ /'di ster gyi sgo gsum spyod yul byas/ /sku des kyang phan bde'i grogs su 'gyur/ dpal mkha' 'gro bcu gsum bla ma dang / /dbyer med kyi mgon la 'phrin las zhu/ /zhes so/ /de ltar kun tu rgyu rab bzang ltar/ sku dngos kyisagadul bya'i mtha' ma rdzogs te nag zla'i nyer drug gi tho rengs/ sprul sku rags pa'i za ma tog las/longs sku ye shes sgyu ma'i sku logs su phye nas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal snying po yi drung du gshegs so/ /nyer bdun gyi nyin skyid shod bde chen rtser sde pa bkra shis rab brtan pa zhogs ga'i gtor ma zhig gtong ba li skabs/ rje 'di seng ge dkar mo la chibs nas phebs pa yun ring por gzigs par lo zla tshes grangs kyi tho nyi 'od shar gyi thal ba'i ngos la btab nas phyis su sku 'khor rnams la dris pas dus tshes 'grig pa byung ngo/ /ring po nyid nas 'gro la brtser dgongs nas/ /bde chen 'gyur med chos dbyings nam mkha' las/ /sprul sku'i chu shel dbang po rtag 'char na/ /zhi ba'i nub ri'i ngos su mnal 'di ci/ /dug lnga'i nyon mongs grang reg gis gtses pa'i/ /lus can ljon pa'i tsho gos la thugs bskyed kyis/ /dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal gyis mi skyong na/ /dam bca'i khur chen 'khyer ba ngo re mnong / /log bsgrub mi bsrun skye bo'i tsher ma dang / /snying nas gus pa lhur len a shwa — / /nye dang ring ba spangs te rjes 'dzin pa/ /'phags chen rgyal sras rnam thar ma yin nam/ /rigs drug skye bo'i pha mtha' rdzogs min par/ /gzhan phan dam bca' bzung ba'i snying stobs can/ /da dung 'dul dka'i skye bo grangs med pa/ /mchis so gzhan (107ba)don mdzod cig pad dkar 'dzin/ /—157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)de nas phyag mdzod gu shri dpal ldan rgya mtsho dang rgyal po sogs sbyin bdag rnams kyis lha mchod mi mchod kyi dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs/ dbus gtsang gi phyogs su dgongs rdzogs bsgrub mi mngags/ de yang dgos pa'i dbang gis/ phyag mdzod dang / drung yig 'dzam sras pa chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs gros thog nas/ gzhan phan don gnyer gyi byed po 'di/ /dbus dad ldan don du 'dren pa gyis/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis po 'di bka' chems kyi nang du bcug nas/ gdung dbus gtsang du gdan 'dren pa 'gab tshul gsungs kyang / rgyal po sogs la rje drung rin po che nas/ gsung yin min gyi sa mtshams gsal por phye bas/ yar gdan 'dren pa la bkag cha byas te/ rje bla ma'i dpe drangs nas sog yul du ril por bzhugs pa la kha 'cham yang/ sa yul la ma ngan par/ hor zla bcu pa'i nyer lnga la zhugs su phul bas/ bde mchog dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi sku/ yig 'bru mang po dang / dbu thod ril por phebs/ ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur pa phyogs thams cad du bkye bas/ so sos gdung rten grangs med bzhengs pa ni/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis mchod rten bye ba bzhengs pa'i rnam grangs la yang 'gran par nus so/ /sa glang gi smon lam thog /sku mdun chos mdzad pas/ dge 'dun stong phrag bzhi tsam la zhag bco lnga'i ring bsnyen bkur zhus/ phyag mdzod kyis gtsos pa'i sgar pa rags rim yar bteg /lcags stag la btsong khar byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs/ rim gyi dbus su 'byor ba dang / gzhi byesa'adzom thog nas/ sku'i rten du bka' gdams lha bzhi gtso bor gyur pa'i gos sku/ gsung gi rten du gser kyi bka' 'gyur/(108na)thugs kyi rten du dngul gdung rin po che 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag khru bcu gsum pa/ thig rtsa bzo bkod sogs pir thogs dbang po sman thang nas sku mdun blo bzang pa/bzo bo rgya shing dang / ji wa ra dza rnams kyis byas te/ lcags yos la gegs med du grub pa'i chu 'brug hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes la gzungs bzhugs kyi phyag len sman thang nas/ rab gnas la khri rin po che dpal 'byor rgya mtsho dang / ser 'bras kyi slob dpon rnams 'tshogs te dga' ston rgya chen po —158

rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ 6)byas so/ /rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen brtse brtse bas 'gro kun rjes 'dzin zhing / /zhing 'dir mgal me ltar du du mar sprul pa'i gar mkhan ma/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i gnyen mchog mchog dman yongs kyi mgon gcig pu/ /bu ltar skye rgu ma lus lus med phan bder 'god mkhas pa/ /rlabs chen bsod nams gser gyi shing rta yis/ /rnam dkar yid bzhin nor bu 'bad med du/ /drangs tshe rgya mtshor dka' ba brgya phrag gis/ /bgrod pa'i byed po phal cher gnyid la yur/ /grangs med skye bar rlabs chen spyod pa yis/ /dpag yas gzhan don mdzad pa'i rnam par thar/ /brjod ces tshangs pas gdong bzhi sprul pa na/ /ha cang ngal bas zag bcas bde bar mnal/ zla ba'i ma ma a mra'i tshig gu yis/ /tshad du 'jal ba'i dka' thub len pa ltar/ /rgyal ba mchog gi rnam par thar pa'i mtha'/ /brjod pa rang nyid ngal ba tsam du zad/ /'on kyang thun mong gdul bya dbang rtul ngor/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba'i tshul/ /cung zad yi ge'i 'phreng bar spel ba yis/ /med byung dad pa'i myu gu ci yang skye/ /de lta na yang dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /lo las me tog dri bsung tshar dngar ba'i/ khyad chos rkang 'thung (108ba〉gak+ṣ-i na la ma mchis pas/ /'gran zlar gyur pa'i nor zhabrul ga la skye/ /mkhyen rab 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi blo gros dang / /brtse chen snying rje'i rang bzhin spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu stobs gsang ba'i bdag po'i ngang tshul can/ /rigs gsum mgon yang 'di na gcig tu grub/ /mdzad pas thub bstan mtha' dag rab gsal zhid / /'phrin las nor 'dzin pha mtha' yongs gzhal bas/ /snyan grags srid pa'i rtse mor bsgreng pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la kun mkhyen gnyis par nges/ /cung zad dang ba'i dad pa tsam gyis kyang / mchog mthun dngos grub rgya mtsho ma lus pa/ /'dren pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i shing rta ni/ kha lo phyogs bral rna ba'i tshal chen por/ /sgyur pa'i dge des 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ ring lugs dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rab 'phel zhing / /ris med lus can kun la phan bde'i char/ /chal chil g.yo ba'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /— 159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)ces rgya bod hor gsum thams cad kyi rnam 'dren dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di yang / grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho me zin bris kha yar bsdus te bskul ba la brten nas/ sprul sku 'phrang kha ba dpal ldan blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar lha'i rgyal pos zhus pa'i skal ldan shing rta zhes bya ba lcags rta yan gyi rnam thar dang / de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dgung lo bco lnga yan gyi rnam thar tshigasabacad ma/ bsod nams ye shes dbang pos mdzad pa'i mdo khams su phebs pa'i lam yig tshigs bcad lhug gnyis/ mkhar nag lo tsā ba dpal 'byor rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rnam thar yongs su rdzogs pa/ gzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i sgo 'byed (109na)sogs/ yig cha kha yar 'dug pa rnams la gzhi byas/ sprul sku 'phrang kha bas mdzad pa de nyid la lo tshigs sogs shin tu dag par 'dug cing / gzhan rnams la snga phyi'i lo dus 'dzol ba dang brjod don 'brugs pa kha yar mchis na'ang / lo tshigs nor ba sogs ma dag pa rnams la zhib mor dpyad/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i gsung ngag las ji ltar thos pa rnams dang / gzhan yang skad gnyis smra ba zhad mkhar lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rje sogs mang du thos pa'i yon tan mkhan po mang po'i ngag rgyun khungs btsun gyi rigs kyis zur brgyan/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad rnams ma gtogs kun gyi go bde ba'i phyir 'bol rtsom du byas te/ lo rgyus smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/ mi zad pa me pho khyi'i lo/ nyin mor byed pa srang gi khyim du spyod pa'i phyogs gnyis pa'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// sarba ma bla le// //— /60

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)ra༅༅//'jig rten dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄tsho//ring nas mi phyed mdza' gcugs kyis bcings lhag bsam dpyid kyi pho nya yis//mgron du bsus pa'i rlabs chen spyod pa'i dbyar gyi dpal mo bzhad pa'i bzhin//2na〉sus can kun gyi phan bde'i myu gu g.yur du za ba'i pad dkar 'chang //grangs med yon tan khur gyis dud pa'i thub bstan rgya mtsho'i mgon der 'dud//2ba ) phyag na pad+mas 'dul zhing bod yul 'dir//rigs gsum mgon po'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//chos rgyal mes dpon rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs//sprul pa'i 'phreng ba mi 'dzad shin tu ring //ma med thugs rje chen po'i 'od dkar gyis//mig sman lta bur gnag pa'i 'khor ba'i mun//mthar byed skyes rabs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang //srid pa'i dkar cha rdzogs min de srid 'phel//sos dus mkha' dbyings be+e ḍūr ltar dwangs par//sprin dkar dal bur g.yo las char gyi rgyun//babs tshe rma bya dga' ba'i gar bsgyur na//dam pa'i rtogs pa brjod la su mi dad//de phyir yon tan gdengs ka rab g.yo zhing //thub bstan rgya mtsho'i 'jings na legs gnas pa//sngon med klu dbang phyag na pad dkar can//bde chen chos kyi rgyal por grags min nam//khyod kyi gsang ba gsum gyi pha rol mtha'//tshad mar 'jal la kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i thugs//the tshom khyogs la 'phyang na bdag 'dra yis//smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ngal ba'i rgyu//'on kyang rgya mtsho che las ku sha'i rtses//blangs pa'i chu thigs ji bzhin thun mong gi/gdul bya'i snang ngor 'tsham pa'i rnam thar gzugs//rab dkar shog bu'i me long ngos su /ra//de yang dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad ni

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)lus can mtha' dag la lhag par rjes su brtse bas dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas sprul pa mtha' yas pas sems can gyi don rlabs po che mdzad cing / khyad par bskal ba bzang po 'di la grags chen gyi sangs rgyas stong 'byon pa'i nang tshan/ rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po 'phags pa'i yul du chos kyi (3na〉stsor lo rgya chen po bskor nas/ sku dngos kyis gdul bar bya ba'i gnas ma yin la/ rgya nag gi gnas ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis 'dul ba'i zhing dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'di thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyis 'dul ba'i zhing dang / skyon gyi yul ni dpal phyag na rdo rjes 'dul ba'i zhing du byin gyis brlabs par brten/ bod gangs kyi ra bas bskor pa'i rgyal khams 'dir/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa spre'u byang chub sems dpa' las mi'i 'gro ba 'phel zhing / bod spyi la dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po sogs/ chos skyong pa'i rgyal po rnams kyang thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa sha stag yin la/ de dag gi rjes su 'brom chos kyi rgyal po sogs gos dkar lcang lo'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / 'brom ku mā ra ma ti sogs khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i rnam par rol ba ste/mdor na sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba spyi dang / bye brag gangs can pa rnams kyi don rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa ni/ glegs bam rin po che las/ spyir sems can rnams kyi mgon po yin/ /sgosagangs ri'i khrod du rgyal srid skyong / /zhes pa dang / mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ ston pa zhing 'dir byon pa'i tshe/ /mgon khyod khye'ur snang ba la/ /rgyal dbang don kun grub pa de'i/ /legs bshad 'doms la lhag par dad/ /de nas dkon cog gsol ba sogs/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi 'dzin ma'i gzhin/ /zhakhrul med skyes rabs tshar dngar bas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yang dag spel/ /khyad par kha ba can ljongs 'dir/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po (3ba tshe tshes/ /snyan par grags des jo shāka gnyis/ /spyan drangasabaka' drin mtshungs med stsal/ /'gro ba'i mgon khyod bar skabs su/ /chos rgyal 'phags par gyur ba'i tshe/ /se chen gan gyis spyan drangs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi las mtshan phul/ /'di nas mi rabs bdun pa na/ /gser dang rgya mtsho'i mtshan ldan gyis/ /slar yang mchod yon byed do zhes/ /lung bstan thog — 162

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)tu babs par mdzad/ /rgyal bas sher phyin byang phyogs nas/ /byang du rgyas par 'gyur gsungs pa/ /al than gan dang sarba dzhas/ /'gro don dpag med mdzad la dgongs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ de yang bod yul du 'gro ba'i don mtha' yas par mdzad pa'i nang tshan la/ rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas kyi shug pa rnams la shun pa rim pa bdun 'byung ba ni/ bzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i sgo 'byed las/ mchog gi sprul sku ji ltar phebs pa ni/ /rwa sgreng shug pa'i mtshon don 'chad pa na/ khun pa bdun ni gangs ri'i khrod 'di nyid/ /rgyal ba bdun gyis bar mtshams med par skyong / /zhes pa ltar/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i sprul pa bdun rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i mtshon don du bshad cing / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur du/ skye ba bdun du 'gro don legs byas nas/ /zag med chos kyi dbyings su sdud par byed/ /ces zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /de ltar sprul pa bdun du 'byung ba'i/ /mchog gi sprul sku bzhi pa 'di nyid ni/ mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ dkon cog 'bangs kyi rnam (4na)thar las/ /a ti sha'i sras 'brom rje dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan can re/ /bod du rim par 'byon par gsungs/ /de yang paṇa chen dge 'dun grub/ /slar yang saṃ gha sa mu dra/ /rje btsun bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /da lta bde chen chos rgyal lags/ /zhes pa ste/ thog mar ngos 'dzin gyi tshe/ snang tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis su gyur pas/ la la dag 'bri khung zhabs drung chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi thugs sras gsum pa/ zhabs drung dkon cog rin cen yin nam zhes dpyad gzhi shar/ de la brten phyag mdzod gu shrī dpal ldan rgya mtshos 'bri khung du gzigs par byon par/ seng ge slebs byung gsungs pas/ rje gong mas ni nged la seng ge gsung gi med snyam ste sku skye min pa 'dra bsam pa cig shar/ 'on kyang de skabs yin min gnyis dzi'i kha tshon ma chod par/ re zhig spam me bzhag ste phyir byon/ gnas chung lcog nas sprul pa'i chos skyong chen pos mchog gi sprul sku sog yul rang du 'khrungs par lung bstan/ tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can tsher gseb chos rgyal — 163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6logyis kyang de dang mthun pa zhig gsungs pa la yid ches kyi gnas su mdzad dgos rgyur 'dug kyang /zos bde'i skabs chos skyong gi rigs kyi lung bstan la yang ras su bor re ba byed cing / 'gag la thug pa'i dus/ rgyu mtshan ci yang med pa zhig gi tshig la'ang sangs rgyas kyi gsung ltar gces spras su byed pa 'di kun gyi srol la snang ngo / /sog yul gyi sgar pa rnams kyi mgo mir gsol dpon tshul khrims rgya mtsho yod 'dug pas/ khong pa dang (4bskong so mdzo mo mkhar pa gnyis kyis dbus su mi ched gnyer mngags pa'i yi ge 'di lta ste/ phyag mdzod rin po ches dbu mdzad/ chos rje zhal ngo rnams dang / drung 'khor bgres gzhen rnamasakyi zhabs drung du/ thag ring gi sa'i cha nas gus pa chen pos zhu ba/ deng sang gi dus dpon slob thams cad sku snyoms shing / lugs gnyis kyi 'gro don rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhugs pa gnang lags sam/sprang chung snying rul bdag kyang / zhabs drung thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs rje la brten nas/ lus la nad 'tshe med cing sgar chen gzhis kyi dbu sdud dang / 'gro phan 'phel ba'i khul du gnas lags/'tshams zhus/ 'dir se chen chos khur gyi bī ji chung ba la/ lo sngon ma'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i gnam gang gi nyin bu zhig skyes 'dug /de la rtags rten 'brel legs pa 'ga' 'byung 'dug kyang / dpon mos gsangs nas bsdad le red/ de rjes bī ji zla ba gsum tsam dbang po shor nas sems mi zin pa lta bu byung 'dug /dang po khog la zhugs dus/ bī ji'i rmi lam du/ zhabs drung rin po che na bza' dkar po bzhes nas bzhugs pa la/ phyag btsal ba dang / lha dkar po zhig dang mjal ba byung 'dug /khog par yod dus khog stod la bsdad pa dang sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i lus sems bde ba sogs rtags mang po byung 'dug ste snga sor ma bshad le red/ de rjes zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du/ bā ji kha lha dkar po zhig gis/ 'di ta la'i bla ma'i sku skye yin/ khri thog la phud la sde tsho la mjal kha thong zer ba'i lung bstan byung gsungs(5na〉〉ga pas/ nang so mdzo mo mkhar pa dang khong rnams kyis sprul sku yin na rten 'brel kyang gas drogs/ khri thogs tu gdan drangs 'dug lags/ de skabs kyang me tog gi char babs—164

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)pa sogs rtags khyad par can byung zer/ de rjes sde chen kun la grags byung bas/ bdag gis cha dkar phyogs la 'gro zhor la mjal bas/ 'khrungs nas zla ba bcu las mi 'gro ba 'dug ste/ rang ga ba'i phrug gu dang mi 'dra bar/ bzhugs tshul dang gzigs stangs za ma bzhes tshul rnams ni khyad du 'phags pa zhig 'dug lags/ zhabs drung thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku skye yin min ci yin rung tha mal gyi nyams ni mi 'dug /nged 'dir yod rnams kyis gsung ma byon bar la yin min gnyis ga'i thag ma chod/rtags rten 'brel de bzhin red pas/ g.yas phyogs su nges shes 'grongs pa bzhin e byung / ma byung na khyed dpon slob rnams kyis/ chos skyong la lung bstan zhu ba dang / thugs dam brtag pa/ gzan sgril sogs mdzad nas thugs yid ches pa e 'ong gzigs pa zhu pas/ sde chen kun la skad 'di grags song bas/ mthong tshod/ tshor tshod kyi gnas tshul zhus pa yin lags/ yang gsung byon nas yid ches byung na myur du 'phros 'bul lags/ gzhan ma bī jis lung bstan 'dra mang po gsungs 'dug ste/'dir ma zhus/sa glang hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga la chos khur dbon po'i sde thog nas phul ba'i zhu yig /ces so/ /gnas tshul de la brten nas/ 'bri khung phyogs kyi re ba bskyungs te/ phyag mdzod gu shri chen po nyid kyis gtsos pa'i sgar (5bskomangs rnams sog yul du gdan 'dren pa la 'degs pa'i bdun pa dang ldan par gyur/ ding sang gi dus ni bla chen rnams kyi stobs 'byor la hams pas sku skye la hab thob byed par snang / de skabs bskal dus bzang bas srol ngan de 'dra ma dar ba dang / lhag tu 'bri khung du sku skye yin nam dgongs pa'i thugs rtog byung ba las spros pa'i spyan nye'i rnam pa ni/ zhabs drung chos rgyal phun tshogs de skyes bu dam par song bas ga la mdzad/ phyag mdzod ni bod sog gang du sku skye byung yang brtag pa lung bstan sogs nges shes 'grongs pa zhig don du gnyer ba las/ sog po'i rgyal rigs lta bu zhig la byung na kha drag dang rgyu chen po yod/ bod kyi bla chen mi chen gyi rigs su byung na de dag gi sa cha'i steng nas longs spyod rgyu 'ong snyam pa'i ding dus kyi sku skye ngos 'dzin rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i — 165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ska'akhor lo bskor pa rnams dang 'dra ba min no/ /rje drung rin po che bstan pa rgya mtshos/ rje gong ma'i zhal thang rgyab la phyag bris 'byar ba zhig /'bri khung du bsnams byon dus ngo mkhyen pa sogs yid ches tshul gsungs pa/ spyir sprul pa la/ skye ba snga phyi star chags su 'brel ba'i sprul pa dang /dus gcig tu sprul pa'i sprul pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa sogs 'byung zhing / de dag kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig la gzugs 'bum phrag 'char ba ltar pha mtha' tshad bzung bral bas na/ bdag lta bu'i blo gros kyi rtsal dman pas kha tshon gcod par ga la nus/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel gyi gsung las/ ga jag chos mdzad sdom brtson blo gros (6na)rgyal mtshan de/ chos mthun thugs dam pa zhig yod 'dug pas/ rje gong ma'i dgongs par bde zhing zham 'bring du bcar ba nas/ khong gi sku'i skye ba zhabs drung dkon cog rin cen yin 'dug pas/ rnam par dkar ba'i las kyi 'brel pas rjes su bzung ba zhig go zhes bka' gnang ba thos so /de yang zhabrul med kyi nges pa ni/ sog po'i yul du 'khrungs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bka' chems las/ sngon dge legs kyi 'brel pa mi dman pas/ /dus ding sang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs/ /slar smon lam mthu las mar yang / /tshul 'di ltar theg chen lam bzang nas/ khyod skal ldan 'dren pa'i dpal du 'gyur/zhes pa/ zhabs drung rin po che 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa dang thugs rgyud gcig la/ a lan tha rgyal po de gong ma se chen gan gyi skye ba yin par snang bas/ dus der mchod yon gnyis smon lam legs par btab pa'i mthus/ ding sang sog yul du dam pa'i chos dar ba sogs rten 'brel 'grig pa 'di bzhin byung la slar yang smon lam gyi mthus skye ba phyi mar ji gir gyi rigs su zhakhrungs te/chos srid gnyis ldan zung du 'brel ba'i tshul gyis skal ldan rnams theg pa chen po'i lam du 'dren pa'i dpal du 'gyur zhes zhal gyis 'ches pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'gyur ba med pa'o/ /glegs bam rin po cher/ bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ /mi dbang mdzod la bod khams — /66

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)bde bar skyong / /zhes pa ltar/ bod kha ba can lta bu'ang / thog mar chos kho nas 'dul bar ma nus par srid kyi sgo nas 'dul (6ba)dgos pa byung ba dang mtshungs par 'dir yang hor gyi rgyal rigs su sku bltams pas/ rje gong ma'i dus su hor sog rnams rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel lam bzang po byung pa'i steng du/ sku skye rting ma'i dus nged kyi rigs su 'byungs zhes/ 'jig rten dang sgo bstun pa'i srid kyi cha nas kyang mngon par zhen pas bstan pa la 'gyur med kyi gus pa mi lhod pa la gzigs pa ni gongs gzhi shin tu che zhing / 'brug pa rgyal dbang chos rjes 'brug bstan la dgongs nas bsam bzhin bya khri dpon gyi rigs su skye ba bzhes pa'i bsngags brjod thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar po'i rnam thar du gsal ba don 'di dang mtshungs mod kyang/ gzhan phan gyi gdul bya skyong ba la/ /thugs bskyed rgya che chung gis shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun gyi chen po hor gyi rgyal khams mtha' dag zhwa ser po gcig gi 'og tu chos srid gnyis ldan gyis khyab par gyur tshe/ gnyal byar lo gsum 'brug bstan gyis khyab pa tsam la zhal pho mdzad pa'ang nam mkha' dang lag mthil gyi dper mngon no/ /g.yin yang bka' chems las/ mi gnam skos kyi dga' ba skyed byed rgyal/ /mtshan kun tu rgyal ba'i yon tan de/ dpal yar gyi ngo bzhin gong du 'phel/ /zhes pa'i don gnam bskos ni jing gir gyi rgyal brgyud de'i rigs su 'khrungs pas yab yum sogs phyogs de'i skye bo rnams kyi dga' ba skyed par byed pa dang / yon tan zhes pa'i mtshan zur dngos su thon pa dang / gong du 'phel zhes pas rgya mtsho la chu bo mtha' dag 'du zhing 'phel bas don gyis thon (7na)pa'o/ /e ma srid pa'i me long du/ /las nyon gyis 'phangs bde sdug gi /bzang ngan sna tshogs 'char ba la/ /byis pa'i skye bo ngo mtshar byed/ /gtan bde'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'gyur med sprul pa'i ri dwags gzugs/ / nam yang 'gog med gsal ba 'dis/ /'khor ba'i mun pa pha mthar bskrad/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i smon lam mthus/ /grangs med 'gro 'dren dam bca'i khur/ /chad med ri gzar las babs chu/ /zhi bde'i rags kyis bzlog —167—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nenus ci/ /dam pa 'di ni rgya dang mi lhag gi dregs pa can thams cad bsod nams chen po'odapung gis dbang du bsdus te/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong la brten nas yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun la mnga' sgyur ba'i jing gir rgyal po nas bzung tho gan the mur gyi bar du/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khri la zhabasazung bkod de rtsod dus kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po sha stag tu byung ba yin la/ tho gan the mur gyi dus/ gru thal grus rgya nag gi rgyal sa phrogs te/ rgyal rabs mang ba'i bar kla klo sdig spyod kyi rgyal po mi dge ba'i gling du 'khyams pa las/ dus ring mo zhig nas grangs med pa'i rgyal ba'i thugs rje chen po'i byed pos/ mtha' 'khob mun pa'i gling du dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod pa'i shing rta chen por/al than rgyal po zhes yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu nyi zla ltar grags pa'i rigs yin no/ /de yang zhabs drung thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ sa byi nag pa zla ba'i nyer drug gi tho rangs gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus te/ (7ba〉snyung sems tsam las grub pa'i ye shes kyi sku des/ thog mar dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su phebs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang thugs dam gyi snying po thun mong ma yin pa rnams gsang ba'i tshul mdzad pa zhig yod 'dug pas/ mkhas grub khyung po dang mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i zab chos mgon po snying zhugs kyi 'pho ba/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho khyab bdag sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi la thugs dam nar mar mdzad pas/ bka' chems las/ dpal mkha' 'gro bcu gsum bla ma dang / /dbyer med kyi mgon la 'phrin las zhu/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de dang chabs gcig par/ nā ro pa'i gsang chen slob bshad/rdo rje 'chang 'tshar pa chos rje yab sras kyi man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa thugs su bstan pas/ rtsa dbu ma la brten pa'i zla ba mo rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi nye ba'i lam khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungasapa'i brdar/ bka' chems las/ nyams bde stong rol pa'i rgya mtsho che/ /dbyar chu bo'i ngang tshul dag la 'gran/ /de lam bzang rdo rje theg pa'i drin/ /drin che bar nges so bla ma rje/ /bdag tshe rabs nasatshe rabs thams cad du/ /lam bzang po 'di dang mi 'bral shog /ces gsungs la/ yab bka'i yi dam — 168—

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)gyi gtso bo yang bde mchog dril bu pa dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi gnyis yin par snang bas/ drin chen bar nges so bla ma rje/ /zhes pa'i bla ma ni rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis dang/ rje btsun bod mkhar pa mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan gnyis yin par nges so/ /mkha' spyod kyi gnas nas (8na)skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du se chen chos khur mtshan g.yin su mi tha'i ji'i bī ji bā khen skyu la'i lhums su/ sa byi nag pa zla ba'i gnam gang gi nyin/ khye'u dkar po shel 'phrong thogs pa'i rnam pa can gyi tshul du bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yum gyi gur la 'ja' kha dog lnga pa lan mang po'i bar du zug pa dang / me tog gi char babs pa kun gyis mngon sum du mthong / yum gyi mnal lam du gur gyi thog na'i steng du mi dkar po rta dkar zhen pa zhig dang / yang rje gong ma phying dkar bzhes nas nged 'dir gnas shig g.yar ba la 'ongs pa yin gsung ba dang / po ta la yin zer ba'i ri mthon po zhig gi rtser khang bzang nyams dga' ba zhig nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros pa'i sna la/ khye'u dkar po shel dkar gyi 'phreng ba thogs pa zhig 'ongs te/ rang gi lus la thim/ mnal sad pa na/ lus la bde ba'i nyams khyad par can skyes/ de la brten nas ting nge 'dzin gyi zas kyi 'tsho bas nyin zhag bdun tsam gyi bar zas rags pa gsol ma dgos pa dang / sngon med pa'i yid la dga' ba'i nyams lhang lhang ba shar bsnyung 'dug /yang nub gcig mnal lam du/ ne'u gsing yid du 'ong ba zhig gi khar bzhugs pa la/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa nas nyi zla gnyis zung 'brel du shar ba/ cig car rang gi khong par zhugs pa dang / ri bo mthon po zhig gi rtser 'bad med du 'dzegs pas/ chu chen po gting dang kha zheng thams cad gzhal bar dka' ba zhig gi 'gram nas pha rol tu 'gro mi thub bam snyam tsa na/ gos dkar po gyon pa'i khye'u zhig gisagrogs byas (8ba)te 'bad med du bgrod/ pha rol tu slebs pa tsam gyi nam mkha' la bya ltar 'phur bas/ yul dang grong khyer mang po mthong / de nas sngar mthong ma myong ba'i yul nyams dga' ba zhig tu babs pa na/ lha dang klu la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rigs mi gcig pa yin zer ba'i rgyan cha lugs gzugs—169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (bebarnyan sna tshogs pa mang pos 'dud pa dang mchod pa byas pa dang/ yang cung zad phyin pa na/ lung pa phu na gangs ri mthon po yod pa/ bar na rtsi shing nags tshal me tog sogs yid du 'ong ba'i tshal chen po/gtsug lag khang dge 'dun gyi kun dka' ra ba dang zung du 'brel ba zhig gi nang du slebs ma thag sngon med pa'i rang gi lus la/ u dum wa ra dang pad+ma dkar po'i thod dang ga sha sogs rgyan du mas rang shugs kyis brgyan pa byung ba la/ de'i tshe gsang ri'i rtse nas dung dkar zhig bus byung bas/ gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol tu 'ongs pa na/ mi nyam thag pa'i rnam pa can mang po tshogs pa chu chen po pha rol tu bgrod dka' ba zhig la rang gis sna drangs te bde bar khrid de/ khri mthon po seng ge'i gzugs kyis bteg pa zhig 'dug pa'i 'khris su slebs tsa na/ seng ge de seng ge dngos yin nam snyam pa'i snang ba zhig shar ba'i mod la/ seng ge de gnyis kyis nga ro chen po phyogs kun tu khyab pa zhig bsgrags/ de dang thag nye sar yul lugs mi gcig pa'i bud med mang po rgyan gos bzang pos spras te glu len zhing bro 'khrab pa gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mang du thong bar snang / gzhan yang sngon med pa'i dri bzang po 'thul ba dang / sgra snyan po sgrog pa sogs nye 'khor ba phal cher (9na)gyis spyod yul du gyur pas/'di 'dra ba'i ltas ji lta bu zhig yin nam zhes kun som nyir gyur kyang / mtha' 'khob kyi yul grur song bas legs nyes dang de dag gi rgyu mtshan zhib mor dpyod pa ni ma byung ngo / / zla ba kha yar song ba na/ yum gyi mngal du sras chags par mngon pa'i tshe/ yum gyi khog stod du yod nyams byed cing / khong pa'i nang nas yi ge drug pa dang hrīḥnang dhī la sogs pa'i sgra dir dir sgrog pa 'khri / na yod pa rnams kyis kyang thos zer/ zhakhrungs pa la nye ba tsam gyi dus nub gcig mnal lam du/ rang gi snying gar bod yig gi hrī: dkar po zhig lam me snang ba las/ 'od zer 'phrosanas sems can mang po'i don byas te/ slar rang la thim pa dang / mar me chen po zhig spar bas 'jig rten thams cad gsal bar byas pa byung ngo / /sgo mang slob dpon bzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub kyis/ sprul pa'i sku mchog bzhi pa 'di nyid ni/ /bsam bzhin al than nyid kyi rgyal — 170

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)rigs kyi/ /su mir tha'i ji bā khen skyu la yi/ /sras su bsam bzhin 'khrungs tshul 'di lta ste/ /rta dkar zhen pa'i khye'u mdzes pa zhig /skra yi steng du byon pa yum gyis mthong / /lhums su zhugs nas khog stod nyid bzhugs shing / /yig drug sgra zhig gsal por thos pa byung / /de dang mtshungs par skra la 'ja' zug cing / /me tog char sogs dge mtshan du ma byung / /zhes dang / mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ mthong ba don ldan thugs rje'i 'od/ /nam yang 'grib par mi 'gyur mod/ /re zhig gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /chos dbyings chu lha'i phyogs su yol/ /(9bskor yang mkhyen brtse'i rlung shugs kyis/ /zhing 'dir 'byon pa'i snga ltas su/ /gur la 'ja' zug de steng du/ /lha mchod rta dkar chibs pa zhig /yum chen mnal ba'i lam nas gzigs/ /rang la thim pas lus sems bde/ /sad tshe yid dga' 'ja' tshon 'khrigs/ /me tog char gyis chu mthongs khengs/ /sngon med spos kyi dri zhim 'thul/ /ya mtshan ltas bzang dbang po tshim/ /zhes so/ /'byams klas dag pa'i zhing gi mgon rnams dang / /gsang gsum bkod pa rgya mtshos dus 'da' yang / /ma dag 'gro ba 'dren pa'i zlos gar ni/ /dmigs med snying rje chen po'i 'brul gyis bsgyur/ /gzod ma nyid nas spangs rtogs yon tan kun/ /rdzogs pa'i rgyal sras tshul 'dzin snying rje'i lha/ /sprul pa'i rnam par rol la ya mtshan ltas/ /byung bar mtshar du 'dzin rnams byis pa'i blo/ /mgon khyod re zhig chos dbyings bde ba cher/ /bzhugs la 'gro rnams 'dud pa'i ngal gso'i slad/ /me tog char dang 'ja' tshon gur khyim sogs/ /blo khrid 'jig rten mes pos ci yang bskrun/ /de nas zla ba dgu ngo bcu la lta ba'i 'phags pa'i yul du tsi tra dhi zhes pa gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gal bar 'bod cing / rgya nag gi skad du gyi tshe'u phyogs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun pa sa mo glang gi lo/ sa hor mchod yon lugs kyi zla ba dang po/ rgyal bas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus chen/ chu shel gyi dbang po rta chen gyis nya ba'i phyogs sngon ma'i dga' ba dang po'i nyi shar gyi dus su/ pad+ma dkar po 'dam gyi skyon gyis ma gos pa ltar/ mngal gyi nyes pa'i rgya las rnam par grol te/ dgung lo gsum —171

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (yetsam lon pa'i bong tshod tsam/ /(10na gi ser gyi mchod sdong nyi ma'i 'od kyis khyab pa lta bu'i gzi mdangs dang ldan pa'i tshul gyis bltams so/ /sgo mang slob dpon bzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub kyis/ /sa glang hor zla dang po'i tshes tha ṇi ga gi nyi ma shar dang bltams pa lhan cig byung / /zhes dang / mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ 'chi med sras po spor tha'i ji yi'i/ /rigs brgyud su mer tha'i ji yab/ /rgyal khab kun gsal mdzesaphyir du/ /yum mchog bā khyen skyu la yi/ /mngal spran nas 'thon rab mdzes sku/ /rgyal sras nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar/ /sa glang mchu zla'i tshes gcig la/ /sog yul dbang po'i sa 'dzin rtser/ /dkar phyogs pad+ma'i gnyen de byon/ /nag po'i rtsa lag mun pa sangs/ zhes so/ /de'i tshe 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang me rta ge gi char chen po 'bab cing / dus ma yin pa'i 'brug gi sgra dal bur sgrog pa dang / sngon chad sna'i yul du ma myong ba'i dri zhim po bro ba dang / sgra 'dzin gyi yul du thos ma myong ba'i rol mo sna tshogs rang 'brol ba/ sa chen po g.yo ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang du byung ngo/ /zla ba de ga'i nang du yab kyi mtshan nas 'bod pa dang gzhan yang gsung gleng du ma gnang bas/shes ldan rnams 'di ni gang zag phal pa dang ma 'dra ba'i ya mtshan pa zhig go /zhes bsngags rjod byed par gyur to/ /sku gzi byin che bas/ na tshod phra yang kun gyi mig cer rgyag tu blta bar mi bzod cing / mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i ngang tshul can no/ /nyin gcig yum la lha khang nas bka' 'gyur gyi ma dum spyan drongs shig gsungs pa ltar blangs pas/ glegs bam la gzigs te 'di ni nga'i rnam par thar pa'o zhes gsungs/(10bathags bam kha phye bas/ dam chos pad dkar gyi nang gi don yod zhags pa'i rnam thar byung bas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin par gor ma chag ces kun mgrin gcig tu gleng / mchod gnas kyi dge 'dun rnams gsung rab sgrog tu 'jug pa dang / rang dang na mnyam gyi khyi'u mang po dang lhan cig tu/ spos dang me tog sogs kyis sku gsung thugs rten la mchod pa'i rim pa mdzad par/ gzhan rnams byis pa'i rol rtsed la/ dam pa 'di nyid ni yun ring po'i bar du —172

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ (nyanasku lus gnad drang por bsrangs te yan lag bdun pa'i rnam par mdzad/ 'di dag gi dus snga phyi rnams su chos kyi khri rtsig pa dang / chos 'chad pa'i rnam pa dang rdo chung ngu mang po bsags te gral du bsgrigs nas/ 'di rnams bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku 'di dang 'di 'dra yin no zhes gsung ba dang / skabs 'gar gsung chog bskang gso gtor zor 'phen pa dang gar dbyangs kyi rnam par mang po mdzad/ nyin gcig ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ las gshin/ rnam sras/ phyag bzhi pa/gur zhal sogs chos skyong mang po zhal gzigs nas rnam 'gyur 'di lta bu dang bcas te byon byung gsung de dag gi lad mo mang po mdzad/zla ba gsum tsam gyi ring yum rig pa rnal du mi gnas pa'i spyo ba lta bu byung ba sku skye phebs pa'i sdur yin zhes gleng / nag pa zla ba shar ba'i nyin gcig de ring gza' skar dang dus tshod bzang po yin pas/lha khang gi nang du stan bzang po shoms/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la mchod pa rgya chen po phul/phyogs bzhir sāts+tsha bzhi dang / rin po ches gang ba'i bum pa bzhi theg /nged btsas(11na)pa'i sar mchod rten rtsigs/ gdan khri'i phyogs mtshams su rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams sgrigs/ dge 'dun rnams bsdus la chos kyi 'bel gtam mdzad du chug /sog po tsho chen drug sogs rgya bod hor gsum gyi mi sna tshogs pa rnams la ston mo gya nom pa thong / mthong ba don ldan phyogs 'dir bsam bzhin du phebs pa la gsol ba 'debs su chug cig ces gsungs/ de bzhin du yab yum rnams kyis mdzad pa'i tshe/ bka' las/ rin po ches gang ba'i bum pa bzhi/ /nor bus gang ba'i rdza ma bdun/ rin po che sna tsho gos kyis gang ba'i zangs mkhar lnga bcu rnams lha dang klu'i 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis sbas pa zhig kyang yod ces gsungs/de nas khrums kyi zla ba'i nang du/ nyin zhag gsum gyi bar du mnal thun gcig la song ba'i mthar/mnal sad de rjes thob las bzhengs pa'i dus/ yum gyi dri ba zhus par/ zhag dang po la mchod shoms kyi dkar me gnyis nga'i lag na 'dug pa de ches cher 'bar te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od — 173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yokyis gsal bar byas pa zhig rmis/ zhag gnyis pa la nam mkha' 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus na sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med pa bzhugs 'dug pa mthong / zhag gsum pa la/ rin po che'i khri las langs te bod kyi phyogs su 'gro ba rmis so/ /zhes gsungs pas/sgo mang slob dpon bzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub kyis/ de ma thag tu sna lnga'i 'ja' gur phub/ /me tog char babs spos kyi dri bzang ldang / /rol mo'i sgra tsho gos kun gyis thos pa byung / /zla gcig 'das tshe yab kyi ming nas bos/ /byang (11bcub sems dpa'i snying po thon zhes gsungs/ /zla ba gsum nas bka' lung du ma dang / lhag par khri rgyob mchod pa chen po shoms/ /ra snas gang ba'i bum pa bzhi bzhi dang / /dung dkar bzhi rnams phyogs bzhin bus shig dang / /bla ma mchog de nyi zla bzhin du phebs/ /zhes sogs ngo mtshar gsung dang grub rtags sogs/ /brjod kyis mi lang der 'dus rnams la bstan/ /phyag 'phreng chibs pa ngos 'dzin sogs mdzad pas/ /kun kyang ngo mtshar gnas su bkod pa lags/ /zhes dang / mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ bltams nas 'jal byed dang po la/ /yab kyi mtshan nas 'bod pa sogs/ /tshul 'di zas gtsang sras bzhin du/ /ngo mtshar bsngagasapa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /bsil zer ming mtshungs gsum pa'i snabs/ /don bzang tshig 'bru bzang po yis/ /chos kyi khri shom me rta go khrom/ /rin cen gyis gang ka la sha /phyogs bzhin bzhag nas dung dkar bus/ /mthong ba don ldan slar gyon pa/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i snying po mchog nam mkha'i nor bur gsol thob ces/ /zab mo rten cing 'brel 'byung gi /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /gzhal bya klu la zhag gsum du/ /mnal ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag /rjes thob tu ni bzhengs pa'i tshe/ /yum gyis de don zhus pa na/ /dang po phyag na sgron me yis/ /phyogs kun gsal bar snang bas khyab/ /gnyis par 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa'i khrod/ /sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med gzigs/ gsum par rin cen khri steng nas/ /bod la phyogs pa rmis so gsungs/ /'ga' zhig (12na tha dam re re gnyis/ /zhal gzigs byung la ya mtshan byed/ /mgon 'dis bgrang yas lhag pa'i lha/ /mngon sum mjal pas khengs pa —174

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)med/ /ces so/ /de nas lo 'khor ba'i tshe/ yab kyi mchod khang la rab gnas shig byed pa'i dus/ rje 'di nyid kyang der phebs te rten gral gyi sku rnams la zhib tu gzigs shing / zhabs drung rin po che bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag mdzub gtad nas 'di nga yin zhes gsungs/ rje gong mas yab la gnang ba'i phyag 'phreng de'i mtshams 'dzin 'phyugs pa rnams 'chos pa gnang bas kun ya mtshan du byed/ phal cher gyis 'di ni zhabs drung thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku'i skye ba 'khrul med yin pa 'dra che'i/gleng ba la brten nas/ der 'khod pa mang pos phyag dbang zhus pas/ phyag gnyis ka dang ya gcig dang chos kyis dril ba sogs kyi sgo nas drag zhan gyi phyag dbang gnang lugs kyi dbye ba rje gong ma ji lta ba bzhin du gnang / gu shis mjal bar 'ongs te/ rje gong ma'i phyag 'phrong dang phyag rjes la 'dra min bcu gcig tsam dang bsres te gzigs su phul ba/ ma 'dres pa so sor ngos 'dzin mdzad pas yid ches kyi gnas su gyur te dad pa lhag par skyes/ de nas gsol dpon tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang /nang so dka' bcu pas gong gi skad cha'i gnas tshul thos te brtag dpyad byed pa dang bcas mjal bar 'ongs pas/ gsol dpon pa sogs phyag phyi rnying pa rnams kyi spyi bor phyag 'jog pa dang lhan cig tu/ so so'i ming nas bos te ngos 'dzin mdzad pas kun smra mi shes pa'i dad pa thob bo/ /(12ba〉rgong rnams kyis phul ba'i mjal dar mchod shoms kyi rten rnams kyi na bzar sgron pa gnang / de ni gsol dpon pa drung 'khor rnying pa yin pa dang / zham 'bring ba'i mjal mi'i thog mar song bas dpon slob gsar rnying thams cad zhal 'dzom pa dang / dbus phyogs nor 'dzin gyi thig ler myur du 'byon pa'i rten 'brel gyi dgos pa khyad par can la dgongs pa 'dra/lcags yos kyi lo thu med kyi rgyal pos mjal bar byon pas/ na tshod phra yang zhus pa dang bag tsha ba med par/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas rgyal po 'khor bcas bde bar gnas sam zhes gsungs pas/rje gong ma dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis mchi ma zhabrug cing ba spu ldang bar gyur/ rgyal po'i phyag phyir li thang —175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yoshegi lha chen bzheng ba'i bal po yod par/ ming nas bos te ngos 'dzin gnang / tsha rdor nang sos rje gong ma'i thugs dam rten mgon po zhal gyi thang kha/ phyag dpe/ chibs pa a bal ser po/ zur ge sngon po rnams khyer yongs pa dang dus mtshungs par/ sa g.yo zhing 'brug gi sgra chen po bsgrags/ phyag dpe zhal thang rnams la ngos 'dzin mdzad/ a bal ser po la chibs nas/ gzims gur la bskor ba lan gsum mdzad de dbus la 'di ltar 'gro zhes bka' stsal/ chibs las bshol te gzims gur du stan la bzhugs te/ nyams dga' zhing bag phebs pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ gsol ja zhal dkar gang der 'dus pa'i skye bo mang po zhig la gnang bas/ thams cad kyi skom pa sel nus pa'i ya mtshan pa byung / de skabs rten zhig la rab gnas zhu mkhan byung bar/ rab gnas (13na〉kye cho ga sogs sngon chad gzigs rtog mdzad ma myong yang / thog mar gsung gi gdangs drag po dang bcas te/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ces bgegs sprod pa'i tshul dang / phyag rgya dang gar dbyangs mang po'i rnam pa dang / lha spyan 'dren pa dang bstim pa'i tshul mdzad do/ /rje gong ma'i sku zhang rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba kun bzang rtse ba byon/ gong ma'i thang zhu dang phyag dril gzigs 'bul mdzad pas/ ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen par gyur/ gang zag tha mal ba'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i 'phags chen dam pa'i mdzad pa rlabs po che'i snyan grags phyogs kun tu khyab pa la brten/ rgya bod hor gsum gyi skye bo mtha' klas pa mkho rgu'i 'byor pa ji snyed pa dang bcas te dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur 'dus/ chos rjes mdung rtse bar khyed kyi lag gi dngul phor de ta'i ching no yon rgyas phul ba yin/ da sne gdong rtser 'bul dgos 'dug bka' phebs/ nyin gcig mkha' la 'ja' tshon gyi dra ba rma bya'i gdugs ltar phub pa'i sna la dar dkar gyi thag pa brkyangs pa 'dra ba gsum byung ba'i gcig gzims gur gyi steng / gcig sgar gyi dkyil/ gcig yab yum gyi gur la zug /de'i nyin mjal bar 'ongs pa rnams la/ thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa dang / yi ge hūm̐ yig dkar po dang / 'od dkar po'i thig le dang / ral pa'i lcang lo can phyam rtsa dkar po bzhes pa bla ma nyid kyi —176

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)rnam pa can sogs mthong tshul mi 'dra ba mang du byung bas/ skye rgu mtha' dag rje gong ma'i mchog gi sprul sku mu tshom dang bral ba'i nges shes rnyed de/ phyag dang / skor ba dang bshags (13ba)pa dang rjes su yi rang la sogs dge ba bcu'i las lam dbyar gyi chu mtsho lta bur 'phel bar gyur to/ /phun tsho gis gru 'dzin ri bo'i pho brang nas/ /rab stims rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i gzugs/ /mtha' 'khob gdul dka'i 'gro ba 'dren slad du/ /sna tshogs sgyu dra'i rol gar de med byung / /'khor 'dasamanyam nyid mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /mngon du gyur kyang blun rmongs 'gro ba'i ngor/ /tshe ring gnam gyi rigs su srid 'dzin pa'i/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i dge mtshan ci yang ston/ /'gro la rjes su chags pa'i chu gter las/ /legs 'ongs rgyal sras zla tshes gzhone nu dag /spangs rtogs yon tan cha shas gong 'phel ba'i/ /snyan grags rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin yol ba med/ /dga' ba zhes pa chu pho 'brug gi lo gsar pa'i cho 'phrul gyi dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma rnams zhal gzigs/ mkhar sngon por myur du 'byon pa legs pa'i gsung gi snang ba stsal ba ltar/ de bzhin du mkhar sngon por phebs pa 'gab tshul nye 'khor du yod pa rnams la gsungs shing / rgyal po rgyal mo sogs la yang rgyu mtshan gnang / nyin gcig phyi rol tu phebs nas thag ha cang mi ring ba zhig na/ sa la phyag mdzub gtad nas 'di'i 'og na khro yod gsungs pas/ der 'dus pa rnams kyis sakhyu do tsam gyi bar du brkos kyang ma rnyed/ su mi tha'i ji de rang gi sras su skyes bu dam pa byon pa'i sbur lta bu'i rnam pas/ thugs rig la steng shong yong 'dug pas la la zhig gis (14nasgo sbo gar yod/ smyon pa de'i bus zer ba la tha snyad mi yong zhes gleng / phal che ba dag gis/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam sprul du ni gor ma chag pas khro nges par yod do zhes/ slar yang sa khru gang tsam zhig brus pa'i 'og nasakhro shin tu che ba kha la mis skor ba byed thub pa zhig 'thon pa/ sa'i steng du 'dren pa la shes rab kyi rtsal mgrin bzang gi grogs por gyur pa dag mang bas/ re zhig rngo ma thogs par lus de nas rgya — 177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)nang du khro chen po 'di sa'i steng du 'dren pa'i mi zhig thong zhes yi ge rgyab pas/ rgya mi gnyis kyi 'ongs te dka' tshegs med par drangs nas skyed bu'i steng du bcugs pas/ skye bo mang pos bza' btung gi rim pa mngon par 'du byed pa'i gnas su byas so/ /hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ sku zhad rin po che kun bzang rtse ba dang / mnyu chos rjes gtsos pa'i bod sog gi ban+de mang po dang / rgyal po rgyal mo hor tha'i ji sogs skye bo'i tshogs grangs med pa gdan 'dren la 'byor/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin chibs pa zur dge sngon po la chibs te/ gdan 'dren pa rnams dang chibs skyel pa yab kyis gtsos pa'i rta pa stong phrag tsam gyis bskor te phebs/ phyag mdzub gtad nas lam 'di na mchod rten dkar po zhig yod gsungs par/ sku 'khor ba 'ga' zhig gis phyogs der phebs myong lags sam zhus pas/ ngas sngon phyogs der 'gro myong ba yin zhes sogs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung kha yar bka' stsal/ de'i tshe cha dkar rgyal pos dpon po phun tshogs kyis gtsos pa'i rta pa lnga brgya tsam zang zing gi dngos (14ba)po mang po dang bcas te mngags pa 'byor/phyag dbang zhus pas phun tshogs yongs pa e yin zhes ngos 'dzin mdzad/ rgya mi zhig gis bla ma khyed su yin ngas ngo ma shes zhes tshod bgam par/ khyod rang nga la the tshom byed mi dgos/ spyan ras gzigs su mos la gsol ba thob cig ces gsungs pas spobs pa med par gyur/ mchod rten dkar por phebs pa'i tshe/ dkon cog tha'i jis gtsos pa'i rta pa lnga brgya tsam bsu ba la 'byor bas/ bka' las rten 'brel legs 'di na nga'i khri yod pas re zhig sdod gsungs nas khri khar bzhugs te/ zhu ba po med par bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel zhig stsal/ de ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi mi bslu ba'i skyabs gnas ni dkon cog rin po che rnam pa gsum yin la/ nga'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i rgyal rigs kyi bsu ba la 'ongs pa dang / lus can kun gyi mchod pa'i zhing dam pa ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa yin la/ de nyid dkar 'jam du 'gro ba'i brdar mchod rten dkar po'i 'khris su phebs pa dang phebs bsu ba rnams rtse 'dzoms byung ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i brdar der rje gong ma'i bzhugs khri yod pa — 178

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i phreng ba/ 6)sogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bde chen chos kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyis bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /de nas rje gong ma nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas khyad par can der/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mchod pa'i bye brag du ma thogs pas mdun bdar te phebs/ gong ma'i bzhugs khri'i khar zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par bkod de/ der 'khod pa'i skya ser gyi (15na)khrom chen po'i dbus su rje gong ma'i mdzad pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus tsam dang / ma 'ongs pa 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan rags rim zhig 'jigs pa med pa'i gsung gis bka' stsal/ gzims chung dang mgon khang rnams su phebs te/ mchod shoms/ gtor ma/ zhal 'bag sogs so sor ngos 'dzin gnang / de nas re zhig gi bar phyag bris 'dri klog /phyag dpe 'dzin pa sogs thugs gnyer gyi rim pa rnams/rin po che kun bzang rtse nas kyis phul bas 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par dka' tshegs chung ngus mkhyen pas/ rin po che ba de chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa'i zhal ngor song ba dang / dkon gnyer dpon pa la sde srid phag mo gru pas bkur bzos che zhing / sne'u gdong rtse dang gzhis ka gong dkar gyi pho brang yas mas gnyis ni lugs gnyis kyi yon tan can mtha' dag 'du sa khyad par can yin pas/rnam dpyod kyi rtsal cung zad tsam yang mi ldan pa'i bla chen gyi ming gog skam po thams cad la khong pa thugs mgu mkhan zhig min pa 'dug kyang / rje 'di nyid la zhabs drung rin po che bsod nams rgya mtsho de nyid dang khyad par mi 'dug ces gus pa yin skad/ mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ de nas bgrang bya gsum pa'i dus/ khu kho kho tor 'gro zhes gsungs/ /de na dpag yas skye bo'i tshogs/ /smin dang grol ba'i lam la bkod/ snyan grags ma la ya yi dri/ /bstan skyong bser bus bskyod pa las/ /'jig rten gsum du khyab pa na/ /zhes so/ /de skabs phyag mdzod kyi khur len byed mi gsol dpon tshul khrims rgya mtsho phyag g.yog tu 'gyur par ma zad/ drung 'khor drag (15bskos tshang ma dang 'grogs lugs mkhas shing legs pas/ rin po che kun bzang rtse pa de sku zhabs su car mar bzhugs pa gnang /— 179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yophyag mdzod gu shri bla ma la gus zhen che ba ni yongs su grags/ 'jig rten phyogs kyi mdzad sgo ha cang gi zhib cha mi che ba zhig la/ phyi bla gang che zhing nang phyag rdzas la ru nga ba/ mthon po'i gnya' gcog dma' ba'i stong bstar sogs sgar gyi 'dzin tshul dang / sbyin bdag gi sne len zhi drag gis 'dul thabs la mnga' brnyes
