par 'gran zla dang bral zhes kun mthun par gleng yang / chos phyogs nas bla ma la sku yon dgos mi dgos dang / sku yon 'bul mkhan la yon tan yod med kyi rnam dbye phyed po zhig med 'dug pa dang / lhag par rje gong ma'i drung 'khor kun bzang rtse pas gtsos pa'i drag rim zhig dang mtho gnon gyi rnam pas thugs ka mi mthun pa'i stabs kyis/ phyag mdzod byon nas bzung rin po che pasakyang sku zhabs su bcar ma bsdad pa yin skad/ nges pa'i don du rje gong ma dang thugs rgyud gcig pas/gsan bsam mdzad pa la ma ltos kyang / rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras pos 'og min du sangs rgyas zin nas 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa sogs/ sngon gyi mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyang thos bsam gyi phyir dka' spyad mang du mdzad pas/ sku ga zloge sa kyi tsho 'dzin dang sku yon 'bul mkhan la rin po che kun bzang rtse nas de yun mi thung tsam zhig bzhugs thub na/ mtshan nyid pa'i ston pa rig pa'i mdas rang gzhan thams cad thal mar 'bigs nus pa zhig (16na)ma byung na'ang / rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa dang phra zhib phyag len la brten nas/don gnyis rlabs po che lhun gyis grub pa zhig 'ong rgyur 'dug kyang / drung du nye bar 'khod pa mtha' dag mjug ma med pa'i rdo rje'i rna ldan sha stag tu song bas/ gsan bsam gyi 'phror lus so/ /phyag mdzod chen po mtshan dngos dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ rgya nag gong ma'i lung gi gu shri/ 'jig rten yongs la phyag mdzod seng ger grags pa'i sgra skad can des/ dbus phyogs su rje gong ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnams legs par grub nas/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku sog yul du byon pa'i gtam snyan rna ba'i bcud len du gyur pa la brten/ rang nyid na tshod yol ba la ma ltos par/ dge ba'i bshesaganyen bsten pa la byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rnam par thar pa la 'gran par nus pa'i snying stobs — /80

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ (nyanakyi go cha btsan po gyon nas/ sgar dmangs dang bcas te dbus nas bteg /de dang phyogs mthun par/pho brang chen po sne'u gdong rtse nas gong ma mi'i dbang phyug mi pham dbang gyur rgyal po zhes bod shing sgo can thams cad kyi bla dpon zung du 'jug pa'i gtsug gi nor bu de nyid dang / de mtshungs pho brang chen po gong ri dkar po nas/ gangs can pu rnams kyi mgon gcig bu rlangs ston chos kyi rgyal po lha gzigs ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / shun nas zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po che gsum gyi mi snas gtsos/ 'od gsal lha yi gdung 'dzin sa skyong rgya ri ba/ byang phyogs mi'i rje bo sa skyong dga' ldan pa sogs sde (16ba〉dpon che phra mang po dang / ser 'bras dge gsum gyis thog drangs pa'i chos sde khag rnams kyi gdan 'dren pa dang bcas mkhar sngon por 'byor/thog mar mjal ba'i tshe/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyis ngos 'dzin gyi gsung du ma stsal bas/ phyag mdzod kyis gtsos pa'i drung 'khor rnying pa rnams/ rje gong ma dran pas dga' ba dang skyo ba spel ma'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs bstan/ mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ phyag mdzod dpal ldan rgya mtsho 'dis/ /byang 'phags bzhin du lus srog la/ /ltos med phyogs der 'byor pa na/ /yid ches gsung gi ngos 'dzin gyis/ /'byul med gong ma rjes su dran/ /tshes pa snga phyi'i nyi ma dang / /dkyil 'khor gcig pa ji bzhin du/ /mgon khyod mthong ba don ldan du/ /gzugs sku so so thugs rgyud gcig /ces so/ khri rin po che rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshos rwa sgreng du gnas gzigs la phebs dus/ ka gnyis ma'i nang du phyags ma phud par byon pas/ jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rjes/ brtson 'grus g.yung drung khyod nga'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du mchil lham ma phud par yong ba ci yin zhes gsung byon pas/ khu ston yin par don gyis lung bstan cing / thams cad mkhyen pa bsod rnams rgya mtsho gzhis ka brag dkar du phebs skabs shig /yang dgon zhabs drung sogs drung 'khor 'ga' zhig la/ de ring nged rang tsho khu ston dang mjal ba 'dug gsungs pas/ rkyang thang sgang gi dkyil tsam du zhal snga nas rgyal khang rtse pa dang mjal/ de nub yang dgon zhabs drung gis/ de ring khu ston dang mja la ba ma byung lags zhus pas/ nged rang (17na skong —181 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skarkyang thang sgang du phrad byung zhes/ bod kyi mkhas pa chen por ngos bzung ba de nyid dga' ldan gi khri zur bzhugs mdzad nas/ rgyal khang rtser bzhugs skabs yin 'dug pas/ phyag mdzod gu shri sog yul du spyan 'dren la 'byon gdong / 'phral yun gyi gsung gleng mang du gnang zhing / khyad par nged na tshod mthosapas sog yul du sku zhabs su sleb pa zhig mi yong 'dug kyang / ding sang dbus gtsang du rang phyogasakyi bla ma'i rgan mgo nged rang yin pa nas zhabs drung rin po cher mtshan 'bul ba'i babs 'brel 'dug pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho dpal bzang po zhes mtshan 'bul rgyu phul bas/ 'di nas bzung mchog dman kun la mtshan 'di nyi zla ltar grags so/ /dgung lo bcu bzhi ma bzhes kyi bar du gnod sbyin phyogs kyi phang par gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bzhugs te/ nyin re bzhin du sog po tsho chen drug gi 'bul ba sogs ni rgyal po chen pos dpya khral bsdu ba bzhin dang / dpal 'byor longs spyod rnam thos kyi bu'i khengs pa 'phrog nus pa ste/ dus tshod de'i stobs mnga' thang la/ gar 'brug sprul sku sogs kyis gtsos pa'i bla chen sgar pa'i rigs 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad po'i nyams len la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad de/ mar chur nas sran sogs kyi 'bul ba phran bu la'ang / brgya 'bul du ming btags nas/ khrom chen po'i dbus su len zhing / mthong bas don dang ldan par grags pa kun la ma byung 'dug /sngon dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dus rgya hor gyi 'brel lam che zhing / bar du ga me pa de bzhin gshegs (17ba)pa rta ming rgyal po dang mchod yon du song ba sogs rgya hor gyi ti grir gyur pas/ dngos spyad bzang rngams che che mo mang po la longs su spyad pa dang / la la bod dang bod khams rnams su ja snam phrug byu ru spos shel gyis gtso byas/nas dang tshwa nyigs kyi mtha' brten pa la 'bul ba chen por byed pa thams cad/ sngon gyi chos pa bzang po jo bo bka' gdams pa dang / phyag rdzogs kyi sgom chen bya ba btang nges shig gis brtags na/ rmi lam sgyu ma'i rol rtsed du 'char bas bzang ngan ma mchis mod/ ding dus kyi chos pa rgyal po kri gri'i rmi lam lung bstan gyis zin pa rnams la/ rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las kyang zang zing gi rjes su 'gro ldog — 182

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)pa ngos 'dzin pa/ rje mi la dang / ba ri lo tsā ba'i dpe ltar 'jig rten blun rmongs kyi snang ngor grags pas/srid 'byor gyi phun tsho gos la thob bya'i gtso bor 'dzin phyin/ dngos po ga ngon tsam la bzang por rlom pa las/ rgya hor gyi dus kyi spyod pa khyad 'phags pa dag la longs su spyod par rigs sam snyam mo/ /pho brang gong ri dkar po nas 'jang 'tsho byed shes rab rgyal mtshan sog yul du gdan 'dren la gnang rjes/ chibs kha myur du sgyur ba yod tshul sogs kyi zhu yig phul ba'i lan du/ dpal phag mo gru pa lha gzigs bka' brgyud rnam par rgyal bas 'di ltar gnang ste/ tshogs gnyis mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /dag pa gnyis ldan sku de be+e ḍūr+ya'i/ /rang bzhin rdul bral ston pa sman gyi blas/ khyod la dge legs 'dod rgyar sgyur du gsol/ /gang gi skyes stobs shes rab ri byi yis/ /gzhung lugasagaṅgā hub kyis drangs gyur nas/ /(18na phor yang gso rig yan lag brgyad ldan gyi/ /chab tu byas nas 'gro la brims mkhas pa/ /blo bzang drang srong mchog khyod ring mo nas/ /yid la gcags shing mdza' bas bcings gyur pas/ /lhag bsam zla ba'i 'od kyi byugs pa bzhin/ /kun tu dkar ba'i 'phrin 'di rgyang nas smras/ 3/snang rig rjes sbyangs yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /gshog rlabs gzhen nu'i dus nas rab rdzogs pa/ /rnam dpyod mdongs mthas mdzes pa'i rma bya khyod/ /rgyal sras mchog gi spyan sngar ring gnas mngags/ 4/dpag tshad 'bum phrag brjod kyis mi lang ba'i/ /rgya chen nor 'dzin khyon de snying stobs kyi/ /'phur lding dal gyis rgyu bas rab bgrod pa'i/ /spyod tshul zab mo de la glo ba dga'/ 5/rim gyis gangs can las kyang byang gi phyogs/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba se chen gyi/ /rigasakyi thu bo gang de'i pho brang cher/ /bde bar son de mchog tu skal ba bzang / 6/gang der rgyal ba rnamasakyi mkhyen brtse'i gzugs/ /'gro blo'i legs byas me long la shar ba/ /ngo mtshar gsang ba bsam gyisami khyab pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul che la yon tan rgya mtsho zhes/7 /snyan grags lha yi rnga gsang stong sgrog cing / /sa gsum thugs rje'i char gyis bran pa'i tshe/ /phan bde'i lo tog ci yang 'phel 'gyur bas/ /dga' ba'i rma bya khyod kyang gar gyis shig //gang gis zhabs sen mtshan bzang 'khor lo yi/ /rtsibs stong mngon —183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skapar bkra ba mtha' 'khob kyi/ /rgyal rigs bye ba'i cod pan dang 'grogs pa/ khri gshog rgyal mo'i mtsho khar phag gi lor/ 9 /yan lag bzhi ldan gser kyis srab (18ba〉〉gas can/ kha lo sgyur zhing dge bar lhun chags zhes/ /sems la 'bab pa mdza' ba'i 'phrin yig dar/ /rna bar 'jeb cing gshin pa snyan po'i gtam/ 10 /stong 'khun mdzes ma'i lag sor 'du byed kyis/ /ding phon thags su grub pa'i par dang bcas/ /pho lhas dga' ba'i 'dzum dang lhan cig tu/ /son pas kun dga'i bdud rtsi ci yang thob/11/'di na lha gzigs rlangs kyi drang srong cag /sngon du shugs drag nad kyis yun ring gtses/ /'jig rten pha rol mthong bar rtsom na yang / /bslu med mchog gsum thugs rje'i thigs pa yis/ 12/srog gi rten dang lus kyi zungs gyur pa'i/ /ding sang dus na snyom dwangs bde ba dang / /gtsug lag gnyis ldan rgyal thabs khri 'phangs la/ /gzu bor mnyam par 'jog pas 'tsho zhing mchis/ 13/kwa ye gcig tu dkar ba'i lhag bsam dang / /gzod ma nyid nas gnyen gshin rgan po'i blos/ /gcam bu bskyungs te nan tur chen po yis/ /slar yang mol mchid yang dang yang smras pa/ 14/gangs can skye rgu'i bsod nams rgya mtsho che/ /dus las ma yol ngo mtshar rlabs kyi 'dzum/ /dge bar bzhad pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ /nam zhig mngon sum mthong snyam 'di skad zhus/ 15/kye ma snyigs dus mar ngor gyur pasan/ /thub bstan zla ba'i 'od kyang 'phel 'grib can/ /blo bzang ring lugs grags pa'i dga' tshal yang / /smag rum mun pas byugs nas ring zhig lon/ 16/des na rgyal ba'i 'phrin las 'jug pa ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab thugs rje'i nyin byed 'od/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su gang ba dang po'i dgung / /shar ri'i spo la 'char (19na tha'i dus min nam/17 /lta bar mi mngon gtsug tor g.yas 'khyil ba/ /bung ba ltar gnag lcang lo ring po can/ /bregs shing rab tu 'byung ba'i byed po ni/ /so so skye bo'i bla mas 'os pa min/ 18/rigs kyi mngon par mtho ba gangs las skyes/ /snying stobs rtul phod dpa' bar lhun chags pa/ /gdong lnga'i dbang po gzhen nur gyur kyang de/ /ri dwags phal gyi rjes su ci phyir 'jug 19/phan dang bde ba'i 'od stong gling bzhi la/ /rim gyis mdzo sum gnang ba thob pa'i —184

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ (nyanaltas/ /legs lam thog ma'i skya rengs dkar pos kyang / /gdung ba'i mun pa drungs nas phyung bar mdzod/ 20/rgya bod mkhas mang gsung gi chu rgyun gyis/ /lan brgyar bkrus pa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing / /'phrul snang sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang 'dir ni/ /rab tu byung zhing zhabs kyis bcags par mdzod/ 21/sngon rabs rje btsun gong mas 'tsho bzhes pa'i/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la bskal brgya'i bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad bskor ba'i/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i tshogs kyang sgrig par mdzod/22/dum bu bcu gnyis sa rnams rdzogs ldan gyi/ /dga' ston 'dod rgur bsgyur la longs spyod pa'i/ /rgya chen smon lam jo bo'i zhal skyin du/ /bden tshig sa bon grung po smin par mdzod/23/mthong bas don ldan 'dzum zhal mngon gyur cing / /zab gsal gsung gi bdud rtsi myong ba yi/ /skal bzang de 'dra ring por mi thogs par/ /bdag gi legs byas mthu las snang bar mdzod/24 /dngos kun thams cad mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin du/ /dag (19ba)pa ye shes sgyu ma chen po'i dpyid/ /mchog dman blo dang 'tsham pa'i rol rtsed kyis/ /gdul bya'i re ba thams cad skong bar mdzod/25 /de ltar rgyal sras gzhen nu mchog de la/ /snying gi pa blo'i khong nas sbrang rtsi'i bu/ /dad pa'i glu dbyangs rgyang nas len pa 'di/ /lan gcig min par nan gyis gsol bar gyis/ 26/drang srong khyod kyang zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /rtag tu 'grogs pa'i skal bzang bsten pa dang / /dri dang gsol ba 'debs pa'i las rnamasal/ /yid las skyes bzhin spobs pa dge bar gyis/ 27/byang chub mchog tu bskyed pa'i gzhan phan sems/ /kun la snyoms pas bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /rtsad nas phyung ste gro rnams dbugs dbyung ba'i/ /thabs tshul rnams la kun tu gzhol bar gyis/28 /'byor pas mtho dang kun tu nyam chung ba/ kun la 'dris pa min par snying snyoms pa'i/ /lhag bsam kun tu bzang po'i sprin phung gis/ yi/ char bzhin du 'khos su phebs par gyis/29/bslab gsum ngur smig gos dang mi 'bral zhing / /dran dang shes bzhin dbang po bag yod pa'i/ /ngang tshul bzang po srog gi phyir du yang / /mi gtong brtul zhugs brtan po bzung bar gyis/30 /slong ba'i tsho gos la dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /yon tan dgos 'dod —185—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yogater chen kha phye nas/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyun/ /'gro kun yi rang gnas su 'bab par gyis/31zhes rab gsum gyi dpyad pas yongs dag pa/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin khyod ring nas dran/ /e ma re ba las kyang ches lhag pa'i/ /yid kyi dga' ston las kyang dga' ston no/32/ de skad rang blo mkhas par ma sbyangs pas/ /(20na)snyan ngag rgyan gyi cha la btang snyams kyang / /byams ldan ma ma'i ngag gis bu la bzhin/ /rang bzhin gsong por smras 'dir rna ba gtod/ 33/ces ri mo rten dang bcas/ lcags mo glang lo chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dge legs su bris/ zhes/ zhabs drung rin po cher bsngags brjod dang snyan 'bul snyan zhing 'jeb pa 'di bzhin gnang 'dug /dbus phyogs su phebs par/ dpon slob thams cad ji ltar sos kyi dus su nyi ma'i 'od kyisagadungs pa'i glang po che/ khrus kyi rdzing bur 'jug pa la rings pa ltar/ nyin zhag re re'i snga phyi'i dusakyi khyad par la yang ltos pas/ phebs grabs kyi sta gon sogs 'bad rtsol chen pos gnang zhing /sgar pa rnams da ni dus tshod dang tshes grangs 'di lta bu la phebs rgyu yin zhes dga' dga' ltar gleng /rgyal po rgyal mo sogs phyogs der 'khod pa rnams kyis/ thabs du ma'i sgo nas yar phebs mi thub pa'i bkag cha dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas mang du mdzad pa la/ blo chung rnams dpal zhus pa dang mgo bo 'khor nas/ phan tshun thams cad sus bshad dang sus labs bden pa'i dpe ltar gyur kyang /phyag mdzod gu shri chen po de blo gros kyi dkyil che ba dang / khyad par hor sog gi lugs ka la mkhas pas thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul chen pos/ dbus phyogs nor 'dzin yangs pa'i rgyal khams su phebs pa la mi mthun pa'i gegs mtha' dag las grol bar mdzad pa ni zla ba sgra gcan las thar pa'i 'od lhar shes ldan rnams kyi yid dbang du khod (20bskos ba 'ad pa yin no/ /de ltar dngos gzhi yar phebs pa la bkag cha mdzad ma thub kyang / phebs rdzongs gra ma 'grig par khag btags pa'i zhag 'phul nyin 'phul byung bar/ rdzong pa sogs ma bsgugs na re 'khang —186

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)byung dogs kyi thugs rnam par srab pa'i 'tshab 'tshub dang / rdzongs pa'i rnyed pa la sred pa'i ltogs bla me 'bar gyi blo brid mtha' dag ji mi snyam par mdzad nas/ ltos med du bzhugs sgar bteg pas/nyin lam bcu tsam song ba na/ rgyal po rgyal mo phebs rdzongs zhu bar bsnyegs nas byon/sgo mang slob dpon zhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub kyis/ de slad rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho des/ /phyogs 'di yal bar bor ba'i mya ngam bzhugs/ /drag pos da dung bar du gdungs pa'i yid/ /gus ldan slob mar bcas pa rjes gzung slad/ /dga' ldan rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po che/ /mkhas mang legs bris 'du ba'i sum rtsen gnas/ /legs bshad rnga chen rdung ba'i 'dun sa che/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i lha gnas nyams dga' bar/ /thugs rjes spyan stong mnga' ba'i gzhon nu zhig /ring nas smon pa'i rang gi bzhed pa'i don/ grub pa bzhin du dgyes pa'i 'dzum dang bcas/ /mdzesabyed lol chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur/ /rgyal sras bdud rtsi'i gter gyur pa/ /med byung mdzad pa'i 'od dkar can/ /dbus gtsang ku mud tshal chen po/ /spro phyir slar yang shar bar gyur/ /ces dang / mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ /dgung lo tshes kyi bar dag tu/ /byang phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi/ /skye rgu rnams kyi don mdzad nas/ /thugs rje bod du gzhol ba ni/ /gang ga'i rgyun 'dra sus bzlog nus/ /zhes so/ /(21nasgo thag 'dum pa'i khyad dang bcas rgya'i lcags ri dang nye ba'i phyi phyogs kyi lam brgyud de mtsho khar phebs/ der dpon po kho lo ches/ 'dir lo gsum tsam bzhugs kyang zla ba gsum tsam gyi yun tshad kyi nyams las mi yong ba 'dug pas/ bzhugs dgos zhug par/ phyag mdzod kyi gsung las/ nyi ma la nye ring med kyang brag phug kha byang bltas su nyi ma mi 'char ba chos nyid yin pa ltar/nged dpon slob sems can la nye ring med kyang 'dir de tsam bzhugs ga nas thub ces thag chod mdzad/ phyogs de'i skye rgu rnams la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon bskrun te/ zla ba gnyis gsum tsam nas bzhugs sgar bteg /de'i tshe dpon po kho lo che'i thugs la kho rang gi phebs rdzongs byas ma grub gong la thegs mi yong ba gzhir bzhag gi le lo'i dbang du btang bas/ sgar gyi zhabs phyi —187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (yem zin par mtsho skya ring sngo ring gi bar du bsnyegs te phebs skyel dang 'bul ba mdzad par byon/ dpon pos phyag mdzod par/ khyed dpon slob nges par phebs rgyu yin na 'phros mi gtong ba zhes zhus pas/ /lan du tshe grangs 'di tsam zhig la phebs rgyu yin zhes ni yang yang byas/ de las spros pa'i nged dpon slob thegs par khyed la dgongs pa zhu gang thub ces gsung sgam po byon skad/ /rim gyis phebs pas khrums kyi zla ba'i nang du/ mgon po snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'dra ba'i gar mkhan dpal mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan cing / 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal pos phyag bdar nas btab pa'i/ byang rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su phebs/ mang ja 'gyed sogs gya nom pas dge 'dun la (21ba)bsnyen bkur/ chos khri'i steng du phebs te bka' gdams glegs bam gyi chos gsungs pas/me tog gi char 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba na/ 'brom rang nyid kyi gdan sar phebs nas gsang chos glegs bam gsung ba la lha rnams kyis mchod pa phul bar 'dug /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du/ nged rang gis bka' gdamasaglegs bam gyi chos gang 'chad sar ltas ya mtshan pa sna tshogs 'byung ba ni chos kyi che ba yin gsung ba/chos dang gang zag gnyis zung du 'brel ba zhig dgos pa yin 'dra/ deng sang ni glegs bam 'chad mkhan rnams la de 'dra ba 'byung ba dka' bar snang ngo / /dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa sangs rgyas rin cen gdan 'dren la phebs/ dga' ldan spyi sger byings kyi sngon la 'byon pa de phyag mdzod gu gris khyed rang byings las g.yer du 'thon pa zhig mdzod/rab byung gnang ba'i mkhan po sogs bdag rkyen gang legs yod pa'i ban rtsa nged rang nas byed/ /ces nang sbyar gyi yi ge btang ba 'ol kha ba'i zhen yin par gleng / de nas dwags po'i bka' brgyud kyi 'byung gnas/ gdan sa chen po dpal phag mo gru'i mtsho chen ma dros pa las 'ongs pa'i/ phyag rgya chen po'i chu klung gcig tu 'khyil ba stag lung du phyag mdzod pa dang rtags brgyad dpon sogs drung 'khor che bgres rnams kyi chibs bsu dang / dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas ser —188

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)sbrengs dang bcas te phebs/ spyir 'jig rten gyi gtam dpe la gtsang nag pas/ stag lung mkhas pas ma bzung zhes gsungs par grags (22na)kyang / khri thog pa zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal de/ gsung rab mtha' dag la gsan gzigs che zhing mkhas btsun bzang por bzhugs zhes snyan grags che/mjal 'dzom gyi tshe drung 'khor khrod nas zhabs drung gong ma las gdung rus che ba dang / sog po'i gshed mo la brten pa'i da lam rtsod pa btang na stag lung chos rjes phyag 'bul yong zhus par/ bla dpon ci rigs kyi byed pa ltar/ gnas dus la brten pa'i dbang gshed dang 'gro 'tshams spel mar song na/dpal ldan sa skya pa dang sne gdong gong ma la yang brnyas chos byed par ya nga bag tsha med pa tsho dang mi 'dra bar/ /phyag mdzod gu shri dang sku mdun rin po che gnyis rang gi tshugs ka zin cing gzhan la 'gro 'tshams mi mdzad pa'i ya rabs pas/ rje gong ma'i dus mjal 'dzom mdzad pa kho nas chog ces rgyal tshod 'dzin pa mdzad/ der stag lung lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur gya nom pa btab/ phar gdab lan gyi 'bul gnang mang 'gyed phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/de'i tshe sa skyong dga' ldan pa mi dbang g.yul rgyal nor bu yab sras dang / dga' ldan pho brang nas dpon gnyer sku mdun rin po che chos bzang 'phrin las pa sogs gdan 'dren pa phal cher 'byor/sku mdun rin po ches chibs pa snang srid kun ldan/ a drung chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang bcas phul ba la shin tu mnyes pa byung skad/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ de slad chibs kha phyogs 'dir bsgyur/ /lam bar ring yang spro bzhin du/ /thugs rjes kha ba can du byon/ /rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su/ /yon tan (22ba〉khyung gnas sprul pa'i sku/ /phebs nas glegs bam gsungs pas/ /me tog char sogs ltas bzang byung / /stag lung chos rjes bsnyen bkur te/ /zhal 'dzom chos kyi gleng mo mdzad/ /de nas sa skyong dga' ldan pa/ /mchod yon rnams kyi bsu pa'i dper/ /thub dbang ser skyar gshegs pa'i tshe/ shwakya rnams kyi mjal de 'os/ /zhes the tho/ /—189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yophan yul nang du phebs pa na/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i chos kyi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i zhal snga nas dge 'dun rgyal mtshan pa bsu bar phebs/ zhal snga nas khri rin po ches phyag phul bar bzhed pa ma gnang bar/ la la dag gis stag lung chos rje phyag 'tshal du mi 'jug /rang re'i bla ma bsres po 'di phyag 'tshal du bcug ces phyag mdzod pa la kha zer/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ bod kyi che rgyas phyag btsal yang / /ldang ba tsam yang ma mdzad pa/ /rigs kyi snyems pa ma yin te/ /mya ngan med byin rnam thar bzhin/ /zhes pa 'di dag la bsam pa 'dra/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du/khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i 'dus pa legs bshad kyi rdza rnga sgrog pa ngang pa'i khyu chen po dag gis sngun bsus te phebs/ de'i tshe nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang me tog gi char chen po babs/gtsug lag khang rnams kyi gnas gzigs zhib par gnang / khyad par dngul gdung rin po che mjal ba'i dus/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa zhal gzigs/ gnyug mar gnas pa dang glo bur du lhags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la mang ja 'gyed sogs zang zing gi dngos po gya nom pas tshim par mdzad/ /(23na spros gas chen du dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel ba stsal/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ 'phan yul gzhud nas dga' ldan du/ /phebs tshe dge 'dun tsho gis kyisabasus/ /phyag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /dus der nam mkha' g.ya' dag kyang / /me tog char pa ci yang babs/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis tshim mdzad cing / /dad pa'i ljon pa mtha' yas bskrun/ /yab rje'i dngul gdung mjal ba na/ /'jam dpal snying po'i gzigs snang byung / /bka' dang bstan bcos rig gnas la/ /sbyangs shing mkhyen rnams legs bshad kyi/ /'brug sgra sgrog pas shin tu mdzes/ /rgyal sras mchog gi dam chos gsungs/ /zhes so/ / bod gangs can gyi lte ba ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang chen por phebs par nye ba na/skya ser gyi gdan 'dren mtha' yas pa'i chibs rags bgrang bar dka' ba dag gis/ khrom khri phrag mang po brgal te tshogs pa rnams kyi mig lam du/ ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan gyis/—190

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)e ma ma la/ 'di 'dra ba'i mig gi dga' ston ni sgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul pa zhig yin nam zhes gleng zhing /phal che ba dag ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po de nyid dran pa'i gdung ba'i shugs kyi mig nas mchi ma 'khrug cing / ngag nas gsol 'debs kyi sgra chen po dar dir du sgrog par gyur to/ /sgo mang slob dpon bzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub kyis/ gzhon nur gyur kyang dbang po zhi/ /rgyan gzhan bral yang mchog tu mdzes/ /srid par gnas kyang nyon mongs med/ /mgon (24ba〉gid mthong ba skal ba bzang / khyod zhal zla ba mthong ba yi/ /dga' ba 'jig rten la rgyas pa/ /de 'dra srog chags 'gum pa ni/ /slar yang sos pa dag la med/ /mgon khyod gdul bya'i 'jig rten la/ /snying rjes kun nas brtse ba tsam/ /snying du sdug pa'i bu gcig pa'i/ /ma la'ang de 'dra skye ma lags/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje la/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes snyan grags pa'i/ /gtam snyan rnga ba'i ༄ la la/ khyed kyis mig la mngon sum mdzod/ /ces dang / mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ lha mchog jo bo bzhugs pa'i sa/ /skyid shod mthil du phebs pa na/ /bgrang bar dka' ba'i chibs rags kyis/khrom chen mig gi dga' ston bsgrubs/ /zhes so/ /de nas sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan pa'i gsung las/ de dang 'brel bar byang phyogs sa skyong gi /pho brang rgya bod kun gyis gtugs pa'i gnas/ dga' ldan khang gsar zhes bya lcang lo can/ /nor ldan dpal mo mgron du bos 'dra yod/ /ces bsngags brjod mdzad pa'i gzhis ka dga' ldan khang gsar du spyan drangs/ gzhi len dang shangs len sogs gang la gang 'tsham dngos gtsang zhing dpangs mtho ba'i dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad/ sde pa chos rje'i gtsug phud phul zhing / 'bul bar ston rje gong ma'i dus su zhabs drung bkra shis rab brtan pa zhes/ lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa de la mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung du mdzes pa'i dpe ltar/ gtsug lag lugs brgya'i tshul la 'jug pa yangs pa'i blo gros dang khengs pa phan tshun du 'gan bzod pa'i rin spungs zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jigs — 191 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yogrags kyis/ pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i lha gzigs gdung brgyud ngag (24na/dbang bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal bzang ba dpon g.yog gzigs stabs ma gcig pa'i rgyu la brten/ rtse nasazhal phyogs bsgyur ba gnang g.yin sde rnams kyis zhabs nas bkur ba'i dpung gtos che ba yar klung du 'byor na'ang / 'gro lding ba'i skabs/ skyid shod mi'i rje bo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor par snyems pa'i rwa rtsa sbom pa bkra shis rab brtan pa la 'phrin du bya ba yon tan gsum gyi do shal zhes bya bar/ stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rwa/ /chos kyi dbyings na gdengs pa'i nyams gcig tu/ /drag po me yi ral pa gsig pa'i gar/ /'jigs byed bdud las rnam par rgyal ba mchod/ /de nyid bskyed pa'i rim pa zab mo yi/ /rnal 'byor snying la lci ba'i khur bsnams nas/ /dngos grub mtshan nyid yan lag brgyad ldan pa'i/ 'byor brtsen lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung lo/ /ya mtshan mgur na mdzes pa'i do shal gyis/ /'phreng ba yon tan gsum gyi do shal du/ /'phags pa'i spyod pa gzhan dag med sems pa'i/ /skad sangs sgrog par bya de rigs sam kye/ /rtul phod longs su spyod pa brgyan pa yi/ /dpung pa grags pa'i sa bon 'debs nus pa/ /mthar byed skye ba'i lam ster ma gyur pa/ /gang dag srid pa'i 'khor lo med byung bkra/ /e ma rig pa'i me tog sna ba sa /'bar dang sgyu rtsal gzhan gsos gar+sha ne nu'i glu/ /bye bar bsgrengs pa'i sgra des sa gsum gyi/ /dpal mo chags pas mi gzir rgyu ci zhig /lha gzigs dbang po'i chab srid gru bo che/ /'jing zhing 'degs pa'i rnam 'gyur chu bo yis/ /byed po'i ri mo gcig min (24ba〉thang gnyer bar/ /dbu 'phreng sems med ma yang gad mo dgod/ /ces sogs 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rjes su bzung ba'i snyan pa dang / bod shing sgo can gyi rgyal srid 'di 'chags 'jig ji ltar byed kyang khyod kyi lag tu yod do zhes/ mdun na 'don gyi gtso bo dang / dpa' mdzangs rtul phod pa sogs la brten/ zol gyi bstod pa'am smad pa gang rung du snyan ngag mkhan gyi dgongs pa'i dbang gis 'then chog pa'i tshig sbyor ngo mtshar ba dang / mnangs kyi dus na lha gcig khyod kyi srid/ /'jig dang mi 'jig mngon sum brten pa'i srog /sbyin pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'bab —/92

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)stegs mkhan/ /'di las gzhan pa btsal du yod dam ci/ /tshul de mi brjed mdza' bas bcings pa'i sems/ g.yo med brtan pa'i phyi thag ring po pa/ /byas shes drin du gang ba'i dga' byed grogs/ /ha nu mar+sha'i brtul zhugs rdzogs par 'tshal/ /de'i don/ lha gcig ces bos nas khyod kyi sde srid 'di dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' drin la brten nas byung ba yin pas/ tshul de la byas shes drin du gzo ba'i sgo nas/ ram ṇa sa lang ku'i bdag po gsod pa'i grogs spre'u ha nu na byas pa dang mtshungs pa zhig gyis zhes brjod pa 'di/ skyid shod zhabs drung bkra shis rab brtan pa mnga' thang mtho ba dang / dgra thog la dpa' zhing mkhyen spyod yangs par song bas/ /rang gzhan kun gyis bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur pa de la/ zhabs drung rin po che bsod nams rgya mtshos/ khyod rang 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor pa yin pas 'di nye bar mkho ba yod gsungs nas/ dngul gyis ka pā li kha gcod la g.yu phra phyug po yod pa zhig (25na)gnang ba/ 'di skabs sde pas ka pā yis gtsos pa'i zang zing gi dngos po mang po dang / chos lung bde legs kyi sa cha rnams 'bul ba mdzad/ zhabs drung g.yul rgyal ba de/ kho rang gi khu bo bkra shis rab brtan pa dang / rin spungasang ga dbang 'jig grags lta bu'i chos phyogs kyi yon tan 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'gran bzod cing / /'jig rten gyi cha nas pha rol gyi dgra dpung 'jomasapa la dpa' ba'i/ a bo hor 'dra'i spyod tshul dang ldan pa zhig min par gda' yang / 'phral du kha la za byung na phugs sna la sgrogs byung na'ang bzod snyam pa'i har spyod hur spyod kyi rigs ye mi mdzad par/ /brtan brling rang tshod che zhing srong btsan sgam po ltar sgam pa'i mthar thug pa/ sngon kyi dus sdosrid khungs btsan rnams kyi spyan ltos ma nyams pa'i/ dkon cog la gus shing rang srid skyong mkhas pa/chos kyis mdzes shing sgrigs kyis spa ba/ ya rabs dam pa'i mdzad spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang tshul can zhig yod par snang / 'dren byed phra la ring ba zhig yin zhes gleng yang / 'di'i skabs thugs snying khams dpe med bskyed pa yin skad do/ /tshes bco lnga'i nyin ser 'bras dga' skyor sogs nyer 'khor gyi dgon sde grangs med pa'i dge —193

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ska'adun rnams 'dus te/ ngur smig gi gos rung ba tshad dang ldan pa'i kha dog gis nam mkha'i lam kun kyang gser gyi mdangs 'dzin par nus pa'i ser sbrengs kyi 'phreng ba ring por bstar/ gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ rol mo/ me tog sogs mchode pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas nor 'dzin gyi lto ba dog por bkod par/sgo mang slob dpon bzhu khang (25ba 'ab stims pa dge legs lhun grub kyis/ khyod kyi med byung mdzad pa'i nyin mor byed/ /gangs can mkha' dbyings mdzes ma'i lang tsho la/ /rtag tu 'od brgya 'gyed pa 'di shar tshe/ /bdag sogs rmongs pa'i smag rum gang du 'bros/ /gru 'dzin ri bo'i ngos la gtsug lag khang / /ma pham mdun sa sa la 'phos 'dra ba/ /brgya phrag ngur ba 'khrigs pa'i chu gter dbus/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs yid dga' chos 'dzin du/ /mkhyen pa gzhig gis dus gsum gsal gzigs kyang / /mkhas pa'i legs bshad pad+mo'i dra ba yis/ /rang gi thugs mtshor slar yang mdzes bskyed na/ /de slad thub bstan 'o mtsho rlabs cher 'gyur/ /legs bshad gsar pa'i chu 'dzin 'byung ba'i gnas/ khyod thugs rab dkar 'o ma'i chu gter che/ /gzhung lugs zla zer bye ba'i gos gyon na/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i lhun po cis mi mdzes/ /zhes dang / mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ se 'bras dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sbrengs/ /mtshar du dngar ba de mthong tshe/ /byams pa'i 'dus pa dang po yang / /da lta nyid nas byung ngam snyam/ /zhes so/ /bla brang khag /khams tshan mi tshan sogs kyi rta pa'i bsu ba dang bcas te/ rgya gar 'phags yul ba'i shrī dha n+ya ka ṭa ka gnyis pa/ bod yul gyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gru 'dzin gnyis pa dga' ldan phor brang gi seng ge'i khrir phebs/ der /bsu ba dang phebs skyel la 'dus pa'i skya ser gyi tshogs chen po la/ sku mdun rin po ches khur bzhes nas bur ston/ mar ston/ sha rtsam nas/ gro sran rnams kyi phogs zur gsos nar ma sogs (26na jig 'a ston rgya chen po bsgrubs/ g.yin yang gzims khang gong / grwa tshang khag bdun/ slob dpon tshul pa/ khams—194

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)tshan mi tshan star dngul sogs phyug po khag mang pos so so'i gnas khang du spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur gya nom pa bstab/ sngar sne'u rdzong pa'i gzhis ka rdo khang sngon mor grags pa chung ngu zhig las spros pa'i pho brang gi lte ba legs rgyu med pa/ rje gong ma sog yul du thegs pa'i rjes dga' ldan pho brang gsar pa 'di nyid/ sku mdun rin po che chos bzang 'phrin las zhes/ zhabs drung gong ma'i gsol dpon sogs/sku zhabs su bcar ba'i las tshan dang / rjes su gzhis kyi phyag mdzod kyi go sar mnga' gsol ba'i bdag rkyen yar 'phel du gnang zhing / dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i phyi nang bar gsum gyi zhabs 'degs phul du phyin par gyur nas/ thugs kyi gtad so thun mong ma yin par gnang / babs nas kyang mkhyen dpyod shin tu yangs pas/ grwa sa gsum gyis gtsos dpal ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan srid spyi'i srog shing tu gyur la/ sde dpon rang srid rnams kyi bka' bgros kyi snying po 'dri ba'i yul/ gzhan srid kun gyis kyang re stos dang mthong gzos che ba de nyid kyi phyag rjes/ 'chi ba med pa'i khang bzang la co 'dri ba 'di nyid bskrun par mdzad cing / ar po'i skabs/ dbyangs can ngag gi dbang phyug sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan pas thugs khur mnyam bces kyi rnam pas/ zhal bkod dang 'u lag gtong ba sogs mthun rkyen mang du bsgrubs/ zhal bkod la phebs res kyi sde pa dpon g.yog tshang mas dan 'bag mda' nas chibs las bshol te rtsig rdo bskyed pa/ rje btsun (26ba)mi las sa mkhar dgu thog rtsig pa la 'gran bzod pa lta bu mdzad skad/ de lta bu'i pho brang 'dir phebs tsam nyid nas thugs bag phebs shing / sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i gsung mang du byon par snang /mkhar los/ dga' ba'i tshal gyi dpal ldan pa/ /phyag na pad+mo'i pho brang du/ /phebs tshe snga dro dgongasakhyad las/ /gsal ba'i sngon byung rjes su dran/ /rgya le chos mdzad la sogs pas/ /gzab bshoms gzims khang gong la sogs/ /spyi sger mang pos mchod pa'i tshe/ /chos kyi gleng mo'i sprin dbyangs dang / /byin rlabs char pa ci yang phab/ /ces so/ /gangs can 'gro la rjes brtse'i gzhan gsos kyis/ /las — 195—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6losmon mgrin pa'i dbyangs snyan 'khor ba na/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sos kyi dpal mo'i bzhin/ /swā la'i ljongs kyi nor 'dzin sto bar ngom/ /rigs dus stobs ra rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ /wo po'i lha min dregs pa'i mngal lhung yang / /bdag bstod g.yin smod gtsor 'dzin mi bsrun yid/ /mi ldan khyod ni sa 'di'i brgya byin bzhin/ khungs can sgro gzhog dang bral pha wang rnams/ /bzang por rdzu ba'i gya gyu'i thabs tshil gyis/ /rtsod med yongs grags wo po'i bya rgod steng / /bgrod 'dod ngang tshul mthong tshe khyod la dad/ /de yang phyag mdzod gu shri chen po sog yul du gdan 'dren la 'byon skabs/ sku mdun rin po che dang bka' bgros zhib tu byung ba dang / gzhan yang drung yig 'jam sras chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs/ rje gong ma'i drung 'khor dang zhal slob nyams myong can mang po dag mgrin ga gtu/ mchog gi sprul sku dbusasu phebs nas theg pa chen po'i yongs 'dzin (27na shig ni med du mi rung ba'i yan lag yin la/ de yang dbu'i gtsug phud 'bul ba dang rab tu byung ba'i mkhan slob ni/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan nas khri rin po che gdan zur rnams 'os pa gzhin bcas kyang / dbang lung man ngag gi rigs mang po gsan par/ sku na smin pas sku gzugs kyi lcogs mi lcogs kyang yod cing / lhag tu mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad la mkhyen pa che ba las gzhan ma'i rigs lags na rgya mi che bas/ de phyir dbus gtsang du bla ma dkyus ma las/ lugs gnyis ka nas 'os pa zhig mi 'dug pas/ ba so sprul pa'i sku lha dbang chosakyi rgya mtsho 'di pa/ 'jig rten phyogs nas bla chen gyi gos dang yang ldan zhing / chos phyogs nas rje gong ma dang / zhal snga nas bde ba can pa/ drung pa lha'i btsun pa sogs yongs grags kyi bshes gnyen mang po bsten nas/ mdo rgyud kyi bshad srol dbang lung gdams pa'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa 'di spyan drangs pa 'thad ces gleng zhing / bka' bgros mthun par brten/ sgar pa dbus phyogs su phebs pa dang lhan cig par/ bar khams su rje drung rin po che gdan 'dren pa mngags pa ltar phebasartsis la/ mi 'a rgya pas par dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa stabs ma 'grig 'dug /gza' tshes phun sum —196

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ benatshogs par ra sahrūl snang gi gtsug lag khang chen por/ sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i drung du/ rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa zhal snga nas sangs rgyas rin cen dang / slob dpon khri rin po che/ las thog pa zhal snga nas dge (27ba〉khyun rgyal mtshan gyis gnang ste/ lcang lo'i 'phreng ba ring du dor nas rab tu byung ba'i dge tshul gyi dngos po bzhes nas/ 'gro ba kun gyi yon gnas bla na med par gyur te/ rje zhal snga rinas sangs rgyas na cen de la/ drung 'tsho ba 'dan pa sogs mang pos bdud kyi sprul pa yin zhes sgro btags shing / lha rtse dpon mos gter nas bton pa'i lugs su byed pa'i rdzun gtam gyi glegs bam zhig 'dug pa de'i nang na/rje bla ma'i khri la burnya'i ming can zhig byung ba na/ bstan pa la 'phel 'grib yong zhing / de bdud kyi sprul pa yin pa'i phyogs mang mang po zhig 'dug pa la/ mkhas pa dang / btsun pa dang / grub pa dang / bzang ba dang / rtag tshugs zin pa dang / gzhan la 'gram chu mi ldang ba dang / sgam sdig mor byed pa mang po zhig mgo 'khor te bden par bzung nas rje sangs rin pa la smod na'ang / khong sku tshe de la mdo sngags la sbyangs pa'i dge bshes smo yin pa las spros pa'i/ dam pa'i rigs dang bdud kyi rigs gnyis ka min pa 'dra ste/ bdud kyi rigs kyi rtags yod skad ma thos zhing / la la lha zur phud lnga pa'i skye ba yin pa 'dra zer ba'i phar gtam rgyu mtshan du byas nas bdud yin zer na'ang / lha zur phud lnga pa yin pa'i nges pa ci yod/ gal te yin du srid kyang / lha dang bdud gnyis mi gcig pas/ rgyu mtshan de 'dra rang gi nang cha ston pa tsam du zad la/ lha zur phud lnga pa la yang drang don nges don gyi dgongs pa len shes dgos pas/ gzugs med la gzugs ma 'chos par btang snyoms su 'jog pa zhu/ rab byung gnang ba'i dus der drung 'khor rnams kyis bskul nas/(28na)rtses thang byang ma nas dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub kyis sku bstod cig rtsom pa mdzad/ bdag bstod gzhan bstod mang po zhig 'dug pa'i nang nas tshig spyor legs par mthong /'di lta ste/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa yon tan rgya mtsho dpal bzang po la bstod —197—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6lopa byin rlabs kyi za ma tog ces bya ba/ rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gang / /bsod nams yon tan 'bras 'byin dge 'dun zhing / /mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis dbang po'i 'gror/ /sku gsum 'dod rgur stsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung rtogs yon tan nor bus yongs gang zhing / /rmad byung 'phrin las rabs 'phreng phyogs bcur g.yo/ /thar 'dod klu dbang kun gyi rol gnas mchog /rje btsun rgyal ba rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje zla bas 'phel/ /smon lam ri dbang mchog gis bsrubs pa'i mthus/ thub bstan kun 'gro'i dbyings na rol rtsed mkhan/ /rgyal dbang mtshan mo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /nges byung dri yi bzhen pas nyer bskul te/ /tshangs spyod lha lam langs par rtag rgyu zhing / /skye rgu'i rmongs mun mtha' dag drungs 'byin pa/ kun mkhyen nyin mo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen ngo mtshar spyod pa'i chu gter dbus/ /rang bde mun pa'i go skabs rgyang bsrings te/ /gzhan don bang rim rnam par bkra ba can/ zla med lhun po'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dpyod gom pa gcig gi rig gnas lnga'i/ /sa chen la dgongs chos (28ba) min stobs ldan dpung / /mthar mdzad mkhyen brtse'i pad dkar spyan yangs pa/ /skyabs mchog mtho ris gsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde ba'i byang bar gzhan gyis mi mtshon pa'i/ /zhal bzang bdud rtsi'i 'od can mthong thos dang / /dran reg tsam gyis don ldan dga' ba'i mthus/ /'gro kun thar par 'dren la gsol ba 'debs/ khams gsum ma lus thugs rje'i 'od ris kyis/ khyab par byugs te ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i gar/ /zas gtsang sras po gzhan bzhin bsgyur mkhas pas/ /rgyal ba gnyis par gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /bkra shis 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs mthil zung / /gser ldan dga' ma'i thod du ngal bsos pa'i/ /rnam phra'i rdul dang chos 'khor bskor gnas kyang / /dam pas mchod byar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdul gyi grangs brgal yi dam lha tshogs kun/ /zhas gzigs mthu ldan srung mas bka' bzhin du/ /rab 'byams 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mthu stobs can/ /phul byung skyabs kyi dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun —198

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)gsal ler gzigs pa'i spyan stong ldan/ /mtha' yas lus can sgrol pa'i thabs la mkhas/ /thams cad mkhyen zhes brjod pa don ldan pa'i/ /'dren mchog thugs rje'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun bla ma la/ khugs drag dad pas mdo tsam bstod pa'i mthus/ /byang chub bar du skad cig mi 'bral bar/ /dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /de tshe srid 'byor mtha' dag chu shing ltar/ /snying po med par mthong nas yid can rnams/ /rang nyid gcig pus sgrol ba'i snying stobs kyis/ /rgyas sras (29na〉1da la slob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam dag dbang gis bdag rgyud smin byas shing / /zab lam rim gnyis mchoge gi lam bzang nas/ /sku gsum go 'phang mthon por phyin gyur te/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro kun 'dren gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang / /mthu ldan srung ma chos nyid bden pa'i mthus/ /dge legs yon tan nor bu'i 'byung gnas mchog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /ces pa 'di ni mgon po de nyid rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar lhur bzhes kyi tshul bstan pa'i nyin/ zhabs 'bring ba rnams kyis bskul ba dang / rang nyid kyang dad spros kun nas blangs te rje'i zhabs drung rang du/ shākya'i dge slong dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub kyis sug bris su bgyis pa'i gnas ni chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ces so/ /mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ jo bo shākya mu ni'i drung / dga' ldan gdan zur rnam gnyis las/ /rab byung dbu skyes dor nas kyang / /ngur smrig rin cen rgyal mtshan bzhes/ /ser 'bras seng ge'i khrir 'khod pa/ /gser gyi sa gzhir lhun po bzhin/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yi bang rim gyis/ /rab brjid mngon par mtho la 'dud/ /snyan par grags pa'i gdong lnga'i sgras/ /lta ngan ri dwags rnams skrag nas/ /rang rang grub mtha'i gnas mal du/ /'jigs bcas smod pa'i 'khrun bu 'byin/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe bod du phebs pa'i legs ja zhu bar bla chen rnams kyi mi sna dbyar dus kyi sprin ltar (29ba)'dus/ khyad par sgar chen nas zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug ces/—199

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānechos phyogs kyi sku yon dang / 'jig rten gyi mkhyen pa mtha' dag mtshungs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug gi blo'i ra ba las kyang yongs su brgyal ba des/ legs bya'i zhu shog 'bul ba gnang ba 'di lta ste/ sems dpa' sa brtol thog ma'i dus nas snying rje'i chu yi dbang gyur drang srong nga ro snyan pa de las mchog gi thugs kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /grangs med bskal par lta ba'i ri bo rgul gyi dngos po rnam par 'thag pa e waṃ tshogs kyi 'khor los stobs kyi lus rab rdzogs/ khro sreg gdugs su 'bar bas snying stobs zil gyis gnon pa de dag thabs kyi 'phyang mor zin nas dbugs kyi ngal gso ston byed pa'i/ /ma 'dres yan lag rnam par bskyod pa yongs 'du'i dbang po shākya'i skyes mchog khyod kyis 'jig rten kun tu dge legs 'bras bu sbyin par mdzod/ /blo bzang grags pa bden pa'i 'od brgya pa/ /gsong po'i gzhung lugs srubs shing des 'phangs pa'i/ /'byung gnas bsod nams yon tan chu yi gter/ /lugs kyi klung phran brgya yis gang gyur tam/ shes bya'i gnad don rig gzhung 'od kyi 'phreng ba ni/ /chun por gyur ba de tshe gnas lnga dbang po'i gzhu/ /'tsher bas bstan la gsal byed ri mo'i byed po can/ /bdag kyang lags gsung tshon gyis gzi 'od 'bar bar gyur/ /mtho btsun rgyal po'i gdung 'dzin zhing / /chos ldan snyan pa dang lhan cig /phyogs 'dir chos nor dga' r+sā gyi/ /mkho rgu yongs su dar ba der/ /bgrang bya'i khur gyis mi lci yang / /brjod (30na)bya rjod byed khur 'dzin pa/ /dge slong chos kyi dbang phyug kyang / /de la legs pa brjod pa'i sgra/ /smra 'dod sems kyi tshangs pa yi/ /lte ba chu skyes dbuma'i sras/ /snyan dngags dbyangs can lha mo 'dis/ /rig pa'i bi waṃ rgyud la drangs/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu sa bzhin tu/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs pa'i phyir/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bslab pa'i gzhi/ /mnos nas bstan la byi dor bya bar rigs/ /rig pa'i gnas la mkhas par ma byas na/ /'phags mchoge gis kyang kun mkhyen mi 'thob ces/ /gsungs phyir rig stobs g.yeng ba ma 'dring par/ shes bya'i gnas la sbyang stobs mchoge tu mdzod/ /gsang ba'i sngagasakyi dkyil 'khor dngos grub gzhir/ /gsungs pas rgyud sde rgya mtsho rten brten pa'i/ /rgyal ba yi 'khor —200

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ snyenalo smin grol dbang dang lam/ /nges gsang 'byug med cho gas bzhes par mdzod/ /mchog gi nye rgyu sgrub pa kho na de/ zhan tu zab pa'i rdzogs rim dbang gi don/ /gnyug ma'i de nyid phyag rgya chen po ni/ /lhag par bsgoms te thugs su byon par mdzod/ /sngon du bod na snying rje'i dbang sgyur chos kyi rgyal po dang / /lo tsā brtson ldan srog gi dka' ba len pa de rnams kyis/ /a ti sha zhes gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i bdag po spyan drangs nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan phyar ro zhes su grags/ /de yi rjes su kha che zla ba mgon dang shākya shrī/ /so ma nā tha sogs kyis bod du dka' ba'i bstan pa spel/ /dus der lo paṇa mkhas grub byon dang bstan pa'i dar tshul la/ /bsams (30ba) na da lta mchi ma blag pas khrus kyang rung ba tsam/ /de phyir me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa de ltar gyur pa na/ /mkhas btsun bzang por bstod pa'i snyan grags kyis/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i nyin mor mdzad par rigs/ /lcags las gser du 'gyur ba ltar/ khung ngu mang por blos spel bas/ /skyes mtshan dra bas sbrel ba yi/ /yan lag bskyod pa'i gar bcas te/ /don gyi lus bzang stobs rgyas shing / /rjod byed rgyan gyi gdub bu 'khor / /snyan ngag dbyangs ldan ngang mo 'di/ /yon tan rgya mtshos bsten par mdzod/ /shu snye ma stu sarba dza ga lta/zhes pa brjod bya'i don rig pa'i gnas lnga la gsan bsam mdzad dgos tshul sogs/ snyan sgron legs po yin 'dug /tshig sbyor ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ /'jig rten dag ni gragasapa'i rjes su 'brangs/ /'jig rten 'das pa gnas lugs spyod par byed/ /ces pa ltar/ rje zhwa dmar pa de snyan ngag mkhas par grags kyang / gsung rtsom gyi babs rong pa gong ra lo tsā ba'i rgyun gyi khob shag ge ba las spros pa'i/ snar thang pa dang dpal khang pa sogs kyi snyan ngag 'jam pa dang / rin spungs pa'i shugs che ba lta bu'i yid 'phrog pa ni min par sems so/ /'on kyang de'i lan 'grel chags shig dgos rgyur/ drung 'khor rnams rgyu dngos kyi 'byor ba rnam thos kyi bu la 'gran par nusakyang / snyanang ga sogs tshig sbyor smra ba'i ljags rkyong ba nyin mo'i skar ma ltar so ngebs/ de'i lan 'debs—201

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)byed pa po su 'dra zhig 'os zhes gleng pa na/ rje gong ma'i dpon po rtse kha ba'i sde pa rgyal chen pa zhes/ /yig rigs sogs (31na)yon tan dang shes rab kyi nor la spyod pa de dang / bzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub ces gsung 'jam zhi zhing dul dul ltar ston pa de gnyis bgros thog nas bris pa/ bsnyen rdzogs gnang dgos pa'i lan du dgung lo nyi shu ma lon zhesapa dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyang dgos pa'i lan du/ chos thams cad sngon du thugs su chud zin zhes sogs 'brel med rang mtshang ston pa'i lan mang po btab skad/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ dpal ldan bla mar sgar chen nas/ 'od dpag med mngags cod pan can/ /gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug dang / /sprul sku dpag bsam dbang po yis/ /bstod bsngags dang bcas legs ja phul/ / zhes jo(/dga' ldan khri gdan zur gnyis la re zhig gsung chos 'bul bar bzhugs dgos tshulu gnang yang /rje zhal snga nas zur pa gsung ngag dog pa dang / khri rin po che las thog pa yang gsan rgya che rgyu med 'dug pa dang bcas dgongs pa zhu ba gnang / rje'i zhal snga nas khri pa'i gsung las/ ding sang bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen khri las thog pa 'di nged rang gi slob ma yin pas/ rgyus yod kyi zhu ba la dbang lung gi gsan rgya mang che ba yod pa dang / sku na gzhen pas bka' chos 'bul bar lcogs pa yang bzang ba yod pas/ khong gis bka' chos 'bul mkhan gnang na ji ltar yong zhes 'char ston mdzad/ drung 'tsho 'dan pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis dga' ldan khri gdan zur/ba so sprul sku sog bla chen yongs grags shig stabasam 'grig phyin/ bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen las sngags pa'i slob dpon nam mkha' (31ba)bzang po 'di 'os pa 'dra zhes gleng / gtsang stod bkra shis lhun po nas mkhan slob tshang ma mjal bar phebs pa'i lam du/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i gzigs snang la/ mig 'phrul lta bu'i khye'u dkar po sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas byung ba paṇa chen rin po che'i rnam thar du gsal/ phyag rten la 'og rtasagatsos pa'i yod 'bul lta bu byas zhes rnam thar du 'dug pa ltar/ dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod —202

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ snyenapa rgya chen po dang bcas te thugs dwangs dwangs dod dod mdzad par mchis/ 'ga' zhig gis sku chas yod 'bul mdzad pa'i gtso bo chibs pa yin pa de nyams mtshar zhes ma rengs pa zer na'ang / de skabs bkra shis lhun po paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi bzhed pa ltar gyi bya bral grwa sar song ba dang /paṇa chen rin po che yang dben sa pa'i rgyun gyi bya btang snyoms chung gi rnam par phyag rdzas rang 'byor rgyu med 'dug pa rnam thar gyi brjod bya de ka sgro skur dang bral ba'o/ /khri rin po che dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi 'char ston ltar / zhabs drung rin po che dang phyag mdzod rnam gnyis bka' bgros thugs rtse mthun nas khong dpon slob la bka' chos kyi snyan gsan 'bul ba gnang / thugs dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas zhal gyis bzhes te/ bkra shis lhun po'i slob dpon sogs phyir zlog /dpon slob rnams re zhig 'bras spungs su gzhi phab nas bzhugs te/ gsung chos kyi rim pa 'gro gang che phul/ dpon slob rnams phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bur gyur/ thog mar mjal skabs bkra shis lhun po sogs gtsang phyogs kyi paṇa chen spyi'i gdan bzos sa gdan grum (32na)'jags kha gdan tsam la/ bka' chos gsan nas bzhugs khri sogs ti shri ra 'os pa'i bkur bzos je mthor gnang / thams cad mkhyen pa de bshes gnyen bsten tshul la 'brom ston pa dngos yin tshul sogs kyi rgyu mtshan yang yang gsung ba thos/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ de tshe bkra shis lhun po nas/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan stong rab yangs pa/ /don gyi brgya byin dben sa pa/ slob dpon nye dbang rnams dang bcas/ /'dir byon kun bzang mchod sprin btab/ /cho ge kun mkhyen nas ring lon kyang / /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa la/ /dbang lung gdams pa'i tshogs rnams gsan/ /zhes so/ /khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug gi cho 'phrul chen po'i smon lam gyi mchod pa'i gral dbur phebs/ dad pa dang ldan pa mang po zhal mjal gsung thos kyi ched dang / la la dag de lo byang 'grul gtos chen po slebs pa'i grags pa la brten/ rnyed pa 'tshol ba'i phyir du 'ongs pa sogs phyi lus kyi rnam 'gyur —203

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skagacig pa la/ nang sems kyi 'khyer so tha dad pa'i tshogs chen po/ khyams ra steng gshong bar skor dang bcas par mi shong ba dang lhan cig tu/ jo shāka rang byung lnga ldan sogs rgyal dang de sras mngon sum du bzhugs pa dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i drung du smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor dang / 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i 'brungs rabs so bzhi pa'i chos thun re/ ljags klog bzang zhing sgra brjod dag pa dang bcas te gnang bas/ kun bod skad kyi nang nas kyang stod lung mda'i skad ma nyams pa 'di 'dra ya mtshan zhes gleng / ding sang dbus gtsang gi bla ma sog yul du skye ba blangs par (32ba)grags pa rnams/ bod skad gtsang ma smra ba'i ljags 'dab chags thi ba'i lce la 'gran bzod pa'i ngang tshul rnams mthong na/ ya mtshan pa'i gnas shin tu yin par gda'/ smon lam gyi rin tshogs su dpon slob gzhung sger/ 'debs 'byar gyi 'grul pa khag rnams dang bcas pas mang ja dang / gos dar gser dngul ja ras sogs kyi 'gyed grangs med pa btang bas/ gnod sbyin gyi bang mdzod la longs spyod pa lta bur gyur/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ khro lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba la/ /lha sa smon lam mdzad pa'i tshe/ /khyams chen skor lam tshogs pas gang / /gangs ri dang mtshungs phye mar dang / /chu gter la 'gran mang ja dang / /dpagabasam sdong po'i 'dod 'jo ltar/ sgyu 'dod 'gyed bcas tshim par stsal/ /khyed la dad pa'i dmigasaskor dang / /yi ge drug pa'i bzlas brjod kyis/ /'jig rten dbang phyug da 'grub ste/ /bod pa rnams kyi khyed zhal mjal/ /zhes so/ /de nas pho brang chen po rgyal khab gong ri dkar por/ lha gzigs mi'i dbang po bka' brgyud rnam par rgyal ba'i lhas spyan drangs te phebs/ zhabs drung rin po che ngag dbang grags pa dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gral dbu gnang / gzhi len dang shangs len rgya chen pos mnyes par mdzad/ lha gzigs mi'i dbang por tshe rta zung 'brel gyi bka' chos dang / rgya hor gyi sil snyan sbug chol sogs dngos spyad kyi rigs rnams che ba mang por sku skyos kyi tshul dang 'bul ba gnang /—204

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)mchod yon thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ zhabs drung rin po che 'di 'brug pa kho na la mos zhes zer mkhan mang yang / sngar rgyun (33na〉 brten pa'i rje 'di nyid la thugs mos re che yod pa 'dra ste/ snga phyir bka' phebs gnang ba'i lhongs la yang gus nyams che ba 'dug /yar lam gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pa'i gdung brgyud gye re lha'i btsun pa srong btsan tshangs pas bsnyen bkur ba bzhes nas chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad de 'bras spungs su phebs/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ de nas gzhis ka gong dkar du/ /mi dbang chen pos spyan drangs te/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs kyis mchod/ /chos dang zang zing gnang bas tshim/ /de nas gye re lha btsun pa/ /sgong btsan tshangs pas gsol btab pas/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos gsungs slar/ /ser 'brasaskyid sna(da phyogs su phebs/ /zhes so/ /de nas rje gong ma na rim gyi gdan sa chos 'khor rgyal mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du chibs kha bsgyur/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches kyang bka' chos 'bul khyad nas zhabs phyir phebs/ 'phrin yig gar mkhan pho nyar/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gter gyur pa/ /snang ba mtha' yas 'gro mgon g.yu brag pas/ /ye shes rnam par rol pas legs bskrun pa'i/ /tshal gung zhes bya dpal ldan he ru ga'i/ /pho brang dngos gyur ston mtshan kun gsal ba'i/ /do shal sal lhung 'dra'i dgon gzung / /lugs gnyis lhan cig spyod pa'i 'dus pa'i tshogs/ byu ru'i do shal gcal du bkram 'dra yod/ /ces bsngags pa'i yul gyi gzhis ka tshal zur khang dang / der yang ma chags na pa margad mtshor/ /rab dkar ngang mo'i tshogs kun rol pa bzhin/ /phun tsho gos lo tog dgod pa'i ljangs khrod du/ /bgrang yas grong (33bsgo byer bkram pa'i yul ljongs yod/ /de nas gdugs gcig bgrod la rab mtho'i mkhar/ /snyeg 'dra'i sa 'dzin rtse la dbang po'i gnas/ /'phos 'dra lha mi'i phun tsho gos dga' ston gyi/ /'byung gnas bde ba chen po'i pho brang yod/ /ces pa ltar/ skyid shod yer phyogs kyi yul ljongs sum rtsen gyi skyed tshal sa la 'phos pa 'dra ba brgyud de btsan rdzong gsang sngags bde ba —205

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)chen po dang / /de dag lam du drag tu gzhog bskyod la/ /mgyogs par phyin la legs bris dga' tshal la/ /skyo ba ster ba'i nor ldan dga' ma ni/ /mdzes sdug spu long g.yo ba'i yul ljongs yod/ /de dag dbus su zla ba brtsegs pa'i spor/ /'chi med bdag po'i khang bzang skyengs byed cing / /lugs gnyis kun gyi mdun sa brag dkar zhes/ /phun tsho gos 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas pho brang yod/ khres rdzong chen bcu gsum gyi ya gyal pho brang chen po brag dkar rnams su/ byang brgyud rgyal por grags pa'i sto bos 'byor dang bsnyems pa phan tshun gcig la gcig 'gran bzod pa'i/ sa skyong ba g.yul rgyal nor bu khu dbon gyis gdan drangs te/ rdzong gzhis rnams su zhag mang tsam re bzhugs/ skyid shod lung pa 'dod dgu 'dzom zhing / sde pa dpon g.yog phyag rgyun legs pas/ zhabs tog dbangs mtho zhing dngos gtsang ba zhus/dpon slob rnams myur du phebs pa la rings pa'i spro ba mtha' dag mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar gyur/zhugs zhag mang sar dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches ljags lung gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' chos 'bul ba gnang / mal gro brgyud/ rin cen gling chos sde bas bsnyen (34na tha kur zhing / tsho gos su bka' chos kyi 'brel pa stsal/ bdog pa'i skyes kyis kun re ba yongs su bskang / skyod kyi la brgyud gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gi bsti gnas rdzing phyi'i chos sder phebs/ der mkhan chen lung rig smra ba blo bzang rgya mtsho/ yongs grags kyi mtshan 'ol kha sba ba zhes pa'i skad grags can des gtsos/ spyi sger tshang mas bkur sti gya nom pa bsgrubs/ rdzing phyi skya ser rnams la lugs gnyis kyis tshim par mdzad nas 'ol kha rtser phebs/ dad pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing gtong ba'i phyag ring du rkyong ba'i nor 'dzin dbang mo 'ol kha dpon sa sa gus 'dud phun sum tshogs pa byas/ bla ma dri ma med pa mtsho lasaskyes pa'i rdo rje dang / mnyam med jo bo yab sras kyis lung bstan pa'i gnas mchag chos 'khor rgyal du phebs/ dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams kyis 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo'i rigs du ma dang bcas pa'i sngun bsus/ mchod khang nang rten thams cad zhib par mjal zhing / ri mthil gyi mgon khang rnams su/ gtor gsos snyan dar bskang gso rnams rgyas par mdzad/ tshogs su bka' gdams—206

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)glegs bam gyi gsung chos dang / zla sbrel gyi bar du mang 'gyed sogs lugs gnyis kyi dga' ston mtha' klas pa byung / lcang ra/ gru mda'/ bang rim pa sogs dwags nang gi skya ser rnams mjal bar 'ongs te/ gzhi byes tshang mar bsnyen bkur rgya cher bsgrubs/ de dag rnams la so so'i 'dod chos ci rigs pa dang / ja gos dar gyi gnang sbyin bzang ba mdzad/ slar skyid shod du chibs kha bsgyur/ ser theg (34ba〉rna gling du phebs/ spyi sger gyi kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la 'gran bzod pa'i zhabs tog zhus/ bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas sde chen po de nyid kyi mchog dman mtha' dag legs pa'i lam la bkod/ 'bras spungs su phebs/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ sa skyong g.yul rgyal nor bu yis/ /pho brang kun tu spyan drangs mchod/ /mal gro brgyud de rin cen gling / /der mchod chos 'khor rdzing phyi nas/ /mkhan chen blo bzang rgya mtsho ni/ /'khor dang bcas pas chibs bsur byon/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ma thag /mig dbang tshim zhing dad gus 'phel/ /gling du phebs tshe spyi sger gyis/ /bsod nams phung po dpag med bskrun/ /skya ser stong phrag du ma la/ /snyan pa'i gsung gis dam chos bstan/ /de nas stag rtse mthong smon du/ /mi yi dbang mos spyan drangs te/ /mchod cing 'ol kha'i skye rgu la/ /dam pa'i chos kyi skyes gnang ngo / /ngo mtshar che ldan chos 'khor rgyal/ /rgyal bas lung du bstan pa'i gnas/ /gnas mchag de ru phebs pa'i tshe/ /tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis mchode/ /mchod rten gser sku mi pham mgon/ /mgon khyod phyogs 'di'i skye 'gro'i dpal/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la/ /la la dad cing thams cad zhus/ /gus ldan dwagasapo'i sbyin bdag rnams/ /rnam thar gtsang ma mjal bar 'tshogs/ /tsho gos mchog dge 'dun dang bcasamachod/ /mchod 'os mchode rnams skal ba bzang / /slar yang 'ol kha mal dro sogs/ /dbu ru'i phyogs su skyid shod dang / /theg chen gling dang 'bras spungs su/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /zhes so/ /me pho rta'i lo (35na skyon ljongs sa'i lte ba yar klung gi phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bskyod/ bod yul gyi blon po rig pa can 'byung ba'i sa spyad rnam par bkra ba'i 'phyong rgyas stag rtser/ sa skyong wo po —207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa sku mched kyis spyan drangs/ ri bo sde chen/ spyan g.yas pa/ phyag sde pa/ dpal ri sgrub sde/ ba po shis bde chen/ chos lamarim pa/ bde steng pa sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi dgon che chung thams cad ser sbrengs/ chibasabasu/ yul pa rnams kyi bro gzhas shon sogs rtsed sna'i rigs kun gyi mig gi gzigs mor tshar du dngar bar gyur/ rtser bzhugs gral chen mo'i nyin/ grags pa don ldan gyi gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po lo chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi zhal slob zhang mkhar nas rig byed pa 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan tshun bskor ba'i/ phal skad kyi lo tsā ba/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog la thos bsam byas pa'i mkhar nag chos mdzad dpal 'byor rgya mtsho gnyis kyis/ sgra rig pa la brten pa'i 'phros gtam rgyas par phul/ nang ma der dus ston gyi zhabs tog /sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs ba'i 'bul ba sogs rgya cher mdzad/ zhabs drung sku mched la tshe rta zung 'brel gyi bka' dbang dang / gnang sbyin rgya hor gyi dngos spyad kyi skyes stsal/ chos dbang rin po che'i zab gter gyi las byang le'u brgyad pa'i chog bsgrigs dang bstun pa'i tshes bcu'i gar 'chams kyi rim pa zab rgyas su 'bul ba gnang / dgon so so'i bla ma grwa rigs rnams kyi re ba yongs (35ba)su bskang/ de nas phebs lam du mkhar thog dpon sa sa bsnyer bkur gya nom pa zhus/ bod shing sgo can gyi rgyal khyab pho brang chen po sne'u gdong rtser phebs/ rtse tshogs pa/ dkon gnyer/ ras chud phug /ri bo chosagling / bkra shis chos sde sogs dgon che phra mtha' dag gis bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i ser sbrengs dang / rin cen rgyan sprod dang bcas pa'i rta pa brgya phrag brgal ba'i chibs bsu chos bzang lha'i mdun sa'i dga' ston la 'gran bzod par gyur/ mchod yon gyi mjal 'dzoms bka' 'brel ma gsan gong du/ phyag rtse sprod dam ldem mjal gang rung / bzhugs gdan mtho dma'i mnyam mnyam la dan pas/ phan tshun gyi mgron gnyer rnams kyis bzhugs khri rgyag pa la rgyug tshad la gzhal/ brtan brtan khrig khrig gi lugs byas kyang / sne'u gdong rtse'i mgron gnyer nyams myong ches pas/ bzhugs —208—

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)khri'i bar bar la g.yan pa srab mo brdzangs pas/ mjal nas ja gcig tsam bzhes tshe sne'u gdong zhabs drung bzhugs khri mtho ba byung zer/ mi chen po'i tshugs ka 'dzin pa'i 'os sde srid phag mo gru pa smos ci dgos/ gzhan ma rgya nag gong ma'i lung las kyi mtho ba 'di lta bu rna bas phyag gdan la rtseg pa rigs mod kyang / spyir bla chen dpon chen gyi gral du rang byon mdzad pa'i ris rnams phyag gdan yig bskur nga che dbang btsan la rtseg pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi mdo rgyud nas lan gcig ma yin par gsungs pa'i las rgyu 'bras zer ba'i gal po che de la zhib cha mdzad na legs sam ste/ snyan sgron phul kyang thugs la 'thad pa dka' bar snang ngo / /rtse zhabs drung rin po che lha (36na)gzigs mi pham dbang sgyur rgyal po la tshe dbang 'bul ba gnang bas/ tshe bum dbu thog tu bzhag pa'i skabs bum pa dum bu gnyis su gad pa ni mchod yon gnyis ga'i sku tshal lta ba 'dra'o/ /phyon chen po'i lung bstan du zhabs drung 'di nyid byang chub sems dpa' yin pa dang / dgung lo nyer lnga la bar chad che bar gsungs pa sogs ni/ byi glang sngegazar gyi dus thog tu khel bas nges shes 'drongs pa snang ngo / /tshogs mkhan chen pa rin cen rgya mtshos thog drangs/ skya ser mchog dman mtha' dag la lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas re ba yongs su bskang / chos grwa chen po dpa' gyi rtses thang du phebs/ rtses thang lnga mchod pa spyi sger gyis zhabs tog bsnyen bkur gyi mthil len zhus/ 'bras bu gling pa dang de sngon grwa tshang pa rnams kyis mdzes mtsho ni tsam byas/ dad mos can rnams mjal ba dang / mi gus pa rnamasakyang tshod brtag pa dang / btang snyoms pa rnams ltad mo lta ba sogs la 'ongs te khrom dmar nag tu 'khyil/ de'i tshe gus chen pa zhig gis/ gzims drel la ske rgyan/ g.yer kha khal khebs sogs gra gcig pa zhig byung na yong rgyur 'dug /gar 'brug sogs kyang 'di ltar byed zhus pas/ de'i lan du phyag mdzod gu gris nga rang yang de ka bsam ste/ brgya la byed dam stong la byed lta bur 'dug pas/tshod ma zin zhes pha rol zil gnon gyi gsung byon zer/ bod btsan po'i gdung brgyud/ ste pa lha rgya ri —209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)pas gdan drangs/ rong chad dkar dang / e re sgo chos rdzong ste gzhis gong 'og rnams su zhabs togo dang 'bul chen yang dag pa mdzad/ sdeb khu dpon la ji (36bskor bzhed pa'i chos dang / thugs yid rang dbang med par 'phrog pa'i rgya hor gyi spyad pa mang po'i gnang sbyin mdzad/ e dgon bdun gyis gtsos pa'i phyogs de'i dge lugs/ rnying lugs/ smyung gnas ras pa sogs/ ris med kyi dgon che chung thams cad la chos dang zang zing gi phan pa rgya chen po stsal/ thu mi sa sto ṭa'i gdung 'dzin yar rgyab dpon chen gyis gdan drangs/ srid gsum rnam rgyal/ rgyal chen gling / dol lhun grub lha rtse sogs so sor bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ bzhugs gral chen mo'i nyin/ gsol sder sum brgya tham pa zhus pa/ rjes ma gtsang du sde pa lhun po rtse pas gsol sder lnga brgya bsgrigs pa kha grangs mang ba tsam las/ rgya dpangs dngos dag mi dag sogs/ yar rgyab pas zhus pa'i zur tsam du yang mi slebs 'dug /sde dpon gang gi nang du yang 'di 'dra ba ma byung zhes drung 'khor rnams gleng / pho brang chen po sne'u gdong rtse/ gong dkar/ 'phyong rgyas/ yar rgyab/ rgya ri ba/ lhun po rtse ba sogs snga phyi'i bzhugs gral chen mo'i skabs tshor/ phyag mdzod/ slob dpon pa'i ris dang nang so rnam pa rnams la bang khebs bshur ma gtong ba sogs/ chen po'i mdun sar 'os pa'i sgrigs bca' bdar ngo mtshar zhing babs chags pa byung bar snang /sde pa dpon blon la tshe rta'i bka' 'brel gnang / rgyal chen gling gi gzhis ka lcags ri dang bcas par phyag nas zhu ba sogs gus pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po mdzad/ phyags phyi drung 'khor rnams kyi khrod nas sde pa yar rgyab pa 'di sngar phan sa lugs sang sang yin pa la/ da cha rang phyogs su 'gyur ba lta bu yin 'dug pas/ gnang cha dpangs che ba gnang ba (37na)'gab ces gus pa ltar/ sngar gyi sbyin bdag rnying pa rnga ma nag po'i tshos mdog can rnams las/ gnang cha bcu 'gyur dga' ba mdzad/ mchod yon thams cad zhag gsum gyi gsar 'grogs de 'di re byung / byams pa gling gi mchod rten bod yul na 'gran zla med pa des gtsos pa'i gnas gzigs gnang / jo gdan sa dge gar rnying sogs grub —210

rgyal dbang yon to rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)mtha' ris med kyi ser sbrengs pa la mang 'gyed kyis tshim pa mdzad/ mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ zil gnon lo la g.yon ru'i phyogs/ /'phyong rgyas stag rtse'i sa skyong dang / /mkhar thog sne'u gdong rtse yi/ /gong ma chen pos spyan drangs mchod/ /sras yum blon bcas tshogs chen por/ /tshe dbang la sogs 'dod chos gnang / /de nas rtses thang lnga mchod pas/ /spyan drangs sa dge gar bcas kyi/ /ser sbrengs khrom chen tshogs pa la/ /chos gsungs rten mchod mdzad pa na/ /ngo mtshar ltas bzang bsam mi khyab/ /ngam shod brgyud de e phyogs su/ /pho brang ri sgo chad gar du/ /'od gsal lha yi gdung brgyud pa/ khu dben sras 'bangs chos sdes mchode/ /chos nor gya nom rgya chen stsal/ /de na yar rgyab dpon chen gyis/ /spyan drangs 'byor ba chen pos mchod/ /gra dol rnams kyi rten gzigs mdzad/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin spros/ /zhes so/ /rim gyis chos sde chen po 'bras spungs su phebs/ mi ring bar/ sde pa skyid shod pa dang / bla ma dung dkar 'brug grags sogs phugs su 'tshangs pa 'dra zer/ gang ltar drung 'khor la la dag rang nyid bag yangs su sbyong rgyu ma byung ba rgyu mtshan du byas te/ mi bsrun skye bo gdug pa'i sprul ltar lce gnyis (37ba)dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig gis/ rkun po rnams kyis khyir btags pas/ /ra skyes khur ba bram zes bor/ /zhes pa'i gtam rgyud dang mtshungs pa'i g.yo 'phrul gyis dpon slob sa nyas kyi bar du sel bcug /'phral gyi rkyen sog po kha than gyis byas te/ phyag mdzod gu shri chen po zur du bzhugs dgos ba'i bi na la gas nus pa cung zad thon par snang ngo / /re zhig sku mtshams dam par bcad de thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes la brtson par / mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ de nas ju na ka ṭa gar/ /thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes la/ /gzhol ba'i bcad rgya dam par mdzad/ /rim gnyis lam gyis rnal 'byor 'phel/ /zhes so/ /de nas gtsang phyogs kyi grwa ris sbyin bdag rnams kyis gsol ba btab ste zhal bzhes gnang ba ltar/ bkra shis lhun po nas gdan 'dren par shar rtse dpon slob dgra 'dul 'byor/ 'bras spungs —211 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (benas bzhugs sgar bteg ste snyug la'i thad du phebs pa'i tshe/ der legs bshad gling pa dang / khu pe gra tshang gnyis/ /dpal ldan shākya'i rjes su zhugs pa'i 'dus sde/ khro ba la slar mi khro ba sogs dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi la spyod par khas 'che yang / bya rog lug pa'i brtul zhugs yun ring du 'dzin pa zhig yod 'dug cing / khyad par legs bshad gling pa rnams/ khu pe grwa tshang bas gtso byas phyogs der grub mtha' mi gcig pa rnams 'don pa la mngon du phyogs shing / gsar pa chags 'jug pa ni lta ga la zhig /thub na de'i thad kyi nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba yang 'gog pa'i gar lugs kyi spyan ltos dang phyag len mnyam pa/ 'di skabs kyang phebs lam bkag pas/ lnga brgya tha ma'i me long (38na〉du nang rtags kyi gzugs brnyan mtha' dag phyi rol tu gsal te phyag rgya ba'i chos kyi rang tshugs phyi ma'i chang bu ltar gyur to/ / de nas thon sde dgon rnams kyis/ 'bul ba zhabs tog bsnyen bkur mtha' yas pa byung / sdopa yab sras kyis thog drangs pa'i mchog dman gyi skye bo kun chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston bskrun par mdzad/ 'u yug brgyud sgar pa dmangs sku mdun rin po ches gtso mdzad de chu lho khar bton chibs rags nyung bsdus shig zab bu lung gi gnas mjal la phebs/ de nas shangs ri bo dge 'phel gyi gnas gzigs mdzad/ gdan sa 'og rtse gdong bla brang nas/ dpal sa skya ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos legs bya'i ja 'dren rgyas par btang / chu lho khar bton te dben sa dgon par phebs/ sgrub sde'o mo rnams la chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ bkra shis lhun por phebs nyin/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag /paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dbu gnang /slob dpon rnam pa che bgres sogs kyis chibs bsu la phebs te zhabs thang la hro me bzhugs pa gzigs pas/ chibs las bsgol ba gnang bar/ la la dag bshes gnyen bsten pa'i rnam thar dang mtshungs pa 'dug ces bsngags pa brjod/ g.yin phyogs pa rnams kyis 'bras spungs sprul sku dge lugs kyi —212

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ snyenabastan pa'i bdag po lta bu yin zer bar/ khong dpon slob la chibs pa 'bebs pa gnang ba zhes nyams mtshar mtshar byas skad/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni ngor gyi mkhan po sog gdan sa gong 'og (38ba)gi dbu blar gyur pa'i ris la bdag chen rin po che rnams shin tu gus pa yin 'dug kyang / 'phral gyi snang tshul dbu bla rnams kyis gdung brgyud zhal ngor phyag 'bul ba sogs 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi rigs su ga byungs pa rnams 'gran gyi zla med du 'dzin par gda'/ rin po che lha rtse bar 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang pos bka' chos gsan pa'i snyan gsan phul bar/ rin po ches nged kyis bka' chos 'bul ba mi yong / nges par 'bul dgos na nged la bla ma'i bkur gzos mi byed pa'i dan kha dgos chos rnams maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du 'bul gsung ba sogs skar 'brug la yang mig ltos de 'dra zhig yod snang bas de la dpe byas par 'dug /dge 'dun stong phrag tu nye ba'i ser sbrengs dang bcas te chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun por phebs/ spyi bla brang phyug po khag rnams kyis so so'i grwa khang du gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur rgya cher bskrun/ tshogs su mang 'gyed dang dpon slob paṇa chen rin po cher brgya 'bul sogs sku skyos kyi shangs len rgyas par mdzad/ dar bzhugs rang rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la bka' dbang bka' chos kyang mang du gsan/ de snga gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi yum dpon sa yar rgyab ma jo mjal dang gnyen phrad la 'byon pa'i zhor du 'bras spungs kyi gnas mjal mdzad bka' chos gsan pas thugs dad khyad par can zhabrungs pas/ 'di res sde pa bgres pa rnams ji ltar mdzad kyang / dpon sa yum sras gnyis rang gus 'dud lhur len rtsis la/ dpon sa sku tshes ma zin par brten/ rdzong du gdan 'dren ma zhus kyang / ja (39na〉nus dang gzan me shing gi mthun rkyen gang legs mdzad/bkra shis lhun po'i thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang pos bzhengs pa'i byams chen dang / dpal ldan lha mo'i sku sogs gnas gzigs rnams gnang ba rang gzhan brje nus pa'i chos pa ngo mtshar can jo bo bka' gdams pa'i sde dpal snar thang dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yogrub kyi zhal slob paṇa chen bzang bkras pas btab pa'i gangs can chos 'phel zhes sngar rig sngags 'chang ba'i sde/ dus phyis jo bo mas nyid pa'i grwa sar song ba de dang / paṇa grub gsum gyi dngos slob khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams zhabs kyis bcags/ gnasade dag gi skya ser kun la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ bsnyen bkur ba don dang ldan par mdzad/ sdo pa ser ma pas lhun po rtser spyan drangs/ bzhugs gral chen mo'i nyin gsol sder lnga brgya tsam bsgrigs pa'i zhabs tog rgya cher zhus/ de mtshungs lhun po rtse chos sder phebs te tshul 'bul phar gnang 'gran bzod pa lta bur gyur/ sde pa rin chen rtse pa dang sras rgyud pa mchod yon gyis gdan drangs re ba don dang ldan par mdzad/ dbus su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i lam nor dpal 'khor bde chen du phebs/ dge lugs kyi gra tshang khag bdun gyis bsnyen bkur bzang 'gran zhus/ gur pa dang ri lding pa gnyis kyis gar 'chams kyi gzigs mo rgyas par phul/ sde pa rgyal rtse bas ja 'dren zhus/ gnas rnying du zhabs drung ngag gi dbang po khu dbon gyis spyan drangs/ rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i gser gdung gis thog drangs phyi nang gi gnas (39ba〉gzigs rnams zhib par mdzad/ gtsang du bzhugs ring sde pa ga me bstan srung ba sogs phyogs lhung can mang pos mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byung bar/ thugs ma rengs pas rgya sngags 'chang chen po'i sku gdung gi sku gzhogs su bskang gso dang / gtsang pa zhal ngo rnams kyi mtshan nas smos pa'i bzhas sgra mdzad par/ gnas rnying zhabs drung thugs 'tshab nas/ khyed dpon slob dbus su phebs pa la ma ltos na'ang / nged tsho sa dog 'dir sdod dgos pas de 'dra mi gnang bzhu zhes zhu ba phul/ gnas rnying pa sdodagon gyis gus 'dud dpag tu med pa mdzad cing / phar lugs gnyis kyi bdag rkyen tshad las 'das pa gnang / 'brug lugs kyi gdan sa ra lung du phebs/ gdung brgyud ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma dang dbon ngag dbang rnam rgyal yab sras kyis gzhi len rgyas par btab chos rje smre chung 'di zhabs drung rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshor gting nas mos pa zhig yod 'dug pas/ 'di skabs zhabs tog rgya cher zhus/ nged rang phyag 'bul rgyu yin pas/ tshur —214

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)bzos gnang ma gnang la ltos pa med kyang / gar lugs nang 'di lod drags pa'i stabs kyis/ 'brasaspungs sprul skus ldang ba tsam yang ma mdzad par khyod kyis phyag phul zhes nged tsho sgar pa'i khyu nas bton yod zhus par/ drung 'khor stong 'ur can 'ga' zhig gis/ rje gong ma'i dus kyi gnam dpangasaphar bzhag jing gir gyi rigs su 'khrungs pa tsam gyis kyang khong la ldang ba gnang mi thub ces thag bcad pas smre bo dpon slob mjal ba'i spros pa dang bral/ glu ma blangs pa'i gre ba zhig de ru 'dzer skad/sngon dpal ldan sa skya pas bod kyi bdag mdzad pa'i tshe/ dpa' (40na skyogs kyi grags snyan can dpon chen ag len gyi brgyud pa 'brog khri dpon pas gus 'dud zhus/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ phur bu shar tshe tshe ldan rnams/ /g.yas ru ru lag 'dzin ma'i gzhin/ /gtsang gi sa bdag che chung dang / /chos sde so sos spyan drangs te/ /yul phyogs rang rang gus mchod byas/ /thog mar thon dang rgyal byed tshal/ /'u yug shangs dang za phu lung / /de dag tu phebs kun gyis mcho ne/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhis tshim par mdzad/ /dge 'phel gnas gzigs rtse gdong du/ /sa skya bdag chen ja zhus dang / /lho khar dben sa chos rjes mchod/ /de nas bkra shis lhun por phebs/ /chibs bsu dang bcas ser sbrengs dang / /bkod pa khyad par 'phags pas mchod/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita/ /blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /rgyal ba yab sras nyi zla zung / /zhal brgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi dang / /longs spyod chen pos dge 'dun rnams/ /tshim mdzad skal bzang ci yang spel/ /bsam grub rtse nas ja zhus dang / /snar thang gangs can chos 'phel dang / / gnas dang khro phu'i bar du phebs/ /de nas srad rgyud rin cen rtse/ /lhun rtseganas rnying 'brong rtse dang / lcang ra dpal 'bor bde chen du/ /spyan drangs ser sbrengs gar 'chams phul/ /ra lung rten mchod mdzad pa'i tshe/ /'brug pa'i gdung brgyud yab srasakyis/ /bsnyen bkur yar 'brog sna dkar rtse/ /mchod cing / /zhes so/ /rim gyis rgyal khab chen po gong ri dkar por phebs/ de'i tshe zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku gdan sa thel du bzhugs/ mjal 'dzom gnang thub na bstan pa spyi sger dang bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs la —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yonerlabs che ba'i dgongs gzhi khyad par (40bcan la brten/ dpon slob gnyis ka mjal 'dzom gnang bzhed pa'i skor yang gi skabs/ drung 'khor rnams kyis rje gong mas sgar pa dang mjal bar bkur bzos sogs tshul ldan ma byung / da sgos kyang rje zhwa dmar ba thugs g.yo ches pas sngar dang 'dra/ snyan sgron phul kyang gsan ris min pas/ nged rang rnams yar log phyin na mjal 'dzom gnang thabs dang bral 'gro zhes lde chung ba nang so phu lung pa dang / drung 'tsho tshe 'dzin ma gtogs drung 'khor ngo ma rnams kyis 'bras spungs su log phyin pas/ /mjal phrad ni sos than dus kyi sprin pa ltar gyur/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ de nas gong dkar du/ /spyan drangs mi dbang yab sras dang / /bka' bgrasagar dbang sprul pa'i sku/ /mjal 'dzom mdzad na bod 'bangs spyi/ /bde bar dgongs pa'i gleng mo gnang / /phan par bzhed pa'i lhag bsam la/ /sdig to'i phyogs kyis log par bkag /ces so/ /snyan grags bsir bus ring nas drangs pa yi/ /lhun grub 'phrin las ma la ya yi dris/ /dbus gtsang 'dzin ma'i khyon kun yongs khyab tshe/ /rgud pa'i tsha gdung ming gi lhag mar byas/ khru 'dzin ri bo'i spo nas pad dkar 'chang / /rin cen rgyan gyi 'phreng ba ring dor nas/ /ngur smig gos kyis klubs te dbyig 'dzin ltor/ /bsod nams zhing du byon la su mi dad/ /mi bsrun bsam sbyor 'chang ba'i phyi nang bgegs/ /rang gzhan du mar sprul pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /lnga brgya'i rang mtshang ston rnams mgon khyod kyi/ /skyon min zas gtsang sras la legs gar bzhin/ /de nas 'bras spungs su phebs/ re zhig thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes lhur mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i skabs/ phyogs kyi gser yig pa dang (41na〉mjal bar 'ongs pa 'ga' zhig la 'dan pa 'tsho byed dang 'or pa chos mdzad sogs kyis sgar pa'i mjal 'dzom gyi yig 'phrul 'dra yin 'ong snyam nas/ brdung 'phrog byas te/ pho brang gi nang du rgyu 'grul byed pa lho brag mar pa rgya gar du 'byon pa'i lam las kyang bgrod dka' ba byung / ra ba stod 'chad nyan las thog pa/ khri rin po che dkon cog cho me 'phel gyis mjal bar phebs pas/ khong gnyis kyis dbyug pa phyar te brdeg tu chas pa na/ khri —216

rgyal dbang yon to rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)rin po che de nyid thugs dkyil che bas zhal mdangs 'gyur ba tsam yang mi mdzad par 'dzum gyis bsus pas thal mo ya gcig gi dper song / dus phyis kyang mi de 'dra'i ris 'dug ces thugs khrel ba'i gsung los yang yang gnang / mtsho kha nas dpon po kho lo che'i sras/ lha btsun che ba dang / se chen tha'i jis gtsos pa'i 'grul pa dang dmag dpon che ba slebs/ de yang shing sbrul lo/ phag mo ba dang zho dkar nag sogs kyis sde pa skyid shod pa'i sgar gtor/ skyid shod kyi drung 'khor mang po 'thab gral du bgor ba'i sde gzar shin tu tshan che ba langs/ de'i rtsa ba yang zhwa dmar bas legs ja'i zhu yig phul ba'i lan bzhu khang rab 'byams pa sogs kyis log par btab pa de la/ zhwa dmar ba dang drung yig 'jam dbyangs pa sogs kyis dga' ldan pho brang gi drung 'khor rnams la yon tan med tshul gyi ngan rtsom kha yar zhig dang / ring por ma lon par zhwa dmar ba lha sar phebs te/ jo bo'i snyan dar gyi kha yig la/gab tshig la brten pa'i ga rtsom gyi rnam pa mang po zhig mdzad pa de dkon gnyer dbon phyis 'bras spungs su bskyal/ de'i nang du/ brag ti (41ba)zhag gsum gyi grong khyer na/ khong ra gan tsho gis pa'i ru rnon tsho/ /rje chos dbyings ri dwags thang bzhugs la/ /rwa rno rtul 'gran pa ci rang yin/ /de mi 'byung ba jo bo khyed rang gi shes/ /zhes sogs la shes rab che che mo mang pos tsā gnyer bar/ brag ti zhag gsum se 'brabang dge gsum/ dge lugs g.yag dang gar lugs seng ge la sbyar/ rna ba rna yi a long de/ /sor phyed kyis 'jal rin mi gda' yang / /nam zhig khyab 'jug gi 'dom pas kyang / /mi 'byud pa zhig byung na cug rang byed/ /ces pa gar dge'i kun slong da lta sor gyis 'jal rgyu med pa lta bu'i chung ba de/ phugs 'phel nas lha khyab 'jug gi 'dom pas kyang mi 'byud pa'i don dang / mdor na snyan dar gyi kha yig mtha' dag la 'bru rgyab nas/ rang phyogs la dmigs ma dmigs ci ltar na'ang /yin par ngos bzung ste gleng brjod mang po byas/ de'i lan la/ sog pos sgar pa'i rta dre'u phyags pasabastan 'gro'i phan bde 'joms pa'i gzhi chen po things pa yin zer/ sngon rje chos grags rgya mtshos/ rin spungs don yod rdo rje bskul nas/ gzhis ka snol pa yul bton/ sa nag mar dgon pa btab ste/—217—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skaser 'bras rnams rang shugs kyis bskam 'gro rtsis kyi gnang sgo la brten/ kun slong chen por song ba dag rim gyis mi gsal bar gyur pa ri mo rnying pa gab pa'i zhig gsos lta bur song / gang ltar sdegazar sngon ma'i lan du zhi drag gang 'os byed par 'ongs par/ zhabs drung g.yul rgyal nor bu dang / sku mdun rin po che sogs 'jig rten gyi mes po rnams thugs rtse mthun par zhi ba'i lab khon mdzad rtsis thog tu khel na/ rang g.yin thams cad la legs pa zhig yong rgyu yin 'dra (42na)yang / skyid shod kyi sde pa bsod nams rnam rgyal dang 'dan pa 'tsho byed sogs mang po zhig gis sde gzar byas na legs pa'i gros shed kyi dbang du song ste/ phar rgol gyi dus zing bslangs pas/ yar gtsang gi dpung chen po skyid shod nor 'dzin gyi lte bar 'ongs/ sa cha rdzong gzhis kyi bcad gras dang ho las byung /hor sog gi dpung chen po dus mtha'i rlung ltar 'tshub pa rnams drag po mig gsum pa yang 'dar zhum me gtong ba'i sngags rgan rnams kyis
