skad cig la rang yul du bskrad/ mchod yon rnams mdzad dka' ba 'gyur/de yang bka' chems su/ gnyis skyes kyi cha lugs ma blangs par/ /'gu ru'i tshe dpal ring bar lus/ /dpal de yi phun tsho gis yid dbang gi /dran yul du gyur pas snang pa skyo/ /zhes pa'i don bod du phebs skabs dbu skra lcang lo can dang sku chas rab byung gi rtags su yod 'dug pa/ jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du dbu skra ma zhus phan bcad khyim pa'i rtags can du yod na sku tshe mthar phyin cing mnga' thang che bar 'ong rgyu la rten 'brel 'phyugs pas/ bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib dang zham 'bring ba la brten pa'i gra 'grig mi 'grig sna tshogs 'byung ba'i lung bstan du mngon no/ /ring por ma lon par se ra theg pa chen po'i gling du phebs/ tsho gos su spyi chos gnang ba dang bcasargyun ring tsam bzhugs/ de skabs lam pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pas/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po cher 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs phyag len mang du zhus/ dpon slob rin po cher ma bzhugs pa jo nang sprul sku kun dga' snying por zhu bar phyin/ jo nang sprul sku la khong rang —218

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)gi yab mes sogs (42ba)bla ma gzhan nas brgyud pa'i 'jigs byed kyi chos bka' re mang yod 'dra zhing / srad rgyud pa'i mgon khang gi shing sgam chung ngu zhig nas rnyed pa'i gdams pa zla bzab mo 'dra'i dpe cha 'byor ba rgyun med kyang rdzogs par zhus/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag tu phul/ 'di skor gyi lo rgyus khungs dag gi zhib cha/ gu ge grub chen snying stobs rgya mtsho dang / lha pa'i zhabs drung sku skye blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas sogs mang po zhig gi ngag nas gleng ngo / /de nas dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' shog bka' ngag dang bcas te rab 'byams pa sku zhabs su rdzong sta gnang bas rang bzhugs thog 'byor/ zhu don snying po yar gtsang sogs kyis rang phyogs kyi bstan pa la rma chen po byung ba 'di la/ nged rang lta bus sku rim gyi phyag g.yog zhu dgos rgyur/bsam grub rtse'i kha 'og tu song bas byed ma bde bas/ rab stims pa 'di pas phyag g.yog zhus nas/sku rim gnang dgos tshul gyi rgyu mtshan zhib par yod 'dug /de nas rab 'byams bsod grags pas mgo byas te/ thugs dam bskang gso rnams kyi steng du bka' rab 'byams kha shas/ sku gar+shagos grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i grwa pa rgan grwa kha yar dang bcas khyon gcig tu 'tshogs nas drug cu pa/ yang mgon rin po che dpon slob kyis mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub pa/ gung ru dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang pa'i dbang phyug /zur gyi sngags 'chang chen po gzhon nu don grub/ byar po sngags 'chang ba rnams kyis/ mgon po zhal dang / tshe 'char gyi sgrub pa btsugs/ sgrub khag mang bas gling gseb thams cad rnga brdung 'ur tshil le ba byung / dka' bcu a skyag zer (43na tha'i mtshan nyid pa rgan po zhig gis/ ston pa shākya thub pas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas bdud btul bar 'dug /'brog pa lha gsol 'dra ba 'di su'i lugs yin zhes zur za ba byas skad/ sgrub khag so sos gtor zor 'phen pa'i nub/ dus min du rlung chen po 'khrugs/ gnam sa ral ba lta bu'i 'brug sgra dang / dus kyi me lce 'bab pa lta bu'i glog 'byug cing ser ba drag po dang bcas po ta la'i rdzong gi lcags ri la 'byug brgyab ste/ mngon brjod kyi ltas 'phral du byung /—219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānemakhar nag lo tsā bas/ de nas ser gos gdan sa cher/ /re zhig thugs dam khro ba bzhes mdzad/ /mi bsrun skye bo'i dmag dpung gis/ /dbus phyogs srog chags sdug bsngal bar/ /snying rjes bskyod pa'i sngags khang du/ /'gal byed lo la gtor zor gyis/ /chos skyong rbad pas mun chen nang / /lhun sdug sprin 'khrigs glog 'byug cing / /nam mkha' ral 'dra'i sprin dbyangs dgod/ /lce 'bab ser zhun 'byur ba'i rlabs/ /ri bo 'dar ba'i 'ur sgra ni/ zhan tu 'jigs pas skrag byed pas/ ring por ma thogs dgra bo rnams/ /nang zhig sdig pa'i tshang bzhin gyur/ /de slad 'dren pa 'di ya mtshan/ /mthu stobo rma chos kyi rgya mtsho rigasol/ /zhes so/ /de nas sa spungs su phebs/ sngags khang du sgrub pa 'dzugs pa sogs sku rim rnam grangs mang du mdzad/ thang cig dbyangs dpon pas dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma'i gtor sgrub mdzad de zor 'phen pa la mngon du phyogs pa na/ rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa dang / bra nyi rab stims pa rnams kyis phrag dog gis chos skyong 'di bka' gnyan pas gshags gtor (43bskom las zor mi 'gab bar chad 'ong snyan 'bul zhus par brten/ thugs the tshom du gyur nas gtor zor 'phangs pa 'gab mi 'gab kyi phebs sgo gnang bas dbyangs dpon pa thugs 'ur te/ ngas chos skyong 'di'i man ngag thams cad rje gong ma dang ba so rje drung gi sku gzhogs su zhun thar bcad/ bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol bar byas/ bzlas pa rkyang pa yang bya ba lhag song ba yin/ dan 'bag yas sna mas sna la them pa bcol nas sdod dgos pa'i dus tshod 'di la las sbyor mi byed na ga tsa na byed/ lo gsum tshun gyi sku khag nged rang gis 'khur/ khong tsho sogazhags gtore byed zer ba'i nya mgo ci non/ gshags na gshags lugs gtsug byed/ gtor na gtor lugs gtsug byed ces sogs mang du zhuganas gtor ma 'phen par thag bcad/ sho la 'debs pa dang / byang dmar la 'jug pa'i las sbyor mdzad pas/ yar gtsang skur gsum gyi zhal ngo rnams kyi mtshan byang gi khrod nas/ yar rgyab zhabs drung bdud 'dul grags pa'i mtshan thog mar bor te rtags mngon sum du byung / de skabs mngon spyod kyi —220

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)las sbyor rnam grangs ha cang mang bas/ rje'i zhal snga nas stag lung brag pa de thugs cung zad ma rengs par/ thog mar skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum gyi lam la go rim ma log par khrid nas/rdo rje theg pa'i mchog thun gyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rim pa rnams mdzad dgos pa la/ sku yon gzhan rnams 'bul ba'i mgo bres tsam yang ma dod par/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo sogs drag po'i las sbyor la btsan khrid du byed pa 'di/ dben sa rje drung gi mdzad lugs thugs lhus ma things gsungs skad/ dgos pa'i dbang gi las sbyor de dag gnang dgos nges (44na than tshe/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gtso bo dbyangs dpon par mdzad bcug na/ khong thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje drung lha dbang pa/ byang bdag po yab sras/ mas rje dwags ma ba/ sde pa yug nas sogs/ sngags 'chang kha yod lag yod mang po la man ngag gi zhun thar bcad pa'i khungs ldan yin na'ang / khong dang yang dgon rin po che sogs dpyod ldan rnams mdzad ma bde bas reg la ma 'byar lta bur song / rab stims pa shes rab che yang rto ge ba rgan po'i nyams kyi rtsing hral dang / khong rang gi rang bzhin las grub pa'i hang rgyag zung du 'brel ba'i/ mthong brgyud kyi phyag len la ma ltos pa'i rang bzo mang po byed yod 'dug go / de yang dpon slob paṇa chen rin po cher bka' chos thog mar gsan pa'i tshe/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i snyan gsan gnang bar/ snga sor nged rang gis 'di yongs rdzogs zhu myong ba zhig med pas/ slar rtsol ba dang rtog 'jug sogs byed khyad nas lo lnga drug zhig gi bar 'gyangs cha zhus/ de nas 'bul thub pa byed gsung ba'i zhal len gnang / rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa jo nang sprul sku kun dga' snying po'i drung du rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang zhu bar btang ba 'dra zer/ 'ga' zhig ni bla ma ris su ma bcad pa'i gsum bzhi zhig nas khu bsdus gsung ba dngos su thos zhes gleng / gang ltar lcags phag nang du 'bras spungs su phebs te/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po nyid dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bor bzhengs nas rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang 'bul ba gnang / sde pa snang rtse nas kyis ston zer ba'i gsang ba'i lung bstan du/ nub phyogs gtsang gi phyogs nas dmags mtsho brdol/ /gra (44ba〉gil gzhung gsum sbrang —221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)ma rlung khyer 'dra/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan thog tu babs te/ de lo gtsang sa dpon zhad thugs 'dod ma mnyam par brten/ gtsang dpung gtos che ba yar rgyab tu 'byor/ yar rgyab pa dpon blon gsol skal gyi stong du bzhugs dgos pa'i gnas gshis la brten/ mtshan mthu stobs rgya mtsho zhes bsgyur/ lo 'di bdag gi snga phyi rnams su lho byang gi 'grul pa gtos cher 'ongs nas/ brgya 'bul stong 'bul grangs kyis mi chod pa phul/ de dag la so sor 'dod chos kyi rim pa gnang / zang zing gi sgo nas re ba bkang ba sogs/ lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i mdzad pa 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /e ma dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa las/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus yongs skong ba/ /dngos po'i ngo bo tsam gyi gshis lugs las/ /phul byung thugs rje chen pos bskul ba yin/ /rang bde'i phun tshogs 'chi med dga' tshal las/ /gzhan phyir me 'obs lta bu'i 'khor ba la/ /dga' bar spyod 'di 'phags chen dam pa yi/ /snying stobs mchog las gzhan gyi spyod yul min/ /'gro la rjes su brtse ba'i snying rje'i lha/ /mi bsrun dgra la khros pa'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /bstan tshe gzhan 'phrul gnas nas 'dod lha'i bu/ /'jigs te lus med zol gyis rdzul brten/ /gtsang sdo srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal lha sar phebs/tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa zhu ba'i snyan gsan byung ba/gnang thub na mchod yon tshang ma la slebs dkyus che ba yong rgyu yin 'dra yang / rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pas/ sdeb gtsang pa bstan dgra yin pas de 'dra gnang ba mi rigs/ myur du (45na〉sgral ba yin zhes bkag /rgyal du phebs pa'i lam zhor bsam yas gnas gags gnang ba zhig la/ bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po dang dpe dkar lcog tu mjal bar/ dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad/ rgyal du dgun kha bzhugs pa zhig la/ dbyar dus ltar dro zhing chu rnams kyang lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgra sgrog cing 'bab pa byung bar/ dbu mdzad dbyangs dpon ye shes rgya mtshos da lo dgun shin tu dro ba /'di thugs rje'i shugs yin par 'dug zhus pas/ 'di tsam la gnang ci yod/ ding sang mtha' dmag gis bod la gnod pa che ba yong grabs byung res kyi kha gnon byas pa yin/ da dung yang nged khams bzang rin sog —222

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)pos bod la gnod pa mi yong / chos rje zhwa dmar bas/ gyod kha smras kyi phrug gu ma skyes dgos/ /zhes bka' bkyon mdzad byung yang / de'i gnod lan dgos pa ma byas/ phyon pad+ma yin byas na kha ches/skyon pad 'dra tsam yin byas kyang chog pa yod ces kyal ka gsungs/ thengs gcig lha sa'i mchod khang mjal skabs/ lha rje dge ba 'bum gyis gtsug lag khang la zhabs tog mdzad pa'i gsung 'phros zhig la brten nas/ lar 'khor ba 'dir lan mang po zhig 'khor tsa na/ 'di ru skye ba ma blangs zhes mtha' mi 'dug gsung skad/ sde pa sku rab pa grub mtha'i kun slong la brten pa'i thugs ru nga zhing phrag dog pas/ bstan pa la re gnod byung bas de la dmigs pa'i las sbyor gnang res kyis/ khong pa rdzong gzhis gsar du lon pa sogs bsod nams yar 'gror byung ba na/ rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pas/ sku rab pa 'di tsā ri zhing (45ba〉skyong gis bskyabs par 'dug /da cha thog mar zhing skyong bsgral dgos zer nas 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg tu sdugs pa/ rgyal dga' tshal gyi mgon khang po ta la'i chos 'byung steng gi mgon khang du/ rje gong ma'i dus btsugs pa'i zhing skyong gi gtor ma gtor gral nas 'don pa sogs rtsing spyod sna tshogs pa zhig byas/ rab 'byams dang / gzims khang gong sprul pa'i sku gnyis sbyin sreg sdugs mkhan yin 'dug par/ nyin gcig khong rnam gnyis kyis dga' ldan pho brang nas sngags khang dang / gzims khang gong du don gcod cig la byon pa/ mchod khang gi rgyab nas khong dpon slob gnyis skar gzigs par/ gtsug lag khang gis pu shu la sleb la khad byas pa'i mi nag po dar nag gi 'jol ber gyon pa rkang thang can rta nag po sga srab spras pa zhig gi 'thur thag nas bzung ste/ bsgugs shig lta ba yin no zer/ de'i mod la rang yal du song / ring po ma lon par sprul pa'i sku lha sar tha shegs skabs/ mi nag rta nag gi cho 'phrul chen po dang / rab 'byams par yang rjes su gtsang ba'i bka' brkyan phog pa sogs/ me dang sma ra'i dpe kho na byung / stong skor zhabs drung rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ 'phags pa lha'i mchog gi sprul sku 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal po/ ba so sprul sku/ pad mo sprul sku/sher dbang sprul sku sogs mdo stod mdo smad dang rgya sog gi bla chen mang po phebs/ yul babs dang —223—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāskabastan pa'i zang zing gi 'bul ba grangs med pa phul/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi re ba yongs su bkang /'phags pa lha dang / ba so sprul sku gnyis kyi gtsug phud bzhes / rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bka' (46na〉༅ma thor bu'i ljags lung gnang/ bde mo sprul pa'i skus thog mar mjal dus/ thams cad mkhyen pa de rab tu byung ba zhig yin pa gzhin bcas la/ de nyid ni khyim pa gos dkar can zhig snang zhes gsungs pas/ nye 'khor ba rnams kyis/khyed rang spyan 'brul ba yin mod/rab tu byung ba'i rtag kho na yin 'dug ces smra skad/ thengs gcig ni lha khro bo zhig gi rnam par gzigs gsung ba dang / nyin gcig dga' ldan pho brang gi rab gsal du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bde mo sprul skus khong rang gcig bur shar rgyag la byon pas/ gsum gdan zhig gi steng na/ ding sang 'bri cha la ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gyi 'brom ston pa'i sku'i rnam pa dang /de dang zhal sprod kyi tshul du mi gang tsam gyi mtho bar jo bo a ti sha khru gang ba zhig 'od kyi dkyil na sgo re bzhugs pa mthong bas/ re zhig smra ma shes par hur re lus/ bka' las sprul pa'i sku der bzhugasashig gsungs pa na/ nyams snang de 'gags tshar 'dug /de nas rgyu mtshan de ltar byung zhus pas/ spyan 'khrul pa yin zhes zhal gyis mi bzhes skad/ rgyal dang 'ol kha phyogs su phebs/ yun ring bar bzhugasashing mthong thos dran reg gi sgo nas 'gro ba rnams smin grol la bkod/ zhabs cung zhig bsnyun pa la chab tshan gnang / de'i tshe sku mdun rin po che gshegs pa'i gnas tshul 'bul mi slebs par/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan la/ dgongs rdzogs gtong lugs kyi bslab ston dang / nged rang rkang pa'i 'phrod bsten grub 'phral sleb yong bka' phebs gnang / dgung lo nyer drug pa shing stag hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i dus tshes dge bar dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde wo por/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te (46ba)paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas mkhan po dang / paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i sprul sku bsod nams dge legs dpal bzang gi las sgo ba/ g.yin yang gsang ston dus bgo ba sogs las kyi kha skong brla dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su/ dar chog —224

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ snyenanyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas tshangs par spyod pa'i gtso bo bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa bzhes te/ngur smig 'chang ba rnams kyi rgyal mtshan gyi tog dam par gyur/mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ de nas kun dga'i gnam lo la/ /rgyal zla drag tshes 'phrod sbyor bzang / /dus der dpal ldan sa spungs su/ /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang / sprul sku bsod nams dge legs dpal/ /mkhan slob dge 'dun kha skong bcas/ /nyes med phun tshogs bsnyen par rdzogs/ /zhes theg/ /de yang zhal snga nas khri rin po che sangs rgyas rin cen/ khri rin po che dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/zhal snga nas chos gnyer grags pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che/ gzims khang gong sprul pa'i sku/ 'ol kha nas drung pa mkhas btsun pa/ rje nor bu ba sogs rang phyogs ngos kyi bla ma mang po la mdo sngags kyi chos tshul ji snyed pa gsan de yang spyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul la/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po dang / rje btsun mi la gnyis kyi rnam par thar pa la 'gran bzod pa'i/ tha na bzhad gad dang ku re tsam gyi phyir du yang mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ye mi mdzad/ rje zhal snga nas sangs rgyas rin cen gyi sku gdung zhugs su phul ba/ sku'i stod kyi cha cher ma tshig pa'i 'phral du lta snang legs rgyu med pa zhig spyan 'bebs la khyer yongs pa/ der 'khor mang po zhig gis ya nga ba'i rnam pa byed pa la/rje 'dis phyag tu bzhes shing (47na po bu thog tu yun ring po'i bar du bzhag nas smon lam 'debs pa gnang / 'ol kha'i drung pa mkhas btsun pa de/ sde pa 'ol kha pa'i mchod gnas dgon sbug gi bla chung yin kyang / khong pa la bzhugs gdan mnyam pa tsam 'ding zhing gsol ja sogs sngon la bzhes su bcug /dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che dang / gzims khang gong sprul pa'i sku gnyis la bkur bzosaches pas/ drung 'khor rnying pa rnams bka' chos gsan yang 'di 'dra rang mi rigs sngar nas srol med ces ma rengs pa chen po byas/ stong skor zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho mjal par byon dus/ thog mar thams cad mkhyen pa ma gtogs gzhan la mi 'dud pas/ paṇa chen rin po cher phyag mi 'bul/—225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)slar bsnyen rdzogs sogs gsung chos zhu rgyu yin pas de skabs skyag bkur zhu rgyu yin tshul mgron gnyer rgya yags pa brgyud snyan du phul bar ma dgyes pa'i bskor sbyangs yan gsum gnang ste/phyag 'phral du 'bul bcug par yang / drung 'khor rnams kyis stong skor ba bden zhes glengs 'dug kyang / bshes gnyen bsten tshul la dgongs par mngon/ de yang khengs dregs khon 'dzin g.yo rgyu sogs/ tshul min gyi spyod pas ma gos shing / ngo tsha shes shing bag dang ldan pa/ drang zhing gzhan mgu ba'i thabs tshul lhur mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam par thar pa 'di ni mkhas pa rnams mgu ba bskyed pa'i gnas yin la/ deng dus kyi skye bo phal che ba rnams tshul de'i ldog phyogs kho na nyams su bstar/ phan btags na chog mi shes par gcig byung na brgya stong long du re/ byang khog gi lha khang du slo ba'i grogs po pad+ma kha zum pa'i nang du bung ba chud pa lta bur g.yo ba'i byed pa po (47bskoms kyis ni/ gnod pa ma byas pa'am lta phyogs legs pa tsam re la'ang mgu ba lhur byed par snang mod/ de lta bu'i lnga brgya mtha' ma'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa'i skyes bu mang pos/ byas pa drin du mi gzo ba'i sgo nas thugs sun phyung ba byung na'ang / 'phags chen dam pa rnams ni/ tshul de lta bu'i skye bo la lhag par rjes su brtse zhing / snying stobs chen pos sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang du len pa la rnam par dpa' ba ni chos nyid yin la/ gzhan dag rnams tshul ngan par spyod pa'ang shin tu bden te/ tsū ta'i yul du skyes phyin chad rkang pa gnyis mi 'byung ba ni rang gi rang bzhin can no/ /bod 'dir dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rje btsun rwa chen zhabs kyi pur ril por nang rten la bzhugs shing / 'jim pa 'theb skyu re la rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i rdzu 'phrul gyis ya ma rā dza stong phrag re bzlas te ljags chab sa dzad pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can de'i drung du/ bzlas brjod kyi rim pa bgrang ba las 'das pa gnang zhing / spyir dam pa rnams ni/ gdul bya'i ngor/ mkhas pa dang / grub pa dang / btsun pa dang / bzang ba sogs/ sna tshogs su ston pa las/ sku tshe 'di la gtso bor sgrub pa nyams len gyi rim pa la thugs—226

rgyal dbang yon to rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)gzhol ba zhig go /bde chen rtser bzhugs pa zhig la/ sde pa'i gzims chung shing rtsi sogs legs shos de ga bzhugs me gnang pas/ sde pas bzhugs me gzims chung shing rtsi med pa 'dir gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ bka' las de 'dra mi dgos/ rdzong gzhis 'di rnams bdag sus byed dang bed sus spyod mi shes pas gtsigs byas yin 'dra gsungs par/ thams cad sku rtsad lta bur go yang / ring por ma lon par bde (4ni thin brag dkar sogs sde srid gtsang par shor bas/ kun yid ches kyi gnas su gyur/ 'bras spungs su/ las byed pas ja snel po zhig gi skor la rtseg rtseg byas pas/ dngos po mang po zhig bzhugs me'i nang du 'debs pa gnang bar/ zhabs 'bring ba mang pos lkog tu/ gnang sgo 'di 'dra spyo spyod dang khyad par mi 'dug ces skur pa sna tshogs shig btab/ de yang skye bo de dag rnams zang zing gi dngos po phra mo tsam la yang / mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par bzung nas/ snod brgya stong mang po gcig nang du gcig bcug pa'i phugs su/ rgyas btab ste cung zad tsam chud 'dza' bar gyur na'ang / thugs rnam par sred pa'i pad+ma ser sna'i mtsho nang du 'dar ba'i ngang tshul de/ byang chub sems dpa' srid 'byor thams cad chu shing ltar gzigs pa rnams la rgyas bkab par 'dug /de ni myur du gzhan don du gshegs pa dang /grwa sa phan tshun la mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul 'byung ba'i brda chos de gzhan gyis ma go bar snang /de yang phyag mdzod gu shri chen po'i rjes su rje gong ma'i dbon po rtse kha nas chos rje sogs phyag mdzod khur len pa kha yar byung ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las/ bla ma'i zhabs 'bring nye gnas phal mo che/ /dkor gyis tshig nas las 'bras khyad du gsod/ /yun du 'grogs pas skyon mthong dad pa 'grib/ /ces gsungs pa'i don dang / rje btsun mi las/ dad pa can gyi dad rdzas 'di/ sal brgyab na sa 'gas/ rdo la brgyab na rdo 'gas zhes pa ltar/ gang gi 'phrin lasakyi cha shas las nye bar grub pa'i bdog pa mang por longs su spyad pa'i me lces/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi ljon pa rnam par tshig pas/ tshul min (48ba thad byed kyi sol ba'i mgal dum ches cher spungs pa —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemang po zhig gis/ zhabs phyir mi 'gyur pa'i spyod pa mang du byas na'ang / rgyal po dge ston/ sdig ston la brtse ba'i lo rgyus dang / de bzhin gshegs pas/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang lhas byin gnyis la nye ring med ces bden tshig mdzad bas/ lhas byin ma bzhu ba'i nad las grol ba sogs mdo las byung ba'i gtam rgyud kyi don dang mtshungs pas/ de dag la lhag par brtse zhing shin tu ma rungs pa 'jam pa gsum gyis 'dul bar mi nus pa 'ga' zhig ni/ rgyab rtsa byed mkhan dang bcas pa mtha' dag la/ mngon spyod kyi las sbyor gyi sgo nas sgo gcod par mdzad do/ /stong skor sprul sku 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos gtsos pa'i sog yul gyi 'grul pa gtos chen po slebs/ yos lo'i smon lam la zang zing gi longs spyod gnod sbyin gyi yul du slebs pa dang 'dra bar gyur/ mang 'gyed dang 'bul ba rnam grangs mang zhing gya nom pas/ grwa tsho gos dang bla tsho gis kyang ngang gis 'phel/ ja snel po mang nyung gi gleng brjod skor lam gyi khyon thams cad dar dir du song / 'on kyang de lo tshe 'di blos btang nas g.ya' dang gangs kyi mtshams su gcig pur sgrub pa mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor pa mnga' ris grub chen brtson 'grus snying por rnyed pa rnams nas rtsam du bsgril nas tshogs chen du bsnyen bkur ba sogs kyi phyir du byon pa/ 'brum nad kyis lha sar gshegs pa dang /sprul sku bsod nams dge legs dpal bzang po 'brum pa dang zhing skyong gi gnod 'tsher dogs pa gnyis bsdongs nas gshegs par brten/ smin lam gyi sgang tsam nas tshogos dbur paṇa chen rin po che bzhugs su bcug /dpon slob byings sa spungs su log phebs/ me 'brug (49na)zla ba gsum pa'i nang du/ rgya nag gong ma rgyal po kun shu wang ste ta'i wang gis bla ma bsod nams blo gros sogs rgya mi mang po mngags/ khyab bdag rdo rje'i sangs rgyas kyi las ka dang las zhwa las gos tham ka phul/ 'bras spungs su rgya spyi khang du gdan drangs te/ 'bul ba dang / rtsed sna ya mtshan pa mang po byas/ rgya nag tu phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsan phul/ rten 'brel gyi sgo nas zhal bzhesamadzad/ bla ma bsod nams blo gros kyis rgya yul du bzhengs pa'i lha khang la/ dga' ldan pho brang gi rtse —228

rgyal dbang yon to rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)nas zhal de phyogs su gzigs te phyag nas gtor bas/ mchod khang gi phyi nang thams cad du nas lkog rgyu yod pa byung zhing / rten 'ga' zhig gi thugs kar me tog dngos su bzung ba sogs/ blo'i ra ba las 'gongs pa'i rdo phrul gyi bkod pa rgya chen po bstan/ gsang yib chab tshan la phebs pa'i tshe rdo la zhabs rjes gsal bar byung /mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ stong skor sprul pa'i sku la sogs/ /sog 'grul mang pos yang dag mchod/ /me 'brug shar tshe shar phyogs nas/ /nag pa'i zla bar rgya nag gi /bkra shis khri sgo'i khri thog pa/ lhun shu wang ste ta yi wang / /rgya la dbang byed dbang li'i 'khor/ /rgya mi mchod rdzas thogs pa dang / /rgya mi bla ma slob dpon rnams/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can steng 'di na/ /rgya chen mchod par rab tu bshams/ /rgya yi las zhwa zhu thor bcas/ /rgya nag phyogs la phebs dgos zhes/ /rgya bskyed zhu ba nan tan bcas/ /rgya phubs can gyi gtsug lag khang / /rgya gar nas byon rten rnams la/ /mchod pas phyag nas dngos su bzung / /de la ring bsrel mang du byon/ /zhing brje mya ngan 'da' ba'i brda/ /de bzhin gsang yib chab tshan khar/ /rdo la zhabs rjes(49ba tha zhag nas slar/ /ser sa spungs chos sder phebs/ /zhes so/ /de yang mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi mdzad pa'i cha nas/ 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i yon tan mtha' dag tshang bar mnga' ba ste/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi tshig don gang la yang / dka' tshegs la ma ltos par brda tsam bstan pas mkhyen/ 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba dag la phan par 'gyur na/rang gi bde ba gtong ba la cung zad tsam yang nyam nga ba mi mdzad/ gzhan gyis slong na dngos po rin thang che chung la ma ltos pa dang / na bza' zhal dkar sogs phyag thogs yod pa zhig kyang the tshom med par gnang ba'i ni rgyal po thams cad sgrol gyi khengs pa 'phrog nus/ gnas skabs su thugs chung ba ltar ston yang / don du gang la yang 'jigs pa med par seng ge lta bu ste/ dus der skyid shod kyi lung pa thamasacad sde srid gtsang pa'i mnga' 'og tu chud pa sogs mdor na dbus gtsang phal cher la lung bsgyur bar brten/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'di'i stobs wor gyis dregs pa'i che che mor rlom pa dang / tshe 'di'i —229—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)bya ba btang btang mor grags pa sogs thams cad sa 'dar rdo 'dar la song ste thugs shing sdong gi yal ga ltar 'khyogs kyang / 'phral srid sgrub kyi mda' ltar drang zhing / zhal pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam pas zhi zhing dul dul ltar gyur pa'i tshe/ rje 'di nyid kyis khrom dmar nag 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ gtsang pa dpon blon gyi mtshan nas smos te kha sbyor dbye par mdzad nas/ mthu stobs chen pos phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rang bzhin can no/ /nang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la mnga' brnyes shing / bla ma dang yid dam gyi lha mang po'i 'kha gzigs gsung gi gnang ba stsal na'ang / gzhan la 'di lta bu byung zhes (50na)mi gsung ba thugs dkyil che/ gsung rab kyi dka' gnad 'gar mkhas pa rnams dpa' zhus par mdzad kyang / kho bos slob gnyer ma byas zhes dman cha kho na len/ rje 'di nyid zhabs pad brten pa'i ring / dpon po kho lo che'i sras che chung gnyis dmag gi dpung tshogs dang bcas lan grangs mang po lhags te/ gtsang skur sogs gzhan sde rnams la/ gnad 'phrod kyi g.yul rlabs po che gshom rtsis kyi bod dang khad nyer 'byor ba na/ ched gtad mi sna mngags te/ 'jun stangs kyi gsung sgam pos/ dusazing gi spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad par brten/ zhabs pad brten ring bod la mtha' dmag gis gnod pa ma byung ba ni/ rnam thar che shos gcig tu snang / rgyu mtshan des na/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che mnga' ris su chibs kha bsgyur gdong / dga' ldan pho brang nas phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan gyis/ da lo thu med kyi tha'i ji 'di rnams kyi mdzad lugs/ skyid shod zhabs drung dang /grwa sa'i thugs khur bzhes mkhan ci rigs kyi gsung tshul/ gtsang sde srid la sku dbang bed spyod kyi phebs sgo 'dra yod 'dug pa/ 'di tsho la brten pa'i dus zings shig byung dogs blo mdzangs che bar byung / rang ngos kyi shar tshod sde gzar langs na/ sngar yang mda' 'di ris kyis mig bcarwa ba'i sna sun dang bcas 'jam chags shig 'dod pa yin kyang / rang dbang 'du mi 'du tshod things dka' ba nas/ da lo phyogs phebs ma gnang bar bzhugs yul gnang ba e 'gab sogs bslab ston zhus par phebs sgor/ rnying ma'i lung bstan na bod sog pos 'dzin pa yod zer ba 'dug pa dang / thams —230

rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6) cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho de zhal bzhugs(50bsko/ dus zing la mi dgyes pa dang mtha' mi la gsung btsan pas sde gzar stol ba gnang 'gro yang / sog po'i rgyal brgyud 'di tsho dbang che ba dang bcas lhas things pa dka' ba 'dug kyang / dkon cog gi thugs rjes dus bde ba yong la che/ dad kyang sems mdzangs pa byung ste/ mnga' ris bdag po'i 'bod mi slebs grub pa sogs nas bshol mi thub pa 'dra/ 'jam gang chags kyi thabs mdzod phebs 'dug pas kyang shes nus so/ /hor zla bstoganyis pa'i bco lnga'i nyin/ gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus te dga' ldan gyi gnas su po ༷ shegs so/ /mkhar nag lo tsā bas/ dgung lo rgyu skar grangs ldan skabs/ /me 'brug rgyal zla'i tshes dbang dus/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim/ /bdun phrag gsum par chos kyi sku/ /bum nang mar me'i 'od gsal bzhin/ /kye ma 'di 'dra'i rnam dpangs la/ /kye hud bdag cag 'di na lus/ /kye rdor la sogs rgyud don bzhin/ /skye mched dwangs pa'i longs skur bzhengs/ /tshad med bzhi yis rab bskul te/ /zhing 'dir slar yang sprul pa'i sku/ /ston nges khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes so/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa kun/ /lag na pad+ma'i rnam par shar ba dag /bkod pa rgya mtsho'i zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /grangs med sprul pa'i rol gar ci yang ston/ /skal ngan dus kyi mtshan mor nye ba na/ /mtha' klas 'gro ba'i 'dren pa rta ljang can/ /chos dbyings zad mi shes pa'i thun 'tshamasakyi/ /phang par bzhugs nas 'gro rnams 'dod 'di ci/ /de lta na yang ma rig snang tshul las/ /rlabasachen spyod la dpa' ba'i rgyal sras rnams/ /'khor ba'i pha mtha' rdzogs min de srid du/ dman lam zhi bder gol ba ga la (51na)srid/ /de nas dgung zhag zhe dgu'i bar du/ rgyud stod smad gnyis kyisagasang ba 'dus pa'i mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang / grwa sa phan tshun sogs dge 'dun gyi sde ris med pa rnams su bsnyen bkur ba sogs dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs so/ /me sbrul ston mjug dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i phyag len rnam par —231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedag pas sku gdung rin po che zhugs su phul bar dbu thod bam ril/ thugs ljags spyan gsum gdung ring bsrel mang du phebs shing / khar kha dpon po chos khur gyis dbu thod dang / thu med kyi tha'i ji blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos thugs so so'i yul grur bsod nams kyi zhing du gdan drangs/ gdung ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong 'dzam bu gling na khyad du 'phags pa zhig khar kha chos khur dpon pos sbyin bdag byas te bzheng ba'i bzo grwa tshugs pa/ sde gzar gyi stabs nas ma 'grub pa/ slar shing glang lor thu med kyi dpon po hong tha'i jis sbyin bdag byas/ phyag mdzod sa stong ba bsod nams rab brtan gyis thugs khur bzhes/ ri mo dgos skyes rdo rjes thig btab/ do dam tsha ba dka' bcu sangasargyas shes rab/ dpon po bying pa blo bzang / bal po nor bu tshe ring sogs bcu phrag gnyis tsam gyis gegs med du bzhengs/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin po che dkon cog chos 'phel dang / sgo mang slob dpon sangs rgyas bkra shis gnyis kyis gzungs 'phul gyi phyag len gnang ste dpal ldan 'bras spungasakyi rnam thar sgo gsum du bzhugs nga / rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gtso mdzad/ ser 'bras kyi slob dpon khri gdan (51ba)zur/sku ga 'gas rnam rgyal grwa tshang dang bcas pas rab tu gnas shing / sbyin bdag tu sog po tsho chen bzhi bcu'i gur dkar po'i bdag po thub pa ju nang tha'i sun hong tha'i ji bskos pas/ rten 'brel legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa 'grig go /smras pa/ ngo mtshar med byung gtam gyi sbyor ba dang / /tshig 'phreng 'dzad pa med pa'i pu sta ka /lo rgyus deb gter don gnyer dpyod ldan rnams/ /dga' ba'i gar dang tsos te da long zhig /dam pa mchog gi phul byung mdzad pa'i mtha'/ /'jal pa kun mkhyen rnams kyang skyid skyur na/ /som nyi'i dra bar chud par bdag 'dra yis/ /brjod pa chu shing gos bu 'tshol ba bzhin/ /'on tang tshad pa'i gdung bas mnar ba rnams/ /rgya mtsho rdzogs par 'thungs pa'i nus bral yang / /ji tsam longs su spyod nus de nyid kyi/ 'dod pa'i re ba yongs su cis mi skong / /thor bu'i lo rgyus bsdus pa'i ga rnga yis/ /dpyod ldan —232

rgyal dbang yon to rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ 6)rma bya'i snying la mi 'bab kyang / /yig tshang khungs ldan ngag rgyun ma gtogs pa'i/ /'brel med rang bzo bris pa 'di na med/ /yongs grags mkhas pa'i slob dpon bsten pa'i mthus/ /bcad lhug snyan ngag smra la thogs med kyang / /mkhas blun kun gyis blta bar go bde phyir/ /'bol rtsom grong pa'i tshig tu lhug par bkod/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi rtogs brjod 'phreng / /tshig gi srad bur brgyus pa'i dge ba des/ /lus can mtha' dag dus mkhyen rgyal po yi/ /bsod nams ji bzhin longs su spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis (52na)bskul ba'i ngor/ sku na phra mo'i dus kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar ba'i rigs zin bris su bkod pa'i lha/ga ril gnyis dang / bzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i go 'byed/ mkhar nag lo tsā ba dpal 'byor rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rnam thar tshigs bcad ma rnams la gzhi byas/ de'i dus kyi drung 'khor rnying pa rgyus can 'ga' zhig gi ngag sgros nges dag gis zur brgyan/ 'on kyang gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa'i rigs mang po dang / lo dus kyi nges pa sogs ni zhib tu brtsad bcad kyang / grwa rigs rnams gdul bya che chung dang bka' drin skyong mi skyong gi gleng brjod las/ bla ma'i rnam par thar pa don du gnyer ba nyung ba'i phyir/ zhib par 'dri ba'i gnas ma rnyed na'ang / gong du smos pa rnams la gzhi byas te/ gtam rgyud deb gter smra ba'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/ btsong kha'i yul dkar thang mar khu'i mtsho mor sbyar ba'i yi ge'i zlos gar sgyur ba po ni rig gnas zad mi shes pa'i bang mdzod 'dzin pa slob dpon ma hā paṇ+ḍita dpon drung rin po che smon 'gro lo tsā ba yin no// maṅga lo// //—233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ra༅༅//khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅//oṃ su sti sirnyi//thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i tshogs gnyis sa bon smin pa las//sku bzhi'i gos bzang g.yur du za ba'i bshes gnyen dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon//cung zad bsten kyang 'dod pa'i re stong sngon med yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//blo bzang chos kyi srid la dbang bsgyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud//blo gsal skal bzang rin chen za ma rtag/lung rtogs chos kyi bdud rtsis 'gengs mdzad pa'i//dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos ngur smrig gis//rnam rol mtshan ldan bla ma phyag gi yul//grangs med bskal par goms pa'i rgyal sras kyis//rlabs chen spyod pa'i pha mtha' 'ching ba la//byed pos kun gsal zhags par sprul byas kyang //cha tsam 'jal ba'i go skabs ga la zhig/'og min zhing du mtshan dpe'i sgyu 'phrul gyis//ngo mtshar gar du bzhengs pa'i stobs bcu'i rtsal//lhun grub gsang ba gsum gyi rnam thar kun//sgrib pa'i yid can rnams kyang rtogs nus su//'on kyang mkha' la rgyu ba'i zla gzugs gcig/rnyog bral 'bum phrag rdzing bur 'char ba ltar//2na ) mchog dman sman pa'i blo dang rab 'tsham pa'i//phun tsho gis bkod pa'i ngo mtshar zad mi shes/khyad par kha bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir//'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa spel ba'i phyir//mkhas btsun bzang pa'i mdzad pa mtha' klas pa//lce brgyas bskal brgyar brjod kyang ga la rdzogs//'on kyang gsang ba'i rtogs pa brjod ma gyur//skal bzang 'chi med tshogs kyi thod bcings nas//dad pa'i do rang rlabs wo bsod nams gar//gto bde'i 4

paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i shing rta/ 6degazigs mor bsgyur la 'di na brel/ /bgrang yas skye rgu'i yid kyi sa 'dzin la/ /rab dmar dang ba mtsho yi shing rta yis/ /legs tshogs bye ba'i nor bu rab drangs nas/ /'di phyir dge ba'i 'dod rgu char du bsnyil/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams ni mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpung mtha' yas pas 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa la thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sprul pa grangs med par ston la/ khyad par grags can gyi bskal ba 'di nyid la sangs rgyas stong 'byon pa rnams kyi nang nas snyigs ma la ches cher bdo zhing 'dul bar dka' ba la snying stobs mchog gi pad dkar lta bur (2ba)bsngags pa 'o skol gyi ston pa zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa rin po che 'di la/ chags pa dang bral ba'i skyes mchogo grangs med pa zhig byon pa rnams kyi nang nas/ rang cag rnams kyi dam pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te lung rtogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po dben sa pa chen po paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyan mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni bskal par brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i mtha' ga la zhig /'on kyang thun mong gi rnam thar rags rim tsam ni/ rje btsun bla ma mchog gi bka' 'bum du bzhugs pa ltar yin la/ de nyid du shin tu spam pa'i tshul gyi gsang ba rdo rje'i tshig rnams 'bri bar 'dod nas/ rje nyid la gsol ba btab ste zhal lung las byung ba dang / rnam par dpyod pa'i blo ldan gu ge chos rje sogs/ spyan snga ba 'ga' zhig gi ngag las byung ba'i khungs btsun pa rnams la brten nas mchog dman gyi skye rgu skal bar ldan pa rnams kyi ched dang / rang nyid kyi dad pa'i gsos thun mong du yi ge'i lam du 'god pa ni/ de yang grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dben sa pa blo bzang don grub de nyid/ sprul sku rags pa'i za ma tog bsdus nas/ slar bsams bzhin 'tsho byed drug brgya ba'i sras su srid pa bzung ba'i sprul pa'i sku sngon ma de/ mi gtsang ba'i grib la brten gshegs pa na/ yum mya ngan gyis non pa'i rna lam du dzo gi zhig byung nas lung bstan tshul rnam thar —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nethun mong bar gsal ba'i ā tsarla de ni/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa ste/ de yang sngon mkhasagrub rin po che'i dus/ mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la mgon po phyag drug pa'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa (3na)gsan cing / chos skyong gi gtso bor mdzad pas lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i rten 'brel du go /dben dgon du sangs rgyas byang sems dang / yid dam chos skyong mang po'i ljags bsnyen gnang ba'i tshe/ lha gang dang gang yin pa de dag gi zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / khyad par rdo rje 'jigs byed/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po/dpal ldan dmar zor ma sogs kyi sku dang gsung gi snang ba dngos su stsal nas 'phrin las bsgrub par zhal gyi bzhes/ 'di dag gi dus gzhan gyi legs nyes sogs shes bya lkog gyur ba mtha' dag kyang / sku na phra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis ma gsangs par gsungs pa na/ ji lta ba bzhin 'phyugs med du thog tu babs pa kho na byung /dgung lo bcu bzhi pa'i dus/ ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma'i ljags bsnyen mdzad pa'i tshe/mngon rtogs dang mthun pa'i dbyangs can ma zhig zhal gzigs pa'i thugs nas dbyangs can ma sngon mo zhig byung ste/ rin po che'i snod shing rtag gsar pas gang pa zhig bsnams nas gtso mo'i phyag tu phul bas/ shing tog gcig las dbyangs can ma dmar mo zhig chu las chu sbur rdol ba ltar thon/des gtso mo'i phyag gi shing tog snod dang bcas pa blangs te/ rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi phyag tu phul nas/ro brgya'i dpal la longs su spyod par mdzad pa dang / pi wang gi sgra snyan pa yang dngos su gsan pa ni/ sku tshe 'di nyid la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i rgyu mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su ma mchis par byung ba 'di'i rten 'brel yi skal/de'i tshe gnang ba'i dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa de la gzigs snang bstod par grags/ (3ba)lam rim chung ba thugs 'dzin gnang ba na/ nang par nas lam rim chen mo la gzigs rtog gnang bsathugs la shin tu babs te thugs 'dzin gnang ba'i dgongs pa gtad/ de'i tshe bdag cag gi ston pa —236

paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po sku che zhing blta bas chog mi shes pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa lta bu zhig zhal gzigs pas yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar gnang 'dug na'ang / rnam thar chen mor mnal lam du byung ba'i sgyu la brten par mchis/ bkra shis lhun por gsan sbyong la phebs pa'i nub bud med gzhen nu pho chas sprad pa zhig gis dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas te gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'dra ba zhig nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yin zer phyag tu gtad de legs so brjod pa ni/ dpal ldan 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug mas/ thos bsam gyi tshul bstan pa la brten nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i snang ba gsal bar 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi brda chos so/ /brtsi bzhag 'dzin pa la thog mar phebs pa'i tshe/ gzims spyil gyi sgo drung du rnal 'byor ma zhig gis 'o ma ka pā la gang khyer nas/ sku'i mdun du bteg byung ba la/ mtheb srin gyis reg pa zhig gnang / cung zad phebs te rnal 'byor ma de ci 'dra zhig yin dgongs phyi mig gzigs pa na/ gar song cha med du gyur/ rnal 'byor ma de 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das ma nges ces gsal bar ma gsung yang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa de nyid bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i snying po lha chos bdun gyi brgyud pa 'di nyid gtso bor 'dzin pa gnang bas/ rnal 'byor ma de yang rje btsun sgrol mar nges so/ /e ma dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal yangs las/ /legs 'ongs dbyar skyes myu (4na)gu gsar pa'i 'bras/ /bya rtsol bral yang tshar du dngar ba de/ /rten 'brel mi bslu dngos po'i gnas lugasayin/ /gzod ma nyid nas spangs rtogs yon to kun/ /lhun grub 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 44 / /tshad kyis 'jal dka'i gsang gsum rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /nam yang yol ba med pa rang gi gshis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas chos bsrung dgyes pa'i chu/ /gsang gsum snang ba'i rlabs phreng g.yo bzhin du/ /tshe rabs du mar goms pa'i ri gzar nas/ /rgyun chad med par 'bab 'di su yis bzlog /yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ljags bsnyen skabs/ /'jam dkar dang 'jigs byed gnyis sbrags —237—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bsgrubs gyi tshul du gnang bas//nyin gcig 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim gyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po'i mthar ya ma rā dzā shel gyi mdog lta bus bskor ba mngon sum du gzigs snang yang /rnam thar chen mo ni mnal lam gyi tshul du mchis/'di dag gi skabs rgyu mtshan gzhan gsal bar mi gsung yang /dngos po'i gnas tshod la dus dgra'i dbang po dpal ldan ma he'i zhal can mngon sum du 'grub pas/rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags lta bu'i mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa ni gdon mi za zhing /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rje dang /sngags 'chang chen po rdo rje dpal gnyis kyis srol btod pa'i zha lu gser khang gi ma he mchod par grags pa 'di nyid mkhan thog 'ga' zhig song 'tshams/ma he'i bka' bsgo 'di gnyan cha ches pas/mkhan po rnams la grongs chad sogs mi shis pa du ma byung bar brten/de phyin chad tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gnyis ma gtogs/4ba(5ba cha med pa'i dam bzhag mkhan ma byung zhing /dus phyis kyi dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud gcig la mthu stobs kyi bdag por grags pa'i khri chen bsod nams dbang pos kyang ma he bka' bsgo la 'byol thabs kho na mdzad cing /phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i rtogs ldan grangs kyi seng ge lta bur rlom pa'i zha lu sku zhang pa bka' bsko mdzad pa'i mu la shangs mtshal shor nas ring po ma lon par grongs pa sogs 'tshub grags shin tu che na yang /dam pa 'di nyid kyis bka' bsgo mdzad pa'i dus 'tshub stobs chung ba thams cad kyi mngon sum du grub cing ya mtshan gyi gnas su byed pa de'o//dben dgon du bzhugs skabs rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po mngon sum du phebs nas/rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir//thos pas sa par mi bya ste//sa gsum brnyes pa'i sems dpa' yang //thos pa'i ngoms pa med la ltos//ces sogs gsung gi snang ba rgya chen po stsal ba'ang mchis/skabasashig phrag rgya rdo rje'i pho brang zhes bya ba'i ri khrod du dgun zla gsum gyi ring me tog ril bu kho na'i bcud len la brten nas/nyin mtshan khor yug tu ༷bas rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas te thugs dam

paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)kho na la gzhol bar mdzad pas/ phyi rol gyi nye 'dab tu 'khod pa rnams lwa ba'i bems po mang po brtsegs te gyon kyang grang ba'i reg bya mi bzod par 'dar ba'i skabs/ bla ma nyid kyi sku zil pa phrom me ba/ phug pa'i nang yang me rgyun chad med par spar ba'i g.yos khang bzhin du tsha 'ur re ba byung ba ni/nang gi gtum mo'i bde drod rang 'bar du song ba'i nang rtags phyir shar ba'o/ /srad rgyud na bzhugs pa'i dus nub cig bkra shis lhun po nas yin zer ba'i/ /(5na)ā tsar+ya dang mon pa 'ga' zhig 'ongs nas/ khyed myur du bkra shis lhun por phebs dgos/ nged rnams kyis grabs byed zhus 'dug pa'i ā tsar+ya gtso bo de mgon po phyag drug pa dang / mon pa'i gtso bo de las gshin yin cing / bkra shis lhun po'i mkhan thog tu gdan 'dren pa 'dug /yang skabs shig mnal lam du/ bkra shis lhun po'i lho 'gram gyi gzhung lam la phebs pa na/ mi dkar po zhig dang dmar po zhig gis chib mthur nas bzung ste/ bkra shis lhun po'i 'du khang bar gdan drangs/ mi dkar po des dar gyis gril ba'i glegs bam zhig phul nas/ 'di gsung dgos rgyu yin zer bas ci yin nam dgongs gzigs tsa na/ glegs bam de lam rim che bar 'dug /de 'phral du mnal sad par snang / mi dkar po de spyan ras gzigs dang / dmar po de mgon po lho nub pa yin pa 'dra/ 'di ni bka' gdams gsar rnying gi bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par mnga' gsol bar gda'/ thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho thog mar bod du phebs skabs/ bkra shis lhun po'i mkhan slob thams cad kyis mjal bar phebs pa'i lam du mig 'phrul lta bu'i byis pa ya mtshan byung ba ni/ nag tsho lo tsā bas jo bo chen po gdan 'dren la rgya gar du byon pa dang / khu ston gyis yer par byon pa'i lam du ltas ya mtshan pa byung ba'i lo rgyus dang tshul mtshungs par 'dug /thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal ba'i nyin thog mar spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rnam par gzigs/ bka' gdams kyi chu 'go rwa sgreng pa'i dben gnas mjal bar thog mar phebs skabs zhabs skor la gshegs pa'i tshe/ jo bo'i (5ba)sku 'dra rang byon gyi tha snyad byed pa de'i sa nas gzigs —239—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)pas/ jo bo 'phying dkar ba gnas pa'i ri'i rtse nas 'ja' sprin kha dog sna lnga pa zhig nar gyis byung ba'i steng du/ jo bo chen po a ti sha/ rgyal ba 'phrom/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ khu ston chen po/ rdzames/ dgon pa ba/ po to ba/ phu chud pa/ spyan snga ba/ glang thang pa/ sha ra ba sogs bka' gdams kyi skyes bu dam pa grangs med par bzhugs pa'i sne mor rje btsun sgrol ma ljang gu dka' thub kyi chas kyis mdzes pa bzhengs nas bzhugs pa'i phyag mtshan ut+pa la'i 'dab ma zhig nam mkha' la bskyur ba'i tshul gyis gnang ba phyag tu babs/ nyam ring du 'khod pa rnams kyis dar ljang khu'i rnam par mthong / 'di ni bka' gdams rin po che'i bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor sku tshe yun ring du brtan par byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /'di skabs shig rwa sgreng gnas bcu khang du bzhugs tshe/ jo bo 'phying dkar ba dngos su byung nas/'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs shing / gtor bsngos kyi tshigs bcad cig kyang thugs rtsom gnang ngo / /rgyal kun gsung gi ngo bo ma sgo'i sgra/ gzhom med dbyangs su 'tsher ba 'jam pa'i dpal/ /ma rungs dus dgra'i dbang po gshin rje'i gshed/ /'di na ngur smig 'dzin pa'i gar gyis rol/ /phul byung lha cho ge bdun ldan ā dar shar/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan 'bum 'char bar/ /rnam gsum mkhas pa'i mdzad bzang byi dor gyi/ /byed por rgyal ba kun gyis mgrin gcig bsngags/ /rigs ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos grags pa'i zhabs/ /de sras pad dkar 'dzin dang gdan 'dzom pa'i/ /(6na)phul byung gzigs mor mtshar ba'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /nyin mor byed dang chu skyesaphrad pa bzhin/ / rje btsun byams mgon gyi lugs sku chen mo'i rab gnas nyin/ dge slong chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa zhig nam mkha' la byon te/ rten 'di la brten nas 'gro phan rgya chen po 'grub pa zhes gsung ba dang bcas te rten la thim pa gzigs/ de ni dga' —240

paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)ldan nas ye shes sems dpa' dngos byon par snang zhing / dga' ldan gyi byams pa'i thugs ka dang rten gyi thugs ka gnyis 'od zer gyi drwa bas 'brel ba'i gzigs snang khyad par can byung / tshul 'di dag la dpags na/ sku rnyan 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg mtha' dag ma 'ongs pa na byams pa'i 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye ba'i byed las khyad par can zhig yin nam snyam mo/ /dbyen bzlums mchod rten gyi nang bzhugs sa ts+tsha 'debs pa gnang skabs/ grub chen sha wa ri pa byon nas gnas chen rnams kyi sa sna rdo sna 'dres pa'i thum bu zhig phul/ drung du 'khod pa rnams kyis dzo gi rang bzhin pa zhig tu mthong / mchod rten gyi rab gnas dus/ de mo sprul sku lha dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gzigs snang la/ mchod rten char khebs kyi steng na/ dbus su rje nyid/ g.yas su grub chen zhig dang / g.yon du dge slong dbu dkar po zhig 'dug pa gzigs nas rgyu mtshan zhusapas/ grub chen de sa ra ha dang / dge slong de grub mchog chos kyi rdo rje yin zhes bka' stsal/ skabasashig nam mkha'i mthongs su rin po che'i khri zhig la rje btsun byams mgon bzhugs pa'i g.yas phyogs su/ /chos rje sangs rgyas ye shes grub (6ba)thob kyi cha lugs su bzhugs 'dug par gsol ba btab pas/ byams pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ste rje nyid kyi sku la thim pas/ sku 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar gyur pa ni gnas lugs nges don phyag rgya chen po la brten nas 'gro phan rgya chen po 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du go /slar yul bde ba can du sems dpa' chen po dang chu bzang pa'i sgrub gnas mjal bar phebs skabs/ smyung gnas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams zhal gzigs / skabs shig mnal lam du 'dzam bu gling thams cad chus gang bas/ ri rab la skor ba mdzad nas dga' ldan du phebs te/ rgyal ba ma pham pa/nam mkha' dri ma med pa/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa rnams bzhugs 'dug pa la rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ nyon mongs pa'i chu bo yin gsungs byung ba na/ nyon mongs pa'i chu bo yin na sems can rnams de las sgrol ba'i khur nged la zab dgongs pa'i ngang la mnal sad do/ /—241—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)mi pham mgon po'i thugs rje'i rnga bo che/ /med byung mdzad pa'i dbyu gus legs bskul nas/ /ring min 'gro rnams skal bzang dga' ston la/ /'god pa'i gtam snyan sgra dbyangs 'brol ba bzhin/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug grangs med dang / /dus kun 'bral med lhan cig bzhugs gyur kyang / /ma rig sgrib pas sbags pa'i 'gro rnams kyis/ /mngon sum mthong ba'i skal pa ches cher phra/ /las nyon gting mtha' med pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /thar 'dod blo dang ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i ded dpon 'di sten dang / /sku gsum nor bu'i gling du bgrod par nges/ /mnga' ris su phebs pa'i yar lam/ mtsho ma dros pa nas rde'u phyag gang bzhes pa rnams/ spyan (7na)ras gzigs sogs lha'i sku kho nar gsal ba byung / /mnga' ris su las dag pa zhig gis/rje nyid kyi dbu la gtsug tor dang / ljags kyi steng 〉yig ring po kha dog sngon po zhig gsal bar mthong ma thag yid kyis bstod cing gsol ba btab pas/ rje nyid 'dzum bag dang bcas te/ spyan 'bur tshugs su gzigs byung ba na 'jigs zhus pa zhig byung skad/ phyir lam gangs te se'i mdun du khrom dbang zhig gnang bas/ gangs ri de dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi pho brang dang / nang du 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs thams cad bzhugs 'dug pa'i gtso bo'i sku las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pas/pho brang snod bcud thams cad sngon por gzigs/ yang lho mon kham bu stag lung gi phyogs su phebs skabs de dang nye ba na btsan rgod 'jigs su rung ba zhig yong 'dug pa'i sar zhabs kyis btsugs pas/ chos skyong beg tse lcam srid zhal gzigs/ beg tse zhabs la lham ma gsol ba'i 'kha gzigs ma de 'di'i skabs kyi de yin pa 'dra/ btsan rgod de chos skyong beg tshe'i 'bor yin 'dug ces gsung / lho na bzhugs pa'i dus/ ma gcig dpal lha byon nas ra sa 'phrul snang gi rang byon lnga ldan gyi rgya phigs zhig gsos kyi bskul ma mdzad cing / gsol chos bsdus pa zhig kyang gnang / lho na phebs dus cig o rgyan rin po che zhal gzigs/ skabs shig rje mi la zhal gzigs nas gsang ba'i mgur drug gi lung bshad pa dang sbrags pa gnang / gzhan yang snga phyi mang por las ldan rnams —242

paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)la mthong snang ya mtshan can mang po byung ba ni/ de mo sprul sku lha dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis theng gcig rje 'di nyid dpal 'khor lo (7ba〉sdom pa dang / /gzhan ma 'ga' zhig gis ni rgyal ba myong kha pa chen por mthong ba dang / dbu gtsug tor dang ldan par mngon pa byung skad/ gdan sa chen po ri bo dge ldan gyi gser thog bzheng ba gnang skabs/ dam can chos rgyal gyis brje'i gzugs su bstan te gser phul/ rgyal ba myong kha pa la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba yang yang zhal gzigs tre(/ /sku gsum rin chen them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dbang po'i sar gshegs te/ /dkyil 'khor spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po la/ /snod bcud dag pa'i snang ba mtshar du ci/ / mchog gsum rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sri zhu yis/ /mi zad 'byor pa'i phung po cher spungs par/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i mdzod kyis bskrun du med/ /'jam mgon mkhyen pa'i lha yi lam yangs por/ /rnam dpyod 'ja' tshon bkra ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ /rnam 'dren kun kyi yab gcig myong kha pas/ /dgyes zhal 'dzum gyis lan cig min par bsus/ /de ltar dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'di nyid kyi gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i rnam thar mtha' dag ni tshur mthong gi skye bo rnams kyis rtogs par ga la nus/ 'on kyang rnam thar chen mo na/ tshe ring du gnas na rnam dkar gyi/ /lam bzang po bsgrub po shi yang bde/ /zhes dang / khyad par lam thun mong ba'i rgyud sbyar nas bzung ste zung 'jug gi bar mngon du mdzad pa'i bar gyi 'das tshig mang du yod pa'i gsung mgur de'i mjug tu/ rje sangs rgyas las kyang ches dkon pa'i/ /lam 'di 'dra bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /ces dang / glu 'di nyid gsang chen rgyud sde'i bcud/ /yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /(8na)glu 'di 'dra gsang ba'i mgur du mdzod/ /zhes don gyis bshad ma thag pa'i lam rnams thugs rgyud la mngon du mdzad zin par zhal gyis bzhes pas gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi gtso bor mthong ngo / /—243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skade ltar phun tsho gos 'od brgya'i snang ba yis/ /srid zhi'i gdung sel rtogs brjod nyin mor byed/ /blo gros nam mkha'i ngos las shar ba'i tshe/ khres ldan 'dab brgya 'dzum pa'i cho ga bstar/ /chags bral ngur smig sgo nga'i sbubs rgya nas/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan glu dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i/ /theg kun zung du 'brel ba'i 'dab gshog can/ /rje btsun ka la ping ka 'di ko mtshar/ /'chad pa'i rnam dpyod yangs pa'i sprin rum nas/ /rtsod ngag gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog mda' can/ /rtsom pa'i legs bshad dbyar rnga dal sgrogs pas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la kun mkhyen gnyis par nges/ /rgya chen gsung rab mtha' dag sbyangs pas mkhas/ /rnam dag tshul khrims dri bsung ldan pas btsun/ /ris med 'gro la rjes su brtse bas bzang/ /dhi paṃ ka ra'i rnam thar gnyis par khums/ /mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun la mang du thos/ /de'i don phra zhib dbyad pas rnam par bsams/ /'khrul med zab dang rgya che'i lam kun bsgoms/ /na ro pa yang 'di las gzhan du ci/ /bdag gzhan brje bar nus pa'i lhag bsam can/ /ji snyed chos kun gzigs pa'i mkhyen dpyod yangs/ /bdud dpung pha mthar sprod pa'i mthu stobs can/ /rigs gsum mgon yang 'di na lhun gyis grub/ /ram 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /dngos grub legs tshogs 'byung gnas bla ma mchog /mchog gsum dam pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i tshig /tshig gi 'phreng bar rtogs brjod dbyangs 'di blangs/ /zab zab pha mtha' rtogs dka'i rnam par thar/ /yang yang phra (8ba)mo'i blo yis dpyod dka' bar/ /btsun btsun khungs ldan lo rgyus la brten nas/ /dag dag yi ge'i 'phreng bar 'di na spel/ /sdeb legs tshig sbyor shes pa'i mkhas rnams la/ /snyan ngag ngag gi 'dod 'jo legs mod kyang / /blun rmongs rmongs pa'i tshogs kyis rtogs sla phyir/ /grong gtam gtam gyi don rnams gsal bar byas/ /de ltar rgyal mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po yi/ /mi zad gsang gsum rnam thar chu gter las/ /rang blo'i ma ma'i tshi gus nyer blangs nas/ /tsha gdungs 'gro la bsil ba'i chu rgyun sbrengs/ /dge ba 'dis kyang rje btsun bla ma mchog /bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor srid mtha'i bar du ni/ /nam yang mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri —244

paṇa r+sā blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)chen por/ /nam yang g.yo ba med par brtan gyur cig /grangs ring skye bar bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /mi 'bral brtse bas rjes su rab bzung ste/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal gyi 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud/ /drug cu'i dbyangs snyan 'gro la spel gyur cig /lubor lo'i mgon po rdo rje lang ོ po don gyi slad du mas nas smos te/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan po rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i shing rta 'di ni dam pa gang la bka' drin gyi nye bar 'tsho ba'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde/ ming gzhan 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du 'bod pas/ rgyal ba zhes pa'i shing lug nag pa zla ba'i mchog gnyis pa'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos bgyis pa dza ya skyo// // maṅga le// //—245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6lor༅༅/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 95nyeng zhes bya ba bsdo/gas/༄༅/ /oṃ su sti sid+dhi/ dus gsum rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng zhes bya ba gdan gsum tshang ba'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs sen zla ba'i cod pan byang chen mthar thug gtsug tor rtse mor 'ching ba de srid brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ste byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rigs kun bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen mi yi gzugs su song ba'i gar/ /dang po'i mgon po bsod nams zhing du e waṃ zung 'jug sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /rnam kun mchog ldan 'gro la rjes brtse bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'khor los sgyur de rgyal gyur cig /gdul dka' 'dul la dpa' ba'i snying stobs kyis/ /brgya pa'i tshe dus mchog (2na)gi sprul ba'i gar/ /legs bsgyur shākya seng ge dkyil 'khor gtsor/ /rab bzhengs dgyes mdzad rdo rje he ru maḥ /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ltar gnyis med yum/ /zag med bde chen bskyed pa'i bdag med mas/ /rjes bzung rnal 'byor dbang phyug birnya pa/ /paṇa grub yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal/ /mgon de'i dbang ci gi mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /lo paṇa skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangs pa/ /rnam dpyod —246

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyanalto bar 'khyil ba'i drang srong che/ /sa skya'i bla chen rjes 'brang bcas las su/ /gang gi bstan srog rgyu skar 'phreng ba'i dbus/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi yi snang ba'i gzi/ /cher 'bar slob bshad 'dzin pa'i bdag chen rje/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mgon de'i gdams pa'i bang mdzod kha'u pa/ /kun spangs bla ma'i snyan brgyud zil dngar gyis/ /thugs kyi za ma tog gtams tshar pa rje'i/ /dri med ring lugs yid bzhin dbang gi (2ba)rgyal/ /dmar ser dhīḥyig bzhi blugs mi yi gzugs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po bsod nams skal bzang dpyid/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i bdag nyin can/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /a ho 'phags bod ris med grub mtha'i srol/ /'dzin pa'i mkhas grub yang srid mtha' klas kyang / /zhing 'dir mjam mgon bla ma sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa'i khur chen rnam dpyod phrag par lci/ /dbang lung rjes gnang rig gtad rgyud bshad zlas/ /gdul bya'i blo yi kun+da bskud pa'i mod/ /grol lam ka spu ra yi gzegs ma'i rdul/ /babs pas sgrib gnyis tsha gdung sel la sbyor/ /gcig tu rnam gsum mkhas pa'i bya ba la/ /rtag par 'grus kyang rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyis/ /gang thugs mtshan dpes yongs spras he ru gar/ /bzhedas pa'i cho ga rdzogs pa 'di ko mtshar/ /de phyir mes pos bskal par bsams byas kyang / /gting mtha' dpag par dka' na bdag 'dra bas/ /rtogs brjod smra ba 'dab chags rtse sgro yis/ /mthon po'i brag ri zad par byed pa bzhin/ /'on te rnam 'dren dus mkhyen rgyal po yis/ /bde gshegs rtomachogo bstod pa'i legs byas bzhin/ /rdo rje slob dpon bsngags pa'i skal bzang 'di/ /grangs med skye bar chos dkar zong gis bsgrubs/ /de phyir rnam par thar pa'i pi wang rgyud/ /bcad lhug tshig gi sor mos legs bskul sgra/ /dpyod ldan rna bar 'jebs pa rdo rje'i glu/ /gzhom med nā da'i dbyangs su blangs 'di nyon/ /de'ang 'jam mgon (3na)sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ /mchod bstod 'dud pa'i bdag nyid can/ tshes pa brjod sogs mi 'gal te/ /thams cad du yang ston pa yi/ /che ba 'ba' zhig ston phyir ro/ zhes —247—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yoyopa'i don ltar tshigs bcad dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gleng bar bya ba ni/mkhas pa'i gsung las/ /gang phyir dge legs thams cad ni/ /rtag tu sbyin zhing 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /thub bstan dpag bsam ljon shing gi /ngo mtshar gleng la su mi gus/ /zhes bdag can gi rnam 'dren dam pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po 'di nyid/ /byon dang byon 'gyur 'byon bzhin pa'i sras bcas rgyal ba mtha' dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ de dag gi mgur gyi bum pa nas dam pa'i chos kyi phung po zlad mi shes pa ljags kyi dbang po legs par bkram ste gdul bya rnams kyi rnabar 'jebasapa'i sgra bo che yongs kyi snying por gyur pa nang rig pa sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i 'byung gnas de rnams klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan gyi sgo nas tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i theg gsum skyes 'phags 'dus pa'i dbang phyug /ris su ma chad pa'i grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu son pas mkhas pa/ nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum sogs nyes lhung gi cha phra mo tsam gyis kyang ma gos par las 'bras la zhib mor dpyod pas btsun pa/ bdag pas ga' na gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs la 'brungs pas gzhan don lhur mdzad pa'i bzang po/ /(3ba)ma nub dbang gi chu bos thugs rgyud smin pas grol byed bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni zab lam la brten nas grub pa'i mtha' snyog par nus ldan rig sngags 'chang ba sogs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan gyi phung po tshangs pa/ dbang phyug /khyab 'jug ste 'jig rten gyi gtso bo gsum dang nyan rang byang sems so skye'i tshogs kyis gzhal bar dka' ba 'phags pa rnams kyi ye shes kho na'i spyod yul nyag gcig pa bdag 'dra'i blo gros kyi cha phra bas lta ga la zhig /sku tshe'i 'phreng ba du mar thub bstan rin blo che gsal bar byed pa'i mkhas grub kyi skyes rabs mu thi la'i 'phreng mdzes dang / sku tshe 'dir yang lha dang bla ma mang po zhal gzigs shing lung bstan thob pa/ rdo rje chos skyong bran du 'khol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa/ sal ma gyi yon tan phul du byung ba ni/ zhu lan nor bu'i 'phreng bar/ bdag gi yon tan —248

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / snyenasba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag par bya/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin yon tan mtha' dag rgya mtsho'i gting gi rdo ba ltar mi mngon pa gtso bor 'don pas bsnyel tho dang zhal slob kyi rigs la gsung 'phros kyi zur tsam yang cher ma gsungs shing / kho bos gsung ngag rin po che zhus skabs mdang rmi lam du po ta la'i li ma lha khang yin rgyu ba la ze'u lha khang 'dra rung ba'i glo skar nas bltas pas rje btsun sa skya pa chen po bzhugs 'dug pa zhig byung ba gsung ngag rin po che 'di'i 'chad nyan la dgyes pa 'dra gsung ba zhib tu zhus kyang de tsam las mi dran zhes thugs dkyel che bas gsal bar mi mdzad na'ang don du mnal ltas ma yin pas gzigs (4na〉snang ngo mtshar ba zhig byung tshod du mchis/snga phyir mjal ba tsho'i skabs nan tan du zhus na thor bu tsam mi gsung ba'i nges pa mi 'dug kyang rang nyid rtag par 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba dam pos bcings pa'i dbang gis rje bla ma'ang sku tshe mthar phyin par bzhugs pa gzhir bcas kyi slar rim gyis zhu 'dun la lus song zhing zur thams cad mkhyer pa dang / rje 'di nyid zhal 'dris ye med pa'i skabs mnal lam la gzims khang shar yin khul du khri mtho bar sa lugs kyi bla ma yin zer ba sku bong che zhing gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa zhig la dbang chos mang po gsan pa'i mnal ltas byung ba nas lo gcig tsam gyi thog yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sder zab chos gsan par glo bur du phebs par shar ba'i sgo dod cing zhing skyong dbang po'i chos skor rnams gsan nas gung thang du phebs pa'i 'od gsal zhig la ras ljang gu'i ang rag tsam las gos gzhan med ba skra dang smra ra dkar po byas pa lag tu mi rkang gi gling bu thogs pa zhig na re mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan 'di slob dpon dharma pā la/ gzims khang shar gyi bla ma zhig dang tshar pa chosarje sogs kyi skye ba yin/ khyod kyisang la gtor ma re'ang ma chag pa gyis/ nga'i chos skor rnams su rung rung la ma ston zer ba zhig byung snang ba bdag yid bzhag chungs pas kha che rin cen rdo rje dang dharma pā la gnyis som nyir gyur rung slar dpyad tshe phyi ma nyid du nges shing bka' las/ rjes ser gzims khang shar du yun ring bor stan chags pa dang mdzad pa'i tshul rnams la rjes su dpags tshe tshar (4ba thin —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yochos kyi rgyal po thub bstan spyi dang bye brag rang bstan kha'u brag rdzong pa'i ring lugs 'dzin par sprul pa'i zlos gar bstan pa 'dra phebs pa rdo rje'i gsung bla na med par go /gzhan du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i rngo ma thogs na'ang snyigs dus kyi gdul bya smin pa gsum shas chung / sgrib pa gsum gyi bag chags ches cher bde ba'i gang zag rnams kyi blo dang 'tsham pa rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu las cher long tsam drung du 'khod pa'i rgyus yod 'dras zin bris su btab cing / rigs kun khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen kun spangs pa chen po'i spyan ras kyis bca' bar mdzad de lam tsam zhus dag pa'i steng nas cung zad 'bri ba ni/ rin po che sdud pa las/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing / /me rtag gos ldan sman dang nags tshal skyed byed pa/ /ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu bdag brten gnas te/ /de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thosapa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / /'chad dang rig pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ /zhes 'dzam bu'i gling gi chu klung sman dang nags tshal sogs klu'i rgyal po'i mthu las byung ba bzhin thub pa'i rjes 'jug gi tshogs thos bsam sgom pa'i mthu la brten nas 'bras bu thob pa rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje las byung bar gsungs pa spyir sangs rgyas 'jig rten du mi 'byon pa'i tshe mun bskal dang byung ba'i (ldan)dus sgron bskal du bshad pas bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byung bar gsungs pa'i 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya seng ge'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du dar rgyas su gyur pa nas yun ring zhig nas bod du dam pa'i chos 'byung bar lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes swā la'i nags kyi sman ljongs ri kha ba can gyi khrod du rgyal ba'i bstan pa byung ba'ang spyir 'gro ba mi'i byung tshul lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel du/ skya seng bu lnga dang dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis 'thabs pa'i dus su rgyal po ྅ pa ti zhes pa dmag stong phrag —250

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)gcig dang bcas pa bud med kyi chas su zhugs te/ ri gangs can gyi gseb tu bros pa las 'phel tshul byung zhing rgyal po bka' 'bum sogs thugs rje chen po'i chos skor rnams su spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las 'phel bar bshad pa gdong dmar sha zan gyi phru gu shin tu gdul par dka' bar chos la blo mi 'jug pa rnams bka' gdams glegs bam rin po cher/ bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar 'dzin/ mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar stongs / /zhes thog mar 'bangs mtha' dag rgyal po'i chen po zhig gi mnga' 'og tu bsdus te rim gyis sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las 'byung bar mkhyen nas bod spyi'i rgyal pos la snga ba rje gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rabs rim par byung la (5bskom pa 'di'i rigs ni/ bod rgyal po'i dbon du gyur pa'i 'a zha zhes bya zhing de'ang zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'i shes bya spyi'i khog dbug gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyi sgo 'phar yangs por bon gyi gtam rgyud drangs par/ gri gum btsan po'i dus dmag drangs nas kha che'i yul bcoms pa'i tshe yul bye brag pa puṇ+ḍa su ra brag nyung ma ltar gshog par byed pa'i rdzu 'phrul can gyi mu stegs bye brag pa zhig la 'a zha zer zhes gang zag cig la ngos bzung zhing mi shi ba dang phyugs bsad pa rang gi mi phyugs su skye/ phung po dang mnyam du sbas pa skye ba phyi ma dbang bar lung ston/sha khrag gis mi ma yin brngan nas smreng gis dkrol bas phan par byed pa la bon nam ling tser grags la/ /des ma rungs te rgyal po'ang long ngam rta rdzi zhes pas bkums smra ba gri gum gyi dus bod du 'a zha byung bar 'dod pa 'dra snang ba dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag gis mkhas pa dga' byed du/ gu r+ṇa kha tra zhes bya'i yul khams nas/ /mu stegs bon po 'a zha zhes pa byung / /zhes ngos bzung ba'i rdzu 'phrul can des rgyal po'i mtshan gri gum zhes btags par brten nas rgyal po grir bkums par bshad/de nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa dmus long dkon pa bkras byung bar yab 'gro gnyen lde'u sa 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa bos nas mig phye gsung ba bzhin phye bas spyan byung ste ltag ri gnyan gzigs su grags pa ltar na 'a zha zhes pa yul gye ming du bshad/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya —251—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shematsho'i rnam thar zhal gsungs mar/ khri srong (6na snga'u btsan gyi skabs/ rje srog po khyung bzhi lha jo bo lcam dang lnga/ 'bangs ra klog can dang drug /se 'a zha gnyis dang bcas pa rnams/ chad pa mdo khams snang nas chad/ chags pa g.yas ru shangs su chags shes pa rnams gungs bsgrigs na gang zag rang mtshan pa zhig la bkar nas rgya gar phyogs na yod tshul khungs dag par mi sems te bon dang mu stegs mi gcig pas lo rgyus de 'dra dwags brgyud pas bon gyi rjes su 'grangs pa'i sgrung gi bye brag tu snang /spyir 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rigs phyi bar nang gsum las/ rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs te phyi rigs bzhi/ rgya gar lha/ rgya nag klu/ hor lha ma yin/ bod spre'u dang brag srin ma ste bar gyi rigs bzhi/ bka' chems bka' khol mar/ sprel phrug spun bzhi brgya po de tshan pa bzhin 'thabs pa dang mes pos bar mtshams byas te zhing la cha bzhin bgos/ gcig la gcig 'jigasanas tshan bzhir chad pas se dang / rmu dang / ldong dang / stong ste nang mi'u rigs bzhi rnams bcu gnyis po rigs kyi phyi mor grags/ mi'u gdung drug tu dbye na bod mi khri tho chen po bya ba de la dgra 'bru sdong lha dang nu bo dpa' rda ste bu drug ces bshad/ spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa'i yig tshang du/ dga' sdong 'bru gsum dgra dang bzhi/ nu bo dpa' mda' gnyis te drug tu gsungs/ tshal pa thams cad mkhyen pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros kyi hu lan deb ther du spre'u dang brag srin mo las mched pa (6ba)ma sangs spun dgu/ rgyan phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bcu gnyis/ sil ma bzhi bsas rim gyis dbang byas par bshad pa kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi rnam thar du mi'u gdung drug gi nang tshan du gsungs pa gong du dngos ming ngos ma 'phrod kyang zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa bzhi pas mdzad pa'i khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du/ phyi'i rus chen sdong la nang tshan bco brgyad du gyes pa'i rog yin te/ /zhes nang gses kyi khyad par du ngos 'dzin pa rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i gsung 'di bzhin ltar rus so sor dbye gzhi gcig la dbye ba'i ya rgyal mang du byung ba'i rus chen drug gi dang po'i nang gses su —252

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)gtogs pa gor ma chag /rgyal phran sil ma'i khrod kyi rgyal por gyur pa rje gnya' khri btsan pos bod spyi la dbang sgyur ba nasamanga' 'og tu gyur cing rje dang gnyen bsres pas dbon du song / lha btsan pos bstan pa rin po che'i ched du chos kyi bca' khrims mdzad pa'i tshe na rjer gtogs pas rdo ring gi yi ger yang dbon 'a zha zhes rgyal rigs khungs btsun dri ma med pa de las rim par brgyud de glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs rjes so thar gyi bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslang ba'i tshe 'a zha mgo bo che'i sras 'a zha ye shes g.yung drung gis khams su sdom pa len par 'byon pa'i zhor du ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du mjal du byon pa'i dus steng khang la 'gro ba'i skas kyi mar zur gdong la dpal ye shes mgon po'i sku gzugs ri mor bris pa yar 'dzeg skabs yod pa la mar lam bris sku de dpal mgon po dngos su gyur cing thod pa'i (7na skong na dgra bo'i snying khrag blug pa mi rtsib kyis thur ma byas te gsol ba mngon sum du bstan nas rjes su bzung bar gsol ba btab pas/ khyod kyi mi brgyud dang chos brgyud bcas pa'i srung ma ngas bya/ khyod khams na zla ba gcig la 'khor bar gyis zhes gsung gi gnang ba thob pas 'a zha mthu che bar grags shing mgon po 'di nyid rtsis mgon yin par sems/ khams su byon nas bla chen gyi mkhan bu tre bo mchog bla la sdom pa der bas ma'i rgyun blangs nas sna nam 'dres brda/ 'o yug /gnas po che so gos dge 'dun gyi sdebatsugs pa de dag las gyes te mang du 'phel/ kun mkhyen bu'i chos 'byung du sdom pa chab gtor ma'i rgyun blangs zhes snang /de nas 'a zha lha'i blo gros kyis lha ldan gtsug lag khang la zhig gsos dang rdo kong ba po shis 'od 'bar phul/ a mes jo sras phur pa 'phel gyis rngog lo rgya gar du 'byon pa'i cha rkyen la gser srang bcu bdun phul/ gegs med par phyir byon nas lo tsā ba'i chos 'khor gyi thog ma yang 'dol chung du bskor/ dpal skyon chen pos byin gyis rlabs shing ma hā kā la dngos su bzhugs pa'i gnas dang zung 'brel du jo bo blo gros kyis gnas gzhi btab pas rtsis gnas gsar bar grags/ dpal —253—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yoldan sa skya pa'i mnga' thang sgang la rgyag pa'i dus chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che dang ti shri kun blo sogs kyi zhabs la/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' bzang po/ shākya seng ge can 'gyas gtugasapar nyang gzhung mtha' dag shes su bcug (7ba)pa'i 'ja' sa la gser gyi tham ga shel gyi nyin shan/ dngul gyi sgor mo lung dang bcas las ka gnang bas gnas gsar stong dpon du grags/rgyal po/ sngags 'amang / ge sang gyi yon to tshang ba'i mi bdag rig byone las stong dpon kun dga' rdo rje'i sras nang so chos kyi rgyal po'i khab tu snyan brgyud kyi mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i lcam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sprul pa dpal ldan 'dzom pa byon par lcam srid brgyad byung ba'i bgres pa nang so rnam rgyal dpal bzang slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul sku zhang 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yab sras gsum bsten nas 'khon gyi yab chos rdo rje phur pas gtsos gsar rnying gi zab chos mang bo zhus shing bsnyen sgrub bzlas sgom mthar phyin/ slob dpon chen po'i bsnyen phur me 'bar bzhin pa rtsis kyi mchod rten nag po nas bzhes/dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lngar phebs na'ang skyes dar ma'i yang rtsal dang lang tsho ltar gyur pa'i grub mtshan ngo mtshar ba ston/ rin cen sgang pa sgos dang yon mchod du gyur pa'i zhal ngo phyi ma rnams kyis rang bstan gyi srog 'thud pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig /de 'og phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa nang so mgon po rin cen gyis mgon po zhal gzigs shing thal deb kyis log 'dren sgrol ba/ ri dwags sogs la bya glag gis 'tshe ba'i tshe sngags rgya ting 'dzin tsam gyis sar lhung ba/ mi chos la'ang sgyu rtsal 'gran zla dang bral bar grags/de 'og 'jam dbyangs kun dga' blo gros zhes gzhung lugs rgya mtshor sbyangs pa che zhing dngos stobs (8na)rigs pas rgol ba thams cad zhus par nus pa'i gnas gsar chos mdzad ces snyan pa'i sgra bo che kun tu bsgrags/ sgrol dkar gyi sprul par rgyal dbang pad+ma'i lung gis zin pa'i lcam bgres pa khrom ge sar rgyal po'i mag pa'i brgyud pa shar kha rgyal rtse ba'i khab tu byon nas snga 'gyur gyi —254

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / tanargyud 'bum bzheng ba dang bka' gter bstan pa'i sbyin bdag zla med du mdzad/de 'og mar pa'i yum bdag med pa'i sprul par grags pa ra lung du zhabs drung 'brug pa dbon rin po che'i jo mor phebs/ rje btsun ma gsum gyi gcig gis bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen por gsung ngag rin po che gsan nas sgrub pa snying por mdzad pas 'da' kha ma'i nyams len gyis grub mtha' snyogs/ rnal 'byor ma kun dga' chos ldan dang ni gu chos sgron ma gnyis kyis ka thog pa bzhag bla ye shes 'bum dang sprul pa'i gter ston pad+ma gling pa gnyis la btugs nas zab lam rdzogs pa chen po'i chos nyid zad pa'i sar 'byol/nang so sku mched gnyis kyi jo mor sa skya'i nang chen lha khang chen mo ba'i sras mo dpal 'dzom bsus pa'i sras nam mkha' rdo rje tshe brtan dpal 'byor bzang po ni yig rtsis/ brtag pa rnam pa brgyad la sogs pa lugs kyi bstan bcos la mkhas pa/ sgam zhid brtan la blo gros kyi mthu phul du byung ba/ bdag chen chos rje yab sras gsum/ lce ston seng ge sogs mkhas grub kyi dam pa mang du bsten/ rang gi a ne 'khrul zhig kun dga' chos ldan la rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid gsan (8ba)pas nyams gong 'phel gyi rtogs pa klong du gyur/ thos grol dang gcod yul sogs la brten nas sgyu lus rmi lam la rang dbang thob pas lcang lo can gyis mtshon dag pa'i zhing phul/ gam pa rdzong du phyag rdor gyi bsnyen pa'i tshe thun 'tshams su mar me shi zhing thun dngos la rang 'bar du 'gro ba/ byang chub kyi sems bcos min du 'khrungs shing klu 'bum gnyan khri'i gdan gsal por gzigs pa/ mnal lam du khyod khyung 'di la zhon nas ri rab la skor ba lan gsum byas te lcang lo can du gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan rnyed/ gnod byed kyi klu gdug pa can btul ba sogs gsang bdag gis rjes su bzung bar brten/ rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ 'di nas 'pho tshe byang phyogs lcang lo can/ /zhing der pha rgan drung du thog mar 'gro/ /de nas skyon zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser/ /skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsung ba'i dgongs gzhi yang de yin la/—255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneseng ge rtse ba'i blon po mdzad pa sogs srid kyi rnam g.yeng dus 'khrug che skabs kyang mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ye ma bzhag /snyun dam pos btab pa'i dus khu bo gnas gsar chos mdzad kyi sgrol ma'i rjes gnang mdzad pa'i tshe sgrol ma ri bo tsam pa'i sku gzigs pas snyun las myur du grol bo dong du jo nang mkhan chen/ rje btsun sgo wo pa r+ṣa po kun dga' legs pa rigs kyi bdag por bsten nas bdag lus longs spyod thams cad mchod sprin du phul/ rje zhing gzhan du gshegs khar rigs brgyud dkar nag gi 'brel pa bzhag (9na)pas mtha' brten pa kun rjes su 'dzin pa'i zhal bzhes zhus/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje dang ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge la zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gsan/sras gnyis la srid kyi bya ba ma lus pa gtad de bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor bsnyen sgrub bskang ba mdos gtore sogs thugs dam gyis wo mas dus 'da'/ de dag gi tshe rdo rje chos skyong zhal gzigs pa/ bsreg mkhan med par sha chen dri ngad 'thul ba/ dgun sman rag khol ba/ liṅga 'gul ba/ zor gtor 'phar ba/ mdos gtor gyi gseb nas btso rgyug pa/ gam pa rdzong du thog sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la blangs te gzhan du 'phangs pa dang / bo dong rdzong du babs kyang ma gnod cing sdigs mdzub dang shā sa nā'i nus pas hor dmag bros pa/ rong chung du rbab dang tsag sa dkar grur chu rlabs kyi 'jigs pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i phaṭa sgras bzlog pa/ mnal lam la ti pu pas sku tshe'i tshad lung bstan pa sogs ngo mtshar rnams ches dpag par dka' na'ang zhang ston chos 'bar/ rje mar pa/ mkhas pa g.yu thog pa so gos la'ang las ma dag pa'i skye bo phal cher khyim pa rang bzhin pa'i mthong las med 'dug pa ltar 'di skabs kyang sde dpon dkyus ma'i rtsing thol zhig gi nyams las med par snang / de'ang mnal lam du ri rab la lan gsum bskor zhes pa skye ba gsum brgyud dgos rgyur lam zab mo'i nyams len la brten nas dgung lo re brgyad pa khrums zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin gshegs khar tshar chen la (9ba)re ltos zhus pas skyabs 'jug shin tu rgyas pa dang khyad par rdo ring rin po cher —256

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)gsol 'debs shugs drag gnang bas mnal lam du rdo ring pa chen pos khong pa las kyi rnam smin gyi 'phro zhig gis rgya nag gi mtha' 'khob tu ru dra mo'i mngal du zla ba drug gnas dgos pa chos skyong gis ma de bsgral nas lcang lo can du skye na'ang chos rje pas 'bad rtsol mdzad na zla ba gcig tsam gyis chog nyen 'dug cing gang ltar do nub mjal du 'ong ba yod gsung ba ltar sngon dus kyi cha lugs ji lta ba dzo ge'i 'khor la brten nas byung ba bdag tshe 'phos kyang bla ma dang chos skyong gi mthus rgyal kha byung /phyag rdor gyi dbang gnang bar gsol bas sang nas bzung phyag rdor gyi dkyil 'khor du lho sgo'i cho ga lan gsum mdzad pas nub cig 'od gsal du 'brug sgra dir rir sgrog par gzigs pa na nang 'od kyi rnam pa'i nor bu mig gsum pas gang ba gsal bas sde pa de lcang lo can du 'brug gi zhen pa can gyi gnod sbyin bde ldan 'od zer du skyes nas drin lan 'jal du 'ongs par mkhyen cing gnod sbyin de phyag na rdo rjes rjes su bzung bar brten thugs bde bar gyur/ 'di pa'i yum snga mo nas grongs pas chun mar gtsang tshong 'dus mgur mo'i khri dpon gyi lcam sring byangs sems bu khrid blangs pa'i sras nam mkha' rgyal ba lce ston paṇa chen las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nos/ gong gi yongs 'dzin phal cher dang / sprul sku shākya bzang po/ gnubs chen rin cen dpal bzang / lha btsun legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje sogs dam pa mang du bsten/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal (10na)po la thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi cho me skor gsan pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bde mchog /gshed dmar/ phur pa/ sgrol dkar sogs yi dam gyi lha rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub dang mkha' 'gro lnga'i mchod gtor gyis mtshon thugs dam shin tu smin/ sku tshe'i smad la tshar chen gyi drung du rab tu byung zhing dgung lo don gnyis pa'i tshe tshar chen rdo rje 'chang spyan drangs pa sngas mgor bla ma 'di lta bu phebs nas 'chi ba skal ba bzang tshul sogs dgyes dgyes dang bar dor yang hūṃ sgra dir rir 'gro gsung / gshegs nas dbu thod sor bzhi tsam 'phags shing me tog gi char gyis mtshon ltas ya mtshan gshis rtog ge pa rgan po 'ga'i nga rgyal chag pa sogs la dpags na gcen du ma zad 'di nyid la'ang ding sang gi chos pa bzang por rtsi ba
