rnams kyis —257—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo te/bsgrun dka' bar mchis/mched gnyis kyi jo mor se ston dpal chen 'bum dang mthu chen nyi ma bzang po sogs yang phur gshin rjes gtsos lha'i snang ba thob cing chos skyong bran du 'khol ba'i rigs brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa'i dbon por gyur pa 'dar chos rdzong pa don yod rnam rgyal gyi sras mo tshe brtan bu 'dren zhes bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje sgo rum pas mtshon dam pa du ma'i zhabs pad bsten cing tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang zhakhrul zhig kun dga' chos ldan la gdams pa'i nying khu nos nas mgon po'i yig bdun ma sa ya gsum dang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chag med mdzad pas mnal lam du rje btsun zhal gnyis ma gser gyi mdog ldan gzigs shing phag skad ngur sgras khengs pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes pa bud med phal (10ba)pa'i ngang tshul las 'das pa de bsus pa la mched kha yar 'khrungs pa'i dang po zhabs drung bstan pa'i drung ngam bsod nams rab brtan du grags pa/ de 'og chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de 'og thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /chung ba nor bu bzang po rnams las gcen dang gcung rnams ni sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhis gtsos lugs dang 'brel ba'i yon tan gyi mthu phul du byung zhing rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po dang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje sogs sngags gsar rnying gi mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul nye bar bsten nas zab chos mang du gsan cing de'ang tshig tsam du ma lus par bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor bsnyen cing sgrub pa rdo rje chos skyong rnams phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam skong ba'i mdzad pa sogs sde dpon phal pa'i spyod tshul dang ye mi 'dra ba'i gong ma'i zhabs rjes zin pa thub pa'i ring lugs 'dzin no cog la dag pa'i snang ba dang ldan na'ang rang bstan kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bla ma dang chos las bstan dang ston pa gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i dam bca' brtan po spang la be phur btab pa'am rdo la ri mo bris pa lta bu'i dam pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa sha stag yin no/ /e ma gangs can dpal mo'i mngal yangs por/ /bsod nams 'bras bu'i khur sa rgyas rab lci —258

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)ba/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar mkhan mi yi bdag /chad med mtho ris chu bo'i spun zla bzhin/ /de dbon 'od gsal lha babs 'a zha'i gdung / /che gnyan btsun gsum 'dzom pa rgyal po'i brgyud/ /mthu stobs nus par ldan pa rig sngags 'chang / /dpa' rtsal (11na〉na dong ngar che ba ge sar rigs/ /rlung gis mthon por bteg pa'i 'dab chags sgro/ /'gro mangs ral pa'i rtse mor stes dbang las/ /g.yengs min khungs 'brel lus phra'i 'gram chang gis/ /dpyod ldan blo yi ba ku la de ba 'ad/ /rdul mang phang par nyal ba'i khri stan steng / /chen por bkur bar mi bsnyengs byang tshan la/ /gzhes pas in+d+ra bhū ti rna rgyan gyis/ /ljongs 'dir gzugs can gnyis pa bzung ba bzhin/ /de'ang tshigs gsum pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi yongs grags kyi rnam par thar pa dgung lo sum cu so brgyad yan gyi rtogs brjod rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar snye mar gsungs pa smos ma dgos/ de nas kyang lo phyed drug tsam gyi bar zhing 'dir bzhugs pas 'phro 'thud thub na legs par snang yang zin bris sogs nges tig ma 'byor la/ sku tshe sngon ma snams su gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul snyed las 'das pa'i zhing khams rgya mtshor mchog dman bar pa'i tshul sna tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i mtha' la rtogs/ 'on te skye ba rim brgyud dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i sprul pa sogs kyis bstan 'gro'i sman yon du gyur pa'i rim pa ni/ rje nyid kyi zhal gsungs mar/ na mo gu ru khyoḥrgyal ba sku dngos phyon chos kyi rje/ /rdo rje 'amang dbang kun dga' legs pa'i zhabs/ /sku drin mnyam med blo gsal rgya mtsho sogs/ /skyabs mchod bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyon drung na lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung / /(11brkog dang ma dag skye ba 'ga' yi mthar/ /chos dbang gsung sprul pad+ma dbang chen zhes/ /mkhas grub dam par gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor 'od gsal rang grol dang / /bka' brgyad bka' babs rdor 'chang bsod nams bzang / /'jam dbyangs sgeg pa bsod nams grub la sogs/ /dag pa'i skye bar gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan zab gter bstan pa'i bdag /'brel tshad don —259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneldan rgyal po'i bla mchod de/ /chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa zhes/ khams gsum grags pas khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs mthar phyin a seng rgyal mo dang / /'phags yul bram ze bh+ra ma nā tha nyid/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal po'i rigs su skyes/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /de yi sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /'phrin las sprul pa shes rab snying rje can/ /rab byung rgyal chen rnal 'byor tshul can zhes/ / pad+mas lung bstan khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal sras gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis/ /yang srid gnyis su pha bu'i 'brel pa bzhag /da dung 'bral med rjes su 'dzin no zhes/ /byin rlabs lung bstan thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgyes pa rdo rje 'khor lo sdom pa dang / /rdo rje phag mo sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha/ /'jam dpal khros pa 'joms byed 'bar ba yis/ /byin rlabs mtshan ma thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha chen dpal 'bar lcam bral pho lhar bcas/ /gur gyi mgon po gnyan mgon rnam sras sogs/ /dam can (12na)rgya mtsho phal cher bran du 'khol/ /'phrin las thogs med sgrub la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di nas 'pho tshe byang phyogs lcang lo can/ /zhing der pha rgan drung du thog mar 'gro/ /de nas skyon zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser/ /skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar khyed la gus pas gsol ba 'debs na/ /dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du/ /nam yang 'bral med mnyes pa kun bsgrubs nas/ /cham gcig gdod ma'i klong du grol bar shog /ces pa 'di snying nas dad ldan gnyos dka' bcu pa chos rgyan gyis bskul ba'i ngo ma chogs par nged rang gi khong khrag shog bu'i logs la bkod pa yin pas/ thams cad la bstan na nged kyi tshe la gnod pas shin tu gsang zhing sbas pa'i tshul du mdzad pa gal che che/ dam tshig la dgongs mdzod cing / dge slong chos rgyan la bstan kyang bzod/ tsha bo btsun chung rnams snod ldan yin kyang / na sogazhon pas gzhan la shor nyen yod pas theng gcig la ma ston mdzod/ sam ya/ zhes pa dang shes rab rgya mtsho/ bu d+dha/ sangs rgyas lhun grub/ sbyin pa dpal bzang / rkam dan cog legs pa lngas zhus der —260

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)gnang ba'i kun khyab chos dbyings ma gnyis 'dug pa rgyas bsdus tsam du mthong bas gcig tu byas na sprul gzhi rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam dbyangs/ 'o skol gyi ston pa'i drung du shes rab can gyi mchog shā ri'i bu/ lha sras khri srong lde'u btsan/ rdzu phrul gyis thog chen mda' ltar 'phen pa'i lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas/ mnga' bdag nyang gi (12ba)sras zab gter chos kyi bang mdzod 'gro mgon nam mkha' dpal ldan zhes bla ma'i bka' babs shing thugs rje chen po dngos su 'grub pa/ gter kha 'og ma gu ru rin bo che chos kyi dbang phyug gi gdung las bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi bka' babs pa rgyal srasapad+ma dbang chen/ bdud 'joms skye ba rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phrus rjes su bzung zhing sangs rgyas gnyis pa skyon chen po zhal gzigs nas gdams pa thob pa'i zur tsho rdor 'chang bsod nams bzang po zhes bka' brgyad kyi bka' babs pa/ 'di nyid kyi sku skye yin tshul gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen pos yang yang gsungs pas rdor 'chang pa yan khong rang gi rnam thar du gsungs pa la the mi tshom par ma zad mnga' bdag yin pa'i khungs/ rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi chos bdag lung bstan skabs su/ chos rgyal khyod sprul me tog ming 'dzin pa: dngos las lhag pa'i skyes bu snying stobs can: bka' gter chos bdag bong ring lug sprel lo: rin cen phyag rten dgongs kyi dus su 'byung : zhes shin tu gsal/chos kyi rgyal po klong chen pa'i thugs sras 'od chen go cha zhes snying tig gi bka' babs pas 'od gsal longs sku'i zhing khams myul zhing tshe dpag med kyis mngon sum du zhal gzigs pa/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi thugs sprul kun mkhyen dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis sbyor ba yan lag drug gi zab mos grol bar mdzad pa 'jam dbyangs sgeg pa nam mkha' dpal/ zab don gdamasapas yongs (13na)grol bsod nams grub pa/ sras pad+ma dbang chen gyi yang srid gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa'am gter gnas dang lung bstan gyi dbang gis 'gro 'dul gling pa dang zhig po gling pa ste gter ston gcig la gling pa gsum du grags shing gter kha nyer brgyad zhal phye nas snga 'gyur —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skabastan pa'i srog 'thud par mdzad pa po/ chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par sprul pa gha ta nā thas byin gyis brlabs nas drag sngags nus pa mchog tu brnyes shing e ṇ+ḍi ya na'i gnas su rdo rje phag mos dngos su rjes su bzung ba bh+ra ma nā tha/ rje btsun brtse pa chen po'i rnam 'phrul 'jam dbyangs dkon cog bzang po'i zab don chos kyi nying khus 'od gsal pha mthar phyin pas thogs bcas kyi bdud las rgyal ba a seng rgyal mo/ rat+na gling pa dang bsod nams grub pa ma gtogs pa'i bzhi po dam pa 'ga'i lung bstan dang bstun/ btsun ma 'di byis pa'i dus wal gyis dran zhes gsol 'debs kun khyab chos dbyings ma'i mjug na gsungs/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba ni/ las 'gro gling pa'i lung bstan du/ lang 'gro'i sprul pa bka' gter bdag po ni mkhyen brtse'i ming can rig gnas lngar mkhas pa: gtsang phyogs 'di nas 'khor gyi thog mar 'byung : de la gdams pa gtad na bstan pa 'phel: zhes gsal bar lung gis zin cing rat+na gling pa ni lang 'gro'i skye bar yongs su grags/ bsod nams grub pa ni/ gong du gsol 'debs bris par gsal/'jam sgeg ni 'dar du zhal gtor chen gyi phyag len zhu ba gnang skabs tshar chen gyi mnal lam du rdo rje ring pa (13bskong rdo rje gdan pa gnyis zhal sprod du bzhugs sar byon pa na rdo ring rin po ches chos rje pa kha sang nas gar byon gsungs pa jo nang 'jam sgeg ces par chos shod kyi bsdad zhus pa'i tshe rdo rje gdan pas rdzun ma gsung gnas gsar chos rje yin gnang ba'i lan rdo rje ring pas gnyis ka med khong yar klungs pa'i dus su 'jam sgeg da lta gnas gsar chos rje yin/ zhes dang /gsung mgur du/ skyon thugs rje'i smon lam mthu btsan pas/ /rdo rje 'chang chen tshar pa chos kyi rjes/ /mi nas mir gyur skye ba lnga yi bar/ /rjes bzung byang chub mchog gi sa bon bzhag /ces byung ba ltar tshar chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs par 'khrungs pa'i tshe snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa gnang ri gsol btab pas brag rdzong ma'i 'khrid yig tu/ skye ba gsum gyi gong nas gsol btab cing / /tshe 'dir longs spyod sgrub pas mnyes par byas/ /dad dang snying rje shes rab mi dman la/ /kun spangs chos rje'i —262

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)bstan la lhag par dad/ /ston dang bstan pa gzhan nas mi 'tshol bar/ /ci mdzad khyed shes mos gus lde mig gis/ /gsang chen thugs kyi bang mdzod sgo phye nas/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu kho bos rnyed/ /ces pa'ang 'jam sgeg /bh+ra ma nā tha/ a seng rgyal mo gsum rim par byung ba la dgongs la/ kun khyab chos dbyings ma las/ bcu gsum skye bar mkhas dang grub pa dang / /zhu byed sgyur byed rig sngags 'chang ba'i tshul/ /du mar sprul nas sems can skyong mdzad pa/ /zhes pa'i bcu gsum po ngos 'dzin tshul kha tshon gcod dka' na'ang (14na〉smu di bzhin yin nam snyam/zhal gzigs sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa rnams ni tshig gcig tsam yang rlung phyogs su ma grags par bsnyel tho phyag bris ma zhig snang ba'i kha yig tu/ sprang btsun 'khyams po'i gsang ba'i gtam 'di dag /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du kha tham rgya/ /snying nas dad ldan re re tsam la bstan/ /des kyang snying gi dkyil du a tham rgya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal ba dang / /man ngag rgyud sde'i snying po zab chos pas/ /snying rus med kyang bla ma'i sku drin gyis/ /rang la ngo mtshar yid ches byung tshul yin/ /zhes kha byang btab nas tshes dang bcas rgya 'byar du zha lu shel tham gyi sgam mkhan po ma bzhugs par kha 'byed srol med 'dug pa der bcug pa de'i ngang la bo dong du gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pas rjes su mkhan po rtsis sprod kyis dus tham sgam nas byung bar lung med kyang rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis 'go mjug gi thugs rtsom 'ga' zhig mdzad par lung rgyun kyang 'dug la/rnam thar 'di dpe rgyun dkon gshis rgyun mi nub par bya ba'i slad du gsung dri ma med pa yi ger bkod pa ni/ na maḥ badz+ra khyu ra dz+nyā na da ye shwa ra pā dwa ya/ /'phags yul e nyi ya nar pad+ma'i mtshan/ /byang phyogs bho ṭa'i gnyen gyur khri srong zhabs/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chos kyi rje/ /dbyer med mkhyen brtse'i zhabs pad gtsug na rgyal/ /de la 'dir lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa thar pa'i gling du 'dren pa'i sa mkhan/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus pa'i spyi gzugs/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i yab (14ba〉gcig /—263—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yodakyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag /rig pa 'dzin pa dang mkhas dang grub pa yongs kyi ded dpon/rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi ral pa'i khri la zhabs kyi pad+ma ngal gso ba/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal ldan skal pa bzang po'i zhal snga nas de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang mod/ 'on kyang mdo tsam zhig brjod na/rje de nyid kyi mdzad pa'i tshul che long tsam ni rnam thar chen mor rtogs par bya zhing / de bas kyang ches snying por gyur pa'i gsang ba'i rtogs brjod/ gdul bya snod ldan pa dad pa dang dam tshig la gnas pa lhag bsam la nyes pa'i dri ma dang bral ba rnams kyi spyod yul/ log lta dang nga rgyal 'dzin pa kun gyi rna ba'i lam tsam du yang mi bsgrag pa'i gsang chen dpa' bo ḍā zhi'i tshogs kyi zab pa bas ches gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa gsang chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes pa de la/ rje de nyid kyis/ sa khyi zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu'i nub rmi lam du/ nga'i mal sa'i 'khris na mgar mo gzhen nu ma zhig gcer bu skra bshig nas 'dod pa bsten pa'i grabs su 'dug pa nga snying nas ngo tsha zhing 'di 'dra byed du mi nyan snyam nas de la 'ur/ nga rang 'gros pa'i grabs byas pas de tsug ma byed 'di la skyon med/ khyod kyis yun ring po nas nga bos pa yin mod zer bas/ ngas ni khyod 'bod pa lta ci da lam las mthong yang ma myong /sdom pa nyams nas dmyal bar skye ba las skyon che ba gar yod byas/ nga thong byas sprugs pas/ khyod la mi dgos na nga (15na 'dod chags thams cad dang bral ba zhig yin zer nas nam mkhar 'phags song ba dang / rje btsun rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma phag zhal gyi smin mtshams dang / bha ga'i nang na dga' 'khyil 'khor ba zhig tu gyur song bas de'i zhabs la 'a sdus gsol ba btab pas/ da tshe 'dir rjes su 'dzin pa'i skal ba med/ yi ge soganyis po 'bru 'bum sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bzlos/rang sems phag mo'i rang zhal ma yengs par skyongs/ snying rje byang sems kyis 'gro ba la phan thogs/bar dor rjes su 'dzin no gsungs nas yal song / gnyid sad pa na skyo snang drag po sngar yong ma myong ba zhig gda' 'o/ /—264—

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)me lug zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga'i nub rmi lam du/ /o lo dge bsnyen dang blo gros bzang rogs la khrid de rdza ri dkar po rtse mo rno ba rong nge ba zhig gi ldebs la phyin nas rgya gar nub phyogs la 'gro rgyu yin zer bsam 'grub yin snyam pa zhig gis rta sngon po sga srab chab pa byas pa zhig gis gdong la khrid 'gro gi 'dug /ngas bltas pas ri'i logs thams cad la rdo dang bye ma rlung gi btab pa 'dra ba'i skya nyol las grub pa'i yi ge lwanyu dang / dbu chen gyi dbyangs gsal dang / aṣ+ṭa dang / bde mchog gi rtsa sngags sogs hram me 'dug /ri gdong de nas mar babs pa'i steng kha zhig na/ dbus na rnam rgyal mchod rten chen po zhig dang / mtshams bzhi na de'i phyed tsam gyi mchod rten re 'dug /nga'i yid la rje btsun rdo rje 'chang gi phyi rten yin pa la/ da lo khong tsho dmag gis brel nas sku dkar yang ma gsol pa (15ba〉sig /nga bla ma mchod rten la re ba'i dus byung snyam nas mchi ma mang po shor/ skor ba du ma byas gsol 'debs brgya phrag mang po byas shing dad gus kyi yus brnags nas/ mchod rten dbus ma de la 'jus nas bstan pa dang sems can spyi la phan pa'i smon lam mang po btab khyad par skye ba phyi ma sems can thams cad rje btsun rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs drung du skye bar smon lam dungs par btab pas/ mchod rten lnga po g.yo zhing ldeg /dbus ma'i khebs gdugs ltar g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od li khri 'dra ba mang du 'phros nas ngo mi shes pa'i lung pa mang po gang song / dril bu du ma 'dug pa rnams kyang skad snyan pa 'brug tsam sgrog /de'i gdangs las/ su zhig kha tsam ma yin dad pa yis/ /bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs pa/ /de ni myur du mngon par 'tshang rgya ste/ /rang nyid grol nas gas yang sgrol bar 'byung / /zhes thos pas phan yon 'di tsam yod pa yin byas/ /zla bo kun khrid nas skor ba gsol 'debs mang du byas/ ngas rta la zhen blo bzang gis bal dra po tigagang ba zhig khyer nas thur de la babs phyin pas/ nyang stod rgyal khang yin snyam pa zhig tu slebs pa na/sde pa nor bzang drung gis spos sna byas/ khang pa g.yabs sgor nyi ma dro ba zhig tu slebs a jo lags sku mched kyis ja bur so gos kyi bkod pa yang bshams byung / a jo chos kyi zhal nas khyod gang la 'gro —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skargyu sogs dris byung ba la lo rgyus rnams zhib tu zhus pas/ khong tsho'i zhal nas/ rgya gar nub (16na)phyogs na 'dul zhing legs po yod pa dang chos ha cang mi dar bas der phyin na phan pa rgya che na'ang / da lam la phar la ma 'byon/ lo kha yar zhig 'di tshor bzhugs la/ chos bka' nub nye ba 'di pa gsos phan sems rgya bskyed nas gas la chos mang du shod/ 'di skad byas na rang gzhan kun la phan phyir dpe cha med pa kun bris/ yod pa kun ltos/chos thob pa thams cad bed med la ma bzhag /chos bka' dam po byed zer/ nor med pa la mi ster ba dang chos la dpe mkhyud byed mi nyan pas/ sems bskyed rgya chen pos kun nas blangs pa'i chos nyan pa dang / dpe gzhan la spel ba dang / de'i don rang rgyud la sbyor ba rnams mdzod la/ rim gyis rgya gar nub phyogs su byon/ nged spun gsum yang khyed gar 'byon sar yong ba yin gsungs pa la/ de skad zhu ste/ chos nyan sa yang mi rnyed/ rnyed na yang zhus yang mi yong /ngas chos bshad kyang nyan mkhan ni mi yong ste/ da lam thabs mi gda' bas stod lags zhus pas/ rta rdzi ngo nag thing byas rta dang bcas pa nub phyogs phar la 'ur sgra dang bcas nas 'phur song ba dang gnyid sad pa mnyam du byung ngo / /sa sprel zla ba dang po nas rkang pa'i nad de langs nas/ re mig la zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi la 'gro smon can du phyin/ gcod bka' ma dang gsang ba med byung sbrags nas nyams len gang lcogs byas pas zhag gcig nas rkang pa nas 'dud pa dang khyi nag pos rmugs pa sogs pa sdigs ri dang /bud med mdzes ma sngar ma mthong ba'i byad bzhin dang / gos rgyan phun sum tshogs pas (16ba〉slu brid byed pa sogs lhongs tshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung na'ang / phung po'i gces 'dzin btang nas nyal bsdad pas/ zhag gsum song ba na nyams snang la bud med byad dmar byang nge ba bong che zhing skra dmar ba zhig phyag 'tshal zhing / /('di'i mtshams su la lha yig 'bru kha shas 'dug rung 'bri thabs ma rnyed/tshe tshes pa'i srog snying 'bul ba snyam byed par dam la btags/tshes bcu'i tho rengs dge sbyor rnams byed 'phro la gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du/ g.yabs lho yin —266

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)snyam pa zhig na dar sman tse'i yol ba rgya che bar btang 'dug pa'i nang na/ sprul sku grang so gter ston chen po lcam sngon sdud ma zhig bsnams/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing bzhugs 'dug /phyag 'tshal nas 'dir phebs pa yin nam zhus pas/ drung pa 'og gdon gyis zhabs bsnyel gyi 'dug zer phyag rdor gyi dbang zhig 'bul du yongs pa lags/ sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang bcas pa tshar bdog /da gsan pas chog pa bdog gsungs/ phyag rdor che ba brgyad skor gang lags zhus pas/ u tsa drag sngags kyis che ba'i dbang yin gsung / sku gshogs g.yas na u tsa lha bcu dgu dkyil 'khor zhig bkram/ mar me chen po mang po spar/ sku mdun na lcog tshe'i kha na/ rdo rje dril bu/ bum pa/ cod pan/ mchod rten sngon po mtho gang pa zhig dang / phyag rdor gyi sku shel 'dra ba zhig dang / gzhan yang phyag mtshan gyi bye brag mang po 'dug /g.yon na rdul tshon gyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig gi dbus na/ pad+ma phyogs mdog 'dab bzhi'i lte ba la khyung dkar po gzi brjid 'bar ba/ gshog pa sngon po rdo rje'i rang bzhin me 'od 'phro ba/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon (17na〉gil nag po'i mgo bo za ba'i rked pa nas bzung ba/ 'dab ma shar na sbrul dkar po gnyis/ lho na ser po/ nub na dmar po/ byang na ljang gu gnyis rnams kyi mjug ma bsnol nas gdan du byas pa/ rked pa yan langs nas khyung gi pus mo'i tsam na gdeng ka byas pa zhig 'dug /'di gang yin zhus pas rdo rje mchu'i dkyil 'khor yin gsungs nas/ phyag rdor la dbang bzhi rdzogs shig dang / rdo rje mchu la rjes gnang rgyas pa zhig gnang ba'i mthar/ 'di rnams kyang khyed la mkho ba yin gsungs nas po ti glegs shing med pa mang du gtad byung / de rnams bdag gis pang du bzhag pas mgo bo dang mnyam por song / res nga rang dpe char 'gro/res dpe cha rnamasanga'i lus su 'gyur/ res nga'i rgyab mdun du glegs shing bzhag nas skud pas sdom pa rnams byed pa byung ba dang gnyid sad do/ /tshes bcu bzhi'i nam langs khar gnyid du song ba na/ dpon sa tshe dbang pa yin snyam pa'i bud med dkar dmar mdzes pa zhig gis chang thod pa gang sbyin pa 'thung gi yod tsa na/ blo gros bzang gis —267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yoskyes pa slog pa gyon pa zhig khrid nas 'di la thod 'phreng legs po yod pas mjal ba zhu zer/ ston dang byas pas thod 'phreng byu ru ltar dmar ba brgya rtsa gcig bstan nas 'di kha che paṇa chen gyi 'phreng ba yin zer/ nga la gnang dgos byas pas lag tu sprad byung tsa na thod pa legs pa khyid gang tsam la 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i sku me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu zhig gsal bar mthong ba dang gnyid sad do/nywa/ snga mo zhig (17bskyong ma'i gshed dmar la thugs dam byas na tshe la phan zer ba byung ste zhu sa ma rnyed/ myug tu sleb nas btsal bas nyi sbug pa la bzhugs zer/ bya lo zla ba lnga pa'i nang du nyi sbug la 'gro khar/ shangs chu che drags thar sa mi 'dug zer nas bsgol ba'i nub rmi lam du lung pa kha lho bstan ri skya hreb se ba zhig gi ldebs rab gsal nyis brtsegs yod pa'i khang pa zhig na bla ma 'ber mo byin chags shig gi drung na nga 'dug pa na bla ma de'i 'khris na o lo nor bzang ba yin snyam pa zhig gi phyag na rag gi 'phreng ba rnying pa zhig bzung nas 'dis jo lags rang gi thugs dam dang thog ma nas yin pas/ da dung mdzad na khe che ba 'dug ste the tshom las mi 'dug /ding sang ma bzung na de nas mi yong zer ba rmis pa nas/ sang de ga chu la ma 'dzems par phyin pas khang pa sogs rmi lam sor bzhag gda'/ gshed dmar nag gi dbang lung rags pa thob/ dbang ma thob pa zhig gshed dmar gyi rdul tshon gyi drung du bto bas sna khrag dar 'phyar 'phyar byed/ shin tu ga kha la byin rlabs che bar go lags/ de res zhag bcu bsdad/ dbon po des chos gnang ba'i spyan tshab mi nusapar gegs chen po byas/ rin po che'i zhal ta la ma dang zhag mnos pa bzhin 'bul mi thub pa 'dug pas phyir byon/ khong tsho me tog la song shul lta bu 'gol ba zhig la nga rang gis gang thos 'di tshang na zhig 'bul thub byed do gsungs/zla ba bdun pa'i nang du rmi lam la lto steng gi khang thog yin snyam pa zhig na/ rin po che nyi sbug pa zhal nub gzigs byas bzhugs pa'i drung na bdag 'dug pa la/ gshed dmar gyi skor po ti gcig gi —268

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mas gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i lhos tso ri / 6)lung rdzogs (18na)par gnang / dpe ris tshon rdzogs byas pa'i legs po mang po bstan nas mdzub khrid mdzad/ khyad par thod pa zhal dbye dang ru mtshon la zhi rgyas mang po gnang ba zhig rmis/ gnyid sad nas kyang shin tu gsal ba 'dug pas zin bris byas na thub nges 'dug ste/ dga' mo zhig thos pa'i ltas yin snyam pa las ma byung bas yi ger ma btab/ de nas me tog ran pa dang phar 'gro rtsis kyisaskor yang la btang ba dang pha gi nas zhi bar gshegs pa'i gsang brtol gyi mi gnang ba lam du 'phrad log byung / bar do ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung bar gda' bas bka' drin che/ chu phag sag zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma dros chen tsam la lam zab kyi de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa'i ngang la gnyid du song ba na nang thams cad 'od dmar ser li khri 'dra ba zhig gis khengs nas phyi nang thams cad gsal ba'i khrod nas 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan las grub pa'i yi ge dbu chen mtho re tsam byas pa'i rje sa skya pa chen po'i rnam thar ding sang yongs grags rnams las tshes zhib pa zhig yig 'phrong du yod pa so so'i sgra sgrog pa zhig 'dug /de la dad gus byas tshig rnams sgrogs/ sgra de'ang snyan bzhin pa'i ngang nas sa skya pa chen po'i zhal ras gdong dkyus ring po la sha dkar la snum pa zhal chen po 'dzum bag can ga ther byas pa zhig yod de snyam mig sngar lam lan yong ba la/ dad gus kyi mchi ma 'chor ba zhig gi ngang nas gnyid sad do/ /chu phag zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu'i tho rengs rmi lam du bo dong rdzong gi nyi 'od 'khyil pa yin snyam pa zhig na a pha lags drung na bza' ring 'gag dkar po gsar pa zhig gi steng na ras sngon (18ba)po'i 'od dang 'phro bzhi'i sku gzan bzhes raka sha'i 'phreng ba bsnams nas bzhugs 'dug pa'i drung du slebs/ snga phyi'i lo rgyus mang po zhus pa'i mthar bdag 'tsham por gnas khyed gar thegs da nged tsho ci tsug byed zer zhing mchi ma gtong gin zhus bas ma bshum khyed tsho a pha rkyen gyis shi bar byed kyi gda' ste de 'dra min/ sku tshe rdzogs nas lo lnga song ste sngags kyi dam bca' zhig ma thems pas bsdad pa yin bas de thug bsdad ba'ang ya mtshan che/ da lam a pha lcang lo can du slebs gsang ba'i bdag —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yopo la theg pa chen po'i chos kyi dga' ston rgyun chad med par myong nas myur du 'tshang rgya bar yod/ khyed rang yang lcang lo can du skyes nas sems can du ma'i don byed par 'gyur/ de'i slad du dge sbyor 'di gyis gsungs nas nam mkha' la je mthor 'od cig la bzhud song bas drung lags zer 'bod 'phro la gnyid sad do/ lo de'i zla ba drug pa'i nyer gsum nas rje btsun rdo rje 'chang gi dus wo sgrub mchod btsugs pa'i tshe/ bug sgo'i nang na nged gnyis lam med/ thig sus kyang slob ma myong / phyi nas 'bod kyang ma bde bar gang drag ci drag la song skabs/ thig kyang mi shes pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du khas len pa'i blun po snying kham can nga 'dra snyam dus/ gsol ba btab pas thig rtsa zhig blo la lam lam byed nas brgyab pas thig shin tu legs/ de'i dkyil 'khor des mar me bzung / zhag bcu gsum bzhag kyang rdul ye ma blangs so/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad nas zhing gshegs kyi dus mchod la/ 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub mchod sbyin sreg dang bcas byed kyin yod dus/ sbyin sreg gi skabs na drogs pa 'dra (19na〉rgod tsa na rmi lam du/ nga sbyin sreg cig byed kyi 'dug pa la/ de'i pha tshad na rdo rje 'chang chen po dang drung lags gnyis bzhugs nas 'khor chen la sbyin sreg gi yi ge mang po yod de/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan gyis 'di la thugs gtsigs che/ 'di'i skabs su phyag len 'di bzhin mdzad gsungs nas/ 'grig shin tu zhib par gsungs/ dpe cha de'ang gda' ba 'di khrod na gda' gsungs nas bstan/ de nas drung lags kyis zhu mkhan mdzad nas 'khor chen gyi skor la dka' gnad mang po la bshad pa mdzad pa'i sgang la gnyid sad pa/ bla ma yab sras gnyis kyi zhal mig sngar lam me ba'i ngang nas tshig de dag kyang blo la gsal por 'dug /sang nyin mdang phyag mdzub btsugs pa'i dpe hrul bral brul bsdus pa'i po ti de bltas pas sbyin sreg gi dpe cha yang 'dug cing / ji skad gsungs pa zhig 'dug go /byi lo zla ba dang po'i nyer lnga la sding ma nas 'khor gdong du gtor ma'i rgyab na bkram pa'i gur me tog ma'i zhal khebs 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa ja sbyor gcig gi bar lam me 'dug /gral grol rjes na zhal khebs sad rtsas khad de bkab 'dug pas mig 'khrul ba'am ya —270

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)mtshan can zhig gda' 'o/ /lcags phag zla ba lnga pa'i nang du rmi lam du/ mnga' ris sprul sku dang mjal dpe cha gnang bdog gam zhug pas/ na ning khyed rang gis bltas pa de nas shog ldebs gnyis las ni ma bris/ dpe chung de gnyis bskur yod gsungs/ spa gam zhig nas zhi khro'i dpe cha yin snyam pa'i dpe chung zhig gnang byung bas/ 'di thams cad la ngom dgos snyam dga' tshor tshad med pa'i ngang nas (19ba)gnyid sad/ sang phyag dam dpe cha phebs pas de ga sor bzhag 'dug go /yang nub cig a lhun pa yin snyam pa zhig gis sprul skus skyel du btang ba yin zer rag bum mgul chings dar dkar nog po zhig gis byas/kha rgyan rma bya dang / shel gyis byas pa zhig dang / po ti bru le dkon rtsos gril ba sprad pa rmis pas sang bka' 'dus kyi phyag dpe slebs nam la bris pa'i sgang la/ rmi lam sprul sku byon nas rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi dbang gnang ba byung ngo / /shing glang zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas bka' brgyad sgrub chen sman sgrub dang bcas pa mdzad dus bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gsum gyi thig 'debs shing / nam mkha' la'ang dkyil 'khor gyi thig rdzogs pa zhig skya ta le 'dug pa rmis/ yang nub cig nub phyogs kyi nam mkha' la mnga' ris paṇa chen bzhugs nas/ stong pa stong pa stong gsal 'dzin med yin gsungs nas li ser po'i za ma tog nor bu mig gsum pa'i dbyibs can zhig bdag la gnang byung ba dang gnyid sad do/ /nub cig bka' brgyad kyi dpal dgu thog tshad tsam 'od 'bar ba'i mdun na sprul sku bzhugs nas bka' brgyad kyi rgyud lung man ngag thams cad 'dir 'dus shing khyod rang bdag po yin pas ye gsung po ti gcig nga laganang byung ngo / /stag lo chos lung sgang gi khang chung de mtshams dam po'i khong nas dpon sa nam mkha'i drung sogs kha cig la ro snyoms sgang 'bril bug chos byas bshad pa'i grol kha tshes bzhi'i snga dro rmi lam du/ gcung rin po che sku gzi 'od shin tu 'bar zhing / na bza' kong gzan ngur kha zhig bzhes/ 'khor mang chen dang —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6nebacas (20na)phyogs la thegs rgyu ba'i rnam pas/ rdzong zhig gi brgya sgo'i phyir phebs kyi 'dug pa'i thegs skyel la phyin phyag 'bul byas pas phyag lan mdzad rjes mgul phrag nas zhwa dmar legs tshad thub yug cig gnang byung nas da 'phrin las yang 'di che ba yod pa 'dug pas da phyis dbu zhwa 'di bzhes las 'gro don mdzad pa zhu gsung ba dang gnyid sad/ zhal ras gsal la drags mchi ma mang po shor/ dang po sgom zhwa gon gsung gnang skabs rten 'brel 'phyugs drogs mi mang sa la mang por gyon/ phyis su grol cha zhig zhu snyam pa ma grub pa'i ngang nas zhing brjes/ da ci drag snyam sems ma bde ba'i ngang la yod pa bla ma thugs rje che bas grol cha gnang bar 'dug bsam mos gus bgyis so/ /na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra dzhai ra wā ya/ bdag dang po nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la dad po zhig yod do/ /man ngag ma thob pas dge sbyor byed lugs ji lta ba ni ma byung 'dug /myug du sleb 'phral bcu gsum ma'i thog nas ya ma rā dza 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa'i tshe nub cig /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhal phyag yongs rdzogs mi tsam zhig gsal lam ste mthong ma thag gnyid sad/sa rta zla ba dgu pa'i nang du/ bla ོ rin po che'i drung du gsung chos zhu yin rgya r+ṣa yod pa'i nub cig rmi lam du/ bo dong bla brang dkar po'i tshoms chen gyi dbus na bzhugs gdan shin tu mtho ba zhig la/ lo chen byang rtse yin zhu ba'i sku'i rnam pa da lta bris yod pa'i sku 'dra 'di rnams sor bzhag la/gos bem dmar smug nyis brtsegs bzhes pa shin tu gzi brjid che ba zhig dang / de'i sku gzhogs g.yon na bla chen chos dpal bzang po yin zhu ba zhig bzhugs/ (20ba〉gzhan gral pa mang po byas pa zhig gi drung na bdag 'dug pa na/ lo chen rin po che bdag la ched du gzigs shing / bla chen pa'i rnam thar bsngags brjod mang po gsungs/ de nas lo chen dang yang yang mjal ba dka' snyam rje bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar lo chen rang gis mdzad pa de'i lung zhig gnang dgos zhus bas shin tu legs de ga bya yis gsung / gcig la phyag dpe khyer shog gsungs/ len du song ba ma sleb pa la gnyid sad/sems 'phrang ba'i tshad thub pa zhig byung / bla chen rin po che bla chen chos rin pa'i skye ba yin 'dug —272

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)pas de'i byin rlabs yin nam snyam/lcags sprel zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nas gzhi bsnyen gyi sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshugs pa'i tshes bzhi'i nub rmi lam du/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang pha tshar pa rje dang mjal/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi dbang rdzogs par gnang / dkyil 'khor gtor ma dbang tshig sogs kyang shin tu gsal ba dang /phyag len la dogs gcod 'dra zhu rgyu yod pa'ang zhus shing / lan gnang ba zhig byung ngo / /nub cig yang pha bla ma bzhugs khri thog rtsar stogs pa zhig gi steng na ber thul nel cho gsar pa rang zhig bzhes nas bzhugs pa'i sku gshogs g.yon na bdag 'dug pas/ a skyabs kyis gsol ja zhus rjes gsol kha zhu yi 'dug pas/ nga'i de khong la drongs gsungs/ gsol kha de bdag la drangs pa zhig rmis/ yang nub cig dbu rtse 'og 'dra ba zhig na khri sngar gyi de las mtho ba zhig la bzhugs nas tshe khrid kyi tshar chos de gsung rgyu yin snyam pa byas/ bdag sku mdun na 'dug pa la gsung chos ha cang gsal ba ni ma byung / rlung bum (21na)can bzung spyan lta stangs mdzad ha re bzhugs pa gsal po zhig rmis/ /yang nub cig bo dong rdzong du bde ba can yin snyam pa zhig na bzhugs gdan mtho po zhig la rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa chen po bzhugs/ de'i sku gas g.yon na bdag /bdag gi g.yon na rje btsun dpon bzhugasapa la rin po ches gzhi len gcig mdzad rgyu ba'i ston shom bzang po byas pa zhig rmis/ nub cig dpal sbug bzhugs khri'i steng na pha bla ma bzhugs gsung ngag rin po che bskyar nas gnang rgyu yin zer zhu mkhan mang po 'tshogs 'dug pa la bslab gsum pa gsal po 'dug g.yin ngo shes rang ni mi 'dug /khog phug yin snyam pa'i dpe cha zhig gi lung mdzad byung ba na/ thod phu'i blo gsal rgya mtsho de/ birnya pa lags sam zer ba zhig 'dug pa la/ don 'di ga yin de tshig 'di cung sdeb ma shes 'dug gsung / bdag gis thod phu'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug de/ da lta'i blo gsal rgya mtsho yin byas na bde ba 'dra zhus pas de ga bris pas yong gsung / de nas gzhung bshad cig kyang 'go btsugs/snang gsum kyang btsugs byung nas na ning gi zin bris de la zhu dag byed dgos snyam pa dang gnyid sad/ bsams pas thod phur byon —273

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skapa'i rje gha ya dha ra rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi thugs kyi sprul par mnal lam bka' rgya ma nas bshad/ de dang pha bla ma thugs rgyud gcig pa'i brda' ru 'dug snyam pa byung ngo/ /aṣ+ṭa 'bum phrag gsum song ba'i nyi ma shar lhor bzlas pa'i sgang la/ gnyid du cung zad song ba na mdun gyi nam mkha' la dpal kye rdo rje zhal brgya phyag bcu drug pa yab yum gnyis ka sku mdog g.yu drug dkar gyi mdog (21bsko bu dang gsal rnyog med 'od kyi rang bzhin zhig ja dkar yol gang lhod byas 'thung ba'i yun tsam gyi bar la 'dzin med kyi ngang la cham me ba nas mthong / de nas tshogs pa mang pos phun tshogs 'dod dgu ma 'ur ding gis gyer byung ba'i skad kyis gnyid sad kyang sems bde cham me 'dug go /yang gtum chen gyi mngon dkyil bsgrig pa'i skang la rmi lam du pha rdo rje 'chang tshar pa dang mjal nas/ gtum chen gyi dbang rdzogs par gnang / shes rab ye shes bla med spyi dang 'dra ba dang dbang bzhi pa'i skabs su bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa spyi bor gsal btab nas slob ma la bstim/ de dang rang sems 'dres pa'i gnas lugs la ngo sprod mdzad/ de tsam ma gtogs dkyil chog sor bzhag mdzad/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal tshun tshar nas brgyud pa zhus pas ngas ni rdo ring rin po che la thob/ des mkhyen rab rin po che la gsan pa yin nam gsung / de nas gnyis sad/yang nub cig sku ni ma mthong / rje btsun bsod nams dpal ba'i gsung yin snyam pa'i skad gog ge ba zhig gi gtum chen 'di sri'u chung ba'i pha chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin te/ rnam par nyams shing 'thor bar gyur/ 'di khyod kyi legs par bsos shig /ngas byin gyis brlabs kyi gsung ba gsal bar thos/yang nub cig sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje yin gsung ba'i sngags pa zhal ras dmar cham me ba la/ dbu skra sil bu ring shag dkar po dang lcam smug sdud ma bzhes pa zhig mjal nas zhib rgyas mang du gsungs/ gtum chen la gnang ba rgyas par mdzad pa (22na to kho byung bar rang don med par bstan par bsams pa'i byin rlabs yin nam snyam/ rin po che rong pa'i drung du 'joms byed kyi dbang —274

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)zhus pa'i dus/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bcom ldan 'das 'jom byed 'bar ba sku mdog mu men dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu rtsa zhal khrag skam pa 'dra ba'i smug po zhal gsum phyag drug phyag mtshan sogs gam la cher ma zin/ sku khru gang tsam gsal zhid dwangs la rnyog pa med pa zhig /mig phye ba nas bzung ste/ bum dbang ma rdzogs bar mig phye btsum med par dngos su gsal ler mthong / de dus sku dang rtsa zhal kha dog so so ba de gang yin nam snyam mod/ de nas yun ring po song nas lce blo ldan seng ge'i thugs dam bris sku mthong ba la'ang kha dog de ga 'dug cing / 'phrin las kyi tshig gi go ba myangs na de kho na dgos rgyur 'dug pas yid ches rnyed/ rje btsun rog pa'i zhabs de lce'i gdung zhakhrul med spyir byin rlabs che zhing / sgos lha 'di la mnga' brnyes pas de kho na'i byin rlabs su gda' 'o/ /khyi lo myug chos sde'i 'du khang du mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po'i phyag phyi byas bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen mdzad dus nyin gcig skor ba byed 'phro la ngal nas snyel byas bsdad pas/ gnyid du hrib tsam song ba na rigs 'dzin chen po phebs nas skyon pad+ma'i bka' lung la tshe chu 'di khol zhing 'dug pas dngos grub len ran gsung gi 'dug /da lta tshe dbang byed gsung ma thag gnyid sad/ skor ba la phyin pas mchod dpon byon nas de ring bka' dbang zhig yod pas zhal ngo tsho gdan 'dren (22ba)thong gsung / de 'phral bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dub pa'i zhi ba'i tshe dbang gnang byung ngo / /yang sgrub dbang chen mo'i chu dbang gi skabs su rigs 'dzin chen pos bum pa thogs nas 'dur dbyangs bcas/ bum pa mgo la bzhag pa'i tshe lus sprid cing shes pa kyi bun pa'i zil chen po zhig byung skabs/ lho nub kyi nam mkha' na tshur gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug sngags pa sgang yol dbu skra'i thor cog dar dmar pos bcings pa/ sku shag sham thabs dkar po'i steng na tshem ge sngo sang bzhes pa/ mgul la me long 'od lam me btags pa zhig phyag bum pa thogs te/ 'dzum ye re re byon byung nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag /nga'i lo tshad kyi steng du lo brgyad bsnan pa'i tshe thub par 'gyur/ mi nyams pa'i slad dang sems can mang po'i don la lung bzhi'i 'di lta bu'i sgrub pa chen po ma chags pa —275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yogyis shig gsungs nas 'od du yal song / re zhig rtog med du cham me lus 'dug /sad pa na mchi ma bun pa zhig byung / 'di nas bzung ste nam gsol ba btab res kyis nyams kyi snang ba la mjal byung ba yang pha rigs 'dzin chen po kho na'i thugs rjer gda' 'o/ /oṃ ā: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma si rnyi hūṃ/ phag lo zab lung du sku 'dra'i sgo drung du zhag bdun mtshams byas nas bla ma bka' 'dus kyi spyi'i bsnyen pa byas pa'i dus/ de bar la ni rmi lam brda 'dra mo tshe 'di'i legs nyes ston pa shas che bar byung / zab lung nas lam zhag gnyis byas g.yang du bsdad pa'i tho rangs mdun gyi nam mkha' la skyon rin po che'i sku byis pa lo brgyad pa'i tshod tsam sku mdog mi sha kha dmar mdangs che ba/ spyan gnyis shin tu zlum pa ha re gzigs(23na〉/ phod snamathing kha/ chosagos dmar po/ pad+ma mthong grol dmar po gsol ba/ sku lcam kha thi smug khra 'dra ba'i pad+ma sdum ris khra chil le ba bzhes pa phyag mtshan spyi dang 'dra ba zhig gsal bar mthong nas/ de'i zhabs kyi thad tsam du mgo btsugs nas/ nyi ma lta bur ma rig mun pa sel/ /zla ba lta bur nyen mongs gdung ba sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /be+eḍūrla yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zer ba 'di kho nas ston ma thag gnyid sad/ de nas bzung ste tshe 'di'i bya byed 'du 'god thams cad bun long nge ba 'a'i nam 'chi'am/ byang chub cig ma bsgrub na na ma mi 'dug snyam pa'i dung dung ma gtogs blo rgya ye med la/chags zhen 'jigs skrag ci yang med pa'i zi chod de ba zhig rgyun du byung ba de/ rin po che la bdag chen gyis ngan byas pa la zhe snang drag po skyes ma thag gnyid sad pa bzhin yal song /byi lo bo dong kun ra rnying mar skye bdun bsgrubs tshe zhal ngo rnams la 'khor ba dong sprug gi lam dbang phul ba'i spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong na skyon rin po che sngar mthong ba ltar dang /de'i g.yas na gu ru rin po che chos dbang babs dang mo'i de ga la/ phod ga'i steng na chos gos li khri'i mdog 'dra ba zhig bzhes/ phyag na bum pa bsnams/ g.yon na pha mnga' ris gter ston da lta'i dbyibasaji lta ba mdun gyi smad tsam na rgya mtsho dge slong ba de me tog dmar po zhig thogs pa rnams ye re re —276

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / benabyon byung nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'od bung nge bzhugs/ gu ru chos dbang gi phyag gi bum pa nasabadud rtsi 'o ma 'dra ba re skya (23bskor nar zhal ngo thams cad kyi dbu gtsug nas blug /dbang gi spro bsdu'i skabs su yang mdun na bzhugs pa de rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi 'od rang g.yin kun la thim pa'i snang ba dang bcas dbang de ma grol ring nyams kyi snang ba la gsal 'grib med par mthong / de skabs khrom thams cad dad pa 'ur langs/ sa 'phags gnam 'phags la song / zhal ngo 'dra la de gong du 'chi bltas 'dra gsal bar 'dug pa de nub nas grol byin rlabs yid ches par byung ngo / /de skabs ngan song kun sbyong kyi dbang byas pa'i tshe yang babs snga ma sor bzhag la rgyab na rdo rje gling pa lo chab spel ba'i steng na pad zhwa sngon po bzhes pa/ phod ka sngon po byas pa'i skam seng ba phyag na thod pa bsnams pa zhig bzhugs 'dug pa nyams snang la gsal bar dbang ma grol bar du byung /lcags mo glang lo bde gzar nyen che la nyams dma' ba'i sgang la/ bo dong tsho mes chen du dbon rin po che la gdan bzhugs kyi rgyab chog thugs sgrub kyi las kyang bgyis pa'i spyan 'dren gyi skabs su/ drin can spyon chen po sngar kho na 'dra ba zhig gi zhal nas/ 'di 'dra rang gi sred pa yang byed mi dgos gsungasanas yud kyis yal song / nyams dga' la shes pa 'ur ba zhig byung / de skabs mgon po g.yul bzlog byas pa'i byang shar gyi gyer gyi skabs su/ sngags srung e ka dza stu sku mdog smu ga nag ral pa g.yu drug dmar 'dra ba gcig skyes nam mkha'i mthongs su bun ba ba/ dpral bar spyan gcig ong kong ltar dmar bung nge ba / rma bya'i sgro thul khra bun bun gyi gseb nas me dmar lhab lhab yod pa/ g.yasasnying za zhing (24na skoyon spyang ki 'gyed pa thog tshad tsam zhig gyer ma grol bar dngos su mthong / de skabs gza' bdud chen po babs sngar yong ba de ga sor bzhag la mig thams cad ong kong btang ba tsam dmar hur re ba/ kha dgu car mi re khur nas khyu ru ru za ba zhig lan kha re mthong /'di yan rje nyid rang gi phyag bris dngos las bshus pa yin cing / de man kha bskang ba yin/ yang skabs shig byang phyogs nas rbod gtong gi ltas shig gis mnal lam du mi mang pos phyag zhabs nas —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebateg nas mtsho chen po zhig la bskyur grabs byas pa na/ rje nyid kyi zhabs gnyis kyi bar du mtsho bcug nas ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dpal mgon chen po zhal bzhi yongs rdzogs gzigasanas rbod gtong kyang rang sal zhi/ yang skabs shig thugs nyams la myug yin dgongs pa'i lung pa 'phra shur ba zhig na mar khrag gi chu rgyun chen po 'bab pa nam mkha' nas dmag zor re ma tī zhes pa'i sgra byung ba la brten/ khrag gi rba klong 'tshub pa'i khrod nas khro mo khrag gi ral pa can 'jigs su rung ba sku rked yan 'thon pa zhig gzigs gsung /stag lo tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan tshe/ rje nyid kyi gzigs snang du mdun gyi nam mkha' la dbus su rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ g.yas su sprul sku shākya thub pa/g.yon du skyon chos kyi rgyal po rnams dngos su gzigs gsung / yos lo zha lur ma he mchod pa la phebs skabs/ las kyi gshin rje yab yum gyi zhal 'bag la bka' bsgo gnang ba'i tshe las kyi gshin (24ba)rje yab yum mdog kham nag shin tu 'jigs pa spel dkar dang mnyam pa zhig la dngos su bka' bsgo gnang gsung / rje nyid zhing 'di'i mdzad pa legs par mthar phyin nas gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul ston par mdzad tshe/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la skyon chos kyi rgyal po/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' legs pa/ rje btsun blo gsal rgya mtsho/ sprul sku bdud 'joms rdo rje/gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug rnams phebs byung gsung ba dang / de skabs su drung na bzhugs pa'i phyag phyi rnams la khyed rnams kyis nyi ma 'di kha dog ji 'dra zhig tu mthong / ngas ni nyi 'od thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna lngar 'dug gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ sbyor drug bsgoms pa'i yon tan rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs shar bar 'dug gsungs/ yang mkha' 'gro ma kha dog sna lnga so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i seng ge la chibs pa rigs lnga dngos su byon nas spyan 'dren par brtsams pa na/ de nyin bu slob rnams kyis brtan bzhugs phul nas bzhugs gsol gtab pa na mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang sleb yong gsungs nas zhag bdun bar bzhugs pa'i mthar/ 'brug lo zla ba lnga pa'i nyer gcig gi —278—

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus kyi cha la/ gong du brjod pa'i bla ma rnams dang yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs mngon sum du byon/ dpa' bo dang ḍā zhi'i tshogs kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ lha (25na skong rig pa 'dzin pa kun gyis mdun nas bdar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis sngun nas bsus/'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis zhabs nas bteg /lha dang lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas me tog gi char 'bebs shing 'ja' dang 'od kyi lam nas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /kye ma yab rje rdo rje 'chang dbang de/ /rtag par zhen tshe chos dbyings ngang du gzims/ /chad par rlom tshe sgyu ma'i gzugs skur bzhengs/ /kye ma kyi hud thugs rje'i bdud rtsis skyongs/ khyod sku nyin byed chos dbyings nub ri'i rtser/ /gzims tshe 'gro rnams lag gi ku mu da/ /'gram pa'i chu mtshor brten pa dal ba'i lus/ /zhing 'dir khyod sku'i ngang tshul brdas bstan nas/ /da ni srid zhi'i cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i gar/ /gnyug ma'i ngang nas ro snyoms g.yo med bde/ khyod sku dag pa'i rang zhal dbyings su mjal/ /a ho snying la bdud rtsi'i ngal gso byin/ /ces brjod nas/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi gsang ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam/ so so skye bo dag gi spyod yul ma yin pa gong du brjod pa dag gis tshad mas grub pa yin mod/ 'on kyang 'di tsam gsang tshig kyang kun gyi blor mi shong ba'i snod ldan re re rnams kyi spyod yul du bya zhing / 'dis mtshon pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod mod/ 'dir brjod par ga la cus so/ /dam pa khyod kyi ngo mtshar gsang ba'i gtam/ /bgrang yas rgyal bas bskal bar ma gsung na/ /deng 'dir (25ba〉spo shas rdzogs par mi spobs kyang / khyod zhal dran tshe yid la dbang ma mchis/ /de phyir dam pa'i rtogs brjod cha shas kyang / /brjod pa'i dge tsho gos bla na med do zhes/ /rgyal rnams bden pa'i dbyangs kyis yid drangs nas/ /gsang chen snying po'i gtam 'di phyogs brgyar bsgrags/ /dam pa'i rnam thar zla shel thig ler be+e ḍūr tshon ris 'khyil/ /med byung gtam gyi bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar —279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()snyan tshig legs bshad cha yi gter//rtogs brjod kun+da'i rtse la gar byed dpyod ldan mgrin sngon gtsug phud rgyan//deng 'dir skal bzang blo mun sel la e ma ho shar gyi thig le mtshar//a ho 'di na gsang ba mi zad pa'i//snyan tshig snying gi gdung sel mkhri gaḥ//ngo mtshar rtogs brjod li shi'i ljon pa dag/skal bzang gzhon nu'i grib bsil 'di ngo mtshar//rigs brgya'i cod pan rdo rje 'chang dbang de//gsang chen ye shes gzigs pa'i med byung gtam//bdag lta'i blo chung za zis sems myos nas//thun mong gtam du sgrag la gnang ba stsol//skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du//gang gi mtshan yang bgrang yas bskal pa'i bar//rnyed par dka' ba'i rje btsun chos kyi rje//mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zhabs pad bsten par shog/mkhyen brtse'i dpal mnga' dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan//bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can//'dren mchog bzang po pha rgod bla ma rjes//skye ba kun tu thugs rjes 'dzin par shog/dkyil 'bor rgya 26nasgo tsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 44 //ngur smig zol gyis rol ba'i bka' drin can//mgon po khyod la gsol ba btab pa'i dge/ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du bsngo//skyabs chen bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang /gsang chen rgyud sde zab mo'i bden tshig dang //mthu chen mkha' 'gro srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis//rlabs chen smon lam 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog khu bha ma stu sarba dza ga rta/'di na sngon med gsang ba'i gtam//mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i phyag sor rtser//bzhugs nas snod ldan bu la byin//skal min rna bar sam ya//zhes bka' rgyas kyang btab bo//sa mā ya gu tho/rdo rje 'chang dbang rje btsun mkhyen brtse zhabs//bka' drin mtshungs med dran mchog bslab gsum rje//yab sras zhabs rdul mchod pa'i skal bzang can//thugs yid gcig gyur gang des sbyar ba dge/dpe 'di pha bla mas bdag la dgyes bzhin du gnang ba byin rlabs rbe'o//zhes pa'o//dbyar gyi char sprin sngon por sgyugs pa'i sum//g.yu 'brug mgrin rnga shugs kyis sgrog byed na//dam pa'i rang bzhin lo du byung ba'i gtam//dngos po'i gshis la mtshar 'dzin byis pa'i blo//'jam mgon byin rlabs nya gang 'od dkar naX8/0/mkhas grub ga pur gzegs mas sgrib gnyis

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)kyi/ /gdung sel sgyu 'phrul lha lam mtha' rnyed na/ /yon tan 'di tsam rdul gyi cha las phra/ /gang thugs (26ba)bla ma yi dam chos srung dang / /dbyer med mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba bzhin/ /so sor med kyang sna tsho gos gzigs pa'i tshon/ /kun rdzob dwangs shel dngos su 'ja' ltar bkra/ /rnal 'byor dbang mos rjes brtse dril bu'i zhabs/ /skyengs nas mkha' spyod zhing du bros pa dang / /lhan cig tshangs spyod brtul zhugs brtan po yis/ /nye bar 'khor gyi bsnyems pa chung ngur byas/ /rdo rje chos skyong bran 'khol gnam lcags thog /yid srubs brag ri btags la mtshar du ci/ /dbang bzhi'i lam gyi bgrod pasatshe gcig la/ /sku bzhi'i go 'phang rnyed der gang gis bston/ /'bum phrag lce yis bskal bar brjod pa'i tshad/ /bzung bar nus min bdag blos ga la srid/ /tshangs pas zag bcas bde ba'i gnyid spangasate/ /bsams kyang rtogs dkas snying las chung ngur gyur/ /'on kyang 'di tsam mthong spel smra ba yi/ /'dab chags grib ltar rjes 'brel yang srid kun/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan chos dang de ston pa'/ /bla masarjes 'dzin skal bzang thob bam snyam/ /zhabs drung brtan pa'i drung ngam bsod nams rab brtan du grags pa la 'dar chos rdzong pa'i sras mo dpon sa nam mkha'i drung blangs par sras mo byung ba'i chun mar tshe dbang drung bsus pa'i sras 'a zha nam mkha' phun tshogs la rwa lo'i gdung brgyud sde pa brgya tsho ba'i lcam bsod nams 'bol zhes par sras rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ nam mkha' tshe brtan rdo rje/ nam mkha' mgon po/nam mkha' (27na thakra shis dang bzhi bltams pa'i gcen rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam par thar pa logs su 'bri bar spro bas 'dir ma bkod/ nam mkha' tshe brtan dang nam mkha' bkra shis gnyis kyang / legs bshad rin po che las/ phal cher bu tsha'i spyod pa ni/ /rigs brgyud snga ma'i rjes su 'gro /khu byug phrug yi rgya khra mā /'gro ba rgya lam srid pa tsam/ /zhes yab mes gong ma rnamasakyi chas kyis dpa' zhing bsgrigs kyis che ba sogs lugs gnyis kyi spyod tshul mtha' dag ya rabs bzang po'i ngang tshul kho nar byung la/ khyad par 'a zha nam mkha' mgon po'i khab tu mnga' ris gong —281—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yoma'i bla sman pa'i sras mo tshe dbang bsod nams dpal mo bsus pa'i yab yum gnyis da'ang che btsun gdung gis mtho ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan zhing tshe 'di'i don du gtan mdun rgyab tu bskyur ba'i gya gyu'i ngan spyod ye mi mdzad par rje la gus shing 'bangs la byams pa ngo tsha shes shing khrel gzhung gi bag yod pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing dkon cog gsum la mchod pa dang ma nus par sbyin gtong / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs rdul bsnyen nas gsang chen zab mo'i nyams bzhes la lhod pa mi mnga' bas phyi'i ltar snang gi cha lugs gcig kyang ding sang gi sde dpon du grags pa rnams kyis dpe zlar mi 'os pa zhig yin la/ yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su nam mkha' bsod nams rab brtan dang gcung nam mkha' don grub dbang po (27ba)gnyis zhakhrungs pa'i gcen dam pa 'di nyid lhums su ma zhugs pa'i sngon du yum gyi mnal lam du rdor 'dzom zer pa'i zhing gi tshigs nas grong chung dung gi gang ba rnyed khrod nas lcam gyi a jos dung dkar g.yas 'khyil legs po zhig tshe dbang bsod nams dpal rang gyis zhes gtad pa sku phag tu bcug pa rmis/lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe srid pa 'khor ba'i ngang tshul mtha' dag me 'bar ba'i rlubs ltar sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can lha mi'i dbang phyug rnams kyang zag bcas kyi bde bar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yid brtan mi rung ba'i chos can dang / tshul des drangs nas rang nyid gcig pur ma zad khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gsum ci rigs kyis mnar bar mi bzod pa'i snying rje dang skyo shas nges 'byung bcos ma ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal de dag las thar pa'i skyabs gnas dkon cog rin po che rnam pa gsum yin par rgyu mtshan shes nas mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa brtan po gong du 'phel ba sogs yum gyi thugs la 'gyur ba sngar dang mi 'dra ba 'khrungs par brten nas de dag ka mad sum cur gras pa'i tshigs bcad kyang mdzad/ mnal lam du brag mthon po zhig gi rtse thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug phyag na bum pa bsnams te bzhugs pa'i brag rtsar yum nyid 'khod pa'i dbu gtsug nas bum chu skya nar gyi blug pas lus sems bde ba khyab pa'i —282

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)nyams shar/de yang sku bltams pa'i yul ni/ khrus khang lo tsā (28na tha bsod nams rgya mtshos/ lar dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal sras pad dkar zhabs drin las/ /bod kyi yul khams 'di nyid kyang / /'phags yul dang skal ba mnyam pa snyam/ /zhes sras bcas rgyal ba spyi dang lha gcig phyag na pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pas dge ba bcu'i khrims dang bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul las mi zhan par gsungs shing paṇ+ḍita chen po gha ya dha ra'i zhabs kyis/ da dge sbyor byed pa la rgya gar las bod 'di chu bzang zhing bsil drod snyoms/ srog chags nyung la zas bcud che bas rgya gar du mi 'gro nga bod du sdod/ ces 'khor 'das dbyer med dag pa'i snang bas 'byams su klas pa'i grub pa'i 'khor rte pa des kyang ches cher bsngags pa'i bod yul gyi stod spu rangs/ mang yul/zangs dkar te gsum po skor gcig /rtse li/ gru sha /sbal sde ste gsum po skor gcig /zhang zhung / khri te stod smad de gsum po skor gcig rnams mnga' ris skor gsum/ mdo khams la smad khams btags pa khams gcig /mdo smad g.yar mo thang btags pa khams gcig /btsong kha la gyi thang btags pa khams gcig rnams smad khams snang gsum sgang drug zer ba ni bar khams rang la nang gses kyi dbye bar ma rga/ bar na dbus ru dang g.yo ru gnyis/ g.yas ru dang ru lag gnyis te dbusagatsang ru bzhin grags pa'i g.yas ru'i cha shar gong ma'i lung gis bod chol (28bakhi gsum la dpal ldan sa skya pas mnga' sgyur ba'i tshe shangs khri skor gyi nang tshan dang gnam gyis bskos pa'i dpal phag mo gru pa'i dus rdzong chen bcu gsum du grags pa pho brang chen po rin cen spungs pa'i chab 'bangs su gtogs pa gnubs khu lung zhes sngon dpal bsam yas mchims phur slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha was sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba'i dus rje 'bangs dgur grags pa'i sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor du me tog phog pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che sogs skyes chen du ma zhakhrungs shing khyad par khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtshos mtshon gnubs kyi sngags 'chang rim par byon —283—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepa'i bsti gnas rje mi las lha rje gnubs chung par drags sngags gza' gdong dmar nag zhus hūṃ shi phags skyel gyi mthus sku dgra'i tshogs cham la phab cing byang khar paṇa chen rin po che shākya shrī'i brgyud 'dzin pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i 'byung khungs chos lung tshogs par grags pa'i sde tshugs pa/lho byang gi yul gru rnams kyang / rtogs brjod rin po che las/ gser gyi ba gam gzhalu yas khang /khang pas bskor ba'i grong khyer ni/ /'od ldan zhes bya bsod nams nas/ /'od ldan mtho ris lta bu yod/ /ces margad gos su klubs pa'i spang ljongs me tog rnam par bkra ba sna tshogs pa'i 'bru rigs kyi snye mas yongs su dud pa'i zhing gi phyogs mtshams su ljon shing gi 'phreng bas kun nas dkris pa/ grong dang grong brdal gyis khyab pa 'chi med kyi (29na)dga' tshal la co 'dri bas/ me long mar/ skyed tshal 'phreng 'di bu mo bzhin/ /mdzes ldan swā la kwa na na/ /zhes yid du 'ong bar gsungasashing thag ha cang mi ring bar pa ku'i klung chen po 'bab pa ni/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar du/ li shi'i yal 'dab dag ni zos gyur pa'i/ /lag ldan chu yi sgregs pa'i dri bzang gis/ /chu dang ldan pa rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'di/ /rin cen 'od zer dag gis spras te mdzes/ /zhes mtho ris lha'i chu bo ma dag pa'i dri ma 'bru ba la ring du chas pa lta bu/ ba da ra'i gling bgrod kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab las/ /rtse mo shin tu mtho ba yi/ shel gyi sa gzhi mdun du mthong / /bya rnams kyis kyang bgrod dka' na/ /'jam pa'i brag ni gcig pu der/ /zhes lho byang gi ri bo rnams mkha' la bsnyeg pa ltar mtho zhing shel dkar gyi brag ri bcal du bkram pa dang la lar spang dang rtsi shing nags tshal mngon par dkris pa'i yul gyi cha khu lung gzhis dar yab dgung lo nyer bzhi dang yum bco brgyad kyi bgrang byar babs pa'i tshe 'phags yul du stod 'grel ba'i lugs la sho bha na zhes phyogs 'dir mdzes byed du grags shing 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu gu'i ma'u zhes chu mo yos kyi lo dus ni/ 'phags skyes po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab las/ de nas yid srubs longs spyod grags/ /sbrang rtsi 'thung ba rnams kyi gnyen/ /skal bzang 'khri shing 'byud byed pa/ /legs (29bskon dpyid ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /—284

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / snyenazhes spyir 'dul mngon dus 'khor nag rtsis rgyal po lo gsar sogs lo 'go 'dzin lugs mang na'ang rgya rtsis rnying ma la bcu gcig pa dpyid zla ra ba stag tu ngos 'dzin pas kun yid dga' ston ster ba legs ldan dpyid kyi dus la babs pa mārga shī ra zhes pa hor zla bcu gcig pa'i dmar cha'i gang ba gsum pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba nyer dgu res gza' zla ba/ skar ma sog pa/ nyi shar bum pa'i dus sbyor gyi tshe yum la bsnyun mi mnga' ba'i ngang nas lte ba'i ga sha gsum rim du dkris te a zhes pa'i rang sgra dang bcas sku 'khrungs/de'ang kun mkhyen bu'i gsung skyor lung pas drangs par/ don dam gshis kyi gnas lugs la/ /rtsis dang 'bras bu'i spros pa bral/ /tha snyad las 'bras mi slu bas/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu bde ba dang / /sdig pas sdug bsngal sbyin par byed/ /gza' skar bde sdug byed po min/ /byed can bcu gsum mu stegasasmra/ /de ni log pa'i kun rdzob yin/ /tha snyad slu med bden pa sa /rtsis tshul nges par 'dzin dgosate/ /dper na tha snyad dbang bskur dang / /chog lha sgrub byas pa yis/ /don de 'grub par sangs rgyas dang / /paṇa grub rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ /rtsis tshul rgyud sde mdo mang por / /rtsis tshul byed par gces par gdams/ /zhes zla ba bsod nams kyi gza' btsan phyug dang ldan zhing / sog pa chos ldan thos shing las kun mkhas pa sogs rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar 'grig pa ni/ mdo (30na〉ga rgyan las/ skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs nas/ /spro ba'i sems drangs dga' zhing de la 'jug /ces dam pa rnams ni 'gro ba'i don du srid par skye ba len pa la chags ldan gyi skyes bu skyed mos tshal du 'jug pa lta bu'i spro ba dang ldan par bshad pas rje 'di nyid rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i rnam par sprul par gdon mi za bas spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa'i btsas su mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing na nyi ma las 'od zer bzhin du shar yang gdul bya thun mong ba rnams kyi snang ngo dang mthun par byis pa'i rnam par bstan pa de la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mtshan nam mkha' bsod nams rab brtan du gsol/ de 'phral du zhugs skongs kyi lci shing dang na bza'i rgyu'i snam phrug rtsol med du gzhan gyis —283—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ska'abul mi byung zhing / yum gyi chab zhe'ang shin tu mang bas bzhes pa'i lhag ma sman gyi rgyur dkrogs pa dang nyin mtshan bar ma chad par 'dzag pa na dbang thang che ba'i ltas legs zer/ sku'i dbyibs dpral ba dbyes che zhing zhal khyim sgor ba/ dbu gdugs ltar phug pa sogs mtshan dpe rjes mthun pas spras shing / mdangs dkar la gsal ba/ sku bong g.yin las che la kun gyi yid du 'ong ba snyun nad gdon zhud kyi 'tshe ba dang bral ba zhig byung zhing gsung ma bye ba'i dus zhal ngo lhan rgyas su bzhugs pa'i tshe yum gyi sku pang na gral mjug tu yod pa la gsung gtser ba sogs mi dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa rmo mos gral gsham (30ba)du bzhugs ma 'dod par 'dug gral 'gor bzhugs chug zer ba de bzhin du mdzad pas dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa na nye skor du 'khod pa rnams byis pa dkyus ma'i ngang tshul dang mi ldan pa zhig go snyam ngo mtshar du 'dzin/dgung lo gnyis 'gro ba'i tshe dbang phyug rab brtan gyi sku 'gag gsar pa bzhes nas byang gter gyi tshe dbang lcags sdong ma stsal ba'i skabs sku'i dbyibs dang na bza'i khyad par sogs thugs la nges te sku na yar phebs nas dran zhes sku 'khor ba tshor bka' stsal ba ni lo ngo gnyis kyi dus de 'dra gang zag phal bar 'byung ba mi srid cing gal te dus der ngo 'phrod pa lta bu'i dbang du byas na'ang rjes su dran gsos pa rang cag rnams la mi 'byung ba mngon sum du grub pas/ mngon pa kun las btus su/dran pa gang zhe na/ 'dris pa'i dngos po la sems kyis brjed pa med pa ste rnam par mi g.yeng ba'i las can no/ /zhes sku tshe gzhan du zhi gnas sam bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin la goms pa'i nang rtags phyir shar te blo ldan zhig gis dpyad na 'di gcig pu'i rnam thar yang dpag par dka'o/ /sngon med pa'i rdo chung ngu dang 'jim pa sbyin po mang po khu lung gi gzhis ga'i ltag nas rnyed pa dang / zan sogs la gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbyibs/ dkon cog gi sku gsung thugs rten gyi rnam par bsgrigs par ting dang kong bu sogs bzos nas mchod pa 'bul ba/ dung dkar bus te dge 'dun tshogs pa/ chos 'chad nyan gyi tshul dang / de bzhin du rang nyid kyi bla ma dang (31na)byis pa gzhan —286

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs phreng / snyenarnams grwa pa'i tshul du mdzad de chos 'chad pa'i rnam pa/ nga'i ming la btsun chung tshul khrims zer gsung ba/ mdos gtore/ cho ga /bskang bas mtshon pa'i lad mo sogs bskrun pa sku skye ba mang por 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba la rtag 'grus su gnang ba'i bag chags kyi mthu brtas pa yin cing dus phyis sku rim la dgos pa'i 'jim pa sngar shul nas btsal kyang lar ma rnyed pas bka' las nged chung ngu'i dus su blo brid kyi rtsed mo'i ched du gzhi bdag gis byin pa yin 'dra gsung / mdor na kun spyod mtha' dag chos dang mthun pa'i rnam 'gyur ma gtogs byis pa tha mal pa'i ngang tshul ye mi mdzad pas thugs sgam pa'i tshad thub par gleng /dgung lo lnga drug tsam la yum gyis snyan pad/ kong na/ sor gdub sogs phul bar mi dgyes shing 'dogs par mi mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes/ la la ba lang ji bzhin spyod/ kha cig bram ze'i rnam thar skyong / kho bo nyan thos spyod pas mdzes/ khug 'byung skyong ba bla ma'i drin/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin yang srid du mar nyan thos kyi bslab pa la gnas pa'i bag yod kyi ngang tshul nyams sad pas khyim pa'i rtags dang cha lugs sogs la thugs mi gzhol bar gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po 'byung ba'i snga ltas so/ /dgung lo bdun gyi steng du gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i shing rta pa chen po ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa rab gsal gyi rnam par sprul pa thams (31ba〉5da mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i gdan sa zha lu ri phug chos kyi pho brang du rigs brgya'i bdag po dbang phyug rab brtan bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phebs gtsug phud bzhes shing mtshan mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ rkyen sel rjes gnang ci rigs gsan nas gzhis sdo/ thegs/thun mong zhes pa lcags khyi'i lo dgung lo brgyad kyi thog slar zha lu ri phug tu phebs pa'i nub snga ma rje bla ma'i 'od gsal du rtsis kyi mgon po chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu'i mngag gzhug dam tshig —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yosrog gi bdag po zab bor dkar po'i gos dang khrab gsol zhing seng ge dkar por zhon pa lag na rgya spos khres kyi chun po dar skud kyis bcings pa spar ba'i tha snyad med pa dri zhim pa phun sum tshogs pas khyab pa zhig khyer nas nam mkhar yud yud 'gro ba byung ba sang nyin bka' las mdang de bzhin byung ba khyed 'byon pa'i ltas su 'dug cing tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yong ba'i brdar go gsung / rje nyid kyi drung du tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi dngos por bsgrubs/ mi ring bar rje rdo rje 'chang la stod la chibs kha bsgyur ba'i zham 'bring mdzad nas gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar phebs 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba dang chos skyong mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i sgo rum mgon khang sogs la gnas gzigs rgyas par mdzad/ phyir lam lha rtse dang 'dar phyogs su thegs skabs/ sku na gzhon pa la nges shing mdzangs pa rnam dpyod kyi mthu phul du phyin pa la phyogs de'i skye bo rnams ngo mtshar zhing yi rang bar gyur/(32na8 nas sde pa bkra shis rtse ba dang chos sde ba yon mchod nas gdan 'dren byung ba ltar yab sras chabs cig par chibs kha bskyod/ byams chen du rje btsun zha lu pa chen po dang thog mar mjal/ de nas dbus 'gyur gyi lte ba yar klungs skyid pa'i sman ljongs su phebs/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsang chen slob bshad kyi sngags grwa bkra shis rtse chos sder stan chags/ lo shas bzhugs ring rje rdo rje 'chang chen pos gnyug mar gnas pa dang phyogs 'dus kyi dam pa'i chos don du gnyer ba chu'i rlabs 'phreng bzhin yol ba med pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i zhan chos dang / snying po kye rdo rje man ngag lugs/ 'jigs mdzad rdo rje sogs dkyil 'khor du ma'i dbang bzhi/ mkha' spyod skor gsum/ dmar po skor gsum/ chos skyong che chung nas nyer mkho'i gas dang gzhan yang rgyud sdebazhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang / byin rlabs/ rjes gnang / lung khrid man ngag mang du gsan cing de dag kyang gsan lo tsam ma yin par sku na phra yang thugs la nges shing byang chub par mdzad/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs par snyan brgyud mnga' bdag rin po che bod mkhar nas kyi zhal slob spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gdams ngag bum pa gang byor bzhugs pa chos rje rab 'byams pa kun dga' lhun grub —288

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)gdan sar bskos nas yab sras gnyis ka gtsang du thegs bzhed de rin po che chos sku ba gdan drangs kyang chos sde ba tsho'i blor babs rgyu ma byung bar brten nged kyi tsha bo 'di chos bka' 'dra zhu rtsis yin tshul la bsnyad pa'i bka' (32ba༄65chag lugs dang dze tā ri'i tshe dpag lha dgu /khro phu'i 'jam dkar/phag dkar shes rab gsal byed/ rnam rgyal lha dgu /rnam 'joms ljang sngon/ seng ge sgra/ nor rgyun ma ser mo/ khro bo sme brtsegs/ khro mo sme brtsegs/ dzam ser nag rnams kyi rjes gnang / de dag la mkho ba'i yig cha'i lung / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang / mgon pod me 'bar ma'i lung sogasamang du gsan na'ang sku na phra ba dang phyag g.yog grul thub med gshis brgyud yig gi drogs gcod gnang rgyu ma byung 'dug rung 'chad bzang po yin zhes thugs mos par mdzad/dgung lo bco lngar phebs pa dmar ser can zhes me mo sbrul gyi lo/ de'ang mnyan yod mchod pa snga bsnur ba la brten nas bde legs phun sum tshogs pa byung bas rgya bod kun tu rta chen zla bar mdzad par grags na'ang / rtsa ba'i dus rje mar pas/ cho 'phrul khra yi zla ba la/ /mi kho bo lam du zhugs te mchis/ /zhes sa hor mchod yon gyi zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge bar dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chig brgyud rdo rje'i brgyud pa bdun ldan gi nang tshan sangs rgyas gnyan ston chen po'i sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan rin po che gzhen nu blo gros kyi bzhugs khri'i thog tu bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i ring lugs rgya cher spel ba'i ched du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por rigs kyi sras stong phrag tsam yod na'ang thu bor gyur pa rgyal sar dbang bskur ba bzhin dam pa'i (33na〉byas kyi rgyal tshab chen por khyab bdag bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mnga' gsol bar mdzad nas shis pa brjod pa'i me tog char chen po phyogs kun tu bsnyil/ de'i tshe gtsang sdo srid/ sdo pa yar stod pa/ bkra shis rtse gsum na bsko 'ja'/ grwa rigs sbyin bdag rnams kyisalegs skyes rgya cher bstod/ ljags bsngo gsung dpangs mtho zhing snyan la brjod bya rjod byed kyi don phun sum tshogs pas de 'khor thams cad dag 'a mgu yi rang gi sar bkod/ rje rdo rje 'chang gtsang —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāyophyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bskyod na'ang dam pa 'di nyid kyis grwa sa'i khur bzhes so ba'i btags ming tsam ma yin par sgrub mchod dang bskang ba gtor sgrub sogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon rje bla ma'i dus ji lta ba'i phyag len phra rags mtha' dag la thugs zhib cing 'phyugs med kyi dag ther kho na bstar ba ma gtogs 'jig rten bya ba gtso bor bzung ste gal chung chos su smra ba'i thebs chag ye mi gnang bas rje bla ma kun spangs mdzad par grwa rigs rnams mya ngan gyi mes yid gdungs pa'ang dam pa 'di'i mdzad pa'i char chen pos bsil bas gsos sman bla na med par gyur to/ /ches btsun 'od gsal lha yi gdung ma 'chol/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i byin rlabs rgyun ma chad/ /bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor lhag bsam mthu ma nyams/ /rgyal sras slob mar sprul ba'i mtha' ma rdzogs/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i grong du bde chen klong / /gzims la tshad med lha mos yongs bskul mthus/ /zhing 'dir mtshan dpe'i zlos gar mngon sum du/ /gsal 'di yid can legs byas bye (33ba thas nyos/ /na tshod gzhen nus phal spyod glang po'i mche/ /phyungs te dam pa'i rnam thar mdongs mtha' la/ /zhen nas rgyal bstan mtho ris mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /gdong drug gnyis pa'i lha gzhan gang du rnyed/ /srid pa chu srin 'byung gnas sdug bsngal rlabs/ /mi yol mtshang rig myang 'das gru rdzings kyis/ /gtan bde'i nor bu len la legs zhugs pa'i/ /nyes med dang po'i phun tsho gos chog rdzogs/ /sal mngon sum gnas pa'i 'og min zhing / /sa chen brgyud pa rim byon gzhal med khang / /sa steng zla bral sku gsung thugs rten rnams/ /sa skya bstan 'dzin khyod kyi gzigs mor mtshar/ /tshar chen gdung chos mi tri yab sras kyi/ /mtha' klas snyan brgyud bka' babs kun tu dga'/ /lam bzang ston la spobs pa lhun grub rje/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs pad yun du bsnyen/ /mchog gi gdul byar gdams pa gsang chen lam/ /slob bshad bkra shis chos kyi 'dus sde'i khrir/ /yab gcig bla mas bstan pa'i bdag po sa /mnga' gsol grags snyan tshangs pa'i yul sar bsgrags/ /'di nas bzung lcags sprel bar phal cher bkra shis chos sde nyid du bzhugs nas chos sde'i 'dzin —290

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)skyong spel gsum bca' ba chos khrims/ nang gi grwa rigs dang phyogs 'dus kyi chos don du gnyer ba rnams la dbang / byin rlabs/ rjes gnang / rig gtad/ nyams khrid/ lung man ngag /phyag khrid sogs blo dang 'tsham pa'i re ba skong zhing sbyin bdag skya ser gyis mtshon pa'i skye bo mchog dman bar pa rnams la'ang rkyen sel gyi byin rlabs(34na)rjes gnang / yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims dang yig drug gi bzlas lung sogs gang la gang 'tsham gyi sgo nas mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi sa bon khyad par can bskrun/ bar 'tshams mang por zla sbrel du rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma sogs dkyil 'khor 'ga' dang lha bran du ma'i ljags bsnyen/ bcu cha'i sbyin sreg gis mtshon phra zhib phyag len bzhin thugs nyams su bstar/ sku mtshams min pa'i skabs kyang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes bzlas brjod gtor bsngos sogs mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi thugs dam la lhod pa cung zad tsam yang mi mnga' zhing shi gson gyi ched du bdog pa 'bul bar thugs brtse ba chen pos kun nas blangs pa'i nad gdon las grol ba dang dus kyi chos nyid du gyur ba rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'phrang ring po las bsgral te nges par legs pa'i sar bkri ba'i skyabs 'jug ched du gsol bar rigs drug gnas 'dren sogs gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga rgyud sde rin po che las ji ltar byung ba bzhin ma gtogs sla chos kyi rigs mi mdzad/ dngos po rnams kyang dkon cog la sri zhu/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ nyam thag la sbyin gtong sogs rnam dkar gyi ched kho nar 'gro ba'i zhal ta dang mdor na mgon po byams pas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'am da dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa ste/ /spyod pa 'di brgya'i bdag nyid kyi/ /bsod nams phung po gzhal du med/ /ces chos spyod bcu'i (34ba)bya ba lhur mdzad pas yar stod smad shar nub kyis mtshon pa'i lho byang gi skye rgu phyogs 'dzin drag po'i gdon gyis ma zin pa mtha' dag dad pa'i sa la 'god bzhin pa'i ngang nas gtsang phyogs su bteg /lcags sprel khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan mjal bar phebs pa'i tshe gur mgon gyi gsang —291—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)'khrid zla ba gsum gyi bar smin rgyas dang / g.yin yang zab chos mang po lcags bya zhabs phyir bzhugs mu nas klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs du ma dang lhan cig tu gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos rgya cher gsan/ gtsang sde srid nas rje rdo rje 'chang zha lu ri phug gi dbu mdzad chen mor bskyar bskos grub nas sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi dbang gis thugs kyi bum bzang gtams nas ston bkra shis rtse chos sder phebs zla shas kyi bar bzhugs nas gtsang du chibs kha bskyod/ bla ma dgon pa sgye lung pas rdo rje 'chang skye bdun sgrub par gdan drangs pa'i phyag phyi mdzad/ yang 'ug gis gtsos pa'i sngags pa mang por bka' brgyad sgrub dbang gnang ba dang lhan du gsan/rje rdo rje 'chang la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bslab ston zhu ba gnang bar 'di tshor las slob gsang ston kha skong sogs cha tshang bsgrig dka' bar 'dug pas ngor du bsnyen rdzogs kyi grwa bzang bas 'gab tshul phebs pa ltar rnga chen zhes pa chu khyi'i lo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ge tshes bdun la sku bltams shing tshes bco lngar mngon par byang chub pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus chen khyad par can 'byung ba'i sa ga'am nam mthong (35na)zla ba sngon mar grags pa gza' skar sbyor byed phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs yon tan rin po che ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po mnga' zhing brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bcas pa phra mo las kyang mi 'da' bas tshul khrims kyi dri bsung phyogs brgyar khyab pas 'phags pa nye ba 'khor sa 'dir 'phos pa lta bu don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mkhan po/ sngon rje mnga' bdag gi dus rgyal po'i bla sman stod na bi ji cher rje 'ug pu gsum/bar na mi nyag brang ti g.yu thog gsum/ smad na gnya' dang mtha' bzhi stong dang gsum ste dgu'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa brang ti'i rigs las mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug thar pa rtse pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas pas las kyi slob dpon/ dpal ldan sa skya'i shar nub gung gsum du grags pa'i —292

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs bstan 'dzin rim par byon pa'i dbon gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa shes rab 'byung gnas pas gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon/dus bsgo ba sgrub khang mnga' ris pa nam mkha' dpal ldan sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i las chog gi phyag bzhes sla chos dang rung mthun (35ba tshe sbyar ba tsam ma yin pa'i phra zhib kyi rgyun bzang po mdzad bzhin pa'i steng nas bstan par zhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po rnam dag tu gyur nas nyes lhung gi dri mas ma gos pa gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur cing 'di nas bzung ji srid par lus ngag gi sdom pa las cung zad kyang mi g.yo bas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung mgur las/ thub dbang dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' legs pa'i zhabs las/ so thar sdom pa thob pa nyams su legs par blangs nas/ /nyes lhung dri mas ma gos ngo lkog med par bsrungs pas/ /btsun pa tshogs pa'i khrod 'dir mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug skyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang mthun no/ /bla ma dam pa 'di gsum la zab rgyas kyi chos snga phyir gsan pa cher long tsam 'dir phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa la mkhan chen sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyi drung du 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ me tog phreng rgyus/ sum brgya pa/ 'grel pa 'od ldan/ kun mkhyen bu'i las chog /ngor du grags che ba'i mdo chung bcu bdun/ rdor gcod/ sdud pa/ sman mdo brgyad brgya pa/ mkhan po'i mdo chog /byams chos sde lnga/ spyod 'jug rnams kyi lung / kye rdor ḍom+bhi/ mtsho skyes/ nag po lugs/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga/gur rigs bsdus/ sa sbu ṭi'i rdor dbyings/ bde mchog lo nag dril gsum/ 'jigs byed sa lugs dang rwa lugs/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma/ rigs byed ma lha lnga/ phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa (36na tsher jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ rigs gsum spyi/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu /tshe dpag med dze tā ri lugs rnams kyi dbang dang de rnams kyi mngon dkyil kha shas/ ḍom+bhi pa'i bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i 'od sogs kye rdor gyi rgya gzhud mang tsam/ jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ thogs —293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6te/med bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung / rje thar pa rtse ba'i drung du gsar ma rgyud 'bum/ 'phreng bskor gsum/mngon dkyil gyi cho ga thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang lung bcas/gdong drug gi dbang dang yig sna kha shas/ ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i yig sna/ kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa 'a bka' 'bum/ gnubs lugs stag 'on gnyeji/trag /dzam dkar gsum gyi rjes gnang / rje shar pa sher 'byung ba'i drung du kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi rgyu dbang / lam dbang /bde mchog bong zhal can dang tshe dpag med lha dgu gnyis kyi dbang / dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi 'jam dbyangs/ pha dam pa'i 'jam dbyangs/ chag lugs tshe dpag med dkar po/ klu dbang rgyal po/ u tsa ya/ sme brtsegs ljang nag /khyung nag /dbyangs can ma dkar dmar/ rnam 'joms mthing kha/ seng gdong ma sngo dmar rnams kyi rjes gnang dang yi ge'i lung kha yar rnams gsan no/ /gsol bzhi'i cho ga ma la ya klung nas/ /bag yod khrims kyi dri bsung rab 'thul ba'i/ /'dul 'dzin tsan+dan sdong po dar drag pas/ /phra rgyas tsha gdung bcil ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /rang (36ba)rgyud zhi byed 'phags bod sdom pa'i chab/ rtsing spyod dug bral nyon mongs nad brgya'i sman/ /rgyal kun dgyes pa'i mchod sprin thun 'tshams gos/ /'chang ba'i tshul la mi smon shes ldan su/ /thub pas lung bstan rje btsun e waṃ pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i byed po 'gas/ /nges gsang chos sgo brgya phrag phye ba'i tshe/ /snaṇ+ḍi ya na sa 'dir 'phos pa bzhin/ /rim gnyis chang gis myos pa'i bde stong zung / /'jug pa'i mdza' mor rtse dgas rtag rol yang / /lus ngag sdom la phyi nang med brtson pa'i/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rtsa bar da gdod 'khums/ /zha lur phebs/ chu phag gi dgun stod bar zham 'bring du bsnyen te mkhan chen sgrub khang pa byon pa'i dpon slob gnyis kur thos bsam mang du mdzad/ rdo rje 'chung dgung lo re lngar phebs shing dbus gtsang gi bar sa khad 'gyangs par ma zad 'dar gyi mkhan po gnang gshis sku na dang bcas 'grul bskyod gnang stabs ma bde ba'i mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros gyi gdung zhugs 'bul dang rten bzhengs sogs bslab ston rgyas par stsal nas dbus su byon/—294

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du rje btsun gzhen nu blo gros kyi sku pur dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bzhugs su phul ba'i tshe sngar nged kyi bur su la'ang ma ston gsung ba'i zhal chems yod pa la dpags grwa dmangs tshos go med kyis mdzad dka' zhus rdugs tshogs pa rnams gdugs rol cha sogs mchod rdzas kyi phyag mtshan dang bcas (37na)gsung chog ma tshar bar gtsug lag khang la ser sbreng gi skor ba dang pur khang gi steng thog tu gdugs dang g.yas g.yon du bkra shis khra ring btang nyid sbyangs zin nas zhag shas bar rgyas btab pa zhal phye nas/ gdung rten bzheng bar bal po mkhas pa mi grangs bcu gcig 'bod pa gnang ba'i gser zangs kyi rnam rgyal mchod rten zla gnyis khongs su grub par dri med kyi srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga /ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi'i gzungs 'bul dngos gtsang ba rten bzhengs so'i snyan grags lhur blangs pa ma yin pa'i khungs btsun pa'i yid ches su gyur par bcom ldan 'das dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga nyin gnyis ma'i sgo nas dam tshig pa la ye shes kyi tshogs dngos su bcug pas lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i slad du 'ja' tshon tsho sna lnga'i gur dang me tog gi char/ rgya spos bzang po'i dar kyis sgrun du med pa'i dri bzang pas phyogs kun tu khyab pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ya mtshan pa byung ba ni/rje btsun bla ma rim par byon pa mtha' dag la dad pa sngar ma skyes pa rnams gsar du skye zhing / skyes pa'i tshogs gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i thabs khyad par can te/ mkhas mchog dpa' bos/ grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ /bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur/ /yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par byed/ /chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/
