/zhes pa'i don du mngon zhing / sde pa bkra shis rtse bas gsung ngag brgyud pa'i zhal thang (37ba)thog tshad ma skya ris grub cing tshon 'go tshugs tsam la lus par kha skong cung zad dang bcas grangs sum cu tham pa gong gsham zhal khebs tog ldan legs par bsgrubs par kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab tu gnas pa rgyas par gnang / de nas gsung ngag brgyud pa'i —295

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo te/ zhal thang gra tshar bsnams te gtsang du thegs pa'i lam nas ngor du mkhan chen dpal ldan don grub/brang ti pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas gsum dang mjal zhing bris thang la phyag nas zhu ba mdzad/ rim gyis 'dar stod bla ma'i gdan sar phebs/ rje rdo rje 'chang la phyi nang phyag rdzas yod dgu lta bu'i 'bul chen dang bcas gsung ngag brgyud par dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'jug pa'i phyag nas zhus/ de nas bdag tshe dad sgrub pa mnyam pa'i bug sgo 'dam sbyar byas chog pa'i gsol pa btab par/ khyod kyi sgom sgrub gcig pu mdzad pas ga la khyab/ thos bsam 'chad nyan bya ba las kyi 'khor lo sogs tshang ma mdzad na bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher 'grub tshul bslab bya lung bstan gyi tshul du gnang bar brten bla ma dam pas ji ltar bka' stsal ba bzhin snying stobs kyi mthu phul du byung ba'i dam bca' brtan pos de ltar bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i nor bu gzhon nu'i dus/ /blo gros gdengs ga'i rtse mor gzi 'bar bas/ /mkhas btsun grub mchog klu yi dbang po'i gdung / /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ji bzhin sri zhung bskrun/ /rab mdzes sa zla'i 'od 'phro mchod sdong che/ /rab tu brtson pa'i mthu (38na7sa nyer bstar tshe/ /rab 'byams rgyal kun bzhu blugs kyis bstim pas/ /rab yangs mkha' la ngo mtshar gzigs mor che/ /thugs gsang dpal gyi be'ur dbang gi chu/ /ma nub g.yas su 'khyil ba brgyud pa'i 'phreng / /snang srid ri mor 'bri la zla med pas/ /bskrun tshe sgyu ma'i khengs pa thung ngur byas/ /dregs ldan laṅka'i stobasalas mi 'jigs pa'i/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i nyag phran rtsal che yang / /yongs 'dzin ra gu'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i khur khyer dga' byed lha/ /shing pho bya ba'i lo 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng shes dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por chos kyi rgyal po zla ba bzang po la dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa bka' stsal ba'i dus nag pa zla ba'i gza' tshes dus sbyor bzang bar dbu btsugs zla ba brgyad la nye ba'i bar lam mthun mong ba snang ba gsum sems bskyed chen mo/ rgyu dbang / lta ba 'khor —296

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)'das dbyer med/ phyi skyed pa'i rim pa'i 'khrid/ lam dbang / nang lus kyi bskyed rim/ lam/ lta ba/grub mtha'/ 'da' ka ma/ bar do/ rmi lam/ sgyu lus/ dbang phyi ma gsum gyi 'khrid/ rdo rje bdag med ma lha bco lnga'i dbang / lam zab/ bir srung phyi nang / sgrub pa lung sbyin gyis mtha' brten pa la de dag la dgos pa'i so so'i skabs kyi rgyab brten lung dang bcas pa gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad tshad ma bzhi ldan rjes 'brang gi mkhas grub phal cher la ma grags pa'i snyan nas snyan du (38ba)brgyud pa'i zhal shes kyis brgyan te rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis dbu mdzad snod ldan gyi slob ma nyi shu rtsa gsum la smin rgyas su stsal bas rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las/ dus da res dam chos sgor zhugs kyang / /chos tshogs bshad sbun pas g.yengs pa'i tshe/ /rje khyod kyi thugs kyi rgya mtsho las lam zab mo snyan brgyud rin cen stsal/ da khyed kyi byin rlabs kho na yis/ /bdag rtse gcig dam chos sgrub 'dod shar/ /tshe 'di phyir skyid pa'i gtan brling khel/ /chos zab zab gzhan la sems ma shor/ /don snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bdud rtsis myos/ /lar shi yang mi 'gyod gdengs shig thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang snga phyir zab cing rgya che ba'i chos mtha' klas pa gsan pa'i rags rim tsam 'dir bsdo mes te brjod na/ dus 'khor/ bde mchog /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ yang dag mar me dgu pa/ ma hā mā ya/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ phag mo lha so bdun/ bcu gsum/ lha lnga ma/ klu sgrub lugs kyi phyag rdor gtum chen lha nyer gcig pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ dgra nag zhang lugs/gtsug tor dri med/ 'od zer dri med/ gdugs dkar lha zhe gcig /rnam 'joms ma ṇi ka lha bcu dgu /dkar po sa ba ri lugs lha bco lnga/ 'chi med rnga sgra/ mgon po sngon 'byung gi le'u nga gnyis pa nas bshad pa'i mgon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu drug pa yum lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ dze tā ri'i tshe dpag med rnams kyi dbang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang byin rlabs(39na)spros med kyi 'khrid/ de dang 'brel ba'i yig sna/ bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs dang 'khrid/ rwa lugs 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/—297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dpa' bo gcig pa phyag mtshan gyis bskor ba'i dbang /dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang /sngags btu/rwa 'khrid/rnal 'byor bzhi'i 'khrid/las gshin dpa' gcig/bcu gsum ma/khrag mdog dmar po/brtse bya bzhi bskor rnams kyi rjes gnang /grub rgyal lha gcig bum gcig/rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs dang 'ba' ra lugs kyi nyams 'khrid/chag lugs tshe dpag med dkar po/'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/'jam dpal yon tan ye shes bzang po/ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar/'jam nag/skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/phyag rdor u tsarla me dbang yod med gnyis/'byung 'dul me dbang yod med gnyis/gos sngon can/ba ri lugs kyi rnam 'joms/rnam rgyal lha dgu/gtsug tor 'bar ba/sman bla bde gshegs bdun/sna tsho gos yum/khyung khra/song 'brang /'od zer can ma/lo ma rgya ne ma/migayo ba sngon po/gtum po dkar po/sme brtsegs lugs gnyis/khro mo sme brtsegs/rta mgrin ras chung dang /zla rgyal lugs kyi lcags ral can/seng gdong ma/sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/seng ldeng nags sgrol rnams kyi rjes gnang de dang 'brel ba'i yig sna'i lung /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs rje btsun yab dang 39ba ) thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rtsa dbu ma'i nyams 'khrid/in+d+ra mkha' spyod dang /mi tri mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/de rnams kyi chos skor gyi lung /rje btsun rigs byed ma'i thung mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang /snga ra lha lnga'i byin rlabs/tshogs bdag gi byin rlabs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa khyad par ba'i rjes gnang /'dod rgyal gyi 'dod pa lha dang gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang /dmar chung skor gsum/gser chos dzam dmar dang bzhi'i rjes gnang /de dag rnams dang 'brel pa'i las rab 'byams skor gyi lung /gur mgon gri gug lha lnga/lha brgyad/lha bcu gnyis/lha bstobadun// ra la brten pa'i dbang /sgrub thabs kun 'a yig btusapa'i mgon rkyang /mgon po lha gsum ma/lha brgyad ma dang /lha bcu gnyis ma gnyis la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa re/mgon po khro bcu/gsang 'khrid/dud sol ma'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/zangs gri can phyi nang /pu tra ming srid/bran bdud gshin rje nag po rnams kyi rjes gnang /brag rdzong ma 298

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)phyi nang gsang gsum/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gyi nyams 'khrid/ me 'bar glegs bam/ kha skong / gyi ljang / snyan brgyud/ dud sol po ti rnams kyi lung mgon po zhal bsnyen pa sgrub dus thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ gdong brnyan can/ las bzhi'i mgon po/ gsang 'khrid/ shi sa bstan pa/ bram ze'i mngag gtad/ khyung zhal can/ seng ge nag po rnams kyi rjes(40na skonang / tshe sgrub srung 'khor ma dang /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i nyams 'khrid/ be'u bum yongs rdzogs/ gnod sbyin beg tse'i rjesaganang dang lung / tshar chen gyi bka' 'bum/ rnam sras ser chen sogs rigs gsum tsam/ phyag bzhi pa/ beng dmar/ legs ldan mched gsum/ dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud/ rdo rje rab brtan ma/ dmag zor ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang chen nyang gi gter ma'i drag dmar rdo rje spyi blugs kyi dbang dang chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi lung / gter mgon phyag bzhi ba'i dbang / bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi sgrub dbang dang 'gyogs dbang / phur pa spu gri'i dbang dang chos skor rnams kyi lung / 'khor ba dong sprug /nā ga ra ka'i dbang / ma ning dang bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi srog dbang / jo mo'i nyams len skor dgu'i lung / gnubs lugs 'char ka 'jomasabyed 'bar ba dang / stag zhen gyi dbang stag pod kyi lung / grwa pa'i dzam dmar/ byang gter thugasasgrub rnam gsum/ tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang rnams kyi dbang / e ka dza tī/ re ma tī/ thang lha/rdor legs bzhi'i srog dbang de rnams dang 'brel ba'i yig sna thor bu'i lung / pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa/ rdzong chung tshe dbang dang bcas pa rta pod yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung / rat+na gling pa'i phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi dbang / pad+ma gling pa'i tshe dpag med rdo rje 'phreng (40ba tha dang drag dmar gyi dbang chen/ rnam sras mdung dmar can/ phyag rdor dregs 'dul/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rtsa gsum rnams kyi dbang / rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi rtsa dbang sgos dbang dang thor bu/ tshe dpag med ye shes 'od mchog /drag po dbu dgu rnams kyi dbang dang chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi lung / rin cen gling pa'i nā ga ra ka'i byin rlabs/ o rgyan gling pa'i stag zhen gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ gsang 'dus—299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yomi bskyod rdo rje'i rim lnga'i nyams 'khrid thugs rje chen po chem bu lugs/ blo stong don bdun ma/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong rnams kyi 'khrid/ rje thang stong pa'i tshe dpag med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang sogs zab rgyas kyi chos ji snyed pa gsan pa de dag kyang gsan pa tsam ma yin pa'i sngags gsar rnying / rgyud sde phyi nang gis gtsos par so so'i lugs kyi gnad 'gag mtha' dag thugs su chud par mdzad/ khyad par gsung ngag /gser chos bcu gsum/ mgon po che chung sogs 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i yab chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi zhal shes man ngag yi ger ma 'khod pa dang yi ge tsam gyis rtogs mi nus pa thams cad la phyag len dmar 'khrid mdzub btsugs su zhib mor dpyad pas the tshom cung zad kyang mi dgos par 'di ni 'di'o zhes thugs kyis bskyud pa ni nam yang mi mnga'/ chos phyir dka' spyad byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rjes su 'gro zhing / ji skad du/ sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs can/ /(41na〉〉nga bu min pas sbrang rtsi'i bcud ma myong / /gzhung lugs smra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po min pas shes bya'i bcud ma myong / /zhes 'jams dbyangs sa paṇa gyi gsung ltar rje bla ma la slob ma skar tshogs ltar mang na yang snyan brgyud gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs kyi nying khu bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan pa ni bla ma dam pa 'di nyid dang / de dang cha mthun pa ni glang phu nas chos rje tsam du mngon/ 'dar grang mo cher kha'u brag rdzong pa'i lugs srol thun mong ma yin pa'i shing rta'i srol phye nas 'dzin par mdzad pa'i rje btsun brtse ba chen po'i rnam sprul bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ grub pa'i dbang phyug bram ze mchog sred kyi zlos gar rje btsun rdo ring pa wo po/ mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug sgo rum pa chen po/ ma byon sa rgyas gsum pa kha che paṇa chen gyi rnam sprul tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'phags mchog shā ri'i bu'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i ded dpon mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ grub chen ku ku ri ba'i yang srid khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan rnams kyi bris sku bzhengs pa rdo rje 'chang la phyag nas zhu ba gnang / myug bkra shis rgyal khang gi gtsug lag khang du thams—300

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phrong / 6)cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis zhal bkod dang sbyin bdag sde pa gnas gsar bas mdzad pa'i gsung ngag bla ma brgyud rim sman sku mda' tshad ma zhe mtshungs bzhengs nas bzhugs (41ba)pa dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis zha lur gdan drangs/ de nas rim gyis cho me 'khor yang rtser phebs pa'i kha skongs mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/rje rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gsum bzhengs te grang mo cher lam 'bras lha khang gi zhal bkod sogs bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan rnams la rdo rje 'chang gis rab tu gnas par mdzad de ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung zhing lha mchod mi mchod kyi dga' ston rgya cher gnang / rje bla ma'ang dgyes pa'i rtser son no/ /dbus 'gyur mkhas btsun rtser son chos skyong zhabs/ /bdag med rdo rje btsun mos rjes bzung mthus/ /tshe gcig zung 'jug sku bzhi mngon gyur pas/ /grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba bi rū pa/ /gang gi thugs bcud gsang chen dbyar skyes sgra/ /thos pas 'phags bod skal bzang rma bya kun/ /bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa la grub pa'i mtha'/ /rab snyog mngal khur 'dzin la gcig tu brel/ /phyogs re tsam min thub bstan yongs rdzogs chos/ /tshogs slob bshad srol bzhed pa ches mang ba'i/ /snying po'i yang shun snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /snod ldan legs bris las gzhan skal ba phra/ /rin cen sgang dang rgyal tsha lung mang po'i/ /gdung rigs rim byon zhal brgyud gser gyi chos/ /mgon zung man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can/ /'dzin khyod zla med nam mkha'i zla ba 'dra/ /rgyud sde'i thig le kun bsdus lung rtogs bzhin/ /mthong mod (42na ye blo sgam tshangs pa'i yid 'phrog tshe/ /lha rnams ba spu ldang bar chun po'i thod/ /me tog 'dab ma 'dzum dbus ge sar rgod /tshogs gnyis sdong po dar drag a mra'i ljon/ /thos bsam 'bras bu'i ro bda' smin pa'i zhar/ /bya ba las kyi grib mar skye rgu kun/ /bde ba'i ngal gso bsod nams gzugs can bzhin/ /de nas slar bsti gnas yang klungs bkra shis rtser phebs/ chos sde lcags stag btab pa nas lo so drug las ma song yang bar skabs su sde pa dngos —301—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6te/grub rdo rje bsam sdings nas dben bcos pa'i grub mtha'i 'dzin stangs gzhan du gzhol ba'i bstan sel chen po'i rkyen gyis chog grwa sogs mang ba ma tshugs pa da lam gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kye rdor man ngag lugs/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ gur rigs bsdus/ rdo rje sgrol ma/ ku ru kul+le/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lug bcadang ye shes kha zhababa'i lugs/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ ma rgyud lo nag gnyis/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ sam+bha ṭi/ gur lha brgyad/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ kun rig /bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu /dze tā ri'i tshe dpag med/ 'od zer can ma rnams dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ rnam rgyal stong mchod rnams kyi cho ga nag 'gros su bkod nas 'dzugs pa'i sta gon du rgyugs bzhes/ rnam bcad dang po sa chog /gnyis (42ba)pa sta gon/ gsum pa sgrub mchod dngos rnams la dgos pa'i gar thig dbyangs gsum phyag len che phra mtha' dag sku ngos kyi phyag khrid du mdzad/ dkyil 'khor so so'i dbang lung / rnam rgyal ma'i rjes gnang rnams nas dbang cha grangs su bcad par shin tu 'grus shing dngos gtsang ba'i sgo nas rgyas par bstar/me yos hor zla dang po'i cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus chog grwa rnams btsugs te 'dzugs ston dang bsnyen bkur sogs lha mchod mi mchod lhag par rgya che bar spel/ lo phyi ma rnams su rgyun mi nyams par bya ba'i slad du sgrub mchod thebs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar bas mtshon gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che srid mtha'i bar du nyams pa med pa'i thabs tshul 'di ni/ rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rin po che/ byams pa'i rnam sprul bdag po kun bzang 'phags/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa dang gsum gyi mdzad pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gnas che ba zhig tu snang / 'phags pa gang pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpas ma thos chos/ /thos na don du tshul bsam bya'i/ /bdag gis sngon chad ma thos zhes/ /de skad du ni smra mi bya/ /ma thos chos ni thos gyur na/ /yang dag dran pas sems byed na/ /rgya mtshor 'bab chu shong ba bzhin/ /de phyir shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes dam pa rnams —302

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)ni thos pas nam yang mi ngoms pas sngon chad gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad na'ang de tsam gyi kho bos mang du thos so snyam pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi chog shes shing 'dod yon la skom (43na)pa ba mo'i chu bzhin ngoms pa med par byed pa'i bshes gnyen du rloms pa du ma dang phyogs tsam yang mi 'dra bar bod 'dir chos rgyun yod pa rnams mi nub pa thugs la brnag pa yang / rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las/ steng nas gnam rdeb 'og nas sarba ba kyang / /bod 'dir yod pa'i lam bzang zhakhrul med rnams/ /ma lus len pa'i brtson 'grus mi rtsom ri/ /zhes pa'i don ltar yin cing / 'o skol gyi ston pa slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su chos tshigs bcad gcig gi ched du sku lus la lcags gzer stong btab pa dang / rgya bod kyi paṇa grub mang pos chos phyir lus srog thed la bor ba'i rnam par thar pa la rjes su 'jug pas rje rdo rje 'chang la chos 'phro don du gnyer bar ma zad sku na smin pa la sri zhu'i slad du sa 'brug gtsang la chibs bskyod pa'i zhar du rje mar pa lo tsā'i dngos slob rngog chos sku rdo rje nas bzung mkhas pa dang grub pa'i bla ma zam ma chad pa byung ba'i gdung las byon cing rigs tsam lhur len pa ma yin pa'i yab sras chos mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa rngeg ston 'jam dbyangs 'od zer gyi zhabs kyi rdul dmar dbu'i gtsug tor du bsten nas/ dgyes rdor lha dgu /bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ rdo rje gur lha zhe dgu /rnal 'byor nam mkha' lha dgu bcu rtsa bdun/ gdan bzhi yum bka' lha bcu gsum/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lnga/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan lha nga gsum ma ste rngog dkyil bdun gyi dbang (43ba〉pan ngag gi yi ge 'ga' zhig 'khrid bcas/ mi tri pa'i phyag yig dgu phrugs kyi byin rlabs/ dud sol ma'i gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / gter ston nyi zla sangs rgyas kyi 'pho ba 'jag chugs ma/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i byin rlabs rnams gsan/ rim gyis 'dar du rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs drung du phebs nas dbang chos ci rigs gsan/lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi rigs dbon bka' gdams kyi bstan 'dzin chen por ma zad phyis su kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan srog —303—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo te/mthud pa'i mkhas grub kyi snyan pas gdan sa gong 'og gnyis kyi rigs kyi bdag por bzhes te/gtsang phyogs su lan kha yar phebs pa'i skabs shig dam pa 'di dang gdan 'dzom nas bka' gdams lha bzhi'i 'khrid/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ mi'u thung gsod byed/ zhad blon dang bzhi'i rjes gnang / de dag gi yig cha thor bu'i lung sogs kha yar gsan cing / slar yang bka' gdams sogs ma gsan pa'i rigs la thugs rtsol gnang bzhed che zhing zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol yang spyan snga rin po cher bka' gdams skor gsan ma thub pa la thugs 'gyod che zhing kho bo'ang de ltar sems mod kyang yid srubs brlang spyod kyi lhongs chen pos gnas nges med du gshegs pa'i 'o brgyal ba'i chos gegs su gyur te bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs bzhed ji bzhin byung ma song / kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho dbyangs can mas rjes su (44na〉bzung nas shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la chags thogs mi mnga' zhing khyad par gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad kyi skor la rtsal du bton pa'i bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi ring lugs srol 'dzin bla na med pa yin rung /sku'i skye ba klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan du grags pa sprul sku kun snying par thugs dad de log pa'i bshes kyi mthus rang bstan spel ba'i gong ma'i rnam thar ma 'khyongs kyang ma nas mdo sngags kyi gsan pa rgya cher mdzad cing / khyad par sprul pa'i sku mnga' ris pa chen po dang khri srong rnam sprul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis gtsos dam pa du ma'i zhal slob/ bla chen sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po yongs 'dzin du bsten pas sngags rnying ma'i phyogs la gsan rgya che gshis snga 'gyur gtso bor bton pa'i zab chos mang du gsan pa ni byang gter rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi chos skor/ gter ston gyi rnam thar/ thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi dbang lung / rdzogs pa chen po rang byung rang shar gyi nyams 'khrid lung bcas/ bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar gyi chos skor/ phur pa che mchog dang drag sngags gnyis kyi dbang / lugs gsum ga'i lung / lha chen stobs 'dul gyi chos skor/ stag zhen gyi chos skor bka' gter/ zhal chems lung bstan gyi skor/ rdor legs kyi srog dbang lung bcas/ gter ston bal po a hung gi dzam la nag —304

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (na)po'i chos skor/ sprul sku tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi dbang lung / yang (44ba)gsang ya ka me dbal dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa'i dbang lung / gzhan yang las phran thor bu/ kun skyong gling pa'i rdor sems snying tig gi chos skor/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang lung /pad+ma gling pa'i tshe dpag med rdor phreng gi chos skor gyi lung / phyag rdor dregs 'dul gyi chos skor/ gu ru drag dmar thems med kyi skor/ rat+na'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus kyi chos skor nas thor bu/ bstan gnyis gling pa pad+ma tshe dbang rgyal po'i 'jam dpal gshin rje drag sngags kun 'dus kyi dbang lung la sogs pas thugs rgyud yongs su gtam/rje 'di nyid/ glang phu chos rje/ zha lu mkhan rin po che gsum zha lu ri phug dang 'dar du snga phyir rdo rjes 'chang gi sku zhabs su chabs cig par bzhugs nas dam pa'i chos kyi gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad pa'i dus khyed gsum rdo rje'i mched po zla med pa yin pas dbon gyis sa lugs/ glang phu rje drung gis rnying lugs/ sman khang nas kyis bu lugs rnams gtso bor btan pa'i thos bsam byas pa sogs chos rgyun gcig la med pa rnams gcig gis bsabs pa'i nyan bshad byed dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar glang phu nas chos rje rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug zhal ngo gong ma rnams kyi dus nas kha'u skyes lhas pa'i ring lugs la dbang rnon chos rjes 'brang ba'i dad pa brtan pos sbyin bdag lhur len pa'i rgyun dang chos rje nyid sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po 'gran zla med pas chos gsan pa'i yul du gyur pa nas thog mar chos 'brel ci rigs gsan cing rting sor gsan pa (45na)rags rim smos na bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi chos skor nas nyer mkho dang ga me gling pa'i zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol nas thor bu'i lung / bstan gnyis gling pa'i rdzogs chen klong gsal snyan brgyud kyi cho ge skor/ 'od gsal thig le nyag gcig gi chos skor/ phag mo zab rgya'i chos skor/ dpyal phur gyi dbang lung / klong chen pa'i bla ma yang tig dang zab mo yang tig gnyis kyi lung sogs mang du gsan/rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yang srid zha lu mkhan —305—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6te/chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub la rje bla mas tshig bkra'i khyad nas phun tshogs dngos grub ma'i lung zhus phebs pa ltar dang rdor dbyings kyi dbang gsan cing rjes sor rim gyis thugs rtsol gnang bar 'khor lo sdom chen / bde mchog /pad+ma dra ba/ dril bu lha lnga/ chos dbyings gsung dbang / dpal mchog rdor sems/ mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum/ phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ shākya seng ge gtsug tor dgu pa/ rnam snang mngon byang / phyag rdor 'gro bzad dang bcas pa'i dbang / rnam sras bka' mi 'dra ba bco lnga/ dzam la dmar po sogs rjes gnang dang lung gi rigs kha yar gsan/rje rdo rje 'chang dgung lo phebs par ma zad sku gtsong gis ma lcogs pa'i gtsang sde srid du dgongs khrol zhu ba mdzad pa grwa rigs sbyin bdag gi 'dod sbyar bzhin dbon rin po che nang bskos kyi bca' gzhi shar ba dkar po zhes pa sa sbrul gyi lo'i dus tshes dge bar rgyal ba kun (45bsko ngos tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i slob bshad 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro sgrog pa'i chos kyi khri chen por gdan sa gong dang gzhis ka rtse nas bsko 'ja'i gnang skyes 'dar nas sogs sbyin bdag grwa rigs rnams kyis 'bul 'gyed tsha ra'i thog rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dbang phyug rab brtan gyis bkra shis me tog gi char chen po phab nas mnga' gsol lo/ /lcags mo lug gi lo la stod lho nas sprul sku 'jam dbyangs pa zhes par thogs dbang po sman thang pa'i slob rgyun mkhas pa zhig bkug nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar zhing bkod thang kha gsum la tshang ba de zhor du gur mgon/ dud sol ma/ las gshin gsum gyi sku brnyan bzhengs te rdo rje 'chang la rab gnas zhu ba mdzad pa bris bkod phun sum tshogs pa byung zhes dgyes pa'i rtser son 'di gras lcags stag lo skyid 3|da gung thang du bzhugs yul gnang skabs/ gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa dang gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral gnyis zur kun mkhyen chen pos phyag bris gnang zhing beg tshe'i skya bris kyi dus zur chen gyi 'od gsal du dur khrod sogs kyi bkod pa sna tshogs byung ba mus srad pa'i thang rnying khungs btsun zhig gzigs 'dug pa de kho na ltar snang zhes thugs nges mdzad/—306

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / smyon)chu pho sprel lo gsol 'debs gnang bas rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur bar zhal gyis 'ches skabs gdan sa 'og gi bdag chen khri thog pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du mkhan rin po che ngag dbang chos grags kyis phreng ba gsan pa'i (46na tshe gnas tshul byung bar brten bdag rgan po'i dge sbyor bcag pa las rin po che ba sku na gzhen zhing mkhyen pa'i klong yangs pas der zhus shig pa'i skabs dbye ba bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i ched du grang mo che'i gtsang po byang kha bla brang rdzong du yongs rdzogs gnas lnga rigs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs drung nye bar bsnyen te rje btsun rdo rje btsun mo'i gnang ba thob par brten nas slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs kyis rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag spyi bka'i tshul du dgongs pa bkral ba phreng ba skor gsum mdzad pa dang phyogs mtshungs par slob dpon chen po da rlan ā tsarlas kṛ yas muñtsa mdzad pa gnyis kyi dbang gi chu bo sa bzang 'phags pa nas gcig tu 'dres pa rdo rje 'chang e waṃ pa kun dga' bzang po brgyud par bcas pa'i phyag bzhes nyams pa med pa phreng ba zhe lnga ma'i dbang / kun rig dang bsrung ba lnga'i dbang / sa skya pa chen po dang slob dpon rin po che'i bka' 'bum/ glang ri thang pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong gi rtsa ba rin po che rta ra ba'i rnam thar sngags 'chang nyid kyis mdzad pa sogs snga phyir chos mang du gsan no/ /grangs med 'gro ngor gcig la du ma'i gar/ /snang tshul rgyud sdebazhi yi ltar shar 'ga'/ /lo paṇa bzhed pa ma nor sgrub mchod srol/ /legs btod snying po'i ring lugs srog gi zungs/ /phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam la dbang bskur du/ /re ba'i dug bral nā ro mi tri yi/ /bzhed gzhung sman gyi chu bo arga'i rgyun/ /sbreng ba'i rngog ston a ga sdu yi spun/ /'gro kun bde ba'i dga' (46ba〉sdon la sbyar nas/ /'di phyi'i don gnyis yongs grub bka' gdams kyi/ /zab chos jo 'brom nying khu lha bzhi'i khrid/khyod thugs rin cen za ma tog tu bskyil/ /klu sgrub snyan grags g.yu dmar 'dab 'phreng rgyan/ /sgra 'dzin —307—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag nga bang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skamun pa'i mal nas slong ba la/ /bltos min snga 'gyur sgron me lam bzang gzugs/ /gzigs la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum tshar du dngar/ /'jam dbyangs 'khon ston chos tshul kun+da'i tshal/ /skyong la thos bsam sgom par dbang phyug zlas/ /mgon khyod mnyes byed theg mchog mchod pa'i sprin/ /kun bzang rnam par thar de ngal gsor 'gyur/ /mtha' klas rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod sgo/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i lde mig 'phrul po ches/ /'byed la phur bu'i blor 'gran zha lu pas/ /bzhed pa'i re bkang yongs 'du sa brtol bzhin/ /tshogs bshad gcan gzan dregs pa'i ngar skad ltar/ /rab gnon slob bu mchog la gdams bya'i 'khrid/ /'jigs med seng ge'i nga ro sgrog pa'i 'khrid/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas dbang bskur legs so byin/ /ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can ngang mo dkar/ /rab 'byams mkhyen pa'i thugs mtshor rtag rol bas/ /chos phung mgrin pa'i dril chung sgrog pa'i glu/ /len pa'i grags snyan srid pa'i rtse las brgal/ /mtha' yas 'gro khams dang 'tsham thub gsung don/ /'chad mkhas gtam gyi sbyor ba lag pa'i rjes/ /gtsug lag bye ba'i rtsig par legs bzhag pa'i/ /ri mo mig gsum pas kyang dbye nus min/ /rin cen sgang pa'i gdung brgyud rim byon gyi/ /rang bstan sa chen gyen du rab bteg pa'i/ /snying stobs khyab 'jug khengs 'phrog yongs 'dzin 'dis/ /yab rje bla ma'i bzhed pa ci yang bkang / /(47na)rje rdo rje 'chang gzhan snang du sku na cher smin cing spyan mi gsal ba sogs nas dpal di paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na dang 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po dpon slob kyi rnam thar bzhin yar klungs bkra shis chos ster phebs dgos sogs thugs brel gzhan rnams khyad du bsad de/ bla ma'i sri zhu zhi zham 'bring la gal che bar dgongs nas bcar bzhugs gnang ba'i lo sngon ma rnams su rdo rje /3chang gzhan don du gshegs grabs kha yang byung bar rje 'di nyid kyis gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs gnang bas zhal ngo ma bzlog par bzhugs shing khyad par pha dam pa lugs kyi 'chi med mgon po'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs 'bul ba gnang bas tshe gtor dgu 'dren sgang la bdud rtsir zhu ba sogs rtags mtshan legs par byung /—3//ci

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa 'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo ma/tshar dad pa'i rlabs 3phreng / rtonadachos sde'i grwa pa 'phyos pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho zer ba zhig la sems skyon ma chags rung rje bka' 'gyur pa dbus la phebs par yid gdungs nas rdo rje 'chang la da cha rdo'i ngos rang yin 'dug yang na ni sku khams gzhi med du gdangs na legs shing / de min zhing gak+ṣ-i na gshegs na zhes gleng mo btang ba byams pas snyan du gsol pa na kho bden dpon drung gis nan chags gsungs pa ma bzlog par bsdad pa ma gtogs sdod 'dod kyang med cing gzhan don mi nus pa'i lus 'di de ga rang du 'dug gsung chu bya tshes bcu zhig la rje bla ma phyi rol tu mngon pa'i snyun sogs ye med pa'i ngang nas drung chen byams pa bstan 'dzin par kho bo 'gro ba yin tshul gsungs pa byams pas rje nyid la zhus par brten drung du phebs shing nan tar gsol 'debs gnang bas zhal gyis bzhes te sku tshe byin gyis (47ba)brlabs nas lo gsum bzhugs pa'i bar mtshams su sku cung zad dwangs skabs tshor dbang rjes gnang 'khrid kyi rigs 'ga' gsan cing / rwa pod/ dpal 'dzin pod chung gis mtshon pa'i lung du ma spyan chab bcug nas gnang / snyan brgyud zhal bzhes gal che ba'i rigs sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin par bzhugs/ 'jam dbyangs rdo rjes dge slong rab 'dzin bsad pa'i rkyen gyis rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba shing phag hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du dgon pa'i don skor la gzhis ka rtser phebs de dus yar 'brog tu sog po a sa lang gi dam/ga rgyugs pas dbung sa/tsang thams cad zi chod de ba'i skabs dang 'grig pa'i gtsang sde srid nas sog bzlog la dmigs pa'i sku rim gnang dgos tshul phebs pa ltar mgon po khro bcu'i gtor bzlog mdzad/ rdzong gi gtor rgyag pa phal cher 'chams sogs spros bcas /lhur len cing gzigs mo'i khyad kyis cho ga rdzogs ma rdzogs la mi bltos par gcig rjes su gcig 'don pa zhig yod 'dug pa drung yig bde rgyas pa 'ongs nas don dgos tshul dang 'chams sogs ji tsam yod kyi dri ba byung bar rdo rje slob dpon gyi chas zhugs tsam las 'chams byed kyin med cho ga'ang nyin 'tsham/sa las mi grub 'dug gsungs pas g.yin tsho'i pad las dang ma mthun nga/sa dgongs pa la 'thad rgyu rang ma byung 'dug /'on kyang chos skyong bran du 'khol ba'i snyan grags la —30(3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)brten mthongs lcags rdzong du sku rim la rdzong bda' gnang ba'i phebs zhor nang so dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i jo jo thar pa'i gnyer pas gdan drangs kun mkhyen dpyal ba'i gdan sa thar pa dgon gyi rten brten pa rnams zhib mjal (48na)gyi tshe stag zhen yab yum gyi 'chams sku'i zhal ras las bdud rtsi babs/ lo lo bzhin tshogs brgya'i dus 'chams sku phyir 'don khar snum phyis sogs byed dgos pa la de nas lo shas dgos pa ma byung zer/ 'dar du yul sar nang par byon pa'i stag sna nang pa'i sras mo tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i snang dpon byang sems lags kyis rdo rje 'chang gi drung du mchi ma dang bcas mthong lcags rdzong shin tu gnyan pa yod 'dug pas srung 'khor gnang dgos zhus pas de lta bu bsams pa dga' rab yin/ dpon rin po che gzhan dang mi 'dra bas skyon mi yong gsungs/ mthongs lcags rdzong bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi snyan sgrub las sbyor gnang sa gsang ba'i mgon khang bod yul na gnyan pa der las sbyor gyi bca' gzhi rnams kyang shin tu 'grig pa nas gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu nas bshad pa ltar gyi mngon spyod rgyas par gnang skabs bdag chen rin po che'i gsol phod re nag dang dbu zhwa yang mchod cing rdzas la rta dang bya rog gi snying dgos pa ched du gsod pa ma 'gab pa'i rnyed dka' tshe mgon khang steng gi nam mkhar bya rog ster 'dzings byas pas gcig shi nas lhung ba dang rgyal rtse'i ltag tu mi zhig gi rta nag la glo bur du btsan rgyab ste 'bad med du rnyed gdab las kyi dus sha tshil dri chen spos sogs kyi dri nges med bsreg mkhan med par 'thul ba dang mgon khang mde'i bar 'khyams su skad ngan 'khun bu 'don zhing yag glu len pa sogs tshub cha che bas gsol dpon dang mchod dpon gcig pur 'gro mi nus pa byung zhing / dmigs bya as lang hung tha'i ji blon po dang bcas pa lo gcig tsam nas nang 'khrugs kyi (48ba)dmigs med du song rtags mtshan che yang rnam shes 'og min du rgyal ba'i sras su bskrun pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bla na med pa yin pas/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las/ e ma rgyu gos rten 'brel dgod re bro/ /dal med sngags spyon 'dren pa'i sngags 'chang la/ /'bad rtsol med par nus mthu shugs la 'byung / /chang 'thung 'ur gog 'thag —310

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / snyenapa'i sngags 'chang rnams/ /ban ling rnga brdung drag kyang ngal ba'i rgyu/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu khel bar bsam 31/ /'dar du phebs gdul bya rtag par 'dzin pa'i dngos chen ldog ste gtan mdun sgrub la brtson pa'i snying stobs kyi go bgo ba dang skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i 'phrin las kyi sgo 'phar zhing khams gzhan du 'byed par dus babs kyi 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po dang por rta bdun rgyal po nub ri'i phag tu zhugs par nye ba'i tshe zhing brje ba'i rnam pa bstan pa na rje 'di nyid kyis gsol 'debs shugs drag por mdzad pas spyan hur gyis gzigs nas rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje dang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis phebs nas de la rig pa zhugs pa bzhin du bde cham mer yod pa de sad pa zhig byung / sngar khyed kyis nan tan mdzad par brten de tsam bsdad yod da cha de 'dra mdzad nas ci gnang khyed rang la bltos bcas thams cad rjes su 'dzin zhes zhal gyis 'ches pa ni/ tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las/ lar nga rang tha mal snyoms las can/ /tshe 'di phyi gang 'gro'i gdengs med kyang / /mi nga la blo gtad byas pa kun/ /pha kun spangs chos rjes mkha' dbyings nas/ /dus rtag tu skyong (49na)pa'i bka' bzhes yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i don dang mthun par snang / /gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus skabs byams pa'ang gling gseb tu song ba dang 'grig pa'i rje nyid las phyag g.yog gzhan su'ang med pas mdor phebs te sgrub rnying slob dpon 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan rdo rje 'chang gi sku ber gyi gong ba la 'dra sku 'dri yin yod snang bar skor cig las mtshams zhog la byams pa bos 3stog gsung / de'ang dam pa gang de/ ma pham pas/ /de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid par/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa dang mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi 'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' ltar mnyam mod/ mchod sbyin brgya phrag gcig gis lha'i bdag por 'gyur ba bzhin tshe rabs gzhan du sbyin shugs kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir smin par blun po rnams kyi ngor 'phrin las 'phrin las zhes 'bod pa'i chen por grags pa rnams dang mtshungs pa'i 'byor ba mi mnga' na'ang bla chung —311—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 3bum/ 6lo'agam khums 'jugs pa'i ngang tshul can ci rigs ltar bre gsog phul gsog mdzad na de 'drar ma bltos pa'i dad 'bul la brten phyag rja sa 'khyil yong tshod du snang yang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung mgur du/ nor longs spyod 'bad pas bsags na yang / /tshe phyi mar mi phan lus sems sdug /de bsags pa snying po ma mchis kyi/ /da zas nor ci yod gang dgar zhog /ces snying po med pa dang / chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur gzigs pas 'dod sred kyi 'ching ba dang bral te dkon cog gi mchod pa dang dbul phongs la gtong ba sogs 'phral dag mdzad pa'i gshis/ yab sras gnyis mar gnang bde'i bdog (49ba)pa'i mthu dman pas dgongs rdzogs kyi mthun rkyen sgrub rtsol khyad zhag bdun par gsang ba'i chul mdzad/ zhag gcig gi bar 'od gsal gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag nas mkha' spyod rdo rje bcun mo'i zhing du gshegs pa'i gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje dpon dgyes mjad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi gco bor gyur par/ dngos su bshams pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa bzhin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar yongs su phye ste bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che bskrun pa'i mchod pa sna lnga brgya rtsa tshar re nyin zhag rer brje dgos la grogs g.yin med pas bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gnyid log long med pa lta bu byung skad/grang mo cher kye rdor man ngag lugs dang rdo rje 'jigs byed/ 'dar bsam grub dgon gsar bas kun rig /mang mkhar cha lung pas pad+ma yang gsang khros pa/ shing mangs pas dpal mo lugs kyi thugs rje chen po rnams kyi chog grwa zhag bdun gyi bar btsugs/ gnas de gar dge 'dun 'dus pa'i ser tshogs kyi gral dbur yongs rdzogs gnas lnga rig nga/'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags gdan drangs pa'i mang ja/ 'bul 'gyed/ tsha ra sogs kyis bsnyen bkur/ nye skor phu mda' bar gsum gyi skye bo'i tshogs la rtsam nas snam ras zangs lcags khro ja mar rta drel gyis mtshon pa'i zang zing gi bdog pas tshim par mdzad/3/2

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / smyon)hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi mtshan mo'i char kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 2bor zhal phye nas rje btsun nyid kyis phyag dar te sku gdung rin (50na)po che dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha ma dad par mchod pa'i tshul du zhugs su phul ba'i tshe ye shes kyi me rang 'bar zhing sang nyin lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i phyir me tog gi char dang 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim za 'og ris su phub pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par mchis/ de nas gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skur phebs te bzhi thog tu khri rin po che 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por thugs dam 'dogs rten/ chos dung dkar po rgyang grags btang ba'i dge 'dun tshogs chen la mang 'gyed/ lha khang tshor mchod pa snyan shal bzabs rgyas dang bcas rdo rje slob dpon dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bstan 'gro'i phan bde rlabs po che bskrun par mdzad bzhed kyi smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs/ mgon khang rnams su mchod gtor bskang bshags bstod 'phrin rgyas par gnang ba'i dam bsgrags shing khyad par bas 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi dbu dpral nas zil pa khrom khrom byung ba je 'phel du song ba shangs rtser babs pa zhal du mchod cing sku 'khor ba byams pa/ mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros kyi snag dbon nang so dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ mchod dpon gsum la gnang ba zas gang dang yang mi 'dra ba'i zhim la bcud che ba dri bzang chags pa byung zhing de'i shar g.yu thog tu bzhugs pa'i mgon po'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun gong dang 'dra/ sa bzang sku 'bum mchod khang na mgon po'i sku thal ba'i rdul gyis cher gos pa'i lta snang mi spro ba zhig la snyan dar 'bul grabs mdzad pa'i tshe sku 'khor (50ba)ba 'dras 'di la phul nas ci gnang zhus par ye shes pa gang na bzhugs mi shes zhes lha gos sgron pa dang dus mnyam du bdud rtsi babs pa gsum ga mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis thog mar ngos zin/ bdud rtsi babs par blo chung ba rnams ya mtshan gyi gnas su byed na'ang sku tshe mang por chos skyong bran du 'khol bar ma zad gsang rten lus la sba ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan na dam can grib ma bzhin 'khor bar dpal brtse ba chen po (spru dgag mkhan med —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skapa'i dbu snyung bzhes par dpags na mtshar 'dzin gyi chen por mi sems so/ /kha'u skyes lhas su phebs skabs dgon pa'i 'og tsam du chibs gde|la nas spyan nam mkha' la hur rer gzigs te rgyang tsam bzhugs pa 'phral du 'di yin mi gsung yang rjes su rdo ring rin po che man chad kyi bla ma rnams phebs dus gnyan mgon bram ze'i gzugs kyi bsu ba re nges par byung 'dug ces drung du 'khod par bka' stsal ba la dpags na de dus gzigs snang khyad par can byung ba gor ma chag /skyes lhas kyi dge 'dun rnams la sger du mang ja mi rer zhwa 'gyed/ rten gyi tshogs la mchod pa snyan shal bskang ba 'phrin bcol dam bsgrags/ zhabs drung bdag chen rin po che mjal zhing dgyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du stsal/ bka' chos kyi snyan gsan gnang bas 'brum nad las grol nas yun ring tsam song rung dpon tshang rnams kyis skor cig dpe lta sogs mi 'gab zer bsad lam mi thub 'dug slar long dang bstun pa'i byed ces dgyes pa'i zhal gyis bzhes/ zha lur mang ja tsha ra dang / ngor e (51na/shā chos ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i sa lugs dang / gzhan yang grub mtha' ris med rags bsdus dbus gtsang gi sde dgon mang dag la mang ja bsngo rten rgya cher spel/ rje rdo rje 'chang zhi ba'i dbyings su gzhol bar nye tshe sku cung zad hreb pa'i tshul bstan par nyin mtshan kun tu skyo ngal med par gnang bas thugs dam chag med rnams la thang lhod ci rigs byung bar brten me glang dbus su phebs zhor ngor e waṃ chos ldan du mkhan chen thar pa rtse ba nam mkha' sangs rgyas la lam dus sogs chag med gso ba mdzad/ rim gyis yar klungs bkra shis chos sder phebs nas rtse tshogs/ rtses dang sa dge /dkon gnyer phyi nang / ri bo chos gling / bkra shis chos sde/ lam rim/ bkra shis bde chen/ ras chung phug sogs kyi ser tshogs gral dbur thub bstan rdo rje brag nas dus gsum sangs rgyas dpal o rgyan chen po'i rgyal tshab byang pa ngag dbang rigs 'dzin rdo rje chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po spyan drangs 'bul 'gyed mang ja tsha ra la brten pa'i rnyed bkur yang dag bsgrubs/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i drung du rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi byin rlabs thugs dbang / lcags stong ma dang tshe —314

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)gur sbrags ma/ nyang gi drag po me'i spu gri rnams kyi dbang / rig 'dzin chen po'i 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi chos skor/ gu ru yon to gter mdzod kyi dbang lung / sngags sdebs snying gzer nag po dang gter ston brgya rtsa'i gsol 'debs kyi lung / gru gu yang waṃ gi 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i chos skor/pad+ma gling pa'i gur phur zhabs can dang ra ka'i zhal/ (51ba tshe gzi ldan dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/gdong bzhi pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi lung sogs snga phyir dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mang du gsan par gnang /dgongs pa rin po che chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa dang phyi rabs gdul bya rnams kyi legs byas rgya mtsho'i zhing gi ched du e nas sprul sku mkhas pa chos 'phel can lnga bkug ste bzo gra btsugs shing rdo rje 'chang gi sku tshab mgul pa yan rje bla ma dam pas phyag bzo gnang bas zhal khyim mngon sum lta bu mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam par grol ba'i byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'od du 'bar ba gtso bor bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'amang / rdo rje bdag med ma/ grub chen bi rū pa/ brtse chen snying po'i zhabs/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje bas rin po che/ chos rje paṇ+ḍita/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phagasapa/ tsho gis sgom rin po che/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen burnya shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'amang / rje btsun kha'u pa chen po/ tshang chen chos kyi rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mtshungs med gzhen nu blo gros mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan bar gyi lam zab brgyud pa'i snang brnyan gyi zhal khyim bzo bos dpe ma lon pa mi 'phyugs pa'i khyad nas phyag sor gyis bskrun pa dang bcas par gnas chen du ma'i sa sna rdo sna/ dam rdzas khyad par can/ sman sna/ dar sna sogs bsres pa'i sku rgyu la byad dbyibs bgres gzhon bzhugs stangs na bza' kha dog rnams dpe khungs(52na tha tsun dang gsung rgyun las byung ba ltar la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gis gtsos yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/ bla ma gong ma de dag gis mtshon pa'i dam pa du ma'i —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6te/sku bal dang sku gdung gi ring bsrel/ rgyud sdo rnam bzhi'i gzungs chos sku'i ring bsrel gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs gzungs bzhugs kyi rim pa rten bzhengs so byas so ba'i 'jig rten chos brgyad lhur len pa dang mi 'dra bar dam pa'i phyag bzhes 'khrul pa med par thugs ru shin tu nga ba rnams kyi bzhugs khri na bza'/ mdun lcog /cang te/ rdor dril/ nang mchod ka pā la/ bum pa/ zhal dkar/ spyi blugs/bzed zhal sogs rung mthun mkho ba'i yo byad rnams sla chos su ma song ba'i legs par bsgrig pa gnang sde bkra shis chos kyi 'dus grwa chen por lam zab bla ma lha khang ngo mtshar ba grub par gnyis su med pa dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje man ngag lugs lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rab gnas nyin gsum ma'i sgo nas 'og min zhing khams rgya mtsho nas ye shes pa gaṅgā'i klung gis bgrang bar mi nus pa spyan drangs te dam tshig pa dang ro gcig tu brlabs pa de'i tshe 'chi med kyi lam kun gur gyi dbyibs lta bu'i 'ja' ris sna lnga bkrag tu 'tsher zhing gsol gdab sems bskyed kyi dus me tog gi char babs pa thams cad kyi mngon sum pa'i spyod yul du gyur/ bzo bo rnams kyang yon tan gyis tshim pa sogs lha mchod mi mchod rgyas par mdzad/sa stag hor zla bcu gcig pa'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi rdo rje slob dpon du phebs skabs dge slong ye shes blo gros kyi mthong snang la/ gsol lcog gi khar (52bsgri lo dang kong rna btags pa'i mgo zhig mi nag po zhig gis khyer nas bzhag song ba ring por ma lon par sde pa'i nang zan chos sder shin tu brnag pa/ khyab 'jug gza'i gdong thug gis skad cig la 'jig rten pha rol tu song ba'i mi nag po de ni 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po pu tra nag por nges so/ /dwags po phyogs su bkag po'i zi bun la brten pa'i 'khrug zing cher song ba gra dol yar klungs lho byang gi dmag dpon bkras sgang nas kyis byas nas phyin skabs sde pa bkra shis rtse ba'i sku rim du 'jam dpal gshin rje dmar po rlung sgrub kyi dgra mnan gyi las sbyor gzhis dar gnang ba'i tshe gtor ma las khrag rgyun mang du 'dzags pas lcags slang khengs shing mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs —316

rme/rgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyanargyal mtshan gyi rmi lam du sa dong ring por srog chags mang po 'jug pa dang 'gro ba rmis tshul zhus pa na las sbyor 'di rigs la rmi ltas de bzhin 'ong gsung / nub cig stob pa'i gtor ma phul dus mchod dpon gyi rgyab dang mdun steng du gzugs mi mthong ba'i hab sha /cag cag gab be shob be sogs kyi sgra thos pas 'jigs zhus zhus byed pa sogs ltas legs pa/ brag kha ba'i dmag dpon skyer po gong 'og gis mtshon shor thal che ba byung yang bkra shis rtse ba dpon g.yog nyes skyon med pa'i dge mtshan du gyur/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rwa 'bro shong gsum gyi 'gyur dang jo zhal sogs mkhas pa du ma'i bzhed srol mang ba'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i yig cha sor bzhag gi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod 'dzugs par bzhed de sa yos hor zla dang por dpe rnams (53na)grwa pa tshor bkram pa'i blo 'dzin byed du bcug /zha lu nas bla chen mkhyen rab pa bos pa'i dpon slob tshang mas gar thig sbyong bstar gnang / rjes sor slob dpon 'phel khyad nas deng sang gi sgrub rnying bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ gzims khang shar bla ma dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ nang so tshe 'phel gsum yang bskyar sbyong bdar byed du 'jug par mdzad/ gar pa nyi shu'i gar gos/ pang khebs/ rus rgyan/ skra zhwa/ rtse phran/ rdo dril/ bsdus rgyud kyi bshad khungs dang 'brel ba'i rnam bum che legs bcu rnams thugs rtsol ba chen pos legs par bsgrig par gnang ste grwa pa rnams sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad nas nam mthongs zla ba phyi ma snon gyis nya ba'i dus tshes gza' skar sbyor byed bzang por btsugs pa'i sa gar gyi skabs rje nyid gar dpon du phebs pa'i sku rgyab kyi bar snang la yi ge dbu can gyi tshigs bcad 'dug pa zha lu bla chen gyis mthong zhing blor zin na'ang rjes su ma dran/ sbyin sreg gnang ba'i sar mchod gar ba rnams 'gros dang bcas 'byor ba dang dus mnyam du nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa las me tog gi char babs/ zhag sbrel gyi bar dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi 'khor lo'i gtso bor khyab bdag bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan bzhugs par sgrub mchod kyi dga' ston cha bsags kyi grong khyer la 'gran par gyur/ 'di —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skalo grabs gshoms stabs kyis snon slar mdzad kyang lo phyi ma nas nag zlar btsugs so/ /e nas dpon yig mkhas pa kha shas bkug nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshar pa chos rje'i gsung (53ba lko.u ma po ti bzhi/ bkra shis rtse'i dpon sa dbang 'dus rgyal mos sbyin bdag mdzad de 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsung 'bum gsang bsgrigs kyi glegs bam gsum dang rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi bka' 'bum pu sti gaḥgacig rnams bstan pa rin po che'i bcas su dgongs te bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' bsdu'i tshul du legs par bsgrub par gnang ngo / /zhing mang skal ldan don la dgyes pa'i zhal/ /'dzum pa'i gzugs brnyan sdud la nyer gzhol tshe/ /gsol ba'i re skongs 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /grub de lhar bcas 'gro la ston pa bzhin/ /spur rgyal bde 'phrog chom rkun du rum /sde dpung mngon spyod las kyis phyer btags nas/ rnam shes mi bskyod zhing du rab 'phangs pas/ /kun la brtse yang khyad par khyod kyi gnyen/ /rtag brtan g.yung drung chos sku mngon gyur kyang / /rtag 'dzin srid zhen 'ching rgya las grol ched/ /rtag min zhing 'dir mdzad pa'i mtha' btul yang / /rtag tu phyogs 'di'i bstan 'gror gcig tu brtse/ /'chi ba 'od gsal don gyi he badz+ra/ /so sor snang ba'i cho 'phrul tha mi dad/ /'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtsor gshegs pa/ /ngo mtshar mchod sprin spro la lha rnams brel/ /grangs med 'gro 'dren sems bskyed dam bca'i khur/ /nam yang gtong ba'i go skabs mi srid mod/ /thugs rje bskul ba'i legs byas phung po sa /song na snod du 'jig rten khams 'di chungs/ /'on te bstan srung bye ba'i 'khor los sgyur/ /byin rlabs mdzod spu'i thigs phreng gzugs can du/ /grub tshe bdud rtsi'i bum pa chu gter nas/ /len pa'i lha rnams bya (54na ji ka'i 'bras bur zad/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i bdag por mkhyen brtse dang / / nusapas dbang sgyur sngags 'chang byang pa rje/ /nyi zla 'od zer sprul par chos rjes su/ /'brangs te rigs kyi bdag por thod du bcings/ /mkhas grub gzhan gyi spyod yul ma gyur pa/ /sa skya'i bla chen kho na'i khyad par chos/ /lam zab bka' babs brgyud pa nor bu'i 'phreng / /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i srad bur —318

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)gcig tu rgyus/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong chen phyag rgya che/ /e waṃ zung 'jug dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /'khor lo'i mgon du bzhengs pa'i rdo rje'i 'gros/ /tshangs pa'i yul sa sor mo'i rdul gyis gnon/ /dus gsum 'dren pa gsung gi yang snying dpyid/ /brjod pa rnam dag ka 'phreng glegs bam du/ /legs bsdus srid mthar rma med bstan pa'i srog /btsugs pas 'od srungs bgres po'i snyan pa phyogs/ /re zhig gdan sar stan chags mur gnyug mar gnas pa dang phyogs 'dus kyi gdul bya rnams la khams dang dbang por 'tsham par rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dbang khrid rjes gnang rigs gtad lung blo sbyong ba'i rim pa sogs theg chen thun mong ba dang khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba rnams so so'i rigs kyi bslab pa la 'god pas mtshon rnam par dkar pa'i 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel na'ang don med zang zing gi 'du 'khod kyi dbang du nam yang mi 'gro bar mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi nyams bzhes dus gtor sogs thugs dam zab mo'i rim pa bla nas blar 'phel bzhin pa'i ngang nas bka' chos mang du gsan par ma zad sngar sa stag dang zha lu'i lo gsum ma'i rjes thugs rtsol gnang ba 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig (54ba/3 bkod par/ kun mkhyen ye bzang rtse pas/ de ltar 'dul ba'i bstan par 'phel 'grib cher byung mod kyi theg pa chen po gsang sngags ni deng sang gi bar nub ma myong zhes gsung ba glang dar gyi bstan pa bsnubs zhes pa'ang so thar la dgongs pas/ ji skad du/ ji ltar 'di ni shing rtsa'i gtso bor ste/ /rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin gnyis kyi rgyu/ /de bzhin dam chos tshogos rnams thams cad kyi/ /gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ /zhes thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me yod med chos 'dul ba la rag lus shing lhag tu dam pa 'di nyid tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par 'dzin pas snga mo nas lung sde bzhi gsan bzhed yod pa ltar sna nam pa chen po rdo rje bdud 'joms dang srid gsum 'gran zla bral ba chos rje bla ma dam pa'i rnam 'phrul mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi bsti gnas gong dkar rdo rje —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo /degadan gyi chos grwa chen po'i dpal 'byor gling du khu ston ngag dbang rnam rgyal la 'dul ba lung sde bzhi dang gzhan yang chos bka' ci rigs gsan cing snga phyi mang por nyi ma gling du mthu ston 'jigs med dpa' bo'i ring lugs 'dzin pa la 'gran zla med pa mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bla chen tshul khrims bkra shis par dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang /gong dkar ba lugs kyi lam 'bras kyi 'khrid yongs rdzogs/ byin rlabs dang lung kha shas/ lam skor phyi ma'i lung / yi ge med pa dang mchod rten drung thob kyi byin rlabs/ yo ga khams gsum rnam rgyal/dpal mchog rigs bsdus/ rdor dbyings phreng ba'i (55na)nang gi bdud rtsi gsum/ sa phur stod las gsum gyi dbang / smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang paṇa chen kun bkras par bde chen ral gcig /rdo rje rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dbang sogs zab chos rgya che bas thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang bar mdzad/slar yang bkra shis chos sder phebs/ de'ang bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya ba'i bstan pa dang ston pa las gzhan du mi 'tshol ba'i thugs kyi dam bca' brtan po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i lam yig tu/ rje bcun rdo ring pa chen po dang mjal nas gsung ngag rin po che thob pa man gzhan bla ma dang gdams ngag gang la'ang byang chub sgrub pa'i ched du mi smon zhing 'gram chu mi ldang ba'i nges shes gting tshugs pa zhig yod/ ces gsungs pa ltar 'gyur ba'i go skabs ga la srid kyang / rje btsun grol mchog gis/ dam chos kun gdul bya'i blo brid las/ /phyogs 'dzin gyi grub mtha' skyong ma myong / /chos du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor pa/ /grub mtha' rkang mtshugs zer kyang 'gyod rgyu med/ /ces pa bzhin bdag cag gi ston pas kyang la lar gang zag gi bdag yod par bstan pa sogs gdul bya rjes su 'jin pa la thabs sna tshogs shig dgos pas ris med pa'i chos lugs la gsan bsam 'chad nyan mdzad pa'ang gdul bya rjes su 'dzin par dgongs shing khyad par/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las/ ngas sbyangs pa de sa skya pa'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs kyang / mkhas pa de gsang sngags rnying —320

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (2)ma la mkhas pa/ 'di ko sngon gyi las 'phro zhig yin nam/ /a ho ngo mtshar du che byung / ngas bsgoms pa de gsung ngag lam 'bras bsgoms kyang / rtogs (55ba)pa de rdzogs pa chen po la shar ba/ 'di ko sngon gyi las 'phro zhig yin nam/ a ho ngo mtshar du che byung / ngas gsol ba de rnal 'byor dbang phyug la btab kyang / byin rlabs de skyon pad+ma khos gnang ba/ 'di ko sngon gyi las 'phro zhig yin nam/ a ho ngo mtshar du che byung / ngas bshad pa de dam chos phyogs med cig bshad kyang / 'gro phan de gsang sngags rnying ma la byung ba/ 'di ko sngon gyi las 'phro zhig yin nam/ a ho ngo mtshar du che byung / zhes gsungs pa blo chung ci rigs kyi khong par mi shong yang 'khon klu dbang srungs nas dkon cog rgyal po yan la rnying ma bka' ma'i sngags 'chang sha stag tu byon zhing / de nas kyang yi dam yang phur dang chos skyong dkar bdud la mdzad la/ mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti yang phur gyi rdzogs rim khyad par can dang rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po sku thog tu'ang rnying ma ba'i sngags 'chang 'ja' lus grub pa gnyis tsam byung tshul bla chen ru thog pa nam mkha' gzi brjid kyis gsungs pa ltar tshar chen yab sras bka' gter chos kyi gnad mkhyen pa'i thugs gtsigs che tsam gnang ba'i rgyun bzhin rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis kyang klu sgrub rjer gsan pa tsam du ma zad nyang ting 'dzin bzang po dang mnga' bdag nyi ma 'od zer sogs grub brnyes nyang rigs stod smad mang por gyes pa'i nyang ston sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i gdung rigs las son cing bla ma mnga' bdag gi byang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs gnyos zhig chen po nas rim brgyud khra tshang pa'i snag dbon rje khyab bdag blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje zhes paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra'i sprul par lung gis zin pa de la (56na)gter kha 'og ma bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung / bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi chos skor/ rta mgrin dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa'i sgrub skor/ rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi dbang lung / 'char ka gnam skas ma'i sgrub skor/ thugs sgrub dregs pa tshar gcod du grags pa'i drag dmar gyi dbang lung / phyag rdor gtum po'i seng ge sgra sgrog dbang lung / dregs pa dbu dgu'i srog dbang lung bcas/ dzam bha la dmar po'i chos skor/ grwa —32/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yopa'i 'dzam dmar gyi sgrub skor/ dung tsho ras pa'i rdzogs chen yang ti nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig ma'i dbang lung khrid bcas/ rat+na gling pa'i thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa' dbang lung / gu ru drag po'i dbang che 'bring chung gsum sgrub skor lung bcas/ nyang gi bla ma dmar 'khrid kyi chos skor/ gter rgyud snying po'i dbang lung / rta mgrin nag chung lha brgyad gyi dbang lung / snang rtse ba'i rta nag gi dbang lung / gdugasadakar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang / pha dam pa'i 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dang mthun pa'i rjes gnang / 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa'i lung sogs mang du gsan/chos dbang rin po che'i gdung 'dzin lha bro sprul sku dme gu ru zhes lo chen be+e ro tsa na'i sprul par lung gis zin cing bka' gter chos kyi srog shing chen po gang de'i gdams pa'i bka' babs sgrub mchog chos dbang bsam grub kyi gdams pas thugs rgyud yongs su gang ba'i mthus srid pa'i phun tshogs mtha' dag chu shing gi 'bras bu dang me 'obs lta bur gzigs nas chos brgyad kyi bun long thams cad rgyab (56ba/3 bskyur nye bas mtha'i dben gnas su lhun grub snang ba bzhi khor yug tu 'da' ba'i mtshungs med chos dbang kun bzang la chos dbang gi bla ma gsang 'dus kyi dbang lung / bla ma sku gsum gyi sgrub pa/ pad+ma lam zab kyi gu ru khro bo rigs gsum gyi dbang lung / tshe dpag med rdzong chen ma'i tshe dbang / rdzogs chen sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi chos skor/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa' dbang lung / rta mgrin nag po'i dbang lung / bla ma gsang 'dus kyi cha rkyen pad+ma bcud bsdus kyi chos skor don tshan bcu gnyis pa/ dpal mgon ma ning gi chos skor/ mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi pad+ma snying tig gi chos skor/ rdzogs pa chen po kun bzang snying tig gi chos skor/ rdzogs pa chen pa'i rgyud bcu bdun sogs kyis mtshon pa'i zab chos mang du gsan/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa dbu bsnyengs pa'i gnas chen pho brang yum bu bla mkhar mjal bar phebs te/ chos rgyal tho tho ri snyan shal gyi mkhar byin rlabs can der bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyag mchod smon lam mdzad zhol der tshal dus bzhengs pa'i gyang logs shig la mgon po gur gyi bal bris rnying pa byin rlabs can zhig yod par 'di —322

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyanababs chags shing zil che zhes snyan shal sgron pa'i tshe de 'phral zhal nas bdud rtsi zil pa khrom khrom byung ba'i shul da lta yang yod/ de'i shar phyogs kyi bang so der gter mang po yod pa 'dra zhes gzigs rtog gnang bas gyang hrab tsam brkos shul kyi steng na g.yam pa'i gnam sgo zhig 'dug par phyag reg pas khral khrol byed par 'di rngogs na gter yod nges rung re zhig gzhog gsungs pa zham (57na)'bring pa sogs der yod thams cad kyis nges shes su gyur na'ang rjes su bltas pas shul tsam yang ma byung snang /bstan pa spyi sgos kyi ched du 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog gnang / skabs shig gzims chung gi nang sha chen gyi gsur dud chen pos khengs pa bka' las khyod tshos sha bsregs pa'i dris nga'i gre ba 'gags gsungs par mchod dpon gyi nged tsho'i khrod na bsreg mkhan med gzims chung nang rang nas dri ma byung zhus pas cang mi gsung / de nub bla brang thog nas gtor ma 'phen pa gnang bas sman lung gi mda' na chos sde la shin tu brnag pa'i ma rungs pa zhig yod pa de srod 'khor la grir gum/ bla brang gi rgyab tu sngar nas btsan zhig yod pa gtor zor babs pa dpal ldan dus kyi dgra bo'i gzi byin ma bzod par sne mo khang gsar gyi rgya lam khar spos pa da lta'ang yod do/ /chags bral tshangs par spyod kyang 'dod yon kun/ /lam khyed rdo rje gdan mtshungs chos kyi sder/ /thub bstan dgongs pa gcig pa'i 'gal med gar/ /bsgyur tshe klu sgrub snying po gzugs gzhan bzung / /dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor pa gling yangs por/ khu ston smra la ngag gi dbang phyug pa/ /rnam dpyod yid bzhin rgyal mtshan rtser bkod las/ /sde bzhi'i lung gi 'dod rgu char du bsnyil/ /tshul ldan khrims gnas mkhyen pa'i lha lam ngos/ /smin grol gzhung bshad 'ja' tshon rab bkra ba/ mas brjod glu yi nyi mas yongs khyab pa'i/ /gling 'dir nges gsang bstan pa'i bdag por bskos/ /gzhes med blo mchog yangs pa rdo rje'i khams/ /rnam dpyod g.yas (57ba〉phyir la mgrin las legs bshad sgra/ /'dren pa'i snyan gyi dbang por ches dngar bas/ /dbyangs bdun tshang ba'i glu la yi rang bcad/ / chos brgyad tsha zer —323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)spangs pa'i rta ldan snar/ /kun bzang chos kyi sa bon yongs zhugs 'bras/ /'od gsal snang bzhi'i lus rdzogs tha skar skyes/ /'jam mgon mtho ris dbang po'i bla yi sman/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i mngal du bstan pa'i dbu/ /thog ma sbrums pa'i pho brang yom bu sa /kun yid tshar du mngar ba'i brjod pa'i mtha'/ /'tshol la khyab 'jug gom pas ma bgrod ngal/ /ris bral 'gro la rang bde gtong nus pa'i/ /rgyal sras spyod la bslab pa'i sems dpa' che/ khrag 'thung ye shes rdo rje'i mtshon rnon pos/ /brtse med dgra bgegs don snying 'bigs 'di ci/ /har zla drug pa'i nang du chibs kha bskyod de gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi lha gling spyil por phyi rol rnam par g.yeng ba'i 'du 'dzi thams cad rgyang du bsrings nas sku gsung thugs lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pas khor yug tu 'da' ba'i bcad rgya zla ba brgyad kyi ring mdzad pa'i skabs dam bca'i phyag bris su gnang ba sku'i bkod pa bsdus rjes rnyed pa las 'di ltar/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /rang byung lhun grub ye shes khyab brdal las/ /ma 'gags rang rtsal sprul pa'i sku ru byon/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig pad+ma 'byung / khyad par bdag gi 'di phyi'i mgon gcig pu/ khyed la gsol 'debs snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /rgyal ba gang de'i ye shes rnam rol las/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshul/ /mdo sngags gsar rnying bka' gter ma lus pa/ /nyi ltar (58na)gsal mdzad mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhyen/ /de yi rdo rje ye shes rnam gsum gyis/ /bskrun pa'i rgyal tshab grub dbang rdo rje 'chang / /bka' drin mnyam med dbang phyug rab brtan gyi/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs skyabs su mchi/ /chos dbyings bde chen mtha' bral rang nyid las/ /gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro ba rjes gzung phyir/ /zhi dang khro dang zhi ma khro yi tshul/ /rab 'byams lha tshogs bdag gis bsnyen cing sgrub/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs las rnam sprul pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung ma rungs tshar gcod pa/ /drag shul mthu ldan dam can tsho gos rnams kyis/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod bar chad sol/ /ji ltar 'dab bzang dbang po mkha' la bgrod/ /de la 'gran min —324

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyananyam chung bung ba'i tshogs/ /rang rtsal 'bad nas nam mkhar 'phur ba ltar/ /sngon byon dam pa rnams la 'gran min yang / /rang nyid 'khor ba'i 'dam las rab brgal nas/ /ma rgan 'gro ba smin grol la 'god phyir/ /dam pa'i rjes zhugs go cha cher gyon nas/ /nyon mongs dgra tshogs g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal srid 'thob phyir ngas 'dir 'bad/ /de la 'a zha'i rgyal rigs las byung ba'i btsun pa mkhas grub dam pa mang po'i dbon du gyur cing rjes su bzung ba/ dam pa'i chos tshul mang du thos pa/ rgyu 'bras kyi chos la bden pa'i dad pa thob pa/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mi phyed dad pas phyug pa ming gnas gsar dbon po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan zhes bgyi ba bdag yongs 'dzin bla ma mang pos thugs rjes (58ba)bskyangs pa'i dbang 'khrid gdams pa mang du thob kyang rang nyid kyi rgyud la ni ma 'byor/ lung rtogs dang sbyangs pa'i yon tan ni med/ shes rab dang brtson 'grus ni zhan/ dka' spyad sdug rus ni chung / le lo dang snyom las ni che/ sbyin stobs dang bsgoms stobs ni nyung / gnyid rmugs dang rnam g.yeng ni mang / de la sogs pa'i skyon dang nyes pa ni brjod pas mi lang / yon tan dang dge ba ni btsal bas mi rnyed pa'i tshod tsam du 'dug /mi tshe ni phyed lhag song 'dug /'tshang rgya bar ni spu tsam mi nye ba'i khar nyes lhung mang po zhig gis mar la en tsam nye ru song 'dug snyam pa'i blo la bde ba'i skabs ma byung bas slar yang yang bsams pas mtshams med pa'i sdig po che yang gsang sngags kyi gnad gsang shes na myur du 'tshang rgya bar gsungs 'dug /snying rus dang ldan na zla ba drug rtse gcig bsgoms pas phung po lhag med 'grub par yang gsungs/ tshul bzhin du bsgoms na zhag bdun gyis bden pa mthong bar dus 'khor las gsungs pa sogs kyis spro ba slar rnyed/ da cha rang lo so brgyad pa 'brug lo zla ba dang po nas bzung ji srid 'tsho'i bar tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags ched du mi sgrub zas ster mi byung na byol nyog tu ma song bar longs spyod/ ma byung na bcud len la sogs pa'i ngan ngon la brten gos ster mi byung na gyon/ ma byung na'ang chos gos rnam gsum ngan rnyigs dag gtum mo la brten pa byed/ chos bka' —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6logater mdo sngags rnam dag zhu sa gang na yod kyang zhu/ khyad par khe dang rgyal kha g.yin la bskur zhing gyong rang gis len pa gang yong yong byed/ lhag (59na)par lha'i bsnyen pa rigs mi gcig pa brgya phrag byed/ rtags dang mtshan ma yod re med kyang grangs bsnyen/ dus bsnyen/ gtso 'bum/ 'khor khrir longs pa brgya phrag gcig lo zhe dgu tshun la grub pa bgyid/ de nas kyang ma shi na ci 'grub byed/ de dag gis khas len dang dam bca' la rta zi ba dang nyams len lag thog yod pa la khyi mi ri ba byung gi dogs 'dug pas yang yang zhus dag byed/ grub na khengs rloms spangs te chos chos su song ba byed/ de dag 'grub ma 'grub blta phyir yi ge bris pa yin/ sprang ban bdag gi dam bca'i tshig 'di dag /byas byung yi ger 'dri ba'ang mi 'os mod/ /'on kyang khengs dregs bzang 'dod ma yin pa'i/ /ma 'grub tshe na rang ga rang khrel 'debs/ /tshul bzhin 'grub na zhen med dga' ba sgom/ /des na bla ma yi dam chos skyong tshogs/ /bdag bi dam bca' tshul bzhin 'grub pa dang / /bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu tshul bzhin 'thob par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las/ dus dang por 'jig rten bya ba thong / /dus bar du tshe 'di'i bya ba thong / /dus tha mar chos kyi bya ba thong / /nga ci nus bya btang rnal 'byor bgyid/ /lus sna tshogs rgyan gyis rab brgyan kyang / /rus sha dang pags pas g.yogs pa 'dis/ /gos mdzes pas brgyan kyang snang shas rgyu/ /nga cha lugs ngan ngon tsam la brten/ /zhes pa'i don dang mtshungs par ma zad ljongs 'di'i mkhas grub chen po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba'i gnas 'gangs che shos su 'dug cing zhib tu brtags tshe zhal gyis 'ches pa kho na mdzad par yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed (59ba)pas dad pa'i gsos bla na med pa'o/ /de nas drang srong srin po ri'i gnas mjal la bya bral 'gros kyis phebs/ deng nga 'bri gung pas paṇa chen shākya gdan drangs pa'i tshe paṇ+ḍi ta'i bhū ti tsan+t+ra sa phyag rgya ba rdzun che zhes skur pa btab pa'i sgrib sbyong du rje btsun ma'i lung bstan ltar bde mchog gi lha khang bzhengs pa'i sku khyad par can de'i zhabs 'og tu dar skud 'drongs pa sogs bar snang mar grags pa de lam khyud gang tsam sa la ma reg —326

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)pa'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa dkon gnyer dang nyam 'bring bas mtshon der 'khod kun gyi 'dren byed kyi yul du gyur/ snyan dar dang lha bskos mar me sogs mchod sprin spros te bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dbyer med ngo bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang bzhi bzhes pa dang bstan 'gro rgyas pa'i smon lam rgya cher 'debs par mdzad/de nas gong dkar chos sde brgyud rim gyis hor zla bcu gnyis pa nyis brtsegs kyi lcags 'brug hor zla dang por rong khu lung du phebs/ rje btsun mi las lha rje gnubs chung par drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag gsan nas las sbyor gyi mthu khang lag mthus glags mi rnyed pa'i ched du brus pa'i phug pa der byon te nam zla zad dus yin rung brag las sgrub chu glo bur du babs pa phyag phyi ba rnams kyis lce thog tu myong zhing yid ches kyi gnas su gyur/ yum bsres mos gsol ba btab par brten gzhis gar zla ba lnga tsam gyi ring ljags bsnyen kha gso'i sku mtshams dang phyogs 'dus kyi snod ldan rnams la dbang 'khrid lung man ngag sogs chos 'khor mtha' yas pa bskor/ de nas bkra shis rtse chos sder byon/ thub gsung rin po che bka' 'gyur ro cog yongs rdzogs kyi lung (60na)rgyun nyag phra ba thugs kyis ma bzod pa'i phyogs gang dang gang du yod ces rtsad gcod gnang yang nges khungs ma chod pa'i mur kong po gter ston 'ja' tshon snying por yod pa'i gnas tshul gsan par brten 'degs rtsis mdzad/me byi byar dwags rnams kyis gtsang sde srid kyi zhabs 'dren byas pa nas bzung bkag po mang du 'phel ba'i dwags kong phyogs su rgyu 'grul mi bde ba yod pas phebs pa mi 'gab pa zhu mi mang ba byung na'ang gsan 'jog ma gnang bar chos kyi gdung shugs drag pos bltos med du phebs pa'i dwags po ru'i gru bton sgam po'i gzhis ka klu mkhar zhol du bzhugs nub sngar zhal 'dris med kyang gdung brgyud nas sne len dang bkag po'i nyes sel la sde pa bkra shis rtse ba'i sku skye yin zer ba'i btsun pa drag pa zhig gis 'go byas mi bcu gnyis tsam phebs skyel du btang ba'i dwags la sgam po'i phu gnyal la ma thebs —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skatsam gyi byang stongs na chu chen pos bcad nas mi thar bar thug tshe bka' las yas mas tshor 'khyags zam yod 'dra ltos dang gsungs pa ltar bya rog cig gis sna drangs pa'i snyed nas pha rir byon pa dang 'khyags zam brdeb pa na sna mo shag grub chen pas mchi ma 'don zhing phyag mang du btsal bla ma khyed la thugasarje yod kyang yod byung yang byung / zhus shing jag pa kha shas 'ong ba'ang chur ma thar pa sogs chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las grol te kun ya mtshan du gyur/ zhabs skyel ba dmangs la la 'gro ma 'dod pa'i bros shing rgad bu zhig lus pas lam rgyus zhus gnyal la de kha ba ches pas khal rnams dbang skyel dang rkang lag 'phyid pa kha yar sogs tshang ma 'o brgyal ba'i ngang nas phebs pa'i gnas mal du (60ba)bzhugs nub phyag g.yog tsho sdod sa'i thog brdib ste 'ur zhogs che'ang nyes skyon ma byung bas gter gsar gyi srung ma rnams gnyan pa'i 'tshub tu ngos 'dzin mdzad/ sang nyin bshul du bzhugs skabs phar gnas tshul gyi sngan phar gnang ba mda' rgyang de tsam nas mi zhig dang 'phrad de gleng mo byas yar slebs byung ba gter ston gyis phebs bsur brdzangs pa'i nga la dbon po yin zer bas kha btags kyi phyag mjal dang spos chag spar bzhin pas spyan drangs/ khyed dpon slob la sus zhus gnang bas skad cha mi dgos kho rang gis shes yong zer skad/gter ston dpon slob dgun tshang du chos thog la phebs pa dang 'grig par dngos po brgya phrag tu longs pa'i 'bul ba dang bcas mjal/ gter ston gyis bka' 'gyur thog mtha' bar gsum gyi lung las mtshan nyid pa gsan tshod kyang min 'dug /gter ston rang gi phyag g.yas g.yon mdzub mo gnyis sbrel ba'i phyag rgya mdzad nas nged rang dpon slob gnyis 'di ga byung ba bka' 'gyur gyi lung yin/ phyag sor rnams zlum po/ zla gam/ gru bzhi/ gru gsum du mdzad de spos phor nang du til btab pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg cig car du grub pa sogs snang tshul dang gnas tshod mi gcig pa'i grub thob zhig po'i rnam thar rtogs dka' ba dang ma nas tshad thub kyi gter ston du thugs nges shes 'drongs pa'i gter gsar yang zab dkon cog spyi 'dus/ tshe dpag med gnam lcags rdo —328

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)rje dngos grub kun 'byung / thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol/ zhi khro nges don snying po/ rta phag yid bzhin nor bu ga me gling pa'i zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol rnams (61na)kyi dbang lung / sgrub thab gser chos ma'i lung / bi mā la'i snying tig gi chos skor/ yang rdzong snying tig gi chos skor/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi chos skor rnams gsan/ phar sa lugs kyi chos skor kha shas 'bul ba gnang /gter ston gyi rnam thar du lam 'bras dgong bstad ma gsan gsung ba dgongs bstad dang thog mtha' bar gsum byed pa sa lugs la mngon sum mi dgongs rmi lam du'ang mi srid cing rje 'di nyid kyi thugs la yang ga nas shong phal cher kye rdor gyi dbang dang zab lam gyi rnal 'byor lta bu gnang bar lam 'bras su ming btags pa'i rtag brtan sprul sku'i rnam thar zhig de ru phebs pa 'dra'o/ /gsung gleng zhig la/gter gsar lung bstan du/ nub nas byang sems 'gro 'dul nyi shu gcig:stag yos lo pa rang rtags dpral sme can: zhes pa nyid yin par 'dug ces ngos 'dzin mdzad pa ltar dgung lo yos dang dbu dpral la sme ba nyis brtsegs yod par der tshogs rnams nges pa rnyed kyang rje bla ma bdag gir cher mi mdzad/ gzhan yang gter ston rje lcags zam par 'byungs pa'i dus lcags zam then pa'i sprul pa'i rgyad du gyur pa dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang tshan zhig yin tshul khrom bsgrags su gsungs pa sogs thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ gter ston gyi dus tshone 'di gang 'dra yod mi shes pas yar mgyogs tsam phebs gsung ba zla shas nas gtsang sog gi bde gzar langs pa sogs mkhyen par snang / yar lam yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bu chur thugs rje chen po dang rta mgrin sogs gnas rten mjal zhing mchod 'bul dang smon lam gnang / dung mtshor tshong dpon bkra shis kyis (61ba)gtsos pa rnams kyis ja snam thug gi 'bul ba dang bcas byin rlabs dang chos 'brel zhus/gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung brgyud kyi jo mo sgam po'i lcam gyis gzhis gar mjal nas gzhis len bstab/ sang nyin phu'i gnas su byon shog ser dam rdzas sogs rten rnams zhib tu mjal/nga lar phebs mtshams dwags po gro lung gi skyon zer ba'i rtsub spyod can de'i ma rungs pa'i blo zhi ste —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)zhabs 'dren ma zhus par ma zad byin rlabs zhu bas mtshon gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byas/ nyer 'tshe cung zad kyang med bzhin pa nas yar klungs su bde bar phebs te gdan sa chen po nyid du stan chags/ bla ma bka' brgyad yongs 'dus kyi spyi lung mdor bsdus snying po las/ khyad par gdug pa sprul gyi lo shar dus: gnam rtags 'od dkar skya rengs yang yang 'char: gza' skar 'khrug cing byang du hor sog g.yo: 'ol dga'i phyogs su chos pas rkyen byas 'khrug: dbus gtsang sde 'khrug 'gro rnams nyam thag 'gyur: sa g.yos nad rims lo gsum lo nyes 'byung : lo dgu'i bar du dbus gtsang dbu rur 'tshog:ces pa dang / yol mo sprul sku gter ston bstan 'dzin nor bu'i gter gsar du/ yos kyi lo la ngal gso byed: 'brug gi lo la 'brug ltar ldir: sprul pa sprul shun lta bur 'thor: de phyir yos bu'i lo la long : zhes pa'i lung bstan dus la bab pa'i gtsang sog gi dus 'khrug chen po langs par nye ba mchog dman mtha' dag blo 'tshub par brten gtsang sde srid nas sa rnying gi sngags sde phal cher la sog bzlog gi sku rim btsugs pa'i rnam grangs mang tsam byung song ba dang phyogs mthun du bslab ston dang bstun pa'i dmar chen (62na)gtor bzlog gi tshe zangs gri can gyi gtor ma sgo phyogs su 'chus shing yungs dzir gang bzang rnams rang bzhin gyi sil sgra chad med sgrogs/ gtor ma 'phen sar gtor ma las me lhab kyi 'bar te rtse mo nas btso byad shar phyogs su rgyugs pa sogs rdo rje chos skyong rnams bran du bkol ba'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab cing de lo lho byang kun tu dus kyi chad pa'i brdabs gsigs sna tshogs byung na'ang yar klungs stod smad kyi sdodagon yul gru tshor gnod pa cher ma byung ba'i khar sgos su dmigs med kyi dbyings su rgyas 'debs pa'i gra bsgrig klungs su ma rgyugs pa'i nyes pa rnams rim gyis zhi bas nus mthu'i gzi byin 'od du 'bar/ 'on kyang lo 'di dang chu rta'i bar stod smad kyi bde gzar gcig mjug gcig non lta bu'i rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol ba med pas 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin ha cang gi rgya che ba gnang ma thub rung gdan sa nyid du stan chags shing / gong dkar chos ster yang nyi ma gling du chos kyi gsan pa mdzad/ khra 'brug gi li ma rnams byin —330

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyanarlabs zhu mi mangs par brten dreg pas nogs pa chu lug sde pa bkra shis rtse pas sbyin bdag mdzad de star bu sogs kyis bkrus nas gsar pa lta bur song bar zhal gser spyan 'byed dbu mthing gi zhig gsos/ rje nyid nas ras las grub pa'i stod smad kyi gos zungs 'bul ba gnang /lcags sbrul bde gzar skabs rgyal khang bshig par brten gnas rnying rgyal po rten med du song ba'i e gnyal yar klungs lho kha phyogs su 'khyar ba'i gnod pa sna tshogs byas pa 'di dus khra 'brug gi phyag bzhi pa'i mgon khang mdor yod pa sna mo shag grub chen pas rab gnas kyi (62bzhin bdag zhus te rje nyid phebs rgyu'i snga nub lha 'dre'i dmag sgar rnams 'ur ba'i chu byang khar song ba legs bshad gling pa'i gra pa dge slong rje btsun zer ba'i mig mthong shin tu gsal bas nges shes 'drongs pa'i ya mtshan du byed pa bcom ldan 'das he badz+ra gyi rnam par rol pa'i gzi byin ma bzod par snang / de'ang gter kha mang por gnas chen rnams la rab gnas bskyar na bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs la phan par gsungs bzhin mchod yon thams cad thugs rtse mthun te thog mar sde brgyad cha mnyam pa'i phyir bsangs dang gser skyems/ dngos gzhi dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab tu gnas shing me tog gi char chen po phab pa'i tshe lha sras kyi phyag bzo'i dpal skyon chen po'i sku la rang nyid kyis nga 'dra gsungs te mkhur chos la phyag mdzub btsugs shul rgyal blon gyi dus nas gyong tsam yod pa'i nang du sngar med pa'i a 'bur dod gsal ba dkon gnyer gyis mthong ba sogs gangs can bde legs spel ba'i rtsa lag tu gyur/sbrul lo bstan pa spyi rim sogs mdzad par bsnyad gzhan sbyor phun tshogs mi bzod par phrag dog can 'dras snyan phra sna tshogs phul bar brten sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan kyang thugs kyi 'dzin stangs gzhan du gzhol ba'i gnang sgo la zhogs drud de dgon gnas la 'pho len sogs bka'i lung lci ba'i chad pa 'dra 'ong ngam zhes brjod rigs du mas phyogs de'i skya ser phal cher re dogs dang som nyir gyur pa sde pa bkra shis rtse pas dag sangs kyi rgyu mtshan phul ba 'gab tshul zhus tshod du 'dug rung —331

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skaha cang dbyings ches pas mdzub mos gnam mi theg pa'i dpe bzhin zhu 'bul sna phibs yong ba (63na)dka' ba dang rje nyid kyi dgongs pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung mgur du/ sdug mi 'dod ci dang ci byung yang / /de byur ngan rang gi nyes pa yin/ /mi g.yin la sdug yus mi 'tshong ba/ /nga ci nus kun gyi sdug bsngal 'khrur/ /skyid bde ba ci dang ci byung yang / /rje mnyam med bla ma'i bka' drin bsam/ /bdag rang gi bsod nams mi bgyid par/ /da 'gro drug kun la mnyam par 'bul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyid na dkon cog gi thugs rje dang sdug na las ngan 'dzad pa'i chos thog tu 'jog bzhed kho nas lha btsun bo dhi rā dzas/ jo bo chen po bsam yas su bzhugs par ma 'dod pa'i tshe/ gang na 'thab cing rtsod pa bas/ /dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol 'gro/ /zhes gzhan du phebs pa'i lo rgyus dang mtshungs pa'i 'phral rkyen bskul ma lta bu'i don lo gsum gyi bzhed pa 'grub pa'i dus bab kyi ring por ma lon par zha lur phebs te lo gsum gyi bar ri phug gi rnam grol yang rtser shing sprel hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum nas phyi rol gyi rnam g.yeng mtha' dag rgyang du bsring bar mdzad pa'i kye rdor bsnyen chen/ rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ ma hā mā ya/ dgra nag /bde chen ral gcig /gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang lha phran gyi rim pa sku na phra ba'i dus gnang ba nas bzung da lam stan thog gcig tu grub me yan chad bsdoms par lcags 'brug dam bca' gnang ba'i brgya rtsa brgyad po lhag dang bcas pa legs par song bar gong gi lha grangs kyi ljags bsnyen zhib cha'i tho ma rnyed cing dam bca'i ljags bsnyen brgya (63ba)po dang rgyun bzlas mi the ba'i snga phyir mang tsam mdzad pa'i bsnyel tho'i snying po bsdus pa 'di lta ste/skyabs 'gro bzhi khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya/ sems bskyed sum brgya/ yig brgya nyis 'bum chig khri dgu stong brgyad brgya/ badz+ra satwa drug 'bum tshig khri maṇ+ḍal nyis stong nyis brgya/ badz+ra gu ru sa ya gnyis dgu khri bdun stong / tshig bdun ma bzhi khri bdun stong bdun brgya/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyi sku bstod skyabs gnas ma sum khri brgyad stong bdun brgya/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku bstod mkhyen ldan ma —332

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / phyinachig 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong bdun brgya/ 'jigs byed kyi snying po sa ya gsum sum 'bum sum khri/nye snying bdun 'bum drug khri drug stong drug brgya/ kā la rū pa bzhi 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya/ gsang 'dus kyi sngags chig 'bum/ mi g.yo ba'i sngags bzhi 'bum/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags drug khri/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring thung stong phrag re/ dun nyis stong / sarba ྅ pa tshig khri nyis stong / pad+ma saṃ bha ba'i sngags 'bru bco brgyad pa sum 'bum sum stong / yig drug bye ba gcig sa ya gcig nyis 'bum drug khri lnga stong / 'chi med 'od snang gi gzungs drug stong / drag sngags so lnga pa tshig 'bum sum stong / rdo rje gro lod kyi sngags bye ba gnyis dang chig stong / drag sngags bcu gnyis pa sa ya gcig dang bzhi 'bum/bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi che mchog gi gzungs sa ya gcig dang nyis 'bum/ mgon po'i yig bdun sa ya gcig dang nyis 'bum sum khri bdun stong / lha mo'i
