sngags brgyad khri/ bod rbad khri tsho lnga/phyag rdor gtum po'i sngags sa ya gcig dang bdun 'bum/ /(64na〉skrub mchod kha thor ljags thog nas song ba la/ kye rdor bdun cu don bzhi/ bdag med ma lnga/ bde mchog nyi shu rtsa dgu /dus 'khor bco brgyad/ 'jigs byed nyis brgya dang lnga/ gshed dmar gnyis/ gsang 'dus bdun stodon dgu /ma hā mā ya gnyis/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bcu bzhi/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor lnga/ 6bu ṭi lnga/ nā ro mkha' spyod bdun/ in+d+ra mkha' spyod gnyis/ mi tri mkha' spyod gnyis/ phyag rdor gtum chen bco brgyad/ bka' brgyad bcu drug /thugs rje chen po nyis brgya bcu bzhi/ tshe dpag med dze tā ri'i lugs brgyad/ kun rig lnga/ sgrol dkyil brgyad/ 'od zer can ma bcu gcig /rig byed ma brgyad/ mi zhakhrugs pa nyi shu rtsabazhi/ bla ma drag po gsum/ rnam rgyal stong / 'chi med 'od snang bcu dgu/ bskang gso kha thor la gur mgon la stong dang lnga brgyad bcu gsum/ lha mo la stong dang sum brgya don gnyis/ zhal la stong dang bzhi brgya nga gsum/ las mgon pu tra dang bcas par brgya/ beg tse la sum brgya so bzhi/ las gshin la drug brgya re gcig /rtsis mgon la so gcig /beng la brgya dang zhe brgyad rnams cha shas tsam yin 'dug rung rjes 'jug rnams kyi mig rgyan la phan nam snyam gyis bris so/ /—333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skad lta'i zha lu mkhan chen kun spangs pa de skabs ri phug gi dbu mdzad chen mo yin pa thun 'tshams su gsung gleng dang bcas 'phral 'phral phebs shing dkyil 'khor re'i ljags bsnyen rdzogs 'tshams chos bka' phar gsan tshur gsan kyang cung zad gnang ngo / /'tsho ba chog shes rgyal (64ba)sras phu chung pa/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par brje nus 'chad ka ba/ /rab 'khu dam chos 'tshol la bag ston rje/ /rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol ba brag phug pa/ /hūṃ 'od nyang ban thugs las nyer 'phros pas/ /hūṃ sgra'i nga ro cher sgrog gter ston gyis/ /hūṃ nag chos kyi bdag por bka' babs zhes/ /hūm̐ mtshan thugs dgyes ngang nas ljags ring brkyang / /yom yom gling dgu'i rgyal khams 'dar ba'i tshe/ /rngam rngam rdo rje srin po'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /thibs thibs bsam ngan 'chang ba'i sbyor rtsub mun/ /'jigs 'jigs mngon spyod rta ljang can des sangs/ /kun bzang bla ma'i chos kyi gdung gsob ched/ /kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs kyi dben gnas su/ /kun dga'i mdza' ba ster ba'i bsnyen sgrub la/ /kun tu lhod med lo gsum bcad rgyas bcings/ /lha sngags ye shes rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas/ /lha tshogs rang zhal gzigs sogs ngo mtshar ltas/ /lha mi'i blor 'das cho 'phrul dpag yas kyang / /ltar bcas 'gro khyod mi mngon brdzul brten/ /cher rlom mang zhig rdul phra'i yon tan la/ /la 'ur ltos zhes mkha' la 'phyar mthong tshe/ /tshe rabs du mar goms pa'i dam pa'i tshul/ /tshul min rkun po'i nor ltar sba 'di mtshar/ /me khyi'i dbyar sde pa bkra shis rtse pa mchod yon mjal thog lha sar grongs pa yar 'dren la gdan drangs chog pa dgos tshul dpon sa sa sde pa bsod nams rab brtan la snyan 'bul zhus pa khrol bar brten gdan 'dren gdos drag gshis lo gsum mthengs pa dang 'grig pa'i de (65na tsher phul du chibs kha bsgyur te bkra shis rtse chos ster phebs/ ser tshogs kyi gral dbu gnang nas dge sgrub kyi dngos po thams cad don ldan snying por smin pa'i 'bras bu sbyin bdag 'khor bcas gnas skabs lha mi dang ring min 'khor ba mtha' can du mdzad pa'i re ba yongs su bkang / rta lug tshor mchod yon du —334

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)zhu 'bul ma gnang ba'ang gnas skabs su thugs su ma chun pa'i rnam pa 'dra zhig tu mchis rung ma 'ongs pa'i 'byung 'gyur mkhyen nas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag pa gor ma chag /de yang bod du 'gyur ro cog gi rgyal ba'i bka' rnams las rgyud sher phyogs mdo lung sogs kyi rgyun sngon nas dar na'ang mdo mang gi lung shin tu dkon par gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyis stengs pa lo tsā ba rgya gar du 'tshol bar btang ba dang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches spyil bu ba stag ston shes rab 'od zer la mdo mang gi lung dag pa zhig 'tshol bka' gnang ba sogs lung rgyun mtha' dag shab pa bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims kyis gsan zhing bar skabs su rin po che grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gces par 'dzin pa'i sngon byon dam pa du ma'i bka' drin las dar rgyas su gyur pa dus dbang gis rim gyis 'grib cing grub mtha' so sor yang rang rang gi chos lugs kyi kha 'dzin tsam las sangs rgyas kyi bka' rnams spyi rta sgal ral bzhin du lus pa rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs (65ba)kyi srol 'chad nyan rtsi sman ljon pas 'thud pa'i snying stobs kyis khur phrag par bzhes pa'i rgyud 'bum dang 'dul lung gnyis ngor dang gong dkar du gsan zin kyang / sher phyogs dang mdo mang gnyis phyogs kun tu 'tshol ba gnang bar/ 'thor klog lcags ri ma/ dba' bshur ma/ thog mtha' bar gsum sogs nyan bshad kyi gzugs brtan tsam las mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ma byung ba sde pa rnam gling pa sdom brtson tshogs gnyis dpal grub la mthar chags su chad med kyi klog lung yod pa'i khungs chod par brten khra tshang pa chen po mkhas grub blo mchog rdo rjer g.yu pad gser dngul sogs sku chas kyi mthun rkyen gya nom pa dang bcas lho brag phyogs su rdzong bda' gnang ba dhī tsha sprul pa'i skur bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub kyis lung phul ba'i sher phyogs rdzogs mtshams dang 'grig pa'i skor gcig gsan ma thub rung mdo mang rnams rdzogs par byung ba dam pa'i chos kyi skyes bzang po dang bcas byon par sa byi lo gsan/—335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāyode'ang nged rang tshar lugs snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi chos la shin tu mos na'ang yul dus gnas skabs kyi mos pa lam byed du lus shing zur thams cad mkhyen pa zab lam nā ro mkha' spyod gsan bzhed pa nye skor tshor gsan yul gzhan ma rnyed pa'i chos rje rab 'byams pa kun dga' lhun grub kyi zhal slob dge slong ri khrod pa zhig la yod pa khungs chod rung / de la nyams len las spros pa'i 'chad nyan tshad ldan yong mi yong som nyir gyur pa'i ngang la lus pa'i mur 'a zha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa zha lu nas sku mtshams (66na)grol 'phral phebs lam du bshad drags pas skya babs kyi sku ma bde ba la rong nas drung 'tsho dbon po gdan drangs pa'i sku'i 'phrod bsten dang mchad yon gyi dgongs babs thugs lhus ma things pa'i mngon chung lta bur bzhugs gshis me phag gi dbyar bar gnas tshul zhib pa ma thos shing ston mjug nye len gyi yi ge phul bar lan tshigs bcad ma zhig byung bas/ 'di ga nas bskul ma dang rje bla ma'ang phebs bzhed 'dom pa'i sa byi zla ba dang po nyis brtsegs kyi sngon mar yar klungs su thegs nas zla gcig gi bar chos sder bzhugs/ dpon slob gnyis sngar nas 'dris pa lta bu'i thugs nang dag cing dgyes rtser son pa'i zur kun mkhyen chen por kye rdor man ngag lugs ras bris la brten pa'i dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ nyams khrid shin tu zhib pa chos skor yongs rdzogs/ in+d+ra dang mi tri mkha' spyod gnyis kyi lung / rig byed ma'i thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang lha lnga'i byin rlabs/ tshogs bdag gi thun mong ba'i rjes gnang / dmar po skor gsum gyi lung / dmar chung skor gsum gyi rjes gnang dang / chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi lung / zhal bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang / gsang khrid ma gtogs rje tshar chen gyi dkar chag ltar gyi be'u bum dang ha la nag po'i skor sogs chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ gser chos kyi dmar po skor gsum gyi gdams pa zab grags ches pas mkhas grub chen po bod mkhar ba/ spyan snga rin po che/ cho se rje kun (66ba'i ga' lhun grub gsum sde pa dga' ldan pa'i bla mar gyur pa sogs 'phrin las ches pa la skyid lha/da phyogs su ngan dogs kyi dbang sdud yod zer ba'i sgro skur thugs la mnga' ba dang / phag mo gru pa dang shen —336

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)rdor seng gnyis kyi lo rgyus ljags lung gi dus gsan pas kyang rkyen byas rje 'di'i mchod gral du 'phel gdung bzhugs pa'i ba so'i ze'u zhig yod 'dug pa der dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo med dam dgongs pa'i thugs rtog 'phros pa mkhyen te gzigs 'bul dgos 'dug gsungs nas za ma tog kha phye nas spyan 'bebs phul bas mngon mkhyen la thugs yid lhag par ches/ tshur snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho la dag snang du slob dpon chen pos gnang ba'i tshe dbang hrīḥgacig ma gsan cing 'dod chos mang tsam zhu ba'i snyan gsan mdzad/hor zla drug pa'i nang du khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba skyid shod du chibs kha bskyod de 'bras spungs su zhag shas su bzhugs ring ngos mjal kha yar byung ba'i thog ma'i nyin chos kyi gsung gleng gnang ba tsam nas mos gus kyi dad pa lhag par 'phel/ chos 'brel dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshor grub chen dpal ldan rdo rjes gnang ba'i tshe dbang nye brgyud/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi yig rnying / pha chos nas chos thun gsum tsam/ sha ba ri pa'i lugs kyi zhal gyi las tshogs gang thob kyi lung rnams phul/ de nas zhang bde ba'i rdo rje'i bste gnas gung thang du phebs pa'i gzims khang shar du bzhugs ring gi gsol phogs dang dgos (67na〉6 mtha' dag gzhung nas bskrun/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa la in+d+ra mkha' spyod mi tri mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ gur mgon lha brgyad/ bstoganyis ma/ lnga ma/ bstobadun ma dang bzhi'i dbang / mgon po lha gsum/ brgyad ma/ bcu gnyis ma dang gsum gyi thun mong ba/ mgon po khro bcu rnams kyi rjes gnang / phyi 'khrid rdo rje brag rdzong la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi nyams 'khrid/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gyi gsang ba'i nyams 'khrid/me 'bar kha skong / gyi ljang / snyan brgyud/ dud sol dang 'i bcas pa po ti rnams kyi lung man ngag /zhal sgrub dus/ thun mong ba/ las bzhi/ bram nag shan pa drug skor rnams kyi rjes gnang / phyi 'khrid srung 'khor tshe sgrub/ nang gi nyams 'khrid/ de'i rgyab brten lung gi skor/ mgon po phur zhabs ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gtor skyong dang gtor chen sogs chos skyong che chung gi las tshogs thor —337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1te/bu'i lung / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin beg tshe'i rjes gnang dang chos skor/ 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang dang chos skor/ 'dod rgyal gyi 'dod pa lha'i rjes gnang /seng ldeng nags sgrol/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ khro mo sme brtsegs/ gnas bcu rnams kyi rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs sogs yig sna'i lung kha shas/ gter kha 'og ma'i bla ma gsang 'dus kyi zlum po bzhi dbang dang lung / bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/ phur pa spu gri/ bstan ma bcu gnyis/ pad+ma yang gsang khros pa rnams kyi dbang (67ba〉rung yongs rdzogs/ mnga' ris sku mched kyi bla ma bka' brgyud yongs 'dus kyi rtsa dbang dang sgos dbang thor bu de dag dang 'brel ba'i chos skor/ legs ldan rje'i drag po dbu dgu'i chos skor/ nyang gi drag dmar dbang chog rdo rje spyi blugs kyi dbang rdzogs pa/ dum pa brgya'i 'char ka sgrom bu ma dang bka' ma sprin shugs ma nyis 'dus gshin rje 'joms byed 'bar ba'i dbang / chos skor thor bu/ rnam sras sprin gseb pa'i rjes gnang dang sgrub skor/ byang gter gyi tshe dbang lcags sdong ma bkra bzang pa chos skyong bsod nams kyi phyag bzhes/ thang lha'i srog gtad/ thang stong pa'i tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster sogs zab chos mang du phul/ /de yang zur kun mkhyen chen pos sngon chad gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos bka' mang du gsan mod kyang nye lam shin tu dgyes pa'i nged la'ang sku 'khas thugs rtsol gyis khyab par brten da cha gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa'i thob rgya byung zhes bka' phebs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur du/ smin byed dbang gi chu bo mtha' dag legs par thob nas/ /de dag rjes su 'brel ba'i rim gnyis nyams su blangs shing / /dam tshig sdom pa skyon med srog bzhin gces par bsrungs pas/ /rdor 'dzin tshogs pa'i khrod nas mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug skyid do/ /rgya bod mkhas grub bla ma mtshan ldan mang du bsten nas/ /mdo sngags gsar rnying smin grol bshad bka' mang du thos shing / /rnam thar thos pa'i don mang tshul bzhin cung zad rtogs pas/ /mang thos tshogs pa'i (68na ji bus na mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug skyid do/ /zhes pa'i don 'di nyid kyi rnam thar du song ngo / /—338

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyanagung thang pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khrom la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang / ma ṇi ba rnams la thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang stsal/ bar der mong bza' khri btsun gyis btab cing slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa dang mnyam med jo bo chen po di paṃ ka ra sogs dam pa du mas byin gyis brlabs pa yer pa'i gnas mjal bar phebs te rten brten pa rnams la yan lag bdun pa rgyas par phul/ 'tsho rgyal phug tu gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma'i skabs sku chos la tshe chu thigs pa re gnyis babs po je 'phel la song ba nas dpon slob thams cad la mchod rgyu byung zhing snod du blug ste bsnams phebs rgyu sogs ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo des rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma khyad par can du gda'o/ /zur kun mkhyen chen por gsan pa bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i sgrub dbang / bka' brgyad bder gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang / rat+na'i klong gsal snying thig gi chos skor/ dam can skyes bu'i srog dbang lung bcas/ gshin rje tshe bdag lcags 'dra dang lcags sdig /khro chu/ dri med lhun po'i don tig 'gro ba kun sgrol rnams kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ rlung dmar gyi skor/ rdor 'bum chos grags kyi bdud rtsi bum pa dang / g.yu thog snying thig gnyis kyi dbang lung / brang ti'i ga dmasang ga dngul bre'i drang srong ser skya'i sgrub lung / sangs rgyas gling pa'i rnam sras ser chen (68ba)gyi srog dbang lung bcas/grwa pa'i zhang blon las tshogs kyi lung / las 'brel rtsal gyi bdud mgon gyi bas/'a gtad dregs dbang lung bcas/ 'bro lo'i khams gsum 'khrug byed rlung nag gi skor/ bram ze sdom bzang gi rlung 'khor bla ma zhang gi bka' 'bum pod bzhi bka' rgya ma dang bcas pa/ snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung bcas sogs chos bka' mtha' klas pa gsan/ 'di dang lcags stag gi chos 'khor gyi 'dus pa dang gnyis kyi gtso bo skyed tshal mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin yod par snang ngo / /hor zla dgu pa'i nang du khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba 'bras spungs su phebs nas pha dam pa'i 'chi med mgon por brten pa'i ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung gi gsung chog rgyas par gnang / rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur du/ yongs bla ma bsten pa mang na yang / khong slob 'khor rgyas pa'i 'ur rgyang can/ /—339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skasgrob gang che'i rjes su rgyug pa las/ /rje mtshan ldan bsnyen pa dkon na yang / /dpal rgyal ba kun dngos sgo rum pa/ /sras tshar pa'i zhabs pad bsten lags pas/ /bdag sprang po bsam bzhin skyid du tshor/khyed mched grogs tsho'i thugs la ji ltar gda'/ /zhes pa'i don ltar sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa la gus par byung bas/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos zab lung bder gshegs 'dus pa'i sku brnyan drung du mdzad pa'i skyon rin po che'i gsol 'debs kyi lung dang tshar chen gyi phyag dpe ngos ma'i ha la nag po'i be'u bum mgo thog tu 'jog pa gnang ba'i bka' bsgo zhig zhus phebs rdzongs gzabs (69na)rgyas dang bcas yar lam zur kun mkhyen bla ma dang zhal rgyas ngos rgod dkar la brgyud dpal zan g.yang lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por phebs te dbu rtse rigs gsum ya ka bla 'og /gling bzhi/ gling phran/ jo mo'i gling gsum dang bcas pa'i rten brten pa rnams la dkar me snyan shal sogasakyi tshogs gsog /bshad sgrub kyi ring lugs/ skye rgu'i legs byas 'phel ba'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba'i dus mkhan tshang pa dang rab byung ba rnams kyis zhabs drung sgar chen zhing khams gzhan du gshegs nas lcog tu rang lugs kyi bla ma phebs mkhan gzhan ma byung gshis da lam chos skyong chen po sku phebs dang 'grig pas ngos mjal 'gab zhus rung snyan dar dang dmod nas tsam phul bas 'thus rtsis la smon grong gi dre'u g.yar por btsad 'bangs pa'i mdzos brdungs pa ma mjal na 'bren pa'i brdar dgongs te lcog la phebs pa dregs pa yongs kyi sde dpon gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po khog tu brlams pa rdo skyags mgor bsu bar phebs nas khrom pa rnams lha rgyal lan gsum then bcug cing dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/sde pa stag rtse bas dung chen gsar brdungs spyan 'bebs zhus pa da res mkhan po byon pa dang 'grig pa rten 'brel gyi sgo yod pas phyogs bzhi nas 'bud du bcug pa/ ji skad du/ sngon gyi rgyal po grags pa'i gzugs/ /ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob/ /de nyid nye bar mi gnas kyang / /rang nyid nyams pa med la ltos/ /zhes pa ltar rje bla ma dag zhing du gshegs nas lo bco brgyad tsam slebs kyang sku gsung —340

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)thugs kyi rnam par thar pa'i (69ba)grags snyan phyogs bral gyi rna ba'i rgyan du je cher 'phel ba'i brdar mngon/ sngon dge slong nag po sogs kyi skye rgyus bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa nas byon te gu ru pad+mas gtsug lag khang gi srung mar bskos pa nas da bar ma nyams par mdzad lugs kyi rgyu mtshan rgyas par gsungs pa'i tshe rje nyid kyis shin tu legs tshul dang dge rgyas 'di bye ma'i gnod pas 'jig par nye ba chos skyong chen po'i rdzu 'phrul gyis zhi ba byung na zhes zhus pa'i lan du spyir 'gro ba'i las gtso zhing sgos su gzugs can gyi mis ma byas na nged gzugs med kyis dka' gsung / dmod nas dang bcas bstan 'gro'i phan bde sgrub pa'i 'phrin bcol dang 'gro ba rnams kyang mi dge bar spyod pa shas che bas mi lus thob pa'ang dka' mor mchis pa zhing bcu tshang ba'i rigs ma gtogs skye 'gro'i srog dbugs la gnod pa mdzad na mi legs tshul zhu ba gnang bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'i bya ra byed cing bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i dgra bgegs ni sngar yang tshar bcad da rung gu ru pad+ma'i bka' las mi 'da' de min sdug 'dres sems can tshor gnod pa ga la byed/ 'gro ba rnams kyis sdig pa mi dge ba bsags pa'i 'bras bu sdug 'dre'i rnam par shar ba yin pas bya thabs ga la yod gsungs par rjes su'ang thugs nges shes 'drongs par snang /sngar khyed kyis mdzad zer rgyu min kyang sdug 'drer dmigs pa'i srung mdud rma ngas na bar chad kyi rgyur 'gro bas mi 'gab tshul gsung ba'i shugs bstan ched du dmigs nas bskyed chog mdzad pa re gnyis la sngon rje btsun rdo ring pa chen por gnas rnying rgyal pos khas blangs pa dang 'dra (70na)bar sems shing slar sku rim sogs blang dor gyi lung bstan zhib tu mdzad/ rdo skyags mgo'i bar phebs skyel zhus shing mchod rten dmar po ba'i btsun pas stag lung zhabs drung phebs pa las 'tshub pa dang da res las 'jam pa ma dran zer ba ni/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las/ phyi rol gyi dregasapa rgyud gsum po/ /rang sems kyi rtsal du rang ngo 'phrod/ /yin lugs kyi shes pa lhug pa la/ /bzo bcosamed pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin gsang las yang gsang snying po'i man ngag gi che ba'o/ /—34/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skarim gyis bkra shis chos kyi sde chen por phebs/ zhol nas nang pa shod pa bas spyan drangs te nang mi dmangs la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gyi byin rlabs/ tshong dpon phun tshogs khyo shugs gnyis la lcag sdong ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang / rnam sras ser chen gyi rjes gnang stsal/dbang gtor gyi khang brtsegs de lo 'khor du bzhag pa sos ga'i tsha ba dang gtor ma bzhag pa'i nang der lo ro ba lnga tsam gyis mchod kong dang ting sogs blug pa'i me dugs rnams 'doms na'ang rgyan sprod kyi mar ma zhu zhing bag rdul gyis bkrag ma nyams pas mtshon skyon gang yang ma byung gnod sbyin ngal bsos po 'dod rgyal gyi lcags kyus bcug pa'i rtags mtshan mngon sum du gsal ba de'o/ /sa mo glang lor khyab bdag khra tshang ba chen po lho brag nyi lder dhī tsha sprul sku 'jig rten dbang phyug gi drung du sher phyogs skor gsan par rdzong bda' gnang / phebs sgo bzhin gsol chas rnams do bo rdzong nas 'tshems med du bstar/ dbyar zur kun (70ba)mkhyen chen pos yar klungs su phebs par mgon po lha brgyad dang bcu gnyis ma thun mong ma yin pa/ dud sol ma'i rjes gnang nan chags ma/pu tra/ ber nag zangs gri can phyi nang / bran bdud thun mong ba/ las sbyor gyi mgon po glang gdong ma/phyag rdor gos sngon can/ rnam sras ser chen smad lugs/ dkar bdud lcam bral rnams kyi rjes gnang /yang gsang khros pa'i rdzong chung tshe dbang / byang gter 'chi med 'od snang gi dbang / drag po dbu dgu'i rtsa dbang / tshe dpag med grub rgyal lha gcig bum gcig ma/ tshe sbyin dkar po zhag bdun ma/ tshar chen gyi bka' 'bum/ bla ma dam pa dang mus chen gyi kye rdor mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog bya bral ma/ sgo rum pa'i rnam thar rje mkhyen brtses mdzad pa sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos bka' mang du 'thul ba gnang / rje khra tshang ba chen po lho brag nas phyir phebs pa la brgyad stong pa ma gtogs pa'i sher phyogs yongs rdzogs kyi lung gsan dus gsung ngag lam 'bras dang rdo rje phreng ba sogs spyi bka' zur bka' mang tsam zhu ba'i snyan gsan 'bebs par sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis thugs khur bzhes nas rgyal rtse sman grong tshe dbang dar rgyas rdzong bda' mdzad/ sher phyogs kyi ljags lung 'phro gsan dgos —342

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)dang phyag dpe gzigs rtog sbrags pa'i thugs brel khyad kyi zla ba phyed gnyis tsam nas 'byon pa'i dus tshes bsgrigs/hor zla bcu pa'i 'gor rgyal khab chen po pho brang po ta lar phebs te thog mar rten 'brel gyi khyad nas tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams 'khrid dang tshe dpag med dkar po chag lugs kyi rjes gnang stsal ba'i snga dro li ma lha khang du (71na)gsung ngag gi khrid dang dgongs ja khar rang byung 'phags pa'i lha khang du dbang rjes gnang gi rigs rim gyis gnang bar gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad kyi nyams khrid smin rgyas/ rje dbang / lam dbang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang byin rlabs kyi skor rags rim/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ rgyab rten gyi lung / rdo rje phreng ba zhe lnga ma/ bde mchog lha i pa'i dbang bka' babs bdun ldan/ nag po pa/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bka' babs bzhi ldan/ bti shin rje dgra nag ra lugs bcu gsum ma/ gdan bzhi lha dgu bcu rtsa bdun ma/ bde mchog bong zhal can lha so bdun ma'i dbang / gsang ba 'dus pa sa lugs lha bcu dgu ma'i dbang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang brgyud pa sum ldan/ 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu ma dang ro langs brgyad skor/ ku ru kul+le lha lnga/ gur mgon lha lnga / ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ dam pa lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi dbang / dze tā ri lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha dgu rnams kyi dbang de'i sgrub thabs dbang chog bstod pa dze tā ris mdzad pa/ dkon cog lhun grub kyi dkyil chog dbang bcas pa'i lung / 'dod rgyal gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang / bram ze nag po'i mngag gtad thun mong ma yin pa/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang / de'i sgrub thabs sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa dang rjes gnang gi yi ge ngor chen gyis mdzad pa/ brtag gnyis/ tshe mdo le tshan gnyis/ mi gzugs pa'i rgyud rnams kyi lung / gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i rjes gnang / mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/(71ba)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga tshar chen gyis mdzad pa dang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gur mgon gyi sku rten bzhengs tshul rab gnas dang bcas pa'i lung / tshe dpag med grub —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)rgyal lugs kyi nyams 'khrid/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo 'od zer drug sbrags thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang rnams thugs dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas stsal zhing gser dngul gos dar ja ras 'bru sogs zang zing gi maṇ+ḍal chos yon tu bteg /de yang / kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las/ sprang po las ngan gyi dbang gis snyigs dus mtha' 'khob tu skyes kyang / /tshe sngon dag pa'i smon lam gyis mtshan ldan bla ma dang mjal nas/ /thos dka' rtogs par dka' ba'i zab lam du ma zhig thob pas/ lke yang 'gyod med kyi blo bde gzhan las lhag pa zhig gda' bas/ /dga' dga' skyid skyid mo gzhan la yid smon med pa zhig gda'o/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin/ sngon chad rdo rje slob dpon mang du bsten pa'i skal pa phra zhing cung zad rnyed pa'ang zhabs pad bsten yun thungs pa dang gzhan rkyen gyi 'jigs pas gsang thabs rkun nor ltar spyod dgos pa la nye lam de rigs kyi skyon dang bral zhing thos bsam gyi cha spyod yul yangs pa sngon bsags legs byas kyi 'bras bu dus su smin par ma zad dam pa 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag sngar dam bca' gnang 'dug pa'i don dang cha mtshungs pa'i zhal gyis 'ches pa la dpa' ba tsam ma yin par don mthun kho nar snang ba sha stag tu mthong ba dper na 'phyong rgyas zhabs drung dmag dpon lha'i dbang phyug gis bka' shog gtan tshigs thams cad (72na)ras su bor ba'i 'phyos lam rim pas bkra shis chos sde ba'i dkor sa'i gral khungs sogs phyogs pa chos sde ba rnams kyang re ba che zhing phyi yul nas bltas par yang babs 'brel 'dug rung phebs sgor kho rang tshor dkor skal za rgyu ni 'dug gral gyi rgyab mdun gang du bsdad kyang khyad ci yod ces zhu ba'i rtsom pa tsam yang mi mdzad cing sku sger don du gtogs pa rje sman lung pa sher phyogs gsan pa'i gsol phogs dang dbon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal phyag phyir bsdad chog pa'i dgongs khrol tsam ma gtogs zhu don mdzad pa ma mthong zhing dgon gra rigs sbyin bdag sogs re ba mkhan po du mar yang nged rang pher pher dang yong yong ba de 'dra lar mi dga' zhes zhu don gyi sna len ye mi gnang / bstan pa 'phel ba dang 'gro ba'i bde —344

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)skyid sogs spyi la phan pa'i zhal ta lhur bzhes shing / shes rab sdong bu las/ 'gro ba shin tu grangs med kyang / /sems can yon tan ldan pa dkon/ yul ljongs dpag tu med mod kyi/ /rin po che dag 'byung ba dkon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyad par dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang rig gtad nyams 'khrid la da lam long chungs pa'i dgag bya dgos pa yin zhes mtshon don tsam gyi bsdu ba dang 'di'i tshab 'dis 'ong 'di'i dod 'dis byed ces chos la dbang mi za bar so so'i lugs bzhin ma 'dres pa kho na dang ljags lung gi skabs dpe rnam grangs phra mo mang du yod pa'i rigs la bsnyel tho dang bstun nas gsan ma gsan gyi dbye ba 'byed pa las yi ge lhogs pa rgyu mtshan du byas te byung tshad ljags sgrog mi gnang / phyag len gyi rigs gang la (72ba〉dogs gcod zhus kyang 'di ni 'di'o zhes shig mdzub sprad pa'i nges shes kho na las mun nag 'dom 'jal gyi zol sbyor ci yang mi srid pas dbang rnon chos rjes 'brang ba'i dad pa brtan po'i gting tshugs so/ /thugs rje 'od kyi spubs gur bde ba'i lam/ /sa spyod rig pa'i khye'u chung dag zhing du/ /drangs tshe dge sdig gcig tu dkar ro zhes/ /las kyi me 31nga lta ba'i ngal ba btang / /mkhas pa'i gzhud lugs sa ha ka ra yi/ /snye ma nam mkha'i pha mthar yongs dud kyang / /sa bon thub pa'i gsung rab gces pa'i nor/ /bstan 'dzin phal gyis dor bas dgun chu bzhin/ /de tshul bzod min snying stobs ri rtse'i chab/ /brtson 'grus shugs kyis 'bab pa le lo'i rags/ /sdig to'i 'phrul gyis mi ldog chos 'tshol bar/ /mi zhus rgyal sras spyod pa 'di med byung / /bcos min nges par 'byung ba'i chos brgyad las/ /log pa'i thugs kyi sna de rab thung yang / shwakya seng ge'i ring lugs spel ba'i blo'i/ /zhags ring brkyangs mtha' bskal par rdzogs nus min/ /nyang ston rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug de/ /dam pa'i bzhed pa skong ba'i maṇ+ḍal/ /bteg tshe srid zhi'i yon tan nor bu'i dpya/ /phyur bur spungs te chos bzang mdun sar gleng / /gsar rnying nyi zla zung 'brel 'od po ches/ /'khor mun mthar byed las smon mthu btsan pos/ /zur chen rje dang stabs cig stan 'dzom pa/ /phan bde'i snang ba 'dren pa'i shing rta —345

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skabazhin/ /ma rig las 'khon 'jam mgon rim byon chos/ /ma dag 'brul ba'i dra ba gcod pa'i mtshon/ /ma lus (73na/sna gro gnyen sa skya'i bla chen gyis/ /ma smad snyan brgyud gser 'khor mkha' la 'phags/ /gnyags ban dz+nyā na'i sprul pa'i zlos gar des/ /mgon khyon pad+mā ka ra'i gdung 'tshob khrir/ /theg mchog nor bu'i cod pan dbur bcings nas/ /bkod tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun me tog gtor/ /bde chen 'dren pa'i las rgya mkhar chen bzas/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi bcud byin tshe/ /gnas 'di las gzhan ḍi ka ḍā k+ki'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i skyon yul de 'tshol rnams ngal/ /snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon tsi dmar bas/ /mgon khyod 'phrin las sgrub par zhal 'ches pa/ /lhun grub rten cing 'brel 'byung dung chen sgra/ /phyogs bral bu mo'i rna lung mdzes pa bzhin/ /bshes gnyen mngal du ma sprums stong pa'i sgra/ /grang drod las btsas khye'u dkar min 'bras/ /drang srong u pa'i re skong rgod ma kha/ /gtan mdun rgya mtsho skam pa'i cho ga ltar/ /'on te srid mang 'phrang bgrod dka' spyad kyi/ /bsod nams dzam bu'i shing 'bras mtshor lhungs pa/ /dal rten don ldan gser gyi phung po la/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang 'di la gcig tu rangs/ /snyan brgyud rim bzhi'i rten 'brel yongs 'grig pa/ /ma nub dbang bzhi'i lam las 'bras bur smin/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i chos kyi thems skas la/ khrid nas sku bzhi'i grong du bcug 'di mtshar/ /khu lung du yum bsnyun pa'i gdan 'dren byung bar brten lcags stag gi lo gsar gdong rong phyogs su thegs nas zla gcig gi bar byin rlabs sku rim dang 'phrod bsnyen gyi zhal bkod dang bcas zhal ngo rnams kyi dgongs pa bkang ste (73ba tshe nang 'gro ba'i mgon po'i bsti gnas su phebs pa'i dbyar ston gyi rings bzhugs/ gsol chas dgos cha rnams byi lo'i skabs ltar phul zhing zur kun mkhyen chen pos dbu mdzad don gnyer can du ma la gang blo ma/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo/ dus 'khor gyi thun mong sgrub pa'i lha gsum/ sman bla bder gshegs bdun/ phyag rdor u tsarla/ba ri'i rnam 'joms/ sme brtsegs/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngon/ rta mgrin ras chung lugs/ rta nag lcags —346

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)ral can/ seng gdong nag po/ dzam ser nag /spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ rnam sras drag po bka' shin tu gnyan pa/ gsang sgrub ljang ser be con can/ drag byed rta sngon srin mo bzhi skor/ nang gsang ltar sgrub pa lha dgu/ drag byed seng zhen klu brgyad kyis bskor ba/drag byed rkang thang lha brgyad/ mdung dmar can lha bcu gsum/ yang gsang drag po srin po bzhi skor/mthing kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor gnyis gar mkhan mchog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa lha brgyad/ gar mkhan mchog dmar smug zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa/ dkar po tshe 'phel lha dgu/ yang gsang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ gur gsang 'khrid rnams kyi rjes gnang / bran bdud kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/zhal sgrub dus thun mong ma yin pa/ khyung zhal can/ seng gdong nag po/ lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / phag dkar shes rab gsal byed dang rta mgrin skyer snang (74na)lugs kyi byin rlabs/ rdo rje nam mkha' ldings gser mig 'khyil ba'i rjes gnang lung bcas sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las sku'i rnam 'gyur dang sngags mi 'dra ba brgya bzhi bcu'i rjes gnang dang rgya gzhung gi lung / dus 'khor gyi bdag po chen po ma gtogs sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs/ gshin rje gdong drug /rnam snang mngon byang / rnam 'joms mthing nag lha bcu dgu /rigs gsum spyi/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun/ srung ba lha nga gcig /mi zhabrugs pa lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ sa phur lha khra'i stod las rnams kyi dbang dang smad las drag po'i rjes gnang / e dza ka ti'i srog gtad dang lung / ma ṇi ka nā thas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtser gnang ba'i gsar 'gyur skyon sku gsum sgrub pa rgya 'gyur de'i lo rgyus 'grel pa dang bcas pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zin bris kyi lung / dkar bdud lcam dral gyi sgrub skor/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi lung yongs rdzogs/ tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs/gsung ngag slob bshad kyi chos 'byung zin bris 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa/ tshar chen gyi kye rdor bskyed rim sogs chos sbyin rgya cher mdzad cing rje bla ma zur chan la snga 'gyur gtso bor gyur 347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6lopa'i zab chos mang du gsan/ dran pa nam mkha' dang gnubs chen gyi rnam par sprul pa dar rgyas chos sdings pa 'phrin las lhun grub byon par dpon slob gnyis gas lhan du paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi dbang lung / lho brag gu ru lha khang nas yang gter gyi skor/ rat+na'i phur pa yang gsang (74ba)bla med/ rtag phag gsang sgrub/ thugs rje chen po zhi drag lam gyi cha rkyen gsang ba snying po 'dus pa/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs rtsa gsum 'bras bu'i don 'khrid/ phyag rgya chen po mun sel nyi ma'i snying po/ skyes rabs lung gi lde mig sogs zab gter kha thor ba'i skor/ mnal lam dag snang gi skor/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gu ru mthing kha spyan mangs kyi sgrub lung / las 'brel rtsal gyi dregs 'dul sgrub thabs chig brgyud ma'i lung / kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i yid bzhin mdzod/shes rab me 'bar gyi rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol gyi dbang lung / spa gro gter ston tshe ring rdo rje'i rdzogs chen ci ti'i gsal byed nor bu'i dbang lung / dri med kun dga'i thugs rje chen po ye shes 'od mchog /lho las 'phro gling pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs sgrub kyi dbang lung /e spel lcog las 'phro gling pa'i bla sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang lung / gter ston 'jam dpal rdo rje'i tshe sgrub thugs kyi yang snying gi chos skor/ snang rtse ba'i tshe 'khrid yang snying 'dus pa/ 'jam dpal nag po'i yig sna gnyis/ gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa/ spo bo gter ston pad+ma rig 'dzin rtsal gyi nor bu pad+ma'i 'phreng ba'i gsang sgrub kyi skor/ zla ban gzi brjid 'bar gyi sngags sdebs snying gi me long zung gi tshung / rgya ban rdo rje dbang phyug gi bcud len gyi gdams skor/ sprul sku dam pa dmar po'i bdud rtsi bum pa'i bcud len skor/ bal po badz+ra mo ti'i rim srung / gu ru khyung nag gi gshin rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi za yig /gter ston bon po drag rtsal gyi rā hu (75na)la shis bstan pa dang rus sbal ser srung / lcang sman don grub dar gyi dug sman gyi gdams pa/ g.yu thog snying thig gi sman lha mched gsum ye shes khye'u dang bcab(pa'i rjes gnang / de bzhin du gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje la bla ma snying tig gi dbang lung sogs gsan zhing khong dpon —348

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)slob gnyis la phar yang bka' chos ci rigs stsal/ char 'bebs la zur kun mkhyen chen po dang chabs cig par tshal yang dgon du phebs/ zhang rin po che'i gzigs snang dang phyag bzor grags pa'i ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sku la khrus gsol dang bcol dam gnang bas mgon po'i zhal las bdud rtsi babs pa der 'khod rnams kyis mthong nas rgyu mtshan gsol ba na dpon slob rin po che phebs pas yin gsung / skyid shod pa lam nub she ma mkhar ba'i bu nad tshabs chen pos btab ste sman pas mi 'tsho bar thag bcad pa'i dus byin rlabs gnang bas nad las grol/ lha gdong shan kha ba'i ma 'chi bar thug par sngon gyi pha mes tshes gcig dpal 'byor gyis bsgrubs pa'i dur khrod kyi bdag mo 'dre mo ngan ne ma'i sgrub khang yod pa de'i 'bren dogs su mkhyen nas dur khrod bdag mo la thun rdzas dang bcas bka' bsgo gnyer gtad gnang bas de 'phral gzhi med du bde/ gzims khang shar du rtsis mgon gyi 'dzin gtor btsugs pa 'jig par nye bar gsar du brje ba'i sta gon gyi rnying pa bton pa'i shul gyi gtor snod bdud rtsis khengs pa mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan dang zha lu sher rin pa gnyis kyis longs spyod rgyu byung bas mtshon ya mtshan gyi ltas mang po zhig byung tshod du mchis/bkra shis rtse'i (75ba)dpon sa bsam yas chos skyong gi 'khor du skyes pa mkhyen pa'i tshe byang bzhu gnang bas khugs zin nas rjes snyegs la btsun pa dang a tsar 'dra ba 'ongs te phyir khrid song ba a lags bsod nams kyis zhus pas sang nyin glud sngon dus kyi srid pa'i dbyibs ji lta ba bzos pa byin gyis brlabs/ rnam shes khugs 'phral glud sngags rgya ting nge 'dzin gyis bsngos pa'i mthus lha 'dre'i pho nya rnams rab tu tshims nas log rjes lam ston rgyas par mdzad de dag zhing du bskyal lo/ /gung thang gi bka' chos rnams grol ba'i rje bka' 'gyur ba chen pos 'bras spungs su phebs/ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung gi gsung chog gnang / rje btsun rdo ring pas mdzad pa'i gur gyi gsang 'khrid/tshar chen gyi brag rdzong dang gsang 'khrid rgyun khyer gnyis/ rab gnas don gsal sogs kyi ljags —349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skalung dang / rgyal sras rin po che'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i steng nas nyams 'khrid mdor bsdus/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mang po'i phyag len dang phyag rgya 'ching tshul gyi skor sogs la dogs gcod zhib tu zhus/bsam gtan par rlom pa'i tshul 'chos mkhan 'dras gzhan 'byor phun tshogs ma bzod par byad rbod kyis rje'i sku la sdo ba'i sbyor ngan yod 'phros thos pas/ brag rdzong ma'i srung bzlog gi thugs dam gtso bor gnang dgos tshul zhus par snga sor gnad bsnun kha yar byas par bsam sbyor ngan pa yod 'dra bsam pa 'ga' zhig 'das song bas rnam shes 'dren pa'i nus pa dka' bas de rigs kyang las gsag par song dogs byed 'dun med gsung / dgun yar klungs phyogs su thegs/bong bu zhes (76na)pa lcags yos kyi dpyid gong dkar rdo rje gdan du phebs nas sku mtshams kyi bcad rgya yun ring du bsdams/ nged rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang tshogs chen la 'bul ba'i grabs yul gyi skabs su slebs pa sngar phyag len rnams la rtog 'jug dang dogs gcod zhib par zhus khul yin na'ang gsang sngags kyi phyag bzhes ches zhib cing phra ba dang rang re blo gros dman pa'i gshis kun rtog gi spros pa ban bun du shar ba'i yid gnyis rnams la dogs sel gyi shog dril phul bar bka' mchan zhib par stsal/ 'di lo char dkon pa'i lo tog rnams than pa'i 'jigs pas nyen pa thugs kyis ma bzod par rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i char 'bebs kyi phyag len gnang yang lha 'dre'i tshub lhongs lta bus phebs dka' bar dpal skyon chen po la gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs gnang bas klu dbang gling gi rgya dang mnyam pa'i sprin las char babs shing gzhan du sprin ma 'khrigs pas de 61 tshos las kyi bud shing la kha reg gi nag ba'i bcad pas khyung btsun khro bang pa'i de phyogs su yams dang lce 'bab pa sogs byung snang bas de dang dbyibs mtshungs par dgongs te rdo rje dpal gyi yum la gtor bsngos dang bcas dam bsgrags pas kha reg gi ri rtse las chu 'dzin dkar po lang long du g.yos shing thog mar drag char gyi lhongs che tsam dang bcas rim gyis sprin phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i char gyi rgyun chen pos myu gu'i tshogs kyi bskyed rab tu bsrings nas yul khams mang por 'bru'i —350

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)mchod sbyin don gyis stsal lo/ /chos sde 'di ga dang phyogs 'dus kyi don gnyer can kha shas(76ba〉pa gshin rje gdong drug /sangasargyas mnyam sbyor/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu rnams kyi dbang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang brgya rtsa/ gur lha bcu bdun/ bcu gnyis/ brgyad ma gsum gyi dbang / brag rdzong ma'i phyi 'khrid dang zhal gyi gsang 'khrid gnyis kyi nyams 'khrid/ rin cen gling pa'i nā ga ra ka'i rig gtad/ dbyu gu spun gsum gyi sgrub skor/ mgon pod nas kha shas kyi lung / mgon po ma ning gi char 'bebs/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dmar 'khrid/ rab 'byams smra ba rin cen rgya mtshor g.yu thog snying tig gi dbang lung / khro bo sme brtsegs dang khro mo sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang / dmar chen skor gsum/ skyes rabs so bzhi'i lung sogs chos bka' snga phyir du mar gnang /dga' ba zhes pa chu 'brug hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du nged rgya nag la 'gro ba'i ngos 'phrad la phebs nas gzims chung mgon khang lcang lo can du ring por gnas pa'i rten 'brel gyi cho ga rigs mi gcig pa gsum tsam zhig gnang / tshe dbang kha shas dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin 'chi med dpal ster gyi sgo nas phul bcas de ga'i steng nas nged rang gis kyang tshar gcig zhus shing 'phral yun gyi bslab ston mang du gnang bar rgya nag nas ring por mi thogs par ldog pa'i 'dun pa yod pas de bar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog las mi g.yel ba'i srung 'khor dang 'chad nyan la thugs rtsol gang che'i ngos gtso bor bstan 'gro'i gnyen du 'tsho gzhes kyi thabs tshul lhod med dgos pa'i snyan 'bul dang brtan bzhugs phul/de nas gung thang du thegs pa'i zla ba phyed gnyis tsam gyi bar zur (77na༄na chos kyi rgyal por gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang spros med kyi nyams 'khrid/ rwa chen gyi sgrub dkyil la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i lhan thabs sbyar ba'i rwa lugs thun mong ma yin pa lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang / rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi nyams 'khrid/ rwa chen shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi dkar chag tu gsal ba dang der ma 'dus pa'i kha skong bcas pa'i rwa pod/ 'bri gung dpal 'dzin gyi pod chung / bu ston thams cad —351—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6te/mkhyen pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i 'khrid yig za ma tog la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i kha 'byed lhan thabs sbyar ba'i rim lnga'i dmar 'khrid/ kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi bde mchog dkar po'i nyams 'khrid/ rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rjes chu bo ri nas gdan drangs pa'i bla ma sku gsum gyi nyams 'khrid/ 'khrid yig so so'i lung / gtsug tang dri med lha lnga'i dbang / bir srung nang ma'i byin rlabs/ jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing / gsar ma rgyud 'bum nas rgyud che chung bsdoms pa re lnga dang bcas pa'i ljags lung 'bul ba gnang /de nas la mor tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can gyi gnas khang du phebs/ chos skyong khog tu brlams pas bsu ba mdzad/ tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs gya nom pa bstab/ spyi sgos kyi dri ba gnang bar mkhan po rang gi thugs la lkog gyur gyi chos kun gsal bzhin du dri ba mdzad spyi sgos sogs bstod bsngags dang bcas sku rim gyis mtshon pa'i blang dor gnang rgyu'i lan zhib tu phul zhing khyed sngon rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang nas (77ba)gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam 'phrul yin zhes ngos 'dzin mdzad pa gter ston 'ja' tshon snying pos rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i khrod nas gcig yin gsung ba'i rgyab chos su song bas yid ches kyi gnas su nges/ bka' 'gyur gyi ljags lung gnang ba'i sbyin bdag sde pa sras gling pas mdzad pa'i sa dpyad grub na'ang / mtshungs med nyi ma gling nas kyis gong dkar rdo rje gdan rang du btsugs na gnas bzang zhing tshogs 'du che ba dang / bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i rten 'brel yod tshul gsungs pa ltar nam mthongs zla ba'i tshes bcu skor la kun mkhyen 'jigs med dpa' bo'i gdan sa gsang sngags kyi chos sde chen por thegs/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po'i gzim spyil klu dbang gling du rdo rje brag nas rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog /skyed tshal gong 'og gi mkhan po/ sna mo shag grub chen mi pham dmi sangs rgyas sogs phyogs 'dus kyi don gnyer can du ma dang rdo rje gdan gyi grwa tshang khag gi slob dpon 'ga' zhig brel bas ma 'byor zhing / rin po che nyi ma gling pas bskal bzang / dkon brtsegs/ 'jam dbyangs rnam par rol pa/ rnam par 'phrul pa/ pad dkar —352

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)rnam gsum sogs kha shas las tshang mar bsnyun nas 'byon ma thub/ de phyin chos 'chad pa rnams kyis gtsos pa'i grwa pa rags bsdus la 'o skol gyi ston pa rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po rdo rje gdan gyi spor bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i byang chub brnyes pa'i tshul bstan te mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par rol ba'i dus chen tshes bco lnga la thog mar rten 'brel khyad kyi mdo sde bskal pa bzang po nas (78na)rim pa bzhin dbu 'dzugs pa gnang ba de'i tshe nam mkha' thams cad dri ma dang bral ba'i g.ya' dag par chos sde'i khyon dang mnyam par chu 'dzin gyi nyi 'od mi sgrib pa zhig nas rgya gar skad du gsung ba dang lhan cig par sa sbangs pa'i char shar gyis babs shing sngar phan char dkon pa yod pa de nyin nas dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams dga' ba'i chos yon gyi ched du phab cing thag ring ba tshos mthong ba na klu dbang gling la 'ja' zug pa sogs bla ma dang chos kyi che bas gzur gnas rnams mi phyed pa'i dad pa la bkod/ mdo sde za ma tog gi skabs tshogs pa rnams la yig drug gsung ba/ ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo'i dus sangs rgyas kyi mtshan re 'dzin dgos tshul gyi bslab bya dang bka' 'gyur lce thog nas tshar re sgrog pa'i dam bca' 'bul mi kha shas byung / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la thub pa 'od srungs kyis gdul bya rnams gtad pa bzhin du nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba la sogs pa byams par yongs su gtad pa yin no sogs gsung skabs bdag cag la ston pa bde bar gshegs pa thugs brtse/ zhes spyan chab rgyun ring bar snang / des mtsho ni khyim pa byin rlabs zhu mkhan gyi rna bar byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs tshar re sgrog par mdzad/sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan la g.yar po zhus pa'i bka' 'gyur mtshal par ma dang / chos sde'i bka' 'gyur gnyis la zhar byung du zhus dag pa'i yi ge'i 'du byed dge slong 'phrin las rnam rgyal dang / gong dkar gyi glegs (78ba)bam khrod du ma bzhugs pa 'dra mtshal par ma'i steng nas lung gnang ba zhal snga nas brag sna bas sde par snyan phra phul na'ang yar bzhes rgyu thugs kyis bsnyel nas ljags lung gi bgegs su ma song bar gda'/ mdo mangs thor bu/ dkon brtsegs/ phal chen/—333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (te/sher phyogs skor grub nas/ de yang sngar ngor du bsgrubs pa gnang ba de phyag len mkhan slob kha skong tshang ma khungs btsun na'ang shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis yar klungs rnam rgyal du tshag mig mkhan chen dka' bzhi tshul khrims rin cen la bsgrubs pa'i sdom rgyun yin la/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi sdom rgyun la sa paṇa brgyud par bzhugs pa dang / phyogs de'i gdul bya rjes 'dzin la dgongs te smin drug zla ba'i tshes nyi shu'i gza' lhag pa dang skar ma rgyal 'dzom pa'i nyin snga dro sdom pa 'bul ba gnang ba'i brda chad tsam du tsar mo'i steng na bza' dkar po zhig bzhes/ phyi dro gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po tshul khrims bkra shis pas mkhan slob sbrags ma/ gsang ston skyid tshal 'og mkhan po ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ dus sgo ba rab 'byams chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ kha stong ba brag thog pa shākya mchog ldan sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su tshigs snga ma dge bsnyen nas bzung ste sdom gsum rim gyis mnos pa'i nyi ma ri rked la yod dus bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa thugs dzo/da la bstar/de nas zhag lnga tsam na 'dul lung khyim pa'i spyod yul du ma 'os shing rab byung sha stag dgos pa chos sde gnyis kyi grwa rigs nyi shu skor gyis (79na)nyi ma gling du sku ngo sbran pas rje tshul khrims bkra shis kyis da lam bskyar bzhes gnang nas yun ring ma song yang mkhan po'i bya ba mdzad dgos par gsol ba bzhin rje nyid kyis mkhan po/ mtshungs med nyi ma gling pas las slob bstar te rtses dang chen mo byang ma ba ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis gtsos pa'i bsnyen rdzogs pa kha shas dang rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che dpon slob lnga dge tshul du bsgrub pa gnang ba'i chen mo byang ma pa'i mtshan la slar byams pa bsnan te 'dogs par mdzad/ chos zhu ba po rnams kyis dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang thob gshis gsang sgrog gi nyes pa mi 'byung yang rgyud dang 'brel ba'i lha'i rig gtad lta bu byung na phyag len gtsang ba'i dbang du mdzad zur bka'i dkyil 'khor rjes gnang gi srol mi 'dug rung / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i kye rdor/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ he ru rkaḥphyag gnyis pa/ bdag med ma/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar —354

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyananag /phag mo lha lnga phyag rdor / mi g.yo ba/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa/ gur mgon/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ zur bka' sna tshogs yum/ khro phu'i 'jam dkar/ phyag rdor 'gro bzang sogs spyi bka' zur bka' skabs su gang babs nas rgyud sde tshan du phye ba phal cher dang 'brel bar sngon du rjes gnang re mdzad pa'i rgyud 'bum nas bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i sngags yas mas dkrugs pa rnams bsdebs pas mtshon mdor na chos bshad pa'i dus tshod snga phyi sogs gang la'ang thugs brel gyi rjes su mi 'brang zhing dpon slob rnams (79ba)kyi kun tu spyod pa yang mdo rgyud las/ ji ltar byung ba ltar bstan rgyun la dgongs pa'i thugs ru shin tu nga ba'i sgo nas chos sde'i rigs gra dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgrub mchod sogs la rta ma chag tsam dang gzhan ma nyi khyongs su gnang ba hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la legs par grub cing rten 'brel khyad kyis bstan 'gyur gsan khrod nas po ti gsum tsam dang / chos zhu ba'i tshogs la nyin re bzhin mang ja gnyis re chad med dang /kun mkhyen bu/ rje rdo rje gdan pa/ tshar chen/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse khu dbon rnams kyi dus dran la bka' 'gyur rin po cher brgya mchod/ tshogs su mang ja 'phar ma/ skabs 'gar chos ston mjug tu grol ston gyi tshim pa sogs bsdu ba rnam par bzhi'i sgo nas rjes su bzung zhing gnyug mar gnas pa dang glo bur du lhags pa'i khong nas rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che'i yab gzhis nas bsnyen bkur gzabs rgyas lan gnyis/ gzhan phal cher gyis mang ja'i thog 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i zang zing gi bdog pa maṇ+ḍal du bteg /mtsho sngon po'i sgar thog nas dharma khe ya tha'i ji bod du btang skabs nged rang nas 'phrin gsol dngul gyi rten ldan brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad dang bcas phul ba chos zhu ba rnams kyis shes nas la du btsugs te nyin star gyis gsung ba sogs rten 'brel 'grig cing gzhan don du dgongasanas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs su bsgyur te deng sang yang tshogs 'don chag med du yod snang /chos grol rjes rten 'brel gyi khyad nas skya ser gyi khrom chen po tshogs par phyi rol gyi rdo cal bzhugs —355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānekhri'i thog tu phebs shing 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi (80na〉dbu zhus zhu mchod/ grub rgyal lugs kyi lha gcig bum gcig la brten pa'i tshe dbang / da lam gyi chos 'khor 'di la brten pa'i 'chad nyan zhabs tog mthun rkyen sgrub so cog kun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams byang chub chen por bsngo ba'i yon bshad/bkra shis kyi mtha' brten dang bcas rgyas par stsal ba ni/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las/ gang 'di'i thub bstan tha mar gyur pa'i mthus/ /ji snyed chos kyi bka' babs chad gyur cing / cung zad lus rnams 'chad la nye ba 'di/ /bsams bzhin snying nas ma dga' shes par 'phyo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog la dad pa dang / /mar gyur 'gro la brtse ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rin cen sgron/ /spel ba'i thabs la snying nas spro bar gyur/ /zhes pa'i don dang mthun par mchis so /rin cen tshul khrims bkra shis dang gsung gleng la ri phug tu lo gsum ma'i skabs sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i lha rnams kyi bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol ba khyad par bya rgyud la legs grub kyi dgongs pa bzhin g.yal dang sbrid pa sogs byung na phreng skor gcig pu de grangs su mi brtsi bas mtshon phra mo rnams la'ang thugs ru nga tshul gsungs pa dpyod ldan 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyi thos 'dzin du gyur par ya mtshan du 'dzin zhing kho bo'ang rjes su yi rang ngo /nye skor nas zhing 'khyar kha shas gzigs pa hor zla bdun pa'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgrub mchod thebs su nyin gcig 'phar ba'i sbyor 'jags gnang / de nas mi ring bar rnam snang mngon byang la (80ba)nyer lngar gcod mi dgos pa rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin chos sde yas mas kyi grwa pa bzhi bcur dbang / gtsug dgu'i dbang cha/ grangs bco lngar dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang / rnam sras sprin gseb ma dang dzam la dmar po yum bcas kyi rjes gnang / skyed tshal 'og gzhi ba slob dpon pa sogs la spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi dmar 'khrid kyis mtshon 'dod chos kha shas stsal/ sngon chad yongs 'dzin mang por mdo rgyud gyi gdams pa rgya cher gsan yang lo chen rat+na bha dras/ chos —356

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)pa'i son ma yin pas thos bsam byas/ /cho so kyi rtsa ba yin pas gnas lugs bsgoms/ /chos la 'bras bu dgos pas smon lam btab/ /sgo gsum tha mal nam yang bzhag ma myong / /sngon chad ga dmasang ga brgya phrag du ma bslabs/ /'on kyang da dung gzhan la 'tshol bar 'dod/ /ces pa ltar slar yang ngoms pa med par thos bsam mdzad bzhed kyi chu mo sprul lo shar nas gtsang phyogs su gshegs zhor lcags zam sprul ba'i sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug gi drung du 'khrid brgya sogs zab chos kha yar gsan zhing / ngor e waṃ chos ldan/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya/ slob dpon chen po'i sgrub gnasari bo bkra bzang sogs su zhabs pad kyi phreng ba bkod na'ang / rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur du/bdud kyis dbang sgyur skal ngan ches mang bas/ /dam chos 'tshol la 'gal rkyen char bzhin 'bab/ /mthun rkyen mi 'byung byung yang stobs zhan pas/ /ji ltar bsams pa bzhin du grub ma gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngor mkhan (81na)chen shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas dang / bkra bzang pa chen po nam mkha' rig 'dzin gnyis sku na ha cang smin par ma gyur rung bstan pa'i gegs chags lta bus dag zhing gzhan dag tu sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsdus pa dang 'grig cing sngags 'chang bla ma sems dpa' chen po khri chen 'jam da byangasang ga dbang kun dga' bsod nams rtsa dkar gyi bsten babs lci ba sogs gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs la pi nā ya'i cho 'phrul cung zad nus pa'i dus dang 'grig pas chos gsan rtsis rnams bzhes pa dang mthun pa ma byung na yang bzhi thog tu bdag chen khri rin po che nas bdag rkyen tshad med pa dang bcas lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i bka' mchid kyi rim pa zhib rgyas su stsal/mchod khang dang mgon khang ches mang ba mtha' dag mjal bar phebs pa'i tshe dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa dang / 'jig rten khams su bde skyid rgya cher 'byung ba'i smon lam mdzad/ nged gong nas phyir 'bor ba'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du ngos 'phud la dga' ldan pho brang du phebs thugs dgyes pa'i gsung gleng bag phebs par mdzad/ byes lam du yul dus gnas skabs kyi rang dbang 'du —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)mi 'du dang gtso bor le lo dang snying rus gnyis tshong thebs pa'i kha ton dge sbyor byed blo rnams mos 'dun tsam du lus gshis chag med bzhi gsos shing / bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/ phyag btsal ba'i phan yon 'ga' zhig /gdugs dkar g.yin gyi mi thub pa/ 'jam (81ba)dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i dri med kyi srog shing 'dzugs chog rnams kyi lung dang / sngar gung thang du gnang rtsis kyi gtor gshoms grub mtshams gnam ngo chen po slo bur du byung ba 'ong gseb tu bsgor na dpon slob gnyis gar skur 'debs byung dogs kyi gzhol ba gnang 'dug pa da lam zhal gsang 'khrid dang shis bstan pa'i rjes gnang yang zhu kha/ rje bla ma dam par byang lugs phyag len gyi tshe dpag med lcags sdong brgya rtsa/ /rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa klong gsal gyi tshe dbang /chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi mtsho skyes rdo rje sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi dbang lung rnams phul zhing gter gsar gyi tshe mda' rtse sor gsum tsam 'phel bas sku tshe'i rten 'brel 'grig /rgya nag nas 'khor ba'i skyes ma dang chos yon sngags pa'i maṇ+ḍal rgyas par bteg cing yar lam gung thang du zhag shas bzhugs te rim gyis bkra shis rtse chos ster thegs/ da dung tshe 'di'i che thabs bsgrubs kyang 'grub par dka' zhing / grub kyang skyid mod ngang nas gnas ngan du mar 'khrid pas/ ci byas dam pa'i chos dang yang yang rjes su bstun nas/ chos brgyad spong ba'i thabs la 'bad pa bgyid pa ma gtogs/ tshe 'di'i mdun ma sgrub pa'i zhe 'dod med pa zhig gda'o/ /zhes rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung mgur las byung ba ltar/ lo sngon ma 'bras spungs su phebs skabs gsung gleng la da cha lo'ang mang du lon cing de bar sde dgon gyi kha 'dzin sogs ban tsun gyi g.yeng ba'i ngang du zad pa zhig byung ba tshe mjug 'di la dben pa bsten nas dge sbyor la chig sgril byed (82na〉twan yod gnang bar da dung dgung lo sogs ha cang gi mtho bar ma zin cing sku gzugs kyis rkyen mi theg pa'ang mi 'dug pas re zhig spyi sgos kyi chos rgyun spel bas mtshon par thugs las chung ngur ma song ba dgos tshul zhus shing shing rta chos sde pa tshor de mtshungs kyi bslab ston gnang ba grwa —358

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)rigs sbyin bdag skya ser thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa sogs gang ci nas thugs dbang ma 'dus par brten da cha tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa ma thub tshe g.yeng ba byed rin chog pa bgyid gsung thog babs su bka' 'gyur bzheng ba'i dgongs pa bstad nas shog bu sgrub pa'i sta gon dus sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyi gcung gsung rab rgya mtshos snag tsha dang spyig rgyu'i sig phul bas rten 'brel 'grig ces dgyes par gyur/ shog bu sgrub mi slebs pa dang mon nas sgo rdzog tshong ba gtos can yongs pa 'grig pas gnas po yang dus gcig la bka' 'gyur ldangs pa 'di 'dra yong ba thugs rje rang du rme | ba'i dad pa lhag par skyes te 'brabs kyi skyes phul nyid srung ba zhus/ la la dag thugasarig la steng shod med dam phyag rdzas stobs che ba med par thugs gra 'di bsgrig pa zhes thugs lhus ma things pa'i skur zhus byed pa byung na'ang rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos rdzing phyi'i zhig gsos kyi tshe dpon slob bcu gnyis kyi sku chas la zi gong brgyab par gser zho bcu gnyis las ma byung ba de nub rnam sras la 'dzin gtor zhig gnang bas sang nas yo byad 'bad med du byung zhing thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / paṇa chen (82ba po kya mchog pa lta bu'ang snyoms chung bya bral gyi ngang nas bkra shis lhun po/ e waṃ chos ldan/ gser mdog can gyi sdebatab pas mtshon 'phags bod gyi7 gang zag khyad par can rnams gnas skabs su 'dod yon la mi dgyes pas gsog 'jog mi mdzad kyang chos ldan gyi mdzad pa rgya chen po'i dus nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' 'byor ba'i shugs kyis 'bad rtsol la mi bltos pa'o/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug zang zing bdog pa la/ /phan tshun skyes su bstar ba don ldan du/ /byed pa'i ngang tshul mthong na dam chos nor/ /gtong len 'di ko dam pa'i rnam par thar/ /sngon du lo paṇa mkhas grub mang byon nas/ /rgyal bstan dar tshe rtsol bar ci zhig bltos/ /'chad nyan dgun gyi chu bran ltar gyur ding / /thos bsam khur gyi ljid la lhag par rangs/ /snga phyir 'gyur ba'i smon grol man ngag lung / /pad+ma'i skud par rdo rje bzhu blugs pas/ /srog 'tsho'i rig byed dran pa'i mkhyen dpyod kyi/ /—359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ketshangs ris grub pa'i lha de gzhan min drang / /sprul zhing lta na sdug nas 'ongs min par/ /skye rgu'i srog 'tsho sman gyi bla ma dngos/ /ging chen tshangs pas bsnyems btang gang gi zhabs/ /nam mkha'i snying por nges te gtsug tu blangs/ /lha min dmod pa'i lcags tim ma skyes par/ /gzur gnas blo yi dpal be'u snying ga mā /ri ma rab bkra'i skal ldan nabs so skyes/ khyod zhal bdud rtsi 'thung la lhag par rings/ /rnam gsum chos 'khor dus gcig yongs bskor bar/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams dga' mgur lta ba la/ /mdzor yi smin legs phreng mdzes dang / khor (83na〉srig dbang gzhu'i dra bas sbrel phyir brdzu/ /g.yas ru'i 'dzin mar 'khrul med lam ston shes/ thang zad tsam yang ma bzod lus med mdas/ /re zhig bzhed pa'i dka' thub 'jig nus pa/ /ches cher lnga bdo'i shugs de gang gis bzlog /'dam skyes 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma ltar/ /'khor gnas 'khor ba'i rgya las yongs grol yang / /slob lam slob pa'i ched du zhi bde la/ /nges par nges 'byung tshul gyis 'drid de ci/ /nam mkha'i ska rags ma nges 'ching dka' ba'i/ /grangs med 'gro 'dren thugs bskyed rdo ba'i ngos/ /bris pa'i ri mo semasacan zad pa'i mtha'/ /de srid mi yal rgyal sras spyod pa'i gshis/ /myos byed ces pa shing lug zla ba gsum pa'i tshes dgu la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs pa'i zhar byung du gra dar rgyas chos sdings su gdan grangs yab rje gnubs chen sprul pa'i zlos gar dang gdung brgyud bgres pa chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa gnyis la dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs dang dze tā ri'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang gnang / tshur rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub la gter chos ci rigs pa gsan te rim gyis dga' ldan pho brang du zhag dgu'i bar stan chogs pa'i dus 'khor bdag po chen po'i dbang / sis ra la brten pa'i bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ /bde mchog dkar po/ tog tse ba'i bsam mi khyab gsum gyi byin rlabs/ a lha'i bzlas lung / gur sprin gseb ma'i rjes gnang / sum pa lo sto'i blo sbyong dang tshem bu lugs kyi dmar 'khrid gnyis 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zin bris steng nas nyams 'khrid snga dgongs so sor smin rgyas/ rje btsun grol —360rgya

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)mchog gi 'khrid brgya'i skor yongs rdzogs/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi chos skor phal cher/bstan gnyis gling pa'i rta glud/ kye rdor dbang chog gi lhan thabs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ de'i sbyin sreg dang swā tsū 'debs chog kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses (83ba〉5 dzad pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i byang gter skyes bdun sgrub thabs/ sa ṭa rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ las sgrib rnam sbyong / rten 'brel snying po/ 'od zer can ma/ dug sel ma/ gdugs dkar mchog grub/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa/ ngan 'gro sbyong ba'i rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ mig nad sbyong ba/ gzhang 'brum zhi ba/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba/ mi rgod rnam 'joms/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/gza' yum/ nor rgyun ma/ tshe dpag med kyi snying po/ mi 'brugs pa'i rgyud/ stobs po che/ rgyal po mdo lnga sogs mdo phran kha shas rnams kyi lung zhus shing 'phrang 'go gter ston gyi tshe dpag med sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi dbang phul/ rim gyis gung thang brgyud de bkra shis chos kyi sde chen por phebs pa'i e rig pa'i 'byung gnas chos lung dkar po nas dpon yig mkhas pa don bdun bos par dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed dang thos grol gyi ljags lung / sa ga zla ba sku bltams pa'i dus chen yar tshes bdun gyi res gza' lhag pa dang skar ma rgyal gyi 'phro dge bar bka' 'gyur rin po che bzheng ba'i dbu btsugs pa'i tshugs ston rtses dang nas sna mo shag grub chen ga me sangs rgyas kyis bsnyen bkur brgya 'bul bzabs rgyas su bstar/de skabs yar shar nub tshor bshal rims mched pa'i shi chad kha yar byung bar sha brgya zan brgya gtong ba gnang bas yams nad rnams (84na)ring por ma lon par chad cing lhag par bkra shis rtse zhol du nad pa mangs par yig mkhan rnams tshab tshul tu gyur tshe srung ba gnang bas 'dzem med du phyin kyang 'go ba gtan ma byung bas mos pa lhag par 'phel/hor zla lnga ba'i nang du khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po slob bshad zhu ba la phebs par bka' 'gyur ma —361—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)grub pas 'dzugs pa gnang ma thub pa'i de'i ring sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ gsar ma rgyud 'bum/ gshed dmar spros med kyi 'khrid sogs 'bul ba gnang zhing / tshur yang 'bor lo sdom chen sogs dbang lung mang du gsan/ rnam sras gling pas gces sbyin bdag skya ser rnams kyis dubs ston gyi thog legs 'bul gyi bdog pa rgya cher bstabs pa'i tshogs gsog la brten phogs ja thug gi gtong chas mtshon dgos che mtha' dag ngang gis 'grub pa'i sgo nas zla ba phyed bdun du nye ba hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad la zhal khebs gdong dar glegs shing glegs thag glegs chab sogs cha 'grig legs par grub/gong dkar du ljags lung gnang skabs bka' 'gyur gyi nang nas byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan zur du phyung ba khri lhag bcas thor bkod pa 'di dang dus mtshungs su sa le sbram zhun ma'i khu bas bris legs phun sum tshogs pa gong gsham zhal khebs tog bcas/ shing par la brten nas zhal bkod gnang ba'i byang chub mchod rten bcu tshar mi tshad tsam/ nang bzhugs gzungs sngags sāts+tsha phyag dar ba'i 'bum phrag gnang steng nas gang 'gro dang gsol phud du sāts+tsha sogs kyis gtams par lhang (84ba)tser btul ma'i na bza' gsol te bla g.ye'i sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi thog 'og tu bzhugs su gsol ba rnams kyi smon lam gsung rtsom 'di lta ste/ lha rigs 'a zha'i dge slong byang chub sems/ /gsang sngags kun 'dzin mgon po bsod nams kyis/ /sngon byon mkhas grub rnams kyi rjes zhugs nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la yun ring rgyas phyir dang / /mtha' yas 'gro la phan pa lhur len phyir/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dam chos 'gyur ro 'tshal/ /dka' ba du mas kun nas lung nos shing / /bstan 'gror phan phyir lung yang 'bad pas bgyis/ /glegs bam thams cad dus gcig 'bad pas bsgrubs/ /bka' 'gyur nas bstan rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i sku/ khri phrag brgal ba'i gser gyi bris sku dang / sāts+tsha 'bum phrag byang chen mchod rten bcu/ /de sogs rnam dkar dri med dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag dang pha mo spun zla ming sring dang / /bran g.yog las byed khal khur dud 'gror bcas/ phan thogs yi rang dkar nag 'dres pa kun/ /sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs rnam mkhyen myur thob shog /ces pa mdzad/—362—

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyadade ltar sku gsung thugs rten rnams la rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po gnyis su med pa dpal dgyes pa rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtsho la rje rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi phyag bzhes kyis brgyan te rab tu gnas pa nyin gsum ma mnga' dbul gyi dus rgyas pa dang cho ga'i mthar lhag chad kha skong ba'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang bcas rgyal kun gsang ba rab 'byams kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa rten (85na〉rten pa lha'i tshogs chu dang 'o ma bzhin ro gcig tu mdzad pas phyogs kun bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur/ bris pas gtsos bzo bo'i tshogs yon rdzongs su gser gos dar ja ras g.yu byu ru spos shel go khrab khro zangs rta drel pho mo'i gos sna snam phrug sogs kyi rnyed pas blo'i re ba yongs su bkang ste tshim par mdzad/zla ba de ga'i tshes nyi shu'i rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor nas bzung mkhan chen zha lu pa khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'bras yul skyed tshal mkhan po byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ rtse tsho gos dum bu chos 'khor sogs phyogs nas 'dus pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa bcas dge 'dun du ma'i tshogs la dus gsum bder gshegs rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi yang bcud/ 'phags yul grub dbang birnya pa chen po la rje btsun rdo rje btsun mos mngon sum du gnang ba'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa/ gcig shes pas mang po grol ba/ skyon yon tan dang bar chad dngos grub tu blang ba/ ltas ngan g.yang du len pa/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba/ bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba/ sde snod gsum gyi de nyid shes pas gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu/ mchog mthun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gsung ngag rin po che'i 'khrid bod yul 'dir 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu 'brog mi lo tsā ba chen pos legs par bsgyur nas bzung bshad srol mi 'dra ba mang du byung ba'i gtso (85ba〉rdu rdo rje 'chang dang zhal gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa tshogs bshad dang slob bshad gnyis las rjes 'brangs mkhas grub phal cher la ma grags pa rin cen sgang pa gdung brgyud —363—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skasgos kyi zab chos lta bu gsang chen slob bshad kyi nyams 'khrid zab mo dbang byin rlabs rgyab brten lung dang bcas pa mtha' dag zla ba phyed bzhi lhag tsam gyi bar gnang rjes dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung so gnyis gnang ba'i dus kho bos ngor rdzong tshar lugs gsum ga'i lam 'bras thob pas rgyun gsum ga yod gshis gang 'dod kyi rjes su 'brangs chog ces bka' stsal zhing / me sprel hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la gegs med du grub pa ni/ /sbyang gzhi dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi'i zhing sa mchog tu gshin po/ /sbyong byed smin grol rnam bzhi'i chu lung rkyen gyis sbyangs te/ /sbyangs 'bras sku bzhi'i sa bon gang btab mchog tu legs pa'i/ /sa zhing mchog de'i 'dul sbyong bdag rang mkhas snyam bgyid pas/ /tha rangs thul med kyi zhing la yid smon med pa zhig gda'o/ /zhes thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung mgur las byung ba ltar shin tu smin pa'i grol ston dang rdo rje chos skyong rnams la gtang rag gi bskang bstod gnang ba'i mjug tsam du gzhan gyis bsregs pa po med par sha chen gyi dris bla brang steng shod med pa khyab pa'i dam can dgyes pa'i cho 'phrul ci yang mdzad/zha lu mkhan rin po che yang zhag shas bzhugs par bla ma bka' brgyad yongs 'dus kyi dbang sogs kha yar 'bul ba gnang zhing rje bla mas kyang nyer mkho'i dbang lung (86na༄ rigs gsan/ tshogs la bka' gdams kyi chos skor 'ga' zhig gnang skabs me tog ser po dang dmar po lag pas zin la khyad pa'i char babs/ sgo khang du khra 'brug chos skyong gi rten gtor yod pa lha mi'i bar du sel cung zad byung ba / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rten khra 'brug rgyal khang rang du skyel ba mdzad pa rje 'di la chos skyong gis sngar ltar dgos zhus pa'i lan ras gzhir kho rang ji ltar bzhed pa'i rta glang pags rigs sogs bris pa sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis brlab pa gnang bar dgyes te mkhan pos 'di ltar byung zhes mi thams cad la ston par mdzad/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs 'ol dga' chu tshan khar 'dred brdabs la gegs kyi rnam pa'i yar klungs su 'byor nas kyang skyed che ba ma byung ba dam pa 'di nyid kyis dbang byin rlabs mang du mdzad pas tsher ma dbyung ba ltar gzhi med du bde/ nub —364

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)cig mchod dpon gyis zhabs byug zhu skabs cing sgra chen po byung ba gang yin nam gsung bar khyi lta bu srog chags shig gi skad yin nam zhus pa na min pa 'dra thug gi skad yin nam gsung ba ltar phyin pas gzims chung steng du thug gsum yod pa'i dkyil ma rtsis mgon gyi thug de tsing sgra chen po rgyag gin 'dug rung mun pas sgra tsam las g.yin ma mthong sang zhogs ltas tsa na rdza ma nas khrag 'dzags pas sa gzhi la 'thor zhing rtsa bar khrag snyim pa gang tsam 'khyil ba chos skyong 'di shin tu 'go zhing bka' gnyan pa yod 'dug pa nas bstan pa spyi sgos kyi dgra bo zhig bsgral ba'i rtags su 'chis/sna mo shag grub chen pas bsam (86ba)gtan gling gi spyil por sri zhu'i ched du spyan drangs pa'i phebs zhor tshe chung 'bum pa mjal ba gnang dus tshe chu cher babs pa zla ba brgyad pa yin pas de dus yong ba'i skabs min rung byung bar ya mtshan du 'dzin/ me bya gtsang phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ sngags 'chang bla ma sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs rdul dbu gtsug tu bzhes nas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / zhabs drung nyid kyis mdzad pa'i phur ba'i chos 'byung sogs ljags lung mang du stsal/ gtso bor gsan bya rnam sras kyi be'u bum yin na'ang bsam yas kyi sdig khrab sgrog par phebs rings pa'i slar yong ba'i bka' bzhes gnang / zhabs drung khri thog pa ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dang rje btsun ma gnyis la'ang bka' chos kha yar gsan/ gdan sa dang kha'u bsam brling sogs kyi gnas gzigs gnang /rigs 'dzin lha khang gi 'gag tu ngor zur 'chad chos rje dpal gling pa dang lhan cig tu 'dzom pa da res rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i khrir 'byon pa'i rten 'brel byed dgos pa 'dug pas ja sngon la mchod gsung ba de skabs mkhan po yong ba'i dogs pa tsam yang med pas thugs khrel bzhin min nam bsam rung de nas ma 'gyangs par mkhan po byed dgos byung ba mngon mkhyen du 'dug ces thugs yid ches pa'i dper 'dzin/ bzhi thog tu zhabs drung rin po cher mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs rgyas par phul nas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga'i bar du bzhugs —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)pa'i bka' bzhes zhus par mkhan po rang bstan don la dgongs nas de tsam bzhugs (87na)na ni nga yang da ga bgyid de min nged rang gnyis lhan du 'gro ba yin phebs pa'i gnas tshul rje bla ma 'bras spungs su phebs dus gsung 'phros gnang 'dug cing sa phag hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la dam pa 'di dang bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la bdag chen rin po che me tog 'thor ba la dpags na bla ma rnam gnyis sprul gzhi gcig las bstan 'gro'i ched du spro bsdu mdzad dgos par sems/ngor mkhan chen rgyal rtse zhabs drung byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi drung du ba gu nas brgyud pa'i dbang byin rlabs/ rtsa ba ba gu chos drug sdong po phyag rgya chen po/ yal ga lam khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu 'chi med rang grol rnams kyi 'khrid lung sogs tshang ba gsan/ de nas rim bzhin khu lung du phebs/ de yang bla ma sog bzlog pa nas brgyud pa'i mdo dbang ches dar na'ang / sog bzlog pa'i zhu sa rigs 'dzin g.yu 'brug rdo rje shangs rta nag pa'i yul mi rnams la rgyus med pa'i dpyod ldan tsho the tshom gyi gzhir mdzad gshis rigs 'dzin chen po mnga' ris pa nas brgyud pa bla chen chos rgyal rdo rje la khyab bdag sman lung pas gsan pa'i bskul ma'ang bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis gnang zhing nye char rje sman lung pa gdan drangs te rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsan la spel ba'i bzhed pa ma grub rung rjes su rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul sku rin po ches khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen por gsan nas dbus gtsang khams gsum du dar rgyas kyi bstan pa'i me ro bslang ba yang rje (87ba)'di'i bdag rkyen las byung bar sems so/ /zur thams cad mkhyen pa hor zla bdun pa'i nyer lnga la pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i thugs dam 'dogs bcas 'bul ba dang rten bzhedas kyi gzungs bzhugs rab gnas la phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsan phul zhing zhal gyis 'ches na'ang sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyis byung na dge lugs pa zhig rab de min rnying ma ba zhig byung na mngon chung ba yong / sa skya pa'i rigs bos na mi yong ba'i bkag cha mdzad par brten skor cig phebs mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'bul mi —366

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)mngags pa gam pa lar mjal bas bka' las nged dpon slob gnyis sngon la su song yang rjes kyi bya ba byed pa'i cha don yod pa nas da lam nga la babs thob yod kyang rten 'brel 'phyugs gsungs nas ma mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad/ rngog zhabs drung mkha' spyod kyi gnas su gshegs pa'i gzhung sbrel shing du shar mar phebs/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'od zer gyi sku gdung dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa la me mchod dang gdung tsha bzhugs pa'i thugs rten gyi ljags bkod dang bcas skor cig stan chags/ngor pa'i khams pa bsnyen chen nyer gcig song zer ba gnam rab bsam gtan sgrub sde ba dge slong shes rab dpal bzang mjal bar 'ongs pa khyod kyi ga'u'i nang du ci yod kyi dri ba gnang bar/ byin rlabs min pa gzhan med zhus pas/ spyan cher gzigs nas de min pa zhig yod pas ga'u ston dang gsungs nas kha phye bas kho rang la gnag pa'i dgra la las sbyor byed bsams pa'i dug khrag gi rdzas thum yod pa bton nas mer bsregs (88na)pa gnang ba dge slong gi bsam par ngan sems de mkhyen song snyam pa'i blo 'jigs zhus pa byung skad/ mar lam rgyal grub gling 'og gi 'obs rags bsam grub sgangs ba'i bu mo 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba nye bar byin rlabs gnang bas nad gdon las grol te gzhi med gyur pa'i ming shi lhogs su 'dogs par mdzad do/ /bdag rgyud tha rengs zhing sar blo sbyong dang/ /dmar 'khrid gdams pa'i myu gu ci yang bskyed/ /nges gsang byin rlabs rjes gnang bklag lung gi /bka' drin byang chen de srid 'khor nus min/ /zas gtsang sras kyi rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bka'/ /rgyal blon lo paṇa mthu las 'gyur ro cog /bskrun la bya dka'i kun bzod khur mthong tshe/ /mi sngon rus sbal gzugs sprul gtam du zad/ /thub gsung las rnyed khri khrag brgal ba'i sku/ /byang chub mchod rten bcu phrag gzungs bzhugs can/ /sman ljongs yar klungs skye rgu'i legs byas su/ /grub 'di tshangs pa min pa byed po su/ /lus med thul dang de sras slob mar bcas/ /dag zhing rgya mtsho'i gnas kyi ye shes sems/ /spyan drangs mchod bstod me tog char babs par/ /lhun pos nyi zla'i sgron me bteg nas lta/ /bzo rig gtsug lag yangs por sbyangs pa'i mig /dri —367—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)med gsal ba'i dpyod ldan der tshogs la/ gtong ba'i phyag ring brkyang tshe ngal gsos bu'i/ /bang mdzod phye zhes legs bris mdun sar sgrog /bkra shis rgyal mtshan 'chang ba byang gling pa'i/ /yang srid rin cen bsod nams mchog grub sogs/ /snod ldan du ma'i sgra 'dzin dbang po sa /tshad ma bzhi ldan (88ba)snyan brgyud pi waṃ brdungs/ /tshul 'di'i ched du dgongs rtse nyer gtod pa/ /ma 'ongs brtse chen bla ma'i khyad par gyi/ /zab don bka' babs chu bo mi nub pa'i/ /dri bral ye shes gzigs par da gdod khums/ /legs ldan dgra srog la rngam khus sgra dang / /lhan cig dmar chen a lha chal chil 'dzag /rab smin 'bras bu khur du dud pa'i tshe/ /'dzad med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ci yang 'bab/ /'khon rigs 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i zhal gyi lung / /ro mnga'i bu ram snyan gyi bcud du mngar/ /bsod nas rgyal mtshan rje btsun e waṃ pa'i/ khrir 'byon lkog gyur gnas de mngon sum mkhyen/ /bskal brgyar tshe byin brlabs nus sa chen gyi/ /yon tan khyod kyis gzhan la dngom pa'i tshe/ /sngags 'chang che des spangs rtogs mnyam mo zhes/ /gang gi sbas pa'i rnam thar sgrog la brtson/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ba gu'i thugs kyi bcud/ /zung 'jug gar mkhan khyung po'i chos drug lam/ rdor 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan rgyal rtse bas/ /legs bshad mchod yon sbrengs pas zhal sgo 'dzum/ /theg pa rim dgu tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /theg tshul 'khrul pa med pa nyang rigs rjes/ /theg chen byang sems 'byongs pa gnas gsar ba/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol mdzad/ /mkhas grub chad med gdung byon rngog pa'i zhabs/ /dpa' bo'i grong du zhugs tshe rags pa'i pur/ /sri zhu bskrun pa'i bzhugs gnas mchod sdong che/ /rab bzhengs chos sku'i klong du thugs dgongs rdzogs/ / /de nas bkra shis chos kyi 'dus (89na)pa'i gling chen por phebs nas sa khyi ma rdzogs par stan chags/ de yang rnam thar gyi sa bon la lo tshigs zhib cha yod med sna tshogs dang yod pa la'ang snang la ma nges kyi dpyad mi bzod pa 'ga' mthong na'ang bla ma rags rim gong smos ltar yin la/ zhib tu ma 'tshal bar phyogs gcig tu bsdoms par rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra —368—

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)shis grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug /sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de sras kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug /lcam rje btsun ma/ zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku/ ra lung zhabs drung mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma/sger pa'i rin po che nyi ma pa/ sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/ chos rje 'od mchag pa/ chos sde'i zur lar pa kun bzang rtse ba kun dga' bkra shis/ chos rje mi pham blo gros sogs kyis mtshon pa rnams la sngags gsar rnying gi dbang rjes gnang 'khrid lung sde snod gsum gyi chos tshul mang du gsan pa dang ches nyung ba la lar bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshe dbang tshigs bcad re gsan pa yan chad la 'brom gyis se btsun dang mi las mar pa bsten pa'i rnam thar bzhin mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas gus pa lhur len pa las log sgrub dang bla ma'i skyon phra mo tsam yang mi 'tshol zhing thams cad yon tan du 'char ba lo chen 'brog mis gsang sngags kyi chos zab pa'i brdar bdag med ma'i dbang rdzogs re la 'bri bco lnga dang lha mo ral gcig ma'i rjes gnang re la 'bri g.yag re dgos kyi yod tshul mar pa'i (89ba)rnam thar du gsal ba ltar/ bla ma dang chos kyi che ba 'don slad du sri zhu kho na mdzad cing chos gsan pa tshor yang thos lo byung lo'i ming tsam la mi 'chel bar rgya bod kyi grub mtha' so so'i bzhed tshul gyi phyag len dang bshad thabs mtha' dag yong rgyu ba dang shes rgyu ba'i zag zog sbub ldir gyi rdzong gog ye mi 'dzin par mkhyen dpyod rnam par dag pas dpyad bzod kho nar gnang ste dper na rngeg lugs dang sa lugs kyi dbang gis dril bu dkrol lugs kyi mtha' brten pa spu ris phra mo tsam yang ma 'dres pa so sor dbye la/ ris med pa'i chos kyi rgyun dang gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa tha dad pa'i dbang gis gsan pa rgya gang cher gnang ba las gtso bor thugs nyams bzhes su dgongs pa dag byas so byung ngo tsam ma yin pa'i yi dam lha'i zhal mthong pa/ gsung gis gnang ba thob pa/ dam can bran du bkol ba/ rdzogs rim gyi lam la drod thob pa mdzad cing g.yin dag kyang gsan pa tsam du ma lus par so sor blo dang 'tsham par rgya cher spel ba'i zhal slob kyi grangs thams cad brjod par lta ba 369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)zhig bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen rags bsdus tsam brjod na/ dpal zha lu gser bkang gi gdan sa pa khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ glang phu chos rje 'jam dpal chos skyong dbang phyug /zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ khra tshang pa chen po khyab bdag blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin mchog sprul pad+ma 'phrin las/ rgya rtse bdag po byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ngor mkhan po thar rtse nam mkha' rin cen/ (90na〉ske waṃ mkhan chen dpal gling pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bye rdzing tshogs mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal bzang / gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ bang ri gter ston hūṃ nag me 'bar/ skyed tshal gong mkhan po byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ skyed tshal 'og mkhan po ngag dbang bstan pa/ dar rgyas chas sdings pa rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ de sras sprul sku gter ston chen po 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa/ rigs 'dzin chos dbang kun bzang / rje dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mtshungs med nyi ma gling pa rin cen tshul khrims bkra shis/ kun bzang rtse pa paṇa chen bsod na mas mchoge ldan/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ rab stims chas rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ mdo ba chos rje dge ba'i dbang po shar lung rab 'byams pa/ dge slong 'phrin las rnam rgyal sogs rdo rje gdan slob dpon dang zur 'chad pa tshang ma/ de sngon chos sde'i slob dpon paṇa chen lung rigs/ rigs 'dzin ga rma gsang sngags/ sna mo shag grub chen/sman sgom 'brang rgyas pa/ kre bo bla ma/ sgrub rnying bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan sogs mang du byung ba phal cher gyis gsung rgyun bzung ba'i phyogs kun tu spel nas bstan pa rin po che'i srog legs par 'thud cing la las tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng mtha' dag rgyang du bsrings te bsam gtan gyi ro myang ba/ 'ga' zhig gis 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa sha stag byung zhing chos zhu ba po mchog dman su 'dra zhig gis kyang na yam tsam ma yin pa'i don (90ba)du gnyer ba rnams la dmar 'khrid bshad bka' phyag len gang la'ang blor ma chud bar du skyo ngal med par yang yang bskyar nas ci chud mdzad/ dam pa 'di'i yon tan gyi khyad par ni sku mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i —370

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)mdzes shing brjid chags pa gzhan snang zil gyis gnon cing gang zag gcig la'ang mthong tshul ma
