nges pa sna tshogs su shar ba mthong ba tsam gyis nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rtog pa thams cad rang shugs kyis 'gags pa/ yid bde zhing bag phebs la dge ba dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan ngang gis 'phel ba/ rang gi mnga' thang dang longs spyod kyi ched du gdams ngag mi mdzad na'ang sems can gyi don du 'gyur na der ma zad lus longs spyod la chags pa med par gzhan don sgrub pa la mi skyo ba rgyal sras 'phags pa ngan 'gro'i gnas kyang mtho ris kyi dga' tshal du gzigs pa'i ngang tshul can/ chos zhu ba'i tshogs la phogs zur gsos mthun rkyen 'tshems med dang rang gnas su 'gro ba'i tshe gnang sbyin dang thos bsam sgom sgrub kyi bslab ston blo dang 'tsham par gnang bas dpon slob 'bral mi phod pa lta bu byung /tshul khrims kyi dri ngad 'thul zhing gshegs bzhud dal brel ran pa sogs spyod lam rnams lhun chags pa/ gsung gi gdangs che chung snyoms shing ha cang dal ba dang phul ba ma yin pa'i snyan nyid 'jebs la tshig 'bru gsal bas chos gsungs pa mtha' dag nyan pa po'i tshogs kyis tshig don rtogs par sla zhing blo 'khrul bas thos pa'i mod la tha mal gyi snang ba 'gags shing mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste rang dbang med par rje nyid ma gtogs mi (91na)re ba'i gus pa skyes pas 'brel tshad don ldan gyi sgo nas thar pa'i lam du 'dren/ rang bzhin gyi gsung gleng rnams kyang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen/grwa pa chos byed kyi rigs su ma zad sde dpon sbyin bdag tha na skyes pa bud med rang bzhin pa tshun la yang so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i ngos dge ba la bkri ba'i thabs min pa/ dmag /tshong / gshags/grub mtha' sna tsho gos kyi chos dang bla ma sun 'byin/ 'brel med kyi nyog gtam/ rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag kyal sogs mi gnang / chos gang gsung ya nga rang lugs ma 'dres pa ston pa las gzhan gyi lugs la zur mi za/ gsol ba 'debs mkhan ma byung bar bstan na chos btsongs pa lta bur 'gro zhes 'di bzhin yod pas nyon cig ces bskul ma mi gnang thos bsam sgom pa 'chad nyan sku —371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skagasung thugs rten bzhengs pa dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong nad pa dbul phongs la phan btags pas mtshon mdzad pa gang la'ang ngas 'di byas so ba'i yus mi 'dren/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rtags mtshan bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi zhal gzigs lung bstan dbugs dbyung mngon shes grub rtags sogs yon tan khyad par can byung ba skad mi gsung zhing gzhan nas de 'dra'i dogs gnas kyi dri ba zhus par mi dgyes pa sne tsam yang mi len zhing dman cha kho na gnang /thugs dam zhal gzigs ngo mtshar ba'i bsnyel to 'di sa bon tsam las dngos su zhal lung zhu thub na zab cing rgya che ba zhig yod rigs su snang na'ang da sgos 'di'i don 'grol bar ma nus shing rtog bzo'i na yams byas na skabs su ma che (91ba〉bas gang 'dug bkod par/ tshes bcu bzhi la bde mchog nag po pa'i sta gon tshugs sgrub cing mchod pa thengs gcig dang gzhan sgrub mchod bdag 'jug bcas par rdul tshon steng nas tshar bcu gsum dbang tshar gnyis yid ches par song /tshugs pa'i nub zhal bzhi pa li ma'i sku dang / grol ba'i nub sa chen/ sems dpa' chen po/ zha lu ba/bu d+dha bha dra sogs kyi bris sku dang skad cha za zir mang ba legs pa tsam yin rje bla ma gsung bas tshe gcig nyams len byas na/ byin rlabs yong ba e yin nam gzhan nam ring gi rmi lam la tig tig med/ med rang med/ rje btsun grags pa'i thugs dam mtsho skyes/ mi g.yo ba phyag g.yon rang mgo bag dro ltas bzang / chu sprel pad+ma saṃ bha'i bsnyen pa yid ches par song / gzhung gi rtags cung zad dngos rmir mthong / khye'u bla ma shel mchod rten/ bya zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum bzhi de pa la/ dbang phyug rab brtan bka' gter chos kyi mdzod/ hūṃ nag me 'bar thugs sras dam pa dang / sogs dngo shog dril gter gnas dang ras thums gsol 'debs la brtson na lo gcig gi nang du mjal zer ba dang /sprel lo dpyid zla'i tshes bcur yang zer/ tshes bcu gcig la mkha' 'gros gdan 'dren/ dbang lung man ngag ston pa yin zer ba dang / drag po'i zhal gyi sangs rgyas bstan pa la dgyes sogs mang dag go srin po'i 'jigs pas sngags ba las gu ru me tog dmar po la bdag dang sems can thams —372

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)cad du bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa las skyob tu gsol bas je bder song (92na tha dang / yid kyis nas bur thud sogs phul ba dang / bla ma rin po che'i thugs dam zhal sngo skya dang / de rjes mgrin snying sgrub dus mtheb tshigs tsam bdun/ gzhi nas tsam la g.yung rgyal sngo skya nas tsam gsal ba mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ ra tri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍom+bhi ni hūṃ phaṭa sogs dang / gdong bas can nag po bdag chen thugs dam dang / rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam sgrub dus mda' gang tsam mo/ /mkha' sngo sangs rang du bud med sngo nag dpral bar 'gron bu btags pa zhig gis da dung sgrib pa ma byang ba 'dug zer sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la bstad do/ /bi rū pa shin tu che gsal ba dang / sa chen na bza' 'od 'phro ba sngon po zhal ras dmar mdangs che bag dang bcas pa/ shangs su tshe dpag med dang / drag dmar yongs rdzogs/ bsam grub tu dbu dgu pa shin tu gsal ba/ 'dar mgon khang du nā ro pa mi tshad tsam/ yang phyon gyi thugs shar kye rdor lha dgu /mkha' spyod drug /zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu'i tho rangs phyon da lta ji lta ba rag la yang gter sogs yin snyam/ sgam/ bag shi /'ja' gur 'ja' skya 'dug /sa skya ba chen po gos sngon dwangs gsal rnyog med/ shangs su lhan skyes/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen las gu ru rgya dang bcas pa'i gru bzhi sgor mo gsal/ 'dar du tshe dpag med/ skye bdun grol 'phral skyon che zhing gsal/ pad+ma ni mi gsal/ thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig dang bcas shin tu gas/la/ yang sa chen gyi rnam thar yin yang zer skyon rnam thar yin pa'i (92bsko gul gyi byang shing / dkar thal srab mo yod pa la yig 'phreng bzhi bris pa rten khebs kyis gril ba zhig byung / de'i sang zab brgya'i po ti dwags po nas 'byor yang lan gcig gtor bsngos kyi skabs chos skyong thams cad zang nge dang zing nge nyams snang du byung / chos rje tshar pa zha thul ser po bzhes pa zhig kyang byung / gter sgo gter rtags kha byang btab 'dug brag phug 'di bzhin la dpags na zab gter bzhes rgyu zhig kyang yod par mngon/kun mkhyen bus/ rang nyid rgyal 'dod pha rol dma' dbab 'dod/ /g.yo sgyu'i rtsod pa tshig rtsub ngan sems can/ /ngag kyal sna tshogs smra zhing g.yin rgyud bsreg /da lta'i rtsod pa 'di yang dmyal ba'i —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (te/rgyu/ /zhes pa'i don ltar rtsod pa 'di gzhan dag rang gi nyes pa khas blangs nas spang blang mi byed pas phrag dog dang kun slong ngan pa 'phel te bstan sel gyi rgyu las med ces mi mdzad/ thugs rab kyi klong shin tu yangs pas tshig bcad lhug gang la'ang phun sum tshogs shing dper na dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon dkyil dang rnam sras lnga phrag lnga'i chog sgrigs ltar chos rgyun mi nub pa'i btsas su nges par 'gro na yang mi dgos kha med re gnyis ma gtogs gsar pa mangs pa dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab nub pa'i rgyur 'gro zhes brtsams chos po ti du mar longs pa yod skad kyi rang che mi 'byin/skya ser mang po tshogs pa'i sar rang nyid mkhas so'i grags pa sgrog ched dgos med du bshad pa mkhas nyams mi gnang zhing khyad par gsang sngags kyi chos snod ldan ma gtogs nor dang ngo bsrung gi slad du ston pa dang (93nasgo gim sgrags mdzad par ya shin tu nga ba'i gleng brjod dang de dang mthun par bka' dam par mchis/ thugs phra rags kyi bskyed rim la brtan pa thob cing rdzogs rim gyi lam bzang po'i grub mtha' stogs pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang lo chen 'brog mi lta bu'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas rnams brjod pa'i yul las 'das mod mdo rgyud kyi chos tshul gang la'ang tshegs chung ngu tsam gyis thugs su chud pas dus 'khor dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs dkyil 'khor shin tu che ba la nyin bzhi lnga/ bde mchog lo nag gur rigs bsdus kyis mtshon par nyin gnyis tsam/ dkyil 'khor chung ba'i rigs la nyin re'i bsnyel gsos mdzad pas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus tshig zur phra ba la yang skyon med pa'i rgyun gyi zhal 'don ltar byang chub pa dang thugs 'dzin gsar du gnang dgos la'ang sa glang 'phreng ba'i snyan gsan phul ba zla ba gsum tsam gyi khongs su sher phyogs kyi lung gsan pa sogs dang 'dom pa'i grubs dbar la paṇa chen thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i phreng ba'i mngon dkyil shog bu nyis brgya lhag tsam de shin tu byang ba thos lo zer lo ma yin par kho po'i mngon sum du gyur cing mdor na byin rlabs rjes gnang / rig gtad/ 'khrid/ man ngag gang gi skabs su'ang chags thogs mi mnga' ba blo chen tshangs pa rgan pos kyang 'gran par ga la nus/ chos mthun 'tsho ba med pa/ ya —374

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)rabs dmangs su babs pa/ rgyas shing khogs pa/ ngan song / nad pa/ dbul 'phongs nyam thag gi rigs rnams la rang (93ba)gi bu gcig pu ltar rjes su brtse zhing sku la bsdo ba'i dgra bor chos skyong gis 'phrin las rang shugs kyis bsgrubs na min pa 'khon 'dzin dang las sbyor dmigs su phug pa mi gnang bar theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong ba 'ba' zhig gis ltas ngan g.yang du len/ skye ba dang 'jug pa la dbang thob pas byang gtsang rong gsum/ gra dol yar shar nub nas rgyal nad spyo 'bog sogs gdon drag pos zin te sman pas bor ba du ma'ang bka' bsgo rjes gnang byin rlabs tsam gyis nad gdon rnams phyir 'pho ba dang rtsa log lung log gi gegs sel/ 'du ba rnam bzhi zhakhrugs pa sman gyis ma snyoms pa dag kyang gzhil te 'chi bdag gi kha nas phyir slog pa grangs mang ba thugs rdo rje'i ting 'dzin las su rung ba'i mthur sems/ dbang gi ye shes 'bebs pa gnang tshe lus kyi bud byed cing 'phar g.yo/ ngag gal zhing smra nyams/ sems bde stong gi ngang du lhan nor 'gro ba sna re nges par 'ong gshis da lta rang ye shes phebs byung snyam pa'i dga' spro mos gdung tshad med pa 'byung / sgam zhing dul la ngo lkog chung bas lan cig mjal ba dang rgyun du 'dris pa gnyis la khyad par med pa bka' gdams jo bo yab sras kyi rnam thar dang mtshungs/ phyogs phebs kyi 'chad nyan gyis gtsos pa'i gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las skyong dgos pa'i skabs ma gtogs don med kyi 'du 'dzi'i rjes su mi 'brang bar so sod lkog nyal gyi ci bder gnas pa la mtshams kyi ming btags pa'i chen po rnams kyi spyod tshul bug sgo 'dag 'byar gyi khongs nas yig 'grul dang mdun gshoms/ mtshams yun ring du bcad kyang da lam (94na)dmigs bsal gyi gal chen byung zer ba tsho dang mi 'dra ba'i thog mar ji tsam bcad pa nas bzung grol ba'i dus la ma sleb kyi bar du dam bca' las mi g.yel ba lhur mdzad/ thugs brel dang sku bsnyun pa gang gi'ang rjes su mi 'gro bar bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong sogs kyi spros med dang cho ga /ljags bzlas/ gtor chog /dus gtor bla ma rnams kyi dus dran gyis mtshon pa/ zhag re dang zla re'i star chags rnams la thang lhod ma shor ba'i ci —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (yemadzad rgya bod kyi paṇa grub kyi rnam par thar pa dang mthun par snang ngo / /'di lo'i dbyar sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i me tog la shin tu mnyes shing de'ang rten gyi drung du mi bsgrig par sku'i rgyab mdun g.yas g.yon khor yug bskor ba la spro bar mdzad pa ni 'og min sogs kyi gnas rnams su me tog gis brgyan pa'i bkod pa bshad pa dang mthun pa'i zhing khams gzhan dag tu gshegs pa'i brdar snang / mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs la nyin gcig kyal ga'i tshul du nga shi na skye ba blangs dga' 'am/ ma blangs pa dga' gsung bar de 'dra mi gnang ba zhu/ rnam rtog kyang za de bzhin byung na skye ba bzhes pa rang las dga' zhus pas khyed rang tsho bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang bsams bzhin srid par skye ba bzhes pa ni ngo mtshar che shas kha g.yin ma skye ba zer tshad ni ya mtshan rgyu rang ci mchis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'khor bzhin par 'dug khyo ga khyed tsho dang nga mi 'dra bas ltos shig gsung ba dang g.yin yang thengs 'ga' re de dang dbyibs mtshungs pa kha yar gnang ba lo rting ma gzugs (94ba〉sku rags pa'i za ma tog bsdu ba'i brdar snang yang phyag phyi rnams la rtog pa 'phros tshod du mi gda'o/ /rang che khengs pa'i ri bo mthon po'i rtser/ /legs bshad gtam gyi chu bo ga la 'drongs/ /gzur gnas thugs kyi gaX|nga bur mdo rgyud kyi/ /mkha' glang gzegs ma phyogs brgya nas 'bab 'khyil/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug gtan bde'i don po cher/ /rloms na chos nyid bden ston thub pa yi/ /bzhed 'bras gsung las skyes pa'i slob bu'i tshad/ /rgyu skar grangs kyis gzhal yang rtogs nus min/ /mthong bas mtshan dpe'i mdzes sku mi mthun bral/ /thos pas drug cu'i dbyangs snyan rna ba'i dpyid/ /dran pasasrid zhi'i 'jigs skyob chos kun gzigs/ /rnam 'dren yon tan tshogs rnams gcig bsdus 'dra/ /chags bral tshul khrims dri lda nga nyan thos gzugs/ /g.yin phyir lus srog gtong phod rgyal ba'i sras/ /bdag med gtso mos mgrin par rtag 'khyud pa'i/ /sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di ko su yis bskrun/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i rjes 'gro chos brgyad gdon/ /phra mo'i shas kyang gang thugs ma gos pas/ /ci mdzad dam —376

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyanapa'i chos su nyer 'gro bar/ shwakya seng ge'i rnam thar dpe slar 'os/ /mthon po'i grub mtha' snyogasate zung 'jug skur/ /bzhengs par nges kyang da dung slob lam la/ /sbyongs zhes dman cha 'dzin pa'i zol sbyor 'di/ cher snyigs gdul bya'i snang ngor dgos sam snyam/ /zhing gzhan bzang po'i skal ba can gyi 'gro/ /'dren la spro ba'i rtse 'jo rgod pa'i brda/ /rtogs min yid srubs mthu las kun dga' bo'i/ /gsol gdab (95na〉rtog tshogs rags pa 'gags pa'i spun/ /sgyur byed ces pa sa phag hor zla dang po'i nang dus dpal ldan 'bras spungs su gdan drangs te mdo dbang gis gtsos pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi zab chos mang du zhu ba'i rtsis yin na'ang gnas chung chos skyong chen po khog tu brlams te da lam chos bka' sogs rgyas par tshugs na khyed dpon slob su rigs la gegs che ba 'dug pas skor cig 'then pa'i slar rim gyis btsugs chog tshul gyi zhib cha sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs la gsungs 'dug pa bzhin rje bla mar yang de ga'i rgyu mtshan phul zhing zhag bdun tsam bzhugs ring ljags lung thang thung 'dra dang chos dang 'brel ba'i gleng mo gang 'phel zhus legs ldan rje'i shangs mtshal gyi khu bas brdzis pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku khyad can de gnang / da lo sku dog yod par sku rim dang chos sder sku mtshams gnang rgyu yang tshe sgrub dang bsun bzlog la ched gnyer mdzad dgos tshul gsol ba na/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur du/ tshe ring lo brgya thub pa dang / tshe thung da lta shi ba gnyis/ /rnam pa'i sgo nas khyad par che/ /ngo bo'i sgo nasabazang ngan med/ /thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam yin/ tshe ring thung gang dga' ma dgar shog /da 'chi ba la 'jigs pa mi gda'o/ /zhes pa'i don dang mtshungs par dka' las da cha blo sbyong ba'i lugs yin pas/ na ba dga' na na ba byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs lung 'dren dang bcas na shi gson bde ci byung yang dkon cog la blo bkal nas shi dogs pa'i rim gro byas na dkon cog la yid ma ches (95ba)par 'gro ba 'dra gsung bar gcig tu de bzhin yin kyang rgya bod kyi dam pa tsho'i rnam thar la brtags tshe dgag bya dgos dbang gis nges pa mi 'dug pas re zhig gi bar du 'tsho zhing gzhes na spyi —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skasgos mtha' dag gi bstan pa'i srog shing tu 'gyur nges pas thugs sna bstungs pa de ltar mi legs tshul nan tar gsol ba na bka' bzhin bsgrub gsung ba rjes su byas tshe g.yin ngo bsrung bar 'dug /rje rdo rje gdan pa'i dus kyi mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag bris mdo dbang gi tsa ka li rnams ras bse las grub pa'i ljid che ba nas slar bka' dbang la phebs dgos phyin da lam 'di gar bzhag pa 'gab 'dra nyam ring pa rnams kyis zhus tshe khong dpon slob mthong chen po yod pas da res khyed nas rtsis 'bul zhu gsung / chu kha bar sman sgom 'brang rgyas pas gdan 'dren la phyin skabs bka' las da cha rgyun ring po rang stod pa mi 'char nges yin pas slar chos sde nas 'phros shig gtong bas de dus cis kyang yong thub pa dgos tshul gnang bar da dung bstan don la rgyun gang ring bzhugs dgos zhus pas zangs mdog dpal rir skyon chen po'i g.yas g.yon du bzhugs khri rim par bshams 'dug pa la rje rdo ring pa chen po nas rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan yan bzhugs pa'i mthar khri stong pa zhig mchis pa bdag gi yin 'dug ces zhal gyis ma bzhes/ des na sku skye phebs dgos zhus par rje btsun kun spangs pa chen po dang sgo rum pa gnyis zangs mdog dpal ri kho nar bzhugs pa la tshar chen sogs bla ma yab sras gcig la gcig thugs chags pa'i 'bral (96na)mi phod pa lta bur yod gshis bdag kyang de mtshungs su sdod pas skye ba mi len/ 'phros 'di rnams bdag ma shi bar su la'ang bshad na mi yong ba'i dpang por dpal mgon 'khor bcas dang rang gnyis ga'i mdun na yod do/ /zhes lhag par stsal snang /de nub sne'u zhol gyi bzhugs 'tsher gyi thog nas 'bras spungs phyogs su zhal gzigs te ring 'i tsho'i smon lam dang mchog gsum dam par gsol 'debs gnang / sang nyin se mo do'i thang la phyag g.yog dmangs ma rnams sngon du brdzangs/ chibs shol nas mchod dpon dang byams pa gnyis kyis phyag phyi zhus nas sku ngal gsos shing de nas chibs thog tu khyon pa dang lhan du lam khyod la da lam tsam min pa yong mi dgos pa 'dug gsung ba byams pas slar sku mtshams grol nas phebs dgos —378—

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)pas de 'dra mi gsung ba zhu zhes zhus song ba bka' las khyed tsho mi glen par 'dug da lo nga rang gi snang rtags dang sku zhabs chen mo'i bka' gang la dpags kyang mi sdod par 'dug gsung zhing der ma zad zha lu mkhan rin po che sman khang nas la yang gtsang du rjes ma phebs dus gsung bgros byung tshod du mchis/ chos ster phebs nas nged rang gis rgyu mtshan gsol ba dang phyag g.yog sogs phyi nang mang po nas bskul ma zhus pa ngo ma bzlog pa'i gong dkar chos sder mang ja sbyor sbrel thog tshe gzungs sher snying gi bzlog pa/ bkra shis rtse chos sde'i mgon khang so sor bskang gso brgya rtsa/ bka' 'gyur sgrog pa/ la 'bum ther sogs bsgrub pa gnang / rdo rje gsum mi 'da' ba'i sku mtshams dam pa'i ngang nas thun 'tshams tshor gsan yig gi zin bris (96ba)phyag dper 'bebs pa'i yig mkhan chos sde ba'i gra pa chos mdzad rgyal mtshan bzang pos byas pa chig dril du gnang ma thub gshis po ti thung nge ba zhig gi rtsis las lhag ma rnams 'phror lus pas da lam rnam thar skabs su zhib par 'dri ba'i rngo ma thogs/ sku cung zad ma bde ba'i rnam pa la sman sgom 'tsho byed 'brang rgyas pa sku'i 'phrod bsten du 'bod pa gnang song ba rje btsun yab dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i nyams 'khrid sogs zab chos 'ga' zhig gnang bzhes pa'i bsnyad btags las 'phrod bsten 'gangs can 'bul ma dgos shing gsol sman kha yar phul nas gzhi med du song na'ang zhing 'dir bzhugs bzhed med pa'i mdangs kyi gsung gleng 'ga' zhig byung tshod du 'dug kyang yar 'byor nas sku khams bde ba'i gnas tshul las de rigs kyi zhi kha cha ma byung /lha rje 'brang rgyas pa rdzong bda' grub rjes nas bzung sku zo mdog sngar las bzang zhing yang zor che ba'i tshul mdzad na'ang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa rin po che 'chad nyan bsam sgom gyi sgo nas spel ba'i 'phrin las rgya cher grub pa dang snyigs mar spyod pa'i 'gro ba'i ngang tshul la gzhan snang tsam du nges par 'byung ba'i thugs sun snang skyo shas che zhing grangs med pa'i zhing khams rgya mtshor yid can rnams kyi don rlabs po che 'grub pa'i dus babs la gzigs te lo sngon ma'i hor zla —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)bcu gcig pa gzhol ba'i dbang du byas na hor zla dgu pa dang ba ded kyi smin drug zla ba'i 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta mngon dga'i zhing du gshegs pa'i dus chen yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin phan snyun du mngon pa ci yang med bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung mgur las (97na skol ldan rnams la kho bo snying nas mgu/ /de phyir dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /ma brjed snying gi dkyil nasagasol ba thob/ kho bos snying nas brtse ba'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /dus kun rjes su 'dzin no skal ldan tsho/ /brgyud pa bzang po sa skya pa yis zin/ /mes po mtshan ldan tshar pa chos rje bskyangs/ /ban rgan nga rang bslu med yin nam snyam/ /bu kun tsab tsob ma mang gsol ba thob/ /'di phyi bar dor bslus na kho bo zhan/ /byin rlabs che chung tshar pa chos rjes shes/ /'di skyid phyi mar a skyid nga rang shes/ /nga rang gang 'gro skyon pad+mas shes/ /chu 'go gangs la thug pa'i tshul yin pas/ /ji skad smras pa'i dge sbyor nyams len mdzod/ /ces pa'i don bzhin de nub drung du 'khod pa rnams la sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu gsungs/ chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab ston shugs 'byung dang nged rang la thugs mnyes pa'i bka' 'phros kyang kha yar gnang zhing so so'i mgo la phyag gis byil byil dang dbu thug gis byin gyis brlabs te gnas so sor btang / gtor gzhis rnams yun rings pas gsar du spo dgos 'dug ces bstab pa dang tshang ma chabs cig par spal gyi yang thog tu rgyas par 'bul ba mdzad nas byams par sang zhogs thor ja mi dgos da dung ja zhim po skol gsungs byams pas snyung ba bzhin med dam chab skol e bzhes zhus par na tsha med par chu skol ga la dgos zhes ba 'ad/ de nas srod thun la tshugs pa'i sgang mjug tsam (97ba〉pa 'da' kha ba'i ma'i rnal 'byor gyis mtshams sbyar te dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas me tog gi char gdugs dang ba dan rol mo sogs mchod sprin dpag tu med pas sna drangs nas bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i rigs kyi bdag por gdan drangs/ de'i dus —380

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)byams pa gzims chung du nyer len la bsdad pa'i gnyid thum pa zhig gi gseng la hig gi sgra byung nas bltas tsa na sku gshegs zin 'dug zer/ de skabs sde pa brgya tsho ba'i chos rje bkra shis lhun po'i sngags gra ba'i sgrigs 'grim pa de gsung chos zhu bar 'ongs pa de nub kyi rmi lam la stan dkar steng du rje nyid bzhugs pa'i zur bzhi nas bud med brgyad kyis bzung ste nam mkhar yer rer bteg pa thar ja 'dren mi la mdang nga la rmi lam 'di 'dra byung ba ci yin zhes blo ma bde ba'i rnam pa byed cing / dus mtshungs su zha lur khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyi 'od gsal du rje 'di nyid dgyes pa'i tshul du phebs ra ka'i phreng ba 'di thugs chags gnang ba zhu da nged la mi dgos pa 'dug gsung bar byung gnang / zhag kha yar gyi sngon tsam la stong ra ba'i mna' ma sde pa 'phrang 'go ba'i tsha mor gtogs pa rtsa sgo yangs pa de'i rmi lam dkyus ma dang mi 'dra ba'i gsal por byed pa zhig la rmi lam du nyi ma bzhud la khad lho nub kyi nam mkhar bla ma rdo rje gdan pa yin zer ba legs par btags tshe rdo rje 'chang gi sku'i dbyibs la sa zhu bzhes nas (98na)bden bral gyi mtshams su 'ja' 'od dang bcas yer gyis phebs song rje nyi ma'ang bzhud de nag thum byed pa rmis tshul de ga'i ma rgan mo 'phrang 'go ba'i spyil por sdod mir bshad pa zhing brjes pa'i skad cha tshor bas nga'i bu mo'i rmi lam de la lta ba 'dra zer skad/sku mtshams dang 'grig pa'i phyag g.yog nyung gshis nyi ma gnyis gsum gsangs pa'i bkra shis chos sde nas mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan dang sher rin pa sogs 'bod mi btang / tshes bco lnga nas nam mkha' g.ya' dag par 'ja' sprin ri mos bris pa lta bu lha sa nas gong dkar phyogs su zhag shas kyi bar rgyugs pa kun gyis mthong zhing gzhis ka rtser gad sgo zhang tshan gyi zi bun dang thug pa'i zla mjug nged jus rim gyi 'khor lo 'dri bar dga' ldan yang rtse'i sgo mangs phye ste yod dus kyang gong dkar phyogs nas 'ja' sprin pir gyis bris pa 'dra ba mang du mthong bas de mtshungs zla phyed tsam gyi bar du byung bar mngon/dpon slob kyi sku zhabs nas 'ongs zer ba'i bang chen byung ba'i rten gyi dril kha bshog pa'i nang du —381—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skali sku btags sman tse dang bcas sum tshan yod pa la phyag bris mi 'dug pas ci yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom du gyur pa rjes su byas tshe zham 'bring pa rnams kyis 'gyogs bsngor btang ba yin 'dug / zhag gsum tsam na sher rin pa thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten khyer nas byung 'phral bla ma dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa la mchod 'bul gsol 'debs rgyas par byas/ sku (98ba)gdung rin po cher snyan dar la smon lam tshigs bcad bris pa dkar me/ dgongs rdzogs kyi thebs su gos dar sha mar 'bru cha sogs bdog pa gya nom pa phul zhing dbus gtsang stod smad kun nas gdung 'bul gyi mchod sprin rgyas par spros/ gong dkar du gdung chog dang bkra shis chos sder chog gra'i rigs mang du btsugs/ drung chen byams pa dang mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs gnyis gdan sa gong du mngags pa'i dpal ldan sa skyar chos dung dkar po rgyang grags bus te mang 'gyed btang /bzhi thog tu bdag chen rin po cher 'bul bar rna ro'i ban+de gshin rje grags kyis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i sku brnyan gzhis ka sne'ur bzhugs pa rjes sor phyag tu phul ba des gtsos zang zing gi dngos po ring por brkyangs/ gzhan yang zha lu ngor chos 'khor yang rtse gsum gyis thog drangs dbus gtsang gi chos sde du mar mang ja bsngo rten/ yar klungs su ser tshogs sogs dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing gi gdul bya rjes 'dzin gyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rim pa khu lung nas sde pa nam mkha' don grub dbang po yab sras lcam sring 'kha 'bring ba rnams kyis legs par bsgrubs/dgung zhag zhe dgu'i bar lho nub mtshams nas nyin re bzhin 'ja' dkar ku sha bkram pa ltar byung nas sku gdung rin po che'i thad kyi nam mkhar gdugs phub pa bzhin gyur pa la kun ya mtshan du 'dzin/de skabs gtsang phyogs su bde gzar (99na)gyis lam ha cang bde ba med kyang 'di ga nas phebs dgos pa'i hung rgya lam yig dang bcas zha lu nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po phebs te hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis dgung zhag rdzogs pa dang bstun bla ma na rim gyi thugs dam rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa'i bzhed gzhung gshed dmar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla —382

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje sbyin sreg gi mchod pas mnyes par mdzad pa'i tshe ched du rtsol ba la ma bltos pa'i gdung yid bzhin nor bur ye shes kyi me rang 'bar lta bur gyur/ /de'i sang me tog gi char 'dra ba nyi ma'i 'og nas 'od skya sim sim gdung khang du nye bar mang du babs pa dmangs la cher mi yong ba'i rtags ya mtshan pa byung / pur khang zhal phye nas gdung skal bgo ba'i du rnga/ ring bsrel shel ltar 'tsher ba kha yar phebab//khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po thugs brel chod de 'dir byon dus ltas ya mtshan pa byung tshul tsam las bde gzar sogs kyi g.yeng ba dang rje nyid kyang yar thegs par ring khyad 'dug gshis zhag mang du sbrel ba'i 'di dus zhib cha ma 'tshal/ dngul gdung thebs kyi gser dngul g.yu shel gyis mtshon pa'i mthun rkyen gyi bdog pa gya nom pa bstab cing bka' 'gyur dang dgongs rdzogs la song ba'i lhag ma rnams dang bcas gzhis byes rnams kyis khur blangs te bkra shis rtse chos ster hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu nas brtsams pa'i sku rten sman 'dam las grub (99ba)pa'i mthong grol yid bzhin nor bu sku tshad dang mnyam pa/ gsung rten glegs bam yum rgyas pa dum po bcu drug mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs kyis thig rtsa bgyis pa'i thugs rten gser dngul las grub pa'i byang chub mchod rten thog tshad phra 'phul sogs bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa/ ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi dang gnod sbyin 'khor lo khyad par dri med nas gsungs pa'i srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse dbang phyug gi phyag bzhes ltar dbon mkhyen rab blo ldan/ mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ dge slong sangs rgyas dbang phyug gsum gyis lag bstar/ bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang zhig gsos la brten pa'i rgya dang dpangs bstod par bzhugs su gsol sku rten la bla chas cha 'grig /gsung rten dang gdung rten la khri/ thun mong du sa rgyan/ gnam rgyan/ mchod rdzas kyi rim pa tshar du dngar ba zla ba bzhi'i khongs su legs par grub pa la gong dkar chos sde'i chos 'chad pa rab 'byams smra ba rin cen rgya mtshos rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi —383—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loyotshogs dang lhan cig par kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa dang rten bzhengs gas la'i rmang 'ding ba tshang ma'i dus su 'ja' sprin/ than pa'i tshe char gyi rgyun 'bab pa sogs rgyal kun ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i ngo mtshar mtha' (100na pos pa byung / gnas gsar sde pa nam mkha' don dbang dang dbon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal yab sras gnyis kyis gong dkar rdo rje gdan du gzims mal sku 'dra rin po che gong mtshungs bzhengs te bla chas mchod rdzas rab tu gnas pas mtha' brten nas bla ma lha khang du bsgrigs/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse yab sras kyi gdung rin po che dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs pa'i mchod rten zhig dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid kyis dgongs par yod bzhin pa'i ngang du lus pa khu lung gzhis sgar gser dngul las grub pa'i khru phyed gsum tsam bzhengs par rigs kun khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyis gzungs 'bul dang gsung ram pa dang bcas rnal 'byor rgyud dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rab tu gnas te bkra shis kyi dge mtshan phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur to/ /zab chos dwangs ma dkar min me lha'i mthus/ /nyer spyod blo yis mngal las phyir 'phangs pas/ /slar brtson gaṅgā'i ltor smin ga rti gaḥ /thos bsam smyug ma'i tshal rgyu ring zhig 'gyangs/ /thub bstan srog gi zungs su 'tsho gzhes par/ /bskul gsol g.yin ngo bsrung ba'i g.yar khral las/ /ma dag zhing la nyer sun thugs kyi rtse/ /bde chen sal spro dga' su yis bzlog /'bras dkar spungs pa chos sder zhal phyogs nas/ /med byung rnam par dag pa'i smon lam gyis/ /mtshams sbyor bdag sogs bla/ med byang chub bar/ /mi gtang bshes(17ba〉sdu zhal 'tshes dam bcar nges/ /thos don mtshor 'phangs rdo ba bya lam rjes/ /dal ba'i 'bras bu tsam du ma 'jog ces/ phyi rabs dpyod ldan bskul ched gang gsan chos/ /ngo mtshar pu sta gaḥ /bsgrig cho ga bstar/ khri stan zur bzhi ḍā gis nye bar bteg /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun mas mchod sprin bcas/ /'og min zhing khams zhing gi rigs bdag tu/ /dpal —384

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / 6)ldan rdo rje sems dpar bzhengs de ci/ /thub bstan cha shas bcu gnyis yongs rdzogs shing / /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i tsha zer stong 'phro ba'i/ bshes gnyen chos dbyings mthun 'tshams gzhon nu'i phag /gzims pa'i dus kyi sgal ngan kye ma spyod/ /be+eḍūr zhun ma ltar 'phos mkha' ngos la/ /sna tshogs 'ja' sprin 'od dra'i ri mo'i mdangs/ /legs bris bkod pa bskrun pa'i sgyu ma yis/ /rjes 'jug mya ngan gdung ma gzhil lam ci/ /'on te gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul snyed kyis/ /bgrang bar nus min dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /mtha' klas sprul pa ston pa'i thugs rje'i spyan/ /bdag sogs gdul byar gzigs tshe yid dbang spro/ /tshogs gnyis nyal 'gro'i phung po'i chu gter la/ /dge ba'i klung gis gang bar bltos min kyang / /rjes 'brang legs byas zhing gi son ma du/ /'dzad med rnam dkar char rgyun chal chil phob/ /rigasabargya'i khyab bdag rje btsun zha lu pas/ /dus dgra 'jam dpal dmar po lha lnga dang / /sku gdung rin cen dbang gi rgyal po gnyis/ /dbyer med ngo mtshar mchod pa de med byung / /de ltar dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi gzugs bka' drin mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyab bdag rdo (101na)rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med pa gang gi rnam par thar pa ches phra ba ni spyan dang mngon par shes pa la chags thogs med pa rnams ma gtogs 'jig rten gyi byed po tshangs pa lta bus kyang brjod par mi nus na gzhan dag gis lta ga la zhig thun mong ba'i gdul bya'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i mdzad pa rags pa'i lo zla tshes grangs yul dang gnas sogs rjes 'jug rnams le lo'i mal du 'du 'dzi'i gnyid la g.yur bas zhib par ma rtogs kyang rgyus yod kyi tho thor bu dang yid gnyis su gyur pa mang dag khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po/ sgrub rnying slob dpon 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar chos sde'i zur 'chad pa dpyod ldan 'phrin las rnam rgyal sogs 'ga' zhig la dpyad cing gsan yig dang dam pa gzhan gyi rnam thar lo rgyus/ dus dang lo zla lung rigs kyis bsgrub nus pa dang la lar rung mthun kyang 'ga' zhig sbyar ba'i go rim bsgrigs par so skye'i snang la ma nges kyi zhakhrul par tshad bzung dka' na'ang phyogs 'gro tsam la yid brtan du rung ba'i lugs su bgyis te —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)rtogs brjod kyi rim pa cher long tsam bshad zin to/ /blo chen mes pos rig byed gtam gyi sbyor ba ma lus gcig tu bsdus/ /dbyangs can lha mo mgrin par byon te brjod pa rnam dag tshig 'phreng spel/ /brtan pa'i 'khor los gsang gsum mi zad yon tan bang mdzod sgo phye nas/ /bla ma mchog gi rtogs pa brjod las bdag 'dra'i blo gros mthu yis ci/ /lha lam gser ldan ri bo mthon po'i khyon/ /rab phra bug pa'i nang nas lta ba bzhin/ /'phags chen dam pa'i rnam thar ches brling yang / /rang blo dang 'tsham brjod la klan ka su/ /zas gtsang sras kya brgya phrag mdzad pa la/ /bsngags pa'i dpal ldan ma khol bsod nams kyis/ /phung po srid rtser 'phyur des yid drangs nas/ /ngal ba'i dka' (101ba)thub len la gcig tu spro/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i spangs rtogs mtsho ltar zab/ /sdugs snod tshig don a mra'i tshig gu tsam/ kho bo'i blo gros ku sha'i rtse bzhin phra/ /de phyir ma rtogs 'khrul pas nongs kun 'chags/ /de lta na yang rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba'i/ /mdzad pa'i cha shas mthong ba'i shing rta yis/ /mi phyed dad pa'i nor gyi dpya drangs tshe/ /srid zhi'i dbul phongs gdung ba pha mthar byed/ /'di la sgo gsum 'bad chen ngal bsten tshogs/ /mgon po khyod kyi dpal chen he ru ga'i/ /grong du nyer khrid kha sbyor bdun ldan sku/ /ring por mi thogs 'grub par bdag byin rlobs/ spyi dang khyad par tshar chen yab sras kyi/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan ring lugs bstan/ /ma pham dbus 'gyur 'chang du 'byon min bar/ /thos bsam sgom pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /de ltar 'a zha rgyal po'i gdung las bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mgon po bsod nams mchag ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de pa la bzang po'i rnam thar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng 'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhan chen zha lu ba rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyis ring po zhig nas bka' gnang zhing dbon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal dang mkhyen rab blo ldan gnyis kyis reg zig dang bcas snga mo nas bskul ba dang rdo rje brag nas rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog sogs dad 'dun can du mas mtshams sbyar ba ltar 'dun pa rtse gcig pa yod —386

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs 'phreng / (nyanana'ang kho bo don med rnam g.yeng gi yang bran du gyur pas mos pa lam byed du song ba nye lam rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab rin po che'i dbon rigs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bco brgyad chos rje byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i dbon rin po che nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ thub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam (102na)pa chen po'i gdung rigs rje drung ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs gsum gyis thog drangs skal ldan gyi gdul bya nyi shu skor la zha lu mkhan chen kun spangs pa chen pos skyid shod dogs bde lho mos gzhis gar mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i yang snying nges don snying po'i dam chos gsung ngag slob bshad rin po che rdzogs par stsal pa'i tshe dpon slob gsum gyis bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong du cis kyang rtsoms shig par gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas slob bshad 'dzin pa'i za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes ā na la zhes pa me 'brug nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor nas dbu btsugs na'ang zin bris la dogs gnas mangs pa'i phyogs kun tu dri mal gyi sgugs sdod la brten dal 'gros kyi ngos snron gyi zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes gnyis rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi dus dran gyi nyin rgyal khab chen po dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas/ par gyur cig/ // maṅga le// //—387

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo te/ra༅༅/ /'jam dpal dbyangs chos kyi rje dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan bsdo sdug bsdo/༄༅/ /legs byas snang ba rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' tshur mthong blo gros gzhal bar rab dka' bla med rin chen 'byung gnas che/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis rlung gi shugs kyis rang dbang dang bral zung 'jug gling du bde bar son pa'i rigs brgya'i bdag /mtha' yas lus can kun mkhyen khang par 'jug pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'byed phyir sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar las/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi cod paṇa legs 'chang dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba tsong kha pa la spyi bos 'dud/ /gang gi dri med bstan pa'i shing rta log par rtog pa'i 'dam rdzab tu/ /bying nas mkhas pa'i byed po phal cher dub pas btang snyoms la gnas tshe/ /thogs med 'dren po'i kha lo ba ru zur phud lnga pa mi'i zol can/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug dkon mchog chos 'phel thub bstan yongs kyi bla na mtho/ /lung rtogs lhun pos rab lci bstan pa'i sa/ /nyes bshad chu mtshor nub la mngon phyogs tshe/ /rnam dpyod rus sbal khur gyis bteg pa na/ /khyab 'jug skyengs te sum rtsen gnas su bros/ /bdag pas gzhan gces med byung snying rje'i gter/ /chos kun rjen par rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa'i klong / /smra ngan nag po'i sder bcas 'joms pa'i mthus/ /rigs (2na po sum mgon yang 'di las gzhan du ci/ /de phyir mdzad pa'i mkha'/ yi pha mtha' la/ /blo gros gshog pas gzhal ba'i nus bral yang / /thun mong snang ngor bstan pa'i lha lam ngos/ /snyan tshig 'phur lding bgyid la su mi spro/ khyad par rnam 'dren kun 'dus bla ma la/ /spel legs snyan pa'i tshig las drangs pa'i blos/ /rnam par thar pa'i bstod bsngags brjod pa yi/ /byed po dus mkhyen rgyal por tshul mthun snyam/ /bsod nams zhing gyur dge 'dun yongs kyi dpal/ /gang —388

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 'dader phyogs lhung nyin byed 'od dkar gyis/ /byed min dad pa'i ba ku la ldan pa'i/ /blo ldan rnam rgyal ngag gi 'od snon gyis/ /dam pa'i drin las gzhud lugs mang thos pa'i/ /za hor brje'i rna ba'i pad+ma dkar/ /phye bas rtogs brjod sbrang rtsi mngar ba'i ro/ /spel gyis blo gsal rkang drug dga' ston byos/ /de yang grangs med pa'i sku tshe rnams su mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rim par brgyud pa'i bag chags bla na med pas/ ches shin tu zab cing brling ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag kyang / lta ba po la mi dga' ba'i brtul zhugs kyis khro ba'i bzhin ras nag por ston pa'i mdud pa dbang med par grol ba'i ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba rnam dpyod kyi mgul (2ba)par bcings na'ang / dngos su mkhas pa 'di dang 'di zhes skye bar zhal gyis mi 'ches par skye dgu phal pa'i snang tshul dang bstun pa'i rdzu la brten nas/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub dam pa kun gyi mdzad pa ltar/ thos bsam sgom pa'i tshul la thugs gzhol bar gyur pas/snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba kun gyi dbang po chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po zhes grags pa'i rdza rnga srid 'di yongs kyi rna bar spud pa gang gi rgyal tshab dam pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i sras kyi mchog seng ge'i khri la dbang bskur ba ltar gyur ba'i thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag rje btsun dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rnam par thar pa'i mu mtha' kun mkhyen pa'i yul las gzhan gyi gnas min yang / rang cag rnams kyis ji ltar khong du chud pa'i tshul cung zad brjod par bya'o/ /sngon gnas rjes dran mkhas grub skye ba yi/ /rgyud las 'ongs min tshe 'dir sbyangs stobs kyis/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum kun rdzogs pas/ /brgya ba'i tshe'i yun mes pos ring por sprul/ /e ma 'phags yul mkhas pa'i bag chags kyi/ /bzang po'i cha shas yongs su gang min na/ /bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs su skyes pa'i mi/ /phal cher khyod dang mi mtshungs gang gi skyon/ /mi bsrun skye bos gang ba'i mtshan mo'i dus/ /dpag dka'i mdzad pa'i tshal rnams zum pa'i rdzu/ /rtogs brjod nyid byed dbang po shar ba'i tshe/ /zhig pa dngos po'i chos nyid yin lags drang / /'on kyang dam pa'i skye bar khas 'che nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i mthu dman zang zing gis/ /gzhan snang sgyur ba kho na skyabs bsten pas/ /—389—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (11)ljongs 'di gang tshe khyod kyi dad pa'i gsos/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ gangs kyi rdul mang brtsegs pa'i ri bo'i 'phreng ba khor (3na)yug kun du dkris pa'i ljongs chen po 'di rje btsun phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje'i zlos gar las/ bod dang por skyong ba'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung ste/ mes dbon rnam pa gsum sogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di bdag gir mdzad pa'i rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sprul pa nyag gcig tu byon pa rnams kyi dbu rmog btsan po 'jigs pa med pa'i lugs gnyis kyi khrims bzang po mchog dman skye bo kun gyi gnya' ba na lci bas/ phan ba de'i sman yon mtha' dag ngang gis 'du ba'i skabs/ ru bzhir grags pa las g.yon ru'i char gtogs shing / glang dar ma 'u dum btsan gyis bstan pa rin po cher rma cung zad phyung ba'i rjes su/ slar yang lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gtso bor nan tan du bgyid pa'i mdo rgyud kyi bshad srol mtha' dbus kun tu khyab pa las/ dus yun mi ring bar gnam bskos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i lung dang / rang nyid bsod nams kyi dpal mngon par bdo ba'i byed pos/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi rgyal khams mtha' dag la stobs kyi 'khor los rang dbang du spyod pa'i sde srid phag mo gru pa'i mdun na 'don rnams kyi nang nas/ bod yul 'dir bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa 'jam dbyangs thon mi sa sto ṭa'i gdung 'dzin nang so yar rgyab pa'i mnga' 'bangs kyi sa'i cha/ grwa rig pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rgyal po'i khrims btsan pos ngan spyod kyi skye bo mtha' dag rmeg med par 'joms pa'i drag shul gyis 'dzin ma'i khyon yang rnam par skrag ste/ mi bde ba'i gcong rong dang ngam grog mtha' dag rgyang ring du bskrad nas/ shin tu 'jam zhing khod mnyam pa'i khor mo yug tu dbyar gyi dpal mo rnam par ba 'ad pa'i rkang 'thung gi 'phreng ba yal 'dab 'bras bu'i khur (3ba)gyis dud pa/ g.yul ngor chas pa'i ru mtshon lta bur gzings pa'i brag ri'i tshogs kyis dben pa'i sa 'dzin phal cher margad kyi 'og pag gyon zhing / 'ga' zhig mtho ris kyi dpal mo'i mdun sar bsnyeg phyir ljon shing dang spang ljongs kyi gos dang bral bar byas nas zla ba'i —390

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)dum bu lta bu'i kha dog ngom pa'i yul gru dag gi char/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs pa mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba mi pham dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdan sa byams pa gling gi chos rwa dang 'dabs chags pa dgon pa zhol zhes bya ba yin no/ /'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i rang gzugs kun/ /rab dkar kha ba'i gzugs su chags pa'i ljongs/ /mkhas grub du mas nyer bsten g.yon ru'i cha/ /dge bcu'i yon tan mgron du 'gugs pa bzhin/ /bza' shing ra ba'i mgo lcogs ldem pa'i rtser/ /'bras bu'i khur du smin pa'i 'od mdangs kyis/ /rang min gnyis pa'i rgyu skar 'phreng ba zhig /bsgrigs snyam blta phyir mkha' la 'ongs pa 'dra/ /gnam sngon zhun mar 'khyil 'dra'i pa klu' klung / /nor 'dzin bu mo'i gos su klubs pa ltar/ /sgrol chil rlabs phreng g.yo zhing rgyu ba na/ /chu phran phal cher yul gzhan bros sam snyam/ /rdul mang brtsegs 'ga' 'chi med sar bsnyeg phyir/ /gcer bu'i rang gzugs gsal bar bstan pa na/ /phal cher skyengs pas dbyar skyes gzhen nu dag /sgrib g.yogs gos kyi tshul du byas min nam/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud don smra ba'i sgras/ /gsang chen nā da'i dbyangs kun der blangs na/ /'jam dpal grags pa 'di na ci bya zhes/ /zhus ste mi 'gyur bde ba'i dbyings su yib/ /de yang bod yongs kyi 'dren mchog rlangs lha gzigs (4na)kyi gdung las/ spyan snga grags pa byang chub lta bu yang / rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bslab sbyangs kyi tshul la thugs ha las par gyur nas/ nged kyi skye sa 'di 'dra ba zhes rigs rus srid 'byor mtha' dag nas mchog tu gyur pas kyang rgyal ba'i gsung rab la thos bsam sgom pa'i gegs chen po'i rkyen du gyur par grags pa dang / spyan snga ngag gi dbang phyug dang / bdag po 'jam dbyangs pa lta bu'i mkhas pa yang rgyal srid kyi ched du tshangs par spyod pa'i bslab pa 'bul dgos pa sogs rgya bod kun du rigs rus dang stobs 'byor la brten nas/ rab tu byung ste klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan bgyid pa'i mi mthun phyogs mang du byung ba'i phyir na/ shā ri bu'i smon lam du/ ha cang phyug po'i khyim dang ni/ /dbul po'i khyim du mi skye bar/ /bar ma'i khyim du skyes nas kyang / /rab tu byung —39/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)ba byed par shog /ces pa'i don ltar/ yab bkra shis rnam rgyal dang / yum lha mo gnyis kyi sras su/'phags yul du shrī mu kha zhes pa phyogs 'dir dpal gdong du grags shing / rgya nag po'i gtsug lag tu dbang thang dang bstun pa chu mo bya'i lo la sku bltams so/ /dri med ston gyi mkha' la 'od dkar can/ shar tshe rig smra'i bram ze dga' byed na/ /'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /bskrun 'di skal bzang yongs kyi dga' ston gnas/ /'khrungs nas dgung lo lnga drug man du/ /gung thang nas bla ma zhang gi gsung las myur du shog gsung ba'i snang ba dang / gsang phu dbyar chos la 'gro gsung ba sogs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung mang du byon/dgung lo lnga lon pa dbang phyug ces pa me glang gi lo/ yar rgyab nas sa skya bdag chen sngags 'chang (4bston po spyan drangs/ khong tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sogs bstan 'dzin yin nges tshor dgrar lta ba/ zhwa ser gyis bsam yas bar khang gi zhal ba 'phyi ba'i rdog phyis byed pa sogs mdzad pa sna tshogs la brten phyogs su ma lhung pa'i skye rgu spyi la bdag smyon sa rul du grags la/ 'ga' zhig slob dpon be+e ro tsa na'i sprul pa zhes bsngags rjod byed snang ba/ sde pa snang rtse ba'i lung bstan du 'dug kyang / khong gter brdzus pa yin par dgongs 'dus kyi 'gag sdom rtsa ba'i chings lnga par shin tu gsal bar yod la/ 'phrang 'go gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi lung bstan gab rgya can las be+e ro'i sprul par bstan zer ba yod nges kho na yin tshe/'phrang mgo dge bshes pa tshad ldan yin 'dug pas/ bdag chen pa'i mdzad spyod ngan pa rnams se mos can las ma dag pa'i snang ngor shar ba'i dbang du byas te/ skyes bu dam par 'bad pa chen pos bsgoms nas smra na/ rje nyid yum gyis khur te mjal bar phebs pas/ bdag chen sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung las/ yum la khyod kyi bu 'di la gtsang sbra chen po gyis/ ma 'ongs pa na bstan pa la phan pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug ces ma 'ongs mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i bka' stsal gyi bslab ston gnang ngo / /—392

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)skye mang mkhas btsun bzang po'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /sngon gnas rjes dran na tshod ches phra bas/ /gsal bar gsungs 'di'i tha mal skyes bu rtswa /rdo ba'i rdzun mtshang dngos su ston pa bzhin/ /'khon gyi rigs 'khrungs dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /gang gi mngon par mkhyen pa'i me long du/ /khyod kyi mdzad pa'i gzugs brnyan yongs shar pa'i/ /tshul 'di kun mkhyen ye shes g.yin la (5na)ngom/ /dgung lo brgyad lon pa rnam gnon zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo la sa lugs kyi dgon pa grwa bkra shis chos gling du/ rin po che bsod nams rgyal mchog pa'i drung du/ bstan pa rin po che la thog mar 'jug pa'i sgo skyabs su 'gro ba dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos te/ mtshan yon tan rnam rgyal du gsol to/ /yon tan bye ba'i gzhir gyur tshul khrims kyi/ /skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen bslab pa yis/ /lha bu'i bdud kyi dgra las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /mi 'gyur gtan mdun sgrub pa'i zhing sar gshin/ /de'i tshe thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la spyi pos reg cing gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i drung gnas dkon mchog pas klog gi slob dpon bgyis te/gangs can gyi mkhas pa thon mi'i gtsug lag ltar ka 'phreng sum cu las 'ongs pa'i yi ge'i brda dag rnams kyang dka' tshegs chung dus 'khrul med du thugs su byon/ de nas mi ring bar/ srid 'di'i gnas skabs kyi bde ba mtha' dag glog 'phreng ltar mi brtan cing / khyim du gnas pa me 'obs lta bur sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas su dgongs te/ dgung lo bcu gnyis lon pa nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing pho spre'u'i lo la/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i dben gnas chos 'khor rgyal legs bshad sgrog pa'i dga' tshal gyi grwa tshang / shing rta chen po yab sras kyi bla na med pa'i lam srol lung rigs kyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i dwags po grwa tshang du nye du'i bsgol 'debs sogs nges par 'byung ba'i bar chad mi la jug pa'i slad du gsang stabs kyis chos bros la phebs/ grum mda' chos rje blo bzang chos 'phel ba'i drung du tshigs (5ba〉snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes/ mtshan dkon mchog chos —393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāyo'aphel du btags so/ /rgya chen gtsug lag rin chen do shal dag /dbyangs gsal bsdebs kyi srad bur brgyus pa'i 'phreng / /mgul par brgyan pa'i mtho ris sa rlu dz+nya/ /kha ba'i ljongs su 'ongs zhes lha rnams glengs/ /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas khyim gyi chu gter las/ /nges 'byung rdzings kyis bde ba'i gnas bgrod pas/ /sdug bsngal ster byed me tog mda' yi rlabs/ /blo brid lha ba'i 'phreng bcas rang sar log /mdog dmar mchu sgros rab mdzes mdzes pa'i bzhin/ /rnam par legs ngom mthon mthing mthing kha'i skra/ /lan bu rab g.yo g.yon mig mig zur mda'/ /'phangs kyang khyod thugs sra de de phyir brtan/ /grum mda' mkhan po dang / dngos stobs rigs pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon nam mkha' rgya mtsho/yum don gsal ba'i sgron me slob dpon byams pa brtan pa rnams grwa tshang gi lung rigs smra ba'i chos kyi khri la rim par byon pa'i bar lo grangs bcu'i ring / rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar cig car du 'byed pa'i bsdus pa nas bzung / 'phags yul grub mtha' smra ba bzhi po so so'i lugs phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i po ti phyi nang kun brgal brtag gis gtan la phab ste thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su bltams par mdzad do/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i lugs 'dzin 'phags yul gyi/ /mkhas mang gzhud lugs yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ khyod blo'i lto bar bltams pas klu sgrub zhabs/ /gzhan don zol gyis sgra mi snyan du gshegs/ /chos kun rnam 'byed shes rab zhags pa yis/ /bden gnyis ma lus cig car bcings pa na/ /skabs gsum lam de rang gi pha mtha'i tshad/ /gzhal dogs chu 'dzin stug pos sgrib snyam byid/de skabs zhal snga nas nam mkha' rgya mtsho dwags po sku (6na)rab tu rje drung ga me pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i drung du bya ma tar btang skabs/ grum mdar zhag sa'i nub mnal lam du rje btsun byams pa sku bongs tshad shin tu che ba zhig gis phyag gnyis kyis dbu rgyan phud de dbu la bkon pa'i mtshan ltas khyad par can byung 'dug na'ang / /rje nyid ni rmi lam 'khrul pa'i snang ba la mi 'byung ba'i mtha' rnyed dka' bas —394

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)tig gtad ga la mchis zhes bdag gir mi mdzad pa ni/ sku tshe 'di nyid la mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mngon sum du bstan pa'i phyir na/ nyams dang rmi lam tsam dang tshul bstan la re ba 'cha' ma dgos pa la dgongs pa 'dra zhing / nye bar brtags tshe/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po dang / gangs khrod pa'i rigs pa smra ba mtha' dag gi gtsug rgyan skad gnyis smra ba blo ldan shes rab kyi gdan khri gnyis la chabs gcig tu zhabs zung gi pad+mo rnam par bkod/ sa dge'i mkhas pa phal cher gyi ral pa'i zur phud mdzes rgyan du 'gyur ba'i ltas su mngon/ de skabs rong chad dkar du chos rje rin po che byams pa rgya mtsho phebs pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / yar klungs bkra shis rtser rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhas pa'i dbang po sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gdan drangs skabs grwa tshogs dang lhan du/ zab mo rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba gsung pa la bstod pa'i khyi ka sogs dam pa'i chos kyi dka' 'grel gsan cing / rgyal dbyar chos shig gi skabs/ sku tshe de nyid la zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i snyigs dus kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ming dang don mthun pa na kha dka' bcu'i drung du thog mtha' bar dge'i lung gsan to/ /gsung (6ba)rab lus phrar chags pa'i dmar ba'i lce/ /tshig don lang tsho ngom pa'i lcags kyu yis/ ta sher phyin sbas don mtha' dag bkug go zhes/ /grags snyan dbyangs kyis 'chi med yul du bsnyegs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma lus 'degs pa'i khur/ khyod nyid gcig pus khyogs la blangs pa na/ /mi pham mgon des cod pan nyer gtad nas/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su ngal gso mdzad kyi dogs/ /brgya phrag thabs kyis thos pa'i sgro 'dogs kun/ /gcod phyir ngal brgya lhur len snying stobs kyis/ /nā ro ta pa'i dka' spyad drag po la/ /ches cher gdung ba'i mos pa lhod por byas/ /de nas dgung lo nyer gcig lon pa rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sprul gyi lo/ sa gzhi'i dbang phyug drung chen rin po che ta'i sī tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis/ dwags po'i bka' brgyud kyi phyogs su sngon chad bshad grwa'i srol ma mchis pa dag bstan pa rin po che'i btsas su spel bar bzhed nas/ phyag dar te —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo te/'debs par mdzad pa'i chos grwa chen po dpal gyi rtses thang zhes rigs pa smra ba'i mkhas mang rgya mtsho 'du ba'i dbus su phar tshad gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i rgya gar mkhas pa'i zhal lung las 'ongs pa'i bka' pod kyi tshig don phyin ci ma log par 'grel ba'i gsung bshad dang / phyir rgol ba rnams kyi rigs pa'i thal 'gyur gyi mtshon snon pos cung zad kyang gzhom gzhig dang bral ba'i dam bca' sogs kyi rab 'byams grwa bskor mdzad pas/ phyogs der 'khod pa'i ris bral gyi mkhas pa mtha' dag thugs lhag par phrogs shing / khyad par gar lugs kyi rab 'byams pa smra seng dang rtsod pa mdzad pas/ mgrin sngon can gyi mdas grong khyer sum (7na)brtsegs bcom pa ltar/ chos kyi 'gro bas ming gi lhag ma ltar mdzad pa'i snyan grags phyogs kyi bu mo'i mgrin par blangs pas/ rong chad dkar du zhabs drung khri chen lhag par thugs dgyes pa'i ngos mjal skabs legs so'i bya dga' chen po stsal/de dus chos rje rin po che rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal 'byor lhun grub kyang yon bdag rab 'byams pa zhes dwags po grwa tshang gi dge bshes che khad yod 'dug pa la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dka' gnas las brtsams pa'i 'dzin chos dang / legs par sbyar pa ka lā pa'i 'tshams sbyor lnga pa'i gsan pa mdzad/de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'gro ba yongs kyi thun mong du spyod pa'i snang ngor 'dus pa'i sde chen po'i gzugs su shar ba rgyal me tog thang du/mnga' dwags gnyis sogs kyi rigs pa smra ba bgrang yas pa tshogs pa'i dbus su/ swā la'i ljongs 'di'i mtshan nyid pa mtha' dag la grags pa'i gzhung chen po kun la gsung bshad dang dam bca'i legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs kyi pi wang mkhas pa yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan du brdung bar mdzad/ de zhor rgyal ri khrod du bla ma khyung po la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bzhi gsan to/ /ches phra'i na tshod dkar ba'i zla tshes gang / /thos bsam bcu drug cha shas yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /rgan po'i blo 'chang gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin 'di/ gdong drug sum rtsen snyegs pa'i zol gyis song / /rgol ngan log smra'i 'gog pa'i brtul zhugs kun/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i me tog mdas bshig —396

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)tshe/ /(7ba〉5da' lnga pa dang khyod kyi snang tshul la/ /rags pa'i lus kyis khyad par byas pa bzhin/ /de'i tshe dwags po lto sdings nas chos kyi rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ nyid sngar phan rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams la thos bsam gyis legs par gtan la phab na'ang / de tsam gyis yid tshim par bya mi rigs pas/ deng sang bod kha ba can gyi bstan pa'i snying po gnas pa'i sa/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gdan sa rin po ches thog drangs pa'i bshad sgrub kyi 'dus sde phal cher/ dge bcu'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i skyid shod phyogs su yod pa dang / khyad par mdo rgyud bstan pa'i rtsa lag chos kyi rje rin po che dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i drung du/ mdo sngags kyi sgro 'dogs gcod dgos tshul sogs kyi gsung gis nan tar bskul ba la brten nas/ dgung lo nyer gnyis lon pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing rta la skyid shod du phebs te/ thog mar ljongs 'di'i mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag /dpal gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos grwa chen po mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gcig /tshad ma rig pa'i chu klung mtha' dag gcig tu 'du ba'i dpal ra ba stod du/ 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu mthon mthing ral ba'i zur phud dor te bur smrig gi zol la nye bar brten pa'i chos kyi rje blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhabs la btud de/ sngon nas thugs su legs par byon zin na'ang / drung chen legs bzang ba'i lugs kyi rigs pa'i dbang phyug gi gzhung 'di la g.yin la med pa'i khyad chos du ma dang ldan pa'i snyan pa la brten nas/ rje btsun sa paṇa gyis/ rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad (8na)mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' las ring / /de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang mkhas rnams kyis/ ta shes bya'i gnas rnams sbyongs zhes legs par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don ltar/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnams 'grel gyi tshig don mtha' dpyod kun la bslab sbyangs kyis paṇa chen lha shāka gnyis kyi rnam thar kun rang gir mdzad/ chos mtshams kyi bar thams cad la rje zhal snga nas stag lung brag pa'i drung du byang chub lam rim chen mo'i bzabs bshad gsan/ de nas drang srong chu lha'i bu'i bden tshig gi mthus nyal 'gro mtha' dag sman gyi ro mngar po 'thul ba'i 'bras ldan dus kyi dga' ston la —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skababs pa'i tshe/ 'brog ri bo che dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du/ dus de'i tshe rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug na mngon par mtho ba'i chos rje rin po che dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i drung du phebs te/ sngar nas thugs su byon pa'i phar tshad sogs dang / gtso bor rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/mdo sde thams cad kyi za ma tog /gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud sde'i bshad srol/ snga rabs pa phal cher gyi spyod yul du ma gyur ba/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsi'i bgo skal yang dag par blangs so/phun tsho gos dge bcu'i ngo mtshar yongs gang zhing / shwakya'i bstan pa'i 'byung gnas skyid shod du/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma'i bka' bzhin nyer phebs tshe/ /'dab bzang dbang po'i bgrod pa'i tshul la 'gran/ /gzhung lugs kha ba'i rdul brtsegs ne'u thog /mdzes byed pa ku'i klung chen ra ba stod/ /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i dbang po'i mdun sa der/ /dngos stobs (8ba)rigs pa'i btung ba yun du bsten/ /mi pham mgon po'i pho brang 'dzin ma 'dir/ /'phos 'drar gsang ba sngags kyi thos bsam gyis/ /rgyud kun 'di nyid gcig pus bdag byed ces/ /gsang sngags phal cher mkha' 'gro'i mdzod du sbas/ /de nas dgung lo nyer bzhi lon pa gdong ngan zhes pa me pho spre'u'i lo 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ges ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa mtha' yas pa bstan pa'i dus ston/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du rje bdag nyid chen po'i phyag len gyi srol ma nyams pa smon lam chen mo'i dus/ chos rje rin po che dpal 'byor rgya mtsho nyid kyis mkhan slob cig car du mdzad cing / dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su rgyu skar shar ba'i tshe/ tshangs par spyod pa rnams kyi mchog yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po mnos te/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa rnams kyi bla na mngon par mtho bar gyur to/ /bod yul dbus 'gyur ra sa 'phrul snang du/ /'tshams sprin bla gos gsar pas dkris pa na/ /'dul 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug na mtho'o zhes/ /'chi med dbang po'i mdun sar lha rnams gleng / /—398

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa 'i rna rgyan/ 6)bla ma de nyid kyis 'khor lo sdom pa lha i pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste smin par mdzad/ de nas chos grwa chen po gsang phu ne'u thog tu gsung bshad dang thal 'gyur gyi 'phreng bas dpyod ldan yongs la skyes kyi phul du byung ba gzhung lugs kyi don stsal ba dang / rgol ngan rnams smra ba'i spobs pa 'phrog pa lhan cig tu mdzad de/ lha sar skabs gsum pa'i rigs las chad pa gnyos kyi gdung las lha rin po che lha dbang rgya mtsho ba la grub chen birlu pa nas brgyud pa'i (9na〉〉 sgrub gsan/ lam 'bras kyi cha lag rlung la brten pa'i tshe sgrub de yin pa 'dra/ de nas chos rje rin po che bsod grags pas chos 'byung yid kyi mdzes rgyan du/ mkha' la nyi zla bzhin du slar yang rgyud kyi bshad grwa gnyis pa byung tshul ni/ zhes bsngags pa ches cher mdzad pa pha rgyud 'dus pa'i lam srol 'dzin pa la in+d+ra bhū ti rgyal blon rab tu byung ba'i tshul gyis byang phyogs kyi gzhi 'dir 'phos pa lta bu'i stod rgyud mkhas 'dus kyi grwa tshang gi chos kyi khri la chos rje chos gnyer grags pa bzhugs skabs phebs te/ smo gsum gyi ring 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel mtha' dag legs par sbyangs pa'i phul du phyin par gyur/ dol chos rdzong gi mkhan po srid sgrub gnyis pa lta bu'i drung du/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel gtan la 'bebs pa'i yan lag rtsis kyi gtsug lag las lnga bsdus kyi phyag khrid zhus/ de skabs chos kyi rje dpal 'byor rgya mtsho zhing khams gzhan du 'pho ba la thugs nye bar gzhol te/ phyi rten gyi ched du bdog pa'i dngos po sgrub pa'i 'bul sdud du 'byon dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa ltar/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i zhing dam par dgongs te/ dgung lo nyer brgyad lon pa kun ldan zhes pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo la bar khams phyogs su phebs te/ nas rgyas sogs kyi yul grur zla ba bcu bzhi'i ring chos dang zang zing gi rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las bla lhag tu bskyangs/ rta tshag rje drung /lha dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho la dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang / spag shod chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho la byang chub lam rim chen mo'i spyod pa spyi slob yan gyi lung / (9ba〉sna phags pa lha bsod nams rnam rgyal ba la chos kyi 'grel pa gsan/ mi ring bar mkho dgu'i 'byor pa ji snyed pa dang bcas te skyid shod du phebs/ chos rje rgyal khang rtse ba nyid —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nezhing gzhan du gshegs grub na'ang / bla na med pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su zang zing gi yo byad lhag ma lus par legs byas kyi sman yon skrun pa'i thabs kho nar bsgyur zhing / dngul gdung yang gegs med par grub bo/ /legs byas nor bu'i gan mdzod bla ma rje'i/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i dad pa'i lde mig gis/ /dngos grub sgo glegs rnam par bkral ba na/ /rtag tu ngu yi brtson pa lhod por dra/thag/ /de nas gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi chos khrims skabs/ chos rje rin po sangs rgyas rin chen pa la/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang bzhi dang / rgyal ba myong kha pa'i gsung 'bum thor bu'i lung / gling smad chos rje don grub seng ge la dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo dang / kun rig gi dbang gsan/ de yang chos rje rgyal khang rtse pa'i zhal chems su/ chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho la/ khyed kyi rjes su ra ba stod kyi 'chad nyan byams gling rab 'byams pa 'di pas lugs gnyis thad nas pher pa yod pas skos gsung ba dang / rje nyid rtses thang du grwa bskor la phebs skabs/ chos rje stag lung brag pa dang mjal bar/ sngar nas thugs 'dris che ba med na'ang / rab 'byams pa 'di nged rang gi grwa par byung na ra ba stod kyi 'chad nyan 'ong ba 'dra snyam pa lhan skyes su byung 'dug pa sogs rten 'brel gyi chos nyid rang 'grig tu gyur pa (10na)dang / sngon gyi rnam par dkar ba'i smon lam gyi 'brel ba'i mthus/ dgung lo sum cu lon pa dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo'i hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu dgu gza' skar dus sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ dngos stobs rigs pa smra ba'i chos kyi khri la mngon par 'dzegs so/ / ring nas goms pa'i smon lam mdog lnga pa/ /tha snyad rten cing 'brel 'byung rlung shugs kyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gdan khri'i kun gsal la/ /'gog med rgyu ste dngos po'i gshis lugs mtshar/ /rab dkar tsan dan gzhen nu'i sdong po las/ /ga bur thigs pa 'dzag la mtshar du ci/ /'byul med mngon sum rjes dpag tshad ma yis/ /brtan g.yo'i chos tshul ri mor bris min nam/ /bod yul snga —400

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)rabs phal gyi dam bca'i ri/ /gnam lcags rigs pa'i thog mdas gsil ba na/ /rigs pa'i dbang phyug phyogs kyi glang po de/ /rang nyid zhi bder gzhol ba'i thugs bskyed snyam/ /de skabs bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gtso bor gyur pa'i grub mtha' gong 'og rnams kyi gzhud la bshad nyan ches cher 'phel bar brten/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam mkha' la rgyu skar gyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa lta bur gyur cing / thub bstan bshad sgrub kyis 'dzin skyong spel bar nus pa'i mkhas pa'i grags snyan dang ldan pa gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan gyi 'jigs med seng ge'i khri la 'dzegs shing mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa sras khang sku skye ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rgyud stod sogs mdo sngags kyi bshad grwa du ma'i chos khri la 'dzegs pa slob dpon blo (10ba)bzang bstan 'dzin/ ra ba stod kyi slob dpon byang gling rab 'byams pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ skyor mo lung grwa tshang gi slob dpon pa don grub rin chen/ dwags po grwa tshang gi slob dpon byams pa chos mchog /se ra byes grwa tshang gi slob dpon pa 'phrin las bsam grub/ mdo rgyud kun la blo gros kyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs shing tha snyad rig pa'ang blo gros kyi 'jug pas phyogs tsam rig pa da lta'i 'ol kha bsam gling slob dpon pa bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdzing phyi mkhan po dge 'dun rnam rgyal/ gzhan yang rab 'byams pa lha dbang blo 11sa/ rab 'byams pa spyan ras gzigs/ rab 'byams pa byams pa rnam rgyal sogs bka' rab 'byams smra ba mang du thos pa'i yon tan gyis phyug pa bgrang yas pa byung ba dag ni/ blang dor tshul bzhin du shes pa'i gzur gnas shig gis brtags tshe/ bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la srid dang zang zing tsam ma yin pa'i don snying po'i bya ba yang dag par mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo so gcig pa mdzes byed ces pa chu yos la ra ba stod smad thun mong gi drung chen gyi khri la phebs/ mi ring bar yul lho phyogs sman gyi nags ljongs yar klungs phyogs su chos dbang bteg skabs/ thog mar mkhar thog nas dpon sa sa gya nom pa'i bsnyen bkur dang / bka' chos kyi —40/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6te/'brel ba zhu ba mdzad/ de nas pho brang chen po sne'u gdong rtser/ gong ma mi'i dbang po'i phyag 'bul la phebs skabs/ dpon slob tshang mar bdag rkyen mgo 'dren yang dag gnang zhing / rim gyis 'phyong rgyas su phebs par/(11na〉pyo tshang la bsnyen bkur dang / spyir grwa tshang gi slob dpon gyi rigs la gdan bzos sogs mngon thogs pa'i srol mi 'dug na'ang / rje nyid la tshes bcu chen mo'i gzigs mo'i nyin/ zhal ngo rnams kyi bzhugs gdan gyis phyed tsam du sleb pa'i gdan bzos/ nang rten gyi mjal kha sogs bdag rkyen phul du byung ba'i thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa lta bur gyur cing / spyan g.yas su khrom dbang / spyir grwa tshang gi chos thog rnams su spyi chos la/ mnyam med jo bo yab sras kyi gsang chos glegs bam rin po che/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa/ rje bla ma'i gsung 'bum thor bu sogs zab rgyas chos kyis gdul bya'i yid kyi re ba yongs su gang bar mdzad/ phyir lam gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra'i chos kyi gdan khri la mngon par 'dzegs pa'i jo gdan mkhan po rin chen rgyal mtshan pa la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i lung dang / gdugs dkar gyi dbang gsan/ de nas g.yas ru gtsang gi phyogs nas thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho dbus phyogs su phebs te/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen por bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal bar phebs nas/spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa dang / mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang gsan/ mi ring bar sde pa gtsang stod pa'i dmag gis yar rgyab pa dang lhan cig par/ skyid byusnod phyogs su dpung gi 'jug sgo byas skabs/nyen skag sogs la ltos pa med par yul gru dang dgon pa du mar mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad/ 'di skabs shar dwags po grwa tshang gi 'chad (11ba〉nan la gdan 'dren nan gyis byung na'ang phebs ma thub/ de nas lo tsā ba chen po'i dus mchod la 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams la rmad du byung ba'i bsnyen bkur dang / tshogs gsog pa gnyis kyis/ dam bca' lo re bzhin 'jog pa dang /khang thog nas mda' rdo mi brgyab pa/ skyogs mi 'dzugs pa sogs gzhan dag dang ba 'dren pa'i sgrigs rnam gzhag gsar du btsugs so/ /—4()2

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 'dargya gar mkhas mang mgrin par sgrog pa'i dbyangs/ /khyod nyid gcig pus mgul par blangs pa na/ /rin chen rtsig ngos 'bod grogs gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /sgyu ma'i snang tshul 'di ko ngo mtshar med/ /gnam sngon sa la babs 'dra'i rdzing bu la/ /ring nas ngang pa'i tshogs kun 'du ba ltar/ khyod kyi mkhas pa'i grags pas dpyod ldan kun/ /dus gcig 'dzom pa'i chad so byas pa bzhin/ /mi dman bsod nams 'bar ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dregs ldan kun/ /khyod kyi rnam dkar mdzad pa'i lcags kyu de/ /ma btab na yang 'dud la rings par brel/ /so ga tshad pas gdungs pa'i glang po de/ /chu klung ngogs su ngang gis rgyu byed na/ /skal med gang dag khyod rjes mi 'jug pa/ /sems med yin nam 'on te gdon gyis btab/ /chu shing lta bu'i nor gyi tshogs/ /bsod nams ched du sgyur mkhas pa'i/ /tshul 'dis rab dga'i sa thob pa'i/ /sems dpa' kun la zhum pa byin/ /de nas dgung lo bzhi bcu lon pa yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo la/ 'bras spungs nas thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho dang / sde pa dga' (12na〉ldan pa mchod yon gyi bka' phebs dang / stod rgyud grwa tshang gi grwa rigs rnams mos mthun rtse gcig pa la brten nas/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi dga' ston rgyun mi 'chad par sgrog pa'i gsang sngags kyi sde chen po stod rgyud grwa tshang gi chos kyi khri la phebs/ sngon rgyud pa kun dga' don grub kyis kyang smon lam mdzad 'dug pa ltar ran 'dzab byams pa'i drung du bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam gnang bas thugs ka nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dngos su babs/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub zhabs kyi zhal lung las 'ongs pa'i bskyed rdzogs mdzub khrid/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrags/ rim lnga gsal sgron sogs dpag par dka' ba'i don rnams dpyis phyin pa'i gsung bshad kyis mkhas pa rnams kyi yid rang dbang du phrogs shing / mnyam med jo bo chen po'i bsti gnas yer pa lha ri snying por/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba las byung ba'i dbyar zhal bzhes dang /tshogs pa mtha' dag 'grel bshad nyan par 'byon dgos pa'i —403—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skasgrigs sogs lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong phul du byung ba mdzad do/ /gsang chen theg pa mchog gi chu gter las/ /mkhas grub dgongs don yid bzhin nor bu'i tshogs/ /snod ldan mgul bar brgyan pa'i mdzad pa yis/ /sa ra ha de mkha' spyod gnas su bros/ /phyi ru chags bral ngur smig 'chang ba'i lus/ /nang du bde chen la rol nye lam spyod/ /sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di yis thub bstan kun/ /'gal med dgongs pa gcig pa'i rang mtshang bstan/ /tha mal (12ba)snang zhen yongs dag 'khor lo'i dpyid/ /grags stong nga ro sgrog pa'i rdo rje'i tshig /bde stong gnyis med nyams ldan zung 'jug gis/ /bsil ldan yul 'di 'og min zhing du byas/ /byams mgon dngos dang dbyer med snang brnyan byung / /byams brtse'i thugs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /byams pa'i ting 'dzin chu rgyun 'bab pa dag /byams ldan 'khor gyis btung ba'i dga' ston byas/ /de skabs rdo rje theg pa'i chos nyan pa'i 'khor du 'dus pa/ shar pa chos rje mdo sngags rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bkra shis/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i khri la 'dzegs pa 'jang rab 'byams pa dge 'dun rin chen rgyal mtshan/ stod rgyud grwa tshang dang rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i 'dus sde legs bshad chos 'khor gling pa'i 'chad nyan gyi gdan sar 'khong pa bzang grong rab 'byams pa ngag dbang chos 'phel sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtha' klas pa ji ltar dbyar gyi lang tsho rnam par rgyas pa na dal 'gro'i klung mtha' dag ches cher 'phel ba ltar gyur cing / klung shod du chos bar bteg pas/ gangs kyi ri bo zla ba'i 'od kyis khyab pa ltar/ sngon grwa tshang la mos mthun che ba'i steng du/ nyid kyi rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i char gyis dad pa'i myu gu'i bsos zla bral du gyur/ blo gsal gling gi 'chad nyan du phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsan byung yang de res phebs pa ma shar/ de nas gzhis ka brag dkar du byang phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba sde pa dga' ldan pa dpon blon gyis/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhes stag lung bka' rgyud la ltos pa'i mkhas pa chen por (13na)grags pa de gdan drangs pa dang / rje 'di nyid gdan 'dzom par/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las brtsams pa'i dka' gnad kyi —404

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)gsung gleng byung bar/ rje 'dis the tshom gyi mdud pa mtha' dag bkrol bas/ stag lung rin po che thugs ha las nas/ rjes su/ de dang mnyam du zla gcig bsdad na'ang blo bskyed dpag tu med pa yong ba 'dug ces pa bsngags pa mdzad do/ /grangs med ro brgya'i 'bras bu'i 'phreng ba yis/ /dpag bsam yongs 'dur mdzes la mtshar du ci/ /mkhas mang gdengs ga'i grib bsil rab ldem pa'i/ /bshes gnyen klu dbang khyod ni gang gis bskrun/ ta shes bya'i khyen kun lta ba'i mig stong dang / /smra mkhas dbyangs can ngom pa'i lag nyal gyis/ /grub rigs rgan po'i the tshom ri bo'i rkang / /mthar byed grags pa phyogs kyi mgrin par 'dzer de nas dgung lo zhe gsum lon pa srin po zhes pa shing yos la chos sde rin chen gling gi mkhan por phebs/ 'chad ka dang rin chen gling sde phan tshun mi 'dza' ba'i dge 'dun gyi dbyen bzlums pa'i bde skyid la bkod/ rim gyis skyid shod la phebs te/ grub chen byams pa bsod nams la las chen kun rgyal bas mdzad pa'i bka' gdams chos 'byung dang / paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i drug cu pa'i lung / sprul sku bsod nams dge legs dpal bzang la bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / gur mgon gyi rjes gnang gsan/ dgung lo zhe drug lon pa dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa rta la 'dul mngon gyi bshad grwa skyor mo lung (13bston gdan sar phebs / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'brungs rabs sogs skya ser gyi khrom chen po 'dus pa la gsungs/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo kun dga' grol mchog gis rang nyid la sku skye bod du mi 'byung bar gsungs kyang /sprul pa'i skur grags pa'i jo nang pa kun dga' snying po/ gling smad chos rje 'phrin las dpal 'byor gyis gdan drangs pa'i tshe mngon shes dang pho tshod gang yin yang / 'phros gtam la/ da lta'i ra ba stod pa'i drung chen gyi rnam dkar gyi las shugs ches pas/ /byed dang de'i rjes ma gnyis ka la yun ring dka' gsung ba stabs 'grig pa 'dra'i/ dgung lo zhe bdun lon pa don grub ces pa sa lug la/gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i 'chad nyan thams cad kyi 'byung khungs gcig pu rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes —405

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skarab kyi chos kyi gdan khri la phebs nas/ lo star chags su zla ba phyed gnyis kyi ring sa dge'i mkhas pa rnams 'tshogs pa'i dbus su gsung rab kyi 'brel ba'i gtam phul du byung bas mkhas rlom dregs ldan phal cher gyi spobs pa phyogs/ tshogs chos su shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyis rgyal po bde spyod la springs pa'i bshes pa'i springs yig dang / rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la la jug pa sogs gsungs so/ /de yang rat+na'i bstan pa spyi lung du/ /gsang phu'i chos grwar 'jam dbyangs sprul pa 'byung / /zhes pa yang la la rje nyid du ngos 'dzin pa don la gnas par sems so/ /thos bral sgom pa'i tshang tshing stug po'i nang / /mang thos lo 'dab g.yur za'i a shwa lha/ /(14na sgor me mdzad kyis lung bstan gsang phu der/ /mkhas mang rgyan du mkhas 'di mdzes zhes sgrog /dgung lo zhe brgyad lon pa drag po zhes pa lcags sprel gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gi gdan sa rdzing phyi'i khri thog tu phebs/ de yang sngar lug lo'i sde gzar skabs/ stag rtse sgang du sku rab dmag dpon pa shor ba'i tsen gyis/ de dus 'ol dga' stag rtse skur ba nas bzung bar/ rdzing phyi ba rnams ya nga ba yod pa la/ rje nyid spyir yang lugs zung gi gnang khyab mtho ba dang / lhag tu stag rtser sde pa zur khang nas yod pa'i mchod yon gyi 'brel so dang bcas phan tshun kun re dogs kyi 'ching ba las bkrol/ dgung lo zhe dgu lon pa blo ngan zhes pa lcags bya la 'dam du thu med kyi rgyal rigs lha btsun dang hong tha'i ji sogs hor sog gi dmag dpung chen po 'byor par/ bod sogs chings mdun gleng bar gtso bor bkra shis lhun po nas/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po paṇa chen rin po che phebs pa dang lhan cig tu stag lung sogs su phebs/ bslab btus/ spyod la jug /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyi 'od rnams gsan/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal la phyag na rdo rje gtum po gza' sham can gyi rjes nang zhus/ mi ring bar sngags mkhar gyi gdan sar phebs/ bde chen rtse nas gtsang pa'i bka' blon —406

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)rnams kyis/ dgon pa ldan ri la spo dgos par nye tshe/ zang zing gi bdog pa dang bka' nan chen pos sngar (14ba)gnas kyi phan pa cher bsgrubs mod/ 'on kyang lhas byin drin gzo med pa'i ring lugs pa mang po ni ji mi snyam mo/ /dgung 61 nga gcig pa khrag skyug ces pa chu phag la dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi grwa tshang mkhas pa blo gsal gling gi 'chad nyan du phebs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ma lus pa rdzogs par ston pa'i bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel dang / dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par 'grel ba dbu ma la 'jug pa sogs kyi dgongs pa 'khrul bral lung rigs kyi dbyar rnga lan gcig min par bsgrags pas blo ldan rma bya mtha' dag dga' ba'i rtsed 'jor rol lo/ /da lta'i blo gsal gling slob dpon pa 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ stod rgyud dbu mdzad 'ol dga' rab 'byams pa byams pa rnam rgyal/ rab 'byams pa dom nyag bsod nams chos bzang rab 'byams pa 'bur stag pa ngag dbang dpal bzang sogs dge bshes ches mang du 'dus/ phag mo chos sde'i bla mar phebs dgos pa'i gsol ba nan gyis btab kyang bka' bzhes ma gnang ngo / /thabs mang sgrub pa'i gya gyu'i tshul/ /spangs kyang kun gyi gtsug 'gying ba'i/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal thob pas/ /khyab 'jug mkha' lding zhen nas bros/ /gzur gnas blo yi ka shi'i ngos/ /sbas don gzhung gi li khri'i tshon/ /rnam dpyod pir gyis bris pa yis/ /ri mo'i snang brnyan ci yang 'char /dgung lo nga gsum pa khro bo zhes pa shing glang la dga' ldan shar gyi gdan sa dang / de'i lo phyi ma zad pa zhes pa me stag hor zla lnga (15na)pa'i dus tshes dge bar/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum mtha' klas pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang bzhin can khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i gdong lngas rnam par bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri la stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyis dbang bskur te/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi gtsug na mdzes par gyur to/ /nags tshal dra bas sbrel ba'i dben pa'i gnas/ /dka' thub drag po'i ngal ba bsten pa dang / /—407

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skabargya phrag mchod sbyin dag las legs bris ga sdu'i/ /go 'phang thob pas bsgrun du ma mchis pas /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul spel la bsil ldan 'dir/ /rgyal ba kun las mkhyen brtse ches lhag pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i tog gyur blo bzang grags pa yi/ /rin chen rdul mang brtsegs pa chos kyi khrir/ /'jigs bral zhabs kyi pad+mo legs bkod pas/ /gser mngal gtsug na zla ba pad dkar mig /'dud phyir yangs pa'i sa ni dog por byas/ /de nas bzung ste dbyar dgun gyi dus chos rnams su jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs kyi nying khu byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i don rgyas par ston pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo dang / bka' gdams glegs bam sogs bzabs bshad dang bcas gsungs/ dgung lo nga lnga lon pa rab 'byung zhes pa me yos la rgyal bas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus khyad par can la ris su ma chad pa'i rab tu byung ba'i sde bgrang yas pa tshogs pa'i smon lam gyi mgon du phebs te/ snga dro snyan dngags kyi (15ba)bstan bcos chen po 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa zhes/ dbyangs can mgrin par chags pa dpa' bo'i zhal lung las byung ba de nyid kyi dka' ba'i gnad rnams bstan pas drang srong phur bu yang mkha' la nyul ba'i tshul gyis nyan par lhags so/ /snyan tshig tshig rgyan dpal ldan ma khol gyi/ /zhal lung lung bzang mkhas rlom kun gyis kyang / / ma rtogs rtogs phyir legs bshad snyim pa yis/ /tshig don don gyis mdud pa mtha' dag bkrol/ /mi dge'i dri mas sbags pa'i nag po'i mdangs/ /tshul min kun nas 'brud pa'i dge ba'i chus/ /rnam smin dkar po 'dzag pa'i thigs pa yis/ /legs lam 'dzin ma ma lus brlan snyam byed/ / /de nas 'bras spungs su phebs nas zla ba gsum gyi ring gtan chags su bzhugs pa nas bzung lo drug gi ring kho bos kyang zhal gyi bdud rtsi las 'ongs pa'i bsdus pa nas bzung / chos mngon bar gyi ṭīk+ka spyi don thal 'phreng rnams zhus/ tshig don mtha' dpyod gang la yang chos de dang de dngos su ston rgyu yod pa lta bu'i 'chad mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod kyis drung du nye bar 'khod pa mtha' dag dam pa'i —408

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ snyedachos la blo ngam ngam shugs kyis 'gyur ba'i ngo mtshar khyad par can du snang / dngos cag lta bu'i brtson 'grus dang shes rab ches dman pa rnams la'ang / ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad tshal kun rang dbang med par 'byed pa ltar/ gzhung gi don phyogs 'gro tsam blo yul du mi 'jags pa'i dbang mi 'dug cing / nged rang nas kyang thos pa kho nar blo zhugs pa'i 'dzin pa shar rigs lung sogs (16na smo'i mar/ bod mi chen gyi che khyad sogs shes 'dod med pa dang bcas gtan ma byas par chos la don gnyer 'ba' zhig byas pas dgongs par yang ldan pa byung /dgung lo nga bdun pa dkar po zhes pa sa sprul la sde ba zur khang shar pa dngos grub rgya mtsho dus kyi pho nya'i dbang du gyur pa dag mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi sa bon bskrun pa'i phyir lho kha phyogs su gdan drangs skabs/ sos than gyi tsha ba'i 'jigs pas spang ljongs dang ljang pa gzhon nu rnams gser gyi gos gyon pa la mngon du phyogs tshe/ rje nyid paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i skye ba yin na char chen po phob cig ces bden pa'i tshig brjod pa gnang bas/ de nub nas bzung zad mi shes pa'i char gyi rgyun babs te/ dbyar skyes kyi phung po kun margad kyi stod g.yogs gyon no/ /byams gling pa rnams kyisabasti stang dang bcas mchod rten chen po'i steng nas/ khrom la thugs rje chen po'i bzlas lung dang / yang zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor bstsal bas/ skabs gsum pa rnams kyang dang ba'i yid kyis lhags te mchod pa'i slad du me tog gi char dbab par byas so/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad skyug pa'i gang ga'i rgyun/ /'khrul pa'i rnyog pa dang bral dwangs pa'i klung / /nam
