yang mi zad gsung rab chu bo'i gter/ /blo gsal skal ldan shong rta'i dpal du che/ /gzod ma nyid nas rgyal sras 'phags pa'i sar/ /gshegs phyir bden tshig grub la mtshar du ci/ /drang srong dmod pa'i mthu yis brgya byin la/ /mig stong byung bar rig byed gtam du (16ba)grags/ /dga' ldan gzims khang du rab 'byams pa don grub rgya mtsho sogs dge bshes mang dag la mdo rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka gnang bas/ rab 'byams don rgyam pa yang khengs pa bor te phyis su bsngags brjod kho na byed 409

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skazer/ 'di dag gi snga phyi rnams su rta tshag rje drung / sprul pa'i sku grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang sprul sku/ da lta'i gling stod chos rje/ skyed tshal mkhan po/ skyid shod kyi sde pa chos rje/ dbon drung sku skye/ cha kur sku skye sogs chen por grags pa rnams dang / gnam gyi bu bo don cha mir gan gyi rgyud las byung ba ju nang thub pa tha'i jis mtshon pa'i hor gyi rgyal rigs dang / bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po sogs chen po mang pos kyang zhabs la gtugs so/ /de skabs gsang phu'i 'du khang de legs rgyu mi 'dug par gsar bcos kyi thugs 'dun gtad nga 'i spyi tshogs bka' bgros mol bsdud nas/ shing sogs kyi rtsol sgrub mdzad kyang / 'ga' zhig logs bris sogs bsnon 'phri byung dogs pa'i mi 'dod pa'i rnam pas rkyen byas lus med kyis ji ltar bsams pa'i dbang du gyur/ dgung lo nga dgu pa skye bdag ces pa lcags lug la dga' ldan gzims khang dang / de'i lo phyi ma skyor mo lung gi gzims khang mkhar las/ sngar chos rje rin chen bshes gnyen pas spom rta bslang rjes glo bur du gnyan nad kyis grongs pa sogs 'tshub che bar grags na'ang / 'di skabs 'gal rkyen gyi bgegs med par 'grub/ /dgung lo re lnga pa dbang phyug ces pa me glang la/ dga' ldan du rī ṇa'i yul gru las 'ongs pa'i (17na) dngul srang mkha' mkha' rgya mtsho'i grangs ldan dang / su war+ṇa mkha' klu'i 'khor lo can las grub pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod sdong / shel dkar gyi lhun po nor bu'i 'phra tshoms kyis bskor ba lta bu 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bskrun pa la/ rje nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyi gdan khri la gtso bor bzhugs te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ rgyud sde las ji ltar tsā da ba'i ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs rten la gnyis med du byed pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad cing / ni pā la'i bzo bo rnams mkho dgu'i 'byor pas tshim par gyur to/ /rgyal rnams mchog dman 'gro dang 'tsham pa'i tshul/ /ston phyir bya ba las kyi 'khor lo yis/ /blo dman skye dgu'i re ba ches skong ba/ /de yang sems dpa' che rnams mdzad pa'i 'os/ /snang stong 'khor spro/10

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)lo'i bdag por gsal ba yi/ /g.yo med ting 'dzin mthu yis dus gsum gyi/ /rnam 'dren ma lus phyogs 'dir nyer drangs na/ /zhing gzhan lus can mgon po mchis sam ci/ /dgung lo re drug pa 'bru mang zhes pa sa stag la 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang zung du 'brel ba'i 'chi med kyi grong khyer sa la 'phos 'dra dga' ldan khang gsar du zla shas bzhugs te/ dngos cag la 'dus pa'i 'grel pa sogs kyi bka' drin bla med du bstsal/ de nas dgung lo don gnyis pa nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing sprel/ dbang phyogs rgyal khab kyi gan mdzod las 'ongs pa'i bzang gos yug mkha' me gzugs kyi grangs ldan las grub pa'i snyigs (17ba)dus kyi rab 'byams stobs bcu mnga' ba yongs kyi dbang phyug myong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan bzheng bar me tog mda' can gyi 'ching ba'i zhags pas cung zad kyang g.yo bar ma nus par lhun gyis grub ste/ rgyal ba gnyis pa dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i dus chen/ 'dul mngon pa'i lo gsar tshes/ rgya nag pa'i dgun tha/ yongasagrags kyi hor zla bcu pa'i dbyangs au 'char ba/ dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la rab tu gnas pa 'grig /rten 'brel phun sum tshogs par gyur/ de skabs 'bras spungs su zla shas bzhugs te/ kho bos rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung rab kyi dka' gnad rnams zhus/ bka' las byang chub lam rim gyi bzabs bshad rje bla ma nas brgyud pa bar ma chad pa/ 'jam dbyangs stag lung brag pa'i gsung rgyun yongs su rdzogs par thob pa kho bo tsam du 'dug pas/ da lam 'bul thub pa 'di legs byung zhes thugs dgyes pa chen po gnang / zhal snga nas bsam mchog pas/ bsam gtan mchog ni mgo dkar po yin/ bsam gtan mchog shi na lam rim shi zer ba'i dpe de der byung /dga' ldan pho brang du bzhugs skabs de kha nas rje byams pa gling pa'i gdan sar phebs dgos tshul gyi bka' bgros byung song na'ang / sa thag rings pa dang sku na phebs pa sogs kyis mi phebs par thugs thag bcad/ gsang phu'i grwa tshang rnams dbyar chos phyi ma sngon dus 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i sde chen po sa dge'i bshad nyan shin tu dar ba bar skabs su dwags brgyud pa'i phyogs su gyur pa'i zul phur —411—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skatshogs pa'i dgon gnas mthun rkyen gyi phogs sogs bstan pa'i (18na)rgyun la gnas pa dang / ra ba stod pa rnams la grwa brgyad grwa'i dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang / lo star chags kyi mthun rkyen sogs 'byung ba'i bka' phebs kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor los lugs brgya phrag gi sgo nas phan bde'i sman yon ches cher spel bar mdzad bzhin pa 'di kha ltar/ slad nas kyang / kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po myong kha pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa dri bral gyi dpyid dam par/ ji srid zla nyi'i 'od kyis yangs pa'i sa chen po kun la gsal byed kyi 'od snang 'bar ba de srid du zhabs zung mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gzhi la brtan par gyur cig /mtha' bral lus can kun la rab brtse brtse ldan thugs rje chen po'i rgyun/ /rgyun chad med par phyin drug 'dzin ma ma lus yongs brlan rgyal ba'i sras/ /sras bcas kun gyi rlabs chen spyod tshul tshul bzhin nyams bstar mchog gsum dngos/ /dngos rgyud bla ma'i mkhyen brtse nus kun kun nas rab bsdus yongs 'dzin rje/ /srid zhi'i khams na ches dkon legs pa'i lam/ /mchog tu grub pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi mdzod/ /chos tshul mi zad 'dod dgu cher 'phel ba'i/ /gnas 'di rnam mkhyen las gzhan spyod yul min/ /tshur mthong byis pa'i blo yis shes bya'i tshad/ /'jal ba rang nyid ngal ba sgrub pa ltar/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i mdzad pa rjes dpogs nas/ /smra na thog mar sangs rgyas go 'phang sgrubs/ /zad pa'i go skabs dang bral rgya mtsho che/ /ku sha'i rtse mos pha mthar 'dzad byed pa'i/ /drag po'i dka' (18ba)thub yun du sten pa dang / /'di lta'i rtogs brjod rdzogs smra cis mi mtshungs/ /'on kyang rlabs chen mdzad pa'i su warnya/ khung ngu'i zor yang mi dman byed po yis/ /dpyod ldan ya rabs rna ba'i rgyan 'gyur bas/ /cung zad brjod pa'i bsod nams skal bas rnyed/ /tshangs pas gtam rgyus sbyor bar ma byas shing / /dbyangs can tshig 'phreng spel la ma 'ongs pa'i/ /mkhas mang skyes su 'os pa'i rtogs brjod 'di/ /smra ba'i skad gnyis pa de gang nas 'ongs/ /snying nas rnam g.yeng spangs pa'i drang srong kun/ /bsam gtan tsher ma'i snyan tshig spong bden yang / /ri bor dal 'byor 412

khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 6)stong par yol byed rnams/ /mi 'dor rang nyid thos nyung rmongs pa'i skyon/ shar lho'i lugs bzang daṇ+ḍi'i gtsug lag rgyud/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyis bsgyur ba'i pi waṃ des/ /gzur gnas rigs ldan yongs kyi dga' ba'i 'dzum/ /rdzogs ldan gsar par chags nas bsu ba bzhin/ /dge ba'i rnga yab dri bzhen gyis/ /bsod nams ma la ya dag las/ /bos pa'i bshes gnyen dri bsung la/ /tshe rabs kun tu spyod gyur cig /ces 'jam mgon ngur smrig 'chang ba rab 'byams bstan pa'i rtsa lag rje btsun dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan 'di yang / rdzing phyi mkhan po dge 'dun rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba dang / rang nyid kyi dad pa'i gsos su bsams te/ dam pa de nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i lo rgyus smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang (19na)rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/ nyi sgrol zhes pa shing spre'i lo/ rgya nag gtsug gi dpyid 'bring / chu shel gyi dbang po rgyal gyis nya ba'i phyogs snga ma'i dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ngag dbang dge legs so// // mar+sha lo// // —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yo༄༅༅/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/༄tsho/ /su sti sid+dhi/ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dang po'i mgon po kun bzang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mkhan 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam par thar pa skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pa blor phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/dpal ldan rgyal kun chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i mkha' klong yangs pa las/ /mtha' klas mtshan dpe'i 'byor pa rab rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dbyar skyes 'phreng/ /theg kun gdul byar 'phrin las lhun grub sna tshogs sprul sku'i gru char 'bebs/ /dus gsum 'dren pa yongs kyi gtsor gyur gdan gsum tshang ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /dngos grub rin chen dbang gi rgyal po che/ /brgya phrag thabs kyis 'gro la stsal ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'chang kun bshes gnyen rnam rol du/ /ston phyir bla ma mchog khyod 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rang sems chos skur grol bas shrī sing / /gzhan phan lhag bsam 'byongs pas a ti sha /thub bstan rtsa lag gyur pas tsong kha pa/ /rnam gsum mdzad (2na)pa ma lus gcig tu grub/ /in+d+ra bhū ti klu sgrub mda' bsnun zhabs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub kun gyis dam pa 'di'i/ /mdzad par bsgrun nus min phyir pad 'byung gi /rnam par thar de dpe ru bstan nam snyam/ /rgyal rnams skye sprul —414

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)bgrang yas ston pas na/ /tshur mthong blo yis gzhal las rab 'gongs kyang / /thun mong gdul byar legs bstan skyes rabs 'phrong / /spel ba sngon 'gro'i rtogs pa brjod la spro/ /mtha' yas rigs can gsum sogs gdul bya'i khams/ /ji bzhin 'tsham pa'i mdzad pa'i chu gter las/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan spel phyir dngos kyi sku'i/ /rnam thar bdud rtsi skal bzang snying la byin/ /mang thos mkhas dbang yongs kyi mkhyen pa dang / /rgyal sras dam pa'i mi dmigs brtse ba che/ /grub rigs rgya mtsho'i nus mthu gcig bsdus pas/ /rigs gsum mgon gyi ngang tshul rang gir mdzad/ /dam pa'i snang tshul tshul bzhin ston pa la/ /mi skye'i snying stobs stobs ldan dpa' bo che/ /blo dang brtson pa pa sangs ltar dkar ba/ /dpag nus min 'di 'di zhes sus brjod nus/ /'on kyang dang ba'i dad pas rab bskul nas/ /rgyal dang de (2ba)sras yon tan phra mo dag /smra ba'i legs byas pha mtha' yas gyur na/ /rdo rje slob dpon bsngags la su mi dad/ /rgya mtsho rtswa yis 'jal ltar bdag blo yis/ /'phags chen yon tan rdzogs pa nus min yang / /thun mong gdul byar bstan pa'i snang tshul tsam/ /spel ba bskal par bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs/ /de phyir gzur gnas rnams dang chabs gcig tu/ /dkar phyogasamangon par dga' ba'i 'chi med kun/ /sug par man+ta ra sogs mchode pa'i tshogs/ /thogs te g.yel ba med par sgra 'dzin nyon/ /srid 'dir dri za'i rgyud mang sgrog pa las/ /chags ldan skye bo'i yid la dga' bskyed na/ /rab 'byams sangs rgyas kun dngos yongs 'dzin rje'i/ /gsang gsum gtam gyis phan bde cis mi stsol/ /dbyangs can bu mo'i mgrin las snyan tshig gi /mi zad 'dod pa 'jo ba'i rtogs brjod 'phreng / /'gyur med skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta 'di/ /glegs bu'i rwa bar 'dren no shes ldan kye/ /de yang nges pa'i don nyid du dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag nyid chen rtse por bzhugs pa'i khyab bdag dang po'i mgon po las ngo bo tha ma dad cing / thun mong gi gdul bya'i khams dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal la gzigs te/ nyan thos dang rim gyis sbyangs pa'i byang —415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skachub sems dpa' bgrang yas par ston pas/ rang cag snyigs ma lnga ches cher bsdo ba'i lus can rnams la brtse chen thugs rje'i dbang gis lhag par rjes su brtas pa'i rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi (3na)rtogs pa brjod pa yi ge'i phreng bar cung zad cig spel bar bya'o/ /de yang spyir longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas las mi g.yo bzhin du/ sprul pa grangs med pa ston pa ltar/ bla ma 'di nyid kyi sku'i skye sprul yang 'di dang 'di'o zhes rang nyams kyi blos dpyod pa'i yul las ches 'gongs na'ang / gang gi zhal lung las snod ldan la bka' stsal ba ltar cung zad brjod na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di'i 'gro ba'i bla ma stobs bcu mnga' ba stong gi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rgyal ba bu ram shing pa'i spyan sngar/ dgra bcom pa tsun+da ra sku 'brungs/ de ni byad gzugs kyi lang tsho kun nas brtas shing / dam pa'i chos smra ba'i tshig gi brjod pa bla na med pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ rgyal po dang bram ze sogs mchog dman gyi skye bo rnams dge ba'i sa bon spel pa'i dad pa'i yid rang dbang med par skyed par byed cing / lung sdosnod gsum la mkhas pa dang / bslab pa gsum gyis thugs kyi rgyud yongs su phyug par mdzad do/ /de nas slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen du sku bltams/ de ni shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi sras kyi thu bo/ gsung rab spyi dang / khyad par 'dus pa sogs sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag po chen po'o/ /de rjes ska ba dpal brtsegs su sku skye ba bces pa ni/ thang yig tu/ yab ming ska ba blo ldan che'i/bya baḥ yum ming 'brom bza' rdo rje lcam gyi buḥ shāka thub nye gnas tsun+da ra tshe 'phos pa: skyes bu ska ba dpal brtsegs zhes bya baḥ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po ska ba dpal brtsegs zhes (3ba〉pa do sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba brgya dang brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa de nyid do/ /de rjes sgro phug par skye ba rba zhes/ de ni so zur snubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal po zhes yongs su —416

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)grags pa'i zur gyi rgyud las byung zhing / gzhen nu'i dus su yum dang zhang pos bskyangs te/ mnga' phur lo bco lnga dang / de nas chu bar du glan dang / sked lung du byon te lo gsum gyi rin chos gsan/dgung lo bcu dgu la che 'don mdzad pas 'phrin las lhag par rgyas/ thos bsam la cung zad gnod pa ltar byung yang / glan shākya byang chub sogs bla ma mang po spyan drangs te/ mdo sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs kyi rgyud man ngag sgrub 'phreng phyag bzhes mtha' dag rdzogs par gsan cing / gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par grags so/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs si si ri par sku bltams/ de ni yul e rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi sa'i char/ thugs rje chen po phyag na pad+ma dngos kha su 'grub cing / skabs 'gar thags btags pas las dag pa zhig gis phyag bzhi yod par yang mthong / yi ge drug pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zhig go /de rjes 'phags pa rin po cher sku skye ba bzhes/ de ni rje btsun sa paṇa gyi gcung zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang ma gcig kun dga' skyid kyi sras 'khon blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes/ se chen rgyal po 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khri la mnga' sgyur ba dang chabs gcig par rgyal po gang de'i ti shir gyur te/ dam pa'i chos kyi skyes bzang po stsal ba'i lan du/ (4na khod chol kha gsum du grags pa phul te/ lugs gnyis nas mngon par mtho ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgyal po kwan ding ta'i gu shri zhes grags tre(/ /de nas 'gro mgon bsod nams par sku bltams/ de ni bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal zhes mgon pos rjes su bzung ba'i 'khon rigs dam pa gang der jo mo mang du yod pa las/ ma gcig gzhen nu 'bum gyi sras su zhabrungs/ gzhen nu'i dus nyid nas gsung rab mtha' dag la thos bsam phul du phyin par mdzad cing / phyi tshangs par spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas kyang / nang gsang sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen po mngon du gyur pa/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab don snyan —417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6 ) /rgyud kyi bdag por bzhugs shing / dbus phyogs su sde srid phag mo gru pa'i rtsa ba'i yongs 'dzin mdzad pas 'phrin las kyi sgo mchog tu rgyas/ chos 'khor bsam yas su bzhugs skabs dkor srung gnod sbyin chen pos kyang bka' bzhin bsgrub par dngos su khas blangs pa sogs dregs pa can mtha' dag bran du 'khor bar nus pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid can chos rje bla ma dam pa zhes grags so/ /de rjes byams chen chos rjer sku skye ba bzhes/ de ni skyid shong gung thang du khrungs/ chung ngu nas gsung rab la yun du sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob/ gong ma ta ming rgyal pos rgyal ba tsong kha pa gdan 'dren btang ba'i rgyal tshab tu phebs nas rgya nag po'i yul thams cad rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pas khyab par mdzad de/ slar dbus su phebs se ra theg chen gling gi chos sde chen po 'di nyid gsar du bskrun par mdzad cing / byams chen chos kyi rgyal po ta'i ba'u ha wang du grags so/ /(4ba)de nas rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan du sku 'byungs/ de ni myang stod smin drug khyung rtser dpon skya zhig gi rigs su bltams/ rje btsun dam pa don yod pa sogs yongs 'dzin mang du bsten nas sde snod gsum la thos bsam phul du phyin/ shāka lan dang kur lan sogs bstan bcos kyi rigs mang du mdzad cing sku tshe phal cher 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dus 'da' ba zhig go /de ltar thun mong gi gdul bya'i snang ngo dang bstun pa'i go rim ltar brjod kyi/ mtha' dag brjod pa'i yul ga la zhig ste/ mnga' bdag myang gi gter kha'i lung bstan las 31 tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs khyod: skye ba bcu bzhir rgya dkar nag ru bzhi'i yul: sde snod spyod cing 'gro don byed:ces 'byung ba ltar dang / rgyal po bka'i thang yig las kyang / shākya'i zhing khams lug stod zhes pa nas: byang chub sems dpa' g.yin gyi don la brtson: pha bong kha pa zhes pa 'byung bar 'gyur: de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad: ces snang zhing / rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gter lung du/mtsho rgyal sprul pa 'gro ba'i don spyod pa: bsod nams ming can e yi phyogs su 'byung: zhes mkhar —4/8

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)chen bza'i sprul par bshad pa dang / gter kha du mar 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul par bstan pa ches mang ngo / /e ma ston dus kun gsal 'gram pa la/ /gnyis skyes rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor yongs shar bas/ /snang brnyan grangs med rdzing bur 'char ba la/ /rmongs ldan 'i byas pa zhabrul nyams ci yang ston/ /de bzhin rgyal rnams bde ba chen po'i klong / /dbyer med ngo bo gcig pa'i rang bzhin la/ /tha dad du mar snang ba'i sprul pa'i gar/ /gdul bya'i mos ngos yin phyir (ldan sgod gzung ci/ /ma dag lnga bdo'i mun pas cher sbags tshe/ /gang gi skyes rabs 'od dkar can gyi 'phreng / /bstan 'gro'i mkha' la 'gog med 'char ba 'di/ /sems bskyed rlung gi rta yis drangs par nges/ /rnam 'dren mtha' dag spangs rtogs mnyam mo zhes/ /sde snod mang por yang yang gsungs gyur na/ khyod kyi thugs bskyed snying stobs bla med la/ /kun mkhyen gzhan gyis bsgrun du med 'di ci/ /'phags chen dam pa'i srid pa grangs med pa/ /bzung ba min na gang gi yon tan tshogs/ /brgya pa'i tshe yun gcig la yongs rdzogs pa/ /kun mkhyen tshad mas gzhal nus ga la zhig /med byung lung rtogs khur ldan mkhas grub kyi/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar 'dzin la mtshar du ci/ /rab 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /'khor lo khyod kyi sku la rdzogs min nam/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi gdung ni/ gnam nas lce ring g.yu ring / g.yu bse mched gsum las/ g.yu ring gis dmu'i bu mo dmu sa ldem khab tu bzhes pa'i sras spun bdun byung ba'i chung ba'i sras thog tsha dpa' bo stag dang / mon bza' mtsho mo rgyal gnyis kyi sras g.ya' spang skyes kyis srin po skya rengs khrag med bsad/ g.ya' brum sil ma phrogs te khab tu bzhes par sras bltams pa de srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du skyes pas ming 'khon par skyes su btags te/ 'khon gyi gdung brgyud ces pa'i don yang de ltar yin/ de'i sras dpa' po ches mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po mdzad/ rlangs lo tsā ba'i bu mo lha sa khrem bu khab tu bzhes par sras khri mdzes/ lha legs/ tshe la —419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (te/dbang phyug /'khon klu'i dbang po/ tshe (5ba 'dzin rnams las/ klu'i dbang pos mkhan po rin che'i drung du rab tu byung zhing / slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i dngos kyi slob mar gyur/ gceng gi sras rdo rje rin chen slob dpon pad+mas rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad/ rig sngags 'chang ba chen po de'i sras shes rab yon tan gyis grom par byon/ de'i sras yon tan 'byung gnas/ de'i sras tshul khrims rgyal po/ de'i sras rdo rje gtsug tor shes rab/ de'i sras dge skyabs/ de'i sras dge mthong /de'i sras 'khon ston bal po zhes pas tsha mo rong gi brag la sgrub pa mdzad pas rdo rje phur pa zhal gzigs/de'i sras shākya blo/ de'i sras gcen 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims dang / gcung 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po byon te/ skabs shig khrom chen po'i dbus na sngags pa mang pos dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi zhal brnyan dang phyag mtshan sogs dang bcas nas gar 'chams mang po byed kyi 'dug pa gcung gis gzigs pas/ da gsang sngags 'chol bas rnying ma la grub thob mi 'byung gsungs nas rang gi yab chos rnams gter du sbas te sngags gsar ma'i lo tsā ba bla chen 'phrog mi sogs bsten nas gsang sngags phyi 'gyur la gtso bor mdzad/ 'on kyang chos skyong dkar mo bdud rgyal gyi cho 'phrul che bar byung pas rdo rje gzhen nu'i skor la slar yang nyams len gnang / gra bo lung par dgon pa zhig btab pas sa skya gog por grags shing / de rjes dpon po ri'i ngos su dpal ldan sa skya'i chos sde chen po 'ding bar mdzad/de'i sras bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pas/(6na)de nas bzung ste dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi rigs zhes grags/ de la sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba rgya gar du tshad pas gshegs/ de 'og slob dpon rin po che dang rje btsun rin po che gnyis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen po mngon du mdzad la/ gcung dpal chen 'od po che la paṇa chen sku mched gnyis byung ba'i che ba gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por rgya bod yongs su —420

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ benagrags shing / gcung la sras 'phags pa rin po che sogs bdun byung ba'i slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal yin la/ de yang 'gro mgon phyag nas/ khong rang gi sras dharma rak+ṣi ta gdan sar bzhag nas/ bla ma bdag nyid pa 'di gdung brgyud khungs ma min tshul gyi snyan 'phra gong ma rgyal po la phul bar brten/ rgya mtsho dang nye ba'i yul du re zhig phebs dgos pa byung zhing / de nas mi ring bar sa skya'i dpon chen sogs kyis gdan sar gdan drangs chog pa'i gser yig pa mngags kyang don ma mthong / chos rje khu dbon gyi mgon po'i bka' babs kyi slob ma gha a nyan dam pas pho brang gi steng du la kha'u'i rdo char dang bya rog lcags kyi mchu sder can gyis skad bsgrags pa sogs kyi cho 'phrul bstan pas/ bla ma bdag nyid pa la bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te gdan sar mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ bla ma 'di nyid la mdo khams su sras gcig dang /dbus gtsang du jo mo bdun bzhes pa'i sras che ba rgyud las dha rma pā la rak+ṣi ta bya ba sogs rim gyis e rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi sa'i char rus tsho gyes pa yin no/ /lha rigs dpag bsam yongs 'du gsar pa las/ /'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi yal 'dab rab rgyas rtser/ /mkhas dang (6ba〉spyab pa'i gang bu ldem pa 'di/ /thub bstan nor 'dzin mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi dpyid/ /dman pa'i rigs bral 'od gsal lha yi gdung / /nus mthu'i rtsal lda na rig sngags 'chang ba'i rgyud/ /mkhyen pa'i dpal mnga' 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi rigs/ /tshul 'dis shākya'i gdung gi bsnyems kha pa phrogs/ /gang gi rigs las mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs/ /rgyun chad med par rtag tu 'ong gyur na/ khyod kyi gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan kun/ rtsol med lhun gyis grub par gor ma chag /de yang yul phyogs de'i dbyibs yi ge e'i rnam pa can du yod pa dang / bod du hor gyi lung byung skabs/ dpon po grog mo skam po la chol zer nas ma/bar btsan po mang du brtsigs pas hor gyi khrims 'khur ma dgos zhes rgan po'i ngag sgros su gleng zhing / phag mo gru pa'i sde srid kyi dus/ lha btsan po 'od srungs kyi gdung brgyud nang so rgya ri ba'i mnga' 'bangs su gyur pa/ skye bo phal che ba dag —421—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo lta/yig rigs dang rtsis skar nag /sku brnyan gyi bris 'bur sogs che phra'i yon tan la bslab sbyangs ches dar ba'i yul de'i skyogs mkhar zhes pa'i grong du/ yab 'khon rigs gsang sngags rnying ma bka' gter mtha' dag la gsan pa rgya che zhing / grub pa'i yon tan yang dag par brnyes pa dpon tshe dbang nor rgyas dang / yum bud med tha mal pa'i skyon gyi rigs mtha' dag rgyang du bsrings pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rgyal mo 'dzom zhes bya ba'i sras su rab byung bcu pa 'phags pa'i yul du du rma ti zhes pa bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'dir blo ngan du 'bod cing / rgya nag po'i rgyal khams su zin yi 'ur brjod pa/ phyogs 'dir dbang thang dang (7na thastun pa lcags mo bya'i lo la sku bltams shing mched gsum las bgres pa yin zhes grag go /rab dang gtsang ma'i chu rgyun sbreng ba yis/ /mngal gyi dri ma 'byud pa'i rim gro pa/ /tshangs dang brgya byin lhags par nye 'khor gyi/ /skye bos ma mthong ma rig sgrib pa'i skyon/ /legs bris bu mo'i mnyen 'jam lag pad kyis/ /man+ta ra dang u rdu wā ra sogs/ /chu skyes 'phreng ba tshar du mngar ba la/ /dbang po'i gzhu yi srad bu'i dra bas sbrel/ /tshul 'dis me tog mda' can la sogs pa'i/ /bdud sde'i snying la zug rngu byin pa dang / /dkar phyogs skyong la spro dga' cher rtas rnams/ /yid kyi dga' ston spel ba mnyam du byas/ btsas ma thag pa nas hrīḥdang dhīḥdang a ra pa tsa na sogs 'ba' zhig 'dren pa byung zhing / na tshod gzhen nu'i dus nyid na'ang byis pa'i rnam pa ye med par rtsed mo'i tshab tu yang byis pa zla bo rnams la dbang bskur chos bshad mdzad pa/ rtsig pa dang rdo la yi ge 'bri ba'i rnam pa sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i skye ba rim par brgyud pa'i bag chags bcos ma ma yin pa lhur mdzid pas/ bod rgan po gzhan gyi lugs ltar pha ma g.yo can gyis ched du gnyer nas bcos pa'i ngang tshul sogs ni rgyang du bsrings so/ /e ma rta ljang dbang po de/ tan ra tshe puṇ+ḍa ri ga'i tshal/ /'dab ma rnam par ba 'ad byed bzhin/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul lhun gyis grub/ /bsil sbyin mkhan po'i 'od zer gyis/ /pad tshal rgyas par 'dod —422

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)pa ltar/ /g.yo can bcos ma'i sgro 'dogs de/ /skya rengs 'char kha'i skar tshogs bzhin/ /ches phra'i na tshod myu gu'i rtser/ /'phags mchog yon tan gang bu'i khur/ /rnam par (7bsko ba'i ngo mtshar 'dis/ /kun mkhyen ngang tshul gsal ba ba/ /dgung lo bdun brgyad tsam gyi dus yi ge'i 'bri klog rnams dka' tshegs chen po ma dgos par mkhas par mkhyen zhing / de skabs yig ris ston pa'i slob dpon de'i dpe cha'i khrod na theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi skor mang du 'dug pas/ 'bri klog gi gseng dang / slob dpon gyis ma gzigs pa'i lkog thams cad du ljags klog gnang bas/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa bcos ma ma yin pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / khyad par grong pa'i mi zhig gis khyi la gri brgyab pa'i me'i zug rngu mi bzod pa byung nas skad drag po yang yang 'don pa gsan zhing gzigs pa byung bas kyang rkyen byas te/ khyi des dngos su dper mtshon pa'i 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal la mi bzod pa'i snying rje shugs drag po'i dbang gis spyan chab mang du 'don pa byung / 'di skabs na tshod kyang phra zhing sku tshe 'di'i gsung rab kyi sbyangs pa cher ma mdzad pa'i skabs yin 'dug kyang / rgyal sras dam pa'i ngang tshul ston pa de ni thun mong ba'i rnam thar cig la che bar mthong zhing / lar mi tshe hril por thos pa byas kyang chos nyon mongs pa'i grogs su song ba'i mkhas rlom dang / sems can sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la ba spu la g.yo 'gul tsam yang med pa'i 'gro ba'i 'dren par rlom pa'i bshes gnyen gyi sha tshugs can gyis ljongs 'di gang ba mthong bas kyang lhag par dad pa'i gsos so/ /'khor ba'i chu gter che la gnas bcas te/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong rab 'khrug pa'i/ /mi zad 'gro la brtse ba'i snying rje yis/ /phyin drug spyod la 'jug par ring du chas/ /rang gi gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba kun/ /gzhan la gtong zhing (8na)sdug bsngal dang len pa'i/ /tshul 'dis rgyal ba'i sras kyi mdzad pa kun/ khyod kyi rnam thar yin par da gdod khums/ /rim gyis chu mig lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i legs par sbyar ba ka wā pa'i steng nas sgra'i ri mo dang /—423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (te/gzhan yang mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍi'i gtsug lag snyan ngag me long gi dper brjod/ mkhan po thon mi'i gzhung sum rtags/ gso rig gi skor sogs la bslab sbyangs mdzad pas thugs su legs par chud/yul lugs kyi stabs nas gsung rab 'bri ba yang mang du mdzad do/ /sngon sbyangs mang du thos pa'i bang mdzod gang / /thogs med spyod la ngal ba'i gnas bral zhes/ /ston phyir brda ston tsam gyis rig pa'i gnas/ /ma 'dres thugs kyi me long ngos su shar/ /na tshod ches gzhen blo gros rgan po'i rtsal/ /tha mal tshul bzung dam pa'i rnam thar skyong / /bslab sbyang la brtson sngon nas chos kun mkhyen/ /mkhas par gyur kyang yon tan ngoms pa med/ /de nas dgung lo bcu lon pa'i tshe/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho nang so rgya ri bas ri sgo chos rdzong du spyan drangs skabs/ ma gcig grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed zhus/ chos rje skal bzang pa/chos rje dge 'dun bsam grub/ chos rje sangs rgyas blo gros gsum la tshe dbang gsan/dgung lo bcu gsum lon tshe dwags po grwa tshang gi slob dpon skal bzang rgya mtsho la sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi rjes gnang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi lung / gdugs dkar bstod pa dang bcas pa'i lung / byang chub lam rim chung ba'i dkar po'i las 'bras la thug gi bar gyi bshad lung gsan/sngags (8ba)rnying ma'i rin po che nor bu yongs grags la tshe sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa/ zur ri slob dpon par ga rma rka tshang nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang grub rgyal lugs/ sngags grwa che chung gi bla ma gnyisal 'brug pa nas brgyud pa'i ras chung snyan rgyud lugs kyi tshe rta zung 'brel ting 'dzin gyi dbang dang bcas pa/ yab la rgyud gsang ba snying po dang / de'i 'grel pa g.yung ston gyis mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i phyogs bcu mun sel sogs zab chos ci rigs pa gsan/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chog legs pa'i shes rab kyis lam khar dge bsnyen zhig la chos zhus pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ ku su lu pa'i bla ma mang po la dbang gdams ngag gsan pas dam pa'i chos phyir du snying stobs kyi brtul phod pa ni/—424

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i mdzad pa bzhin no/ /dam pa'i chos dang zang zing nor brje ba'i/ /dus ngan 'dir yang thos bsam sgom pa'i ched/ /dka' spyad khur du bzod pa'i sems dpa' khyod/ /mi gnas myang 'das sa der rings sam snyam/ /gdod ma nyid nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /mngon du gyur kyang tshul de thob pa'i thabs/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar rgya mtsho yis/ /blo dman phal cher 'phyang mo'i dra bar mdzud/ /dgung lo bcu bdun pa dbang phyug ces pa me mo glang gi lo/ sa skya nas bdag chen sngags 'chang chen po bsam yas su phebs/ yab sras gnyis ka mjal bar phebs rtsis la/ bdag chen pas ( zhwa ser gyis bar khang gi zhal ba 'phyi ba'i rdog phyis byed zer ba'i gtam ngan zhig byung bas/ yab kyis mdzad pa de 'dra yin na mi rus ni mnyam/ ci byed ces ma byon/ phyis gtam de bden pa'i nges pa mi 'dug /chos kyi gegs byung gsung yang bdag chen 'di mdzad pa (9na〉dung po zhig yod 'dug pas phal cher bden pa 'dra/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po nang so rgya ri bas gdan drangs/ gtsug phud 'bul mi shin tu mang ba 'dug pa dang lhan cig par/ rje 'di pa'i thugs dgongs la/ rgyal ba 'di lta bu la rab tu byung thub na skal ba re bzang snyam pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i thugs dad zhabyungs te/ rab tu byung / mtshan bsod nams rnam rgyal du gsol te/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs/nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas khyim gyi lha min dpung / /glags bltar nus min thub bstan lha dbang gi /rnam rgyal khang bzang nang du legs zhugs pas/ /gtan bder 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsir spyod/ /de skabs kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi chos skor/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / spyan ras gzigs kyi skyes rabs/ de'i dmar khrid/ 'khyer so gsum gyi ngang nas yig drug bzla lugs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bstod tshogs skor 'ga' zhig gi lung / dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/ ma gcig dpal lha dang spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i 425

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (skarjes gnang gnyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po la dngos su gsan pa'i nye rgyud/ slob dpon pad+ma'i dngos slob grub chen pad+ma badz+ra la dngos su gsan pa'i tshe dbang nye rgyud rnams gsan/ de dus chos sgor zhugs pa phal cher la rgyal dwags po grwa tshang du 'gro dgos pa'i bka' phebs gnang gi 'dug pa ltar/ rje 'di nyid phebs bzhed byung na yang yo byad ma 'grig pa sogs kyi stabs nas lo ngo bzhi tsam gyi ring 'bri klog gi sgo nas 'gro phan mdzad pa dang /khyad par dgung lo bco brgyad lon pa 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag gi lor/ khu bo sngags (9ba)rnying ma'i rtogs ldan gangs kyi seng ge 'dra ba zhig yod pa de dang lhan du/ slob dpon chen po'i dngos kyi slob ma/ yang dag thugs kyi bka' babs snubs nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam 'phrul/ rig 'dzin chen po nyi zla sangs rgyas pa'i drung du theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse/ rgyud sde kun gyi gtso bo/ rdzogs pa chen po slong gsal snying thig ces rgyal blon gyi dus kyi lo tsā ba lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi skye mtha' 'gro 'dul gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gter ma'i dbang lung khrid man ngag dang bcas pa gsan pas sngon gyi bla na med pa'i bag chags kyi mthus me lcags dang spra ba'i snang tshul ltar/ gdod nas 'brul ma myong ba'i rang rig chos kyi skur ngo 'phrod do/ /ma rig sprin rgyas rang sems nyin mor byed/ /bsgribs pa'i zhabrul pa'i 'gro 'di rang mtshang rnams/ /ston pa'i chos tshul 'di ko kun tu bzang / /ma bcos rang sar grol ba'i gzigs mor yengs tha mal snang zhing chen pa'i cho 'phrul kun/ /sems kyi klong du dag pas gang shar rnams/ /chos skur grol tshe be+e ro tsa na de/ /'gyur med bde ba'i dbyings su zhi bar mnal/ /a ti'i chos tshul yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /med byung blo yis cig car 'thungs pa na/ /ljongs 'dir 'gyur pa'i sems klong man ngag sde/ /glegs bam mang por grags kyang gtam du zad/ /gzhan yang drag po rang byung rang shar gyi dbang 'bring po/ dam rdzas skye bdun gyi skor/ rje nyid kyi rnam mgur/ gter ston rin chen dpal bzang gi mnal lam dar dkar ma'i snyan rgyud mdzod rkang —426—

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)dgu pa yan/ de'i rnam thar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dam can sdebadun gyi gtor chog /gter ka 'og ma'i btags grol/ skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang (10na)sgrub/ mnga' bdag dung mtsho ras pa'i tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor/ ma 'ongs lung bstan sogs lho byang gi gter ma'i dbang lung mang du gsan/ nyams len gyi tshe thang lhod phran tshegs byung dus/ khu bos/ skas kha'i 'og gi ljang bu dang 'dra ba khyod gsung zhing / bka' skyon dang phyag 'bebs yang yang mdzad/ tshan gyi bcud len 'ba' zhig la brten nas bsgoms pas nyams rtogs shin tu 'phel ba byung /dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa'i tshe/ rje nyi zla sangs rgyas pa de nyid sgrub sde kun bzang rtser phebs pa'i phyag phyi mdzad/ slar yang dbang dang gdams pa gnang bar gsol ba btab ste/ sprul sku dri med lhun pos bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang gi rang byung thugs rje chen po'i gtsang khang nas gdan drangs pa'i don tig 'gro ba kun grol gyi dbang lung 'khrid man ngag kun gsan nas/ thugs nyams su bstar pa'i tshul mdzad/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen rin po che'i theg mchog mdzod kyi bshad lung / bla ma sku gsum gyi sgrub pa'i chos skor/ rin po che bye tshang pas mdzad pa'i khug pa lnga'i ngo sprod sogs mang du gsan/ skabs shig gter ston bde chen gling pa e gnyal tshor 'gro don la phebs par zhal mjal gnang / bka' 'brel med kyang lung zin gyi gter ston du dgongs pa'i thugs mos tshad med pa zhakhrungs/ e yi nang du khrag mtsho lan gsum khol:sogs dang / bu dal la dmag yong ba'i lung bstan kyang nges pa shin tu 'grongs pa byung gnang ngo / / mi ring bar yab gshegs pa'i de ma thag gsal 'debs kyi rten 'bul bar (10ba)grab tu rje nyi zla sangs rgyas kyi sku 'khas su phebs pas/ sgo drung du grwa pa cig gis yab grongs pa yin nam zhes dris byung bar/ skad cha yong tshod min par sus glengs gsungs pas/ rin po ches thugs dam 'od gsal gyi ngang nas gzigs pas bka' phebs gnang zer bas/ sngar nas thugs dad bla na ma mchis pa yod pa'i steng du slar yang brjod du med pa'i gong 'phel du gyur/ dus phyis bka' phebs gnang —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6te/ba'i mdangs la brtags tshe/ rig 'dzin 'di nyid la o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po de dang ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs nges phul du byung ba zhig 'khrungs par mngon/ de dus mdo sngags kyi thos pa rnams grub rjes tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i ri khrod kho na ma gtogs go sa 'dzin pa sogs gtan mi byed/khyad par nges don yang zab rdzogs pa chen po dang mjal bar ches dka'/ da res sangs rgyas lag par gtod rgyu yod pa'i skabs 'dir mi med kyi dben pa lo na bsten dgongs te/ sgrub 'phrin mngon spyod sogs la don gnyer cher ma gnang bas/ rin po che'i gsung las/ nged kyang snga mo khyod kyi blo dang 'dra ba zhig yod kyi/ dus phyis bu slob 'dra mang bas 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i skor 'di yang dgos pa cig byung gsung / phyis nyi thang gi bla ma gnang dus 'phreng po sogs su ban sngags mang pos sgrub 'phrin zhung 'ongs pa la brten/ rje btsun las kyi rdo rje sogs la slar don gnyer byed dgos byung / de skabs ni 'dod chos de dag ma thob pas byed ma thub/ slar chos zhu ba de tsho ma byung bas ci yin nam snyam tsa na/rjes su bdag po rin po che'i dbon sku mched (11na)gnyis der bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis chos kyis ma phongs pa yin par 'dug ces bka' phebs pa thos pas/ rin po che'i gsung de ni mngon par mkhyen pa'o/ /yon tan dbyar skyes gzhen nu kun/ /skyed la gshin pa'i nor 'dzin mchog /'gyur med dad pa'i dam bca' de/ /lhun po bas kyang ches cher brtan/ /zur rigs dam par srid gzung tshe/ /theg mchog dgongs don mngon gyur na/ /slar yang thos bsam sgom pa la/ /brtson 'di gdul bya'i ngor 95ba/thag ba/34 /de nas dgung lo nyi shu lon tshe sngar gyi thugs bzhed ltar/ shar phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me dwags po grwa tshang du phebs rtsis kyis ri sgo rdzong du nang so rgya ri bar lam skyel dgos tshul zhus pas/ khyod la sangs rgyas zhag bdun ma'i gdams pa yod nas/ grwa tshang la 'gro mi dgos la che zhes/ grab tu rin po che'i sku gzhogs su byon pa la ma rangs pa'i kun slong skyon can gyi zur za bar byung bas/ slar —428

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ tanabaskyar ba sogs ma gnang bar thugs thag bcad de 'grul tshan g.yin dang bsdebs nas phebs/ de ni tshar chen rin po ches/ lar snangs chung la blo rigs rgod pa'i sde dpon dbon skya'i rigs 'di lug thug gi sgro bas wa mo nyin thebs gcog pa ma gtogs dgos pa mi 'dug pas/ de 'dra'i rigs la bya bral rnams lam gzhung srong ba rang gnad du gda' zhes gsung ba dang mthun par snang ngo / /rnam gnon zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo de'i hor gyi zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu'i nyi ma'i bzhi cha lus pa'i dus su/ mkhan po rin po che mang thos mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ol kha (11ba〉gri pa blo bzang rgya mtsho'i drung du dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos/ de nas bzung ste grwa tshang gi sgrigs 'grim la bzhugs/ bsdus pa sogs ched gnyer gyi bslab sbyang ma dgos par rang shugs kyis mkhyen/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la dbus su phebs khar/ chos rje don grub rin chen gyis/ thog mar phar phyin la gsan pa mdzad dgos par gsungs pa bzhin/ sngon du phar phyin gyi bskyar chos yongs rdzogs gnyis dang / dbu ma'i bskyar chos tshar 'ga' gsan cing / rigs lung sogs kyis mtha' chod par gnang bas/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod kyi don rnams tshig tsam du ma lus par gdams ngag tu shar te/sngon byon gyi mkhas grub rnams dgyes pa bskyed par mdzad do/ /grangs med thub bstan nags klung 'phreng ba'i dbus/ /blo bzang grags snyan ring lugs yongs 'du'i ljon/ /dri med tshar du mngar ba'i 'bras bu yi/ /gang thugs legs bris tshogs kyi brtan pa phyogs/ /'phags yul mkhas mang gtsug rgyan shing rta che'i/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bgrod byed pa'i/ mtshungs med mkhyen dpyod brtson pa'i gru rdzings 'di/ /dregs ldan gzhan gyi blo yi yul las 'gongs/ /sngon nas sher phyogs mdo dang bstan bcos kyi/ /u t+pal phang phung rgod pa'i ze'u 'bru/ /blo gros cod pan rgyan du 'dzum byas na/ /slar yang gsan 'di gzhan la co 'drir nges/ /spyi chos su byang chub lam rim chung ba'i skyes bu chung ngu'i skor gyi bshad lung / rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs dang / gsang ba'i (12na sgom thar/ bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che las—429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yorngog chos kyi skor dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar rnams kyi lung bzabs bshad dang bcas pa gsan/ chu rta dgung lo nyer gnyis lon tshe dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gzhal med khang mchog dman gyi skye bo yongs kyi spyod yul du gyur pa chos 'khor rgyal gyi dbyar chos dus/shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi dgongs don phyin ci ma log pa dpal ldan zla ba'i zhal lung ltar/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa myong kha pa chen po'i bzhed pa ji bzhin du gsal bar ston pa'i zab mo dbu ma'i lta khrid kyi thugs rtsom gnang bas/ rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa phal cher thugs yid phrogs shing / mdzad byang gsal kha med pa la brten/ rje nyid dang grwa thog gcig pa'i chags sdang gi rnam pa yid la byed pa zhig gis sus mdzad ma nges shing don bzang po 'dug pa la brten blo la bzung nas bshar sbyang mang du byas shing / skabs shig mdzad pa po shes nas 'phro bcad do/ /de rjes yum don gsal ba'i sgron me grub mda' mkhan po blo bzang chos 'phel grwa tshang gi chos 'chad khri thog tu byon pa nas bzung rim gyis phar phyin gyi spyi don/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gi bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'dul mdzod sogs kyi gzhung 'grel kun la thos bsam phul du byung ba mdzad/ e ri sgo'i chos thog zhig gi skabs mched grogs zhig gis bskul ba la brten nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro tshul gyi gdams pa zab mo snyan brgyud khyad par gsum ldan zhes bya ba'i thugs rtsom (12ba)gnang / lo shas nas ri sgo chos sde'i dge skos kyi las sne las babs te/gzhi dgon du lo gcig bzhugs/ las sne thon rjes ri khrod cig tu 'gol bzhugs kyi skabs/ dwags po rab 'byams pa dang / byams gling rab 'byams pa zhes dpal ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po dpon slob khri rin po che dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis la/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi khyi ka dang / khyad par rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa la rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bzabs bshad dang / zhan la dkon mchog gsum gyi dka' gnad dang / sgra 'tshams sbyor lnga pa gsungs/ dus phyis skyid shod dga' ldan khang gsar du dpon slob —430

'bon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)gnyis gdan 'dzom pa'i tshe/ khri rin po che nas phyag lan sogs ni mi gnang bas/ nag tsho lo tsā ba bri ka ma la shī lar bzhugs skabs nā ro pa phebs pa la jo bo chen pos phyag mi 'tshal bar 'dug pas/nā ro pa jo bo'i bla ma min nam snyam pa'i the tshom byung ba'i lo rgyus dang mtshungs par mngon no/ /rlabs chen mkhyen pa'i shing rta yis/ /drangs pa'i yon tan phung po'i tshogs/ /gser ldan sto ba 'dir shong ba/ /e ma sa ni shin tu yangs/ /tha dad gdul bya'i kun gsal ngos/ /chos phung char sprin stong 'khrigs kyang / /lam bzang zhing sa brlan pa la/ /mtshungs pa'i gnad don lhug par gzigs/ /mtha' bral rten cing 'brel 'byung gi legs bshad dbyar rnga bsgrags pa'i tshe/ /skal ldan gtsug phud can rnams kun/ /dga' ba'i zlos gar byed la brel/ /de ltar dwags po grwa tshang du (13na7do phyogs kyi thos bsam la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa dang ldan yang / sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis kyang thos bsam la ngoms pa med par mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / lhag par rje nyid byams chen chos rje dang rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i bag chags kyi mthus/ se ra theg chen gling gi byes mkhas mang grwa tshang 'di spyir yang gzhung lugs mtha' dag gtan la 'bebs pa'i rab 'byams smra ba'i 'dus sde chen po yin pa dang / khyad par zab mo dbu ma'i gnad don gtan la 'bebs pa'i bka' babs yin pa'i thugs nges dang bcas te skyid shod ser byes su phebs/ 'chad nyan las thog tu chos rje dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub dang 'phrin las lhun grub gnyis rim pa bzhin bzhugs 'dug pa la gus pa gsum gyis btud de/ dpal mgon 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi sras kyi thu bo zla ba'i zhabs kyi 'jug pa rtsa 'grel dang / de'i dgongs don 'khrul ba med par ston pa'i rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa yab sras kyi legs bshad rnams kyi nying khur bsgril te ṭī ka 'grel gtso bor gsan/'gyangs med du gling bse grub/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub la spyi chos dang sgos chos ci rigs par/rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bka' 'bum thor bu/ glengs bam bka' rgya ma/ lha chos bdun ldan/ rang rgyud la —431—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6te/bskul ma 'debs pa dad pa'i ljon shing / ma 'ongs lung bstan/ lo rgyus/ zhu lan nor bu'i phreng ba'i rtsa ba/ mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla/ 'byed gnyis dang / chos 'tshams su pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros (13ba)pa'i dbang / phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi dbang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang rnams gsan/ de nas phun tshogs dge bcu'i yon tan gcig tu 'du ba'i yul grur/ sde srid rin po che drung chen ta'i sī tus phyag bdar te 'debs par mdzad pa'i chos grwa chen po dpal gyi rtses thang zhes ris su ma chad pa'i rigs pa smra ba mtha' klas pa tshogs pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i grwa bskor mdzad do/ /gsung rab kyi dka' ba'i gnad la bshad pa 'byams klas pas dpyod ldan yongs kyi sgra 'dzin bu mo'i brtan pa yongs su phyogs shing / rtsod pa'i nga ros rgol ༅ ri dgas kyi spobs pa 'joms par mdzad do/ /theg chen chos kyi srid la dbang 'byor bas/ sngon gnas rjes dran mthu yis bskul ba na/ /rin chen gling du 'dod ldan skye bo bzhin/ /chos phyir bzhul ring zhugs la lhag par brtson/ /rab 'byams shes bya'i mtha' de khyod nyid kyis/ /rab yangs mkhyen pa'i srang la gzhal ba na/ /rab mdzes 'jam mgon bstan pa'i 'khor lo de/ /rab dga'i tshul gyis khyod kyi mgrin par 'byud/ /sum rtsen 'dzin mar 'phos 'dra'i sman ljongs kyi/ /bgrang yas mkhas mang 'du ba'i rtses thang du/ /lung rigs nor bu char du bsnyil ba na/ /mkhas 'dod mching bu'i rang mtshang phal cher bstan/ /slar yang skyid shod du phebs/ dga' ldan chos rje byams pa rgya mtsho la byang chub lam rim chung ba'i bshad lung gsan/ de skabs/ lhas brag dgon spyan snga (14na)gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po mdo sngags kyi gsan rgya shin tu che ba'i grags pa la brten/ brag dgon du phebs/ spyan snga rin po che'i drung du dpal snar thang ba'i mngon rtogs brgya rtsa/ rdo rje 'phrong ba dang / kri yas muñtsa zung du 'jug pa zhe lnga ma'i dbang / gri gug lcam dral gyi rjes gnang snying zhugs dang sbrags pa/ rnam 'joms bde —432

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)mchog dkar po/ /rta mgrin sho ṇa bzhi bskor/ dbyangs can ma gsang sgrub/ rje btsun rig byed ma/'jam dbyangs nang bsgrub/ dur khrod bdag po/ 'jam dkar gtso 'khor lnga pa/ 'jam dbyangs lus dkyil/ dpa' gcig /sgrol dkar/ seng gdong ma/ tsho gos bdag dkar dmar rnams kyi rjes gnang /byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan lugs kyi rta mgrin lcags ral can gyi rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang / chos skor/ 'jam dbyangs nag po'i bzlas lung /gu ru zhi ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ tshe ring mched lnga'i rigs gtad/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ rtsa she/lam sgron/ glang thang pa'i blo sbyong tshigs brgyad ma/ blo sbyong mtshon cha 'khor lo/ rma bya dug 'dzoms/rtog pa 'bur 'joms/ skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ nyi ma'i 'od zer/ bslab bya chen mo/ /gnas bcu'i sgrub yig /dpe chos rin chen spungs pa rtsa 'grel/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i lam rim gyi khrid/kha rag pa'i ang yig bdun cu/ khrid chen brgyad kyi kha skongs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i lam rim gyi khrid/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum ca dum pa dang cha (14ba)dum pa'i lung sogs dbang lung man ngag gi rigs mtha' yas pa gsan/ spyan snga 'di nyid chos kyi gan mdzod lta bu yin par 'dug ces phyis kyang bsngags brjod mang du gnang / lan gcig spyan snga la skye brtag zhus pas/ lha mo shra wa ṇa'i sgo nas rmi lam bsgugs gsungs pa bzhin gnang bas/ srod kyi mnal lam du bud med cig byung nas khyod la lo bdun tshe las med zer bas/chos ldan gyi dgos pa du ma sgrub pa'i gegs su gyur gyi dogs nas thugs 'dzangs par byung bas/slar smon lam btab/ bar gcod sel byed la ci phan dris pas/ tho rangs kha'i mnal lam du lo re la tshe dpag med dang sgrol dkar gyi sku brgya re bzhengs na lo bdun cu don bdun thub/ de nas ci byas kyang mi phan zer ba byung ba ltar/ sku brnyan rnams lo ltar gyi ma chag pa gnang / skabs shig bar gcod kyi rnam pas grang gzhi'i snyun gyis sku cung zad ma bde ba la/ drung pa sngags ram pa bzang po rnam rgyal byin rlabs che bar grags pas/ sras khang dgon par phebs te/ byin rlabs dang thabs zhus pas/—433—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skamagon po trag shad kyi rjes gnang mdzad/ de nub rmi lam sgugs shig gsung / srod kyi mnal lam du mi pho mo thal skya mang po zhig 'dug pa la/ mi nag rta nag zhen pa mdung khyer ba zhig gis ded song ba byung / nangs par phyag 'bul la thegs pas/ mdang 'am bus kho gtang yod pa sleb e byung gsung /chos skyong bran du 'khol ba'i rtags su 'dug ces phyis bka' phebs gnang / gzhan yang mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang (15na〉sto bzhi dril sgrub dang bla mgon dbyer med kyi khrid/ dmigs brtse ma'i khrid/ lhung bshags kyi khrid/ 'pho khrid/ gshed dmar lha bcu gsum gyi dbang / za ma tog gi lung khrid/ bcu gcig zhal lha lnga dang don zhags lha lnga'i dbang / zhal klu sgrub rtsa mgon gyi rjes gnang /zhal bram gzugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mgon po dang rnam sras kyi rgyas pa dang dbang gi zhabrul 'khor gyi phyag len/ sman bla/ phyag rdor gos sngon can/ rnam sras ser chen sogs cho me bka' mang du gsan/chu 'brug lor yar klungs mkhar thog tu mang thos mkhas pa'i dbang po chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bzhi/ de'i sngags btu/ mgon po/chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum/ rnam sras/ rnam 'joms/ phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi rjes gnang gsan/ slar yang 'dod chos zhu bar yongs chog pa'i bka' bzhes bzang po gnang zhes phyis kyang thugs gzo ba'i bka' 'phros gnang / skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar chos rje rin chen bshes gnyes par/ 'jigs byed kun rig gnyis kyi dbang / chos rgyal rnam sras gnyis kyi rjes gnang / lcam sring seng gdong ma gnyis kyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ byang chub gzhung lam/ 'dul ba'i spyi don mkhas grub bka' 'bum gyi stod cha rnams gsan no/ /phyogs re'i yon tan phra mo'i khron pa yis/ /bsnyems ldan mkhas rlom rus sbal tshogs rnams kyis/ /gang gi mang thos chu gter rlabs zhabrug pa/ /mthong tshe khengs pa'i snying (15ba)de gas kyi dogs/ /bshes gnyen mang bsten brtson pa'i ljon shing la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i me tog ci ya nga g.yo/ /yon tan 'bras bu g.yur du za ba yi/ /tshul de dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i yul —434

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ (nyanazhig 05gas/ /skabs shig stod lung phyogs su phebs pas/ lam khar sde pa snang rtse nas khrom dbang zhig mdzad kyi 'dug pas/ khrom gyi mtha' gcig tu bzhugs nas gsan kyang / gsung chung zhid thag 'gyangs pas tshig 'bru gsal bar ma gsan/ bum pa dang tsa ka li 'grems pa sogs chib par gzigs/phyis rtsad bcad pas thugs rje chen po 'khor ba las sgrol gyi dbang yin par 'dug /'on kyang tshig sogs gsal ba ma byung bar brten dbang thob pa'i go chod pa mi gnang bar mngon zhing / de dus gter ston pa grags che skabs yin 'dug pas thugs mos che ba tsam byung ba 'dra yang / dus phyis lung bstan sogs mang du gzigs pas lhad che bar dgongs te btang sgoms su bzhag gnang ba 'dra zhig yod kyang / don du sde pa snang rtse ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i rang bzo'i rnam thar la mkhas pa chen po 'di thugs rting nas khrel bar kho bo sems so/ /dgung lo so bzhi lon pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta'i lo hor gyi zla ba bcu pa nyis brtsegs su byas pa'i phyi ma'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi rgyu skar 'dzom pa'i dus su/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos chos kyi sku mngon du mdzad pa'i gnas dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi gzims khang rgyal khang rtser/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen bo chos rje dpal 'byor (16na)rgya mtshos mkhan po dang chos rje rin po che dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis slob dpon mdzad/ dad pa'i dge 'dun bcu tshogs tshang ba'i dbus su yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po mnos/ mtshan dpal 'byor lhun grub tu gsol/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya chen mo dang / 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum sogs gyi bshad lung gsan no/ /mkhas mchog 'chi med lam gyi 'phang pa nas/ /rnam dag tshul khrims lang tsho la chags pa'i/ /bla gos 'tshams sprin gsar pa'i lus phra ma/ /thar pa'i bde la spyod phyir 'byud la brel/ /nyes spyod rnyog pa'i 'dam las cher 'phags pa'i/ /bag yod sdong bu rnam par ldem pa'i rtser/ /tshangs spyod dpal 435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skagyi 'dab stong 'dzum pa de/ /thub bstan rkang drug yongs kyi dga' ston gnas// nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum grangs ldan gyi/ /ches phra'i spang bya kun las mi 'da' ba'i/ /gtsang ma'i rnam par thar 'dis 'dren pa khyod/ /gangs ri'i ljongs kyi nye bar 'khor du nges/ /de nas thugs dgongs la/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /zer ba bzhin/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi chos mtha' zad pa med pa lta bu yin pas/ sangs ma rgyas bar du slob gnyer tshar ba'i skabs ci mchis kyang / snying po'i mchog 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa phyi 'gyur gyi skor la thos bsam mdzad pa'i dgongs 'dun mngon du gyur te/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos dngos su bka' stsal ba rje btsun shes rab seng shes dang du bzhes te 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i 'dus sde/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i gsang (16bsngags 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi gtsug na mngon par mtho ba smad rgyud mkhas 'dus grwa tshang du phebs/ 'chad nyan las thog tu mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnam rgyal dpal bzang bzhugs 'dug pa la/ rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi thugs dang bar bcas te gus pas bsten nas/ shing lug lor 'dus pa bskyed rdzogs kyi ṭī ga'i bskyar lung / rim lnga gsal sgron/ bskyed rim rnam bshad/ rim lnga'i dmar khrid kyi sgom lung / khrid lag rjes tshar lnga/ rgyud rkyang le'u bcu gsum pa yan dang / 'grel pa mchan bcas le'u bcu gsum pa'i 'gog pa khro bo'i 'khor lo drang don yan tshar gnyis/ le'u bcu drug pa'i gnod sbyin pho mo 'gugs pa nas/ 'gyur byang gi bar gyi rtsa 'grel mchan bcas/ de thams cad kyi mtha' dpyod/ bstan pa spyi rnam bskyar lung dang bcas pa gsan/me sprel 'grel pa bzhi sbrags/ le'u bcu bzhi pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi las sgrub pa yan/ le'ubaco lnga pa'i 'tshams sbyor yan gyi smi ga'i bskyar lung / me bya la 'grel pa bzhi sbrags yongs rdzogs/gsal sgron/ bskyed rim rnam bshad/ sa khyi la bzhi sbrags kyi le'u bcu gsum pa'i nang rgyas pa dang dbang gi las spel te bstan pa yan/ rgyud phyi ma/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus lo chen dang 'gos kyi 'gyur la rgyal ba tsong kha pas zhus dag gnang ba sogs gsan/ bla mas kyang rang re'i smad —436

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ snyenargyud kyi dpal 'dus pa'i gzhung lugs 'di la rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar mi dbar khyis ma chod cing byin rlabs kyi (17na)drod ma yal zhes spro ba yang yang bskyed pa gnang gsung ngo / /gsang chen theg pa mchog gi gru rdzings la/ /brten nas sku gsum gling du rab bgrod pa'i/ /rin chen skyes bu'i mdzad pas 'phags yul gyi/ /grub chen brgyad cu'i rnam thar gcig tu bsdus/ /chags bral ngur smig 'dzin pa'i zhing sa la/ /'dod yon lam du spyod pa'i dbyar skyes 'bras/ /bde chen gos bu'i longs spyod mi zad gter/ /spyod 'dis klu sgrub zhabs kyi khengs pa phrogs/ /tha mal yongs dag gsal stong lha sku'i mkhar/ /gnyis med bde stong rab bkra dbang po'i gzhu/ /sku gsum ro gcig so sor ma 'dres pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar ngo mtshar smad/ /ltar snang grub spyod 'dam gyis ma gos pa'i/ /tshangs spyod brtul zhugs yal 'dab tshar rgyas kyang / /nye lam bde ba'i sbrang rtsi mdzad med kyi/ /in+d+ra bhū ti mkha' 'gro'i mdzod du bros/ /gzhan yang bla ma de nyid kyi drung du bde mchog lha i pa'i dbang / mgon po phyag drug pa/ rta mgrin gsang bsgrub/ 'dzam dkar ser rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs mkhas grub rje dang blo gros chos skyong ba gnyis kyis mdzad pa/ gzhi gsum cho ga /lam rim chung ba'i skyes bu 'bring gi sdug bden 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa yan/ lam rim gyi khrid/ mtshan brjod/ phyag rdor gyi rgyud/ dgra nag gi rgyud/ 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bdun pa/ bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i las gsum/ rnam gzhag /bla mgon dbyer med thun mong ma yin pa/ grib (17ba〉tsel/ rten bzhi gnad gsum/ mkha' 'gro dbang sdud/ mgon po gnad dbab/ drug cu pa'i sgor/ mgon po'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ chos rgyal gyi sgrub thabs rgya gzhung sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal mtha' yas pa len pa gnang / tshal gyi rgyud khang gi khang las dang logs bris skabs sa min dang mthing spang gzhan sus kyang ma rnyed par rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang nyid kyis rnyed cing / de skabs rje 'di pas kyang sa min len par phebs pas/ rje rnam dpal bas rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes mang du bzhag pa sogs sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzad pa —437

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nedapag par dka' ba mang du gzigs/ dus phyis rje yab sras kyi gsung rab kyi dka' gnad rnams la gzigs tshe yang / dus thog de la rang phyogs kyi mkhas grub grags can shin tu mang na yang / rje rnam dpal ba'i gsung nyid legs par 'dug ces rgyal ba tsong kha ba dngos kyi mos pa gnang /me bya la rgyud kyi chos 'tshams shig gi skabs/ gdan sa chen po'i gzims khang rgyal khang rtser mgon po bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs mdor byas dang mdo sre'i lung / 'grel pa don gsal gyi khyi ka /mdzod kyi gnas bzhi pa yan gyi khyi ga'i bskyar lung rnams dang / byang rtse chos sgo slob dpon 'phrin las dpal 'byor la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/ gu ru zhi ba/ gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed gsan cing / gzhan yang rgyud kyi chos 'tshams rnams su/ 'od gsal lha'i rigs las mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa lha rin po che la/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang / zhal rnam (18na tsher gyur bzhi'i rjes gnang / chos rgyal nang sgrub dang / zhang blon gyi rjes gnang / lha mo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' bsgo ba/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i las gsum rnam gzhag /gtor ma'i rnam bshad rten bzhi gnad gsum/ sngags don/ bsad pa drug gi yig chung / zha kha klu sgrub kyi rgya gzhung / gnyan 'o'i bskang thung / bsnyen sngags/ lha mo'i las gsum rnam gzhag /gtor chen rnam bshad/ zor bzhi thun sgrub/sbyin sreg /nad dang bya nag gtong thabs/ spogs chog /sho mo/ dpal 'bar brtag pa/spyan snga chos drug gi lung sogs mtha' yas pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ rme rtsegs/ khyung khra/ sgrol dkar/ u shār+ya rnams kyi rjes gnang chos rje byang ma nas la rnam thar dad pa'i la jug ngogs/ lam sgron gyi smi da rngog chos cha tshang rnams gsan/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan du slob dpon rin po che dge 'dun rgyal mtshan la rdo rje 'chang gi lam gyi rim pa dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi gnad bsdus pa shing rta chen po'i lam srol byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo'i dka' gnad kyi bshad pa dang bcas pa'i lung yongs rdzogs gsan/ gsung chos kyi skabs shig bzhugs sa spyi khang zhig gi 'og khang du byung bas/ de'i sngon tsam du gnas skor ba mdo pa bsdad shul yin 'dug —438

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)pas/ sku grib kyis shin tu bsnyun pa zhig byung yang / bshad lung gnyis ka rgyal ba tsong kha pa nas rim gyis tshig gcig kyang ma chad par brgyud nges yin par (18ba tha rten/ thugs rus bskyed nas chos thun gcig kyang ma chag par mdzad/ de yang sgom pa yon tan 'bar grang gzhi'i nad kyis na bar rnal 'byor pas gsungs pa'i don lta bu thugs la shar bar nges shing / lhag tu rgyal ba myong kha pa'i gsung rab kyi dka' gnad la don gnyer mtha' yas gnang ba'i stabs/ sku na mthon por phebs kyang bsnyel gso'i tshul ston pa gnang / lar chos phyir du dka' spyad bzod pa la rje mar pa dang / dge slong dang dge bsnyen gyi khyad par las med do/ /glog ltar mi brtan tshe 'di'i phun tshogs ched/ /blun po lus srog 'dor bar phod byed na/ /theg chen chos phyir brtson pa'i dka' spyad 'di/ /bzod la klan ga'i brtul zhugs su yis 'dzin/ /dka' gnad zhun thar mi gcod thob lor brtson/ /chos 'dod de ston bla mar snying nas smod/ khengs pas yongs 'dzin mi sten dpe hrul sdud/ /de 'dra'i bod rgan mang po'i snang tshul dag /mthong tshe khyod ni zab gnad yongs la mkhas/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon la lhag par dad/ /chos phyir mkhas grub sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /ris med gtsug bsten de phyir su mi dad/ /de nas sa phag lo dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen por chos rje nam mkha' bzang po'i drung du/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ bde mchog lha i pa/ dril bu lus dkyil gsum gyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang gsan/ e nas yum shin tu bsnyung pa'i 'bod mi byung ba dang lhan cig tu bshul du zhugs/ zhor lam 'phyong (19na)rgyas rtser phebs pas/zhabs drung gzhung ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa 'jig rten dga' ba'i rgyan gyis bdag rkyen tshang ma mchis pa gnang / gsung las/ yon bdag rab 'byams pa khyed gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi skor la don gnyer che ba yod 'dug pa/ des na zhabs drung bdag po rin po che de ring 'dir phebs rgyu yin pas/ khyed rang yang zhag shas 'di khar sdod la/ 'dod chos mtha' dag chos kyi bdag po la zhus chog 439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yogasungs byung bas/ thugs shin tu dgyes te chos 'ba' zhig la thugs dungs pa'i sems mngon gyur shugs ches pas yul du phebs dgos pa sogs zil gyis non pa lta bur song nas/ bzhugs par thugs thag bcad tshe/ 'bod mi des 'di ru yun ring na de bar yum grongs nas ngos kyis mjal rgyu mi yong zer/ nan shin tu che bas 'phral du thegs par shar/ lam du zhugs pa dang khri srong rnam sprul bdag po rin po che dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde phebs pa mjal/ phyag 'bul gnang bas/ thugs 'dris med kyang / sngar nas ngo mkhyen pa zhig dang 'dra ba'i thugs dgyes dgyes dpe med gnang gsung / nye bar brtags tshe/ ngos kyis chos bka' gsan pa sogs rten 'brel cung zad ma 'grig kyang / gang gi dngos slob rje btsun las kyi rdo rje dang / mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug sogs la gsan pa'i rten 'byung gi dgongs pa mdzad par sems so/ /rang yul du phebs te yum gyi 'di phyi'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi dge ba'i mdzad (19ba)pa rnams brtson pas bsgrubs/ lan bug a mi zhes dkar chas 'dzin pa'i bla ma lo brgya dang nyi shu tsam lon pa/ grongs dus kyang snyung gzhi sogs ye med par sras kyis thugs cung zad dkrugs par brten/yi dam chos srung rnams la da nga mi sdod thong zhig gsung ba'i mus la gshegs pa'i nus ldan de nyid kyi drung du/ gu ru zhi ba/ tshe dbang / rta mchog rol pa/ phyag rdor dregs 'dul/ nā ga rak+ṣa/ khyab 'jug /dbang phyug rnams kyi dbang / rta nag /lha mo spu gri'i rjes gnang / sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub kyi gtad lung sogs chos du ma dang / lha btsun nges legs dpal 'byor lhun grub la zhang blon gyi rjes gnang gsan/ slar skyid shod du phebs/ gzhis kha brag dkar du chos rje dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub la/ mkhas grub nor bzang pa'i dus 'khor spyi don/ bde mchog sbas don kun gsal/ dril bu lha lnga'i rgya gzhung / de'i 'grel pa rgyal ba tsong kha pas gnang ba/ lha i pa'i dkyil chog /zhu lan nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ khu chos tshang ba/ rje btsun rig byed ma'i chos skor/ khyung po'i mgur brgyad rtsa 'grel bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ mkhas grub rje dang grub chen thar pa'i rgyal mtshan pe/40

'bon ston dpal 'gror lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)gnyis kyi bstod pa gsan/ de nas phal che se ra theg chen gling du bzhugs te/ chos rje 'phrin las lhun grub sogs la bka' chos ci rigs pa zhus/mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo zhes thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas kyi rnam gzhag 'gran zla med pa'i legs par bshad pa'i thugs rtsom gnang / (20na nyon kyang sdeb sbyor gyi dz+wa ti'i skor nas gnang 'phro lus/ slar 'phro mus kyi gsol ba 'debs mi zhig byung na phyis skor gyi bstan bcos shig la legs pa zhig 'ong tshod du 'dug kyang / dus dbang gis skye bo phal cher ja'i gar sla dang rtsam pa'i mang nyung ma gtagos/ legs bshad don du gnyer ba ches nyung bas bskul ba po zhig ma byung bar 'dug /skabs shig nyang bran rin chen tshal pas bsnyen bkur byas te/ dgongs zhogs yon bdag gi rim 'gro dang / nyin bar ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du zhabs skor bdun cu re tsam ma chag par gnang bas skor 'bum 'gyangs med du bsogs/ gnas skabs su sku ngal bar byung yang sgrib pa dag pa'i ltas de las che ba byung gsung ba phyi rabs kyi gdul bya la dgongs pa 'dra/ mi ring bar gzhan phan pa bla ma dung dkar 'brug grags kyi bka' 'gyur bzhed ba la/ e pa'i bris mkhan rnams la zhal bkod dang bcas/ bzhu khang rab 'byams pa dge legs lhun grub dang lhan du zla ba gsum gyi bar bka' 'gyur zhus dag dang / rgyal po yab yum gyi sku 'dra'i gzungs gzhug sogs kyi bya ba mdzad/gzhan yang 'di dag gi snga phyi 'ga' zhig tu/ slob dpon bkra shis pa'i drung du rnal 'byor dag rim/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs sogs/ slob dpon sa la chos rje rgyal sras pa'i bka' 'bum/ yig chung nyer gcig /chos rje blo gros mtha' yas la rnam snang mngon byang / bde mchog lha lnga/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub/ rwa sgreng pa rin chen dpal 'byor la mgon po lho nub pa/ bka' gdams(20bsko bzhi'i rjes gnang / slob dpon byams pa brtan pa la tshig gsal gyi stong thun/ 'dul ba'i gzhi stod/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / gzhan yang snyil bo rab stims pa ngag dbang 441—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (yechos grags sogs bka' 'brel gsan pa'i bla ma grangs kyis mi lang / mdor na bsdus tshad nas bzung thugs gnyer mdzad dus kyi rnam pa thams cad la/ slob gnyer 'di byas pa la brten nas sems la phan pa'i nyams len zhig byed rgyu e yong dgongs pa ma to rtog gas/ gzhan khyad bsod rnyed pa dang bkur sdi'i phyir bsams pa skad cig kyang med ces bka' phebs pa ni/ rjes 'jug rnams kyang mig yar blta'i tshul du byed dgos pa'i ched du'o/ /mtha' bral shes bya'i 'chi med dga' tshal du/ /mdo rgyud yongs 'du tshar du mngar ba yis/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bu ro brgya pa/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang nor de khyod kyis rnyed/ /rgya bod brda sprod sa srung dbang po'i steng / /tha snyad rig pa'i mig stong phyogs bcur g.yo/ /nges don zab mo'i rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ /sgrib gnyis ri bo mthar byed khyod min su/ shes bya'i pha mtha' gzhal tshe skyid pa skyur/ /dam pa'i rnam thar bsams tshe spro ba 'phel/ /blun po 'byor ldan mthong tshe gad mo bro/ /chosaldan gtam rnams glengs tshe dge la spyor/ /dbus 'gyur dge bcu'i yul grur cho so kyi phyir/ /lan mang bgrod de brkyang na 'phags yul yang / /'khor bas sngon byon skad gnyis smra ba rnams/ /dam pa 'di yi rnam thar las lhag min/ /kun mkhyen tshad mas gzhal yang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /(21na〉65tshul pha mtha' khyod blos nyul ba'i tshe/ /lha lam skyengs te chu 'dzin stug po'i gos/ /sgrib g.yogs tshul gyis gyon la rings pa bzhin/ /de nas dgung lo zhe gcig pa 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo la gangs ri'i ljongs kyi rigs pa smra ba mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas dpal gsang phu ne'u thog gi grwa tshang nyi ma thang gi 'chad nyan du phebs/ lo lnga'i bar du 'chad nyan 'phel zhing / lho brag rab stims pa byams pa chos dbang / nam mkha' nor bu/ gung ru rab 'byams pa kun dga' lhun grub sogs mang du thon/ gsol skor sogs mkhas pa rnams 'du 'tshog gi tshe/ mdo phyogs gcig bur ma zad tha snyad rig pa dang chos 'byung lo rgyus sogs gsungs pas/ phal cher la sngon med pa'i legs bshad du gyur/ chu stag la gos spungs su rje nam bzang pa la rdo rje phag mo/ bde mchog dkar po/ dur khrod 442

'khon ston dpal 'gror lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)bdag po gsum gyi rjes gnang gsan/ 'phrang mgor chos thog phebs skabs/ kong chen rin po che'i slob ma o rgyan chos rdzong gi bla ma la/ dgongs 'dus yongs rdzogs zhig gsan bzhed byung yang / nye gnas kyis/ chos grwa chag na grwa pa rnams kyis skur zhugs yong zhes bshol bas ma 'grub/ shing sbrul byes kyi slob dpon 'phrin las lhun grub pas kun spangs mdzad/ nged kyi rjes su nyi thang slob dpon yon bdag rab 'byams pa 'di shes rab dang / mdo sngags sbyangs pa che/ khyad par byes pa'i grub mtha'i dka' gnad thams cad la 'dris par yod pas gdan drangs pa 'thad gsung ba bzhin/gdan 'dren (21ba'i nga bas/ dus mchod kyi thog nas/ byes mkhas mang grwa tshang gi chos kyi khrir phebs tre(/ /rnyed bkur go sa 'dod pa'i skye bo la/ /dgun gyi 'brug sgra ji bzhin snying pos dben/ /rnam g.yeng spong bar bzhed pa'i sems dpal la/ /'phrin las dbyar gyi sprin bzhin lang long g.yo/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i bsti gnas gsang phu der/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i nga ro cher bsgrags pas/ /mkhasamang ri dwags dbus na zla bral zhes/ /'jigs med dbyangs de srid rtse'i bar du sgrog /theg pa gong 'og mdo 'grel kun smra yang / /theg chen dbu ma'i tshul las mi 'gong ba'i/ /theg gsum ston pa'i seng ge'i gdan khri la/ /theg mchog chos kyi rgyal po rnam par 'gying / /'chad nyan shin tu 'phel ba'i grags snyan gyis phyogs mtha'i mkhas pa thams cad kyang byes su 'dus/ chos grwar byang chub me tog shin tu mang ba skyes pas 'ga' zhig gis btsugs pa yin nam zhes log rtog byed na'ang / rje 'dis bla ma bzhag pa dang mnyam du byang chub me tog kyang cher ma mchis so/ /chu yos thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho byang phyogs hor gyi yul nas dbus phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ mi ring bar g.yas ru gtsang gi phyogs nas dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che mjal bar 'bras spungs su phebs/ de yang thams cad mkhyen pa nas sngar rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan bar bka' chos mang po'i snyan 'bul gnang bas/ nga rgas pa dang dga' ldan gyi khri las thog pa yin pas 443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānebacar sdod kyis chos 'bul mi thub 'dug /da lta'i bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen 'di sku na (22na)gzhen zhing gsan rgya che ba yod pas bka' chos gsan pa legs gsung ba sogs rten 'brel rang 'grig tu gyur nas/ skyid shod 'bras spungs kyi gzims chung nyid 'od du rje yon tan rgya mtsho dang /ser 'bras kyis mtshon rang phyogs kyi slob dpon chos 'chad sogs mkhas mang 'dus pa la rdo rje 'phreng bas gtsos pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa bskor ba gnang skabs rje 'di pas kyang phebs/ mkhas grub chen po a sa yā ka ra'i thugs dam rdo rje 'phreng ba dang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs gsan/ rje 'di pa yang / dpon slob paṇa chen rin po cher/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug na mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mdzad pas mngon par mtho bas rigs thams cad kyi bdag por gdon mi za ba'i thugs mos 'khrungs/ paṇa chen rin po che nas kyang de skabs chos rje dam chos dpal/ bzhu khang rab 'byams pa/ rab 'byams pa chos grags rnam rgyal sogs dge bshes gragasacan mang po'i khrod nas/ rje 'di la skyes bu dam par don gyis ngos bzung pa'i gzhan las thugs rtsigs che zhing / gzhung lugs kyi dka' gnad mang po la dri ba'i tshul gyis dogs gcod kyang gnang /dus phyis su rje pha bong kha pa de bla ma rnam dag rang yin zhes bsngags brjod gnang ba lan mang thos/mchod gzhis kyi don zhig la sde pa g.yul rgyal bar yang yang zhus pas gsal kha ma byung bas skabs shig /mi dbang mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i rba klong du/ /sdom bu'i zhu yig lus phras sim gyur na/ /gsung gi zhi min mdzad (22ba)pas gang gi thugs/ /'dod dgur mchod la lhan skyes dga' bas rol/ /zhes snyan ngag dam pa yig chung du 'bul ba gnang bas/ sde pas ma dgongs par sku mdun byang ma nas la bstan pas 'bru gzhan du rgyab nas yig chung de med par mdzad/ rjes su mjal dus khyed rdzi chung ba/de 'dra sde par phul nas khong sa bdag min pa 'dug pa e yin gsung / yig chung gi don ni/ rgya mtsho'i nang du gzugs chung chung rnams mi mngon pa ltar/ sde pa'i thugs brel gyis rje nyid kyi zhu yig dbar du 'khyams na/ gsung rta mgrin gyi zhi ba min pa drag po'i mdzad bas khyod kyi snying zo zhes pa'i —444

'bon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)don no/ /rten 'brel gyi dbang gis sde pa yang ma 'gyangs par grongs/ lar dpon rigs yin kyang tha snyad kyi yon to re mi shes na gu dog go /sa sprel lor thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho se ra theg chen gling du bzhugs/ rje 'di nyin ltar gyis phyag 'bul la phebs par/ nyin gcig bka' 'phros kyi lhongs la/ rwa pod dang mkhas grub rin po che'i khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi las tshogs kyi lag len sogs lag tu khel mi khel dang /khyed kyis e yong gi dri ba gnang bar/ phebs lan du/ lag len gsal zhing zab kyang / lag tu lon pa la dbang lung man ngag mtha' dag thob pa/ bla ma dang dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs pa/ bsnyen pa tshad du thems pa/ lta ba'i rgyab dang sgom pa'i rtsal yod pa zhig med na/ don med pa'am rang phung pa'i rgyu yin pas/ nged tshos phyogs 'gro shes na'ang byed pa thog tu khel dka' zhus par/ sku ga'o mes na bzhu khang rab 'byams pa yod 'dug (23na)pas/ zhal snga nas byes pa'i de thugs bden zhes slar sgrub byed mang po gsung zhes gnang / rgyud gsang ba snying po 'di sngar bshad srol ches dar yang phyis skor rim gyis nub pa'i shugs kyis/ byang bdag po rin po ches chos rje ga me gu ru la gsang snying gi bshad rgyun yong med dri ba gnang bar med zhus pas/ khyed rnams gdung rus sogs gang sa nas e yod bsams pa yin/ zhes gsung lci ba phebs/ de thugs la bzhag nas/ brag sna chos rjer khyod kyi bu zhig gsang snying shes pa'i rigs rtsad chod na cis kyang slob par thong gsungs par/ re zhig ma rnyed/bar zhig na rje 'di pas slob dpon gzhan la zhib bshad gsan ma thub kyang / gsang bdag sgro phug pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mthus/ gzigs pa tsam gyis zab gnad thams cad rang byang chub par mkhyen pa'i snyan grags byung bar dpags/ chos rje u rgyan bstan 'dzin ched gnyer gyis se rar sku gzhogs su btang / lam zhen chad dkar du phyag 'bul la byon par/ khri'i drung gis kyang gnang sbyin sogs gnang ste legs po slobs shig ces dgyes dgyes mdzad/ khong pa sku zhem gags su sleb nas bla brang du bcar sdod byas/ chos thog gi skabs rtse gzhag dngos gzhi rdzogs rjes chos mthun re dang /—445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skachos 'tshams kyi gzims chung du gnang ba sogs g.yung 'grel gyi steng nas shin tu zhib cing mtha' chod par grub pas le'u lnga pa yan gyi zin bris kyang ding sang mchis/ gling bse byed sla ba'i stabs kyis mig ltos re phrad byung bar brten gling bse byed khar dbu phar gnyis la dam bca' nyi ma gsum re dang (23ba tsher kyil bar nyin gcig 'jog pa'i sgrigs gnang bas bstan pa'i rgyun la ches phan par byung / slar ser 'bras kyi grwa tshang gzhan rnams kyis kyang de la dpe byas nas btsugs so/ /khyod sngon rgyud rgyal tshul la sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir ma bslabs phul byung mkhyen gyur na/ /mkhas pa'i skye bar grags pa phal cher rnams/ gang dang mi mtshudas ci yis nyes gyur tam/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog /sgreng la zla bral mkhas dang dam pa khyod/ phan tshun bstod cing bsngags par mdzad pa de/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung na mdzes pa'i rtags/ /slar yang paṇa chen rin po che dbus phyogs su phebs skabs shig /bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/ dbang mdor bstan rnam 'joms rgyud/ rnam rgyal gzungs/ byams pas dam bams pas gzungs/rdor gcod/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i mngon rtogs/ chos rgyal gsang bsgrub mngon rtogs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dusa'akhor sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog zhes brjod/ smon lam/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud/ te'u lo pa'i rtog pa/snod tsha ra/ chos rgyal sgrub thabs/ pad+ma yang gsang gi rgyud/ 'jigs byed bdud las rnam rgyal sogs chos mang du gsan/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i skye sprul rje drung rin po che skyid shod phyogs su phebs/ de nyid 'phral gyi snang tshul grub spyod shin tu rtsing ba zhig mdzad pa'i stabs nas/ skye bo blo dman rnams kyi blor yang mi chud cing / khyad par rang phyogs kyi dri ma med pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid (24na)'dul ba'i dang tshugs grub mtha' gzhan las khyad zhugs pa'i dbang gis rdul khrod kyi nor bu bzhin du sgyur bar byed na'ang / rje 'di nyid kyi thugs la/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabasakyis/ de kho na nyid ston pa'i slob dpon byi ba'i sham thabs can yod pa'i brda byung ba ltar btsal bas/ dge sbyong chos gos kyis thod byas nas zhing smod cing 'dug /rjes su 'dzin par zhu zhug pas/446

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)khyim du song zer phyin pas chung ma dang khyi mo zhig min pa mi snang / slad khong rang sleb nas zhing nas 'thus pa'i 'bu srin thu ba gang gtad nas tshos la zo zhig zer/ the tshom byung bas/ rtog ge ba bya ba 'di ga yin/ zer ba'i mod la thams cad med pa'i 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa dang /te los nā ro la sprul pa sna tshogs bstan pa dang / dge tshul tshim bu pas mdze mo khur bas chu'i dkyil nas rdo rje phag mor song ba'i lo rgyus dang / rgya gar chu bo gang gwa tshun chad du rtogs pa mtho ba'i grub chen gling ras kyi rnam thar sogs dam pa'i mdzad pa la mtha' rnyed par mi nus shing / khyad par bla ma de rgyud thams cad kyi sdud pa po lag na rdo rje'i sprul par thugs kyis nges pa rnyed nas yongs 'dzin du bsten/ zhal rnam 'gyur bzhi'i rjes gnang / drag po dmar chen gyi dbang / mgon po a sto ra/ 'dzam la dmar po'i rjes gnang / mgon po ra thod/ klu srung / dbyu gu spun gsum/ hri dmar/ rnam sras mdung dmar gyi las tshogs/ kun mkhyen mu spras pa lugs kyi zhal gyi chos skor/ gzhan yang ma gshin sogs/ bdag po rin po che (24brkong rje 'bri khung gnyis nas brgyud pa'i chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ phyis kyang rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug yin zhes bsngags brjod mang du gnang / g.yin yang gung ru dbyangs dpon pa dpal ldan grags zhes/ bdag po yab sras/ chos rje dwangs ma ba/ yug nas sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas/ chos tshigs bcad re'i phyir dka' ba mang du spyad pa'i gsang sngags 'chang ba de nyid rgyun bzhugs sa ra rtser mdzad pa'i stabs kyis 'phral 'phral bla brang du byon nas chos kyi gsan gleng ji snyed cig mdzad do/ /yang zab nor bu dbang gi rgyal po che/ khyod thugs be+eḍūr dkar po'i dpal be'i mdzod/ /yongs gang mi zad theg mchog 'dod dgu'i char/ /sku gsum dpag bsam ljon 'bras dang ba'i dpyid/ /jo nang sprul sku kun dga' snying po shun zhabs drung sogs kyis gdan drangs nas dbus su phebs dus dga' ldan khang gsar du bzhugs 'dug par/ bka' 'brel mang du gsan bzhed nas phebs kyang thugs brel gyi stabs nas mjal kha dang chos 'brel yod tsam las ma 'grub/ dpal sa skya'i khri —447

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skachen bsod nams dbang po lha sar phebs skabs/ sa skya'i snyan rgyud sogs zab chos mang zhig gsan par bzhed nas nyan len zhig gnang yang / khong dpon slob myur stabs kyis phebs pas stabs ma 'grig /thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho theg chen gling du bzhugs dus shig /bdag po dbon rin po che phebs/ rje 'dis dbyangs dpon pa brgyud nas/ byes bla brang du zhag shas kyi bzhugs yul dang / rta mgrin khang gi phur mjal sogs (25na skonang / 'dod chos ci rigs kyi snyan gsan phul bas/ /thugs dgyes dgyes dang bcas zhal bces/mdzad kyang / byang 'grul tshan chen sleb pa dang 'grig /thams cad mkhyen pa 'bras spungs su phebs/ khong dpon slob kyang 'bras spungs nas rdzong brda byed ces 'phral 'byon dgos byung bas de res 'gyangs so/ /bshes gnyen bsten la brtson pa'i mdzad pa la/ /skabs 'gar rten 'brel cung zad ma 'dzol na/ /yongs 'dzin phyogs la dad dungs med pa'i mis/ /ma ṇi'i bzlas lung tsam yang thob mi 'gyur/ /nyen mongs spangs kyang chos la sred pa 'phel/ /sdom khrims dag kyang zab don ma byin len/ /zhi zhing dul yang bag med dgra la sdang / /thos nor mang yang chog shes ngoms pa med/ /skabs shig grong smad du mi zhig la gdon shin tu che ba zhig btab byung zer nas nam phyed tsam na gdan 'dren pa byung bas/ do nub mun pa'i stabs kyis yong mi thub par 'dug /rta sga thod la kha grong smad phyogs su thong la zhog /khyod rang log gsung gdan 'dren pa slog pas mi de phyir sleb tsa na nad pa drag 'dug zer/ de ni dmigs pa gar gtad la nus pa'i rtsal 'byin pa'i rtags so/ /chos 'tshams tshor bstan rtsis/ 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag /gsang 'dus smon lam/ sagasum ma/ ja mchod kyi smi ka /rab gnas kyi dogs dpyod sogs legs bshad kyi thugs rtsom mang pa gnang bar khams nas ba so sprul sku dang shes dbang sprul sku sogs rim gyis byon/ byes grwa tshang du slob gnyer mdzad skabs (25ba)sbyin sreg zhig gi sar/ rta tshag rje drung ched gnyer gyis 'bod pa gnang / khong gis phyag len la ma bltas par mnal bas/ rje nyid thugs rgyal bzhengs te/ nga sbyir —448

'bon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)sreg mgo ma thon par khyed bos pa min/ khyed rang la rjes su phan du re ba yin zhes bka' bkyon gsung / de tsam gyis kyang gzur gnas kyi slob ma'i rigs la mi dge ba'i rtog pa byung res kyis bka' de dran nas zil chum pa re 'ong rigs su 'dug shes dbang sprul sku dang lhan du lha sar rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po paṇa chen rin po che'i sku gzhogs su ba ri brgya rtsa yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ byes grwa khang gi 'o1gas bris gnang dus/ pad+ma yang gsang bka' srung dang bcas pa'i stabs kyis gnyan pas/'brom stod sngags 'chang gis ri
