mo ba'i gtso bo byas/ rje nyid kyis sku brnyan rnams la ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bcug cing / khyad par thig dang skya ris la rab gnas mdzad pa tsam gyis mchod me 'dzin pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung zhing gegs med par grub/ phyis skor logs bris byas pa rnams la drang srong gi gnod pa sogs byung zer/ skabs shig gzhis ka sne'ur rje 'di pa phebs/rab gsal sgo mangs bsgrigs pa'i them pa yod sar bzhugs par/ gsol ja 'dren mkhan la khyed rkang pa them pa'i khar zhog mdzod them pas mtshams chod na byin legs mi chags zhes bcas pa phra mor yang 'dzem pa gnang / phyis sku gzhogs su bsdad skabs kyang sdom pa gsum gyi bcas pa dang 'gal ba'i mdzad pa mngon pa ni cung zad kyang ma mchis so/ /'di dus gsar 'grul (26na sgong du sleb cing / rma chen spong ra'i 'gul gyi khrab ces bya ba'i sa nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor pa dge slong shākya rgyal mtshan gyis dbus su 'ong ba la bar chad med par 'grub pa'i don du zla ba gsum mtshams bcad de lha la gsol ba btab pas/mtshams 'grol khar da cha myur du 'grul tshan mang bar 'gyogs/ khyod bar chad med par byams chen chos rje'i sku skye dang mjal/ don 'grub ces lung bstan pa dang / gnyid sad pa dus mtshungs su byung /de 'phral gsar brda byung bas yid ches te the tshom med par 'ongs/ 'dam dang ser 'bras tshor grwa pa rnams la/ bla ma 'di dang 'di byams chen chos rje'i sku skye e yin zhes dris pas/ sgros pa med zer/sngar lung bstan yod pa mi bslu la che snyam pa'i ngang nas se ra'i mang ja skol ba'i dung gtong khar rngi —449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loyolam du/ da nang khyod kyi bla ma byams chen chos rje'i sku skye de dang mjal yong bas sems dga' bar gyis zer/ spos bskor la yongs pa dang / rje 'di pa mthong ma thag rmi lam du byung ba dang khyad mi 'dug zer rab tu dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas 'phral 'phral 'ongs nas chos du ma dang / bsnyan rdzogs kyi slob dpon zhus so/ /lha ldan gyi tshes bcu pa khag la bla ma'i dbang gnang bas dam rdzas ka pā la'i nang nas khol zhing lud/ dbus gtsang dang mdo stod/ mdo smad/ rgya hor sogs skye dgu mang por gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs 'dod chos ji snyed stsal/ tshal dang lha sa sogs su cho ge bar bteg pas/ spyir grwa tshang bzang ba dang / lhag tu rje nyid kyi thugs (26ba)rje'i mthus/ lugs gnyis ka'i gdul bya 'phrin las sa 'ur la song / skabs shig stod rgyud pa dang lhan du lha sar 'dzom par/ 'di phyi gnyis ka'i skyabs gnas zhu ba'i phyir du phogs ja tshul 'bul nod sogs byas pa bzang bar byung bas/ 'ga' zhig mdo las sngags sde rkyen sel yar 'dren gang la yang / 'jig rten pa rnams mos par byed na'ang / da res rgyud pa dang byes pa go log pa 'di ci yin zhes mang du gleng / la la byes pa'i bla ma yon bdag rab 'byams pa 'dis dbang sdud bzhin byas sam zhes zer ba yang byung mod/ bla ma 'di nyid kyis dbang sdud sogs las rab 'byams kyang ji snyed cig mkhyen pa'i klong du gsal yang /gnas skabs kyi zang zing phra mo'i ched du las sbyor gnang ba'i thugs 'dun tsam yang ga la mchis/ de ni sngon pho brang sne'u gdong rtser rgyal ba myong kha pa phebs dus 'phrin las ha cang che bas/ mkhan chen seng rgyal ba'i thugs la dbang sdud rang zhig yod snyam nas/ bzhugs gral du de skor gyi dri ba zhus par/ rgyal ba gnyis pas rgyud nas bshad tshul mang po zhig gsungs rjes/ dbang sdud kyi gtso bo ni byang chub kyi sems yin bka' phebs par grags pa ltar/ rje 'di nyid kyi yang lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mthu'o snyam mo/ /dpyid dus sa bon ma btab ston gyi tshe/ /'bras bu'i longs spyod 'dod pa'i skye bo bzhin/ /rlabs 450

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)chen sbyin pa'i skyed byed mi ldan par/ /zang zing longs spyod 'dod pa 'brul pa'i mtshang / /legs byas phung po'i chu yi lcid kyis non/ /mkhas grub sgra brgya lhag (27na) bsam glog 'khyug tshe/ /rnam mang bdog pa'i gru char 'bebs mi 'bebs/ skye dgu'i nam mkhar rang dbang ji ltar yod/ /chos tshugs pa'i skabs dang / gzhan du yang phyogs mtha'i dge bshes du ma sku gzhogs su 'dus te dka' gnad kyi dogs gcod dri lan mtha' dpyod sogs gnang tshe/ sku tshe hril por/ rgya gar gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis rjes 'brang bcas pa dang / bod yul gyi cha gtsang sogs kyi bstan bcos kho na la sbyangs pa mdzad pa zhig yin par 'dug snyam pa'i mtshan nyid pa mtha' dag gis ston par 'dzin/ rgyud stod smad kyi mkhas pa rnams 'dus te rgyud sde bzhi'i skor la rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung rab dang bstun pa'i gzabs bshad kyis gsang sngags kho na la sbyangs shing mkhas pa zhig yin par 'dug snyam pa'i rtog pa dang bcas te rdo rje slob dpon chen por byed/ rang gzhan gyi sgom chen dbu ma/ phyag rdzogs/ zhi byed/ gcod yul ba sogs du ma drung du 'du ba rnams so so'i gegs sel bogs 'don dpyis phyin par mdzad pas/ tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i rtogs pa'i don mngon du gyur pa zhig yin par 'dzin/sgrub 'phrin phyag bzhes don du gnyer ba rnams ni lag len gyi dka' gnad phra mo rnams kyang 'dzub btsugs su ston pas/ ra lo tsā ba rdo rje grags dang / bse ston nyi ma bzang ngo/ lta bu'i rigs sngags 'chang ba dang mtshungs par lta/ brda sprod snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig pa ba rnams la 'phags yul gyi tsan+d+ra go mi dang / bod yul gyi dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa lta bu'i rnam thar ston/ mdor na chos gang dang gang la yang (27ba/sna gi mkhyen ces bya ba ma gtogs mi 'byung pas/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i sgra bshad ni bla ma 'di nyid la tshang bar mngon no/ /e nas srid sgrub gnyis pa 'dra ba'i bon rtsis pa slob dpon nor bu dang gnyal pa sngags 'chang ba gnyis sku gzhogs su bsdad nas/ rtsis dang yi ge'i skor sogs zhal bkod gnang ste/ dbyangs gsal klag thabs kyi ri'u mig /rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sngags 'khor sogs bris rim gyis zhus dag —451—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yodang / rtsis dkar nag gi phyag dpe rnams la yang dag ther gnang / 'chad nyan 'phel ba'i stabs kyis phyis skor grwa tshang gi slob dpon du 'khod pa'i rab 'byams pa byams pa smon lam/ rab 'byams pa 'phrin las bsam grub/ rong pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams bkra shis/ rtses thang rab 'byams pa/ gsang sngags mkhar gyi gzhi pa bla ma ngag dbang rdo rje sogs dge bshes grangs kyis mi lang ba lta bu byung / 'on kyang rong pa rab 'byams pa sogs dred po chos rgyus mkhan du ma dang / tsha ba dge rgan sogs ci rigs kyis rang rgyud nyon mongs kha rgyal du shor ba'i byed spyod dang ma mthun pa rtags su bkod nas bla ma'i mdzad pa thams cad la log par bltas/ thugs sun mang du phyung / de ni sngon yang lo tsā ba ska ba dpal rtsegs su 'brungs tshe/ rgya gar nas paṇa chen ba ma la mi tra gdan drangs te bsam yas su byon nas/ btsan po mnyes su re bar/ sdig blon 'ga' zhig gis rgyal por/ lo tsā bas khrid yongs pa de piṇ+ḍa ta gzha' ma min par 'dug /bod phung ba'i ngan sngags mkhan po yin zer phra ma (28na tshe nus nas re zhig paṇa chen dang rgyal po mjal ba'i gegs byas/ lo tsā ba bzhin gnags su bcug pas/ de dus gnod pa byas pa'i 'phro lus pa'i lhag la spyod phyir skye ba blangs par gdon mi za'o/ /sprin bral 'bras ldan dus kyi lha lam ngos/ /rta bdun dbang po'i dkyil 'khor shar ba des/ /ut+pal nags klung rgyas par byed pa la/ /dpag tshad du mas 'gyangs par bltos pa ci/ /bod dang bod chen rgya hor yul gru nas/ /mchog dman 'gro ba'i yid kyi gnyis 'thung snar/ /rnam par thar pa'i lcags kyu 'debs pa po/ /med kyang btab pa bzhin du ngang gis 'du/ /rgyu mtshan med par chu klung chen po'i tshogs/ /rgyun chad med par 'bab na sems ldan kun/ /bsten pas thar pa'i go sar 'khrid byed pa'i/ /dam pa'i rjes su 'jug la cis mi brel/ /zas gtsang sras dang mtsho skyes rdo rjer yang / /mu stegs bon blon ngan pas gshe byed na/ /dus ngan 'di na rgyal sras spyod pa la/ /bdud rigs sdang ba rang gi ngang tshul yin/ /sra brtan bzod pa'i go cha dang / /snying rje'i ral gri rnon po yis/ /zhe sdang dgra —452

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)bo gzhom byed pa/ /khyod la su yis ci byar yod/ /de nas mkhyen dpyod kyis phyi'i dus rtags 'gyur ba sogs dgongs shing / /thun mong ba'i gdul bya'i ngor mo rtsis gnang ba ltar ston yang / don dngos por mngon par mkhyen pa nyid kyis dus mi bde ba 'ong bar dgongs te/ ri khrod du thegs rtsis kyis gdan sa rtsis sprod par thug pa na/ 'ga' zhig ni bstan pa'i don du zhe thag pa dang / kha cig ni mdzes (28ba〉mdzes dang / la la ni 'jig rten mi mkhyen pa la mdzad dgos par nye ba'i mnad mnad kyi sgo nas gsol ba btab/ rta lo'i bar 'chad nyan gyi 'phro skyong gnang dgos byung / me sprul mjug tu khar kha tshe khur dpon po sogs dmag dang 'grul pa gtos shin tu che ba sleb/ de skabs 'jig rten grags pa'i rjes su 'brang ba mang po zhig sde gzar gyi 'dod pa mngon du gyur/ rje 'di nyid ni/ spyir yang ser dmag mi 'os shing / khyad par dbyangs 'char sogs nas kyang don du mi 'gyur ba zhig gzigs/ de yang sngon 'phags skyes pos shākya bdun khri bdun stong bsad pa rgyal ba shākya thub pas kyang btang snyoms su gzhol ba las thabs ma byung ba ltar/ sems can gyi las kyi 'bras bu mngon du grub zin pa rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang zlog mi nus pas/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches kyang thugs dbang 'dus pa'i nges pa mi 'dug na'ang /'gal ba med par dgongs te 'bras spungs su phebs nas/ dus rtags rter 'brel sogs kyi snyan 'bul zhus/ sa rta lha sa smon lam gyi srod skor zhig gi skabs phan bde legs bshad gling gi slob dpon pa rta'u ri khrod pa phun tshogs bzang po dang mnyam du byung bas gsung 'phros zhig gi mus/ khong gi nged tsho da lo paṇa chen rin po che'i phyags phyir mnga' ris la 'gro rgyu yin zhes zer bas/ khyed rnams bsod nams shin tu che/ da lo nged 'di phyogs su sdod mi rnams ni chags sgo rang che gsung / de nas rim gyis sde gzar gyi sgo dod de/ dga' ldan pho brang sogs nas bshol ba 'gab tshul mdzad kyang / gtsang srid la 'phul bas mthong phyogs kyis nyan 'jog ma byas/ de mtshungs (29na)rje 'di pas chos mthun gyi bka' phebs par/ spre rgan rnams kyis mi bzung nas/ /mjug ma med ces bzhad —453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6logad byed/ /ces pa ltar/ thams cad kyi blo la ma babs pa'i gros pa'i dkyil nas skyar phud la btang bas 'chad nyan 'jog rtsis kyis sku chas rnams 'ga' ru khang du bskyal/ sku dngos bla brang nas phebs ma grub gong du/ lha sa'i g.yul 'khrug skabs tshang mas ma bzhag pas lha sar phebs/ srog skyabs 'dra e 'ong gi rtsis gnang yang / tshur mthong gi skye bo zhe sdang gi rang bzhin can rnams srog gcod pa kho na la dga' bas thugs ba ched dang mthun pa cher ma byung / spyir yang snyigs ma lnga bdo bas 'khrug long mi bzad pa 'di lta bu dang / khyad par ser dmag tu ming btags pas bstan pa 'grib cing 'gro ba'i phan bde la ches gnod pa'i dus ngan 'di lta bu snyam du thugs skyo ba dang snying rje phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gyur ba'i ngang nas se rar phebs/hor zla bdun pa'i nang du brling log byung ste/ ser 'bras phal cher stag lung tshor bteg skabs/rje 'di pa rim gyis sog yul la thegs dgos pa byung dogs nas yer par bzhugs/ phyis 'di skor gyi gsung 'phros byung dus/ btsun pas chos min gyi las byas pa la dkon mchog gi bka' chad yin gsung / dpon sa stag lung rme 'i gnyer pas/ yer par gtsang pas nyul mi btang dogs nas/ dpon slob rnams nang du bzhugs su bcug /phyi nas sgo lcags brgyab nas mdzod yin pa'i lugs su byas/sngar nas thugs 'dres yod pa'i yer pa'i btsun pa dmi brtson (29ba)'grus zer ba zhig gis mi sna la skad cha bshad pas sku chas rnams shor ro/ /blang dor 'byed la ma rig sgrib g.yogs kyis/ /bde ba'i ched du sdug bsngal rgyu sgrub pa'i/ /'brul pa'i skye bos bsgrub pa'i mdun ma ni/ /byis pa 'ja' tshon 'dzin dang khyad par ci/ /mkhris nad can dag gangs ri gser mdog tu/ /snang ltar legs par bslabs kyang log par mthong / /smig sgyur bsnyegs pas skom pa sel 'dod pa'i/ /smongs pa'i skye bo rang mtshang gzhan la ngom/ /gzhan gyis bsags pa rang gis mi myong zhes/ /gzhung lugs mang por gsungs pa nges par brdzun/ /bden na sde 'khrug gzhan gyis byas pa la/ /khyod nyid yul gzhan 'bros de ci zhig lags/ /—454

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)de nas slar stag lung nas do dam mdzad do/ /dgon pa khag kyang so sor rang gnas kyi lugs tsam byung skabs/ rje 'di nyid kyang zhabs thang la yer pa nas gad kha sa brgyud de se rar phebs/ /zhogs gcig tshogs su mang jar phebs pas/ grwa pa rnams sgo sogs ji bzhin med pa la dpags/chas ka phran tshegs yod pa khur nas 'ongs pa dang / snod ma chag pa g.yor sa ma rnyed pas/ /thugs la/bstan pa'i snying po ni rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i ring lugs yin/ de yang dus dbang gis 'di lta bur gyur 'gro ba dgongs thugs shin tu ngal ba byung / de nas phyag dpe 'thor ba rnams 'ga' ru khang du blangs te sgrig pa gnang yang / bar der srang mdo cher blug pa'i shul gyi char lhags kyis chud zos pa dang /dmag mi 'ga' zhig gis dpe cha'i steng du dud 'gro bsad ba'i khrag (30na)gis sbags pa sogs shin tu ma rungs par gyur 'dug pas/ thugs bed spyod thub tsam yan chad glegs bam du mdzad/ de phyin tsha khang sogs 'o mi brgyal ba'i sar bzhugs su bcug /zla shas ra ma rtser zhabs tog zhus nas bzhugs/ yer par sku chas 'dren par nyang bran blon po pa'i g.yag mang po yod pa ma byung zer gzhis ka sne'ur btugs nas mi sna phab/ rje nyid thugs rgyal bzhengs te gtor zor 'phangs pas blon po bsod nams gum mo/ /de nas sgrub pa 'ba' zhig la thugs gzhol zhid / sgrub gnas kyang dpon sa stag lung mas yer pa brag gseb tu bzhugs/ 'tsho chas kyi zhabs 'degs 'di nas byed gsung ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis ni rgyal 'ol dang e dwags phyogs su thegs pa 'gab zer ba mang du byung yang / dgongs pa la nyang bran pha bong kha 'di sngon chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa thob ste/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang dang / de rjes ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs te/ bod kyi phan bde rgyas par mdzad cing / de nas bzung ste sad mi mi bdun rab tu ma byung yan/ sngags pa ral pa can brgya tsam dang / mnga' bdag khri ral yan la rab tu byung ba brgya tsam pha bong khar bzhugs pas/ chos khrims dang rgyal khrims gnyis ka dar la/ de nas rgyal po dar mas rab —455

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yobyung rnams bskrad pas bod 'khrugs te sil bur song / de rjes dbus gtsang gi mi bcus bstan pa spel kyang / pha bong khar dge 'dun gyi sde ma tshugs par brten (30ba)rgya bod zhabrugs pas/ rgyal lha khang dang rwa sgreng la brling log byung / de la brten nas dge bshes brag dkar bas pha bong khar 'dus sde btsugs pas/ lo mang po'i bar du bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid shin tu che/ gdan rabs bdun tsam nas cung zad 'gribs pa la brten/ hor dmag bod du lhags/ slar sa skya pas rgya nag po'i bla ma byas nas yar phebs dus pha bong khar zhig gsos dang / bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam mdzad pas/ sa skya pas bod kyi bdag po mdzad pa'i ring bde skyid che yang / lo bdun cu tsam nas sde 'di cung zad nyams pas sa phag 'khrugs te dbus gtsang thams cad mi bde bar gyur/ de nas theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos phebs nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam dang sde tshugs pa la brten/ phag mo gru pa'i sde srid kyis bod 'di lo nyis brgya tsam bde bar bskyangs/ de nas zhabs drung gong ma chen po'i dus lung bstan ltar/ bdud mi spun dgus phag tshang dkrugs te bod kyi bde skyid bshig / de rjes chos rje bde legs nyi ma pha bong khar bzhugs pa nas bzung / rab byung bcu pa'i sa rta yan la bod bde bar byung na'ang / lo der dge slong brgyad grwa zhig yod pa ma mthun par so sor gyes rjes/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan du sde zhabrug 'di lta bu byung bas/ slar rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'phel ba dang /sems can gyi bde skyid la dgongs te/ pha bong kha byang chub shing gi nags khrod/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal/ de zhwa ko ṭar bzhugs pa'i thugs thag bcad/ sa mo lug gi nang du phebs so/ /phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /(31na tha sil ldan rgyal por shar ba srong btsan rje/ /sgrub pa'i bsti gnas byang chub shing gi khrod/ /bod 'bangs phan dang bde ba'i rtsa lag mchog /gzhan phan khur 'khyer sems kyi mdog lnga pas/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyin mor byed/ /dben gnas 'chi ba med pa'i lam yangs por/ /drangs tshe gangs can bde ba'i pad+mo 'dzum/ /der yang thugs dam spros bcas kyi rim pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil/ dpal —456

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ de dag gi bzlas pa stong tsho re lamatha' brten/ bla sgrub/ bsam gtan gyi sbyin sreg /ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ las gshin/ zhal dmar nag /dmag zor ma/ rnam sras sogs chos stong skor gyi mchod gtor/ phyi gtor brgya rtsa/ bsangs mchode/ nyer lnga byung res kyi dpal gsang ba 'dus pa/ gzhan yang pad+ma yang gsang sogs rgyud sde che ba'i rigs ji snyed dang /gsol 'debs chos spyod kyi rigs kyang mang du gnang / gtso bor spros med 'od gsal snang bzhi'i skor la thugs dam gyi mthil du bstar/ /thugs dam gyi bogs 'don dang bstan dang 'gro ba la phan pa rgya chen po'i ltas ya mtshan pa mang du byung ngo / /sngon nas stobs bcu'i go 'phang gang / /brnyes kyang zab mo'i nyams len la/ /brtson par mdzad de rjes 'jug rnams/ /chos la bskul ba'i brda ru nges/ /lcags spre nang du dpon sa stag lung ma gshegs pa'i yar 'dren du phebs/ de dus byang rtse chos rje ngag dbang chos grags 'brom gling mar gshegs pa'i gdung dga' ldan byang (31ba)rtser drangs pa'i zhugs 'bul la phebs/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i phyag dril/ nā ro'i khrus bum gyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul nod rgya cher byung / dgung lo re gcig pa lcags bya la sgom sde cho me rje rin chen 'od zer/ lha rtse dbon mo sogs 'grul pa mang du 'byor/ sgom sde chos rje dang sgar pa grwa tshang gi slob dpon dung mkhan sogs kyis gsol ba btab ste/ 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi dbu tshugs tsam dang / bde mchog 'dod 'jo/ spyod 'jug /rgyal ba myong kha pa'i gsung 'bum thor bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum sogs mdo rgyud kyi bshad lung du ma dang / kun rig gi dbang / brgya gcig zhal gyi dbang / sgrol ma nyer gcig /snar thang brgya rtsa/ chos skyong skor gyi rjesaganang / sgrub yig gi lung / dpal ri bo dga' ldan par grags pa'i khrid chen brgyad/ snying po don gsum/ dbu ma'i lta khrid/ lta ba spyi khyab sogs kyi skor yang mang du gnang /hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du rje nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa chos kyi rje sngags ram pa zur btsun —457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo te/dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas dpal ba zang po yang / sku zhabs su 'byor/ phyag dpe dang / /thugs dam thang ka 'bri ba sogs zhabs phyir shin tu 'gyur/ mdo sngags gsar rnying gi gsung chos kyang 'di dag gi snga phyi kho nar 'phel/ skabs shig lha rtse dbon mos lha sa nas bton zer ba'i dpe cha 'ga' dang / pha bong kha nas kyang gter 'don rgyu yod zer sku zhabs su 'ongs par/ brtags dpyad gnang bas gter yang zob dang / grub rtags la yang thugs the tshom byung bas/ khyed rang gi 'phrin (32na)las lha sar 'phel zhing / gnas 'di nas gter btan nas bcud nyams 'gro zhes thabs mkhas kyis rdzong ba gnang / mi ring bar dpon mo 'brum pa'i nad kyis thebs nas bka' dbang la gdan drangs/ rnam 'joms kyi byab khrus gnang bas/ de dgongs rmi lam du sprang po 'dra ba'i pho mo mang po 'bog khres khur nas/ da mi 'jog par 'dug zer 'gro grabs byed/ sang nas khams bde bar byung zer/ rje 'di nyid gsung btsun pas dngos su bka' mi bkyen yang / mdangs la brtags na gter dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad zog kho nar dgongs pa zhig yod par nges/ dus phyis kho bos kyang de'i gter lung yin zer mang du mthong bas/ mnga' bdag khri ral las ma gcig lab sgron snga ba sogs mi 'grigs pa'i rdzun gyi rdzob rtags mang du 'dug /lar las 'bras mi shes pa'i mi snying kham can gyi byed pa la mtha' mi snang ngo / /nyan rang zhi bder gzhol dang mtshungs min pa'i/ /dben pa bsnyen yang g.yin phan rnam g.yeng can/ /'du 'dzi 'phel yang rang don yal 'dor ba'i/ /rgyal sras dam pa'i mdzad pa bla na med/ /sgyu ma'i rta dang glang po'i sprul sgyur gyis/ /tshur mthong skye bo bden par zhen pa ltar/ /mig 'phrul rdzun gyis rmongs pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /me dong thal bas g.yogs la lag pa 'jug /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i mkhyen spyan gyis/ /dus ngan zog po'i rdzun mtshang kun rig nas/ /dus kun 'dod dgu'i gter gyur lha sa der/ /dus bstun (32ba)thabs mkhas gsung gis rdzong bar mdzad/ /de yang theg pa 'og ma ltar na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang las kyi lhag ma'i mthus —458

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal ba sor bcu drug pa zug ste bsnyun pa dang / theg pa gong ma'i dbang du byas na tshul bstan bzhin/ rje 'di yang za 'phrug gi snyun dam pos sku la btab ste/ sman dpyad sogs bcos ka ci byas kyang phan ngo che ba ma byung bas/ /thugs dam gyi ngang rang du bzhugs pas gdangs bskyed che bar byung / bar gcod sel byed du dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che spyan 'dren gnang / tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ 'gur drag zhung dmar nag /phyag rdor sogs kyi rjes gnang gsan/ de nyin nyi ma log pos ring ba dang / nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rtags mang du byung bas mi rnams kyis zhing brje bar gleng / byang rtse'i khri dang lcang ra mkhar thog sogs kyi snyan gsan byung yang / bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs thugs la brnags shing / rang nyid gdan sa che ge byas so zhes pa'i snyan grags la ji mi mnyam pa gnyis 'dzom pas mi phebs par thugs thag bcad/ rgyun gyi nyams bzhes dang / ser 'bras rgyud stod smad mdo khams lho byang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la chos kyi bka' drin stsal ba sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gyur/ bying gir gnam gyi rgyal brgyud lha btsun dang / 'gu ru khung tha'i ji sogs rgyal brgyud kyi rigs du mas zhabs kyi pa blor btud de dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mnos/ cha gan rgyal (33na)po sogs kyi bla ma co ṇi chos rjer yang dbang rjes gnang 'dod chos lhug par stsal/ rje nyid kyi dpon po chos bzang nad dam pos btab ste kho rang gis kyang 'chi ba thag bcad/ lha rje sogs kyang tsham tshom du gyur skabs/ zhogs gcig bka' las/ mdang snying thig gi 'od gsal la gnas pa'i skabs shig /sog po dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rjes la 'brangs pa'i mtha' 'dre cig gis dbon po la bar gcod byed pa shar bas/ de ring 'dre de rdzong dgos pa 'dug ces rnam 'joms kyi byab khrus dang bcas glud rdzongs gnang bas ma 'gyangs par nad las grol/ chos rje sngags ram par sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i 'grel khyi ka g.yung 'grel gyi steng nas nyin re chos thun tshar gnyis re/ gzhan yang snying thig gi skor sogs chos mtha' yas pa gnang / khyad par gsang snying gi sgo nas chos grwa chen po dpal gyi rtses thang du grwa bskor —459—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loyogyi bslab bston gnang bas/ snga 'gyur la rgyud bshad med dam snyam pa'i log rtog thams cad bsal ba yin no/ /gang zhig rtog ge'i rigs pas dus 'da' ba'i/ /yul grur theg mchog chos tshul 'di lta bu/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i spyad byar yod do zhes/ /sgrog phyir bshad pa'i zol gyis pho nya mngags/ / rgya hor dregs ldan mang po'i zur phud la/ /zhabs rdul chu skyes bkod pa mtshar du ci/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi 'dren pa zhes/ /sgrog pa'i dbyangs 'di tshangs pa'i yul du ldir/ /shing pho byi ba'i lo la chos rje byams pa rgya mtsho'i sprul skus gtsos pa'i (33ba tshe sprul tshan shin tu che ba sleb/ dam pa rnams zang thing gi 'du 'god lhur mi mdzad kyang / 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du ma/co dgu'i yo byad ji snyed phul/ bdog pa rnams ri khrod kyi mthun rkyen sogs su bsgyur/ don ldan du mdzad/ lo snga ma rnams su phyag g.yog sna tshogs kyi stabs nas sku chas thang ltod ci rigs byung /phebs sgor 'phrin las phun tshogs zer ba zhig yod pa de nged dang lo khams mthun pas lag g.yog byas na 'gyur ba yod/ ma shi na ngo zhag tsam sleb yong gsung ba ltar/ dka' bcu 'phrin las phun tshogs sku zhabs su 'byor/ 'di dag gi snga phyir 'dod chos zhu ba/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs yi dam gyi bsnyen sgrub dang / nyams khrid skyong 'dod dogs gcod zhu ba la dka' bcu rab 'byams sogs du ma la la lo shas/ 'ga' zhig dbyar gnas tsam sdod mi nyung mtha'ang bcu re tsam star chags su byung bar/ dad 'bul bsngo rten gyi steng nas nyin re ja gnyis re dang / gzhung du zhu ba gnang ba'i phogs sogs 'tsho chas kyi mthun rkyen dang / gtso bor rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i 'dod chos kyis tshim par gnang /shing glang lor ju nang thub pa tha'i ji sogs byang phyogs hor sog gi yul gyi skya ser ji snyed 'byor/grwa tshang chos rje bsod nams bkra shis dang / du ral nang so gnyis kyis gsol ba btab nas/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan lha sar gdan drangs/ rdo rje 'phreng ba zhe lnga ma'i dbang / bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i spro/60

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ snyenadabang / rta mgrin yang (34na skosang / thugs rje chen po sogs kyi dbang lung rjes gnang mang po'i chos kyi sgo 'phar zla ba gcig tu phye/ khyad par gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs kyi dbang gi dgongs mo sa g.yo ba sogs ltas ya mtshan pa mang du byung / de dus thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung thu med kyi dpon po hung tha'i jis sbyin bdag byas nas bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches gtso gnang ser 'bras kyi slob dpon las thog zur nga thams cad 'dus/ rab gnas dga' ston gyi tshe/ rje 'di dang sgo mangs slob dpon chos grags rnam rgyal gnyis gsang sngags gsar rnying gi mtshams la chos kyi 'brel gtam mdzad pas lung rigs gnyis ga'i sgo nas sgo mang slob dpon rmeg med pa lta bur mdzad pa ni/ dbang phyug gi mdas grong khyer sum brtsegs bzhin no/ /bar khams nas 'phags pa lha phebs te/ thog mar ni bka' chos shig gsan bzhed yin pas dgongs 'dus zhu zer/ de yongs rdzogs ma thob gnang bar thugs mtho dma' re che yod tshod du gda' bas rjes ma chos ni ma zhus 'dug /mi tri brgya rtsa'i dbang chog zhig bskul nas/ gsal ba'i sgron me zhes pa thugs rtsom gnang / me stag smon lam che chung 'dzugs pa ra shar tshe/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che phebs lam du thugs brel gyis g.yengs nas cung zad 'gyangs pas/ smon lam chung bar ma phebs dogs/ 'phral du dga' ldan pho brang nas snyan gsan gnang ba ltar/ ra mo che'i smon lam gyi mgon du phebs kyang / paṇa chen rin po che (34ba)phebs grub pa nas/ smon lam yongs rdzogs kyi mgon ni gnang ma dgos/ me yos kyi ston mjug /nged la bka' tho zhig gnang byung ba de 'ong rgyu'i dgongs mo zla bo gnyis tsam dang lhan du yod pas glo bur du phyi na rlung ye med par nang du rlung dmar gyi skor tshub byas/ de'i khrod du mi dmar po zhig gcig gis mthong 'dug /phal cher beg rtse 'di bka' nyan bran g.yog rang byed pa cig yod 'dug pas/ phyag bris kyi pho nyar sngon du 'ongs pa zhig yin par sems rbesna/ /pad dkar tshal du bh+ra ma ra/ nyal 'gro'i rdzing bur ngang mo dkar/ /skal ldan yongs kyi gtsug phud —461—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loyode/ khyod zhabs bsnyen la ngang gis 'du/ /tshul khrims dri ngad kyis bos pa'i/ /dug gsum tshad gdungasaglang po rnams/ /nges legs bsil ba'i bde ba de/ /'thob phyir tsan dan khyod drung lhags/ /sdug bsngal gzhom pas sman pa ste/ /bde ba ster bas ri dwags mig /sku gsum gling 'khrid ded dpon che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bshes gnyen tshul/ /sku'i 'phrod bsten du e'i chab tshan la phebs/ de yang gdul bya'i ngor chab la zhugs par ston pa tsam ma gtogs/ don sku na phebs sogs kyis da res las e phyogs phebs par mi 'char zhing /'dul dgos kyi gdul bya lhag ma mang po'i don du dgongs te mthong thos dran reg bka' 'brel gyi sgo nas rnam dkar gyi las rlabs po che bskrun/ khyad par ri sgo chos sder phebs nas sman bla bde gshegs bdun gyi dbang / chos skyong skor gyi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos du ma dang / ja gos dar sogs zang (35na)zing gi 'gyed kyis tshim par mdzad/ grwa pa rnams kyis/ zhal snga nas byams pa brtan pas mi tshe hril po bla ma mdzad pa las zhal snga nas yon bdag thengs gcig phebs pa lugs gnyis nas dga' ba byung zhes gleng / gsol dpon rab brtan gyis gtsos pa'i skye bo mang po yan lag brgyad pa'i bslab khrims la 'god par mdzad/ phebs zhor chad dkar rdzong du zhabs drung khri pas bsnyen bkur gya nom pa dang bcas snying thig zhu ba'i snyan gsan phul/ 'on kyang skyid shod du thugs rings bas 'phral du 'bul ma thub/ slar sgrub pa'i bsti gnas nyid du phebs/ dge 'dun bcu phrag re lhag par lo re bzhin dbyar gnas dgag dbye gso sbyong ste gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang / rgyun ldan du bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i ched du/ snga ja la sher snying tshar sum cu/ nag po skor gsum/ dmag zor ma/ rnam sras/ zhal dmar nag /trag shad/ dpal lha sogs kyi mngon rtogs/ dgongs ja la bskang gso/ gtor bsngo/ smon lam shis brjod bar/ nyer lnga byung res kyi gsang 'dus mngon dkyil gyi rgyun 'dzugs par gnang / lo star chags su dgag dbye ston mo'i dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur grong smad nas tshang rje 'di la gus pa'i stabs nas gang lcogs byed kyi yod 'dug /rdo rje 'chang chen po'i —462

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)lam rim/ byang chub lam rim/ dbang lung khrid sogs so so'i re 'dod dang sbyar te chos 'phel bar mdzad/ 'di dag gi snga phyi rnams su legs bshad kyi thugs rtsom gnang ba yang / se chen bla masabaskul nas/ 'jigs byed (35ba)kyi chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ rgyud pa dbu mdzad rab 'byams pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i ngor dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'phrin las bzhi'i spyin sreg byed tshul dang /sman bla bde gshegs bdun gyi dbang chog phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ rgyal legs bshad sgrog pa'i tshil gyi ri khrod spyi sos zhus nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bla ma mchod pa'i rnam bshad/ nang so tshe 'phel gyis byang gter thugs sgrub kyi mngon rtogs gsar ma ltar lhag 'don zhig bskul nas sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho bum bskyed dang sbrags pa/ zal dkar chos rjes bskul nas/ rgyal ba tsong kha par 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs tshul brdas bcings pa'i 'grol blo bzang dgongs rgyan/ gzhan yang byes kyi phur pa'i lo rgyus/ bde ba can smon lam gyi 'grel pa sogs gsol 'debs smon lam zhal gdams dri lan gyi rigs dang / bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi khyi ka shin tu rgyas pa/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i rnam bshad kyi dgongs don lhug par ston pa gangs khrod kyi phar phyin yig char ltos par legs pa zhig gnang / rkun ma zhig gis dar po che brkus par/ ri khrod pa rnams kyis dar po che snangs chung yang 'di rigs mangs na rjes sor ri khrod mi chags pas 'di la mngon spyod kyi rtags thon pa zhig dgos zhus pas/ beg rtse'i las sbyor gyis lo ma 'gyangs par mi de gum/ drag las gnang na rwa snubs dang mtshungs pa'i mthu bo che zhig yong nges kyang /rtsal 'don mi gnang / bka' phebs la yang (36na)rje mi las/ nga mchog la sems pa'i rnal 'byor pa gsungs pa yin zhes lung 'dren 'phral 'phral gnang / 'brug lugs pa'i bzang sdings sku skyes/rgya bod kyi skad shan sbyar sdeb sbyor sogs yod pa'i zhu yig snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa zhig phul bar/ zhabs phyi ba rnams kyis/ da res 'di ga da nga mtshungs pa'i bka' hā/ga gnang ba legs zhus pas/ de nged rang ri khrod du bsdad nas g.yeng ba gang chung dang dge sbyor gang 'phel la gtso bor byed —463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānepa las/ tha snyad spros pa'i rigs kyis dgos pa chung / 'di la lan de 'dra zhig byas na/ slar khong gis de'i lan byed/ yang lan gyi mno bsam gtong dgos yong bas/ de thams cad kyi tshab tu dmigs rkang re bskyangs kyang sleb tshod cig yod gsung / de ni rje nyid la de 'dras ltos pa ga la mchis kyang /dus dbang gis dben pa bsten nas slar rnam g.yeng kho na don du gnyer ba'i lha bu'i bdud kyis zin pa mang bas rjes 'jug la bag yod par gdams pa'i dgongs pa can no/ /kye ma 'jig rten 'di na ci yang snang / /mkhas rnams rtsom pa'i rnam g.yeng spong ba skad/ /blun po ldab ldib yi ger 'god la brtson/ /go rim ldog pa'i byed po su zhig yin/ /rtag 'dzin skye bo nges par 'byung ba'i ched/ /long med nyams len sgrub la brtson ston yang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grags snyan stong gi rgyud/ /brdung ba'i sgra de srid 'dir su la bston/ /bka' gdams kyi phyag len la thugs shin tu dgyes pas/ dbyar gnas dang dus bzang mang por/ (36ba)gnas bcu'i sgrub mchod snar thang pa'i lugs bzhin phyag len du gnang / sa pho 'brug gi lor chu 'dzin gyi sgrib g.yogs sogs med par nam mkha' g.ya' dag bzhin du nyin byed dbang po'i 'od mog mog por gyur pa la brten/ skye 'gro phal cher yid tsham tshom du gyur cing / 'di 'dra gang gi rtags yin nam zhes gleng skabs/ grub thob mdung rtse ras pa'i dbon brgyud chos rje lhun grub rgya mtsho dang / ye ge drug pa'i 'phrin las pa bla ma dung dkar ba sogs du mas/ rje 'di pa'i drung du dri ba zhus par/ ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi rim pa bshad pa'i lung bstan lnga pa/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde thabs kyis sku rim dge bskul gyi rim pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes pa gnang / de ni 'ga' zhig ltar the'u rang brten nas smra ba dang / la la pho tshod dang / rna ba gsang po 'phar gtam nyan pa dang / byung rgyal du lung bstan mngon shes 'chad pa sogs mthar rang gi rdzog rtags skyel ba tsho dang mi 'dra ste/ nges don du mngon par mkhyen pa chags thogs mi mnga' yang gdul bya'i ngor rtsis dkar nag dbyangs 'char la gzigs pa/ slob dpon chen po'i lung bstan/ lho brag grub chen gyi gsung / bla ma —464

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ snyenagong ma tshad thub kyi gsung / rje nyid kyi dngos nyams mnal ltas sogs du ma zhig sgo bstun gnang bas 'khrul pa ga la srid/ de skabs tshur mthong skye bo byis pa dang 'dra ba du mas/ khyung nam mkhar lding ba la khyim byas 'phya ba dang mtshungs pa'i gtam sna tshogs zer yang / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sprul nas lcags 'brug bar (37na)gyi dus rtags rnams la/ nad rims dang / a sa lang la brten pa sogs dus 'khrug lho byang mang por byung song ba thams cad kyi spyod yul du grub/ kun gyis dmigs brtse mar sgril gsung ba ni/ bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi lung gis gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir mnga' sgyur ba'i brda'o/ /lkog gyur chos kyi gzugs brnyan rnams/ /mkhyen pa'i me long ngos shar tshe/ /kun mkhyen pad+ma ka ra dang / /dbyer med yin par da gzod nges/ /sa sprul hor zla dgu par/ nged tsho la dben gnas su 'ong dgos tshul phebs pa ltar phyin/ bzhugs gral tshor lo rgyus kyis 'byams klas shing / drung 'tsho sog sgor gyi spyil bur ja bzhes sar 'dul ba'i ljags bshad cig gnang gi 'dug pas/ bla ma mkhas pa zhig yod 'dug snyam pa tsam ma gtogs ma byung / de skabs nas 'khas pad bsten nas zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin zhus na/ rgya mtsho las chu bcu ba ltar ljongs 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi chos la gang dgos su spyad chog pa zhig 'ong rgyur 'dug kyang /de dus rtog ge'i log rtog gis dad pa bsgribs nas thal 'gyur gyi 'phreng ba ma gtogs/ gzhan gang la yang khyad gsod kyi dbang du song bas/ phyis su bsams tshe chos kyis 'phongs pa'i rgyu yin par gda'/ rje 'di rang re la thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i shugs kyis 'phral 'phral bslab ston bka' shog gnang skabs shig /khyod kyis mgon po zhal la bsnyen sgrub/ bsten mchod byas na mtshan ma myur bar 'ong ba 'dug /rgyu mtshan sngon sa phag gnyis 'gras dus sa (37bskyo nas chos skyong 'di phag gru dpon blon thams cad la rbad yun ring bas 'phyong rgyas tshor za kha yang zug / 'di 'dra'i rigs tshur khugs te g.yang du lon pa cig kyang 'ong zhes gnang /—465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skalcags rta bar khams nas ba so sprul pa'i sku byon/ bdog pa'i 'bul nod kyi bkur sti gya nom pa phul/ bde mchog lha i pa'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs zhus/ lcags lug 'kho snga nas sku skyes rgyud kyi 'chad nyan 'jog rgyu yin pas bla ma gnang dgos tshul gyi snyan gsan byung yang mi phebs pa'i bka' gsal gnang / khar kha dpon po a khas ta'i chin/ cha skar sku skye/ co ṇi chos rje sogs byang 'grul mang du 'byor/ dbang bka' rjes gnang lung sogs kyis so so'i re ba yongs su bskang/ ca ṇa'i yul gru las 'ongs pa'i dngos po 'gro ba'i legs spyad kyi rgyur bskrun/ chu sprel lo sku shin tu bsnyun pa zhig byung bas/ 'ga' zhig gis da lo bar gcod che ba zhig mi yong la che zhes zhus par/ nged gnas 'dir sleb nas rten 'brel mang du brtags par da lo cung zad 'tshe ba tsam yod na'ang / rim gros zlog par 'dug /lo drug gi rin sdod bsam pa yod gsung /chu bya hor zla gsum pa'i nang du dga' ldan pho brang du phebs/ nged kha shas la zhal bram gzugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ nā ga raka/ bla ma drag po/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang / dur khrod bdag po rnamasakyi rjes gnang stsal/ phebs gdong du chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab ston yang mang du gnang / shing khyi'i dbyar smad sku shin tu bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan/ nyi thang drung 'tsho bas (38na gi sol sman dang / phyag g.yo ga rnams kyis grwa pa phan tshun/ rgyud stod smad tshor mang 'gyed sogs sku rim mang du bsgrubs/ ri khrod kyi 'dus pas brtan bzhugs phul bas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar dgongs pa gtad de sku tshe byin gyis brlabs so/ /mkhas btsun bzang por grub pa'i khab len rdos/ /'phags nor bdun gyi lcags phye bsdus pa ni/ /srid 'di'i 'byor pa'i rdul mang kun dred nas/ /ma bsdus par yang khyod kyi drung du lhags/ /las nyon skye 'chi'i 'phrang las brgyal zin kyang / /skye dang gshegs pa'i sna tshogs cho 'phrul gyis/ /mtha' bral lus can mya ngan 'das pa'i sar/ /'khrid 'di theg chen 'phags pa'i ngang tshul lags/ /zug rngu spangs kyang sman dpyad nye bar bsnyen/ /bdud bzhi bcom kyang mi mthun zlog la brtson/ /—466

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)'ja' lus grub kyang lus kyi mthu dman skad/ /rang dbang gyur kyang gzhan gyis phan ltar ston/ /shing phag nag pa zla ba'i nang du sngar nas bka' bzhes yod pa ltar/ nged kyis pha bong khar sku ga'o ges su phyin/ zla ba phyed gnyis la thug gi bar du zhabs kyi pad+mo bsten te/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dbang lung 'khrid man ngag ji snyed cig lhug par stsal/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i gsung sgros rin po che yig chung nyer gcig gi ljags lung skabs/ yi ger ma btab na rje'i gsung ngag rnams rim gyis nub dogs tshul 'dug ces mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung rnams byung bas rkyen byas spyan chab shar mar shor te yug (38ba༄ga ljags klog gi 'tshams 'jog dgos byung / lar rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa 'di thugs rang la gcags pa'i nyams chen po brjod las 'das par gda' bas/ rje 'di zhal bzhugs skabs/ ris med chos la mkhyen pa che bas grub mtha' mi gtsang bar gleng mkhan mang po yod de/ grub mtha' gtsang gtsang mo tshos kyang / rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bstan pa la thugs chen bcos min rje 'di pa tsam dka' bar mchis/ phyag dpe dpe khrir rtsig pa'i tshe yang / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung rab rnams steng kho nar 'ong ba gnang / gal bor 'og tu chud na bka' bkyon/ bskyed rim gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i rtags kyi gsung thol byung du yang yang gnang / slar zhib tu zhus na sbas pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ nged sku gzhogs na yod dus gcig rdzi bo zhig rbab la shor nas shi ba'i bsngo zhus byung bas de ma thag bcos min gyi snying rje chen po bla na med pa'i rnam pa dang bcas smon lam gyi thugs 'dun gtad/ slar sku mdun gyi mi tshor sbub zo'i rnam pas ji mi snyam pa lta bur bzhugs/thugs dam brtag pa 'ga' zhig zhus pas/ lta snang du phyag 'phreng la brtsis pa'i mo zhig gnang /bka' phebs gang gnang thams cad kyi thog kho nar song / don du ni ye shes kyi gzigs pa ste/ 'phreng mo de nged la slob pa gnang byung bar/ lag tu blangs tshe yid gtan rung ba ni ci yang ma byung / gzhan la yang de dang 'dra ba byung ngo / /rin po che dngas ma ba'i lugs kyi sngags 'khor gyi phyag khrid gnang tshe lag sbyongs byas pa'i —467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6yo'akhor lo (39na)zhig gong lar btsugs pas/ rlung tshub chen po glo bur du byung nas 'khor lo khyer/bka' las/ da res lag len dngos gzhi min na'ang 'tshub kyi rnam pa yin nges su 'dug pas ya rnams 'phral du bsubs pa legs gsung / bla med kyi bka' dbang che ba re gang gnang yang dbang rdzas mchod pa yo byad phra mo tshun la yang so so'i bshad srol ltar zhib tu gnang ba ma gtogs sla chos gtan mi gnang / 'khrid phyag bzhes kyi rigs kyang bla ma 'di 'di 'dra bzhed ces zhib cha shin tu che/rjes sor dmigs khrid kyi khyad 'ong zhes blor 'jags thabs kyi bslab ston 'ba' zhig gnang / nyin gcig 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor las 'phros nas/ dbang gi las kho na la bsngags brjod dang /don gyis byed dgos pa'i brda lta bu gnang / de skabs rang bzhin gyi bka' phebs yin nam snyam pa las ma go /phyis bsams tshe lo de'i 'jug tu khar kha a sa lang 'ong rgyu yin pa la dgongs par 'dug /bka' chos kyi mtshams la gsung 'phros kyi rigs sngon byon gyi lo rgyus/ rgan rabs kyi ngag sgros kyis mtha' brten pa ma gtogs rgyu mtshan dang mi 'brel ba'i dug gsum gyis kun nas bslang ba'i long gtam gsung ba ni ma thos/ tshur 'ong khar thos bsam sgom gsum byed lugs sogs kyi bslab ston dang / da 'gyangs med bsnyen rdzogs cig kyang sgrub ran pas/ paṇa chen rin po che mkhan por gdan 'dren dgos pa sogs zhib rgyas kyi bka' phebs gnang /hor zla dgu pa'i nang du a sa lang dmag gi (39ba)dpung chen po dang bcas te 'dam du 'byor/sleb ma thog yong sha bu'i dpon khag bzhi tsam bcom pa sogs kyi drag shul gyis bod rnams skrag cing /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa la mi bsrun pa'i blo yod pa 'dra zhes phal cher yid gnyis su gyur kyang /rje 'di nyid kyis skyon du 'gyur ba mi 'ong ba'i bka' gsal phyag bris su gnang / de yang sog dmag des spyir bstan pa dang bod khams la mi dge /khyad par rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bstan pa la ngan sems 'chang ba mkhyen te/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa gsum pa'i don rgyas par bshad pa khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyi 'od kyi 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas sdang sems zhi ba/ spa —468

'bon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ snyenabakong ba/ dbang du bsdu ba sogs kyi las sbyor dang / a sa lang la yang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa la gus mchod lhur blangs na 'di phyir dge ba'i zhal ta dang phyag tham gnang ngo / /mi bsrun skye bo'i sdang sems mun pa'i dpung / /rmad byung thugs rje'i 'od kyis rab zhi bas/ /thub bstan pad mo'i 'dab ma rgyas so zhes/ /snyan grags phyogs bral bu mo'i 'gram par bkod/ /rang bzhin gyis stong tha snyad rten 'byung du/ grub phyir gnag pa'i yid kyang gnyen gshin par/ /gyur pas zla ba'i zhabs kyi ri mo'i bar/ /'o ma bzhos pa'i ngo mtshar gnyis pa byas/ /sog po'i dmag gis yar 'brog phyogs su brgyugs pa la brten/ me byi'i dpyid ka gtsang sa nas/ bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi dpung gnam mtsho le gong du bteg /bod sog gi mdun 'chings gleng bar gtsang nas 'gro dgos tshul byung ba ltar/(40na)nged rnams 'phan yul rgyal lha khang bar phyin/ tshur lam pha bong khar sku gshogs su 'ongs/ bka' chos kyi rim pa zhu ba dang bcas zla shas sdod rtsis yin yang / nye skor tshor 'brum pa mched pas/ zhag bcu skor gyi bar las sdod pa ma shar/ 'on kyang / sleb nyin sprel zla'i tshes bcu dang 'grig pas/ de nyin rang thun drug gi ljags lung dang / sang nas bzung 'dod sbyar gyi bka' chos rnams lhug par stsal/ bka' las/ da lo'i 'brum nad 'di yang mtha' dmag bod du lhags ches pa'i mtha' 'dre'i kha rlangs yin pas/ rgya 'gong gnad la gzir ba'i skor 'di lag len du bstar dgos tshul gyi bslab ston dang ljags khrid gnang / dge 'phel du sleb 'phral lag len byas pas rmi ltas kyang phebs sgo bzhin byung / de dus bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du yun ring por bzhugs dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pas/ brag dgon du skye brtag gnang ba'i lo rgyus sogs gsung zhing / nga lo don drug pa yin pas/ da yun ring e sdod mi shes zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa ma byung / sku skye ba gang du bzhes zhus par yang / sngar slob gnyer gyi mus la ri khrod nyag bskyangs nas sgrub pa zhig byed rgyu byung na dag pa'i zhing zhig tu skye e thub kyi 'dun pa yin na'ang /bar du rnam g.yeng dang dkor gyi dbang gis rang dbang 'dus pa zhig dka' bar 'dug kyang / rgya hor —469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6lodabus gtsang sogs su skye ba len 'dod ni med ces bka' phebs/ de yang thugs dbang mi 'dus pa sogs ni dgongs pa can du nges shing / lo sngon (40bsgo'i skabs thun drug ma'i skor nas 'phros te/'di nas gnang gi e yod zhus pas/ ma chag pa rang byed kyi yod lags/ rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su 'gro dgos pa zhes bka' phebs pas/ theg chen 'phags pa snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis skye 'chi'i tshul ston pa ni/ bu pha khyim du 'gro ba las kyang ches sla'o/ /bka' phebs rnams la brtags na/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis/ rgya nag tu chos dar po med 'dug pas skye ba len pa'i shes 'dod med gsungs pa ltar/ mtha' 'khob kyi yul dam pa'i chos kyi snang brnyan tsam las med pa rnams la ni/ rje 'di nyid sku skye ba mi bzhes par gtan tshigs su grub la/ dbus gtsang gi phyogs su gdul bya'i 'phro ma dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskul te sprul pa'i rnam rol ston pa yang srid mod/ de yang nyi ma shar ba na mun pa'i tshogs mtha' dag ngang gis 'joms pa ltar/ g.yin gyis 'gebs par mi nus pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba'i tshul rang babs kyis ston pa las pha ma g.yo sgyu can gyis gtam sna tshogs su sgrog pa/grwa rigs sbyin bdag gi tshod 'ding ba sogs mun khung du mda' 'phen pa'i sbyor ba tsam la ni yid rton par mi nus so/ /hor zla bdun pa'i nang du a sa lang mi bzang dang bcas jo mjal la 'ongs/ rje 'di nyid mjal te/ legs nyes kyi brtag pa zhu ba dang / zang zing gi 'bul nod mang du byas/ dam sel gyi rnam pas nam mkha' shin tu tshub cing / khyad par dge 'phel gyi ri rgyud nas sna drangs/ pha bong kha'i bar ser ba drag tu babs/ de 'phral (41na〉bskang bshags dang gtor 'bul sogs mdzad pas nam mkha' dwangs/ brtag pa yang / a sa lang phar mtsho khar log na pha dang e 'phrad zhus pas mi 'phrad cing bar chad che ba 'dug gsungs/ pha'i blon po tha'i cing gis nga 'di nas mgyogs par mtsho khar phyin na dpon po dang e mjal/ sde rnams 'tsham por e yod/ dpon sku khams e bzang zhus pas/ da lta sde —470

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)yang 'tsham por yod/ dpon yang sku khams bzang bar 'dug /khyod dang dpon mi mjal gsungs/tha'i cing gi bsam pa la/ dpon sku khams bzang / sde 'tsham por yod na zla ba gnyis gsum la nga mtsho khar ni sleb 'gro /brtag pa 'di ci 'dra yin bsams pa shar ba rjes su gleng brjod byung 'dug /de nas zla ba drug thog la bar khams su a sa lang dpon g.yog nang 'khrug dang / mtsho khar o rod kyi dmag gis bcom pa dus mnyam du byung ngo / /grangs med 'gro la brtse ba'i chu rgyun gyis/ /thugs rje'i zhing sa dus drug brlan pa las/ /legs nyes 'byung 'gyur gsal ba'i 'bras bu'i khur/ /ris med skye dgu'i thos 'dzin rgyan du ldem/ /ma 'ongs mngon sum ston pa'i gsang ba'i tshig /mtha' 'khob rje 'bangs rna bar bsgrags pa na/ /log rtog can 'ga' the tshom khyogs 'chang yang / /drug gi zla bar mtha' dag mngon du gyur/ /me mo glang gi lo la dbyar gnas sogs sngar bzhin rgyas par gnang / gnas bcu phyag mchod kyi zhal bkod dang / tha ma'i zhal gdams mang du gsungs kyang mi bzhugs pa'i brdar ma go /dgag dbye grol rjes hor zla brgyad (41ba)pa'i tshes brgyad nas sku cung zad bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan/ nyi thang drung 'tsho ba sogs kyis 'phrod bsnyen mang du byas kyang gdangs bskyed cher ma byung / snga mo nas dgung lo don bdun las mi bzhugs pa dang / rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i rnam thar du khams lcags yin pas bzhur yang mi btub gsung ba'i lung 'dren yang yang gnang ste/ khyed nye 'khor rnams kyis 'khrur dang bul tog sogs lcag rtsol gyis/ kho bo lcags khams yin pas lo gcig gi bar sreg mi btub/ rten sman sku tsam las ma thub kyang gnas 'di khar bzhengs pa 'gro don che gsungs/ brag sna chos rje lha sar 'byor 'phral sku gzhogs su phyin par sku shin tu bsnyun pa'i tshul ston skabs yin 'dug kyang phyag gnyis gas phyag dbang non chen dbu thug dang / rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi bla ma byas pa legs/ grwa tshogasatsam yod ces dri ba sogs dgyes dgyes gnang / tshes dgu dang bcu'i nyin nam mkha' la yang yang gzigs kyin ba 'ad mo dang bcas te dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad/ de la dgongs gzhi che ba —471

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yo te/yod tshod du 'dug kyang 'di zhes brjod pa'i yul las 'das so/ /tshes bcu gcig gi srod dus la zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal chos kyi sku mngon du gyur cing / zhing 'di'i mdzad pa tha ma bstan te gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim/ 'di skabs nged tsho rgyal phyogs nas yongs te dga' ldan khang gsar du 'byor tshe/ dag pa'i zhing du gshegs nas zhag gnyis song grub 'dug pas ngos kyis mjal ba'i skal pa dang ni bral/ gdung mjal zhig la 'gro 'dod byung yang / lho byang nas yong mi mang ba sogs (42na)kyi rnam g.yeng gis rang dbang ma thob/ de yang sems ngo ji bzhin ma 'phrod pa'i skyon du 'dug go /'gyur med chos dbyings ngang gcig kyang / /gnyis med gnyis su shar ba yi/ /sna tshogs sprul sku'i zlos gar de/ /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba bzhin/ /'di snang la zhen 'dzin pa can/ /chu shing 'bras ltar grub pa'i gzugs/ /rdo rje'i sku yang 'jig tshul gyis/ /rnyog bral chu mtshor gsal bar shar/ /zhag bdun gyi bar dad ldan gsol ba 'debs pa rnams kyi ched dang / dmangs phal pa rnams kyi dad pa'i gsos su thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i rtags/ dri bzang pos khyab pa dang / sku mdangs ma yal ba sogs byung / khyad par 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku a ti yo ga'i don las mi 'da' ba'i rtags su/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ rtsibs shar/ gyen 'dren/ thig le'i rnam pa nyi ma mang du byung ngo / /'od skor tshom bu chu yi sgron ma sogs/ /nang du ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i rtags/ /phyi rol skye bo'i mig la ston pa ni/ /rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i ngang tshul ngom/ /tshes bcu dgu'i nyin da lta'i dga' ldan khri thos/ pa chos rje chos rgyal pa smad rgyud grwa tshang gi slob dpon las thog pa yin pas/ dpon slob thams cad kyis gdung mjal dang / sku gdung rin po che'i sku gzhogs su 'dus pa'i smon lam mgrin gcig gsungs pas 'tshams sbyar te/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku las bar do longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs pa'i rtags su thugs dam grol/ gdung chog la dge slong (42ba)ri khrod pa rnams kyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgo —472

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)nas kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin zad mi shes pa 'bul ba dang / rgyud stod smad tshor 'dus pa'i stong rtsa/ ser 'bras dge gsum la mang 'gyed/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che sogs bla ma rnams la thugs dam 'dogs chas kyis mtshon dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rgya chen po dka' bcu pa 'phrin las phun tshogs kyis do dam byas te bsgrubs/ de yang zhal chems bzhin/ glang lo'i 'phro ma rdzogs kyi ring sku gdung rin po che bzhugs pa 'gab par kun mthun te/ tshes nyi shu'i dgongs mo chos rje sngags ram pa dang nyi thang slob dpon gnyis kyis spur chas byas nas mchod pa'i rten du bzhugs su gsol/ zla ba bcu pa'i nang du bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po dang / co ṇi chos rje sogs kyis gdung mjal du byon/dngul srang lnga bcu ma/ dngul gyi ka to ra sogs rten bzhengs kyi mthun rkyen mchog dman du mas mang du phul/ dka' bcu pas bla ma la sri zhu che ba sogs bsam pa rnam par dag pas phyi rten la dngul gdung bzheng rtsis kyis lo gsar nas/ byes pa slob dpon byams pa smon lam dang / ri khrod pa rnams kyis gdung zhugs su phul bas nam mkha' dwangs pa dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ me tog gi char babs/phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags su dbu thod bam ril/ thugs/ sku nyungs 'bru lta bu'i ring srel 'ga' zhig byon/ de yang zhugs 'bul ba byes pa slob dpon 'phrin las bsam grub/ brag sna chos rje/ chos rje sngags ram pa sogs slob ma dam tshig gi sel med pa zhig (43na)yin na/ gdul bya rnams kyi dad rten du rang byon gyi sku dang gdung sha ri raṃ sogs ji snyed cig 'ong tshod du 'dug kyang / rab 'byams pa byams pa smon lam byes kyi dge skos skabs rje 'di pa'i thugs dkrugs pa'i dam tshig gi sel re che yod 'dug pas nyams grib kyi skyon du nges te/ gling ras pad+ma rdo rjer yang dam sel can zhig la brten nas gshegs pa'i lo rgyus dang dus gyis kyang rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i drung du sde pa g.yul rgyal bas byon pas thugs dam grol ba sogs mang la/ dpon slob kyi bar gyi dam tshig ni shin tu 'jigs pas so/ /gzung med brjod bral snang stong 'ja' yi lus/ /ye shes zhugs kyis bsregs tshe sha rī raṃ/ /tha —473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6skasnyad rten 'byung ngo bor grub pa'i gdung / /phyur bur spungs kyang mkha' 'gros zhing gzhan drangs/ /sa stag nang du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten mtho bcu pa nyid chos rje sngags ram pas thig rtsa/gzung gzhug 'bul ba dang / gang ci'i khur len dka' bcu pas bgyis te/ bal po bdun gyis zla ba gcig la gegs med par lhun gyis grub/ ri khrod pa rnams kyis rab tu gnas shing / zla ba lnga pa'i nang du nged la me tog 'thor bar 'ong dgos tshul byung ba ltar dben gnas su 'ongs/ dbu thod dang tshems 'phel ba'i dung g.yas 'khyil rnams gdung rten du bzhugs 'dug pas/ dngul gdung sku gzhogs su zhag gcig bsdad/ smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i shis pa brjod do/ /de nas bzung da lta'i bar (43ba)dka' bcu pa sogs dge slong brgyad grwar mtha' bsten pa pha bong khar rgyun chad med par gnas pa ni rje de nyid kyis dgongs pa gtad pa'i bden tshig gi mthu'o/ /slad nas kyang bod gangs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i bstan 'gro'i phan bde snying la gcags pa yin na/ gnas 'di nyid du dge 'dun gyi sde tshugs pa dang sri zhu bgyid pa la brtson par rigs so/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun dngos dngos rgyud bla ma yongs kyi dpal/ /dpal ldan kun mkhyen ye shes shes bya rnams la thogs med du/ /du mar 'byed cing legs dpyod dpyod ldan dga' ba'i 'byor ba'i gter/ /gter mdzod ji bzhin ma lus lus pa med par lhun grub pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bshes gnyen rnam rol can/ /mkhas btsun bzang por grags pa'i snyan pa'i rnga/ /phyogs bral yongasakyi rna lung mdzes byed pa'i/ /'khor lo'i mgon khyod mdzad pa pha mtha' yas/ /mtha' bral bskal par babs pa'i char gyi grangs/ /'dzin pa'i ngal ba bsten ltar bla ma rje'i/ /dpag yas mdzad pa'i pha mtha' yongs rdzogs par/ /brjod pa kun mkhyen las gzhan su yis nus/ /'on kyang thun mong gdul bya'i bsam pa'i mtshor/ /tshangs spyod ri dwags gzugs kyi 'jo sgeg las/ /rnam thar cha shasatsam gyi zegs mas kyang / /dad ldan gnyis skyes dga' ba'i gar gyis rol/ /khyab bdag dam pa'i —474

'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta/ 6)yon tan nor bu'i dpya/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod pa las/ /bde legs 'dod dgu'i gter gyi char chen pos/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin kun la khyab gyur cig /khyad par tshe rabs (44na)kun tu mgon khyod kyis/ /dgyes bzhin brtse bas gzung ste nges gsang lam/ /theg chen chos kyi dpal la dbang bsgyur nas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rigs thams cad kyi bdag po khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam par thar pa skal bzang dad pa'i shing rta zhes pa 'di yang / ring mo zhig nas bri 'dod pas/ slob ma'i tshogs mang po dang gleng mo zhib tu byas kyang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen pu to ba'i zhal nas/ rang cag chos la ci yang mi rtsi bar ja sun re'i mtho dman la thugs la btags ma btags thams cad rtsi ba de phugs rul ba'i rtags yin gsung ba ltar/ phal cher ni phogs bzang ngan/ bdag rkyen che chung ja tshul gar sla las spros pa'i bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa bshad rgyu yod pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma ltar snang bas/ mtshan nyid pas bla ma mgrin bzang du mthong zer ba'i gtam rgyud bden par gda'/ 'on kyang chos rje sngags ram pas dam pa de nyid kyi zhal lung zin bris su btab ba la gzhi byas/ brag sna cho so rje/ nyi thang slob dpon/ dka' bcu 'phrin las phun tshogs rnams dang 'phros byung ba dag gis zur brgyan/ rang nyid kyis dngos su zhal lung las thos shing /rgyus yod kyi nges pa rnams kyis kha bskang ste/ bshes gnyen mchog de'i bka' drin gyis nye bar 'tsho ba'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ dam pa de nyid gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus nas lo brgyad 'das pa/ sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i lo/ (44bstang gyi zla ba drug pa'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //shu bha ma su sarba dza ga rta// // maṅga lo// // 475

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ra༅༅//byang pa rig 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya ma31 bzhugs/༄༅/ /namaḥbraPROBPROBkye zhwar bi ra lha gi nā ya/phun tshogs ngo mtshar bkod pa'i rang bzhi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gling bzhi la//med byung mkhyen brtse nus par ldan pa'i gser sbyangs 'khor lo rtsibs stong gis//mnga' sgyur ngag dbang rig 'dzin rdo rje chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes//sngagasa'acha yongs kyi gtsug na mngon mtho pad+ma'i gdung sgo dam pa rgyal//ka dag chos dbyings klong du ro gcig kyang //lhun grub gzugs sku'i bkod pa dbang po'i gzhu//bgrang yas sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mkhan//'gro la kun khyab thugs rje'i gzigs mor mtshar//de phyir rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs mchog/spel phyir skye rabs dpag bsam nor bu'i 'phreng //srid zhi'i legs tsho gos 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gtam//snyan pa srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du khyab//zab cing ches brling rlabs 'phrong gyis sbas pa//dpag dka'i mdzad bzang yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//kun gyis mthong ba'i skal ba phra na yang //phan bde'i nor bu'i 'byung khungs gcig 2na thar nges//tshangs pas bskal par ngal ba'i khur bsten nas//smras kyang mdzad pa'i pha mtha' rdzogs min phyir//thun mong gdul byar 'tsham pa'i rtogs rjod kyi//tshig don ngo mtshar bkod pa'i rgya mtsho spel//lo byung legs par bshad pa'i zil dngar can//skal bzang 'chi med dbang po'i spyad bya'i bcud//gzur gnas legs bris tshogos kyi dga' ston du//glegs bam rin chen za ma tog tu 'khyil//zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs gis sngun bsus te/dpal ekhri yā na'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rgyal tshab rig sngags 'chang ba'i ༷/ra los sgyur ba mi nyag byang pa sngags 'chang ngag

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6dedabang rig 'dzin rdo rje chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gyi rnga gsang phyogs kyi rna rgyan du 'god pa gang de'i zhing khams rgya mtshor sprul pa'i rnam rol grangs med pa'i bkod pa ston pa'i nang nas rgya mtsho chen po las skyogs kyis bcus pa ltar skyes rabs kyi 'phreng ba sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad pa dri med pad dkar bzhad pa'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/ grang so (2bsko ter ston gsum pa rig 'dzin chen po yol mo ba bstan 'dzin nor bu'am sngags 'chang chen po stobs ldan dpa' bos mdzad pa las/ 'og min dag pa'i zhing du thog ma'i mgon po dpal kun du bzang po/ mkha' las 'ja' tshon byung ba ltar 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa'/ de nas rim pa bzhin rgyal sras rdo rje snying po/ khyi'u chung she la rog po/ rgyal sras de ba bzang skyong / byang sems ye shes snying po/ bka'i sdud po nam mkha'i mdog can/ bdag cag gi ston pa zasagatsang gi sras po'i spyan sngar skye rgu'i bdag mo/ dga' rab rdo rje'i yum mkha' 'gro bde ldan ma/mkha' 'gro rig byed bde ma/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi slob ma yid byin dpal/rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti'i chos blon blo gros mchog /slob dpon chen po da rgya mtsho rol pa'i mtsho gling du rdzus te sku bltams pa'i tshe sku khrus gsol ba po byang sems nam mkha'i snying po/ slo dpon chen pos u rgyan gyi rgyal srid bzung ba'i dus 'khor sbas pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa sems dpa' chen po/ slob dpon chen po/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad cing chos 'khor skor ba'i tshe las byed bde ba'i rdo rje/ ri bo ma la yar slob dpon chen po sde brgyad kyi gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dus kyi 'khor drag po gas po/ slob dpon chen po dur khrod brgyad du spyod pa mdzad pa'i dus kyi 'khor shākya mi tra/ kun dga' bo'i drung du slob dpon chen po dang lhan cig tu bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong zhi ba'i snying po/ mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo lha lcam man+ta ra ba/ bde chen ye shes skyed mdzad chang 'tshong ma bi na sa/ za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi chos blon ye shes(3na) gsal/ u rgyan gyi yul gru chen po bcu drug skyong ba'i tshe bka'i sdu ba po bde ba'i 'byung gnas/ seng ge sgra sgrog gis rdo rje —477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)gdan du mu stegs tshar gcod pa'i tshe gter gyi sgrom bu 'bul ba po mkha' 'gro ma gar gyi dbang phyugaklu'i rgyal po khyab 'jug 'dul ba'i tshe bde mchog dus snying gi yum lha mo bde 'byung gnyis pa/ dbus 'gyur rdo rje gdan gyi sri zhu la brtson pa dge bsnyen sde dpon ka kha 'dzin/ bal yul yang le shod du rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya bal po dzi na mi tra/ 'di yan ni rgya gar du byon pa'i skye rgyud yin la/ de rjes slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir phebs pa'i tshe las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga'i nang tshan zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms zhes sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa chen por u rgyan rin po ches le'u bdun ma'i stong thun du/ nyin cig sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa: nga yi rnam thar mdzad tshul ni: bsam gyis mi khyab brjod mi lang : zhes gzengs bstod cing grub rtags mi 'dra ba ngo mtshar can re ston pa'i rje 'bangs nyi nyu rtsa lnga'i ya rgyal gcig yin pas chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i gsol 'debs smin byed dbang gi chu rgyun du/ rdo rje bdud 'joms rlung ltar thogs med/ /ces bsngags pa de'o/ /de nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus gsol 'debs de nyid las/ gnubs kyi rigs 'khrungs dge slong chen po/ /lho brag mkhar chur yang dag grub rnyed/ /nyi zer la chibs nam mkha'i snying po/ /zhes dang / gnubs yul rong 'khrungs sangs rgyas ye shes/ /bsgrags kyi yang rdzong gshin rje gshed 'grub/ /mthu stobs brag la phur pa 'debs der/ /(3ba tshe zhes bsngags pa brjod pa'i yul du gyur pa de dag dang gdung rus gcig pa sngags 'chang nag po ro zan gyi sras khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal zhes gsang sngags gsar ma'i lo tsā ba chen po de nyid du gyur pa'i tshe paṇa grub rnam pa gsum la brten nas dam pa'i chos mang du bsgyur cing / rje btsun byams pa'i sku mthong thos dran reg don ldan 'di nyid bzheng bar mdzad do/ /de rjes zab gter chos kyi bdag por gyur pa ni rig 'dzin chen po dngos grub rgyal mtshan yin la/ 'di nyid kyi rigs ni hor gur ser rgyal po'i rgyud las de gyin de wa rā dza zhes sngon chos skyong ba'i 478

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ snyenargyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su rgya mo bza' kong jo/ bod skad du mtsho nang gi pad+ma ra grags pa'i zhang po ste/ de dag gi gdung las byung ba hor 'jig rten mgon pos che mchog dang ma mo'i grub pa thob pa nas bzung rig 'dzin chen po'i yab phur pa'i sprul pa slob dpon bdud 'dul dpal yan chad du spyir gsang sngags rnying ma la mkhas shing khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i grub thob sha stag byung ngo / /de yang yab slob dpon bdud 'dul dpal gyi sras su me mo glang gi lo rta chen zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus dge bar ri bo bkra bzang gi shar mdun sna mo lung gi gzims khang du sku bltams pas/ las can gyi them byang las/ glang ngam 'brug gi lo shar tshe: phag mo yum gyi sku las skyed: chos nyid sgra dang bcas te zhabrungs: bod la bde skyid ldan par 'gyur : che lta/dbu gtsug tu sme ba dkar nag gnyis/ lte bar sme ba sum sgrom/ thugs kar yi ge oṃ/ dpral bar gnyer ma gyen 'greng gsum yod pa'i mtshan rtags bzang po dang ldan pa/ khyad par dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba spu dkar (4na)po'i rnam pa la rtse mor rgod kyi sgro ji lta ba gsum dang / dgung lo nyer bzhi pa'i dus rgod kyi sgro lnga skyes pas 'khrungs yul dang mtshan rtags sogs kyi nges pa ni thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi lung byang las/ lnga brgya tha ma shar ba'i tshe: ri bo bkra bzang shar 'dab snya las can sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rgod kyi ldem phru can zhig 'byung: de phyir nga yi thugs sgrub bzhag: ces dang / ri khrod pa bzang po grags pa'i gter lung snying thig gnad kyi man ngag don bdun ma las/ byang phyogs mtho yor nag mo'i sa phyogs su: ri bo bkra bzang zhes bya'i shar 'dabs su chu khams glang lo sme ba'i mtshan rtags can pad+ma nga yis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags spyi bor rgod kyi ldem phru yang yang 'byung: zhes pa ltar ro/ /rig 'dzin chen po 'dis gzhen nu'i dus nas yab chos zhi khro sgyu 'phrul dang / bka' brgyad ma gshin phur gsum la thos bsam sgom pa nan tan du mdzad/ 'di nyid kyis spyan drangs pa'i zab sa/ter rnams ni u rgyan chen po lho nub srin po'i yul du gshegs pa'i yar lam gnod sbyin bu le'i gangs 'dabs nas/ rje lha sras mu khri btsan po/—479

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)'bangs sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ grogs mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal te las can gyi 'khor gsum dang bcas nas slob dpon chen po'i rdzu 'phrul gyis ri bo bkra bzang gi rtse mor phebs rdo/zangs/ khro'i ga'u kha sbyar gyi nang du mkha' 'gro mas phul ba'i 'dzeng dkar gyi rdo reng gsum shog ser dang bcas pa gter du sbas/de 'don pa'i kha byang ni/ ri khrod pa bzang po grags pa'i gter ma'i snying byang man ngag gnad kyi don bdun ma/ snying byang rgyas pa gnad kyi them bu/ (4bsnying byang 'bring po thugs rje'i 'od zer/snying byang bsdus pa thugs rje'i lcags kyu rnams las gsal ba ltar yin la/ de yang gter ston bzang po grags pa de nyid thog mar phyag rgya chen po'i sgom chen zhig yin pa la gnod sbyin bu les gter 'don par bskul ba dang / re zhig na ding rir sdom bu la byon pa'i tshe slob dpon chen po'i sprul pa snye nam la sgom zer bas kyang bskul ma mdzad par brten/ grom pa rgyang gi lha khang dang rgyang yon po lung gi phug pa gnyis nas zab gter mang du spyan drangs pa'i nang tshan gong gi shog dril bzhi po'i steng du phyir zlog 'khor lo 'bar ba/ zhal chems thugs kyi thigs pa/ kha byang gter gyi bang mdzod/ lam byang gsal ba'i sgron me ste chos tshan brgyad po 'di rnams lha brag gi gter 'don pa'i cha lag tu dgos par mkhyen nas ston pa bsod nams dbang phyug la bskur te/ sngags pa lag na lha'i sku'am phur pa thogs pa thog mar bod bde sdug gi gtam 'dri ba zhig la thod gsung ba ltar lam du zhugs te byon pas rig 'dzin chen po dang mjal bas gong gi gsung rnams dang mthun par byung ba la brten nas lha thog dril rnams sprad/ gter kha snga phyi gnyis kyi gter tshab gung thang rgyal pos bcug na legs par bshad pa ltar zhu bar byon kyang / mnga' bdag phun tsho gos dpal grom stod dpal ldan sa skyar byon pa dang 'grig /mnga' bdag thugs brel gyis g.yengs nas nyin zhag mang po'i bar do gal ma mdzad par lus/ mthar gser zho gang gnang / yar lam ngam ring nas gter tshab tu dar sna dang 'bru sna gtos che ba phul/—480

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)de nas me rta sbrul gyi zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor la ri bo bkra bzang gi rtse mor phebs te skya (ldan)rengs dang po'i tshe gter gnas kyi thang du 'od zer skar chen shar ba lta bu dang / nyi ma'i rtse la dpag bsam gyi sdong po lta bu'i 'od zer dkar po ri bo bkra bzang gi thad la zug /brag la zil pa kha ba babs pa tsam 'dug pa'i 'og nas 'dzeng rdo dkar po sogs spyan drangs pa yin te/ snying byang rgyas pa las/ rta lo sprul gyi zla ba yi: tshes brgyad stag gi kha rlungs la: ri de'i mig gi rnam par lta: 'od zer skar chen shar 'dra 'byung : zhes dang / 'bring po las/ 'dzing brag dkar po'i rdo reng la nang na byang chub srog shing la: gter chen gsum gyi lde mig yod: gter phran brgya rtsa 'don par 'gyur mun pa 'od du snang ba la nyi shar steng du zil pa 'byung: zhes so/ /ltas ngo mtshar ba de la dgongs nas gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs brda chen bco brgyad ma las/ ri rgyal rtse nas gter chen lde mig rnyed: ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i rtags gsum mthong:don chen the tshom med par 'grub pa'i brda: zhes so/ /snying byang bsdus pa las/ ldi mig bton rjes klu gter gzhug: ces pa'i don ltar gter tshab sbas phyi rabs yid ches kyi don du gter shul dngos 'jog pa gnang bar deng sang rlung gseng du grags/ lo phyi ma'i lo gsar gyi skabs myur gu gsar du skyes pa la brten/ gar chen ma las/ ri bo bkra bzang gter chen 'dus pa'i rtser/ /lo gsar 'khyags pa'i dus su lo tog smin/ /gnas der dad ldan ci bsams 'grub pa'i brda/ /che sko/so/ /lung bstan bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dzeng gi rdo reng bkod/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas gter gyi ma dwa dbul dang dngos (5ba) grub blang ba mdzad/ lo de'i lug zla'i tshes bzhi'i srod la brag ri dug sprul spungs 'dra'i sked pa'i brag phug nas rdo rje'i rgya gram gyi mtshan rtags kyi 'og tu lde mig bsnun pas brag gi sgo gsal ba'i nang du rdo sngon po gru bzhi sgo dgu yod pa/ sgo rgyan dngul gyi mdog 'dra ba'i gzer btab pa/ steng na sbrul kha dog sngo skya/ lto ba ser po/ sbom phra lag ngar tsam pa/ rin po che zur brgyad pa'i dbyibs su 'khyil ba/ kha shar lhor bstan pa/ snying kha na 'bur gsum yod pa'i nang nas shog 481

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)dril gcig dang rin po che zhig ston/ de nas dbus snying mdzod smug po nas shog dril gsum dang phur pa gsum chu dar smug po cig gis gril ba/ shar dung mdzod dkar po nas las rgyu 'bras la zlo ba'i chos dgongs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ lho gser mdzod ser po nas bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi'i chos spyod pa nyi zla ltar gsal ba/ nub zangs mdzod dmar po nas rten 'brel khyad par can gyi chos tsan dan gyi sdong po lta bu/ byang lcags mdzod nag bo nas dgra bgegs thal bar rlog pa'i chos dug gi sdong po lta bu ste/ mdor na kun bzang dgongs pa zangs thal gyis thog drangs pa'i chos dang dam rdzas bgrang bar yas pa spyan drangs pas/ zhal chems bdun pa las/ gter chos zab mo'i man ngag rtsa ba bzhi: shar na dung mdzod dkar po 'bras bu'i chos: tshe 'dir sangs rgyas lag bcangs gtad thabs yod: rtsa ba rgyud gcig man ngag rnam pa bcu: de la phran bu'i man ngag bcu bcu yod so sor phye bas man ngag brgya rtsa gcig: lho na gser mdzod ser po bsnyen sgrub chos: lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i sgrub thabs yod: yi dam lha yi sgrub thabs rtsa ba bcu: de rnams re re la yang man ngag bcu: (6na)so sor phye bas man ngag brgya rtsa gcig: nub na zangs mdzod dmar po rten 'brel gyi: zab lam thabs kyi dngos grub gnang tig yod: rtsa ba gcig la man ngag brgya rtsa gcig: byang na lcags mdzod nag po ngan sngags kyi reg gcod sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig la: ma bu lnga lngar phye bas brgya rtsa gcig: dbus na shog dril rgya can gsum yod pas las can snod brtag dam med spang ba dang:gdong dmar lho bod mtshams kyi gdul bya'i gnad: skyes bu khyod la dgos pa'i chos drug yod dug sprul sto ba bshags pa thun mong gi sgrub pa zab mo gnyis dang zhal chems gcig dbus na rtsis rgyar ma bzhag gab pa yi: gang zag spyi la dgos pa'i cho ge tshad ma zab la gnang 'dus shin tu gces pa yod: ces so/ /de lta bu'i zab gter 'don pa'i dus rtags ni/ lam byang gsal ba'i sgron me las/ ri bo bkra bzang gi rtse la zhwa gyon byang phyogs nas mang yul du dmag glog ltar 'khyug rgya gar gyi byang chub —482

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)shing lho ru yo kha che'i mchod rten byang shar du ral: bal po'i 'phags pa shing kun gyi mchod rten byang shar du yo bsam yas brag dmar la thog 'bab: de lta bu'i ltas byung dus brag ri dug sprul spungs 'dra nas rta'i lo la gter 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gter 'don pa'i dgos ched kyang / skul byang las/ zang zang lha brag gi sked pa na: sangs rgyas bstan ma yun sring ba'i thabs yod do: de dus la bab pa'i tshe 'thon na: bod la mi lo brgya dang rtsa gcig bde skyid 'byung: zhes dang / phyi gter gsol 'debs kyi mjug snya ma 'ongs tha ma'i dus su nub phyogs su: (6ba)nga yi rjes 'jug sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa: 'gro don cher spyod lhag par nga la mos: the tshom chung zhing chos rgyal gdung rgyud skyob:de 'dra'i las can snyigs ma'i dus su 'byung: zhes dang / nang gter lha sras zhu lan gyi mjug tu/ dus ngan tha ma mthar phug sle ka n+da/ ri bo bkra bzang zhes bya'i shar 'dabs su:sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gcig gi smon lam gyis: nga yi gter don lha sras gdung rgyud skyob: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje dus ngan tha ma'i sems can zog pos 'dul: de yi skyon gyis log lta'i 'dam la tshud: chos dang chos 'dra mi phyed the tshom che: ri bo bkra bzang shar 'dabs 'byung ba de:gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i bka' dang mthun: dge ba'i tshul spyod sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pas: gung thang rgyal po rje 'bangs skyong bar nges: zhes pa ltar mnga' bdag rgyal po rje bkra 4shis lde dang: gter ston chen po dang mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i zab gter 'thon pa rnams dus gcig tu 'dzom na bod la bde skyid chen po 'byung bar dgongs nas/ gab pa snying gi lde mig las/ slob dpon dang ni zab mo'i gter: gung thang rgyal po gsum 'dzom na: de dus bod kyi bstan pa ni: brgya dang rtsa gcig gter nges 'dzin: zhes byung ba'i don ltar 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi sman yon dam par 'gyur rgyu de/ bdud kyi bar chad kyi dbang gis rten 'brel cung zad ma 'grig par snang ste/ snying byang 'bring po las/ dang po dad pa ma skyes na: gdung gsum gri ru 'gum par 'gyur: zhes dang / snying tig gnad kyi man ngag don bdun ma las/ gal te gung thang rgyal po bdud kyis bar du bcad de rtog ge sgra tshad lta bu'i the —483

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)tshom rtog cing dad pa dang mi ldan na bod kyi skyid pa zad (7na)pa yin te: gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rgyud bdud kyis gcod bod kyi phung mgo gung thang nas 'dzugs so: zhes dang / sngon chos kyi rgyal po rten 'brel nyams grib kyi sris nga'i gter dang phrad dus 'chi'o: zhes gsungs pas 'di dag gi don snga phyi rnams la brtags na/ sngar gter tshab zhu ba'i skabs kyang bdag po sa skyar byon pa dang 'grig cing / rtog ge dang tha snyad la zhen pa'i rigs kyis cal sgrog dang / lta grub kyi kun slong la brten nas gung thang rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bsgyur nas zab gter la yid gnyis su gyur te gter tshab kyang cher ma phul ba sogs gter ston la thugs mos dang mi ldan par gsal la/ de'i dus su sa skyar slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i rnam sprul bdag chen 'jam dbyangs chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes gsang chen slob bshad kyi bdag po khyad par can de lta bu bzhugs pa'i skabs tsam yin par snang na'ang / chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs la yang sa skya pa nang gi gdung rgyud dang bu slob sogs nas thugs sun phyung ba mang du byung 'dug pas skabs 'dir sa skya'i bdag po dkyus ma'i rigs dang dge bshes su ming btags pa 'dras gung thang rgyal po'i rten 'brel 'phyugs pa'i thabs lhur blangs par mngon no/ /tshul 'di dag dang mtshungs par rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gter lung las/ gros mgo dmag dpon nag mos byed pa dang: nal phrug gsod cing mna' la 'gam pa dpa chad la mdo med snying dang 'dra bas bslus: btsun pa'i zhim zas sha la byed pa dang dge bshes thams cad phyogs cha'i bdud kyis (7ba)zin: chos dang chos pa gzhan la smod pa dang: khyad par bdud kyis byin brlabs dge bshes 'gas pad+ma nga yi chos la chos log zer sbas yul gter cho ge smod dang ya ga sgrog lho ru tsha rdol byang du dmag rdol nas: bod kyi yul rnams bde skyid med la zad: de 'dra'i dus ngan tha mar shar dus su: hor dmag byang gi phyogs nas 'byung bar 'gyur: de yi 'ong lugs dang po jag yan tshul: tshu ba gser pa byang 'byog bsnun par byed: de nas rje nye 'byog gi tshul du 'ongs bod dang srid —484

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6desbrel glo ba nye bar byed: de rnams sna drangs gting nas dmag rdol nas byang 'brog 'joms shing rim gyis bod kyang 'joms: de tshe bod yul dmag gi kha rlangs gis: nad ngan lo nyes dus zings glo bur 'byung : dmag ma sleb kyang shis ngan 'chi bar 'gyur: dus kyi tha ma mthar thug de yi dus bod la phan thabs nga yi bka' las med: shākya thub pa'i rgyal tshab nga yin pas: nga yi bka' bzhin bsgrubs na bod yul bde phyi ma mtho ris 'thob par gdon mi za: de dus nga yi sprul pa 'ga' tsam 'byung:sbas pa'i tshul gyis sna tshogs 'gro don byed: bod yul bde zhing skyid pa'i rten 'brel 'grig: mtha' dmag zlog pa'i thabs kyang byed 'gyur zhing : nga yi thugs rje de dus myur bar 'byung : zab mo'i gter ston rim gyis byung nas ni: nga yi zhal chems mang du 'byung bar 'gyur: las can sbas yul 'tshel ba'ang mang du 'byung : de tshe nga la bdud ces dge bshes 'gas: gter chos sbas yul mi bden rdzun yin zer smod cing ya ga sgrog pa'i rkyen byas nas: las can rnams kyang phyi bsgol byed par 'gyur:(8na〉zhes bod spyi bye brag gi bde thabs la bar gcod sna tshogs 'ong bar bshad pas kyang shes par nus so/ /'on kyang zab gter 'di nyid kyi snyan pas bod yul khyab cing / sras brgyud/ yum brgyud/ slob brgyud gsum nas 'ongs pa'i chos kyi rgyun deng sang gi bar ma nub par gan ri / khyad par nub dgon pa phyogs nas brgyud pa slob brgyud gtso che zhing / brgyud pa gzhan rnams la rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po bzhugs pa shas che na'ang / las 'bras rgyab tu bor ba 'ga' zhig gis sgo nga dang sgong skogs kyi dpe byed par mthong / gab pa snying gi lde mig las/ bod khams phung ba'i rtags byung na: yol mo stod la gro mo smad bar yul rin chen 'bras mo gshongs: gang gi rtags byung de ru rgyug: ces pa ltar dang / bod bde thabs kyi rten 'brel cung zad ma 'grig par brten/ sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas sgo 'bye bar phebs/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyi gtso bo ni skul byang chen mo las/ lho 'bras mo gshongs kyi sgo phyed pa tsam gyis lo bdun 'dzam bu gling gi bde skyid 'byung: de'i dus dbus su rgyal po'i mnga' —485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)gsol na lo bcu gsum 'dzam bu'i gling du bde skyid 'byung: zhes pa ltar ro/ /mdzod lnga stag rtse brgyud 'bras sa khongs mthil du phebs/ brag dkar bkra shis sdings su mgur gsungs/ sgo yol gyi lung phran lnga dang dga' bde sogs su bzhugs/ 'bras mo ga'u(ngas kyi gnas sgo phyed pa'i phyag rtags su/gu ru la na mo: grub thob bla ma rnams kyis gsungs pa'i shākya'i bstan pa phyin chad ni: sangs rgyas kun gyis (8ba)gsungs pa'i: deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sleb nas yod rgya gar zangs gling gi byang phyogs mon phag ri kha'i lho nub gu ru ma hā'i bsgrub gnas yod pa'i sa nas rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal gyis bod kha ba ljongs pa rnams la springs pa: bod 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis dka' ba mang du spyad nas: 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas sgo phye nas yod pas: zhes sogs kyi springs yig ngo mtshar pa mdzad/ 'bras mo ljongs su ma zad/ bde ldan skyid mo lung / sbas pa pad+ma'i tshal/ rol pa mkha' 'gro'i gling / rgyal gyi mkhan pa lung / lha'i pho brang sdings/ gro mo khud de sbas yul bdun gyi them byang dang / sbas yul spyi'i them yig /bye brag tu yol mo gangs/ bu le gangs/ 'bras mo khud/ skyid mo lung / mkhan po lung / stag so gangs ri sogs sbas yul ci bye brag mang po'i lde mig /kha byang / lam byang / snying byang / gnas yig /ri kun du gzigs kyi stod rigs rgyud dar ba'i gnas/bar bsod nams dang longs spyod dar ba'i gnas smad phung byed mtha' dmag zlog pa'i gnas kyi sa gnad/ gan tig lung bstan sogs du ma yang zang zang lha brag nas spyan drangs te bka' babs/ de yang gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa dang rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid dgung lo bgres gzhen ma gtogs thog mtshungs par byon/ gter ston gnyis la thugs mi mthun pa ga la mnga' na'ang bu slob 'dra mi mdza' ba'i chags sdang la brten/ dgongs 'dus pa zhig gis rig 'dzin chen po'i dbu skra'i gseb kyi rgod sgro la bsnyad nas lung bstan bka' rgyar (9na/snad 'di ltar bcug ste/ rnal 'byor spyon pa skra rgod can zhig byung nas 'bras mo gzhongs kyi lung phran sgo yol sngog pa rnams 'byung zhing /zhes dang / de'i 'og tsam du/ de yang thog mar bsam yas ltas po ri'i rtse la dge sbyong 'od zer mtha' —486

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)yas kyi gdung dngul gyi ga'ur bcug nas seng ldeng gi sgrom du bzhugs/ rgya rim pa gsum gyis mnan cing brag dpal bshos 'dra ba'i 'og tu bzhugs pa/ sprul pa'i rnal 'byor mched bzhis brtan nas brag dkar bkra shis sdings kyi dbus drang por rdo 'dom gang chu zheng gab pa'i ngos la rdo thal gyis bris pa'i g.yung drung ris yod pa'i steng du tsan dan la sogs pa'i dri bzang po'i shing gis rwa ba bzhi gang rung gi nya la bzhu bas 'bras mo gshongs kyi phyogs thams cad rang bzhin gyis dul nas lha 'dre dang gcan gzan dang dug sbrul la sogs pa'i 'tshe ba mi 'byung zhing / bar chad gang yang mi 'byung ste/de yang dus kyi mtha' la 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi bsod nams zad pas/ bdud kyi sprul pa nga'i cha byad du zhugs pa cig gis bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i gdung gang 'brel ngan song khegs pa zhig yod pa sbyin no zer zhing / khrom chen po bsdus nas dge sbyong 'od zer mtha' yas kyi gdung 'byin pa 'ong / des thams cad phung bar byed/ 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas rengs nas snga thog rim gcig phung bar byed cing / rim pas bar chad kyi rgyu mang po'i rkyen du 'gyur bas/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyis de dag shes par gyis shig /ces pa 'di yang / rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyis 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas sgo (9ba〉khyed kyi 'dug zer ba thos pa la brten nas/ has po ri nas dge sbyong 'od zer mtha' yas kyi gdung yang bton 'ong snyam pa'i ma 'ongs pa sngun bsus kyi kun slong skyon can gyi sgo nas bcug par gdon mi za'o/ /slar yang gung thang rgyal po mchog grub ldes ti shir bkur te gtsug tu bsten pas bod kyi bde skyid la phan par byung / spyir zab gter thams cad bod kyi bde skyid 'byung thabs yin yang / khyad par byang gter 'di bod la phan thabs gtso che bas/ ri kun du gzigs kyi lung bstan las/ rgyal po'i gdung rabs nyi shu song ba dang byang zang zang lha brag gi skyed nas mdzod bzhi 'dus pa'i gter rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru can bya bas rnyed nas lho bod kyi mtshams su dge ba'i las bstan pa 'dzin pa/ mtha' dmag zlog pa/ rims nad gcod pa/ bod kyi nang 'khrug zhi bar byed pa/ 'gong po ar 487

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)la gtad pa/ sde pa'i mnga' thang gso ba/ sa nad dang gnyan nad 'dul ba la sogs gang la gang dgos gter mdzod de'i nang du yod pas
