'gro don la brtson par gyis shig 'di'i skabs su khyung lung brag mkhar nas khams kyi klong thang sgrol ma yar bcad kyi bod spyi'i don dang sa khol bu khol bur bde ba'i thabs sna tshogs yod pa zur du ltos shig: ces byung ba ltar ro/ /shes ldan gzur gnas yod na lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas gangs can gyi ljongs 'di bde ba'i thabs la brtson par rigs so/ /sbas yul skyid mo lung gi gnas sgo phye/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du 'gro ba rnams smin grol gi lam la 'god par mdzad do/ /rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can mtshan gzhan dngos dngos grub rgyal mtshan du grags (10na)pa de nyid kyi sku'i skye ba ni rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje ste/'di nyid gyi rigs ni 'od gsal lha rigs bod chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung 'dzin pa'i gsang sngags 'chang ba'i rgyud las byung ba yin/ yang yab sngags 'chang chen po 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis rje grub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam pa chen po thang stong rgyal po dang / gter ston kun skyong gling pa'i zhabs la thug /mnga' sa su log 'byon khar gter ston kun skyong gling pa'i bka' las/ khyod ḍo snyi'i sku/ be+e ro'i gsung / mar pa'i thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa yin/ skye ba sngon ma rab stims pa kun bzang nyi mar gyur dus gzhan la khyad gsod byas pa'i rnam smin la brten/ drin gang che sdang ba zhig 'ong / 'on kyang shing stag pa skye ba'i gnas su sgrub pa byas na phung po 'od skur smin/ mdo rgyud kyi bshad nyan byas na bstan pa la phan pa rgya cher 'ong / phal cher gzhan rkyen gyis chung ma len dgos shas che yang / de ga bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu 'gyur te khyod la rigs kyi sras brgyad 'byung ba'i dang po la don grub rdo rje/ gnyis pa la dbang rgyal rdo rje/ gsum pa la rin chen rdo rje/ bzhi pa la snang mdzad rdo rje/ lnga pa dang drug pa la ming mi dgos/ bdun pa la kun bzang rdo rje/ brgyad pa la mgon po legasaldan rdo rjer thogs/ zhes dang po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sprul pa dang / phyi ma mgon po legs ldan gyi —488—

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ snyenasprul par lung bstan pa'i rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje 'di nyid yab kyis dpal rdo rje phur pa'i bskyed rim la gnas bzhin pa'i ngang nas yum gyi mngal du bskrun par mdzad/ sku na phra mo (10bskos bzung bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong grangs med pa zhal gzigs shing gsung gi gnang ba thob yab dang sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen/ rgya ma gter ston mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ sngags nag gsang sngags rdo rje sogs mdor na mnga' ris nas bzung kong po yan gyi mkhas grub grangs med pa bsten nas thos bsam sgom pa phul du phyin pa mdzad/ khyad par zab mo gter gyi bka' babs tshul ni/ 'dus pa snga phyi bar gsum las 'das pa dang po gter ston u rgyan gling pas yar lung shel brag nas gdan drangs pa'i bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho/ 'dus pa bar pa gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas spu ri phug mo che nas gdan drangs pa'i bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa/ 'dus pa phyi ma gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen dang gcung legs ldan rdo rje gnyis kyis thun mong du bsam yas dbu rtse rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprod kyi snying mdzod nag po mun pa'i dkyil 'khor nas gdan drangs pa'i rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang gsum gyi phyi ma rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi lung byang las/ 'di nas nyi ma nub phyogs su yang 'dul pra dum rtse yi lho ge gar klu yi kha gnon bya pa ri rgyal glang chen 'gying 'dra'i 'dabs chu chen drag bo 'bab pa'i 'gram slo bo ma thang zhes bya'i phur rje rigs sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa pha ma rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi bu:kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong nas bskrun bhi ma mtsho rgyal sprul pa'i sras spun bdun tshigs sam mtha' ru 'byupalhums nas〉 hrī'i sgra sgrog ci pa skyes pa'i lo nas bde skyid ldan yul khams(11na〉de zhing bsamasadon 'grub chu khams lug gam spre'u lo pa bdag gis byin brlabs pad+ma rgyal: mtsho rgyal byin brlabasa'od zer ming: chos sto byin bsas gro bo lod: nam snying rdo rje thogs med rtsal bdud loms byin brlabs rdo rje'i mi pa 'i ros byin brlabs gter bdag gli pa zhes sogs gter ston gnyis po sa mong du lung bstan pa de/ yul gyi ming dbyibs dang yab yum rigs rus sogs ni sku mched yin pas tshig 489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)cig gis don gnyis ston la/ spun bdun tshigs sam mtha' ru 'byung: zhes pa'i tshigs te bar du 'byung rgyu gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen dang / mtha' ru 'byung rgyu gcung legs ldan rdo rje/ chu khams lug gam spre'u'i lo zhes pa ni lung bstan rnying pa mang por shed bzhi lo pa rnams phan tshun gdam kha can du snang zhid / khyad par khyi'am 'brug lug gam glang zhes 'byung ba mang bas/ skabs 'dir lug gam glang zhes pa mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi 'khrungs lo dang / spre'u lo ni legs ldan rje'i 'khrungs lo bstan cing / pad+ma rgyal dang / 'od zer ming dang / rdo rje thogs med la dang / gter bdag gling pa rnams ni gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs kyi tshul du lung bstan pa dang / gro bo lod dang / rdo rje'i ming ni gcung legs ldan rje'i lung bstan no/ /gzhan yang rat+na'i spyi lung du/ mnga' ris stod nas u rgyan sprul pa gcig: rdzu snyul ston cing bstan pa'i sgron me spor: zhes dang / pad+ma gling pa'i kun gsal me long sogs gter kha du mar ngo mtshar pa'i lung bstan mang po 'dug kyang yi ge mangs kyi dogs ma bris/ bye brag (11ba)gi lung bstan ni/ legs ldan rdo rje'i rang gter thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings grol gyi lo rgyus rin chen 'phreng bar/ bdag gi smon lam mthu btsan pas: rdo rje bdud 'joms skye ba'i mthar byang sems spre'u'i lo pa cig: las ldan thog phabs tshul du 'byung: de yis 'di 'byin 'gro 'dren 'gyur zhes byung ba ltar/ rig 'dzin chen po mnga' ris pa legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje mtshan gzhan gter ston rdo rje gro lod dam gter ston nyi zla'i mtshan can du grags pa 'di nyid kyis gter kha 'ga' bzhes pa'i dang po ni/ srin mo sbar rjes nas gdan drangs pa'i bla ma bka' brgyad yongs 'dus kyi kha byang don sgron gnad gsal las/ bzhi bcur nye dus thugs gter nges par 'phrad: dngos dang nyams su nga yis dbang bzhi bskur: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bskul ma thengs gsum 'od: de dus the tshom ma byed gnad thems yin: rnam par snang mdzad thugs kyi klong sgrom na bla ma'i sgrub pa yongs 'dus rnam gsum yod: sgra sgrog 'brug gi lo la babs pa'i dus gter bdag bya dkar snyug rgod gtor —490

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)mas mchode: rang nyid dbang drag nga rgyal ldan pa yis bden pa bdar zhing dam bsgrags gnang thems yin: zhes pa ltar/ gcen dang lhan cig par bsam yas dbu rtse rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sgrod lta bu'i dkyil mun pa nag po'i gsang sgrom du rgyas btab pa'i zab gter rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi chos skor dgra bcom pa zung gi lhung bzed kyi nang nas spyan drangs/ zab gter 'di nyid kyi chos bdag ni/spyi lung mdor bsdus snying po las/ 'dir 'dus pad+ma rgyal po nga la nyon (12na skol ldan skyes bu de la 'dud byed bu nye ba'i bu dgu bu mo rnam pa dgu bde ster tshe gsol 'debs byed sbas tshul gcig:zhabs 'degs bde skyod dad ldan rnam pa dgu bzang po chos kyi 'brel thogs khri 'bum gcig ngan 'brel thogs pa'i 'gro ba bdun cu gsum khra mo rigs 'dus byed pa sum cu gcig: rtogasaldan sa bon lam zin brgya rtsa gsum: chos 'dir mos byed bdun phrag nyi shu lnga: mi min 'dul zhing 'gro ba mang du 'byung: skye zhing skye bar byin brlabs bla ma dgu: mngon sum mi mngon brda 'grol mkha' 'gro lnga rje blon 'bangs ra dag ldan 'brel ldan dgu: de dus smon lam stobs kyis 'dzom par 'gyur: zhes sogs mchog dman bar pa mang du 'byung ba'i gtso bo ni/ chos bdag skyes bu 'dud byed rigs lnga ni: zhes pa'i nang tshan/ lha sras sprul pa bongs 'tsham sbrul lo pa: blo sgam snying stobasartsal ldan gdong sme can: sna tshogs ming can 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog: rin chen 'dzin pa nyi gros dus su 'byung zhes pa'i lung zin 'bri gung pa chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs la mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches chos 'di dbu tshugs tsam ma gtogs gnang ma thub/ zhing khams 'pho khar zhal chems su/bsam yas dbu rtse'i byang chub chen po'i sku mdun du kho bo'i rus pa gdan drongs la khyed rang gis dbang rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du long gsung ba ltar rten 'brel sgrig pa mdzad cing / bka' rdzogs lung rdzogs ni gcung legs ldan rdo rje la gsan par mdzad/ gzhan yang legs ldan zhabs kyis rje 'bri gung pa la gter (12bakhi gong 'og gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i chos dpag tu med pa gnang bar 'bri gung pa'i phyis kyi gdung rgyud sogs shes ldan kun la rlung ltar grags kyang / sde pa 491—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()snang rtse ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams bka' brgyad pa der 'dus sogs chos mang po rje 'bri gung pa nas brgyud pa nyams su len bzhin du/des gsan yul gyi mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po brgyud gral nas 'don pa ni rang nyid las 'bras mi shes pa'i nang rtags phyir shar ba'o//gzhan yang chos bdag rigs lnga'i nang wo/chos rgyal khyod sprul me tog ming 'dzan pa dngos las lhag pa'i skyes bu snying stobs can bka' gter chos bdag bong ring lug spre lo:rin chen phyag rten dgongs kyi dus su 'byung:zhes pa'i lung zin 'a zha'i gdung las gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la chos skor 'di rdzogs par gnang /rig 'dzin yongs 'dus 'di nyid kyi chos rgyun 'dzin pa'i sprul pa'i gter ston chen po bzhi 'byung ba'i lung bstan ni/de la 'dud byad sprul pa'i gter ston bzhis:nga yi zab chos dam pa gter nas 'don:zhes pa'i gter ston bzhi ni pad+ma'i rgyal tshab 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa kun dga' dpal bzang /gnas gsar ba mdo sngags gling pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/'phrang mgo gter ston shes rab 'od zer bzhin nges shing /rje mkhyen brtses rten 'brel 'phyugs pas gter kha mang ba zhig ma bzhes kyang /thog ser gyi skor sogs gdams pa ngo mtshar pa po ti gcig tsam zhig spyan drangs pa yin/bdud kyis byin brlabs dam sri'i sprul pa bzhis/gu ru brdzus nas 13na tha ka' yi rkun ma byed:ces pa'i nang tshan gyi gcig snang rtse ba la dogs mod/shes ldan rnams dpyad par 'tshal/u rgyan gling pa'i gter ma'i thang yig tshig sna ring ba las/mtha' dmag dbus 'thibs 'bri dang phag pa la 'thab:dbus gtsang sil bu phag khyu tshal par gas 'on phu stag tshang sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi gzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung:gter ston rdo rje gro lod zhes bya 'byung:zhes pa'i dus rtags ho me sog gis mdo smad la gnod pa byed pa'i mgo tshugs/'bri gung pa nang zhig/sde srid phag mo gru pa'i bstan pa nyams te tshal par song ba sogs shin tu dus 'grig pa la brten/rje legs ldan zhabs kyis 'on bu stag ḍā nas/drag po dbu dgu'i /༷skor yongs su rdzogs pa spyan drangs/chos bdag

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)gi gtso bo gnas gsar ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la gnang / rang gter tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lo rgyus don bsdus gsal ba'i sgron me las/ kyai ho sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skor ma bur bcas par mi spel te: rin chen snying po'i brag logs la: 'chi med lha tshogs rang byon yod: de yi g.yon zur tshe chu'i steng: rin chen 'dra ba'i brag 'og 6 tshe chur bcasate gter du sped: da lta spel ba'i dus ma yin:da nas mi lo stong zin dus dus ngan bcu gsum 'char ba dang 'phags pa'i dpon du lha bzang 'di: spre'u'i lo pa gdong sme can byung nas nyang stod skyong dus su be+e ro'i sprul pa cig byung nas bstan pa'i rim gro byed dus su rten (13ba tshe thal bsgrigs na bod khams 'dir: nyer lnga'i lo ru bod yongs bde: dbon brgyud bcu gsum lugs gnyis skyong: de dang 'di nyid ma phrad na: lha bzang rigs brgyud yid 'dzin 'di: khyi phag lo pa nam mkha'i ming:bongs 'tsham blo sgam dad brtson can: smon lam shugs kyis rgyal srid skyong: pha shul bu yis 'dzin pa yin: de dus mtha' dmag phyogs kun g.yo: sde dbon drug dang gnyen srid sdeb: dbyar dgun dusalog lo bdun 'byung gnyan gyi 'brum bus lo bdun bar bod gyi mi phyed shi nas 'gro: de dusabadag gi thugs rje dang khyed kyi smon lam mtha' btsan pas: bdud 'joms skye ba nyi zla'i ming:drag skyong hur 'grogs brtul zhugs can dug lnga rags la yun thung ba pad+ma'i gnas chen sgo 'byed byed: de dus zab gter 'di dang 'phrad: de yis bod khams lo skor bde: gnyan nad de yi thugasarjes zhi: de dang yon mchod 'dzom pa na nyer lnga'i bar du bod khams bde: zhes pa'i lung bstan gyi don thog tu babs te 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas sgo 'bye bar phebs/sa 'brug zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu'i srod la tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i chos skor ngo mtshar can 'di rin chen snying pos brag nas spyan drangs/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal zhi drag /phyag rdor gyi chos skor sogs gter chos mang du bzhes/ skabs shig bsam yas kyi gnod sbyin chen po tsi dmar ba rgyud 'jam du gtong bar bzhed nas/ has po rir sku mtshams la bzhugs pas chos skyong gis mngon shes 493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)kyis rig nas mi'i khog la dngos su (14na tshe rdugs/ bsam yas mthil pa rnams dmag la bskul te bar chad byed par 'ongs pa na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas chos skyong gan rkyal du 'gyel/ slar ar la gtad pas yun ring po'i bar mi'i khog la 'jug rgyu ma byung / de'i tshe slob dpon chen po dngos su zhal bstan nas/ ngas gtsug lag khang gi srung mar bskos pa la de 'dra ma byed ces mi dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pas/ bcings pa las bkrol te chos skyong chen po mi'i khog tu 'jug thub par gyur/sngar gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes dang rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags lta bu'i nus ldan byung na'ang / dus phyis mthu stobs dang nus pa rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid las lhag pa ni ma byung pa 'dug /sde pa snang rtse nas kyi gter mar grags pa'i zab pa skor bdun gyi lo rgyus lung bstan tu/ zhang blon khra yi mgo can skye ba ni: glo bo ge gar nye ba'i sa phyogs su: legs ldan ming can ban gzugs sngags btsun chas:gter min gter 'dras 'gro ba slu byed cing skal bzang sems dpa' bcu yi snying khrag 'byin: sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi sgo 'byed ces: sems can nyam chung sdug la 'god pa 'byung: zhes bris snang ba ban de dang btsun pa gnyis don gcig cing / ban gzugs zhes pa rab byung gi rtags can du ngos 'dzin dgos pas mnga' ris rig 'dzin dkar chas can yin pas dngos su 'gal/ sngags pa dang rab byung gnyis ka yin pa zhig la sngags btsun zer ba yin gyi/ sngags pa gos dkar can la (14ba)sngags btsun zer ba ni kun la ma grags/ snying khrag 'byin pa rnam snang thugs ka nas dbyings grol gyi chos skor gdan drangs pa la zer rgyu yin na/ gter ston gong ma mang po la yang skyon 'di 'jug cing / ma bton par brtan brdzu byas pa yin na snying khrag 'byin rgyu ci la yod pas/ snying khrag 'byin pa 'di gter min gter 'dra zhes pa yang tshig dngos su 'gal/ gos mo ljongs kyi sgo 'byed dus gangs 'ur gyis mi 'ga' zhig tshe'i dus byas pa la sems can sdug la bkod zer na/ rta'i rgyal po ba la ha'i rgyab nas tshong sprug rnams brul te srin mos zos pa la/ spyan ras gzigs kyis sems cad rnams sdug la bkod zer ram legs par soms shig494

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ (nyanasngon gyi gter ston gong ma rnams kyi gter chos phan tshun zhus dag pher ba tsho yang gter gnas kyi stabs kyis gter srung mi gcig par byung ba la/ nyang rin po ches lho brag phyogs nas bzhes pa'i drag dmar dang / khyed kyis skyid shod phyogs nas brtan pa'i drag dmar gnyis gter srung la khyad mi 'dug pa lkugs pas rigs 'gre byas pa'i dpe kho nar song / zab pa skor bdun gyi rdzun pod der bla med kyi lha rdo rje gro lod dang / bya rgyud kyi lha mi zhabrugs pa dbang chog gcig gis bskur ba sogs/kri ya dang mahā yo ga'i rnam dbye ma phyed pa de 'dra u rgyan rin po che'i gsung yin zer ba 'di las/slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zhabs 'dren pa dang snga 'gyur gyi bstan par rma 'byin tshabs che ba ci zhig dgos/ rang dma' rang gis ma phab na brgya byin gyis kyang ga la phebs zhes dang / seng ge dkar mo'i srog khog pa'i nang gi srin bus (15na tshe/cod pa'i dpe ltar/ 'bri gung dpal 'dzin sogs kyi rig pa rnon por rlom pa'i rtsod pa la lan bzlog tu med pa'i som nyi za ba mi 'dug pas gnod par ma nus kyang / khyod 'dra'i gter ston du brdzus nas rnying ma'i bstan pa 'jig pa'i bdud las stobs ldan la su zhig gis klan ka 'jug par byed de/ go rgyu med pa'i glang chen la/ /rgyal po'i bka' las dbyug pa btsan/ /zhes pa'i don du snang la/ sa dge bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mang po bdud sprul du bstan pas de dag gi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs mkhas grub kyi mdzad pa tsho khyed rang gi ngos nas bdud las su song ba thugs med par gang ste tshu ri la ltos nas pha rir 'jog pa las 'os ci mchis/ rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyis dbus gtsang khams gsum dkrug cing mtshon char 'bebs par bstan pa de ni/ mnga' thang che skabs kyang mdo khams lta ci/ gan pa la mnal lung gtong rgyu cher ma byung ba mchog dman yongs la grags kyang / snang rtse nas rang gi dag snang la byung ba las 'os mi 'dug pas/ de la sde gzar dag snang ma zer dgos par gor 34 66ba/ /lung bstan de tsho'i khrod du/ ser skya'i khab tu shākya don grub ming / bdud sprul mtshan dpes brgyan —495

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)pa'i tshul 'chos mkhan/ /de yi rjes 'brang kun gyi gnyen po mā /lha sbyin snang ba dgu 'gyur 'dus pa'i skor/ /las can gsung sras spre'u lo nam mkha'i ming / /gar gyi dbang phyug de dang 'phrad par shog /zer ba zhig 'ad yod pa 'dra bas/ 'byug ra lung pa mi pham chos rgyal/ gong ra ba nyi zla grags pa/gdong kha mtsho (15ba)byed blo gros rgyal mtshan/ phar tshang bla ma dol pa sogs dpon slob thams cad bka' gros thugs lhus gang things mdzad ya zhu/ rdzun po ta tshe sgrub rgyal ba 'dus pa'i skor la yang skyon mang po 'dug pa rnams yi ge mangs kyi dogs pas 'dir ma bkod/ gter chos la la tshad ldan du snang ba ni/ gu ru jo rtses gter chos mang du spyan drangs kyang shog ser phal cher 'bebs ma thub par ge re lha pa'i phyag tu lus pa nas/ snang rtse dang ge re sku nye yin pa'i stabs kyis de nas khyed kyis bsnams te bdag gir mdzad ces ngag bgros khungs ma las thos/ gtso bor nyid dgongs 'dus kyi gter zhabs sdud par zhal gyis bzhes 'dug pa/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi mtha' rten 'gag 'doms rtsa ba'i chings lnga'i tha ma gter srung bka' bsgo'i chings kyi mjug las/ bdag 'dra pad+ma'i ngag la slu tshig med: chos dang gang zag 'dra min brtag pa gces: khyad par 'brom bza' bdud kyis bslus pa'i mthus: da lta pad+ma nga dang 'brel yod kyang: las kyi dbang gis dgongs 'dus dar ba'i tshe dpe dkar snying zhugs 'dra min gter chos rtsom slu chos phan tshun g.yo ba'i tshul du 'byung: gang 'brel log lam 'dre srin 'byung bar skye: 'byung po'i g.yos dar pad+ma'i chos la gnod 'on kyang las kyi mtha' ni mi stongs pas: skye brgyud tha mar nga yi rjes su 'jug: las kyi sgrib byang smon lam rdzogs pa'i tshe:pad+ma can gyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur: tshe tol ma dag skye bos slar bslus na: nga 'dra nga min bstan pa yun ring spel: gter min gter 'dra gter gyi bstan la gnod: de sogs cho tol bod khams yongs la khyab:(16na〉skru tsam slu na de 'dras bslus nyen yod: 'dra min ma byed dad pa'i rjes 'brang ba: blun por bsam zhing de 'dra'i snod ma yin dad ldan mkhas pa'i mig dang sems la 'phrod bdag 'dra pad+mas snying gtam yi ger bkod: kun kyang gtsug tu yid bzhin thod ltar 'khrur: bkres skom —496

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)gdungs pas bza' btung mthong bzhin spyod: de ltar tshul bzhin spyod pa'i rnal 'byor la: 'dod rgu mis ster bkur sti gzhan gyis byed: 'tsho ba lhas sbyor bsams pa yid bzhin 'grub bdag gzhan don 'bras sangs rgyas bstan pa tshugs:da lta mnga' bdag yab sras 'khor bcas dang ma 'ongs rjes 'jug de ltar sems la chongs: swā mā yā dha thim: zhes pa ni sde pa snang rtse nas nyid kyi lung bstan du dus gsum mkhyen pa u rgyan gyis bka' stsal bar gda' bas bdag rkyen mdzad pa dang / g.yin yang thang yig gi zhig po gling pa'i mtshan la zhal bdag mdzad par 'dug kyang / rat+na'i spyi lung du/ khyung chen ri dang mkhar chu'i zab gter 'don: gsang ba'i mtshan yang zhig po gling pa yin: zhes pa byung bas dog 'tshang mi mdzad pa zhu/gzhan yang nyid kyi rnam thar stod cha thugs rtsom ma snang rtse'i gsung 'bum khrod nas 'khyar ba dar/sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'phel gdung rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i rten skal de gu ru jo rtses gter nas gdan drangs gsungs 'dug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las ma 'das pa'i snga rol tu ma skyes dgras yab gzugs can snying po bkrongs par rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa nas (16ba)bshad pas/ sku skye snga ma dran pa las 'os ma mchis na'ang / gsung rab spyi dang mthun pa legs pas bstan bcos rtsom pa kun khungs gang chod dang / dogs pa byung ba'i rigs la sde pa yangs pa can pa/sde pa spa ra ba sogs stod lung gi nang so rnam pa tshor dri mol mdzad 'tshal lo/ /rig 'dzin chen po sku tshe'i stod la byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu ltar chos phyir dka' spyad lhur len pa gnang / sku che'i mjug tu rje 'bri gung pa chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs yab sras byang pa bdag po dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ 'brug pa sprul sku pad+ma dkar po/ bya pa khri dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje/ zha lu mkhan chen 'a zha mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag 'a zha dbang phyug rab brtan sogs lugs gnyis nas mngon par mtho ba mang pos gtsug gi rgyan du bkur/gnod sbyin tsi dmar bas glags gzhan lta bar ma nus kyang sa skya bdag chen kun dga' rin chen 497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)sogs skye bo du ma'i rgyud brlams nas/ dam rdzas la dge slong 'od zer mtha' yas kyi sha 'dres zer ba'i sgro skur sna tshogs byas/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem la dmigs nas lhad bcug pa'i dgongs 'dus kyi bka' rgya'i lung bstan de legs ldan rje la sbyar nas snang rtse ba phyogs kyis bsgrags/ de dag la brten nas skal dman mang po the tshom gyi gzhir bkod na'ang / mu stegs byed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la bram ze'i bu mo dang mdza' zhes brjod pa dang / sdig blon rnams gyis slob dpon pad+ma mnga' bdag la dug gtong bar 'dug ces sgrog pa lta bu'o/ /sku tshe mthar phyin nas byang theg mchog gling du bzhugs (17na tha zhin pa'i ngang nas snyun gzhi ye med par zhing khams gzhan du 'pho ba'i tshul bstan par/ sa skya bdag chen sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ khong gi mthu yin zhes dril rgya cher bsgrags na'ang nam mkha'i 'ja' tshone lta bu ste/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la yang mthus nus pa ma thengs par brten/ sa skya bdag po dang sde pa gdong kha ba sogs rtse gcig par dmag bshams nas bkrong rtsis mdzad kyang chos skyong gi nus pas glags ma khel de'i dus rje btsun kha'u pa chen po mthu stobs kyi dbang phyugs de seng ge la chibs nas zhal gzigs pa'i gzigs snang bstod pa bdud dpung phyer 'thag ma mdzad pa yin/ de ni rat+na'i bstan pa spyi lung du/ sa yi phyogs su bla mas slob ma slu: zhes pa'i dus rtags su gsal te bdag po sngags 'chang ba sku gzhon dus khong la tshar chen gyis bla ma mchod pa'i lung gsan par snang ngo / /sa skya bdag pos pu tra'i las sbyor gyi sgo nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs bsgral ba yin gsung ba ltar na/ pu tras sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi spyan sngar bstan 'dzin sgrol zhing bstan pa la rma 'byin mkhan rnams kyi grogs byed par khas blangs pa las 'os ci yod/ des na 'jig rten khams kyi grongs chad byung ba thams cad sa skya bdag po'i mthu yin par gda' bas/ khungs med kyi mgon po drug cu par grags pa'i zan gyi phung pos khyi rgan rnams kyi lto ba yongs su gang bar gyur/bdag po 'di pa'i mdzad tshul la dpags na/ gter ston byang chub gling pa'i thugs gter 'khor 'das —498

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ zhenarang grol gyi zhu lan gsal (17ba tha'i sgron me las/ mnga' ris gdug pa'i dmag 'go g.yo:'khon rigs kun zhes bya bas zhabrug: khol bur sdug bsngal cung zad skyed: ces dang / gter kha de ga'i lung bstan gsal ba'i shogs dril du/ dus lnga bcu kha ral la nyer song ba'i dus su rgyal po nyid kyi gdung rgyud kyang nyams te: mang yul gung thang gangs ri'i 'dabs kyi bu sdug bsngal bar 'gyur:de dus nas bzung stod smad rim gyis 'byug par 'gyur: dbus phyogs su gnas dgon dud 'gro'i ming can sum cu dar grom pa sa zhes bya ba nga min nga 'dra'i cha lugs can gyi bdud kyi sprul pas 'dzin: de rnams yong ba'i ltas su nyi zla la dgra yang yang yong: nam mkha' la sprin dang khu rlangs mdog mi sdug pas khengs nas 'od mi gsal: gza' skar gdug pa can 'char: zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dus rtags/ dgon pa gsum ni/ 'bri gung / stag lung / 'brug gsum yin par mngon/ /dus phyis kyi sa skya'i gdung rgyud gcig la bdag po 'di sde gzar slong ba'i mdzad pa mang bas 'grig gam snyam/ gab rgya can gyi lung bstan de ni grags pa'i mtshan can gyi gdung rgyud snga phyi mang du byung 'dug pas/ lung bstan dang lung bstan yul gyi gang zag gnyis rten 'brel 'phyugs pa min la che/ gang ltar blo ldan rnams kyis dpyad par 'tshal/ dbyar dus chu 'dzin dbus nas 'brug gi sgra/ /dal bu sgrog tshe rma bya gar byed na/ /ngo mtshar lung khungs bsgrigs pa'i gtam rgyud kyis/ /blo gsal skye bo'i brtan pa cis mi 'phrog /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs sras sna nam pa/ slar yang rig sngags 'chang ba'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /zab gter/ (18na〉bstan pa rgyas phyir sgyur ba la/ /rgod kyi ldem phru can zhes grags snyan dkar/ /'khor 'das srid zhi'i legs tshogs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skal ldan 'gro la ster mdzad rig sngags 'chang / /nus pas bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms so zhes/ /mthu stobs rdo rje gdengs mdzad mnga' ris pa/ /gang gi mdzad bzang nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs lhung brag ris gnas pa'i 'byung po'i bya/ /long yang gzur gnas dpyid kyi pho lha'i tshogs/ /dga' ba'i 'phur lding rtsed 'jo byed la brel/ /499

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)de ltar skyes rabs kyi 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba'i rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i gdung ni/ rgya nag gong ma'i khri la gnam gyis bskos pa'i mi nyag si'u rgyal po nas rim par brgyud pa'i rigs las mi lhag seng ge dar/ de'i sras rdo rje dpal/ 'dis rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhags la thugade'i sras dkon mchog pa/ de la sras gsum byung ba'i 'bum sdes rje btsun sa paṇa gyi sbyin bdag mdzad/ 'di la sras gsum byung ba'i yon btsun gyis sa skya pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ gong nas si tu'i las ka gnang / ngam ring gi chos sde btsugs/ de'i sras mgon po rdo rjes yab mes kyi srol bzung /tshogs sde bzhi'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ de la sras drug las nam mkha' bstan pas gong du byon pas stag mgo nor bu gsum pa dang / gu'i gung gi mtshan dang / shel gyi tho shu rnams gnang / slar ta dben gu lha'i mig dang shel gyi dam kha blangs/ 'di nyid mkhyen pa che bar grags kyang gong ma sde srid rin po che ta'i si tu'i bka' chems las/ sngon tshe dpal (18ba/rdon sa skya pa/ /mnga' thang dgung la reg pa'i dus/ /dpon chen nam mkha' bstan pa de/ /na sogazhone pas lan pa dang / /zhes pa ltar na/ dpon chen 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa ma legs pas sa skya par gnod pa 'dra/de'i sras gnyis las che ba rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis chen po'i las ka bzung / spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par grags/ 'di'i sras snga tshar dgu'i gung chos grags dpal bzang gis si tu chang gu'i las ka blangs/ de'i sras gcen rnam rgyal grags bzang dang gcung dkon mchog legs pa gnyis las/ gcen gyis ta'i si tu'i las ka blangs/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa phul du phyin pas rgyal po paṇ+ḍita ra grags/ de'i sras nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje/ de la sras nam mkha' rin chen/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' legs pa dang gsum las 'bring po rab tu byung / mched gnyis kyi sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' rin chen/ bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs las/ dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde ni mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi sku'i skye ba yin la/ mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che ni bsam pa lhun grub ma'i phyi sgrub yon tan gter mdzod las/ 'di nas tshe lo lnga bcu kha —500

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)ral dus: nga yi thugs rjes sprul pa'i rigs 'dzin ni:pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal:phyi ltar rab byung sngags pa'i cha lugs can: nang ltar sems skyed bstan pa'i bya bar brtson: gsang ba gnyis med rdzogs chen don dang ldan: chos rgyal yab sras mtsho rgyal smon lam gyis: sprul pa'i gzugs gyis ma 'gags spyod pa skyong: de 'dra'i gang zag nub kyi phyogs nas 'ong: zhes dang / bde gshegs (19na)rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i chos: gter nas 'byin pa'i skyes bu rdo 'phrul can:pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal: mnga' ris gtsang gi phyogs nas glog bzhin 'khyug /dbus gtsang lho yi phyogs su 'brug bzhin bsgrags: khams yul rgya yi yul du grags pa ni: lus la rtags kyi rdo rje spyi bor shar: rgya gram 'phrin las phyag gi mthil na gsal:spyan mig chos kyi 'khor los phyag zhabs spras: 'joms byed rnyu gi yi ge rkang la mngon: lte ba bum pa'i phyag rgya sme bas brgyan spyod pa ma nges thogs med rlung ltar rgyu: ting 'dzin mi g.yo rdo rje lta bur brtan/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul rgyun chad med: u rgyan nga dang rtag tu bka' gros 'chang: zhes dang / g.yin yang gter kha gong 'og sogs khungs btsun mang po nas lung gis zin pa ste/ de yang mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che nyid gter gsar gyi nang bzhin sku tshe'i rten 'brel ma 'grig par brten/ /myur du sku'i skye ba bzhes tshul sogs nye gnas rin rdor bas thog drangs sku 'khor pa rnams la khrom bsgrags su gsungs pa dang mthun par/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po nyid kyis rang gter gyi thog ma/ dpal bsam yas ārla pa lo'i gling nas myong grol pad+ma rā ga dang lhan cig byon pa gter kha spyi la gces pa'i zhal gdams las/mtha' yas sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag: rin chen mtsho gling pad+ma'i sdong po la: rang byung mtshan ldan sku ru smin pa'i tshe: thugs rje chen pos lung bstan khyad par du: kha ba can du 'gro don rten 'brel 'grig: mkhan slob zhal 'dzom khri srong dgongs pa bkang: da lta bod yul dam (19ba〉rtos nyi 'od gdal lan cig lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa'i tshe: 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyob byed thugs rje'i gter:brgya dang rtsa brgyad bye ba sar sbas kyang: nyi shu rtsa lnga khyad par thugs gter lnga: da lde mgo nag spyi yi —501—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)rgyal po khyod: smon lam dag pa'i skye ba rnam lngas 'don: dam rdzas 'di dang phrad pa'i skyes bu de skye ba du mar zab gter la spyad pa'i: sku yi gzi brjid mtshan rtags bcu gsum ldan: bden pa'i ngag 'grub sgra dbyangs tshangs pa'i gsung: thugs kyi byin rlab dgongs pa'i gting dpag dka' bdag dang rgyal po'i yon tan sprul pa de 'phrin las rnam pa lnga la rang dbang spyod: da lta'i btsun mo bdud blon dam sel gyis: bar gcod log pa'i lam du ma shor na 'di nas nub phyogs mi nyag rto shing gi rgyal rigs khyi'am 'brug gi lo par skye gal te btsun mos bar gcod dbang btsan na: de yi blon rigs bya spre lo par 'gyur dang po'i rten 'brel ma log skyed byed ni: da lta shud bu dpal gyi seng ge 'di: smon lam bden pa'i skye rgyud mang du 'brel: yun du mi 'grogs blon rigs skyes pa na:pha ltar brtse zhing 'phrin las spel bar byed btsan phran blon po'i rigs su thal ba na: skyed byed ma ni nyang ban rigs ma mchog ma btsas tshe yi dus byed sgra dang 'od: ltas dang bcas nasang khams 'pho tshul ston:yab kyi 'brel pa ma bzung yun ring 'grogs: sbas pa'i tshul de sngon 'brel bag chags can: smon lam mthu btsan yum ni da lta yi: dngos dang dngos 'dra sprul ba'i 'od zer 'gyed:lo tsā'i sras bzung rten 'brel smon lam gyis: bcu gsum lor 'grogs sras rgyud mnga' (20na)thang can/ dam sri bdud mo'i bar chad dbang song na: yul phyogs der yang mi rung ltas ngan pa: nyi zla dus min gzas bzung 'byung ba 'khrug: sa yi bcud nyams mu ge nad rims dang: dmag dang 'khrug rtsod dus ngan spyod pa dang: zhes pa'i don/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan khyed kyi smon lam dag pa'i skye ba lngas zab gter spyan 'dren par mdzad pa'i skabs las/ slob dpon chen po dang mnga' bdag gnyis thun mong du sku'i sprul pa nyang rin po che nyi ma 'od zer/ gsung gi sprul pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug /thugs kyi sprul pa mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje/ yon tan gyi sprul pa chos rgyal dbang po'i sde yin la/ de nyid rten 'brel ma 'phyugs na mi nyag rtswa shing gi rgyal rigs khyi'am 'brug gi lo par skye/ rten 'brel ma 'grig na rgyal rgyud de'i blon po'i rigs byang khang gsar ba'i bu bya spre lo par —502

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)skye/ de'i tshe bu ma btsas gong nas pha mi 'tsho/ rgyal rigs su skyes na pha dang yun ring du 'grogs par bshad/ chos rgyal 'di nyid mya ngan las 'das nas ri zhig zangs mdog dpal rir bzhugs/ slar dus babs su phebs rgyu'i skye ba ni/ 'phrin las kyi sprul pa 'byung bar bshad pa de yin la/ de nyid slar 'byung rgyu yin pas zab gter spyan 'dren pa sogs 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad par gsal/ don 'di ma go bar blun po phyogs lhung can mang po dag gis/ byang bdag pos smon lam log par btab nas sde pa gtsang pa'i bur skye ba blangs pa yin zer ba ni/ gtsang pa'i rgyal po ga me bstan skyong dbang po de rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa 'gangs che lugs la dpags na skyes bu dam pa zhig yin shas che yang /grub mtha'i (20ba)gtso bo gsang sngags rnying ma la mi mdzad la/ rnying lugs kyi chos skor cung zad mdzad pa rnams kyang sde pa snang rtse ba'i phyogs 'ba' zhig yin 'dug cing / gter 'don pa dang 'don pa'i sta gon tsam yang lta ci smos/ 'don rgyu byung na dgongs pa'i mos dung tsam yang med par snang bas/chos rgyal 'di nyid kyi bag chags ma sad pa ni lung rigs thams cad kyis 'grub/ la la dag blun gtam gyi rjes su 'brangs nas rang bzo'i lung bstan du/ bdag chen skye ba'i bstan pa mtha' nas sdud/ zer pa ni rang nyid gsal bar ston pa'i me long ngo / /gzhan yang shing rin po che sogs kyi skye rgyud kyi khungs ni/ rtogs ched du/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis bskyed chos kyi dbang / /'dod chags rdo rje za byed sprul pa'i bu pad+ma rgyal po'i byin rlabs 'od zer las: bkra shis dbang gi ming can rgyud me tog: ces dang / 'phrang mgo gter ston pa'i lung bstan du/ mnga' bdag rgyal po mchims kyi mda' ru 'byung:zhes dang / lung bstan kun gsal las/ gang bzang mgul du me tog babs pa'i dus: zhes pas kyang shes so/ /gzigs snang nyid khams gsal bar shing pho rta lo hor zla bcu pa'i tshes dgu'i tho rangs kyi char bsam yas su phebs te gnas gzhi yangs su ma song ba la lhun po gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa chung du ma song ba zhig maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du 'bul ba mdzad ba'i tshe/ rnam smin sgyu lus kyi bag chags 'gags te/ sku me tog gi (21na sgom —503

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)par shar tshul gsung ba yang dpyad gzhi che bar 'dug go /de yang thog mar byang pa rigs ldan chen po nam mkha' rin chen gyi sras su sku bltams nas na tshod phra mo'i dus kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang gos bzang po/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas bkur ba dang bcas gces par bzung / sku tshe'i stod smad bar gsum du chos phyir yongs 'dzin gyi bla ma 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog /dus zhabs pa shākya dpal ba/ lo chen rat+na bha dra/ nub dgon pa chen po mnyam med byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mchog gi sprul sku mnga' ris pa legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras po pad+ma chos rgyal/ so ston legs ldan rdo rje/ rgyal sras lha rje'i rnam 'phrul rje 'bri gung pa chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rgyal sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnas/ gter ston shes rab 'od zer/ rdo ring pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan/ bdag chen bsod nams dbang po/ bla ma ṭi bo rin po che/ bka' bzhi tshul khrims 'gyur med/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po sogs ris med kyi dam pa du ma la chos kyi gsan pa rgya cher mjad/ gtso bor rang gter las/ sngon du byung ba'i zab gter mtha' dag gi bka' babasa'abyung gi mi nub rgyal mtshan chugs: zhes pa ltar/ gter ston brgya rtsa'i gsol 'debs ji ltar mdzad pa'i (21bskong bzhin/ dbang 'khrid lung man ngag gi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang bar gnang / tha snyad kyi rig pa la yang mkhyen pa'i spyan mchog yangs/ rang gter sku gsum rigs bsdus kyi lung bstan las/ dbang drag rgyas dang zhi ba mchog 'grub pa'i rtags rnams rim gsal bzhin du 'gro don mdzad ches pa'i don ltar/ la stod byang gi rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i dus/ rgya dkar nag hor stod smad sogs kyi spyad dngos rngam che ba mang po dang / gter rdzas dam rdzas kyi rigs bgrang yas pa phyag tu 'byor ba ni lung bstan gyi nang gi dbang gi 'phrin las 'grub pa'i skabs/ de rjes drag po'i 'phrin las ni/ mnga' thang can la gter gyi skal ba med ces pa ltar/ snying po med pa'i rgyal srid spangs nas gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol bar rkyen ngan —504

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)lam du lhongs pa yin pas de'i tshul ni 'phrang 'go gter ston gyi rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul gyi bskyed rdzogs 'khrul med tsit+ta dmar po las/ lnga brgya tha ma dus kyi snyigs ma la: shārnyi'i ming 'dzin bdud kyi bar chad kyis: mnga' ris phyogs nas hor gyi mnan pa 'don ha la 'jig gis ngam ring bar du 'joms byang gi dam rar bdud srin 'og nas slong: sa bdag nam mkha'i snying la bar chad 'jug: de dus byang gi ri nag brgya gsum rtser pad+ma mtshan brgyad gtsug lag brgya gsum re brtsigs na byang phyogs rgyal po mnga' thang rgyas: zhes pa ltar/ bdag po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs kyi snying la bar chad zhugs pa yin la/ zhugs tshul ni/ rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi spyi lung las (22na)'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su bdud mo rno myur nag mo la: bu dgu skyes nas 'dzam gling 'joms: khyad par bod yul gangs can 'dir: ma 'ongs bzhi bcur nye dus su: bdud sprul dgu dang sdig blon dgu btsun mo phyi nang las byed dgu 'bangs 'phrin dbu gtso dmag dpon dgu:dgu dgu brgyad cu gya gcig gis: 'gro kun ka lo thur du 'khrid: ces spyir sems can gyi bde skyid 'joms pa la bdud sprul spun dgu yang sprul gyi tshul du yang yang 'byung bar gsungs pa las/ zhing shag tshe brtan rdo rje la bu dam sri'i sprul pa spun dgu byung zhing / spun dgu'i gtso bo kun spangs lha dbang rdo rje ste/ zhing shag pa pha bu rnams dang byang pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs 'brel btags byas nas rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid dbus phyogs su gnas dbyung ba sogs zhabs 'dren chen po byas par brten/ ma rungs pa de dag drag po'i sgo nas btul te rjes su 'dzin dgos pa'i gdul byar mkhyen nas/ 'phyong rgyas dang 'bri gung sogs su bzhugs skabs 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skor mang po dang / khyab 'jug gza'i sbu gri sogs drag sngags kyi las sbyor du ma'i sgo nas ring por ma lon par dgra bo rnams 'chi bdag gi khar 'dud par mdzad cing / mthu stobs dang nus pa la gzhan gyis 'gran zla dang bral ba yin pas/ rat+na'i gter lung du/ rgyal po'i ming can mthu stobs bdag bo 'byung: zhes dang / rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul las/ 'di la cho seb dag skyes bu stag lo pa: rgyal —503—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)po'i ming 'dzin sngags 'chang mthu stobs can tshangs skud rdo rje sme bas spras pa dang (22bkrokhi 'byung ba ltar 'phrang 'go gter ston rin po che'i chos bdag tu ngos bzung la/ lo tshigs cung zad ma 'grig pa ni gter kha mang por gang zag gcig la lo bdag 'dem kha can snang bas skye srid 'dzin pa rten 'brel gyi dbang gis snga phyi sna tshogs 'byung ba la dgongs so/ /dbus su phebs skabs zhid shag pas snying tshim gyi yi ger/ stobs zhes bya ba'i stobs med 'khyams po khyod/ kho bos pre ta pu ra'i 'gram du bskrad/ zhes bkur ba'i lan du/ zhing zhes bya ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba khyod/ /bdag gis rā hu la yi zhal du gdab/ /ces gsungs 'dug pa ltar/ sku mdun du zhing khyab 'jug gza'i zer khas grongs pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan skor rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras po pad+ma chos rgyal la 'bul ba gnang 'dug pa 'di lta ste/ zhabs drung rgyal ba'i sras po gang gi zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/deng dus kyang sku rin po che mchog tu dwangs ngos de khar phebs yod 'dug pa bka' drin che/rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gzigs pas bslu med cing / /rig 'dzin mchog gi 'da' kha rdo rje'i gsung / /ches cher dam la bzhag pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /rā hu la de bdag gi bran ltar gyur/ /snga nas mi dge'i bag chags yongs brtas pas/ /dge byed la sdang tshul min log spyod mkhan/ /zhing zhes zhing bcu tshang ba'i snying khrag de/ /mthu ldan gza' mchog chen pos mod la bzhes/ khengs par spyod pa'i 'khor tshogs mang po'i dbus/ /dkar nag phyogs kyi nyams 'jug dus kyi tshe/ khyab 'jug yab yum sras 'khor pho lhar bcas/ /phyogs der rngam stabs shugs kyis myur bar 'ongs/ /de yi mod (23na)la gzi brjid dug gzer gyis/ /rengs dang rmongs pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang / /kha nas mi bzad gdung ba'i skad dang bcas/ /dmyal bar rings pa bzhin du sa la lhung / /dgra gnyen bar mar spyod pa'i 'khor de dag /'di lta'i tshul ni rang gi bden med kyis/ /rin du byas te nyos pa'i dpe bzhin no/ /de ni sngags nag de yi mthu yin no/ /zhes zer la la yid dga' shub bur smra/ /bu dang chung ma mya ngan 'khor tshogs rnams/ /stabs bur spyod pas sdug bsngal myong de la/ /'byud bzhin cho nge drag po —506

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)'debs par gyur/ /cho nge'i sgra ni 'bod pa'i dung bzhin du/ /yul der gnas pa'i mtha' dag skye bo'i tshogs/ /kun kyang tshul de mthong bas so ma nyi bral/ /sngags pa dgrar bslang 'di ltar yong zhes smras/ /de nas gnyen grogs rnams kyi brtse sems kyis/ /gso rig pa dang tshul 'di'i rig byed mkhan/ khur 'dzin de dag rnams kyis shes bya'i khyon/ /dus der 'os pa'i blun rmongs 'ga' tshogs nas/ /ngan 'gror spyod pa'i sdug bsngal slob pa bzhin/ /hūṃ phaṭa drag po'i sgra dang thun sna tshogs/ tsha grang myong la gsod mda' ji bzhin du/ /me chu'i lcag gis yang yang 'debs la brtson/ /yang der rang rigs rjes 'jug zha lu pas/ /sna tshogs rten 'brel zab mo'i cho ga yis/ /skabs skabs cung zad smra dang sdug bsngal dag /myong bar shes pa zhag 'ga'i bar du byung / /de dus de yis sems la 'gyu ba'i tshogs/ /srid pa'i bde bar chen dang de 'brel ba'i/ /sdug bsngal dag la gzugs su byas pa na/ /lhun po la yang 'gran par gdon mi za/ /skabs der nye grogs rnams dang lhan cig par/ /sngon du thal ba'i las tshogs rnams dran te/ /(23ba tshe lo da bzhin dug las bdud rtsir 'dod pa ltar/ /bdag la srung ba slongs zer gleng ba thos/ /de nas 'gyu ba'i tshes la slad nas kyang / /srid gsum bdag pos ming gi lhag mar mdzad/ /bden pa bslu med ston pa'i dus de'i tshe/ /ji lta'i tshul ltar 'dir ni mngon sum gsal/ /rig sngags drag po sgrub pa'i sa khung du/ /ling ga dag la drod phebs tshal par gas/ kha ling mer 'bar gzhan yang mtshan ma ni/ /dngos nyams ji snyed mthong nas gtang rag phul/ /de rjes pho nya'i gtam snyan 'phreng ba dag /legs thos 'di lta'i tshul ni da dung yang / /bdag nyid bden tshig ches btsan lo khongs su/ /g.yin dag la yang gzigs pa gnang 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogasalog spyod skye bo'i yul dag tu/ /dpyid dus grang reg spyod la nye skabs kyang / /gnam lcags drag po'i thog gis bsnun pa dang / /gtsug lag khang la rdzu 'phrul me 'bar zhing / /bdag la mtho 'tsham dpung tshogs rnams la yang / /phyi log dus su sum cur nye ba'i grangs/ /gdong thug brgyab sogs zhib cha nang mchis pa/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i snyan du gsan nges sam/ /'di dag rang stobs ci zhig u rgyan —507

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)rje'i/ /thugs rje'i 'jug pa dag dang khyad par du/ /bka' drin mnyam med rig 'dzin mchog de yis/ /ma 'ongs dus mkhyen dam bzhag byin rlabs dang / /sel med dam tshig gces spras snying ltar bcangs /'gyod med bden pa'i ri bo rgyab tu khur/ /g.yel med chos skyong srung ma mchod la brtson/ /dgra med rang gnas myur du 'dzin par smon/ /zhes skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du bka' drin gzhal bar dka' ba'i yongs 'dzin dam pa bka' drin can gyi zhal skyin gang der dad pa mchog gis khyed nyid dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du dgongs/ ci bder nyams dgar phul/ zhes so/ /(24na)de dus kyi las sbyor gyi dam sel gyi 'tshub lhongs brgyud 'dzin tshor yang byung bas/ dus phyis rig 'dzin yol mo ba bstan 'dzin nor bus gzhis ka rtser gtor zlog mdzad skabs kyang thog ser babs te khyab 'jug gza'i 'khu bzlog byung bar snang / rgyas pa'i 'phrin las kyi skabs ni/ 'bri gung zhabs drung yab sras/ sde pa 'phyong rgyas pa hor mi dbang stobs rgyal dang / hor ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa 'jig rten dga' ba'i rgyan sde pa yar rgyab pa/ skyid shod nas sa skyong g.yul rgyal nor bu/dga' ldan pho brang gi dpon gnyer lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen dpyod can sku mdun chos bzang 'phrin las/ sde pa thob rgyal ba/ sde pa snye mo ba/ bar khams kyi sde pa ka nam pa rgya ha ka rang ling rtse'i rgyal po sogs stobs ldan chen po mang po'i ti lhar gyur/ snang gsal chos rje kun dga' tshe mchog /lha gro chos rje ga rma gu sa ka thog chos rjes thog drangs snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi rig sngags 'chang ba bgrang bar dka' ba dang / grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma mtha' yas pas zhabs la btud de/ rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar gyur/ zhi ba'i 'phrin las ni/ spyir nad gdon sogs zhi ba dang / sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa zhi ba gnyis byung ba las/ skabs 'dir zhi ba de dang po la bsnyag dgos te/ mchog grub pa zhes pa'i tshig gis rjes ma bstan pas so/ /de yang sku tshe'i mjug tu sbyin bdag gi mthil 'phyong rgyas dang yar rgyab gnyis su phal cher bzhugs nas/ sbyin bdag dang gdul bya mchog dman rnams kyi bar chad sel zhing chos dang srid kyi —508

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)'dod pa'i don gyi re ba skong bar mdzad do/ /'phyong rgyas stag rtse'i gzims chung tshe ring pho brang du/dag pa'i snang bar rgyal (24ba)sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnas phebs nas/ lta ba'i skor gyi bka' gnad mang po dri ba dris bshad kyi tshul du gsungs/ yang sprul la smin drug zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi dus/ chu bo gser ldan gyi lho ngos don 'grub gling gi sgar du/ mnal lam 'od gsal du shar bar/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar can dang / de nas zhag lnga song ba'i tshe rje grub pa'i dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs tshul sogs gzigs snang gi skor rnams gsung 'bum du gsal/ mchog gi dngos grub 'grub pa ni rig 'dzin chen po nyid nges pa'i don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mthar phyin par ma zad/ thun mong ba'i snang ngor sku tshe 'di nyid la rdzogs pa chen por thos bsam sgom pa nan tan du mdzad pas rtogs pa klong du gyur te grub pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar ba mang du bstan cing / gtso bor thugs sras rig 'dzin sku mched la zab chos rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ba dang / skal ldan gyi gdul bya mang po kun bzang dgongs pa zangs thal/'jam dpal rdzogs chen/ yang tig gcis sgron sogs kyi sgo nas smin grol la bkod pa'i tshul rnams kyis shes par nus so/ /mdzad pa'i gtso bo zab gter spyan drangs tshul ni/ rang gter las/ gter chos pad+ma'i gsung dang ma phrad na: bcu bzhi pa la tshe yi bar chad 'byung: de dus bar chad bdud dbang ma gyur na: rang gter zab mo'i skal ba nges par 'byin: zhes pa'i don ltar sku na phra mo'i dus rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gis/ thod 'phreng rtsal gyi dkyil 'khor du zlum po bzhi dbang gi sgo nas smin par mdzad pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ gtsang rong chung gi sbas yul kham bu lung nas hor sog mtha' dmag zlog thabs dme gu ru'i skor dang / slob dpon chen (25na)pos 'dud rigs dam la btags pa'i brag lhang lhang ma'i mtshams phug dge ba'i dben gnas nas mtsho skyes rdo rje'i skor spyan drangs pa ste/ de yang bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje la rigs gsum yod pa'i/ dang po mnga' bdag nyang gis lho brag phyogs nas spyan —509

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)drangs/ phyi ma sangs rgyas gling pas dwags po sger bye ma dkar po nas spyan drangs/ bar pa chos dbang rin po che'i gter kha bcu bdun pa'i gter zhabs yin pa rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyis spyan drangs pa ste/ rang gter 'chi med tshe'i don dbang gi gtad rgya'i skabs las/ rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag gnyis kyi mtshams rong mdo chu bo chen po rgyug pa'i 'gram sa khams khyi 'brug lo pa snying rje can: drag shul cho rol spyod pa rigs bzhi'i rtags: dkar dmar sme ba sbrul gyi mgo bo can lag g.yas drag po mtshon cha'i ri mo gsal lto ba bum pa'i dbyibs la sme bas mtshan: mkha' 'gro dbang sdud brla g.yon sme ba'i spyan: zhi 'grub rkang g.yon ri mo pad+mas mtshan: rtags dang ldan pa'i skyes bu de dang phrad ces pa byung la/ gzhan yang bsam yas ārla pa le'i gling nas dam rdzas myong grol dang lung bstan gyi skor/ lho brag 'jong pa gser gyi mchod rten nas ma rgyud rnya ang po don gsum/ man ngag thor bu dang phur pa dam rdzas kyi rigs/ gtsang nyang stod dang / khams kyi klong thang sgrol ma'i ka gzhu'i 'chol sogs nas zab gter mang du spyan drangs/ gter thams cad ngo mtshar yid ches kyi gnas 'ba' zhig tu byung bas/ tshe dbang gi che rjod kyi skabs gter lung gi 'phros las/ khyad par 'di nyid nyams su blangs pa na: tshe 'phrang sgrol zhing tshe yi tshad las bsring dbang bskur lan res lo re'i tshe spel 'gyur (25ba tha rgya dang nyer gcig dbang thob skal ba can bdag dang dbyer med byin rlabs mchog thog 'gyur: zhes pa ltar ro/ /lung bstan ltar lhang lhang ma'i gter gsar gyi shog ser rnams kong po rgya lar 'bebs pa gnang ba dang / rgya la rang nas kyang bod khams spyi la phan pa'i mtha' dmag zlog thabs kyi las tshogs kyi gter bzhes rgyu yod pa nas kong por phebs/ de'i dus rtse lha snang du ga me ba dbang phyug rdo rje bzhugs pa'i kur srid gra 'grig cing dbang che/ grub mtha' mi gcig pa'i rigs mtha' dag la 'jam rtsub sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas 'dul thabs lhur mdzad pa'i skabs yin 'dug pas/ kong yul 'di gsang sngags rnying nga ma la mos pa'i stabs kyis 'phrin las rgya cher byung dogs pa'i phrag dog gis mtho gnon dang /—510

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)sgar gtsang mchod yon thun mong la ngan gtad rba dong la brgyab dogs pa'i 'jigs snang phan tshun 'gran bzhin pa la brten/ skyon gnon pa mngags te gter gnas kyi phyogs su ye 'byon ma bcug pas/ gter srung khros pa'i 'tshub dang / gter lung du/ de dus drag po'i ltas cig 'byung: zhes gter gsar gyi shog ser kong po rgya lar 'bebs pa la 'tshub 'ong bar gsungs pa'i 'tshub 'gyur gnyis ka 'dom pa'i nus pas/ ri phan tshun nyil pa'i sne 'grig pas gtsang po'i rgyun lam 'gags te grong khyer mang po chur nub/ dpon slob rnams kyang re zhig gyen du bros pas sa sros te phebs ma thub pas chu mtshams su chos dbang rin po che'i gter ma'i drag sngags 'dus pa'i lcags phur btab pas/ mtshan mo'i bar der chus kyang sa mtshams las ma bsgral/ nam langs nas phur pa btan te phebs pa na 'bros 'ded ltar chu gyen la lud/ de nas gtor zor 'phangs (26na skong bden pa brjod pas/gtsang po'i lam bye nas chu sngar bshul du song ste/ 'gro ba rnams la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa stsal/rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyis bden stobs ma brjod na/ 'di skabs kyang chos rje ga rma pa'i bka' drin la brten nas kong po rnams chu'i 'jigs pas stongs rgyu yin par snang / byang bdag pos yar rgyab gtsang po zhag bdun gyi bar du gyen la slog zer ba'i grags pas/ byang gtsang gi dam nyams lhag lus pa rnams kyang snying rtsa 'dar bar gyur to/ /bla rdzogs thugs gsum tshang ba'i gter kha che ba zhig thag la 'phred nas bzhes rgyu yod pa/ sde ba gtsang stod pa sogs kyi stabs nas spyan 'dren ma thub par rten 'brel 'byugs pas/ rang gter du/lnga bcu rtsa gsum tshe'i yi 'phrang la gzab: ces pa'i lung bstan gyi don thog tu bab par brten re zhig 'gro don gzhan du che bar dgongs te gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas zangs mdog dpal gyi rir gshegs pa yin la/ gcan gzan dregs pa'i ro la seng ge mi 'jigs pa ltar sngags rlom gzhan gyis pad+ma'i rgyal tshab 'di nyid la glag lta bar ga la nus kyang / yol ba bla chen gyis brtsams pa'i mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros kyi rnam thar du/ byang bdag pos 'phyong rgyas pa'i sku rim mdzad par —511—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)brten/ yar lungs bkra shis rtse phyogs kyi mthu kha zug nas zhabs drung bdag mo gshegs pa yin tshul gyi rgyu mtshan mang po bris pa'i mjug tu/ sngags rgyud sbyor bas dman yang snang shas kyis/ /drag shul cho ga'i lad mo zlos pa dag /rang nyid rings par chas pa gshin rje'i grong / yil ba'i grogs su spro bas sgron pa bzhin/ zhes smad par snang ba ni rten 'brel 'grig (26ba〉5 'grig sogs lung bstan gyi don ma go ba'i mu cor gyi gto du snang ngo / /sa la spyod pa'i gnam gyi tshangs pa che/ shar phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba mi nyag gi /gdung las rigs ldan rim pa byon pa'i lha/ /nor bu'i 'phreng ba ji bzhin 'dzad med ring / khungs btsun rigs kyis mtho ba'i dung dkar po/ /legs byas bkra shis ri mo g.yas 'khyil ba/ /bsod nams stobs 'byor dar ba'i snyan pa'i sgra/ /'dzam gling kun la khyab par bsgrags 'di rgyal/ /byang rigs gdung gi rnyog bral rdzing bu'i nang / khri srong sprul pa'i zlos gar zla ba'i gzugs/ shar tshe snga 'gyur bstan pa'i ku mu da/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'dzum phreng ches cher g.yo/ /de ltar chos rgyal dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde drag po stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' pho zhes yongs su grags pa gang gi thugs sras rig 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po ni/ sngar chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi byang theg mchog gling du rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po la zab chos mang du gsan pa'i kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal gyi bar do lnga'i snyan brgyud gsung ba'i skabs mdzad pa tha ma ston par bzhed pa'i gsung gya ma do 'dra thod rgal du byon pas/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes chos gral gyi dbus su bzhengs te thal mo sbyar nas/rab tu mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs pa dang / gal srid zhing khams 'pho bar bzhed na mchog gi sprul sku myur du phebs dgos zhes nan gyis gsol ba btab pas/ nga da res bsdad pas yong ba med/khyed de tsam gyi rtsigs che na bdag po rang gi bur skye ba len no zhes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung (27na)'gyur ba med par brten/ yab rig 'dzin chen po dbang po'i sde nyid dang / yum 'phyong rgyas za hor gyi —312

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)gdung las lcam yid 'dzin dbang mo/ legs sbyar gyi skad du man+ta 5 'bod pa de'o/ /sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni zhang yul du tsha skye mi rung ba'i thugs dogs kyis gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi dus/ dbus gtsang ru bzhir grags pa las g.yon ru'i sa'i cha/ grwa phyi ma'i phu chos sdings dgon par/ 'phags pa'i yul du bī ra zhes pa gnam gnon du grags shing / bod yul 'dir rgya nag gi gtsug lag ltar lcags pho 'brug gi lo la ngo mtshar pa'i ltas dang bcas te sku bltams pas/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba chen pos/ 'gro 'dul dus dang byang phyogs rgyal po'i gdung / /rdo rje rigs mchog bkra shis grags pa'i stobs/ /rab rgyas yid 'dzin sa spyod dbang mo ste/ /lngar gzigs lhums su zhugs der gsol ba 'debs/ /lum+bi ni yi tshal mtshungs yul dbus char/ /tshangs pa lha yi me tog rnam par bzhad/ /man+ta ra yi 'khri shing 'dzum ldan par/ /lung bzhin mngon par bltams der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /na tshod phra mo'i dus nas thugs sgam zhing dgyel che ba byis pa tha mal gyi rol rtsed ye mi mdzad cing / /rig 'dzin legs ldan rje'i bag chags sad pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa dang gsung byon pa la brten/ yab dbang po'i sdes/ nga'i bla ma'i sku skye zhes gces par bzung bas mtshan zhabs drung bla mar grags/ phyag rdzas dang sku 'khor mang po la ngos 'dzin mdzad/ yab kyis/ rgyal ba kun dngos skyabasamachog rig 'dzin rje'i/ /lung bzhin rnam sprul ngag (27bsko dbang po yi/ /zhes sogs kyi sku tshe brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad 'bul ba sogs legs ldan rje dngos kyi thugs dad dang bkur zos gnang / bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho nas/ gter ston u rgyan gling pa'i skye rabs su lung gis zin pa'i dpal 'bri gung pa chos rgyal phun tshogs la gtsug phud phul/ mtshan ngag dbang rig 'dzin rdo rje chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gnang ste rgyal sras sems dpa' mchog gi go sar dbang bskur/ don 'di la dgongs nas rig 'dzin yol mo bas/ yab gcig mi mjed bdag po chos kyi rgyal/ /phun tshogs 'chi med dbang pos rab bsngags—513

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)shing / /gang zhig thos pa ba'i srid pa phyir bsnyil ba'i/ /mtshan gsol gub(pas bsnyen der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /sku tshe sngon ma legs ldan rje'i dus su bya bral gyi brtul zhugs bzung ste yongs 'dzin grangs med pa bsten nas chos phyir dka' spyad mdzad pa'i zab chos rnams yab dbang po'i sdes bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ba la brten/ sku tshe 'dir bla ma mang po la ltos ma dgos par nor gyi bcal po len pa ltar chos rnams phal cher yab la gsan pas/ grang so gter ston gyis/ ded dpon bye bas nyer blangs yid bzhin nor/ /spyod pa'i rang dbang yab gcig kho na las/ /tshegs med grub tshe 'gro 'di'i rgud pa'i mtha'/ /rab bcom kun dgar mdzad der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /de yang yab chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes/ nub dgon chos rje/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po/ dran mchog dpal ldan blo gros sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas gsan pa'i chos rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thugs kyi za ma tog yongs su gang ba'i gtso bo gsang sngags snga 'gyur/ (28na〉de la yang bka' gter gnyis las/zab pa gter ma'i skor gyi chos kyi rnam grangs ni brjod pa'i mtha' ga la zhig /gter ston gyi mtshan tsam smos na/ gter ston sangs rgyas bla ma/ rdor 'bum chos grags/ ma gcig kun dga' 'bum/ jo mo sman mo/ mnga' bdag nyang / gu ru chos dbang / grags pa bzang po/ rgya zhad khrom/ dge bshes drang kun grags/ rgya phur bu/ lha rje gnubs chung / rgya seng ge dar/ gnyags lha 'bar/ pad+ma dbang phyugatshe brtan rgyal mtshan/ snye mo rig gong pa/ grub thob dngos grub/ dge bshes dri 'dzin/ gru gu yang dbang / byang chub gling pa/ nyi zla sangs rgyas/ zla ban gzi brjid/ lho'i ban+de/ rog ban 'brog po/ sar ston phyogs med/ ldang ma lhun rgyal/ lce ston nag po/ zhang ston ba po shis/ me long rdo rje/ dung mtsho ral pa g.yu sgom pa/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem/ ba mkhal skrug po/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma/ ye shes khyung brag /sangs rgyas 'bar/ g.yu ston mgon rgyal/ ra shag gter ston/ zla ba rdo rje/ badz+ra ma ti/ khyung po thig ge bal po bha ro/ khri/da bu dpal grags/ dpal mar me mdzad/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ 'brom chos —514

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)snying / 'byog mi lo tsā/ gra pa dar ye/ lha btsun sngon mo/ sum pa byang chub 'od/ se ston ring mo/ kha la me 'bar/ rgyang grags 'od zer/ 'od zer ston pa/ mnga' bdag mol mi 'khyil/ du gu rin seng /shākya 'od/ gtsang pa ring mo/ sprul sku dmar po/ sum pa/ rkyang po/ 'brel/ bla ma grub/ nag po mkhar/skye ban rdo rje/ ban+de chung ngu / khyung rgod/ mi lhag dbu ma/ mgar ston pa/ a wa dhū tī/ sgom chen 'brug pa/ gnyan ston 'dzam la/ don grub seng (28bsko /pad+ma grags pa/ sprul sku tshul rdor/ sho ban/zangs ri ral pa/ dbang phyug shākya/ nyi 'bum khri/ pra dum pa/ nyi ma shes rab/ gra pa mngon shes/ ra mo shes sman/ sum ston/ brang ti khar bu/ nyang shes rab grags/ gtsang ston chos 'bar/ gu ru hūm̐ 'bar skal ldan byis pa/ gu ru jo rtse/ nyi ma seng ge /gnyal ston nag po/ shes rab me 'bar/ khams pa me zor/ sna nam thub rgyal/ u rgyan gling pa/ sangs rgyas gling pa/ rdo rje gling pa/ kun skyong gling pa/ rin chen gling pa/ rat+na gling pa/ rkadze gling pa/ las 'phro gling pa/ bsam gtan gling pa/ bstan gnyis gling pa/ klong chen pa/ dri med lhun po/ dri med kun dga'/ mchog ldan mgon po/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ mnga' ris paṇa chen/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin/ 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ 'phrang mgo shes rab 'od zer/ yab gter ston ma ba'i mtshan can rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i gter chos las la la'i gter chos yongs rdzogs dang / 'ga' zhig gi gter chos bye brag ci rigs gsan cing / gsan pa kun kyang thos blo tsam min par bsam pa dang sgom pa'i sgo nas nan tan tu mdzad pas/ gter ston bi shwa ḍā gis/ khyad par pad+ma'i zhal lung bung ba'i tshogs/ /gang khyod snyan gyi pad 'dab dris bos shing /khyod thugs dga' ba'i tshal nas snyan sgrogs dbyangs/ /skal bzang yongs la bsnyad der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /yar lungs shel brag sogs sgrub pa'i gnas chen mang po dang / 'phyong rgyas yar rgyab nam mkha' mdzod sogs su zla ba lnga drug sbrel ba'i bsnyen sgrub lan mang du mdzad pas/ yi dam chos skyong du ma'i zhal gzigs pa dang gsung gi gnang ba du (29na to5 stsal zhing / gang gis kyang thul bar dka' ba'i —5/5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)gdon gyis btab pa'i rigs la byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis rang grol du 'gyur/ gsang sngags zab mo'i dka' gnad 'grol ba la mkhyen rab zab cing brling / na tshod phra mo'i dus nas thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gi mthus gdul bya rnams mtsho la ngang pa ltar 'du bas/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba chen pos/ brtson pas sbyangs min chos kun ma 'dres 'byed/ /'bad pas bsgrubs min rig sngagasanus pas grub/ /rnyed pas bsdus min mos blos kun 'du ba'i/ /ngo mtshar dpal kun 'dzin der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /yab dbang po'i sdes gter kha spyan drangs nas re zhig na/ ka thog pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan snang rtse phyogs kyi kun slong ༅ pa'i rigs can gyi skye bos rgyud bsgyur ba brten/ byang pa bdag po khyed gter ston par grags pa ji lta bu sogs tshod bgam par/ shog ser ston par gnang bas the tshom zhi ba yin pas/ rang gter du/ dang po 'dra min chol bur spel: the tshom byed pa'i 'khor tsho gos 'dul/ /zhesapa'i skabs te de nas/ rang 'dra'i slob bu nyi shu gcig: gnas chen drag por zab gter spel dusartags ma nor gnad bstems pa: spyi lung gsang pa'i gal mdor ltos: zhes pa ltar/ chos bdag nyer gcig las gtso bo ni gsang sgrub snying thig nag po'i skor lo bcur rang min kun la sbos: spyi lung bzhin du rtags byung na: drag po'i bu mchog dpral sme can: de sogs rtags dang sbyar la spel:zhes bu mchog dpral ba'i sme ba can ni/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nyid du ngos (29ba〉zung ste gter gsar gyi chos skor thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas chos bdag tu mnga' gsol/ yab chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs phyi mdzad nas/ rgya ha ka ling tse'i bar du phebs/ mdo khams stod smad/ rgya nag po'i yul la thugs pa'i skye rgu thams cad sku gsung thug kyi mdzad pas re ba bkang / rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi phyi sgrub yon tan gter mdzod las/ khams yul rgya yi yul du grags pa ni/ /zhes pa mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched kyis mdo smad du ma phebs shing / de phyogs nas grags che ba'i bu slob kyang mi mang bas/ mched gnyis kyi gter chos sogs kyi snyan grags 'di dag gi skabs rgyas par mdzad pa —516

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)la dgongs so/ /yab dang lhan cig par dbus su phebs nas/ 'phyong rgyas dang yar rgyab sogs su phal cher bzhugs shing 'gro don rgya che ba'i ngang nas/ chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can re zhig zangs mdog dpal rir sna rgyan chen po'i zhabs drung du gshegs rjes/ yab chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab dam par bzhugs te/ rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel bzhin ba'i ngang nas/ rong chung du sngon tshe u rgyan chen pos bdud rigs dam la btags pa'i gnas/ brag lhang lhang ma dang / de dang thag nye ba'i skad thos kyi sar/ rje gong mas gnas sgo gsar du phye ba'i kham bu lung gnyis mjal bar phebs/ lhang lhang mar zhabs drung gong mas gsar du brtan pa'i sgrub chu yod 'dug kyang / kham bu lung du chu med pas/der gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin mkhan dbu mdzad 'od grags kyis dgon pa gsar du btab par lhang lhang ma nas chu len dgos sogs chu thag ring ba'i skabs la/ rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyis/ de'i nye 'dabs (30na)kyi brag la phyag sor gyis reg pas sgrub chu rdol te/ da lta'i bar du yang de kha nas chu len pa yin 'dug /de dang mtshungs par yar lungs shel brag gi phug pa gong ma nas kyang sgrub chu 'byin par mdzad pas/ rig 'dzin stobs ldan dpa' pos 'gran sems chags sdang ring du spangs nas kyang / dz+nyā na ku mā ra yi sgrub mtshan la/ /yongs 'gran phyas/ so ra rtse mos brag chen las/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun mang byung der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /sman thang gi grong pa zhig la 'on dgon phug /dkar mo bas rkun ma byas pa rtsad chos nas thod gsungs pa la/ ngos mi len par ma zad sku la sdo ba dang smod pa mang du byas par chos brgyad kyi 'gyu dus kyi gtor ma 'phangs pas/ dgun dus yin yang thog babs nas mi nor khang khyim dang bcas pa gtan brlag tu song / sne'u gdong rtse dang brag kha gnyis 'gras gzhi chen po byung ba la/ rgyal bzang gzhis gar gdan drangs/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi gtor zlog mdzad pas sne'u gdong rtser rdo char babs/ skabs shig sne'u gdong rtse/ yar stod/ yar rgyab rnams kyi dmag rtse thang du sgar brgyab —517

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)nas/ 'on du dpung 'jug par sngon du phyogs pa na/ sman thang nas dmag zlog mdzad pas/ dmag rnams don med du 'ur shogs chen po zhig byung nas bros/ de la sogs pa'i nus mthu'i mtshan ma mang po la mnga' brnyes pas/ grang sogater ston gyis/ slob dpon smod brtson ma rungs sdig can 'gar/ /nyid kyi mthu yis bsil ldan ma yi dus/ /gnam lcags lce lhung 'bar ba'i shugs chen pos/ /'khor bcas ming mthar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /(30ba)slar yang rgyal khams phyogs med du gdul bya'i don la dgongs nas mdo khams su phebs khar/ yar lungs bkra shis rtse chos sder 'a zha'i rigs las khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gdan drangs/ dpon slob phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur te/phar byang gter gyi tshe dbang sogs chos bka' du ma gnang zhing / tshur rig 'dzin sku mched kyi gter gsar 'ag/ zhig gsan pa mdzad/ has po ri'i rtse nas sku rten zhig gter nas spyan drangs/ 'bri gung du phebs/ zhag shas bzhugs zhabs drung sku mched tshor chos bka' mang du 'bul ba gnang / thog mar kong por phebs gter kha gsar pa gzhan gyi kha byang kong po sngags 'chang zhig gi lag na yod pa phul te/ phyag tu 'byor ba dang nyi ma shar ba dus 'grig /kha byang gi yi ge gzigs pas/ mar gad las grub pa'i rta 'grin gyi sku zhig yod 'dug pas/ dus phyis rgyu mtshan rig 'dzin yul mo bar gsungs par snang / kong po gnyos nas kyang thugs rje chen po'i chos skor gyi chos gter zhig gdan drangs pas/ grang so gter ston gyis/ snod min 'gro ngor rgyas btab gsang ba'i gter/ /rim bdun phyag rgyas bcings rnams gsal byed pa'i/ /lde mig rang byung sprul pa'i sku nyid kyis/ /legs stsal gegs med lon der gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes so/ /de'i tshe 'brug lugs kyi chos rje dung dkar sku skye ming gzhan mi pham blo gros zhes phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa klong du gyur pa de la/ rmi lam du u rgyan rin po che phebs nas nga'i bu cig 'dir sleb yod pas de la mchod pa phul/ 'phrin las spel ba'i grogs gyis gsung ba'i snang ba byung bas/ khong pa —518

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)yid ches (31na)kyi nges pa rnyed de zhal zas khru do tsam brgya rtsa/ mar me brgya rtsa sogs mchod pa mang po sku la dngos su bskor nas phul bas/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba chen pos/ mgon des rjes bzung mi pham blo gros la/ pad+mas lung bstan gang gi sprul pa'i skur nges nas kun bzang mchod sprin lta bu yi/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi spyi lung du: dbus mtha' kun la hor dmag za kha zug: 'gro rnams nyam thag cho nges 'debs par 'gyur: mchims kyi gad skya'i gtsug lag yang yang gso: bla ma zhi drag sgrub btsugs sa dgra mnan: kong yul kun la ma ṇi'i thun kha 'dzugs: dbus ri nag por sde brgyad dam bdar bya: rgya la'i rba la bstan dgra'i khram kha gtad: bu chu'i gnas su rim gro mang du bya: byang gong do lar bla ma'i sgrub pa 'dzugs: rim gro rgyas pa bya thabs zhib rgyas su: mchims kyi gang skya'i lha khang sgo la yod: ces pa'i don la dgongs nas/ u rgyan rin po che'i lung bstan yod pas nga'i grogs mdzod la ma ṇi'i dge skul gyis/ zhes chos rje dung dkar sku skye la gsungs par brten/ khong pas rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyi zhabs tog bsgrubs te kong yul du ma ṇi dung 'phyur bco brgyad tsam btsugs/ dbus ri nag po'i mjug gi sna'i steng du phebs/ lung po byang chub gling pa'i gter ma'i bka' nan rab brjid kyi phyag len la brten nas/ lha srin sdebargyad dam la btags/ de'i tshe zhing skyong gi sku khog bla ma dbang po zer ba'i mig mthong gsal pa zhig gis bltas pas/ lha 'dre gzugs dbyibs mgo brnyan sna tshogs pa sa gzhir mi shong ba tsam (31ba 〉 zhugs pa mthong nas/ der 'khod pa rnams la/ dam bdar ma tshar par rgyu 'grul ma byed/ tho reng kha rlangs kyi dug phog nyen che zer bas/ mi rnams 'jigs skrag gis blo tshab tshub tu gyur/ bla ma dpa' bos mthong ba ltar rje nyid kyis kyang gzigs/ gzhan yang mnan sreg 'phang gsum/ sa gnad gso ba sogs kyi sgo nas bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams kyi bde thabs mang du gnang / sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung brgyud snyi phu rig 'dzin/ gter bdag slob brgyud sngags 'chang bya khyung pa/ rtse le ba sogs snga 'gyur gyi bstan —519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)'dzin rnams gtso bor gyur ba'i skya ser grangs med pas gus pas btud/ chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher stsal/ brag gsum mtsho khar phebs dus gzhi bdag klu btsan gyis mchod pa'i phyir du mtsho'i kha dog 'o ma'i mdangs ltar bsgyur bas/ sngar dad pa mi byed pa'i mi rnams kyang dad mos kyi 'ur langs snyan grags je cher song / 'jig rten gyi 'byor ba yang dkar 'brug sprul skur 'gran bzod par gyur pas/rig 'dzin yol mo bas/ kong yul nags pa'i ljongs dbu mtsho rdzong du/ /gdengs can btsun mos mtsho nyid 'o mar bsgyur/ /gser gyi pad+mo tshar du dngar 'dra ba'i/ /rin chen sgron mas mchod der gsol ba 'debs: zhes dang / bdud ri nag por sdebargyad dam bdar che/ /bod yul lha srin yongs 'dus bka' nyan par/ khas blangs phyag rgya gnyan pos zil gyis mnan/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng gnyis par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /sngar dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal kong po phyogs su phebs dus/ /phan sde dgon pa dang rong chu mdo ba sogs gar ge'i sde dgon mang pos/ phebs lam bkag cing rdo choms btang ba sogs thugs sun che bar (32na〉grang ba la/ rjes su las 'bras kyi ngang tshul la bsams te 'gyod pa dang bstan srung gi cho 'phrul la rnam rtog sna tshogs 'char ba sogs sgo du ma'i rgyus/ rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid la dgra shul dar 'jam du song ste dgon sde de dag gis ser 'phreng gi bsu bas sngun bsus shing bsnyen bkur dang phu dud rgya cher bstabs/ 'bru la dgon du chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i gser sku thog tshad ma zhig bzhengs par/ gzungs bzhugs 'bul mkhan gyis grul ma btub pa'i gzungs rnams 'brugs pa dang dbu zhabs log ste yod pa lkog tu gyur pa la brten/ de nas ring por ma lon par dgon par me thengs gsum shor ba sogs mi shis pa sna tshogs byung bar kun yid gnyis su gyur ba na/ rig 'dzin 'di nyid dgon par gdan drangs te gnas tshul rnams zhug pas/ gzungs bzhugasarnams 'di ltar 'dug pa slar thon la phul gsungs pa ltar 'phral du bltas pas ji lta ba bzhin du byung ste mtha' dag phyogs 'dzin gyi mdud pa grol nas dad mos je cher 'phel/ byang pa bdag po la —520

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)mngon mkhyen thogs pa mi 'dug go zhes snyan grags kyi 'ur langs/ zho kha'i mda' na skam po ding thang zer ba'i char chu ches dkon pa zhig yod 'dug par yul mi rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas/ grong dang wang pa'i bar der mchod yon thams cad bsgril nas nyin gcig la mchod rten thog tshad phyed gnyis tsam zhig brtsigs/ nang du gzungs bzhugs dang byin rlabs kyi rten 'brel mang po mdzad/ming la bsams 'grub 'bum par btags/ yul pa rnams kyi tshogs brgya zhus pa'i tshe/ da (33ba)phyin chad yul 'dir lo nyes nad yams 'khrug long ci byung yang mchod rten 'di la tshogs brgya/ phyag mchod smon lam thob/ bsams pa bzhin du 'grub ces gsungs pa da lta'i bar du slu med kyi rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung bar yod 'dug pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi gdul bya las/ rong sgo sa sgo thams cad du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs: zhes dang / de steng mchod rten bzheng bar bya bum par gzungs sngags bzhugs pa ni: gu ru'i thugs kyi snying po'i mthar: smon lam rnam dag rgya chen bzhugs: rat+na'i gzungs rnams rgyas par bzhugs: rab gnas mnga' gsol bkra shis bya: de ltar byas na bod khams bde: yul phyogs bkra shis bde skyid 'byung: zhes pa'i don thog tu babs pa'o/ /kong po mthil du phebs dus spyir gar lugs 'di sde dpon dpon skya mang pos lang du btang ba'i rang mthong che zhing / khyad par rtse lha sgang pa rnams gar srid kyi khrod nas mnga' thang rgyas pa'i nga rgyal che ba'i sgang la yod par snang bas/ nged kyi mnga' zhabs su khyed dpon slob dkyil gdugs 'bubs pa dang rba rgyug 'byer sa mi yong zhes glu ma blangs pa nas gre ba 'dzer ba la/ ga rma pa shi'i dbon rgyud rtse lha sgang gi drung zer ba rje ga rma pa ma gtogs gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal ba zhig yod 'dug pa de/ rig 'dzin chen po 'di la mos pa thob ste/ rtse lha sgang du gdan drangs nas chos 'brel zhus pas mi bsrun sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i snang tshul de dag rang zhin song / rim bzhin khams phyogs su phebs/ khams spo bo'i yul stod smad 'khrugs pa'i mi gsod sogs sdig rgyun chen po byung ba la bzlums (33nasgo dzad par grong tsho gcig gis ma nyan pas thog babs te mi nor mang po chud zos/ de la 'jigs nas thams —521—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)cad kyis zla ba bdun gyi bar chings byed par khas blangs/ zla ba bdun song ba'i 'tshams la yul stod pas yul smad pa la dmag drangs pas/ yul smad pa'i dpon gyis khang thog nas/ nged tshos bla ma byang pa chos rje'i gsung ma bcag /khyod rang tsho yang de 'dra mi dga'/ yar log zer ba sogs byas pa la ma nyan par 'dzangs pas yul stod pa'i dmag dpon gyi dpral ba la mda' thebs nas shi bas rnam rtog zos te lo grangs mang po'i bar du dus 'brug rang zhir song /gnam pa'i dpon gsang sngags sogs phyogs de'i sde dgon rnams kyis gdan drangs/ de'i nyin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas sna tshogs byung / yul lugs dang bstun pa'i 'bul ba zhabs tog rgya cher byas/chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas tshim par mdzad/ bha ga dgon par phebs dus/ shu wa zam so zer ba'i ri'i rtse bar sgar mdzad pa la/ sa g.yos chen po zhig dang lhan du rbab rdo che ba khang pa tsam dang chung ba'i rbab phran mang po gzims gur gyi thad du 'dril byung ba la sdigs mdzub mdzad pas g.yas g.yon du byol ba lta bur byas te song ba phyogs re'i skye bo mang pos mthong bas/ byang pa bdag pos ri gzar gyi rbab kyang zlog nus pa zhes slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang mtshungs pa lta bu'i dad pa dang 'phrin las snyan grags thams cad dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel lo/ /slob chu mdo ba'i gros pa 'ga' zhig gis lam dgag pa sogs gros ngan bshams pa na/ grwa pa rgan pa mang pos/ sngar (33ba)bla ma 'di'i yab byon dus thugs 'gal mang po byas pas cho 'phrul chen po byung / bla ma 'di pa kha sang ka nam du byon dus sgra dang sa g.yos sogs ltas ya mtshan can byung skad 'dug /gnod pa byas pa mi dga'/ bde bar phebs chug ces gros btone pas/ rtsod pa chosaphyogs su zhi/ spo bo nas la rgyab 'o 'du sgang du phebs/ de mo sprul sku lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mjal zhing / 'jigs byed thub pa nag po sogs chos 'brel mang du gsan/ rim gyis khams ri bo che nas sgom sde nang chen pa'i thog tu phebs/ nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig la shar/ nam mkha' 'ja' sprin kha dog lnga ldan gyis khyab pas/ sngar khong tsho skar lugs kho nar dad kyang 'di nas bzung —522

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)gsang sngags rnying ma la 'gyur ba lta bu'i sbyin bdag gi mthil du song / lung pa de'i spyi stod zer ba'i yul grong chen po'i zhing rnams btsa' dang 'bus zos nas mu ge chen pos stongs pa la thug pa na/ de la phan pa'i byin rlabs zhus pas rin chen khang bu'i man ngag gi sgo nas yul de'i mi rnams dbul ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar mdzad/ de'i 31 las lo legs pa dang skya rgyal ba ma byung zhes gleng /de nas spyi smad kyi g.yi gu brag zhabs zer ba'i zhid thog tu sgar phab/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen btsugs te dad 'dus kyi skye rgu mtha' dag theg pa mchog gi lam la bkod/dbang yon gyi nas phung shin tu che bar bla ma sgar pa g.yin la 'di 'dras ma byung zhes kun ha las pa ltar byed/ de nas phyam la kha zer ba'i sde stod smad bar gsum gyi skye bo rnams gcig tu tshogs te gsol ba btab pas sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la (34na〉brten nas smin cing grol bar mdzad/ rim gyis bi ri stod pa dge rgyas kyi sde thog tu gdan drangs/ mar me gdong lam zer ba'i sar dpon gyis bsu ba la 'ongs pas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mthong bas rkyen byas te dad pa ches cher 'phel/rta nor phyugs lugs sogs 'bul ba dang zhabs tog mang du byas/ bar chad sel ba dang mngon mtho nges legs kyi thabs su 'gyur ba'i dam pa'i chos kyis 'gro don mang du mdzad/ de'i tshe sog po thu med kyi dmag cig dge rgyas kyi steng du 'ongs pas sde rnams 'ur zhing 'byos par brtsams pa na/ rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa'i gu lang gi sgo nas zlog pa mdzad pas sog po'i dmag dpon de'i bu rtas brdabs nas shi zer ba'i gtam la brten phyir log pas mthu stobs kyi snyan pas phyogs kun tu khyab/ sgom sde nang chen pa dang 'brong pa gnyis zhabrug rtsod chen po byung ba la bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas zhal ta mdzad pas ma rungs pa'i zhe sdang gi dug thams cad rang sar zhi nas phan tshun thams cad mnyen bshin par gyur/ 'byong pa rdo rje'i bu a rig /pad+ma dbang drag /bla ma mgon te spun gsum yod pa las/ chung ba bla ma mgon nad drag po zhig gis btab ste slo bur du shi bas khrusachog dbang bskur la gdan drangs/ der phebs te rnam shes bkug nas gnas sbyong dang dbang bskur —523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)mdzad pas mig rig rig lta zhing dbugs rgyu ba dang lus mgul bas/ der 'khod rnams ro langs su dogs te 'jigs pa na skyon med gsungs te byin rlabs mdzad pas gtam yang smra shes par gyur/(34bti nas tshe dbang dang gu ru drag po'i dbang sogs gnang bas skyon med du sos/ gnyen bshes mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ slob dpon chen pos gsol 'debs bsams pa lhun grub mar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' mi 'gyur pa'i bden pa dngos su bstan/ dpon bla ma mgon gyis tshe ring thung sogs kyi lung bstan zhus pas/ dmag jag ri dwags sogs sems can gyi srog la mi 'tshe ba'i dam bca' byed na lo gsum gyi khag theg gsungs pas dam bca' phul/de nas slar yang bi ri stod pa'i thog tu phebs skabs/ 'byong pa stod pa tsho gsum la/ bi ri dge rgyas dang 'brong pa gnyis ga'i dmag cha'i bar brtsams pa na/ rig 'dzin chen pos 'byong pa stod pa la ni mi thebs/ tshur lam dgon pa zhig dang thug nyen yod sogs rgyas par gsungs kyang ma nyan par phyin pas/ 'brong pa stod pa rnams tsha ba rong la bros nas dmag jag ma thebs/ tshur lam spu ba dgon zer ba'i dge lugs kyi dgon re che zhig gi mdun du dmag mi sngon ma rnams kyis sleb/ bzan shing dang chas ka dgos zhes dgon pa la ar shed byas pas/ grwa pa rnams kyis ma khur bar brten dgon pa la dmag brgyab nas sku gsung thugs rten dang rab byung gi rtags cha lugs mang po nom pa la thob/de thog du dge rgyas kyi dpon slob pas 'gyod pa chen po skyes nas dmag mi rnams la chad pa bcad:rjes su yang byang pa rig 'dzin 'di mngon shes thogs pa med ces mos pa je cher song /de nas zur mang gi stod jo go je nang du phebs/ dpa' bo dur khrod kyi bdag po'i (35na tha kang ba mdzad pas rlung ye med pa la tshogs gur rlung chen pos bskyod pa ltar 'gul ba'i tshe/ rnga chings dang bstun dur khrod bdag po yab yum gar mdzad pa mngon sum du gzigs/ zur mang nas rgyam shis zer ba'i la brgyud nas 'dam ldog phyogs su phebs rtsis la/ de gong du kha ba nyin zhag bcu dgu'i bar babs pas nyin lam gsum gyi sa thams cad gangs kyis khyab ste mi 'grul chad nas zhag mang —524

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)song bar brten lam ma rnyed par dka' bar gyur pa na rje nyid kyis lam sna mdzad de kha ba bshags pa na gangs 'ur shin tu che ba mi rnams kyi steng du byung ba la gzigs stangs dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pas g.yas g.yon du byer te gnod pa ye ma byung / la kha'i bar du phebs kyang lam rnying pa ma rnyed pas phyir log rtsis mdzad pa na g.yas ri'i logs nas ri dwags dgo ba cig 'ongs te sgar pa rnams kyi mdun thad nas thur du phar skyog tshur skyog byed kyin babs song ba la/ 'di gzhi bdag gi cho 'phrul du 'dug pas de'i rjes su khal ma sogs thong gsung phebs pa na dka' tshegs la ma ltos par bde bar byon/g.yag 'dam thog tu sa skya bdag chen kun dga' blo gros mjal bar phebs pas sum gdan snye 'bol bzheng ba sogs bkur zos che bar mdzad/ bdag chen gyi sku rim la khro bo rol pa'i gtor zlog sogs gnang ba'i skabs/ nar mas kyi sog po 'ga' sa skya bdag chen mjal bar 'ongs pas mthong ste/ sgar pa 'di rnams su yin zhes dris pa la/ byang pa bdag po zhes rnying lugs kyi bla ma chen po zhig yin zer ba thos pas rta 'ga' (25ba)phyag rten du khyer te mjal bar byung ba las/ rim gyis phyag dbang zhus pas gsum pa de la/ khyod kyi pha'i lag pa la mthe bong med pa ci yin gsungs pas/de'i rgyu mtshan zhu zhing lkog gyur gyi chos rnams mngon sum du mkhyen pa la nges shes cher rnyed/de nas sa dkar dgon du phebs/ rje gong ma bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis bi ma la'i sprul par ngos 'dzin gnang pa'i sku drung bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes grub rtags dang nus mthu thogs pa med pa mnga' ba des/ rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi dbang sogs chos bka' rgya cher zhus khong pa sa skya bdag chen zhig gi skye bar grags pas chen po'i tshugs ka 'dzin cing mi rnams kyang mos par yod pas/ rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid la snying nas dad pa'i gus 'dud chen po mdzad par brten/ snga 'gyur bstan pa 'phel rgyas kyi sgo dam par gyur/ de nas sog dogs chen po yod pa'i la rtsa zhig tu bzhugs pa'i nub thugs dam bkang gso mdzad pa'i tshe gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar pa'i sku khog bla ma dpa'o zer ba des/ de nub chos skyong thams cad sku la bskor nas khrig ge 'dug pas sog po'i dmag gi gnod pa mi 'ong ba —525

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)'dra zhus pa la/ nged rang gi mig ltas dang byings phebs lugs la bltas na de ka 'dug gsung /dpa' ri sgrub sde ba'i 'dul dpon dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs dpon slob sngar spo bo ru nang zhabs dus mthun sgrigs dang rjes su mgo 'don bdag rkyen kho na mdzad pa la/ khong rnams ka thog tu sngon la phyin nas la la'i sar/ nga byang pa bdag po'i dbon po 'bring ma yin zer ba dang phal cher la/byang bdag po'i gdung rgyud gnyis ka gshags nas rigs chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin mkhan med (36na)zer ba sogs lhas byin drin gzo med pa'i
