ring lugs kho nar brten pa rnams la yang khro ba ye mi mdzad cing slar phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa ni 'phags chen rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam par thar pa ste/ ra gan gser chus byugs pa'i cher rlom tshul 'chos mkhan rnams kyi spyod tshul dang 'dra bar mi sems so /mdo khams kyi gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa'i 'byung gnas lta bu ka thog dgon par phebs/phyogs de'i skya ser kun gyis gser ga ngul g.yu rta khrab ja sogs zang zing gi 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur rgya cher bstabs/ so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i dbang lung man ngag sogs dam pa'i chos kyis 'gro don rgya cher spel/ 'on kyang sde pa snang rtse ba'i brgyud 'dzin 'ga' zhig gis kun slong ngan pas dbyen bcas te spyi thog tu bka' brgyad sgrub chen tshugs pa sogs ni ma byung / yab chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal phebs skabs ka thog pa rnams kyi rtsa gsum ja mchod cig dgos zhus pa la/ rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po'i mtshan dpe la yod pa'i legs pa'i lam ston ma thugs rtsom mdzad de btsugs pa rgyun du 'don na'ang rig 'dzin rje'i mtshan dpe la yod pa ma shes pa la/ rjes su gtsang pa rab 'byams pa zer pa'i yon tan dang shes rab re che yod pa snang rtse sde pa'i dngos slob yin pa zhig gis ngo shes te/ dar ma'i lam ston zhes 'don pa bsgyur pas/ de la thugs khros te gtsang pa rab 'byams pa dang rta drel mang po rku ba'i dpon po tshe rgyal gnyis la 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i rlung 'khor 'dzugs pa gnang bas dbon po tshe rgyal glo bur du shi/ gtsang pa (36ba〉ngab 'byams pa sbyin bdag rnams dang ma mthun par lung pa gsum gyi gcig nas gcig tu yul don pa'i mthar rims —526

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)gdon drag pos btab ste 'jig rten pha rol tu song ngo /de'i dus kre po na ga me pa chos dbyings rdo rje bzhugs yod 'dug pa mjal bar phebs pa la lam nor te hor be lag zer ba'i sde zhig dang nye sar sgar babs pa na/ hor rnams kyis gnod pa byed par mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe sgar pa rnams 'dzing ngam 'bros sam zhes 'jigs te tsham tshom du gyur pa'i skabs/ pho rog nag cing snum pa zhig gis gzims gur steng du babs nas skad snyan pa mang po sgrog /de nas cung zhing lon pa dang hor de blo 'gyur te glo bur du dad nas byin rlabs rten slong zhing / lung pa'i phu 'di na nged tsho min pa'i hor mang po yod pas do nub 'dir ma bzhugs par la phar nang du phebs zhu ba sogs rgyu mtshan mang du phul/ de ni rje nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems dang chos skyong gi nus pa'o/ /hor des lam bstan pa ltar mtshan 'gros mdzad nas tho rangs la rtse zhig tu sgar babs nas bzhugs/ sang nam langs pa na la brgyab ste dgon pa nam rag mgo'i phu der bzhugs sgar mdzad/de dus gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma le'u re re nas sku zhabs su brgya rtsa gsog gis yod 'dug pas/spros bral bde chen ma gsung ba'i skabs ri la yang yang gzigs nas gral mgo na bi ri dpon po zer ba zhig yod 'dug pa la/ 'di na sog po 'dra yong sa med dam gsung bar yod zhus pas/ skyon mi 'dug phebs/ rjes su sku 'khor rnams kyis rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ ri gdong 'di la sog po brgya tsam zhig sa thag rong nge babs (37na〉grang ba mi smug yor re ba zhig gis bsgribs nas gar song ma byung gsung / de nas sngags 'chang kun lhun pa kre bo stod kyi dpon po'i sar ja 'dren la btang ba'i tshe dpon po'i mdun na sog po 'ga' zhig 'dug pas/ dpon de'i ngag las/ kha sang sog po 'di tshos khyed dpon slob la ngan byed par brtsams pa na/ glo bur du bor nas ma mthong 'dug pas nus mthu shin tu che/ ban+de thams cad kyi bstan pa bzung zhes dga' dga' byed/ sog po rnams ni tshig pa zos te kha sha 'then skad do/ /de nas sgar du lha bsangs brgyags rngan rgyas pa zhig mdzad/ de'i tshe gnod sbyin tsi dmar ba khog —527

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)tu zhugs pa la sngar gyi ltas rten 'brel rnams kyi dri ba gnang bas/ ri snyed po spun gsum 'dra ba ru nyen chen po yod/ de dus nga 'ong byas pa de pho rog de yin/ mi smug po chen po de ra hu la yin zhes gsungs pas chos skyong so so la gtang rag mdzad/ rim gyis kre bo'i chu brgal/ hor tshang gi dge lugs kyi gam tshe dgon pa'i 'dabs su sgar mdzad/ zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs/ ga me pa dang mjal 'phrad kyi don du lcags mo ru mi sna btang yang / yang ri drung pas bkag /rkun ma mang po yongs pas rta drel dang / phyugs kyi rdzi'u rnams mi ma yin du mthong nas 'jigs skrag dang bcas te bros/ de'i tshe yang ri dung pa kun dga' lhun grub phyi ma bcos lhug pa'i sgrib shing la nang gyod kyi phung po chen po des tshod bgam pa'i phyir du mjal ba skad byas nas 'ongs pa la/ nged ga me pa dang mjal 'phrad byed par 'ongs chogs dgos gsungs par/ de'i lan du khyed kyis zhwa dmar sprul sku la mthu bslabs/ khyed kyi nu bo bdag po dpon gyis (37ba tsher bras spungs sprul sku la mthu bslabs nas nged la mthu byed rtsis byas zer ba dang / rkarma pa la khyed rang tsho dbang che mod/ nga stag lung pa'i tshong pa rgad po zhig gis ci shes zer ba sogs g.yo sgyu khram gsum la goms pa'i nyams kyis che skad chung skad kyi gtam ya ma zung sna tshogs smras skad do/ /nub cig gnod sbyin chen po khog tu zhugs nas/ yang ri drung pa 'di bdud yag sher nag po'i sprul pa yin pas de dang phrad pas tshe la bar chad byung nyen yod/ mi mthun phyogs zil gyis gnon pa'i thabs mdzad dgos tshul gsungs/ de nas shel ram sgang du phebs/ rje gong ma'i grwa rigs sbyin bdag rnams kyis bsnyen bkur/ smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo bstor/ bi ri mang dge phag mo zer ba ar jag rku gsum la goms pa/ sgar pa che chung gnas skor pas mtha' brten pa kun la gnod pa byed mkhan zhig yod 'dug pa des lan gsum gyi bar du mtshan mo jag pa 'ongs pas/ nub gcig yur ba chu chen por 'khrul ba dang / de bzhin du mtha' mes bskor ba dang / sgar gyi nang thams cad mis gang ba sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs mthong nas glags lta bar ma nus pas/ da sgar pa 'grim pa'i —528

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)lam du ngan byed bsams te rta dmag sum brgya tsam zhig gis bsgugs pa na/ sgar pa'i g.yas g.yon du dmag khrab can mang po 'gro ba mthong nas byed rgyu ma rnyed pas/ bsam pa la bla ma sgar pa la dmag de 'dra 'ong don med/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin nam snyam the tshom ste/ sgar pa lung nang du babs zin pa dang lta mi btang pas de rnams dang khrab reng 'ga' zhig 'phrad pa'i snang ba shar te phyir log /de (38na skog la brten nas mang dge phag mo dpon g.yog yid ches kyi dad pa thob ste mjal bar 'ongs/ ngas grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma sgar pa mang po bcom pa yin te/ mthu dang nus pa byang pa chos rje khyed las che ba ma mthong / nga'i yul na bla ma rgad po gnyis dbus gtsang gi gnas mjal ba dang ser 'bras dge gsum gyi gtsos pa'i dgon pa mang por mang bkol ba gtong rgyu yin pas/ de tsho bla ma khyed kyi phyags phyi byas nas rdzong dgos 'dug pas thugs la bzhugs zer ba sogs mang du zhus shing 'bul ba 'khas tog byas/rim gyis rta'u la byon/ yul mi rnams spyod pa 'tshub pas nang khul du sgo nor ri la gtong mi thub pa'i 'byug jag byed cing / phyi nas 'ong mi'i 'grul pa rnams 'phrog rdung sna tshogs kyi sgo nas mnar zhing / khyad par rgya bod hor gsum kun la bla chen du grags pa'i snyan pa dang khengs pa shin tu che ba mchog gi sprul sku zhwa dmar ba lta bu yang bcom ste dwa ri dra'i gnas la bkod pas/ mchog dman mtha' dag phyogs der 'gro ba la srin yul yin pa tsam gyi 'jigs sems byed pa las/ 'di'i skabs mi zhig gis dre'u brkus pas dre'u'i kha nas me 'bar ba'i 'khrul snang byung ste phyir phul/ rnying lugs kyi dgon pa sde pa snang rtse ba'i brgyud 'dzin zhig gis jag byed par 'ongs pa la/ gzigs snang du khyab 'jug chen po 'khor lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pas phyir ded pa dang / dngos su dus min gyi rlung tshub chen po langs te jag pa rnams 'gro gnas min par ded pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung bas slar ma rungs pa'i bsam pa bor te gus pas btud/ gnas(38ba〉tsul de dag la brten nas yul mi mtha' dag gis yul lugs dang bstun pa'i bsnyen bkur gya nom pa bstabs/ rab byung sngags pa skye bo'i —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)tshogs rnams la rang rang dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher mdzad/ khyad par phyi nang gang du'ang 'thab rtsod 'khrug long chen po mi byed pa'i dam bca' bzhes te mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pas 'gro ba rnams kyi dbugs bde bar phyung /de nas mi nyag gi yul du phebs pa'i tshe/ shar bzhag ra lha rtse'i ri'i thod la sprin dkar po re rgyun du mi yal bar sdod pa la/ dus der sprin pa ri'i sked par babs pas mi nyag rnams kyis/ rang re'i a khu bla ma byon pa la bzhag ras zhwa phud byas par 'dug ces gleng / de na mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang yin zer pa'i lha khang zhig yod pa mjal bar dar rtse mdo pa'i sa bdag dpon zer ba des 'ongs pa dang dpon slob rnams phebs pa 'grig /tshes bco lnga'i 'gyu dus grol ba dang mnyam du gnod sbyin chen po khog tu zhugs nas/ dar rtse mdo pa'i a po tsho/ rgya bod gnyis kyi gser gyi gnya' shing chag la khad pa de e tshong zhes lan gsum gsungs pas/ drung nas mdo pa rnams la/ khyed tsho yong skabs 'khrug zings sogs kyi 'phros med dam gsungs dri ba gnang bar/ de 'dra med tshul zhus/de nas zhag gcig tsam song ba na dar rtse mdo nas mi byung de/ ha ka dang ling tse gnyis thug /mdo ba rnams kyang ling tse'i dmag rogs la 'gro dgos pa byung / myur du phebs dgos zhes gdan 'dren tsha drag zhus pa ltar ling tser phebs/ de nus mdo pa'i dmag mi mang po ha ka ba'i dmag rogs rgya ljang rnams kyis mtshan btib byas nas (39na〉nas da pa skad tsam byung ba'i sngon du gnod sbyin pa khog tu zhugs te/ dar rtse mdo ba'i a po tsho/ mgo med kyi dpung pa rong rong de e mthong zer bas/ mdo pa rnams rnam rtog za ba'i mus la gtam gyis sleb/ de'i tshe grwa pa 'ga' zhig khyab 'jug gi 'phyar dar dang bcas ha ga'i rdzong gi mdun du phyin/ kha mchu lab par brtsams pa na ha ka rnams kyis ma nyan pas/ khong tsho'i mthong snang la rig 'dzin chen po nyid nam mkha' la 'phur te rdzong gi steng du byon pa dang rdzong gi phyogs bzhi nas me 'bar bar gyur pas 'jigs te mdun ma byed par khas blangs/ ha rka'i rogs byed mi rgya ljang gi dmag rnams kyang phyir log /de'i dus su rgya'i mi dpon gdugs dkar —530

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)nag phub pa gnyis kyis 'ongs te/ ha ka dang ling tshe'i kha mchu'i rtsa ba byed mkhan 'di tshos so ma ra tsa'i thag pas lag pa gnyis bsdams te btags/ 'phongs la ko sha mang po brgyab ste khrims bsgrags kyang bzlums dka' ba la/ khyed bod kyi bla ma byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi don la byon pa ngo mtshar che/ da dung 'di'i mjug rnams skyong bar mdzod/ nged kyis gong du yi ge brgyag ces zhus par/nga sems can gyi don bsam pa ma gtogs rang 'dod med pas de 'dra mi dgos gsungs/ de'i tshe kha mchu bzlums pa'i yi ge la phyag dam brgyab pa'i dar lcog ha ka dang ling tsi'i bar gyi zam pa la btsugs pa mi cig gis khyer bas chos skyong gi bka' chad byung nas gri khar shi /g.yul 'khrug rlabs po che zhi ba'i srog skyabs sogs rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rgya cher gyur/ dus 'khrug la brten rgya'i tshong pa rnams kyis snyug ma'i g.yabs ring mda' rgyang gsum tsam gyi 'og tu (39ba)ja 'bum tsam brtsigs pa srung mi bzhag ste phal cher rang yul du log pa las/ mdun ma grub nas gnyer pa rtse chen pas 'bod par phyin pas dga' ba dang bcas te yar 'ongs rgya bod kyi gser zam sor chud/dar rtse mdor phebs/ gtang rag gi tshul du bsnyen bkur rgya cher byas/ mdo der mi skad rigs mi gcig pa mang po tshogs pa'i stabs kyis rgyun tu zhabrug 'ong long bar snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang ba'i thugs bskyed kyis kha mchu mtha' dag zhi bar mdzad pa tshe/ mi chen dpon ngang ya ru mgon po gnyis lag thug byung bar bar pa la phebs pas/ sku la mda' rdo mang po phog kyang gnod par mi nus pa ni u rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bslu ba med pa'i mthu'o/ /sngar bla chen rnams byon pa la mdo ba rnams kyis bsdus nas mi chen gyi rwa bar brgya 'bul byed pa la/ 'di'i dus so sor brgya 'bul nas nyi shu'i bar stobs lor dang bstun te phul bas bla chen yongs kyi ngom gcig mo zang zing gi longs spyod kyang dbyar gyi chu bo ltar 'phel/ de nas sgar pa yar bteg /mi nyag brgyad/ skam po gnas nang du zhwa dmar ba drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug mjal/ 'bul ba ches pas sgar pa rnams kyi/ byang pa bdag po'i 'bul ba de tsam la dbu zhwa mi sgron par zhes blor mi shong ba —531

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)lta bu byed/ rje zhwa dmar ba yang kun la mi chos mkhas pa dang / khyad par 'bri byang gnyis sngar nasalugs legs pa'i rgyun la dgongs te dag snang dang legs skyes phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/de nas byang pa rig 'dzin dpon slob ljang zhabs su rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las skyong ba'i skabs kong po'i tshong pa dang ljang (40na)pa rnams gcig pa cher byung / de'i bar pa la 'ba' pa dpon po zer ba zhig gis gdan drangs/ thugs dam brtag pa mdzad pas ru yon zer ba'i ljang kong thug pa'i sa der dgu tshigs dang rgya gram du 'ja' nag po zhig tal gyi zug pas legs par dgongs te zhal gyis bzhes/ ru yon tu phebs pa na kong po'i dmag gis khang pa phal cher me la bsregs 'dug /so sor mi sna bsngags pa na ljang gi khrod nas dbang btsan pa sam pa k+shi zer ba cig gis/ kha mchu mi lab zer nas ma nyan pa thugs 'khrugs te khyab 'jug gi 'gyu dus kyi thun gtor bskul bas sam pa snyi sna khrag shor ba ma chad par 'das/ de'i rkyen gyis mdun ma yong ba'i 'go tshugs te dmag rnams so sor then/ljang kong gi dpon rnams drung du bsdus te dge sdig gi nyes dmigs sogs las 'bras kyi chos mang du gsungs shing lab dan gyis skor yang mdzad pa'i tshe/ kha mchu'i rtsa ba byed mi khams gsi ba'i tshong dpon gcig gis ma nyan par lang gi thog tu dmag dang bcas rta rgyugs byas pa la thugs 'ur nas khyab 'jug gi rten rdzas dang dbu zhwa brdabs pas tshong dpon de la zer ga thebs te rta thog nas lhung /nga la mda' thebs byung zer/ g.yog rnams kyis bltas pas mda' mes ma byung 'dug zer ba'i mus la 'jig rten phyi ma'i ltad mor song bas phan tshun thams cad 'jigs te bka' bzhin sgrub par khas blangs/ de'i tshe kong po tshong dpon khams sprug zer ba cig gis/ bla ma dang dga' lod chung / ga li ga li than 'dra ltas ngan 'dra mi gtong bar tab tob la mi gsod na sdig pa mi (40ba tha ba e min zer bas kun ba 'ad gad theg ge bar gyur/ de nas 'ba' nang du kong po gzhog lngas 'bul ba cher byas/ 'ba' khram mgos dngul gyi dong kha zla ba gsum phul/ rim gyis dga' rje gzhung du phebs pa na/ sngar de na dpon gong 'og gnyis yod —532

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)pa/ 'og mas gong ma bcom ste nyams yod pa las/ de'i tshe gong ma'i nye ba tshong dpon rta mgrin gyis ja pa rnams dmag rogs la sbran te g.yul gshom par rtsom pa na/ 'og ma'i dpon phun tshogs g.yul rgyal gyis rje 'di nyid gdan drangs/ khro bo rol pa'i gtor zlog mdzad pas pha rol gyi dmag rnams nang zhigs te/ sos kyi than sprin ltar gyur/ de nas gar lugs kyi dgon pa dpung ri zer ba'i khad nyer phebs/ dgon pa de'i chu mig bskams pa la rje zhwa dmar bas byin rlabs gnang yang / sems med kyi 'byung ba la 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi brtul zhugs ma song bas chu ma byung / de la brten phyogs 'dzin gyi kun slong dor nas rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid gdan drangs gsol ba btab pas chu mig khar phebs nas gtor ma zhig gnang / gtor chu rnams bskams shul der blugs pa dang chabs gcig par chu sgo nar gyi byung / dpung ri drung pa'i nga rgyal bye ma'i chang bu ltar zhig ste phyag dbang dang chos 'brel zhus/ rkarma pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i dbu thog gi bla bre dang hor tshags kyi spos phor sogs nor sna rngams che ba mang du phul/ gtsang pa sde pa mthu stobs pa'i g.yu drung dmar khyad 'phags zhig phyag tu byung ba spus sgyur byed par ljang du bla ma bsam yas rdzong sta mdzad/rgyal thang jag pa zer (41na)pa'i blon po zhig gis dngul srang sum brgya tsam bcal te nyos/ blon po des/ byang pa chos rjes nged rgyal blon gyi mnga' zhabs la 'brug pa bzlums pa'i bka' drin chen po byung 'dug da lta gang du bzhugs/ sngar bla ma 'di'i yab 'di phyogs su phebs skabs rgyal pos gdan 'dren zhu rtsis byas te/ blon po rgyus yod cig gis bla ma ral pa can de mgu na dag 'tshengs te ma dga' na yul 'di brlag nyen yod zer bshol 'dug /da khyod mgyogs par song las thag ring du ma phebs 'dug na mi thong / sa tham steng du gdan 'dren pa'i mi sna gtong ba yin zer ba byas 'dug pas/bla ma bsam yas pas myur du 'ongs na'ang dbus gtsang du mgyogs par 'byon dgos pa'i spyan ltas shig byung bas rkyen byas/ chibs kha bsgyur ta rme shod phyogs su 'byon rtsis la/ sog po'i dmag 'dug zer bar byol nas phebs kyang lam 'phyugs te sog po'i dmag dang nye sa zhig tu byung ba'i tshe/ sgar —533—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)pa'i so pa dang sog po'i ri dwags pa phrad pa na/ so pa'i khrod du bi ri dge slong go tsong grags pa zer pa'i sog skad shes pa zhig yod pas phan tshun du skad cha dri res byas/ bla ma yin na zhabs tog byed zer sde thog la gdan drangs/ bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba phul/ nged tshos gshen dar sdings pa'i sgar pa zhig la brgyab pas bon po'i mthus mi mang po shi /da khyed kyis mthu zlog mdzad dgos zhus par lan du/ nged tsho sngags rnying ma ba'i bla ma mtha' dmag zlog pa'i bka' babs dang lung bstan yod pa tshos sog po'i rim gro ba mi yong / gal te byas na u rgyan rin po che mi dgyes shing (41ba)srung ma rnams kyi 'tshub yod/ da lam khyed tsho'i sde thog tu lam nor te sleb sa zas tshol mi byed ka med byung gsungs par/ slar yang nan chen po zhus byung ba la/ de ltar yin na skya ser drag zhan su la yang dgra jag mi byed pa'i khas len bskor ba mdzad pas dpon dang mi bzang rnams kyis phyag 'phreng la 'jus nas dam bca' zhus/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i sgo nas mthu zlog gi rim gro gnang bas/ de'i dam sel dang 'tshub lhongs kyi rnam pas sgar la me shor te nyen chen po byung ba na na bza' lan gsum brdabs pas mar me la phu btab pa bzhin du shi /sog po rnams lhag par dad de bsnyen gnas gtan khrims dus khrims sogs dge ba'i lam chen por bkod/de nas yar phebs pa na/ dgra jag 'dug zer ba'i 'ur zhogs chen po zhig byung bas phyag g.yog rnams kyis tshes bcu bsgo/la nas thegs pa legs tshul zhus par/ u rgyan gyis bslus mi yong gsungs te cag mal mdzad nas gsung chog gnang pas nyes par ma gyur/ nyin gcig dgra 'di 'dra zhig 'ong ba 'dug pas 'phral du 'gro gsungs te bshad drag kyis phebs pa na/ ja yun gnyis tsam song ba'i tshe bzhugs sa'i shul der dge tshe dang lcags mo'i dmag mang po byung ba rjes su thos pas kun ya mtshan du gyur/ kre bo'i 'brog pa zhig gis rta drel ded pas dre'u'i sgal steng du phug ron babs pa dang rlung chen pos sbra gur bshags te nam mkha'i mthongs su khyer bas rtog bzos te phyir bshags pa dang bcas te phul/—534

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)rim gyis 'dam 'dog /sgom sde nang chen pa/ bi (42nas nge stod pa sogs sngar gyi sbyin bdag rnams kyi sar phebs nas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ 'brong pa bla ma mgon des lo phyed dang gsum tsam gyi bar srog gcod spong ba'i khas len las ma 'gal 'dug na'ang / nyin gcig ri dwags mang po byung ba la/ bi ri rnams kyis mda' thebs/ 'brong pa rnams kyis ye ma thebs pas tshig pa zos nas mda' brgyab pas sha ba gcig bsad/ des rkyen byas te zhag gsum tsam gyi nad yun byas nas shi bas/sngar lung bstan gnang ba rnams la thams cad nges pa ches cher rnyed/ dge rgyas dpon gyis/ khyed bod du phebs kyang gtsang pas bzang po e byed mi shes/ 'di phyogs su bzhugs na 'gro don che zhes nan cher zhus kyang ma 'ongs pa'i 'byung 'gyur mkhyen te ma bzhugs/ khyung po gser rtsa bas thab bsu dang bcas te gdan drangs pa'i nyin gzims chung skor gyi khal ma rnams rjes la lus pa khyung po nang ru ba rnams kyis jag byas nas khyer/ de nub sa phros pas byed rgyu ma rnyed/ sang sgar pa rnams kyis 'dzing bar 'gro grabs byas pas bka' bkyon nas/ de 'dra mi dgos rtags thon pa zhig byed gsung / bstan srung yongs rdzogs dang khyad par khyab 'jug la 'phrin bcol rgyas par mdzad/ de'i tshe jag pa rnams kyis nom pa thob pa la 'go bsha' byas pas/ sgam kha phye ba'i nang nas thog mar gza' phod don te gza' mig khra chil chil byung bar kun ha las nas hur re lus/ de'i tshe jag dpon de smyo nas/ nga'i nor khyer shog ces zla bo rnams la mda' gzhu bkang nas rdeg /(42ba〉dro'u zhig skas la thogs pa med par song ba la mi gcig gis lta bar phyin pas/ thog steng na bud med mig gcig yod pa zhig gis/ nga'i chas ka rnams khyed tsho zo zhig ces skad brgyab byung bas 'jigs skrag chen por gyur te sku chas thams cad gru tshang sgar pa'i rtsar bskyal/ gru tshang pa rnams kyi nged tshos khyed dpon slob yin pa ma shes/ thog ma nas phyag g.yog tu 'gyur ba ma byung bas dgongs ma khrel zhes 'bul chas dang bcas sku chas rnams tshang bar phul/ der dge lugs kyi dgon pa 'ga' zhig yod 'dug par mang ja gnang bas/ lung pa 'di bon lung du song / ban de la shin tu gnag pa yod par khyed dpon slob kyi nus mthus —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)kun gyi mig ltos la phan pa byung zhes gzengs bstod/rim gyis hor smad pa'i sder phebs/ dpon dbang klus bsnyen bkur/ lcum mda' gcong rong zer ba'i dge lugs kyi dgon pa zhig gi khris kyi zam pa la 'grul pa che chung su 'gro yang tshugs sprod dgos par/ khyed dpon slob kyis khams phyogs su mthu nus kyis ban de kun gyi mgo bton zhes tshugs mi len par ma zad phu dud byas/ lha ri sna dang 'dzam gling rdzong khar phebs dus hor tsha bar pa'i dmag jag mang po byung ba la/ sgrol ma'i 'jag chings mdzad pas hor rnams kyis ye ma mthong bar long po'i phur phebs/ ka thog dgon pa dang bcal sde sngags grong pa sogs la bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi sgrub dbang gnang / grol dbang gi nyin nyang long gi khrom stong phrag mang po tshogs/ chos dang zang zing la brten pa'i gdul byas 'ur la song / ci dkar lha lung myos kyi nang du phebs/ mar (43na)lam gter bzhes dus kyi gter g.yog bu mo sngo bsangs ma cig yod pa de la mda' dar dmar po zhig bskur nas sngon ma'i gter gnas kyi nub phyogs kyi brag logs mtshal gyi ri mo yod pa der tshugs gsung / slar yang gter bzhes rgyu yod rigs su 'dug /ka thog dgon nas chibs kha bsgyur/ nyang po'i phu na hor tsha bar pa'i dpon tshang gi sbra yod pa'i thog du 'bri gung dbon mos spyan drangs te rkyen sel gyi chos ka mang du zhus/ rta khrab sogs 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ hor ma rungs pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams kyang mtsho la kha ba bab pa ltar gyur pas/ rig 'dzin stobs ldan dpa' bos/ chags sdang rlung gis rab dkrugs 'thab krol shing / /'jigs rung ral gri'i yal 'dab g.yo ldan kun/ /rdzu 'phrulamathu dang rnam bzhi'i sbyin pa dang / /bka' rgyas 'dul bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /g.yin yang ma rungs pa'i rigs gdul slad khyab 'jug gza' dngos su phab pas/ kun gyi mig lam du me dpung chen po 'bar ba mthong nas byang pa bdag pos gza' bran du bkol zer ba sogasakyi grags pas khengs dregs can dang blo las su mi rung ba thams cad zhi zhing dul bar mdzad/ mdor na rgya ha ka ling tse nas bzung dbus gtsang gi bar gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs —536

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)pa'i sgo nas phan bde'i lam la bkod/ khyad par u rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad do/ /grub brnyes ma la ya yi dga' tshal nas/ /rnam snang thugs rje'i rlung gis rab bskul te/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i (43ba ji bsung yongs 'thul ba/ /srid zhi'i rgyad pa sel ba'i cho ga mkhan/ / legs pa'i lam ston rje btsun bla ma mchog /rigs ldan chos rgyal rdo rje'i gdung sras su/ /bsams bzhin rnam par rol ba'i thugs rje'i 'od/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i snang ba ches cher gsal/ /dri bral gter lung gis zin dza snu/ /chos tshul gaṅgā chub kyis legs btungs nas/ /bod dang bod chen phyogs bral gdul bya la/ /theg mchog chu rgyun chad med skyug de mtshar/ /de nas zha lha khang du phebs/ gnas gzigs dang khyad par khyab 'jug gi sku brnyan la spyan gzigs mchod gtor rgyas par mdzad/ 'bri gung rdzong gsar du gdan drangs/ zhal ngo rnams dang mjal phrad dbang lung man ngag gi gsan len zang zing gi 'bul skyes gnang res sogs sngar 'khyud bzhin lugs legs byung / de ni 'bri byang gnyis ka rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po'i slob rgyun rdo rje'i spun grogs dam tshig la bsel med pa'i rten 'brel du go /skyid shod bde chen gyi mdun du phebs pa'i tshe chibs rags kyi sngon du rgya mi gnyis yod pa la lcags sbag zhig rgyag 'jog pa gnang bar skad ma byung bas sde pa skyid shod pa'i mtshan don myur du 'jig par lung bstan/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang du phebs nyin nang pa rags kha ba'i mdun du me sbag zhig rgyag bcug par skad shin tu che bar byung / jo shag la snyan dar thus yug gcig phul bas de nub mnal lam du snyan dar gyi rten 'brel des gnas 'di'i bdag po la jus yags yong zer ba zhig byung bas sde ba gtsang pa la dge bar 'dug gsung (44na 〉 phyur du sa rta'i sde gzar langs te gtsang dpung g.yul las rgyal ba'i rtags su mngon/ byams khang ma gtogs pa'i mchod khang thams cad zhib tu mjal nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i smon lam rlabs po che —337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)mdzad/ ra ma sgang du gcung rig 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal dpon slob kyis bsu ba la phebs sku mched mjal 'dzom gnang nas rdo rje brag tu gzhis len dang bshang len rgyas par mdzad/ 'on kyang rje gong ma'i gdung la dpon rin po ches do dam che ba ma byung dgongs pa sogs kyi re 'khang la brten pa'i 'gal 'dzol cung zad byung /de nas sngar gyi mchod yon 'brel so dang bcas/ 'phyong rgyas stag rtser spyan drangs/ yun ring po'i bar du gdan chags/ zhabs drung bdud 'dul rab brtan de nyid la tshe dbang / bla ma zhi drag /tshe bdag 'char ka sogs kyi dbang lung gdams skor mang du gnang / ngos btsas nas ring por ma lon pa'i skabs der 'chi med lcags gdong ma dang gter kha gong ma'i drag dmar gyi sgo nas smin par mdzad/mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi srung 'khor sogs sri'u gso ba'i rim gro mang du gnang / 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi sgo nas gtor zlog rgyas par mdzad pa'i nyin 'tshams pa'i khrod du 'phyong rgyas zhabs drung de nyid kyang phebs yod 'dug cing / rig 'dzin chen po he ru ka drag por khros pa'i bdud chas su zhugs nas zor 'chams mdzad pa'i tshe phyag ya gcig ye ma khyogs par thugs rtog zos te brtag pa gnang bas/ sbyin bdag la ngan par mkhyen nas/ lo gsum tsam nas sku rim gyis(44ba)rgya ma 'khor na dgra ngo shin tu che ba 'dug tshul sogs slob ston mang du mdzad/ tshes bcu'i nyin las byang le'u brgyad ma dang 'brel ba'i gar 'chams shin tu rgyas pa'i gzigs 'bul gnang bas/ byang pa zhabs drung dpon slob thugs lhag par dgyes te u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du sleb pa 'dra ba byung phebs/ sde pa brag kha nas kyis bsam yas su gdan drangs/ khams gsum zangs mkhar gling du bzhugs/ bsam yas mchims phur dpon slob nyung 'dus zhig gis bdun phrag gcig sku mtshams gnang / chos gter zhig bzhes/ chos de thog mar chos rje dung dkar ras pa la spel dgos yod 'dug pa la khong pa gzhanadu brel bas rten 'brel ma 'grig /brag kha nas kyis khams gsum 'bul zhes thog mar khas len mdzad kyang / rjes su bsam yas rab byung ba rnams kyi g.yo thabs la brten pa'i thog tu ma khel/—538

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)dbu rtse rigs gsum gling bzhi gling phran rnams la dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa rgyas pa gnang zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas 'tshams sbyar/ bstan srung gnod sbyin tsi dmar pa la gtang rag tu mchod pa spyan gzigs gya nom pa dang bcas lha mi mjal ba'i dga' ston mdzad/ brag dmar g.ya' ma lung du phebs/ 'chi med tshe'i ljags bsnyen gnang bas tshe chu gsar du 'phel ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas byung / 'phrang 'go shel grong du phebs/ sku mched mjal 'dzom gnang /sa pho rta'i lo sde gzar chen mo langs te gtsang dpung lum par 'byor/ sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ de lo mtshan don (45na)rgyug pa dang rgya rgan ba sogs blon po 'ga' la ma rungs pa'i blo yod pa sogs thugs dam gyi ltas la shar ba gtsang par rgyu mtshan gnang ngam dgongs te phyag g.yog gtsang pa yin pa'i 'tsho byed zhig la gsung 'phros mdzad pas/ de 'dra thog tu bab na legs te gal te mi bden pa bzhin byung na sngar nas lugs mi legs pa dang bcas sde srid kyi thugs la ci 'char mi shes pas mi 'gab zhus par brten gsungs ma nus par snang / 'on sman thang du bzhugs dus tshag gzi rgyal phug gi chu mig tu char 'bebs la phebs/ sbyar sdong gi rtsa bar cog pu phub nas thugs dam gnang ba'i tshe/ sbyar stong steng gi skya ga'i tshang nas phru gu sa la 'gril byung bas mi shis pa'i mtshan ma chen por dgongs pa'i thugs rtog za ba'i mod la bang chen zhig byung ste 'phyong rgyas su dus 'gyur byung ba'i gnas tshul phul/ lo dus kyi nyin dzig yod pa'i lung bstan mdzad pa thog tu khel/ snga gong der rang la deng sang stod phyogs nas slob ma 'gangs che ba zhig 'ong ba 'dug tshul yang yang gsung ba ltar/ 'on sman thang du bzhugs thog sngags 'chang chen po shākya bzang po'i sku skye yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu dwags brgyud rgan po'i skyo ma snga btsan gyi ring lugs dor te/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa dri ma med pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i slad du 'byor/ tshe dbang lcags gdong mas thog drangs/ byang gter gyi thugs sgrub rnam gsum/ phyag rdor dregs 'dul sogs dbang lung gdams pa'i chos (45ba〉khor rgya cher bskor/ sprul sku rin po che nyin byed gling nas phyir byon te ring por ma —539

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)lon pas/ rtog ge pa'i nyams kyis tshogos 'khor gsol ba la 'tsher snang dang / dregs 'dul gyi las tshogs la sems can la gnod pa byed pa 'ba' zhig tu 'dug dgongs pa'i log rtog sna tshogs shar ba na/ rig 'dzin chen pos sprul pa'i sku la spyan gcer gyi gzigs nas/ gsang sngags rnying ma 'di la drag po mngon spyod kyi skor mangs pas thugs khrel yod dam gsung ba na/ mtshan nyid pa'i khyad gsod dang nga rgyal gyi nyam thul yul bud de/ bla ma dang chos la mi phyed pa'i mos pa gting nas 'khrungs pas rnying ma ba'i sngags 'chang du gtsang sing gi song ngo / /gtsang nas sde pa thob rgyal ba'i gdan 'dren byung ba bzhin 'grul du zhugs/ de'i tshe sde pa brag kha nas kyis/ gdan 'dren zhus/pa ltar phebs/ zhag kha yar bzhugs shing bsnyen bkur rgyas par bstabs/mchod yon gnyis ka nyang po gru la byon par gru pha rir 'gro ma nyan pa la 'on gyi gzhi bdag pho lha rgya rgod kyi lha 'khrin du dgongs nas/ gser skyems dang bcas bka' bsgos pas gru mda' 'phangs pa ltar song / de nas yar klungs phyogs su 'gro phan dang khra 'brug gi gnas mjal sogs mdzad/ rim gyis grwa dol brgyud/ chu bo ri nas byang khar don/ thog mar sde pa snye mo bas gdan drangs te phebs/dbang rjes gnang rim gro sogs 'dod sbyar gyi bka' drin mdzad/ de'i tshe snye mo'i la rgyab tu yol gor jing gis khrid pa'i hor sog gi dmag mang po sleb/ lung bstan tu byang kha (46na sko brgyad bshad pa'i mang tshan phag sna zer ba der sog zlog la dmigs nas rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen pos mchod rten nag po zhig bzhengs pa dus phyis bdag rkyen med par zhig ral chen po byung yod 'dug pa la zhig gsos mdzad cing sog zlog gi rigs gnang bas/ 'bri gung bshags ram sgrub sde ba'i bla ma des/ zhabs drung bla ma rin po che sku na bgres po la thugs tshodi chung ba/ phyag g.yog tshod yod pa cig kyang med pa 'dra/ sog po la rgyab tu sleb pa ga la bzlogs zer nas skur pa sna tshogs btab bas/sang de sog po rnams 'ur zhogs shig byung ste bros pa na mi kun ha las/ bla ma des kyang rigs rgyud dang sku skyes khyogs pa'i mthu nus yod bden yin pa 'dug zer ro/ /—340

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)slar thob rgyal nas gdan 'dren byung bas yar lam lhang lhang ma sogs gter gsar gyi gnas rnams mjal te thob rgyal rdzong du phebs/ gzhis len dang shang len rgyas par mdzad/ zab phu lung gi gnas mjal la phebs/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse nas bod kyi gzhi bdag rnams la bag chags stobs 'joms kyi khrus mdzad/ lha bsangs brgyags rngan dang bcas bka' nan rab brjid kyi sgo nas lha srin dam la btags/ de'i tshe na nam mkha'i mthongs su sprin dkar po zhig nar gyi byung ba'i steng du u rgyan rin po che bzhugs pa mngon sum du gzigs/ gter lung rnams rim gyis mjal ba'i tshe/gter lung brgyad par nye ba na phyag g.yog rnams bzhag ste chibs brgyugs mdzad/ ri sgangs shig tu sngon la phebs pa'i tshe/ gter lung brgyad pa'i mtsho ut+pal 'dra ba'i nang (46ba)pha bong zhig gi steng du 'bol sum brtsegs kyi gdan la u rgyan chen po ā tsar+ya'i tshul du bzhugs pa gzigs nas phyag mdzad par mngon du phyogs pa na/ nyam ring ba dge slong sbyin pa byung bas yal ba thugs la shin tu phangs par gyur pas/ rig 'dzin bi shā ḍā gis/ dgongs pa dbyer med gyur kyang chu zla'i tshul/ / rigs kun bdag po pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ /dngos dang sprul pa'i zhal skyin mngon sum du/ /gzigs nas ji bzhin gsol der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes 〈 sna/ /slar thob rgyal du phebs/ dpon sa yum sngar nas steng grib kyis zin pa'i g.yas star rgyud 'gul mi shes pa la byin rlabs mdzad pas gzhi med du gsos/ sdeb de spyir rnying lugs la gus shing de'i nang nas kyang rig 'dzin chen po'i brgyud 'dzin kho na la dad pa che/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang thob rgyal ba'i blon po gangs bzang ba'i mi ngo dpon po smon skyid pa zer ba de bla ma sog zlog par rtsa ba'i bla ma 'chol bas/skabs shig tu bla ma sogs zlog pa thob rgyal du byung ste/ snang rtse nas kyi gter ma'i lung bstan tu/ sde pa phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par yod tshul 'di bzhin yin zhes lung bstan khul bu bstan cing bsngags brjod chen po byas pa la sde pa des ci yin mi shes snyam nas lung bstan la bdag gir dang bla ma la bdag rkyen cher ma byas pas lo gcig gnyis song ba na khong gis/ snang rtse nas kyi gter lung du sde pa thob rgyal —541—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)ba bdud yin tshul 'di bzhin yod ces mi 'ga' la bstan cing bsgrags pa sde pas thos pa la brten zhe khrel te phyogs de la mi mos pa yin tshul thob rgyal ba'i drung 'khor rgyus can 'dras gleng ngo / /de rigs (47na)kyi 'phros don sde ba snang rtse bas kho rang mi dga' ba'i bla ma sde dpon mang por lung bstan ngan pa byas pas/ bya yul du 'brug pa sprul sku pad+ma dkar po dang rig 'dzin chen po mnga' ris pa gdan 'dzom pa'i tshe 'brug pa sprul skus/ snang rtse nas kyis khyed rang zhang blon khra mgo yin zer ba'i lung bstan byas yod 'dug /ngas khong bar lung bstan ngan pa zhig rtsom pas de khyed rang gi gter chos khrod du chug gsung ba la/ rig 'dzin rjes/ khong rang ci gsung rung nga ni u rgyan rin po che'i gter chos su gang 'dug las rang gi dga' sdug la brten pa'i bzang ngan 'jug mi nus/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad dang srung ma'i 'tshub yong gsungs pas 'brug pa zhal skyengs/ 'brug pa rang la yang lung bstan ngan pa yod snang ba'i lan len rtsis kyi las 'bras rgyab bskyur gyi rnam par 'dug pas/ tshul des kyang legs ldan rje la gzur gnas kun gyis bsngags par byed do/ /sdeb la thugs sgrub rnam gsum sogs kyi bka' dbang mdzad pa'i tshe/ byin phab pa na sde pa 'dar ba dang dgod pa sogs byung la/ rje nyid kyi phaṭa kyi sgra drag po dang bcas te/ de ga'i ngo bo la ltos shig gsungs pa na/ja dkar yol gang 'thung yun tsam ka dag la cham gyi gnas pa sogs las 'phro sad pa'i rtags ngo mtshar ba byung / yol mo sprul pa'i sku ched gnyer gyis byon pa la zla ba bzhi tsam gyi ring byang gter gyi phur pa lugs gsum/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag pad lugs dang gnubs lugs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i skor sogs smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi 'khrid/ rgyab rten gyi lung / las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i (47ba)phyag bzhes man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang / sde pa thob rgyal pa'i sku rim la khro rol tshe bdag sogs kyi gtor zlog che phra mang du mdzad/ e waṃ lcog sgar ba'i grwa tshang rnams re zhig sdo pa'i sku rim la thob rgyal du 'jog pa gnang nas dpon slob nyung 'dus dbus su phebs/ de dus gtsang skur zlos pa'i sde gzar chen po langs pa dang 'grig /yar klungs su sde srid phun tshogs rnam —542

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ zhenargyal dang mjal 'dzom gnang / mchod gzhis 'os 'ga' zhig 'bul sbyor mdzad/ byus thag chod nas dpung gyes gdong la dol sngon rdzong du gtsang pa bzhugs thog mjal bar phebs pas/ nyin mo sde srid thugs brel gyis g.yengs te mun rub pa dang gdan 'dren byung bas/ nga sngags pa dang mtshan mo mjal ba la dga' rgyu e yod mi shes gsungs/ gang ltar mchod yon bar du dam sel che ba dang / rje nyid pad gnubs kyi gdams pa zab mo la nang byan chud pa'i ltas ngan g.yang du lon pas/ sde pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'brum pa'i snyung nad kyis btab pa la zla bar nye nas kyang snag chu 'khor rgyu med pa'i gso byed mkhan po rnams kyis bcos su dka' ba zhig byung nas/ 'chi bdag be+e wa satwa'i sto ba'i grong khyer du gshegs so/ /de nas bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du phyag dang zhabs skor gnyis ka 'bum ther re'i sgo nas bsag sbyang dang / dkar me zhal zas sogs mchod pa nyin star gyis bshams shing / dkar me ru ba'i rgyun btsugs te rnam dkar gyi dge tshogs rgya cher spel/ dbu rtse rigs gsum gling phran jo mo gling gsum rnams kyi (48na)rten 'gangs che ba so so'i mdun du res mos kyis dus chen dgu'i gso sbyong bzhes/ bsam yas kyi sde pa'i jo mo la gnod sbyin chen po shin tu gnod par byung bas thabs zhus par rā dza rgyu lam gcod pa'i 'khor lo sgo la sbyar ba na/ chos skyong chen po thugs khros te spe dkar lcog tu lha mi 'dzom thog tu/ nga rang sha rang gis za/ rang khrag rang gis 'thung dbang mi 'ong ba ci yin/ khyod 'jigs na nga lus rten 'di las phrol nas lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum du skyol dang sogs 'jigs 'jigs mang du gsung ba la/ nga sems can gyi don byed mkhan yin pa la srung ba ni 'dogs dgos byung / rgyal 'gong phra rags dkyus ma'i rigs ma gtogs khyed bstan srung rnams la gnod pa ni ma byas sogs 'jam pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa la chos stong khro ba ma zhi bas/ rig 'dzin chen pos phyag gi rdo rje de phyar thabs dang bcas te/ 'o na bden pa su la yod blta bas khyed rang dmod bor zhig gsungs pa la/ chos skyong chen pos nas nam mkha' la gtor bas chos skyong gi phyogs su —543—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)nag po dang rje'i phyogs su dkar po babs/ de nas kyang 'tshub 'gyur ma zhi bas/ thugs 'ur te/ khyod 'jigs na nga'i gnas tshang 'gag gi yu 'bog sdong po 'di bsgyel thub pa gyis/ nga 'jigs na khyod kyi btsan khang 'gag gi dar po che 'di bskyel thub pa byed gsungs nas bzhugs mtsher du phebs/ khyab 'jug gi thun gtor gnang bas rlung tshub chen po zhig slo bur du langs nas spe dkar lcog gi dar po che bcag /mkhan tshang pa rnams kyis sde pa brag kha ba bsgul nas sde pas lha mi dam tshig sre ba'i bar zhus te spe dkar (48ba)lcog tu gdan drangs/ de'i tshe thang lha'i gsol ka mdzad nas 'di'i gnas srung thang lha la bcol bas khyod rang byed mi dgos/ u rgyan rin po ches ma 'ongs pa thang lhas byed par gsungs yod ces pa dang / khyod kyi srog snying nga la yod/ nga'i srog snying khyod la med ces babs lci ba'i gsung byon pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi tshe srog thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i phyag rgya zil gnon gyi skur bzhengs pa'i rtags so/ /de nas lha mi dam tshig sre bar mdzad/ chos skyong gi dbu la rdo rje 'jog pa sogs dam bsgrags so/ /zangs ri phyogs su ga jag pa 'phur ba'i tshe nyi ma sgrib pa tsam gyi mang po byung nas lo thog la gnod pa chen po byas par/ mi mang pos dar 'phyar ba/ dung sogs rol mo 'bud dkrol/ gdan sathil gyi rten byin rlabs can rnams 'ong skor du gdan 'dren byed pa/ zhwa dmar nag gi phyag nas gtor ba sogs thabs ji ltar byas kyang ma phan/ de'i tshe rig 'dzin chen po dbye'i chu tshan la phebs pa'i skad ca tshor nas gdan drangs/ 'ongs skor la phebs nas sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis byin rlabs mdzad pas ga jag pa rnams tsa ri dang yar lha sham po'i phyogs su bros/ de dag gi snyan pa la brten nas rong chad dkar du sde pa rgya ri bas gdan drangs/ lha ga rma chos rgyal ba de snang rtse nas kyi lung bstan 'dra la brten nas log lta zhig yod 'dug pas rang bzhin gyis mjal 'phrad las chos zhu ba sogs ni ma mdzad/ de'i tshe chad dkar rdzong gi bkang gso ba gnas brtan rgan po zhig gis/zhabs drung 'di rnying ma ba ma byas na yong ba 'dug ste byed/ nges par byed (49na)na byang pa bdag po —544

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)'di khungs btsun pa 'dug ste 'di la chos mi zhu/ khungs med rkyang pa la chos zhu/ rdzi chung zhes skur pa btab tshul brag sna chos rje sogs rgyus can 'gas gleng ngo / /de nas yar klungs phyogs su ga jag pa'i gnod pa byung ba la/ drung 'tsho blo rnam pa dang dmag dpon bzhi pos gdan drangs/ ga jag pa rnams sngar bzhin phyogs g.yin du song / de lo 'od ches pas shel brag gi ri nas shwa 'od dang rbab g.yag shad tsam mang po 'gril nas btsan thang dang de'i rgyud kyi 'ongs pa rnam la gnod par mngon du phyogs pa na/ spyan gyi gzigs stangs dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pas phar 'gyur/ bar skabs su than pa chen po byung bar rtses thang bstan ma'i chu mig khar zhag gsum bzhugs te char 'bebs mdzad pas char chen po phyogs kun tu khyab par babs/ rten mkhar de la thugs dogs zos te/ rten mkhar rnying pa de 'di min pa'i gtsug lag khang gi ltag der yod tshod du 'dug /bu mo stag lo ma ming dang dbyibs 'di 'dra ba zhig tshol gsung ba btsal bas rnyed/ de la bstan ma babs te lha mi thams cad kyis gtsug lag khang gi ltag der byon/ sa brkos pas sngar bsangs btang ba'i shul sogs thon pas nges shes rnyed/ bstan mas/ 'di ka yin zhes gsungs/ yar klungs stod smad kyi mi thams cad dad pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel/ thugs rje nus pa mngon mkhyen gyi sgra skad thon/ 'on du phebs dus shig /sku mched bar gyi sel zhi ba'i dga' ston la/ rgyal sras rnam gnyisalhan tu bzhugs thog grwa rigs sbyin bdag rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba (49ba)rgya cher byas/dbon rin po che sogs sgar dmangs 'phrang mgor bteg /rig 'dzin chen po shel brag tu sku mtshams la bzhugs/ 'di'i dus yi dam chos skyong gi gzigs snang dang lung bstan mang du byung / gong dkar du gdung brgyud nyag phra ba la/ bla chen dang bla chung sus thabs byas kyang ma phan par thams cad kyi phyag mdzod phug la sngon las kyi sgra bo che la 'bros khungs 'chol ba'i tshe/ rje nyid kyi snyan pa gsan nas gong dkar du gdan drangs/ sde srid phag mo gru pa'i dbu'i bla mchod du bkur srid 'phel gyi byin rlabs dang rten 'brel mdzad pas gdung rgyud 'khrungs te thugs mos je cher song /—545

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)sde pa thob rgyal ba 'grongs par thug nas rig 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal la gdan 'dren nan cher byung ste phebs pas/ rong gi chab tshan ma 'phrod par sku khams log ste 'phrang 'gor phebs tsam la zhing khams 'phos/ rje nyid brag khar bzhugs pa dang 'grig nas ngos kyis zhal mjal mthub kyang dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rgya cher mdzad/ dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gser gdung la zhig gsos dang gzungs gzhug rab gnas mdzad de/ yab sras gnyis ga'i phyi rten gyi tshul du bzhugs pas nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' sprin gyis khyab bo/ /brag khar phebs/ ga jag pa thog mar byung sa rgya mtsho sbug tu 'gong rdzongs mdzad pas de nas bzung ga jag pa'i gnod pa stod smad kun tu ma byung / slar drung 'tsho blo rnam pa sogs kyis yar klungs su gdan dngas/ bstan ma'i sku mkhar gsar pa la rten 'dzugs dang sger gsol mdzad/ bu mo lo dgu pa zhig la bstan ma babs nas/ bka' drin che zer nam mkha' (50na)la nas gtor nas/ rtsa gsum gyi lha tshogs mthong ba'i brda dang / dus rtags kyi lung bstan mang po zhus/ zur chen rdo rje 'dzin pa grwa skor la phebs/ dpon slob kyi rten 'brel thog mar 'grig /gong po ri'i phyogs bzhi thugs rje chen po'i yig 'bru re re rang byon du yod pa la/ rje'i yi ge rang byon de rig 'dzin chen pos gzigs te kun la ston pa mdzad/de nas za phu gdan sa pas bsam yas kyi zhig gsos legs par grub/ u rgyan chen po'i lung bstan na bod tsam na che ba'i sngags pa zhig gis/ rab gnas dang lha srin dam la btags na bod la bde skyid 'byung bar gsungs/ za phu gdan sa pas nyam khog tu chud de nges shes 'drongs nas rig 'dzin chen po 'di gdan drangs/ mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang la rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ has po ri'i rtse nas bka' nan rab brjid kyi cho gas lha srin sde brgyad thams cad dam la btags/ de la nan tan mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi lung byang las/ /bsam yas gtsug lag gso zhid bde 'dus kyi sgrub pa 'dzugs shing mnga' gsol rab gnas bya:mchod tshogs bzang bshams rtse brgyan dar phyar nas bod khams bde skyid dar rgyas 'gyur ro zhes:—546

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ (nyanalnga tshang 'brug gi lo pas sna drangs nas: bswo sgra bya zhing the le yang yang gdab: ces dang: has po ri la thugs kyi lha gsum bzhengs bsangs dang gser skyems bka' nan rab tu bya: zhes pa'i don la dgongs so/ /yar klungs dmag dpon bzhis gdan drangs/ bod chos rgyal gyi gnas khyad 'phags mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang (50ba)khra 'brug tu/ sngon u rgyan chen pos rgyal sras lha rje la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbang gnang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu'i mdun du dpal sgrub pa bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs rdo tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du sgrub chen btsugs/ rgyal mtho'i nang du chud pa'i dbang zhu ba sum brgya skor gyis 'dzab kyi thun 'dzin pa sogs phyag len gtsang zhing sman sgrub 'phel che la dri bzang pos phyogs kun tu khyab/ sgrub pa grol rgyu'i nub chos skyong tshangs pa dung thod can khog tu zhugs nas/ u rgyan gyi rnam thar gsol 'debs de gdangs ma byas thon gsung / bye rgya mtsho dang rnam thar dri med sogs mang bas gang yin dri bar gnang pas/ khyed rang la gsungs pa de thon gsungs/ sin dhu rgya mtsho che ba dpon slob thams cad kyis gdangs ma mdzad pas/ chos skyong 'chi ma 'don zhing snyan dar gyi khrod nas kha btags gcig bkrol te sku de la btags/ sang nyin u rgyan phebs pa yod pas thams cad kyis gsol ba thob zer nas phyir byon song / sang snga gro grol dbang gi dus khra 'brug gi ne'u thang chen po der khrom khri phrag tu nye ba tshogs pa'i tshe/ lho nub mtshams nas rgod gsum 'phur te khrom gyi thad kyi nam mkha' la skor ba lan gsum byas nas phyir log song ba na/ chos skyong tshangs pa ni u rgyan phebs byung zer brgyal ba'i rnam pa byed/ rig 'dzin chen po yang nam mkha' la gzigs shing phyag thugs gar thal mo sbyor/ dbang gi grol ston gyi bzhugs gral thog byu ru spos shel gser g.yu snam phrug nas sogs 'bul ba rgya che phul/ pho brang gong ri dkar por phebs yol mo sprul pa'i sku bka' chos kyi (51ba)'phros zhu bar byon/ gong dkar nyid du dbang lung mang du gnang / rim gyi rdo rje brag du phebs/ yol mo sprul sku gtso bor gyur pa'i phyogs 'dus gyi slob ma —547—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)rnams la bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi sgrub chen dang / gzhan yang mnga' bdag myang / zhabrul med kyi gling pa bcu gcig /byang chub gling pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ rdor 'bum cho ge grags/ mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde sogs gter kha grangs med pa'i dbang lung khrid man ngag dang bcas pa bum pa gang byor gnang / chos rje sha gzug pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs la/kun bzang dgongs pa zangs thal gyi khrid sprul pa'i skus mdzod ces skul ma gnang ba ltar btsugs pa'i lhun grub kyi dbang gi nub rig 'dzin chen po'i gzigs snang la/ dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dgyes bzhin du byon pa dang / thig le thig phran gyi dbus na zhi khro'i lha mang po dang khyad par thub pa chos kyi rgyal po gsal bar gzigs pa la/ sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i sems can la gzigs zhes gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs gnang / sang sprul pa'i sku la/ 'di ltar byung bas chos des gzhan rgyud smin par 'dug ces gsungs pas/ rig 'dzin yol mo pas/ ring nas rjes 'brel rgyal dang rgyal tshab tshul/ /chos blon gyis sprul stobs ldan shugs 'gro rtsal/ /smin grol gdams ngag mngon mkhyen 'byung 'gyur lung / /du mas rjes su gsol der gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par gang des zhi khro lhun grub kyi/ /dbang bskur skal bzang dang po'i 'khor 'dus la/ /gyis zhes bka' bsgrubasanyid kyi (51ba)mnal lam du/ /zhi khro'i lha tshogs gzigs der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /sde pa brag kha bas bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa la gdon chen po zhig gis bdag gir bzung ste skad 'don pa dang me stag 'phro ba sogs byung bar/ gter ston 'ja' tshon snying po gdan drangs/ skor ba bgegs sgrod sogs mdzad 'dug kyang / gdan sa thil pa'i chos 'don pa bcu gnyis tsam glo bur du shi ba sogs byung ste 'tshub ma zhi bas/ rig 'dzin chen po gdan drangs/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi sgo nas drag po'i sbyin sreg blugs pas gdon bgegs kyi ming tsam med par gyur/ skabs shig rje btsun bla ma zur pad+ma dbang gis thugs sgrub drag po rtsal dang gza' po ta sogs zab chos mang du gsan par phebs/ ma 'ongs pa na bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu 'gyur par dgongs te chos rnams gab sbas —348

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)med par lhug par gnang zhing thugs rtsigs nan ltar che/ pho brang sne'u gdong rtse dang chos rgyal pho brang sogs su gdan drangs/ rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel/ khyad par chos rgyal pho brang pa la lho brag sprul sku gtsug lag rgya mtshos gtor ma mdo sgrub sogs mdzad 'dug pa zlog thabs dgos tshul zhus par/ tshe 'char sogs 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgo nas rang gshed phab pas mi ring bar lho brag sprul sku gshegs/ sprul sku gong ma gtsug lag 'phreng ba yang 'brug pa sprul skus ngag mnan mdzad pas sku tshe'i 'jug tu ljags lkugs pa zhig byung 'dug /sku tshe snga phyi mtha' dag mthu byad du chud dgos pa'i las bsags pa zhig yin nam snyam/ bsam sdings su zhabs drung u rgyan mkha' spyod mtsho mo steng gdon gyis bsnyun pas gdan (52na)drangs/ bcos ka dang byin rlabs mdzad pas myur du snyun nad las grol/ khong dpon slob bo dong pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo yin zhes khengs pa che yang bsnyems pa btang ste tshe dbang brgya tshar sogs chos 'brel zhus/ sna dkar rtse 'brog khri dpon kun dga' dbang chen phun tshogs mched gnyis kyis gdan drangs/ tshe dbang 'gur drag sogs dbang chos zhus/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi gtor zlog mdzad/ 'on kyang gza' rwa gnad la mi phebs shing rwa zor log pa kho na byung ba ni mi 'gyangs par yar 'brog tu sog po rgyug pa'i rtags so/ /stod smad kun tu phrin las ches cher 'phel yang phal cher ni rdo rje brag tu stan chags/ phyogs 'dus kyi slob ma rnams la smin grol gyi chos 'bor bskor ba dang / rdo rje gsum las mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya'i sgo nas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bskyed rdzogs ka dag lhun grub kyi gdams pa zab mo sogs thugs dam nyams bzhes la gtso bor mdzad/ 'on kyang sde pa lha rgya ri ba'i blon chen gsol dpon rab brtan dang / gar lugs kyi grwa tshang nyin byed gling pa'i gnyer pa sogs stobs 'byor can mang po nad gdon gyis gtses pa la byin rlabs zhu ba/ lnga pa'i lam du gyur pa mang po'i rigs drug gnas 'dren dang gnas lung ston pa/ gtsang sde srid kyi dmag dpon dmag las pa sogs g.yul du 'jug pa rnams kyis mtshon cha'i srung ba/ bya byed legs nyes kyi blang dor brtag pa zhu ba sogs la stod smad —549

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)bar gsum gyi skye bo mtha' dag mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba bzhin du 'ong / de ltar 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang /snyan grags dang grags pa don dang ldan pa gnyis las byung bar snang / de yang khams phyogs su ma phebs gong gi snga thog cig rong bde skyid (52ba)pas gdan drangs/ chibs las babs pa dang mnyam du rdo la zhabs rjes gsal bar byung zhing / rdo rje brag gi ltag sgo'i rdo la zhabs rjes gsal bar bzhags pas sku 'khor 'dras 'di ltar snang zhes zhus pas/ sbas pa'i tshul gyis/ nga'i min yol mo sprul sku rin po che'i yin nam zhes grang so gter ston par zol gyis kha bsgyur bar mdzad nas dngos su zhal gyis mi bzhes/ ga 'a na yang phyag 'khas kyi rjes du ma byung bar grags/de ni zur chung shes rab grags kyis rdzogs chen gyi lta ba klong du gyur pas/ chos kun gyi rdzun mtshang rig ste thams cad ka nas dag pas rdos bcas kyi rang tshugs zhig ste phyag gis ka ba la phar yug tshur yug mdzad pas zang thal le byung ba dang 'dra bar snang bas/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba chen pos/ kun rdzob chos kyi rang tshang kun gzigs pa'i/ /'phags chen khyod ngor sra 'khregs la sogs kyis/ /rang mtshan 'dzin par ma nus rdo ba'i ngos/ /zhabs rjes mang du byon der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /skabs shig thob rgyal du phebs dus/ rje legs ldan zhabs kyi zhal slob sngags pa rgan po zhig la ming nas bos te ngos 'dzin gnang bar/ da sku na tshod 'di tsam la sngon gnas rjes dran dka' snyam tshe/khyod la ngas dung chos gzungs thag byin pa de e yod gnang bas kho smra mi shes pa'i nges shes kyis dad pa thob nas dus phyis kyang de 'dra'i ya mtshan pa zhes yang yang zer skad/sngags 'chang kun bzang dbang po sku tshe sngon ma'i dus kyi slob ma grub chen tshe 'phel bzang po zhes pad+ma gling pa'i gter byon drag dmar gyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa dang dgos sgrub thams cad mthar phyin pa de'i skye ba yin 'dug pa'i bag chags kyis thugs (53na)rtsigs nan ltar che bas/khong pa mkha' spyod ri khrod du 'brum 'dzem gyi mtshams byas par rje 'di 'phral 'phral phebs kyi yod snang bar/ sang phebs rgyu yin na rtags ngo mtshar ba re nges par 'byung bas grogs rnams la/ sang —550

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)rig 'dzin bla ma de phebs par 'dug ces byas tshad thog kho nar khel bas bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis slob ma yang mngon shes thogs med yod pa 'dra byung bar gda'/ mi shi ba'i dus kyi skye brtag zhu bar byung tshe/ sngar thugs rgyus med pa tshor byad dbyibs dang babs 'di 'dra 'dug tshul/ skye ba khyed rang tsho'i bu sring nye rigs sam grong pa sogs su skye ba'i lung bstan dang / pho mo gang gi lus 'thob sogs 'phyugs med du byung ba'i dper mtshon na/ yar klungs sna mo gshag pa lha dbang nor bu'i pha kho rang gi bur skye/ dpon mor da lta sbrum yod pa 'di yin gsung ba lta bu dang / rtses thang zar bas khri'i zhabs stegs la sgam bzhag par/ 'di'i nang du rten zhig yod par 'dug /rkang pa bzhag pas bag tsha gsung bar/ sbyin bdag rang la rgyus med kyang sgam kha phye bas mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i zhal thang zhig byung nas dam tshig gso bar mdzad/ des mtshon zhi drag gi bya ba 'grub mi 'grub sogs gang zhus thams cad la yong mi yong bzang ngan lung bstan kun 'khrul med kho nar byung bas/ rig 'dzin yol mo sngags 'chang gis/ gdod nas rab sbyangs dri med rgyal ba'i thugs/ shes bya'i snang brnyan yongs rdzogs me long ngos/ /'gog med ji ltar shar bzhin dus gsum lung / /thogs med cir yang ston der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /yab chos kyi rgyal po bkris stobs rgyal gyi dus/ e waṃ lcog sgar bar thugs (53ba)sgrub gsum dang 'jam dpal zil gnon sogs kyi chog sgrigs gdangs dbyangs rol tshig gar 'chams/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi phyag len/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor sogs spros bcas spros med kyi nyams len sngar yod dar rgyas dang / sngar med gsar 'dzugs kyi sgo nas rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bstan pa spel bar mdzad pas/ grang sogater ston gyis thun drug g.yel ba med brtson gsol 'debs rgyun/ /rab 'byamasazhi khro'i lha tshogs mchod cing skul/ /rim gnyis rnal 'byor spel dgongs lcog sgar gyi/ /'dus sde rgyas par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /spyi lung las/stod nas lag pa'i dmag dpung g.yo: dbus gtsang g.yo zhing sa yul 'phyugs: smad nas hor —551—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)sog byang phyogs 'joms lho rgyud kun tu khol bur g.yo: kha skad lo re zla rer 'gyur: zhes dang / char chu mi rtag sgang gshongs che: lo nyes sad ser mu ge 'byung: gnam la 'od chen skya rengs 'char: de mthong snying 'phyo mi dge dran: nam mkha' khrag mdog sprin dmar mang: hang skya bud chos sa gzhi gang gung thang rje blon rtsod cing 'brug ces dang / 'bri stag rtsod cing hor kha zug: hor dang ga tshe bsdebasaso kha ral: dbus gtsang sa bcud zhan cing nyams: zhes sogs mdor na gter kha snga phyi mang po nas/bod du stod smad kyi hor sogs lhags nas 'gro ba rnams nyam thag pa dang / bod nang 'khrugs nas sdug bsngal mang du 'byung bar gsungs shing / de yang sngar sa skya pas rgya hor gyi dmag khrid nas 'bri khung pas gtsos yul khams mang du bcom/ 'bri khung pas stod hor gyi dmag 'bum tsam sa skya pa'i thog tu drangs (54na)karma pas dge lugs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i grub mtha' mi gcig pa tsho gzhom par 'dod nas bod nang 'brug gi ched du kong po gar srid bsgrigs/ bsam sbyor ngan pa de dag gi lan du dge lugs kyi hor dmag bod du drangs pa sogs shin tu mang de rnams kyi dus so so dang mtshungs par zlog thabs kyi zab gter 'don pa'i skyes bu gu ru chos dbang dang / pad+ma las 'brel rtsal mchog ldan mgon po sogs mang po rim par byon te bka' babs ltar bod kyi bde thabs mang du mdzad pa'i dus tshod phyi ma tsho'i hor sog zlog pa'i bka' babs kyi lung bstan dpal bkris stobs rgyal yab sras la yod kyang / skye bo skal dman mang pos sog zlog pa'i ming can blo gros rgyal mtshan rgyud bcas kyis zlog tu re nas/ sngags 'chang yab sras rnams la bod bde thabs mdzad dgos par ma gsol bas rten 'brel 'phyugs par snang mod/ 'on kyang rig 'dzin chen po nyid rdo rje brag tu gdan chags pa nas bzung lung bstan snga phyi rnams nas byung ba ltar bod kyi bde thabs kyi ched du sog zlog mang du mdzad/ khyad par khar kha chog thu'i bu a sa lang hong tha'i jis gtsos pa'i dmag khri phrag tu nye ba bod du sleb/ zhwa dmar rab 'byams pa/ yang ri skya che bla ma/ zur ri dpal ldan bla ma sogasadar lugs pa rnams kyis dbyen bcos te sde srid gtsang pa dang gnyen byed/ gnyis ga'i bla mchod —552

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)gar lugs la 'chol/ gtso bor dge lugs ming med la gtong / zhan gyis lugs sogs kyang yal 'jug pa'i thabs kyi gros ngan dang bcas gdug rtsub shin tu che bar ma zad/ a sa lang gis kur lugs pa'i gros dang ma bstun pas gtsang sde srid kyang mdzad dkar gyur te/ bod shing sgo can thams cad gsung snyan dril bu (54ba)'khrol skabs/ gtsang sde srid nas nus mthu'i khur can gyi ban sngags bon gsum thams cad dmag zlog byed du bcug kyang grags pa don ldan ni ches nyung bas/ rje 'bri khung pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas 'jam dpal tshe bdag dang khro chu sogs kyi sgo nas mdzad par bla tshe dngos su 'gyu rtags ya mtshan can byung 'dug cing / khyad par byang pa rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyis bsam yas mthil/ mchims phu/ sgrags yang rdzong sogs su phebs te/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad spyi bye brag /khyad par gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon rna cha brgyad dang bcas pa'i sgo nas mnan gtad sreg zor rlung 'khor skor ba/ khyab 'jug gi 'gyu dus brgyad skul ba sogs las sbyor mdzad pas sgrub pa'i skabs kyang btso rgyug pa/ byi'u sogs srog chags mer 'chong ba dang / hom khung du chud pa/ gza' rwa dgra phyogs su rgyug pa sogs ltas mang du byung / de mtshungs rig 'dzin yol mo bas pa snam dang phung po ri bo che sogs nas las sbyor mang du mdzad pas snga ma dang 'dra ba'i rtags sna tshogs dang / nub cig dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad rnams 'ongs te/ sngags pa lug pa lung pas btang ba yin zer nas mi mgo mang po khyer nas dkyil 'khor gyi mthar spungs pa gzigs pas/ sku rim do dam pa bde 'byor byang pa la/ 'di ltar 'dug /mtshan jus la skyon mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan sdo srid la zhus gsung bar snang ngo / /sog dmag yar 'brog nas ldog dus dmag dum 'dra thag nyer byung bar dbang phyug dmag zlog gi las sbyor mdzad pas/ dmag rnams don med du stong 'ur chen po byas te phyogs der gnod 'tshe ye ma byung / zla ba bzhi tsam nas ar sa lang hong tha'i ji spyo 'bog gi (55na)nad kyis zin/ sog po'i sbra gur mang po'i steng du thog babs/ mi dang dud 'gro la ltas ngan sna tshogs skyes pa sogs cho 'phrul —553

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)mang du byung / de nas zla ba bdun brgyad tsam na/ zhwa dmar rab 'byams pa dang chog thu mchod yon gyi slob ston ltar/ blon po tha'i ching gis ar sa lang dpon blon thams cad dus gcig la bsad pa'i nang 'khrug dang / chog thu rang yang dgra lag tu shor te ming gi lhag mar song ba'i mthu nus kyi lag rjes mgo dkar por song song sgug ma dgos par lo gcig nang du byung ba de'o/ /'on kyang gtsang pas rig 'dzin yab sras la drin gzo ma mdzad pas/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bus/ byin rlabs de byang pa bdag pos mdzad/ /lag len de yol mo sku skyes byas/ /kha po de kham lung bla mas ston/ /nom pa de rtse gdong bdag chen gyis blangs/ khong rgyal ba shākya thub pas kyang / /sems can la nye ring ma gsungs phyir/ /mtha' dang dbus mi la khyad par med/ /da mtha' mi'i bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /ces 'phral nyams 'char gyi tshul du gsung bar snang yang / deng sang bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos bod kyi rgyal khams la dbang sgyur ba 'di la dpags na bden tshig grub pa'i gsung du nges so/ /sku rim rnams bsam yas gtsug lag khang dang mchims phu sogs su mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan/ chos dbang rin po che'i mkha' ri'i zhu lan las/ nus mthur ldan pa'i sngags pa rnams bsam yas lhun gyis grub par tshogs: nag po bdud kyi chas zhugs te: 'gong po dgar dang mnan par bya: 'byung ba rlung gi 'khor lo bskor bka' 'gyur ro cog (55ba 'a thun bzung ste zlog zor bh+yos gdab mdos btang na: lo skor gcig tu sring bar gyur zhes dang / spyi lung las/ mchims phur dbang chen 'dus pa'i sgrub pa bya: bod kyi lha srin dbang sdud dam bsgrag bya: zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /'on kyang lo skor bar du mtha' dmag mi zlog pa ni/ pad+ma gling pa'i lung bstan kun gsal las/ rdzas rnams thams cad bsdus nas sbyin sreg byed btsan 'gong yam shud dmar po ar la gtod: rgya mi dmag dpon dgu bsad thod pa'i nang: bdud mi dmag dpon dgu yi ling ga bcug: shākya mu ni zha khas kyi 'og tu mnan ru bzhi'i chos mdzad thams cad dgongs pa bstan: cho 'phrul zla ba'am spre'u'i zla ba —554

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ (nyanal rgyud dang bstun nas nyin mo sngags la 'bad gtor ma mdos dang mnan sreg yang yang bya: bh+yo zlog zor rnams gshams nas chos khrims bya: nyan bshad sgom sgrub byed pa'i bstan pa gzugs: ri rgya klung rgya ling rgya la sogs gzugs skye 'gro sems can thams cad bde la dgod: de ltar byas na lo bcu'i bar du bde zhes byung ba'i lha sar byed dgos rnams shing phag lo sa skya bdag po mthu stobs pa dang / sa stag mnga' bdag phun tshogs rig 'dzin gnyis kyis phyag len sgrub pa tshad ldan med pa'i khyi ston gyi zan skyel rol mor bcas pa las sngags 'chang kha yod lag yod cig gis byas ma song ba'i 'bras rtags so/ /de ltar drag po mngon spyod kyi skor de dag kyang sngags chung ci rigs ltar man ngag phran phran 'dras stabs legs dus nus pa cung zad yod yod 'dra la/ stabs ma 'grig na rang gi sgo gsum gyis ngal ba bsten pa tsam las 'bras bu gzhan mi 'byung ba dang / la la rgyu mtshan med (56na)pa'i zan gong dar 'phyar dung 'bud dang bcas khyi rgan gyi dus ston sgrub par byed pa tsho dang ye mi 'dra ste/ byang pa rig 'dzin 'di nyid lta ba rgyab kyi gdengs dang ldan/ gnyen po stobs kyi bskyed rim dang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin/ man ngag la nang byan chud/ sdebargyad bran ltar bkol bsan/ rig 'dzin yol mo bas/rab brjid mig sman lhun po glog zhags kyi/ /smin ma rab g.yo gangs ri'i 'phreng ba'i so/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan bgrad ma mgon tshogs/ /bran 'khol mthu stobs bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar dug rlangs 'khrug pa'i dbus/ khams gsum skye 'gro dus gcig za ba'i kha/ /gnam sar gdangs pa'i gza' mchog rā hu la/ /'khor bcas 'bangs su 'khol der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /zur chen rdo rje 'dzin pa khyab bdag pad+ma dbang gis sngar rtses thang du gra bskor mdzad dus mjal zhing / lcags gdong ma dang / nyang lugs drag dmar gyi dbang gsan pa nas bzung yang yang du zhabs pad bsten nas thugs sgrub drag po rtsal sogs byang gter skor mang po dang / gza' pod kyis —555

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)thogs drangs pa'i dbang chos du ma gsan/ gtso bor 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon lcags sdig lcags 'dra sogs pad ga khu bas kyi gdams pa rnams gsan par 'di skabs phebs pas/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po sgrags yang rdzong du bzhugs pa dang 'grig /yang rdzong ni sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gnas yin pas/ rten 'brel shin tu 'grig pa byung gsung ste/ lcags 'dra'i skor nas chos tshan nyi shu tsam gyi ljags lung gnang / dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gter gsar dmi (56ba)gu ru'i skor/ gnas chen drag por zab gter spel: zhes thog mar spel ba'i gnas kyang yang rdzong yin pas/rten 'brel gyi che ba la dgongs te/ srog gtad lung dang bcas pa ched gnyer gyis gsol 'debs lam ltos par gnang / zur chen chos kyi rgyal pos yang rdzong gi phug pa gong ma'i brag gseng zhig cung zad brus pas rdo'i dung chung bzo bkod legs po zhig thon pas mthong ba kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ de ni dbus gtsang gi skal ldan rnams la snga 'gyur chos kyi dung rgya cher sgrog pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /nyin gcig tshogs khang du ljags lung gnang ba'i mus la/ rig 'dzin chen pos che mchog gi sku'i phyogs dbu 'dud pa dang bcas te phyag thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa gnang bar/ rgyu mtshan zhus pa na/ rdo rje brag nas 'ongs pa yin zer ba'i bud med 'jigs su rung ba zhig byung ba'i snang ba shar/ 'phrang mgo phyogs su 'brum nad zhig sleb med las che gsung bar/ de nas 'gyang tsam song ba na bang phyin zhig 'byor pas gnas tshul ji lta bar 'dug pas/ dpon slob rnams myur stabs su rdo rje brag tu phebs/ der zla ba gsum tsam gyi ring 'jal dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang lung man ngag phyag bzhes sogs kyis thog drangs/ gter kha mang po zab rgyas gdams pa'i chos kyis zur 'khor lo'i mgon po pad dbang gi thugs kyi bang mdzod legs par gtams par mdzad do/ /'a zha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dbang phyug rab brtan zhing khams gzhan du 'phos pa'i dgongs rdzogs su yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sder phebs/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan gyis phu dud rgya cher mdzad cing (57na)zab chos du ma gsan/ dpon slob gnyis ka —556

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur to/ /de yang / spyi lung las/ bdag dang rdo rje bdud 'joms smon lam las: gsang sngags bka' bzhin spyod pa'i skyes bu ni: glang 'brug 61 pa byang phyogs bkra bzang du mthing smug mdog can gter gyi chos la spyod: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po rgyas par byed:ces pas rig 'dzin rgod ldem dang / rig 'dzin 'di nyid lhan cig tu bstan pa yin te/ sku skye snga phyi yin pas rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi skye bar smos pa dgos/ glang gis rgod ldem dang 'brug gis rje ngag gi dbang po'i 'khrungs lo/ byang phyogs zhes pa'i byang gis byang pa bdag po'i rigs rus dang /phyogs zhes sbyar bas rgod ldem gyi zhakhrungs yul/ bkra bzang gis rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gter gnas/ mthing sprug gis gnyis ga'i sku mdog bstan pas/ lung zin gyi skyes bu mchog des bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje'i theg pa gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi zab gter brgya rtsa'i chos bka' rgyas par mdzad tshul ni/ dpal 'bri khung pa chos rgyal bkris phun tshogs dang / chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde mched gnyis/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba gsum pa dang / zur chen 'khor lo'i mgon po sogs gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i zhal slob kyi gtso bo rags pa brjod zin na'ang / bod kyi che rgu phal cher gyis drung du nye bar btud pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ sngon chad bod du lugs gnyis nas mngon par mtho ba dpal ldan sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs/ 'khon gyi gdung brgyud bdag chen mthu stobs dbang phyug /bod shing sgo can gyi bla dpon zung du 'jug pa sde srid phag mo (57ba)gru pa lha gzigs mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang / lho lung chen bco brgyad la dbang bsgyur te chos kyi rgyal srid kyis mngon par mtho ba 'bri khung kyu ra'i gdung 'dzin zhabs drung chos rgyal bkris phun tshogs dang / zhabs drung chos kyi grags pa mched gnyis/paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gdan sa pa rtse tshogs mkhan chen blo bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan/ gsang phu gling stod kyi gdan sa pa tshe'i rig byed 'dzin pa blo bzang rgya mtsho/ bo dong rje btsun u rgyan mkha' spyod mtsho mo/ gsang bdag las kyi rdo rje'i rnam sprul rje drung rin po che bstan pa rgya mtsho/ bsam yas dkar chen —557

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)sprul sku bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ mgos pad+ma gung btsan gyi rnam sprul grang so ba gsum pa gter ston bstan 'dzin nor bu/ de mo sprul sku lha dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ u rgyan chen po'i 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du gyur pa'i 'a zha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dbang phyug rab brtan/ dpal gyi dbang phyug gi sprul pa snang gsal ba ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ spyan mnga' tshul khrims 'bar gyi sprul pa lo pa kun dga' don 'grub/ kha che rin chen rdo rje'i rnam sprul kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan 'dzin 'a zha'i rigs las khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra'i skye sprul zur rigs kun bdag po pad+ma dbang gi rdo rje/ mdo rgyud dang tha snyad la lta ba'i mig can sha gzug pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal/ tshar lugs kyi bstan 'dzin glang bu chos rje chos skyong dbang phyug /'brug pa sprul sku rin po che yongs 'dzin dung dkar ba mi pham blo gros/ mnga' bdag nyang gi gdung brgyud smra bo lcog pa/ chos (58na)dbang gi gdung brgyud gnas gzhi ba dang lha ba ro ba/ u rgyan gling pa dang / sangs rgyas gling pa sogs gter ston mang po'i dbon brgyud/ zur gsang sngags gling pa/ pha dam pa'i sprul pa byang pa rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra bzang po/ nus pa'i mnga' bdag gung ru dbyangs dpon pa dpal ldan grags/ rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza'i skye ba zur gzhen nu don grub/ nyang ston sman lung pa blo gros mchogo gi rdo rje/ za phu gdan sa pa dbang gi rgyal po/ gnyags shel brag pa/lang gro'i sngags 'chang nyi phug pa dang / ri phug pa/ gter ston gru gu yang dbang gi rigs las sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ chos rje dbang chen lhun grub kyi brgyud 'dzin chos sdings pa/ bla ma 'dzom pa sgang pa/ spa gro chos rje/ bla ma khro phu ba sogs mdor na rigs rus skye rabs go sa stobs wor dang / lung rtogs nus mthu sogs yon tan gyi sgo nas mngon par mtho ba dang / grong sngags sgom chen bya bral ri khrod pa sogs bgrang bar mi chod cing / mang du thos pa'i dpyod ldan 'brug pa sangs rgyas rdo rje dang zhang lo 'jam dpal rdo rje sogs tha snyad rig pa la mkhas pa mang po/ g.yu thog pa'i sprul par lung gser zin pa byang ngos pa bstan 'dzin rgyal po sogs tshe'i rig byed pa du ma/ gnyags ban —558

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)nang ra ba 'jam dpal blo gros sogs skar nag rtsis la mkhas pa bla mkhyen mang pos drung du btud pa mtha' yas/ sde pa 'phyong rgyas pa hor ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa 'jig rten dga' ba'i rgyan/hor lha'i dbang phyug /hor bdud 'dul rab brtan te mched sras dang bcas pa/ sde pa yar rgyab pa bdud 'dul grags pa/ yar 'phrog (58ba)khri dpon sde pa sna dkar rtse pa kun dga' dbang chen phun tshogs/ kun dga' rgyal chen rab brtan mched gnyis/ gtsang sde pa thob rgyal pa/ drag kha nas/ lho mdo mkhar ba/ yar klungs chos rgyal pho brang / thon pa/ snye mo ba/ dgon pa ba/ lho brag lha khang pa/ lho brag gdang ba/ yar klungs bkra shis rtse pa/ zangs ri ba/ mon mkhar rnam sras gling pa sogs mdor na sdorigs nang so rnam pa sogs skye rgu mchog sman grangs med pas 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas zhus te gtsug tu bkur/ kun kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan pa dang bde ba'i lam chen po la sbyor bar mdzad pas/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bus/ 'od gsal lha brgyud 'khon dang skyu ra'i gdung / /rlangs sogs 'jig rten che rgyas gus btud kyang / /dul ba khyod la mngon rlom ma mchis pas/ /dam par bsngags 'os mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /mdo smad byang gling du: kha'i mun gsal nas/ /gangs can 'dzam bu'i ljon pas yongs dud mkhar/ /thugs rje'i rlung gi shing rtas rab drangs te/ /snga 'gyur chos kyi 'od stong lan brgyar spros/ /mkhyen yangs zla ba'i ma ma legs 'khyil bar/ /brtse chen snying stobs yol med rlabs 'phreng can/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i nor bu 'byung ba'i khungs/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i zlos gar 'di med byung / lha rigs dregs pas myos pa'i stobs ldan khengs/ /'phrog byed srid 'byar ral pa'i nor 'dzin mar/ /rnam dpyod gom pa gcig gis non pa'i 'phrul/ /byed po sngon med 'khor lo'i lag pa can/ /rig 'dzin yol mo bas/ ri bo dpal 'bar du thugs sgrub gsum gyi bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi skabs/ mkha' 'gro ma cig (59na)gis shog dril cig gtad pa gzigs pas/ da ni nyon dang stobs ldan shugs 'chang rtsal: 'di nas byang shar 'bar ba'i phug pa phu las can bu la —559

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)bka' 'di gtod cig ces bu mo bdag ni rag sha'i gling nas 'ongs: zhes sogs kyi mjug tu dpal gyi bka' 'di yongs la spel gyur na slo bur gzer btab bzlog dka'i pho nya 'ong zhes pa'i 'og tu mtshal tham kha yig la/ oṃ phya9hūṃ sa ma ya sirnyi hūṃ zer ba yod pa zhig byung / de nas lo shas song tshe/ gter 'don pa'i skul ma ngo mtshar ba byung ba'i rgyu mtshan rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang por zhu yig phul ba'i lan gyi slob ston ltar mdzad pas/ rgyang yon po lung nas kha byang dang rdo rje gro lod kyi sgrub skor zhig spyan drangs pa'i lung bstan du/ gsang 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du legs smin chos kyi blon po ni: gung btsan rdo rje lha 'bar khyod: dag dang ma dag skye ba'i grangs: bcu phrag gcig dang gnyis 'das tshe: dag pa'i skye ba dbyig mtha'i ming bong che sha dkar ba spu can: thi ba las gyur 'dod chags che: spre'u las gyur spro mi ring: btsun mo las gyur ngo tsha che ni tso las gyur smra la dga' brla g.yas rgyal mtshan mtshan rtags can: shar kong lo ma'i nang nas khrung gsang ming stobs ldan shugs 'gro rtsal: lnga'am drug gi nang son tshe nga dang phrad nas brda ston byed bco lnga lam ni bcu bdun tshe pad+ma can gyi bu med cig rnyed tshe tshe yi rgya mdud byed nyi shu gnyis gsum bzhi rnams la:nga yi chos dang phrad par 'gyur: zhes rang gter gyi lung bstan ngo mtshar can byung (59ba)ba bsnams nas dbus su phebs/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i spyan lam du phab pas re|ga ser la gzigs nas/rnal 'byor rdo rje'i sprul pa cig: bla mar 'ong gi gtsug tu bkur zer ba 'di kho bo yin par 'dugakhyed kyi gter dngos gzhi de thon la nged yang phan par gda' zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal sprul pa dbus su 'byung: glo bur rkyen gyis ma bsgribs na rgya bod hor gsum de yis 'dul: zhes pa 'di ngos rig 'dzin yab sras gnyis ka ngos 'dzin mdzad par snang / gzhan yang / glang phu se bo'i skye ba cig slob dpon tshul du 'ong gi bsten: zhes pa sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu/ dpal gyi rdo rje'i skye ba cig: gsang ba'i tshul du slob dpon byed: ces pa rig 'dzin u rgyan don grub/ ku mā ra yi skye ba cig dga' ba'i tshul ston bar chad sel:zhes pa zur dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas:pho gyong rgyal 560

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)mo'i sprul pa cig ma'am sring mo'i tshul du 'ong:zhes pa gter ston rang gi lcam sring sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma zhig /las smon mthun pa'i skyes bu zhig: grogs su 'byung gi snying la chongs: zhes pa rta nag sgrol ma phug nas/ g.yin ma ko jag 'jigs bral/ brag nag bdud 'dul/ sku skye 'chi med dbang po sogs lung bstan gcig gis gang zag so sor thon pa yang yod par snang zhing / zab gter de'i dgos pa'i gtso bo ni/ snyigs dus dam sri mir rdzu ba'i phung chen bla ma stobs chen bzhi: 'dul thabs nga nyid gro bo lod: phur thogs drag po'i sgrub pa yod seng ldeng phur pa rkang gang pa pad+ma dag gi las phur yod: de 'thon tsam gyis de gsum nyams: zhes so/ /dus rtags(60na)kyang / yos kyi lo la ngal gso byed: 'brug gi lo la 'brug ltar ldir: sprul la sbrul shun lta bur 'thor: de phyir yos bu'i lo la long: zhes pa ltar/ dus kyis gtugs pas sa stag gi lor sprul pa'i sku ri bo dpal 'bar gyi gter 'don par slob ston dang bcas rdzong sta mdzad kyang / gter ston dri med kun dga'i lung bstan gsang ba'i sbar skab na/ lho mon gtsang g.yag sa steng nas dur bcol zhes bya'i ming bzung nas: sgom chen chas su zhugs nas 'ong mig dmar khyab pa lag ring ste: log pa'i rdzu 'phrul sna tsho gis kyis tu ru ska yi dmag sna 'dren bod 'bangs thams cad rlag par byed: ming thos rlung khyab na rag 'khrid: bstan pa'i phyin log bskor ba 'ong: zhes lung gis zin pa'i 'brug pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis mon bod sdug bsngal la sbyor ba'i sde gzar mang du slang ba'i stag gi lo/ gtsang dpung lho mon phyogs su bcug pa dang 'grig: mda' dpon dgos lung pas jus rim la phag rir bzhugs bcug pas dus 'gyangs/ gter gnas la ma phebs tsam du/rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po gshegs pa'i gtam sleb nas/ dbus su 'byon dgos byung bas rten 'brel ma 'grig /sngar sde srid ga me phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang / lhun grub sgang chen pa gnyis kyisamanga' ris rgyal po yul phud pas/ bskul byang las/ de ltar mang yul gung thang gi khrod du bdud kyi sprul pa shan pa nag po drug gis rgyal po'i gdung brgyud brlag par byas bod kyi phung mgo btsugs:—561—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)zhes pa dang / stobs dang dpung che ba'i rgyal phran zhig gi snying du 'gong po khad na nag po zhugs te:de'i mthu stobs kyis mnga' bdag rgyal po'i gdung rgyud gang na 'dug pa'i gnas su phyin te 'thor ba rnam pa bdun byed (60ba)pa'i las ngan byed do: zhes dang / rat+na'i bstan pa spyi lung du btsad po'i gdung rgyud glo bur rgyal pos brdupa zhes dang / bstan gnyis gling pa'i kun gsal sgron me las/ mang yul gung thang 'thil 'di sa lha sras gdung brgyud gtsang ma cig dmangs kyis gri ru 'gum par byed:ces sogs lung bstan sngon ma mang por byung pa ltar bdud sprul du nges shing / gter gsar lung bstan du/ de phyir dam sri spun dgu yis: mtho 'tsham gter 'di 'thon pa dka' zhes pas 'brug ra lung pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang mda' dpon dgos lung pa gnyis kyang dam sri'i sprul par the mi tshom mo /khyab bdag dkyil 'khor kun gyi mgon po mchog /mchog tu yangs pa'i rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyun/ /rgyun chad med par babs pas gser ldan lto/ /lto ba yongs su gang de e ma mtshar/ /rgyal ba kun dngos dngos brgyud bla ma mchog /pad+ma 'byung gnas gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /gsang chen theg mchog mchog gi slob dpon du/ /rnam rol ngag dbang dbang phyug brgyad ldan rje/ /yang yang bsams kyang kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /'jigs 'jigs sngags rlom kun gyis zla bral ba/ /'ur 'ur me dpung dbus 'gying he ru ka /gsal gsal zhi khro'i zlos gar sgyur de rgyal/ /de ltar rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po 'di nyid kyis lo gnyis gsum tsam gyi sngon nas/ yol mo sprul pa'i skur gter dzos bka' rgya rnams rtsis len dgos tshul dang / mi ring par lha khang rten bzhengs kyang mang du dgos pa yong / nged kyang da lta dang mi 'dra bar bla ma gong ma zhes rtsis cher 'gro zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ sa yos nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu'i dus chen gyi (61na(tha snyun gyi rigs mngon gyur med pa'i ngang nas/ lcog sgar tsho gos par 'phral yun gyi slob ston mang po dang / sngar mi mdzad pa'i dri med bshags rgyud kyi 'khor rnams rjes su yi rangs te bshags pa'i le'u de tshogs la do nub rang tshugs pa byed gsungs nas dpal 'bar spar te dpe 'don gyi tshul du btsugs/ cho ga —562

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo ma' bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)grol rjes sngar ched gnyer du mi mdzad kyang / dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba rgyas par gnang ste gzims chung du phebs nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig zangs mdog dpal rir bsdus so/ /dgongs rdzogs kyi gral dbur sa skya zhabs drung mthu stobs pa phebs/ gdung mjal mdzad skabs gdung gi steng na 'ja' tshon gyis khyab/ de'i tshe rig 'dzin yol mo ba stod nas mar byon pa'i lam du yang / nyi ma 'ja' lnga sbrag gis bskor ba dang / nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing / 'ja' tshon sna tshogs kyi thig le tshom bu dra bas 'brel ba dang / gdung zhugs su phul tshe/ me tog dkar po khrung khrung gi sgo nga tsam pa'i char babs pas/ yol mo sngags 'chang gis/ snyigs dus log par spyod pas thugs phyung zhing / /sku tshe 'di yi gdul bya 'di tsam zhes/ /mkhyen nas dngos brgyud bka' yis nges mdzad de/ /re zhig zhi bar gzhol la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs bris bu mo'i lag pad kyis gtore ba'i/ /puṇ+ḍa ri ga'i char gyis mkha' srid khengs/ /zhugs su bzhun tshe sna tsho gos dbang po'i gzhu zhi/ /dar dpyangs mdzesapas mchod la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes so/ /dgongs pa rdzogs thabs phal cher grub pa'i yos lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig tho rangs rig 'dzin yol mo ba'i mnal lam du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor (61bcud lnga mu khyud nyis rim gyi dbus na rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po gangs zhu snam sbyar zab ber gsol ba/ phyag gnyis na rdo rje dang sku gsum rigs bsdus kyi tshe bum bsnams pa dang mjal bas/ yol mo rjes/ mos dge dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams mkhar/ /mtshon lnga nyis rim 'od kyi mu khyud nang / /zla rgyas dkyil 'khor shin tu rgya che'i dbus/ /nyid zhal gsal bar bstan der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /de nas rig 'dzin yol mo sprul pa'i skus thugs khur bzhes shing / /thig rtsa sogs zur chen rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis mdzad nas thub chen gyi gser sku bzhengs/ sgrub skor gsum gyi sgo nas rab tu gnas par mdzad/ 'phrang mgo gzhi pa'i bla ma 'tshams sbyor ga pas dam sri ma rungs par gyur pa de yang rten chen gyi 'og du —563

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 61)sngags rgod logs tri'i sgo nas mnan no/ /yol mo sprul pa'i sku bstan 'dzin nor bu gsang mtshan stobs ldan shugs 'gro rtsal du grags pa'i sngags 'chang chen po de rig 'dzin gong ma'i gdan sar bzhugs te phyogs bral gdul bya'i re ba skong bar mdzad/ nub gcig mnal lam du chu chen po zhig byang nas byung gtsang chu dang 'dres te lung pa thams cad gang nas 'gro ba'i tshe zam pa phra mo cig la pho mo gsum rgyu bar thar ma song ba zhig byung bas/ 'di dzi srid gtsang par lta ba 'dug /sku rim dgos tshulu gsungs kyang / chags sgos ltag rtsar slebs grub pa'i nyams kyis sngags 'chang mthu stobs can 'di tshor rtsis mi byed/ sa skya pa'i 'chams kyi bkra bkra hrig hrig dang / mnga' bdag dpon po phun tshogs rig 'dzin pa'i zobs la blo bkal bar snang / ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du nged 'phrad par ched gnyer gyis byon/ chos dbang rin po che (62na)dang rat+na gling pa'i gter rdzas khyad 'phags mang po skyes su mdzad/ de'i nub snga ma/sngags srung dang khyab 'jug gis thog drangs gter srung rnams dgyes pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can mthong / gter rdzas rnams la 'khren cha mi mdzad pa'i brdar go /gsung gleng zhib par byung /
