gnang tshul gang la dpags kyang zog po gter brdzus mkhan gyi rigs tsho dang ye mi 'dra ba'i dpal u rgyan chen pos rjes su bzung nges shes pa'i gter ston sprul pa'i skur nges pa rnyed/ yol mo sprul pa'i skus thugs khur bzhes thog lcog sgar bar mchod thebs gsar mchod sogs lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin bkod phul du phyin par gyur/ gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos/ chu lug lor nged sog yul du 'gro dgos tshul nan che bar rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyis brtag pa mdzad par/ da lta'i sog po 'di tshos gdan 'dren pa'i grags che yang don la phebs mi dgos/ lo shas na sog po 'di pa tsho dang bya spyod cha lugs mi mthun pa nyi ma shar phyogs yul skad rigs mi gcig pa'i sa nas gdan 'dren 'ong / der phebs dgos pa 'ong na'ang myur du yar phebs pa'i mtshan ma 'dug tshul gsung ba thog tu babs pas pho tshod kyi lung bstan mkhan po tsho dang ye me 'dra/ 'on kyang gter gsar de ka myur du —564

byang pa rig 'dzin sha gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ snyenabazhes thub na bod kyi bde thabs dang rig 'dzin nyid kyi sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i rten 'brel la khyad shin tu che na'ang / bdud kyi cho 'phrul 'di thabs zab pas gzhan rkyen sna tshogs kyis rim 'gyangs la song ba'i steng du/ rang gter las/ mi mthun bdud du babs pa ni klu gong blon po'i skye ba ni: bla mar brdzusanas thabs kyis smod bon po thang nag skye ba ni blon por (62ba)brdzus nas ya ga sgrog: bdud blon shing rtsa'i skye ba ni brnye'i gzugs kyis dam log byed ces pa'i lung bstan ltar/ dam log ma rungs pa 'ga'i mi bsrun sgyu 'phrul dra ba sna tshogs kyis bar du bcad de sku tshe dang 'phrin las mthar ma phyin cing / bar chad kyi dbang du 'gro bar mngon par mkhyen pas/ myur du rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i sku ngos 'dzin par dgongs te 'od gsal gyis gzigs pas mon mkhar rnam sras gling du 'byung bar mkhyen nas der phebs/ sprul sku 'brungs ma thag par dbang bka' kha yar gnang ste byin gyis brlabs/ las can gyi bla sgrub ces gter ston gyi sgrub pa byang gter gyi khyad chos chig brgyud ma de zur chen rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug par gnang / sprul sku rnam sras gling du zhabrungs pa de yin par kun la gsung zhing / dril bsgrags te don gyis mnga' gsol bar mdzad pa la brten/ da lta sprul pa'i sku blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs si'i sde/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i seng ge'i khrir bzhugs ba'i na pa'o/ /slar yang dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs rje tshad med pa'i mthu la brten nas/ las can rnams kyis zab gter sngon ma rnams kyi 'phrin las spel zhing / gsar du spyan drangs nas bod khams bde skyid phun gsum tsho gos pa la spyod par nges te/ rig 'dzin yongs 'dusakyi lung byang las/ shākya thub pa'i rgyal tshab nga yin pas rtsod ldan dus su bstan mjug gter gyis skyong:zhes dang / tshe sgrub bdud ni 'khyil ba'i smin byed bsnyen pa'i dbang rim bdud rtsi 'khyil ba las/ phyogasarnams kun tu dgongs(63na)gter spyod pa ma pa ci'i phyir lha rgyan thugs rje ma bzod do: zhes dang / tshebasring ba'i nyams 'a bdud rtsi rgyun 'byung las/ e ma bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rgyud don snying po'i mchog:tshe bsring cho ga rgyud las khol du ju phyi rabs snyigs ma'i 'gro ba bskyab phyir du yu rgyan gsung bzhin —565

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo1)nam snying bdag gis bkod: ces dang / rat+na'i spyi lung las/ thugs bskyed yod na gter kha dpag med snos las can bu mchog re la smon lam 'debs lhad med byin rlabs drod dang ldan pa'i chos: ma 'ongs 'brel tshad don dang ldan par 'gyur zhes sogs rgya cher byung ba lta bus mtshon par nus so/ /smras pa/ gdod nas ka dag kun bzang chos kyi sku/ /lhun grub zhi khro'i zlos gar longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje kun khyab pad 'byung sprul pa'i gar/ /rnam rol mdzad pas 'gro 'di skal bzang byas/ /zab gter yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po che/ /'phrin las rgyal mtshan rtser 'god rgod ldem zhabs/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i legs pa'i dpal ldan pas/ /bdud sde'i dpung tsho gos 'joms pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /a ho bsams shing snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mkhar/ /sprul pa'i nyin byed dkyil 'khor yongs shar ba'i/ /bka' gter chos kyi 'dab brgya bzhad pa las/ /phan bde'i sbrang rtsi'i nying khu ci yang 'dzag /dpyid kyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i phang ba na/ /a mra'i ljon pa lo 'dab g.yur za zhing / /phun tshogs mngar ba'i 'bras bu'i khur dud pas/ /mi zad ro brgya'i dpal gyi mdzod de 'dzin/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba de'i/ /(63ba)med byung rtogs brjod ngo mtshar rgya mtsho yis/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i dga' ston rab rgyas shing / /don gnyis nor bu'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rgyal tshab mi lhag byang pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang rig 'dzin rdo rje chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyan mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba'i ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ so zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal por grags pa'i zur lug bya lung pa'i gdung las son cing / gnyags dz+nya na ku mā ra'i rnam sprul khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa pad+ma dbang gi grong khyer ngag dbang bkra shis kun dga'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te/ za hor gyi rigs las lo rgyus smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/ rig 'dzin chen po yol mo bas mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs rnam grol chos dbyings ma/sprul sku phyag rdor nor bus mdzad pa'i byang gter bla brgyud kyi rnam thar bsam 'phel ma ṇi ga'i 'phreng —566

byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho/ 6)ba dang / sha gzugs pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung phan bde'i dpag bsam rab tu rgyas pa'i 'dod 'jo gnyis kyi nang gi rnam thar/ e waṃ lcog sgar bla mas zin bris rgyas par btab pa'i yi ge /gzhan yang ngag 'gros (64na)khungs ma rnams la brten na'ang / lo tshigs dang snga phyi'i dus sogs zhib par ma 'tshal ba dang / lcog sgar bla ma'i zin bris kyi go rim rags pa tsam 'dug pa'i la lar som nyi re gnyis snang yang mdzad pa rgya che ba'i tshig sbyor mang tsam byung ba rnams go rim gyi tshul du byas/ brjod bya'i don nyung ngur bsdus chog pa'i 'gangs che che'i rigs phyogs mthun du bgyi bar 'os pa rnams chabs gcig tu bsdebs/ lung bstan mang po'i khungs bsgrigs te rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dbyangs e 'char ba'i tshes la/ /gtsug lag lugs brgya'i sgo 'phar gcig tu phye ba'i chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo// // shu bha ma stu sa spru dzag snya/ / maṅga lo// //—567

〈gangs can khyad nor 〉 dpe tshogs chen mo'i bsdu sgrig dang las zhugs mi sna'i mtshan tho/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gtso bo/ blo bzang lhun grub/ dbang grags/ tshe ring /bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gzhen pa/ blo bzang stobs bcu/ phur bu chos 'phel/las zhugs mi sna/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ rgyal mtshan byams pa/ grags pa kun ldan/ tshe brtan rdo rje/blo bzang 'phags mchog /snyan grags/ blo bzang 'jigs med/ tshe ring ma/byams pa brtson 'grus/ spen pa/ lhag pa sgrol ma/ tshe ring chos sgron/ lha skyid/bsod nams dbyangs can/deb 'di'i zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ phur bu chos 'phel/glog 'phrul yig 'jug pa/ spen pa/ rdo rje mtsho/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ byams pa brtson 'grus/

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/tshangs po/mdun shog mdzes 'god pa/li can zhung /na(5 rin sne tu/ ni875/༄sto/rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang zlo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsang 'bam/ri stong/ sa / / / ra tsho ri ri me ra smi311(28ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang gis bsgrigs/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe byen khang bis bskrun te bkram/pe cin kru'u ci par 'debs 'gan tshad kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 9par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 9par par thengs dang po btab/deb tshad/78①la ri092bas1(16bsdoms pa'i dpar shog go25/58ma~Xs/tsho/80311—/byaXrdo)27gsung 'bum cha tshang deb 1 28yod la rin sgor/160000
